MsgLabels_station_01_msg_039.en:
This is the story of a mercenary band
caught in the shifting tides of empire...

They left no name in history but
the name of war itself.
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_039.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: This is the record of a mercenary unit / toyed with by the schemes of great powers...... /  / the deeds of mercenaries / who left no name in history.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_040.en:
The year 2089.
Early summer.

OCU Ground Defense Force,
1st Army Mechanized Division,
Border Guard Unit.
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_040.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human).
Literal: Year 2089 AD. / Early summer. /  / O.C.U. Ground Defense Army, / 1st Army Mechanized Division, Border Maintenance Unit.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 18th Mercenary Unit base, guardroom (barracks).

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_001.en: You must be the new hire.
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_001.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human).
Literal: You are the one who was posted here today...

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_002.en:
That's me.
Codename «E801:00».
And you are...?
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_002.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human).
Literal: Codename: «E801:00». / And you?

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_003.en:
The name's Rain.
I'll be your adjutant on this base.
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_003.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human).
Literal: I will serve as your aide. / I'm Rain.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_004.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human).
Literal: This mercenary unit assigns aides?

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_005.en:
Base rules. It cuts down on deserters...
And complainers.
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_005.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Yes, it's a countermeasure against army deserters. / It's the rule at this base. / Do you have some complaint?

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_006.en:
No complaints here.
But aren't you a merc too?
Deserter watch is usually
a job for the regulars.
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No complaint. / But aren't you a mercenary too? / That kind of deserter-watch role is usually / handled by a regular army person.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_007.en:
As you know, the regular army is
short-handed right now.
That's why they're hiring mercs.
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As you know, right now the regular army is / short of manpower. / That is why they are recruiting mercenaries.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...That's right.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_009.en: Have you had a look around the base?
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_009.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: By the way, have you gotten used to the base?

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_010.en:
Not yet, I only just got here.
It's larger than I expected.
Lots of ground to cover.
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_010.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: It's only been half a day since I was posted. / The base is also unexpectedly large. / Unfortunately I haven't got a full grasp of it.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_011.en:
Right.
Have you been to headquarters yet?
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_011.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: I see. / Have you been to headquarters?

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No?

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_013.en:
Commander Falcon was looking for you.
Do you know the way to headquarters?
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL), partly based on the group's revised line.
Literal: Commander Falcon was looking for you. / Do you know where headquarters is?

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_014.en:
Someone said it's next to this building.
I'll go now.
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_014.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: It was next to this building, right? / I'll go and see.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_015.en:
If you have questions about the base, our
maintenance chief Yuji Kinoshita will be
happy to help. Touch the old man's icon
on the bottom screen if you need to get
in touch with him. Confirm your selection
by tapping "OK" or pressing the A button.
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_015.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: If there is anything you don't understand about / the base facilities, touch the uncle icon / shown in the bar below. / The maintenance man Yuji Kinoshita will kindly / teach you. / Also, by the rules of this base, / when deciding on a choice, / touch the OK panel to the right of the choice, / or press the A Button.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_016.en:
Got it.
I'll get used to it soon enough.
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood. / I'll get used to it soon.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_017.en:
To cancel, touch the Back panel. Pressing
the B Button moves you to the Back
panel, and then the A or B Button cancels.
One more thing: here at the base, we just
call them wanzers.
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: When you want to cancel an item, / touch the Back panel. / Pressing the B Button moves you to / the Back panel. / Then you can cancel with the A Button / or the B Button. / Also, at this base / we mainly call wanzers / WAPs. / Please remember that.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_018.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human).
Literal: Were you able to meet Commander Falcon?

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_019.en: Heads up -- I'll be on this exercise too.
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_019.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human).
Literal: I will also take part in the exercise.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_020.en:
(I'm in the mercenary barracks now. The
mission briefing is at headquarters. That
should be in the building next to this
one...)
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_020.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: (This is the mercenaries' guardroom. / Taking missions was at headquarters. / Headquarters is next to this building...)

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_021.en: (This base is bigger than it looks...)
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL), partly based on the group's revised line.
Literal: (This base seems unexpectedly large...)

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_022.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: (Sortie.)

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_023.en:
You're the new hire, aren't ya?«g:24»
«E801:00», right? Nice to meet ya. Call me
Pete. I'm the base mechanic.
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_023.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: You the newcomer? / So you're called «E801:00». / Nice to meet ya. / I do the maintenance on the wanzers.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_024.en:
You must be the new ace!«g:24»
I'm Matt, one of the operators in this
company. Pleased to meet you.
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_024.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Are you the rumored hotshot? / I'm Matt, an operator. / Nice to meet you.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_025.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: ...Gabriel......... operator......

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL), partly based on the group's revised line.
Literal: Codename: «E801:00», is it. / Come in.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_027.en:
Commander.
Heard you were looking for me.
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_027.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human).
Literal: Commander. / It seems you were looking for me.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_028.en:
We don't love to rush the newbies
like this, but I want to see what you
can do in a wanzer.
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_028.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Sorry to do this right after you're posted, / but I'd like you to show me your ability.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_029.en:
Roger that.
What's the word on the enemy?
Any intel?
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_029.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Understood. / The enemy's information?

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_030.en:
...keep your britches on, kid. I know you
have experience, but we're not sending
you out on a mission just yet. You'll be
running a live-ammo exercise in the
Killhouse.
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_030.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: ...No, wait. / It's not actual combat. / I'll have you do a live-ammo exercise / in the killhouse for WAPs.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_031.en:
The Killhouse? You mean the
training grounds? If you want
me to prove my worth, put me
in the field.
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_031.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Killhouse... meaning the training ground. / I can't show my real ability in an exercise, though?

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_032.en:
Don't worry about your worth.
All our operators complete this
exercise before they're cleared for
field deployment. It's a formality.
You'll find an outfitted wanzer in the
hangar. All yours.
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_032.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Don't say that. / The exercise content is extremely simple. / Try to put all the WAPs set up / in the killhouse out of action. / I've prepared a dedicated WAP in the hangar. / The setup is already complete.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_033.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human).
Literal: Understood. / Sortieing.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_034.en:
Hold up.
Before you go, let me introduce
you to your adjutant.
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_034.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human).
Literal: Before you sortie, let me introduce your aide.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_035.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human).
Literal: That's Rain. / I've already met her.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_036.en:
Fantastic.
That's all, then. Head to the
Killhouse. Anything comes up,
you can talk to Rain.
MsgLabels_station_01_msg_036.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: I see. / Then that makes it quick. / If there's anything you don't understand, / you'd do well to ask her at the killhouse.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_037.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human).
Literal: Understood.

MsgLabels_station_01_msg_038.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Get ready for the live-ammo exercise.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_001.en:
I trust your meeting with the
Commander went well.
You'll have me with you on
this exercise.
MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_001.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: I will also join the exercise. / I'll support «E801:00»'s unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_002.en:
You know, this is a well-equipped
wanzer for a merc outfit.
The gun looks brand new.
MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_002.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Understood. / Even so, for a mercenary base, / it's well stocked with WAPs with proper parts.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_003.en:
Border control is a primary concern
for the OCU, so they don't have a
problem supplying us with proper
gear. But nothing is issued.
We pay for it all. Individually.
MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_003.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Border guarding is an important duty, so / the supply of parts itself is done promptly. / However, they are not issued to mercenaries...

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_004.en:
Understood. That means they'll sell us the
parts, so we better protect the border.
MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_004.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: I see. / "We'll sell you the parts, / so guard the border properly," is that it.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_005.en:
More or less.
Now, let's get this underway.
You'll notice your wanzer's armor
is resistant to piercing damage.
Just watch out for other
damage types.
MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_005.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Now, the exercise with live ammo begins. / The new parts have anti-piercing attribute. / Please be careful of attacks of other attributes.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_006.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human).
Literal: Understood.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_007.en:
Command here. Looks like
you're in position.
MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_007.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Hm. / Seems you're in position.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_008.en:
Alright, «E801:00».
You're up against four wanzers.
It shouldn't be a problem if
you keep your head straight.
MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_008.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: «E801:00». / Then let me see your skill. / There are 4 mock enemies. / I wish you luck.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_009.en:
Commander! Four at once -- isn't that
reckless in a live-ammo exercise? If the
new hire takes a direct hit...
MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_009.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Please wait, Commander! / I think 4 units right away is reckless. / This time it's live ammo. / If he takes even a direct hit...

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_010.en:
Sit back and relax, Rain.
Based on his file, even four
wanzers won't be enough.
«E801:00», here's your chance.
Prove your worth!
MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_010.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: No, you don't know his ability. / If the reports are true, even 4 units shouldn't be enough.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_011.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Eh?

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_012.en:
I can use the equipped items, right?
Then there's no problem.
Go ahead and start.
MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm allowed to use the equipped / items, right? / Then there's no problem. / Begin.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_013.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_013.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_015.en:
Before the enemy is in range, move to
the point marked GREEN. Your movement
range is displayed in BLUE.
MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_015.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: First, before the mock enemies appear, / please head to that green point. / The range you can move is shown in blue.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_016.en:
Yeah, I know.
Point confirmed.
Moving ahead.
MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_016.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human).
Literal: Yeah, I know. / Point confirmed. / Going ahead.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_017.en:
Good -- you know how to move.
Deploying squad Beta.
MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_017.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Quick, aren't you. / Then, mock enemies sortie.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_019.en:
When you select attack,
your attack range is shown in RED.
Select an enemy to target them...
MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_019.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: When you select attack, / the attack range is shown in red. / Select an enemy you can attack......

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_020.en:
"...then confirm the weapon.
Battlefield terrain affects accuracy
and movement cost."
Are you seriously reading me the
wanzer manual?
MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_020.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: ......after that, decide the weapon. / The battlefield terrain affects hit rate / and movement cost, so be careful. / Are you reading the WAP manual?

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_021.en:
I... my apologies.
I'll let you take the lead from here.
MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_021.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Excuse me. / I was treating you as a newcomer without thinking...

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_022.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human).
Literal: Commencing attack.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_023.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_024.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human).
Literal: I've been hit! / Withdrawing!

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_025.en:
Surgical precision.
Not too often we find a
pilot of your caliber.
MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_025.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Precise attacks. / As one might say, as expected of a seasoned mercenary.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_026.en: It wasn't much of a challenge.
MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_026.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: This level. / It's nothing much.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_027.en:
It was. We gave you a wanzer
with only a right-hand weapon.
And our trainer pilots are all
ex-army. You routed them
like they were children.
MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_027.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: ...Strong. / Even if they're exercise pilots, / they're pilots with plenty of training... / And to win completely with this kind of equipment...

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_028.en:
Simulated combat like this is
only so useful. Real training
happens in the field.
In a real battle, your weapon
breaks. Your squadmates die.
The enemy is unpredictable.
MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_028.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: No matter how much training you pile up, if you / haven't experienced real combat, it's pointless. / In real combat you're also expected to / handle the enemy's poorly maintained weapons. / This level is easy.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_029.en:
You're the real deal, that's for
damn sure.
You'll be compensated for this
exercise, by the way.
MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_029.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: I see, so your ability is the real thing... / Even though this was an exercise, there's a reward.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_030.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human).
Literal: Quite generous.

MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_031.en:
Consider it a bonus.
You'll find it helpful when it's
time to outfit your wanzer.
MsgLabels_tactics_01_msg_031.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Mercenaries basically pay for / their WAP setup themselves. / It's not much, but put it toward that.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: May I ask one thing?

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_004.en:
Yeah.
If it's something I have an answer for.
MsgLabels_station_02_msg_004.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Yeah. / If it's something I can answer.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_005.en:
I've seen your file. You were a decorated
member of a certain army unit. «E801:00»,
what kind of battles have you been
through?
MsgLabels_station_02_msg_005.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: The documents said that before coming here / you "earned distinction in a certain unit." / What kind of battlefields / have you experienced?

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_006.en:
Some of the missions I've participated in
could create conflict between us
mercenaries. Even close friends don't
reveal their past jobs, isn't that the rule?
MsgLabels_station_02_msg_006.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: ...Depending on the operations one took part in, / it creates feuds between mercenaries. / Isn't it the rule of mercenaries / not to reveal past jobs / even to mercenaries you're close to?

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_007.en:
Yes, I understand...
Then I'll change my question
to a theoretical one:
What does it take to survive in
actual combat?
MsgLabels_station_02_msg_007.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Yes, I understand... / Then I'll change the question. / What is the condition needed to survive / in real combat?

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_008.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Let's see...

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_001.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Luck.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_009.en:
Luck, I guess. I survived on the battlefield
because I was lucky. Nothing more than
that.
MsgLabels_station_02_msg_009.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Luck. / That I survived on the battlefield / is nothing more than having been lucky.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_010.en:
Luck...?
It takes more than luck to pilot
a wanzer the way you do.
MsgLabels_station_02_msg_010.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Luck...? / No, with luck alone you couldn't / pilot a WAP like that.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_011.en:
No. It's luck. Even the toughest veteran
soldier, if they take one stray bullet, will
die in battle. You can't predict the path of
every bullet flying across the battlefield.
Such a person does not exist. With good
technique, it's possible to lower the
chances of getting hit. However, there is
no guarantee that you can survive 100%.
MsgLabels_station_02_msg_011.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: No. It's luck. / Any tough veteran soldier, if he takes / a single stray bullet, dies in action. / There's no one who can see through every one / of the countless bullets flying across the battlefield. / So you don't get hit by a stray bullet, with technique / it's probably possible to lower the odds. / But there's no guarantee anywhere / of surviving 100%.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_012.en:
There is no perfect soldier.
But you've honed your skill.
And you've survived this long.
MsgLabels_station_02_msg_012.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: There is no strongest soldier... / That's why you polished your WAP piloting / technique and came through real combat.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_002.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Rules.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_013.en:
Rules are rules.
I can't answer that.
MsgLabels_station_02_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL), partly based on the group's revised line.
Literal: Rules. / I can't answer.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_014.en:
Yeah, I suppose so.
My apologies...
Maybe it was your discipline that
allowed you to survive.
Your dedication to the mission.
MsgLabels_station_02_msg_014.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: That's right. / I'm sorry... / It's precisely because you're faithful to duty and rules / that you were able to survive the battlefield, / is that it.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_015.en:
Maybe.
Does that answer your question?
MsgLabels_station_02_msg_015.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Maybe so. / Is that answer to your question good enough?

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_016.en:
Yeah, I feel that I understand your
strength... There's talk of an upcoming
exercise. The Commander will brief you.
I'll be occupied elsewhere, so I can't join
this time. Also, you are now cleared for
the hangar. Go there to modify your
wanzer's configuration and access the
shop. Yuji Kinoshita can instruct you
further.
MsgLabels_station_02_msg_016.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Yes, I feel like I understand / your strength... / By the way, word of an exercise has come. / Please ask the Commander directly for details. / I have a different duty, so / I can't take part this time. / Also, from this time the hangar / has become usable. / The hangar is a facility where you can change WAP equipment / and buy and sell parts. / Please ask Yuji Kinoshita / how to use it.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_017.en:
Understood.
I'll go see the Commander.
MsgLabels_station_02_msg_017.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human).
Literal: Understood. / I'll go to the Commander.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_018.en:
Commander Falcon will brief you on the
exercise. Remember to visit the hangar
now that you have clearance. There, you
can modify your wanzer. For instruction,
just speak to Yuji Kinoshita.
MsgLabels_station_02_msg_018.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Please ask the Commander directly about the exercise content. / Also, from this time the hangar / has become usable. / The hangar is a facility where you can change WAP equipment / and buy and sell parts. / Please ask Yuji Kinoshita / how to use it.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_019.en: I'm heading out on a mission.
MsgLabels_station_02_msg_019.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: I'm heading out on a different duty.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_020.en: (Nice of them to pay me for training...)
MsgLabels_station_02_msg_020.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: (I didn't think I could earn money in training...)

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_021.en:
(I should take some time to modify my
wanzer's loadout.)
MsgLabels_station_02_msg_021.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: (Let's do some setup right away.)

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_022.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: (Alright. Sortie.)

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_023.en:
Hey there, «E801:00».
I just finished some work on your wanzer.
The joints were basically shot.
How'd you manage that?«g:24»
I know it's war and everything,
but maybe you could try...
a gentler approach?
MsgLabels_station_02_msg_023.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Yo, «E801:00». / I did maintenance on your wanzer, but... / how do the joint parts get this damaged? / Treat it a little more gently, gennntly, / would ya.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_024.en:
I hate to say "looks like the
rumors were true," but...
Well, it looks like the rumors
were true! The whole
base is drooling over you.
Ripper job you did at the
Killhouse.
MsgLabels_station_02_msg_024.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Looks like the rumors about your skill were true. / The whole base can't stop talking about you.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_025.en:
The hangar... might be confusing
at first... Listen to Yuji...
And equipping items... easy to forget...
Even without a backpack...
you can equip up to four...
MsgLabels_station_02_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The hangar... might be hard to understand at first... / Yuji's talk... listen to it... / Also... equipping items... easy to forget... / Even without a backpack... you can equip / up to 4...

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_026.en:
We're receiving some guests. Officers
fresh from the academy. I'm making you
their sparring partner... You're to show
them the ropes down at the Killhouse.
MsgLabels_station_02_msg_026.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Yesterday, allied NCOs were posted to Huffman. / So I'd like you, rich in combat experience, / to lecture them on the feel of real combat / in WAP battles.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_027.en:
An exercise for the new officers.
...Roger that. Sounds fun.
The Killhouse again?
MsgLabels_station_02_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: An exercise for NCOs. / Understood. / Is the exercise in the killhouse from last time?

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_028.en:
Not quite. We added some
obstacles.
More interesting that way.
MsgLabels_station_02_msg_028.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Yes. / This time some obstacles have been placed.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_029.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: The number of participating units?

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_030.en:
A three-unit squad. Their weapons are
loaded with live ammo, so they get the
feel of real combat. Disable the leader's
machine, reach POINT B, and the win is
yours.
MsgLabels_station_02_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A platoon of 3 units. / To make them grasp the atmosphere of real combat, / they've been equipped with firearms loaded with live ammo. / This time, if you reach Point B while / making the NCO units unable to attack, / it will be your victory.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_031.en:
"Real combat," huh...
And if I happen to
miscalculate my shot and
kill this officer?
MsgLabels_station_02_msg_031.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Unable to attack means destroying / everything other than the body part.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_032.en:
No killing in the Killhouse. Your merc
contract will be terminated. Remember,
it's only an exercise. Slip past their fire
and make for POINT B.
MsgLabels_station_02_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm. / Avoid destroying the targets as much as possible. / Don't forget this is strictly an exercise. / Slip through their attacks and / head for Point B.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_033.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Understood. / I'll prepare at once.

MsgLabels_station_02_msg_034.en:
Despite the name, no killing in the
Killhouse. Slip past their fire and make
for POINT B.
MsgLabels_station_02_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Avoid destroying the targets as much as possible. / Slip through their attacks and / head for Point B.

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_001.en:
«E801:00», the drill is over
once you reach POINT B.
Disabling all opponents will
also get you the win.
You've exceeded my expectations
so far. Don't screw this up.
Treat it like a real mission.
MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_001.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: The moment «E801:00»'s unit reaches Point B, / or all 3 units are put out of action, / it's the second lieutenants' loss. / It's an important exercise that will affect future postings. / Go at it with resolve.

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_002.en:
Lieutenant Rick here.
We're all strapped in.
Awaiting instructions.
MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_002.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: This is 2nd Lt. Rick. / We were allowed to do full setup. / Awaiting instructions.

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_003.en:
«E801:00» -- POINT B
is marked on your map.
MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_003.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: «E801:00», Point B is here.

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_004.en:
Roger.
I can either make a beeline
for it, or cripple their wanzers.
MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_004.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_005.en:
(There's no way we can lose to
one washed-up merc.)
Weapons free, boys.
If he's so skilled, it won't
matter if we shoot to kill.
Besides... losing this means
I lose a promotion.
MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_005.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: There's no way we elite soldiers would be / beaten by a mere mercenary, but... / This posting is tied to promotion too, / so we'll shoot without holding back.

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_007.en:
All units at the ready...
Commence exercise.
MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_007.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Begin the training.

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_008.en:
Victory: Reach POINT B OR
neutralize all opponents.
Defeat: «E801:00»'s wanzer disabled.
MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies or / reach Point B. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_011.en:
Your setup... it's all wrong. Assault: you're
packing a close-quarters setup. You need
to know each weapon's characteristics.
The shotgun delivers high IMPACT
damage by firing a spread of small
pellets, chipping away at armor. Your
machine gun fires a stream of bullets that
do PIERCING damage. And that
flamethrower... It's an excellent tool, if
used appropriately. It delivers massive
FIRE damage to your opponent's
internals. Those are the basic three. And
mind each armor's type.
MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_011.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: ...Your setup is no good. / Assault, if it's close combat, understand / the traits of each firearm. / The shotgun scatters countless pellets / and shaves armor with the impact. / And the machine gun, weak per shot / but able to pour in many rounds. / The flamethrower physically burns the armor / and destroys internal functions. / Those 3 types are the basics. / Pay attention to each armor's attribute too.

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_012.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Hmm...

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_013.en:
From what I just saw,
I'm guessing you also haven't
studied how your COM works.
Do you even know what a
COM is? It enhances your
performance based on your
wanzer's specs.
MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_013.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Match it to the unit's specs, / and pay attention to the traits of the COM / that improves performance.

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Whoa! / I'm hit!

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_015.en:
Long-range weapons hit hard,
but they're heavy and the rounds
are slow, so accuracy suffers.
Pair them with a power-focused body
and high-accuracy arms.
MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Firearms capable of long-distance attack / are powerful but heavy, and their shells are slow, so / accuracy is low. / Choose a power-focused body / and an arm with high hit rate.

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_016.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Kh...

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_017.en:
You should already know your
shoulder-mounted launchers are
more versatile and more reliable
at range.
But they're useless up close,
and their ammunition is limited.
You won't always get a resupply in
real deployments. Remember that.
MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_017.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Also, a launcher equipped on the shoulder / has long range and is easy to use. / But ammo count is limited. / In battles where you can't resupply, / judge carefully when you use it.

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_018.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: N... no way!

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_019.en:
And you, Lieutenant...
You're using a Striker-class wanzer,
but you're not taking advantage of
its inherent mobility. Light equipment
makes it highly maneuverable.
MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_019.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: You're not making use of the Striker's / natural mobility from light equipment.

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_020.en: So it's not just about the pilot's skill...
MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_020.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: So it's not just / the pilot's skill...

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_021.en:
Strikers are built for melee.
That puts you right in the enemy's
line of fire.
Prioritize each part's durability.
Mobility without durability just
makes you a faster target.
MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Strikers are mainly for melee combat. / Naturally they're exposed to enemy attacks too. / Emphasize each part's durability. / Even with mobility, if there's no durability, / you're just a target.

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_022.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human).
Literal: Mission complete.

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_023.en:
That's it, huh... real combat.
So much for the simulations.
MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_023.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: So this is real combat... / Isn't it different from the simulations!

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_024.en:
Lieutenant Rick...
Report to headquarters later.
Your CO has requested a conference
with you.
MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_024.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: Hm. 2nd Lt. Rick? / Report to headquarters later. / You know what about, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_02_msg_025.note:
Source: the group's revised English (human), picked by Kiley.
Literal: R-roger...

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is something the matter?

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_002.en:
Are you and I the only
wanzer pilots in this unit?
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Are the WAP pilots in this unit / only you and me?

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_003.en:
Ah, that.
This base used to have eight
wanzer pilots, myself included.
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, that matter. / Before, this base had 8 WAP pilots, / including me.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's a fair size.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_005.en:
A few days ago...
Only I and one other came back...
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A few days ago... / The ones who returned were me and one other...

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Two returnees.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_007.en:
Yes. A merc named Buggy.
He was wounded in that operation,
so he's being treated at the
medical facility now.
Six didn't return,
our captain among them...
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, a mercenary named Buggy. / He was injured in that operation, so / he's currently being treated at a medical facility. / The mercenaries who didn't return are 6, including the captain...

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Did the others desert?

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_009.en:
No... we don't know.
We searched, but...
we still haven't found a trace.
They weren't the kind
of mercs to desert...
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, it's unknown. / We searched, but... / we still can't find their tracks. / They shouldn't be mercenaries / who'd desert, though...

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_010.en:
I see.
Any plans to bring in
replacement pilots?
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / Are there plans to replenish pilots?

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_011.en:
There are.
Apparently a few recruits made the
cut in today's exercise, too.
Ask the Commander for details.
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There are plans. / It seems a few high scorers in today's exercise / also stayed. / Please ask the Commander for details.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood. I'll ask.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_013.en:
Ask the Commander about
the replacement mercs.
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Please ask the Commander about the replacement mercenaries.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_014.en:
It sounds like this exercise will
decide the replacement pilots.
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems they'll decide the replacement pilots / in this exercise.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_015.en:
(I'm starting to get used to
this base.)
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (I'm starting to get used to this base.)

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_016.en:
(They sure love their exercises
here, though...)
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (But this unit sure has a lot of exercises...)

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Alright. Sortie.)

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good work on your duty.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_019.en:
I'm «E801:00».
My squad has no official name yet,
but we're with the merc corps too.
Pleased to meet you.
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm «E801:00». / The squad doesn't have an official name yet, / but I'm likewise in a mercenary unit. / Pleased to meet you.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_020.en:
Sarna, Chariot Squad.
I'm here to look over the new mercs.
I'm after one Assault pilot.
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm Sarna of the Chariot Squad. / I came to inspect the replacement mercenaries. / I'm looking for 1 Assault.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_021.en:
Chariot Squad.
I hear you've seen a lot of combat.
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The Chariot Squad. / I've heard it's a unit rich in combat experience.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_022.en:
There's some promising talent here.
We may end up fighting your
squad over recruits.
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There seem to be some quite promising people. / We may end up competing / with your squad for talent.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_023.en:
If it's an Assault you want,
no need to worry.
That position is already filled.
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If it's an Assault, no need to worry. / That position is already filled.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_024.en:
I see.
Then I'll scout freely.
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / Then I'll scout without holding back.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_025.en:
Hm.
That rookie shows real promise.
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hm. / That newcomer has quite good aptitude.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_026.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
Heard you knocked that stuck-up
little lieutenant down a peg.
Serves him right.
By the way, you thinking about
attribute defense? Makes a big
difference in damage, so keep
it in mind, ya hear?
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yo, «E801:00». / Heard you gave that swaggering NCO boy / a good whack. / Serves him right. / By the way, «E801:00», / are you properly thinking about attribute defense? / It makes quite a difference in damage, / so keep it in mind.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_027.en:
That lieutenant you took on?
Word is he's been sent home
for retraining.
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That second lieutenant you took on... / Apparently he's going back to the home country for retraining.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Miss Sarna...... is here...

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_029.en:
This time, I want you to size up
some pilot candidates.
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This time, I'd like you to look at / the skill of the pilot candidates.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Replacement mercenaries.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_031.en:
That's right.
We hired them to form a squad
with you as its captain.
You'll pick your own people
from this batch.
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / They're the ones newly hired to form / a platoon with you as unit leader. / So you'll be choosing your own subordinates / from this round of candidates.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Me as captain?

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_033.en:
Problem?
With your skills, it's the
obvious call.
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A problem? / With ability like yours, I judge it natural.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_034.en:
...I'm not leadership material.
Rain survived the last squad.
I think she'd make a better captain.
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I have a defect. / Rain is a returnee from the previous squad. / I think it'd be better to make her captain.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_035.en:
Nobody on this base has more
real combat under their belt than you.
Rain will be your second.
She was an excellent vice-captain
in her last squad.
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: At this base, there's no one who surpasses you / in combat experience. / I intend to make Rain your adjutant. / She was an excellent vice-captain / in the previous squad too.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_036.en:
...I'll follow your orders, Commander.
So it's a field interview.
The usual Killhouse?
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I'll follow the Commander's instructions. / So, it's a field interview. / Is the place the usual killhouse?

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_037.en:
That's right.
The candidates are already on their way.
This time, the exercise ends when
every target is out of action.
If any of them look useful,
report back to me afterwards.
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / The candidates have already been sent. / This time, if you put all targets out of action, / training ends. / If there are usable candidates among them, / report to me later.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. I'll start preparing too.

MsgLabels_station_03_msg_039.en:
The exercise ends when every
target is out of action.
If any of them look useful,
report back to me afterwards.
MsgLabels_station_03_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This time, if you put all targets out of action, / training ends. / If there are usable candidates among them, / report to me later.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_001.en:
This exercise is to see what you
lot can do.
Whoever puts the target out of action
gets a bonus once they sign on.
MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This training is to see / your skill. / Whoever puts the target out of action / gets a bonus after enlisting.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_002.en:
...Huh?
One guy against the four of us?
They must think we're a joke.
MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Hah? / Just 1 unit taking on / 4 units? / We're being looked down on.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_003.en:
...Or it means our opponent has
the skill and confidence to back it up.
MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...That means it's an opponent / with that much skill and confidence.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_004.en:
...Right.
What kind of hell must they have
been through... I can't imagine.
MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Right. / What kind of hell he's been through... / I can't imagine.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_005.en:
Unit 4, you're an Assault, right?
Want to team up with me?
I'll lay down suppressing fire
from long range.
While he's busy, get in close
and throw him off balance.
MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Unit 4 is the Assault, right? / Want to try cooperating with me? / I'll attack from long distance / as a feint. / In that opening, get in close / and try to throw him into confusion.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll try.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_007.en:
All units, come at me like
it's the real thing.
MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units, come at me as if it's real combat.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Then the training begins.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_009.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Kh... / Was I careless...

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_012.en:
You hesitate on the controls.
This isn't a game.
The moment you face an enemy in
a wanzer, you're one step from death.
You don't have that mindset yet.
MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There's hesitation in your piloting. / This is not a game. / You seem to lack the mindset that / the moment you board a WAP and face an enemy, / you're right next to death.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_013.en:
He saw my hesitation in
one exchange...
Understood...
MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: He saw through, in this one fight, / that I have hesitation... / Understood...

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_014.en:
Still, you have the makings of
a good Assault.
Get some real combat behind you,
survive Huffman, and I'd like
a rematch someday.
MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But you have good aptitude as an Assault. / If you build combat experience and / can survive in Huffman, / I'd like to face you once more.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_015.en:
Thank you, sir...
(...So this is a mercenary...)
MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thank you very much... / (...So this is a mercenary...)

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Damn! / No good, it won't move...

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_017.en:
You've got a knack for melee,
but you're not there yet.
Your evasion is amateur-level.
MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Your melee aptitude seems good, / but you've still got a long way to go. / Is your evasion amateur level?

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_018.en:
Tch...
Put me in a real fight and I'll
level up before you know it!
MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Kh... / Once I experience real combat, I'll show you / I can raise my skill right away.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_019.en:
If you want to be a Striker,
train your melee skill, FIGHT.
And build up AGILITY to protect
yourself from enemy attacks.
MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If you aspire to be a Striker, train the melee skill / "FIGHT". / Also build experience in "AGILITY", / which protects you from enemy attacks.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wah!

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_021.en:
Your long-range accuracy is
impressive.
But once someone gets inside your
guard, you can't do a thing.
MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Your accuracy at long range is something. / But when someone jumps in close, / it seems you can't do anything.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...That's exactly right. / I'm reflecting on it...

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_023.en:
When you set up, mind your weight,
put a weapon in your arms, and
train SHORT or FIGHT as well.
MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: When doing your settings, pay attention to weight, / and you'd better equip a weapon on the arm and / train "SHORT" or "FIGHT" too.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_024.en:
All units confirmed disabled.
Mission complete.
MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed all units stopped functioning. / Mission complete.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_025.en:
Four units out of action
in no time at all.
Impressive.
MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: In this short time, you put 4 units / out of action. / As expected.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_026.en:
They had no coordination.
I just took them out one at a time.
MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I merely destroyed one by one / enemies that lacked coordination.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well? / Did you find anyone who seems a bit usable?

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_028.en:
Yes.
Rough around the edges,
but there's talent there.
MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah. / Rough around the edges, but there are some with good aptitude.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_029.en:
Good.
You can report to me later.
MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good. / I'll take your report later.

MsgLabels_tactics_03_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00». / Congratulations on becoming captain.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_002.en:
I'm the type who'd rather fight
than give orders.
But it's the Commander's call.
For now, I'll go along with it.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm the type who wants to focus on combat / rather than command. / But it's the Commander's judgment. / For now I intend to follow it.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_003.en:
I'll support you, Captain «E801:00».
You just keep focusing on combat,
the way you always have.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I will support Captain «E801:00». / Captain, please keep focusing on combat / as before.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It helps if you do that.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_005.en:
I'll support you, Captain «E801:00».
You just keep focusing on combat,
the way you always have.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I will support Captain «E801:00». / Captain, please keep focusing on combat / as before.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gugoo...

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Is he sleeping?

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_009.en:
Codename: Champ...
As you can see, he's quite famous
in the fighting world.
Snoring away in a place like this...
I suppose that's a big shot for you.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Codename: Champ... / As you can see, he's a famous figure / in the martial arts world. / Snoring and dozing off / in a place like this... / I suppose that's a big shot for you.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_010.en:
...Sorry, Rain.
I have no intel on the fighting world.
When he wakes up, tell him
to go to his quarters.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Sorry, Rain. / I have no information on the martial arts world. / When he wakes, tell him to go to his own room.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Y-yes...

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gugoo...

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Hn, a sortie??

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_014.en:
Oh, Captain!
Thank you for picking me!
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, it's the Captain. / Thank you for hiring me!

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You're, if I recall...

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_016.en:
Codename: Oddeye!
Because, well, I've got odd eyes.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Codename: Oddeye. / My eyes are odd-eyed (heterochromia).

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_017.en:
Your eyes?
Huh. Silver and blue.
Is that in fashion these days?
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eyes? / Oh, silver and blue. / Is that kind of thing in fashion now?

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_018.en:
Hmm, is it?
I couldn't tell you if it's in fashion.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I wonder? / I don't know whether it's in fashion.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: C-Captain!

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_020.en:
It's not a fashion thing.
Oddeye's eyes are real...
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's not fashion or anything, Oddeye's eyes / are real...

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_021.en:
Oh, right.
Yep, they're real!
But sometimes I wear a contact
to make them match.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, yes. / They're real. / But sometimes I also wear contacts / to match one of the colors.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_022.en: I see. Sounds like a lot of work.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is that so. Lots of trouble, huh.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_023.en:
Well, I don't think it's
that much work...
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, I don't think it's that much trouble...

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_024.en:
What? It's tons of work!
Silver or blue? Silver or blue?
I can never decide!
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh, it is trouble. / Should I make it silver, or blue, / I'm totally torn.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_025.en:
Is there something wrong
with leaving them as they are?
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is it no good to leave them as they are?

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_026.en:
Oh! You're right!
If I make them match, my codename
won't make sense anymore!
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah! That's right. / If I made my eye colors match, the origin / of my codename would be gone.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_028.en: That settles it. No more contacts!
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll quit the contacts!

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_029.en: A mission? I'll go get ready!
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right, I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_030.en:
(With more people, we can take
a wider range of missions.)
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (With more members, there'll be more breadth to the missions.)

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Me, a captain... It reminds me of the old days...)

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Alright. Sortie.)

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_033.en:
I think that's all my luggage...
Oh, you're «E801:00», sir... right?
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I guess this is it for my luggage... / Ah, you're Mr. «E801:00»... right?

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_034.en:
I hear you've been assigned
to Chariot Squad.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Seems your posting to the Chariot Squad was decided.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_035.en:
Yes, sir.
Thank you for everything.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / Thank you for everything.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_036.en:
Oh, it's Unit 4!
Are you leaving already?
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Mr. Unit 4. / Are you leaving already?

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_037.en:
Oddeye... ma'am.
My codename is Tornado...
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Miss... Oddeye. / My codename is Tornado...

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_038.en:
Oops, sorry!
Tornado, right?
If you're staying on Huffman,
maybe we'll meet again!
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, sorry. / Mr. Tornado, right. / If you're in Huffman, maybe / we'll meet again!

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_039.en:
Maybe so.
Different squads, but let's both
do our best.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Right. / We're in different squads, but let's both do our best.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, I'll do my best!

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_041.en:
«E801:00», sir. Oddeye...
I should get going.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mr. «E801:00», Miss Oddeye. / Well then, I'll be going.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I wish you luck.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Alright, time to go.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_044.en:
Hey there, «E801:00».
Captain already, and you only
just got here, huh?
Go get 'em!
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yo, «E801:00». / Heard you became captain right after arriving. / Do your best!

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_045.en:
With your skills, making captain
was a given. Anyway...
Could you do something about the
snoring from that guy over there?
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: With your skill, being captain is natural. / By the way... / Can't you do something about the snoring / of the guy sleeping over there?

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_046.en:
...Oddeye, huh......Oddeye...
New parts... came in at the hangar...
Should I... tell her...
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Oddeye, huh...... Oddeye... / New parts came into... the hangar... / Should I tell her...

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Raid on reconnaissance unit

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sniping mission

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Accept

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hear about another operation

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Accept

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hear about another operation

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Raid on reconnaissance unit

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sniping mission

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_055.en:
Now then. «E801:00» Squad's
barely formed, but there are
two jobs on the table.
One: ambush an enemy recon unit.
Two: a solo wanzer sniper op.
Your pick, Captain.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Now, it's right after «E801:00» Squad's formation, / but there are 2 kinds of missions this time. / One is a mission raiding a reconnaissance unit. / The other is a sniping mission by a single WAP. / I'll leave it to you which to choose.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_056.en:
A recon unit ambush,
or a sniper op.
Let me see...
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A raid on a reconnaissance unit, and a sniping mission. / Let's see...

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_057.en:
The recon unit job, then.
Intel just reported an enemy
supply unit gathering on the plains
outside West Peseta.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The reconnaissance unit raid mission. / Just now, information came in from Intelligence / that an enemy supply unit is gathering / on the plains on the outskirts of West Peseta.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_058.en:
The plains outside West Peseta.
Wide open, good visibility.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The plains outside West Peseta. / That's open plains terrain with good visibility.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_059.en:
That's right.
«E801:00» Squad is to disrupt
and wipe them out.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / «E801:00» Squad, disrupt and annihilate it.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_060.en:
Roger that.
Any intel on the enemy unit?
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood. / So, is there information on the enemy unit?

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_061.en:
Transport vehicles with an
armed vehicle escort.
If they reach POINT B, we may
not be able to touch them.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's composed of transport vehicles / and armed escort vehicles. / Also, if the enemy reaches Point B, / we may no longer be able to lay a hand on them.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_062.en:
So the transports are
top priority?
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Destroying the transport vehicles is top priority, right?

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_063.en:
Correct.
And if you can, wipe out the lot
before they make POINT B.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / Furthermore, if possible, aim to annihilate all enemies / before they reach Point B.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_064.en:
Meaning I can expect the pay
to match the results?
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Which means I can expect a reward / based on evaluation?

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_065.en:
Naturally.
Set up to suit the job.
I'd rather you didn't botch
your very first mission.
Well? Will you take it?
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Of course. / Do a setup suited to the operation. / I can't have you failing from your first mission. / Well? Will you accept this mission?

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_066.en:
I'll take it.
Against vehicles, rifles should work.
We'll check our machines in
the hangar and sortie at once.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll accept. / If vehicles are the opponents, rifles are effective. / After checking the units at the hangar, / we sortie at once.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_067.en:
It's «E801:00» Squad's first mission.
Set up to suit the job.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_067.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's the first mission by «E801:00» Squad. / Do a setup suited to the operation.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_068.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The other mission is,

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_069.en:
The sniper op, then.
Before dawn, an enemy field survey
team landed at Freedom Airport.
Our agent there says they're
heading to Peseta tonight.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_069.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The sniping mission. / Before dawn last night, an enemy battlefield / survey team arrived at Freedom Airport. / Word came from a local intelligence agent that the / survey team appears to be heading to Peseta tonight.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_070.en:
Quite the big fish.
They'll have a decent escort,
I imagine.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_070.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Quite the big game. / Naturally a suitable escort unit / will be guarding it.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_071.en:
Send in a big force and they'll
spot us coming.
So it's one wanzer, kitted out
for long-range attack.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_071.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If we send in a large unit, the enemy / will detect it. / So, we'll do a sniping with a single WAP / fitted with equipment capable of long-range attack.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_072.en:
Get to the sniping point fast and
hit the vehicle the target's in.
The command car, right?
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_072.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Move to the sniping point as fast as possible, / and aim for the vehicle the target is riding in. / The command vehicle, right.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_073.en:
Right.
And your machine goes in
unmarked. No affiliation.
If you're captured, we can't
help you. Not one bit.
Keep that in mind.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_073.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm. / Also, disguise your unit as one of unknown affiliation. / Even if you're taken prisoner, we can give no support at all. / Undertake the mission with resolve.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_074.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is there support for escape?

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_075.en:
Of course.
Once the shot's done, get to
POINT A on the double.
We'll send a pickup chopper.
But after 10 turns, the chopper
heads back to base.
Well? Will you take it?
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_075.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Of course. / Once the sniping is complete, promptly / move to Point A. / I'll send a pickup helicopter. / However, if it goes beyond 10 turns, I'll have / the helicopter return to base. / Well? Will you accept this mission?

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_076.en:
I'll take it.
Looks like there won't be time
to bother with other enemies.
I'll gear up in the hangar
and sortie.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_076.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll accept. / In this mission, it seems there's no time / to bother with other enemies. / After getting equipment in order at the hangar, I'll sortie.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_077.en:
Once the shot's done, get to
POINT A on the double.
We'll send a pickup chopper.
But after 10 turns, the chopper
heads back to base.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_077.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Once the sniping is complete, promptly move to / Point A. / I'll send a pickup helicopter. / However, if it goes beyond 10 turns, I'll have / the helicopter return to base.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_078.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The other mission is,

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_079.en:
«E801:00», were you listening?
You've got two options.
Which one will it be?
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_079.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: «E801:00», were you listening? / There are 2 choices. / Which will you accept?

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_080.en:
Good. The recon unit ambush.
It's «E801:00» Squad's first mission.
Set up to suit the job.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_080.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good. The reconnaissance unit raid mission. / It's the first mission by «E801:00» Squad. / Do a setup suited to the operation.

MsgLabels_station_04_msg_081.en:
Good. The sniper op.
It's «E801:00» Squad's first mission.
Set up to suit the job.
MsgLabels_station_04_msg_081.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good. The sniping mission. / It's the first mission by «E801:00» Squad. / Do a setup suited to the operation.

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_001.en:
Enemy recon unit acquired.
As expected, they're heading
for POINT B.
MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy reconnaissance unit captured on sensors. / As expected, the enemy unit is / heading for Point B.

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_002.en:
Roger.
We take them out before they get there.
MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood. / We'll destroy them before they arrive.

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_003.en:
Just transports and jeeps?
These guys are sitting ducks.
MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Just transport vehicles and jeeps. / This is what you call easy prey.

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_004.en:
Vehicles or not, don't get careless.
Those jeeps are fast.
Read how far they can move and
get between them and POINT B.
MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even if they're vehicles, don't let your guard down. / A jeep's legs are pretty fast. / Judge the opponent's movement, / and get between them and Point B.

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is Champ, roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Operation start!

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_007.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_009.en:
All units, watch out for the
missile jeeps.
If they catch you when you're worn
down, even a wanzer will get hurt.
MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units, watch out for the jeeps / equipped with missiles. / If you're targeted when durability is down, / even a WAP won't get off unscathed.

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All targets destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Phew, so that's the end.

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_013.en:
Old-generation weapons like those
are no match for wanzers.
MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: After all, old-generation weapons / are no match for WAPs.

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Maybe so.

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_015.en:
Still, the enemy getting this close...
It could be the prelude to
something big.
MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But the fact that the enemy has come / this close / might be the harbinger / of some big operation.

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_016.en:
Agreed.
We'd better head back and prepare
for the next operation.
MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / We'd better return and prepare for the next operation.

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_017.en:
...Enemy has left the combat area.
We're too late!
MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Enemy has left the combat area. / We won't make it!

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Kh! ...That we can't catch up.

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_019.en:
I'm sorry.
I guess I'm still not used
to this machine.
MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry. / It seems I'm still not used to this unit either.

MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_020.en:
It can't be helped.
Mission failed.
All units, return to base.
MsgLabels_tactics_04_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It can't be helped. / Mission failed. / All units return to base.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_003.en:
Captain, it seems some missions
limit how many of us can sortie.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, / it seems there are missions with a limit / on the number of sortieing members.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_004.en:
Makes sense. Covert ops and the
like are often better done by a
small team suited to the job.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Indeed, for things like covert missions, sometimes it's better / to act with a small number suited to the mission.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_005.en:
So checking the mission details and
choosing which wanzers to bring is part
of the strategy, you mean?
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Checking the mission content and choosing which WAPs / to take along is also part of the strategy... / is that it?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_006.en:
Exactly.
Say it's a sniper op limited
to two units. A melee Striker
would be a poor fit.
Better to bring a Launcher
or a Sniper.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / For example, for a sniping mission limited to 2 units, / a melee-focused Striker isn't suited. / It'd be better to bring along / a Launcher or Sniper.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_007.en:
True. Each type has its strengths
and weaknesses.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Indeed, there's suitability and unsuitability.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_008.en:
Some missions limit the number
of units that can take part.
It's best to check the mission
details carefully before deciding
which wanzers to send out.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Depending on the mission, there may be a limit / on the number of participants. / As for which WAPs to sortie, / it's best to check the mission content / carefully.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh, Captain.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ. / Strength training in a place like this?
