MsgLabels_station_05_msg_012.en:
Habit from my fighting days.
If I'm not moving, I get antsy.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's a habit from my active days. / If I'm not moving my body, I can't settle down.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_013.en:
I suppose a Striker, whose reflexes
and fighting sense carry over into
the wanzer, could use strength
training at that.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Indeed, for Strikers, whose reflexes and fighting sense / are reflected in WAP piloting, / strength training may also be necessary.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_014.en:
Huh, that so?
So my workouts ain't a waste!
Hey, while you're here, Captain,
why not do some sit-ups with me?
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh, is that how it is. / So my muscle training isn't a waste! / Ah, since we're at it, Captain, want to do / sit-ups together?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_015.en:
No, I'll pass.
I train at my own pace,
when I need to.
Don't mind me. Carry on.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, I'll pass. / I train at my own pace / when necessary. / Don't mind me, keep going.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_016.en:
Right on!
Training at your own pace,
that's the key!
Figured I'd get chewed out for
doing sit-ups here.
But if the Captain says so,
sit-ups it is!
Alright! Hup! Hup!
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right, huh. / In training, your own pace is / what matters! / I thought I'd get scolded for doing sit-ups here. / If the Captain says so, / sit-ups without worrying! / Alriiight! Hmph! Hmph!

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_017.en:
Your own pace may be important...
but there's no need to brazenly
do sit-ups in a place like this...
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even if your own pace matters... / you don't have to brazenly do sit-ups / in a place like this...

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_018.en:
That's Champ's pace, I suppose.
Don't worry about it.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's probably Champ's pace. / No need to mind it.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_019.en:
...Sigh. If it's fine with you,
Captain, then I won't object...
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Hah. If the Captain is fine with it, / I don't mind...

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_020.en:
Training at your own pace,
that's the key!
Hup! Hup!
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: In training, your own pace is / what matters! / Hmph! Hmph!

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_021.en:
We moving out?
Alright, let's go wild!
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie. / Alright, I'm gonna run wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_022.en:
Oh, Captain!
Can I take a look at your
wanzer later?
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Captain. / Could you let me see / your WAP later?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_023.en:
I don't mind.
You seem to like wanzers, Oddeye.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I don't mind. / Oddeye, you seem to like WAPs.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_024.en:
I love them!
A next-gen, multi-purpose weapon
for regional warfare!
That means they can do anything!
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I love them! / New-generation, local-warfare-ready multipurpose weapons, you know? / That means they can do anything, right?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_025.en:
True.
Set up with the right intel and
experience for the terrain and the
operation, then used in real combat,
they can handle all kinds of missions.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Indeed. / It's a weapon that, by being set up with information and experience / for various terrains and operation content / and operated in real combat, / can be active in all kinds of missions.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_026.en:
Exactly!
And a wanzer merc's job is to rebuild
a robot with your favorite parts
and ride it around!
It's the best!
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / Plus WAP mercenary is the job of rebuilding robots / with your favorite parts and riding them around! / It's the best!

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Robots?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_028.en:
A robot?
I'd call a wanzer gear that
augments infantry, if anything.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Robots? / If anything, a WAP is an / enhancement gear for infantry.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_029.en:
Infantry augmentation gear?
Oh, so it's like a mascot suit?
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Infantry enhancement gear? / Ah, then is it something like a mascot costume?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mascot costume?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_031.en:
Yeah!
Like the heroes and monsters
in theme park shows.
Oh, so that makes you and me
the people inside the suits!
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / Like the heroes and monsters / that appear at attractions and stuff. / Ah, then that makes me and the Captain the people inside.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The people inside?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, you're troubling the Captain...

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_034.en:
Oh no, did I confuse you, Captain?
I'm sorry...
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, did I trouble you, Captain? / I'm sorry...

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_035.en:
No, I'm sorry.
Don't worry about it, Oddeye.
I'm just short on intel.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, I'm sorry. / Oddeye, you needn't worry. / I'm just ignorant of information.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_036.en:
"Intel"...?
It's not the kind of intel that's
any use on a battlefield...
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, "information"... / It's not information that's / useful on the battlefield...

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: True, it might not be useful...

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_038.en:
Oddeye, come look at my wanzer
later. As much as you like.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, later look at my WAP / as much as you like.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wah, thank you very much!

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I don't think so.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_040.en:
I don't think so.
Wanzers have only recently been
used as weapons.
Whether they're the best isn't
for me to judge.
History will decide that.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I don't think so. / Using WAPs as weapons is a recent thing. / Whether it's the best or not, I / can't judge. / Later history will judge it.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_041.en:
No, no, that's not it!
I'm not talking about weapons.
I mean wanzers are just the best!
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's not iiit. / Not talking about weapons, I mean WAPs / are the best.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_042.en:
Isn't that talking about
weapons, though?
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Isn't that, in other words, talking about weapons?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_043.en:
Um, well, okay, wanzers are weapons,
but, how do I put it...
Walking weapons have a romance that
older weapons don't, don't you think?
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Umm, WAPs certainly are weapons, but / how do I put it... / Bipedal walking weapons have a romance / that old-generation weapons don't, right?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_044.en:
Oh dear.
You two aren't quite on the
same page, are you?
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh my, / seems the conversation isn't meshing.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_045.en:
Sorry.
A lot of what Oddeye says
is hard for me to follow.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry. / Much of what Oddeye says seems hard for me to understand.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_046.en:
No, I'm the one who's sorry...
I'll work hard on finding things
to talk about that you'll get...
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm the one who's sorry... / I'll work hard and think up / talk that gets through to the Captain...

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_047.en:
Please show me your wanzer later,
Captain!
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Show me your WAP later, Captain!

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_048.en:
Oh, a sortie?
I'll get ready!
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, a sortie, right. / I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_049.en:
(Doesn't seem to be anyone shy
in this squad.
...In my experience, there's usually
at least one oddball.)
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (It seems there's nobody shy around strangers / in this squad. / ...In my experience, there's usually one / difficult character.)

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_050.en:
(Now that I'm in charge, I should
get on better terms with them...)
(...Wait. That makes it sound
like I'm the shy one...)
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (If I've been entrusted with the squad, I have to / get closer to the members...) / (...This way it's as if I'm the one / who's shy around strangers...)

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Alright. Sortie.)

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_052.en:
Hello, Rain.
It's been a while.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hello, Rain. / Long time no see.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_053.en:
Oh, Ellen! It's been ages.
Captain, this is Ellen Tyler.
She's a mercenary, like us.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Miss Ellen. Long time no see. / Captain, this is Ellen Tyler, / a mercenary like us.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_054.en:
I'm «E801:00».
Pleased to meet you.
About that name, though...
Isn't it a codename?
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm «E801:00». / Pleased to work with you. / By the way, that name... / isn't it a codename?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_055.en:
Pleased to meet you, «E801:00».
My base has different rules.
Codenames are for operations
only, you know.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Nice to meet you, «E801:00». / At my base the rules are different. / We only use codenames / during operations.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_056.en:
Ellen is usually at another base,
mostly on joint operations
with the regular army.
We're both mercs, but she's
far more senior than I am.
When I first came to Huffman,
she took good care of me...
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Miss Ellen is normally at a different base, / and is someone who mainly does joint operations / with the regular army. / Even though we're both mercenaries, / she's far more senior than us. / When I came to Huffman Island, / she took good care of me...

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_057.en:
Took care of you? I just happened
to be your instructor.
You were so good I wanted you in
my squad, but Lancer snapped you up
before I had the chance.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even if I took care of you, / I just happened to be the instructor. / Rain was excellent, so when I thought / I'd bring her into my squad, Lancer / took her off easily.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_058.en:
Me, good? Not at all...
What brings you to our base today?
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Excellent, no, that's... / Why are you at this base today?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_059.en:
A recon mission near the border...
or so it sounds on paper. Really,
I'm inspecting the bases that
guard the border, like yours.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A reconnaissance mission near the border... / That sounds nice when I say it, but in reality, / it's an on-site inspection of bases on / border guard duty like yours.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_060.en:
Checking that we're holding
the border properly, then.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So it's confirming whether we're properly maintaining the border.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_061.en:
Honestly, it's a job I'd rather
not do. But our report decides
this base's... I mean,
Commander Falcon's evaluation.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Honestly, it's a mission I don't want to do, but / based on our inspection, this base's... / in other words Commander Falcon's results / get graded.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_062.en:
Then we'd better do well,
for the Commander's sake.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If we don't work hard, it'll be bad for the Commander.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_063.en:
We just carry out the missions
we're given.
That will show in his record.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We just carry out the missions given to us. / That will probably lead to the Commander's results.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_064.en:
Exactly.
Rain.
Don't do it for the Commander.
Focus on getting the mission done.
Push too hard and it'll get you killed.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Exactly. / Rain. / Don't think "for the Commander," / concentrate on making missions succeed. / If you overdo it, it'll cost you your life.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_065.en:
Understood.
I still have a lot to learn
from you, Ellen.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood. / I still have a lot to learn / from you, Miss Ellen.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_066.en:
Hehe.
I'll be on border duty for a while,
so I'll drop by now and then.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hehehe. / I have missions near the border for the time being, / so I'll drop by every now and then.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_067.en:
I'll be on border duty for a while,
so I'll drop by now and then.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_067.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I have missions near the border for the time being, / so I'll drop by every now and then.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_068.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
Tuned the actuators like you asked.
Hopefully that takes some strain
off the joints.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_068.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yo, «E801:00». / I adjusted the actuators / as instructed. / Hope this reduces the strain on the joints.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_069.en:
First fight as captain was a
cakewalk, huh? Anyway...
That guy doing sit-ups over there,
his huffing is driving me nuts.
Can you do something about him?
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_069.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Looks like your first battle as captain was easy. / By the way... / The snorting of the guy doing sit-ups over there / is so noisy I can't stand it. / Can't you do something about it?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_070.en:
The new Raptor MG...
...I like it...but Oddeye...
prefers the Grave MG...
We don't...click...
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_070.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The newly arrived Raptor MG... / ...I like it, but... Oddeye... / says she likes the Grave MG... we don't mesh...

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_071.en:
An enemy transport unit is moving
through eastern Grayrock.
Hit it in the Roxta Desert and
burn the cargo.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_071.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: An enemy transport unit is moving through / eastern Grayrock. / I want you to raid it in the Roxta Desert and / burn up the cargo.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_072.en:
Nothing out there but highway.
Perfect for an ambush.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_072.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A place with nothing but highway. / Indeed it's perfect for a raid.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_073.en:
That's right.
Out there, their vehicles have
nowhere to run.
Just the kind of ground wanzers
excel on, wouldn't you say?
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_073.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Exactly. / There, the enemy vehicle unit / has nowhere to run. / A field WAPs excel at, right?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_074.en:
Which makes it hard to believe
their escort is just
armored vehicles.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_074.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Which means it's hard to believe the enemy's escort / is only armored vehicles.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_075.en:
No other forces confirmed so far.
Take out every enemy, transports
included.
Three turns enough for you?
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_075.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So far no other forces have been confirmed. / Aim to destroy all enemies, / including the transport vehicles. / Will 3 turns be enough?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_076.en:
If it's only vehicles.
Mission understood.
Moving out.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_076.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If the enemies are only vehicles. / Mission understood. / Sortieing.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_077.en:
No other forces confirmed.
Take out every enemy,
transports included.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_077.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No other forces have been confirmed. / Aim to destroy all enemies, / including the transport vehicles.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_078.en:
So, what about the leftovers from
that merc squad?
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_078.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What happened to the survivors of that mercenary squad?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_079.en:
One was wounded and is likely in a
medical facility. The other is
believed to still be on base.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_079.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: One was injured and is probably at a medical facility, but / the other is thought to still be at the base.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_080.en:
We've got a Numbers guy who's good
at sneaking in, right?
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_080.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There was a guy in the Numbers who's good at infiltration, right?

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_081.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes.

MsgLabels_station_05_msg_082.en:
Then you know what to do.
Get him prepped. Chop-chop.
MsgLabels_station_05_msg_082.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Then that's how it is. / Get ready right away.

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We've arrived at the destination.

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_002.en: Another easy one, by the looks of it.
MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's an easy-win mood this time too.

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We ambush here, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_004.en:
Why bother?
Once we get in close to those
vehicles, they're ours.
MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is there any need for that? / Once we get in close to the vehicles, / they're ours.

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_005.en:
As wanzer missions go, it's simple.
But I don't think that's all there is.
MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As a WAP mission it's simple, but. / I feel like it's not just that.

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A real-combat hunch... is it?

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_007.en:
Not a hunch.
An assessment of the situation.
MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's not a hunch. / It's situational judgment.

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_008.en:
Captain!
Targets approaching.
Composition matches the intel!
MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain! / Target approach confirmed. / Unit composition is as the intel said too!

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_009.en: Good. All units, take your positions.
MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good, all units to your posts.

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_010.en:
Roger!
The big game's all mine!
MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger! / I'll take all the prey.

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_011.en:
Targets confirmed.
All units, commence attack!
MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Target confirmed. / All units, begin attack!

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_012.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_014.en: The target formation is breaking up.
MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The targets' formation is in disorder.

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_015.en: Let's finish this in one round!
MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll settle it in one go.

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_016.en:
Huh? What's this!?
Captain!
There's a wanzer hidden in the container!
MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh, this is!? / Captain! / WAPs are hiding inside the containers!

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_017.en: So that's what the Captain meant...
MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So this is what the Captain / was talking about...

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_018.en:
Change of plan.
All units, bring down that enemy
wanzer with everything you've got.
MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Change of plan. / All units, bring down the enemy WAPs with full force.

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That was quick.

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_020.en:
Wanzer confirmed in the wreckage
of the transport.
One was hiding in there after all.
MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed WAPs in the wreckage of the transports. / As expected, WAPs were hiding.

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_021.en:
Hitting the transport first
was the right call.
Mission complete.
Returning to base.
MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems hitting the transports first / was the right call. / Mission complete. / Returning to base now.

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed enemy unit silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_024.en:
Some intel that was.
Thanks for nothing...
MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thanks to the intel, we went through hell...

MsgLabels_tactics_05_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission complete. / Returning to base now.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00». / Congratulations on becoming captain.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_002.en:
I'm the type who'd rather fight
than give orders.
But it's the Commander's call.
For now, I'll go along with it.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm the type who wants to focus on combat / rather than command. / But it's the Commander's judgment. / For now I intend to follow it.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_003.en:
I'll support you, Captain «E801:00».
You just keep focusing on combat,
the way you always have.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I will support Captain «E801:00». / Captain, please keep focusing on combat / as before.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It helps if you do that.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_005.en:
I'll support you, Captain «E801:00».
You just keep focusing on combat,
the way you always have.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I will support Captain «E801:00». / Captain, please keep focusing on combat / as before.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gugoo...

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Is he sleeping?

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_009.en:
Codename: Champ...
As you can see, he's quite famous
in the fighting world.
Snoring away in a place like this...
I suppose that's a big shot for you.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Codename: Champ... / As you can see, he's a famous figure / in the martial arts world. / Snoring and dozing off / in a place like this... / I suppose that's a big shot for you.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_010.en:
...Sorry, Rain.
I have no intel on the fighting world.
When he wakes up, tell him
to go to his quarters.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Sorry, Rain. / I have no information on the martial arts world. / When he wakes, tell him to go to his own room.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Y-yes...

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gugoo...

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Hn, a sortie??

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_014.en:
Oh, Captain!
Thank you for picking me!
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, it's the Captain. / Thank you for hiring me!

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You're, if I recall...

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_016.en:
Codename: Oddeye!
Because, well, I've got odd eyes.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Codename: Oddeye. / My eyes are odd-eyed (heterochromia).

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_017.en:
Your eyes?
Huh. Silver and blue.
Is that in fashion these days?
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eyes? / Oh, silver and blue. / Is that kind of thing in fashion now?

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_018.en:
Hmm, is it?
I couldn't tell you if it's in fashion.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I wonder? / I don't know whether it's in fashion.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: C-Captain!

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_020.en:
It's not a fashion thing.
Oddeye's eyes are real...
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's not fashion or anything, Oddeye's eyes / are real...

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_021.en:
Oh, right.
Yep, they're real!
But sometimes I wear a contact
to make them match.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, yes. / They're real. / But sometimes I also wear contacts / to match one of the colors.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_022.en: I see. Sounds like a lot of work.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is that so. Lots of trouble, huh.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_023.en:
Well, I don't think it's
that much work...
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, I don't think it's that much trouble...

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_024.en:
What? It's tons of work!
Silver or blue? Silver or blue?
I can never decide!
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh, it is trouble. / Should I make it silver, or blue, / I'm totally torn.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_025.en:
Is there something wrong
with leaving them as they are?
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is it no good to leave them as they are?

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_026.en:
Oh! You're right!
If I make them match, my codename
won't make sense anymore!
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah! That's right. / If I made my eye colors match, the origin / of my codename would be gone.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_028.en: That settles it. No more contacts!
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll quit the contacts!

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_029.en: A mission? I'll go get ready!
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right, I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_030.en:
(With more people, we can take
a wider range of missions.)
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (With more members, there'll be more breadth to the missions.)

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Me, a captain... It reminds me of the old days...)

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Alright. Sortie.)

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_033.en:
I think that's all my luggage...
Oh, you're «E801:00», sir... right?
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I guess this is it for my luggage... / Ah, you're Mr. «E801:00»... right?

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_034.en:
I hear you've been assigned
to Chariot Squad.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Seems your posting to the Chariot Squad was decided.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_035.en:
Yes, sir.
Thank you for everything.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / Thank you for everything.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_036.en:
Oh, it's Unit 4!
Are you leaving already?
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Mr. Unit 4. / Are you leaving already?

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_037.en:
Oddeye... ma'am.
My codename is Tornado...
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Miss... Oddeye. / My codename is Tornado...

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_038.en:
Oops, sorry!
Tornado, right?
If you're staying on Huffman,
maybe we'll meet again!
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, sorry. / Mr. Tornado, right. / If you're in Huffman, maybe / we'll meet again!

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_039.en:
Maybe so.
Different squads, but let's both
do our best.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Right. / We're in different squads, but let's both do our best.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, I'll do my best!

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_041.en:
«E801:00», sir. Oddeye...
I should get going.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mr. «E801:00», Miss Oddeye. / Well then, I'll be going.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I wish you luck.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Alright, time to go.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_044.en:
Hey there, «E801:00».
Captain already, and you only
just got here, huh?
Go get 'em!
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yo, «E801:00». / Heard you became captain right after arriving. / Do your best!

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_045.en:
With your skills, making captain
was a given. Anyway...
Could you do something about the
snoring from that guy over there?
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: With your skill, being captain is natural. / By the way... / Can't you do something about the snoring / of the guy sleeping over there?

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Oddeye, huh...... Oddeye...

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Raid on reconnaissance unit

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sniping mission

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Raid on reconnaissance unit

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sniping mission

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_055.en:
Now then. «E801:00» Squad's
barely formed, but there are
two jobs on the table.
One: ambush an enemy recon unit.
Two: a solo wanzer sniper op.
Your pick, Captain.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Now, it's right after «E801:00» Squad's formation, / but there are 2 kinds of missions this time. / One is a mission raiding a reconnaissance unit. / The other is a sniping mission by a single WAP. / I'll leave it to you which to choose.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_056.en:
A recon unit ambush,
or a sniper op.
Let me see...
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A raid on a reconnaissance unit, and a sniping mission. / Let's see...

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_057.en:
The recon unit job, then.
Intel just reported an enemy
supply unit gathering on the plains
outside West Peseta.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The reconnaissance unit raid mission. / Just now, information came in from Intelligence / that an enemy supply unit is gathering / on the plains on the outskirts of West Peseta.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_058.en:
The plains outside West Peseta.
Wide open, good visibility.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The plains outside West Peseta. / That's open plains terrain with good visibility.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_059.en:
That's right.
«E801:00» Squad is to disrupt
and wipe them out.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / «E801:00» Squad, disrupt and annihilate it.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_060.en:
Roger that.
Any intel on the enemy unit?
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood. / So, is there information on the enemy unit?

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_061.en:
Transport vehicles with an
armed vehicle escort.
If they reach POINT B, we may
not be able to touch them.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's composed of transport vehicles / and armed escort vehicles. / Also, if the enemy reaches Point B, / we may no longer be able to lay a hand on them.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_062.en:
So the transports are
top priority?
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Destroying the transport vehicles is top priority, right?

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_063.en:
Correct.
And if you can, wipe out the lot
before they make POINT B.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / Furthermore, if possible, aim to annihilate all enemies / before they reach Point B.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_064.en:
Meaning I can expect the pay
to match the results?
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Which means I can expect a reward / based on evaluation?

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_065.en:
Naturally.
Set up to suit the job.
I'd rather you didn't botch
your very first mission.
Well? Will you take it?
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Of course. / Do a setup suited to the operation. / I can't have you failing from your first mission. / Well? Will you accept this mission?

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_066.en:
I'll take it.
Against vehicles, a full-auto rifle
should do the job. We'll check our
machines in the hangar and sortie
at once.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll accept. / If vehicles are the opponents, a full-auto rifle / is effective. / After checking the units at the hangar, / we sortie at once.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_067.en:
It's «E801:00» Squad's first mission.
Set up to suit the job.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_067.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's the first mission by «E801:00» Squad. / Do a setup suited to the operation.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_068.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The other mission is,

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_069.en:
The sniper op, then.
Before dawn, an enemy field survey
team landed at Freedom Airport.
Our agent there says they're
heading to Peseta tonight.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_069.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The sniping mission. / Before dawn last night, an enemy battlefield / survey team arrived at Freedom Airport. / Word came from a local intelligence agent that the / survey team appears to be heading to Peseta tonight.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_070.en:
Quite the big fish.
They'll have a decent escort,
I imagine.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_070.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Quite the big game. / Naturally a suitable escort unit / will be guarding it.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_071.en:
Send in a big force and they'll
spot us coming.
So it's one wanzer, kitted out
for long-range attack.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_071.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If we send in a large unit, the enemy / will detect it. / So, we'll do a sniping with a single WAP / fitted with equipment capable of long-range attack.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_072.en:
Get to the sniping point fast and
hit the vehicle the target's in.
The command car, right?
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_072.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Move to the sniping point as fast as possible, / and aim for the vehicle the target is riding in. / The command vehicle, right.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_073.en:
Right.
And your machine goes in
unmarked. No affiliation.
If you're captured, we can't
help you. Not one bit.
Keep that in mind.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_073.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm. / Also, disguise your unit as one of unknown affiliation. / Even if you're taken prisoner, we can give no support at all. / Undertake the mission with resolve.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_074.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is there support for escape?

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_075.en:
Of course.
Once the shot's done, get to
POINT A on the double.
We'll send a pickup chopper.
But after 10 turns, the chopper
heads back to base.
Well? Will you take it?
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_075.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Of course. / Once the sniping is complete, promptly / move to Point A. / I'll send a pickup helicopter. / However, if it goes beyond 10 turns, I'll have / the helicopter return to base. / Well? Will you accept this mission?

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_076.en:
I'll take it.
Looks like there won't be time
to bother with other enemies.
I'll gear up in the hangar
and sortie.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_076.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll accept. / In this mission, it seems there's no time / to bother with other enemies. / After getting equipment in order at the hangar, I'll sortie.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_077.en:
Once the shot's done, get to
POINT A on the double.
We'll send a pickup chopper.
But after 10 turns, the chopper
heads back to base.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_077.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Once the sniping is complete, promptly move to / Point A. / I'll send a pickup helicopter. / However, if it goes beyond 10 turns, I'll have / the helicopter return to base.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_078.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The other mission is,

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_079.en:
«E801:00», were you listening?
You've got two options.
Which one will it be?
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_079.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: «E801:00», were you listening? / There are 2 choices. / Which will you accept?

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_080.en:
Good. The recon unit ambush.
It's «E801:00» Squad's first mission.
Set up to suit the job.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_080.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good. The reconnaissance unit raid mission. / It's the first mission by «E801:00» Squad. / Do a setup suited to the operation.

MsgLabels_station_06_msg_081.en:
Good. The sniper op.
It's «E801:00» Squad's first mission.
Set up to suit the job.
MsgLabels_station_06_msg_081.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good. The sniping mission. / It's the first mission by «E801:00» Squad. / Do a setup suited to the operation.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_001.en:
A hit on a VIP. Not the kind of job
the regulars can do.
Still, hard to believe he'd come into
the buffer zone with no escort...
MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Raiding a VIP is a job the regular army / can't do. / Even so, it's hard to believe they'd come out / into the buffer zone without an escort...

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Target confirmed.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Executing the operation now.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_004.en:
Victory: Target destroyed and
escape.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed or
turn limit reached.
MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: destroy the target and escape. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down, or / a set number of turns passing.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Reached the sniping point.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy vehicle destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Missed, huh.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy WAP spotted.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Spotted, huh.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_011.en:
Took the bait, didn't you!
You're not going anywhere!
MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You fell for it! / We won't let you escape!

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_012.en:
I see.
So it was a trap after all.
This is «E801:00».
I've hit an enemy ambush.
Requesting extraction support.
MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / So it was a trap after all. / This is «E801:00». / Ran into an enemy ambush. / Requesting escape support.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_013.en:
Rain here.
Plotting an escape route now.
Captain, hold on just a little longer.
MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is Rain. / I'll set up an escape route now. / Captain, please wait a little longer.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_014.en: Right. As fast as you can.
MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah, as fast as possible, please.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_015.en:
Captain, we're on our way to pick
you up! Head for the extraction point.
Enemy reinforcements are closing in.
Please hurry.
MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, we're heading to pick you up now! / Please head to the escape point. / Enemy reinforcements are approaching. / Please hurry.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_016.en:
Roger.
The extraction point's up on the hill...
Only way there is straight through.
MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / The escape point is on top of the hill... / Forcing a breakthrough is the only way.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_017.en:
I can't wait any longer.
Returning to base.
MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We can't wait any longer. / Returning to base.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_018.en:
Hold it!
We haven't picked up the Captain yet!
MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wait! / We haven't picked up the Captain yet!

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_019.en: Negative. My orders are to RTB.
MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No good, the order is to return to base.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_020.en:
Rain, that's the job.
Leave me. Return to base.
MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain, that's the kind of mission it is. / Don't mind me, return to base.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But, Captain!!

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_022.en:
Preparing for capture.
Purging comm logs.
...Signing off.
MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Preparing to be taken prisoner. / Destroying the communication logs. / ...Cutting communications.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00»!!

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, please get on, quickly!

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain, huh.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_026.en:
Enemy reinforcements will be here
any minute. This time they'll likely
bring wanzers.
We need to get out of here, now.
MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy reinforcements will come soon. / Probably this time there will be a WAP squad too. / Escape as soon as possible.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Pickup complete. / Returning to base.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 1 turn left until the pickup helicopter returns.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 2 turns left until the pickup helicopter returns.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 3 turns left until the pickup helicopter returns.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 4 turns left until the pickup helicopter returns.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 5 turns left until the pickup helicopter returns.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 6 turns left until the pickup helicopter returns.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 7 turns left until the pickup helicopter returns.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 8 turns left until the pickup helicopter returns.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 9 turns left until the pickup helicopter returns.

MsgLabels_tactics_06_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 10 turns left until the pickup helicopter returns.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_003.en:
Captain, pilots have aptitudes...
Some roles suit them, some don't.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, pilots have aptitudes for roles... / suitability and unsuitability, right?

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_004.en:
True.
A wanzer will always end up reflecting
the traits of the pilot flying it.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / In WAP piloting, / the traits that pilot has / inevitably get reflected.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_005.en:
Then Champ is a melee fighter first
and foremost... We'll keep him
as a Striker?
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: In that case, will Champ, being melee-focused after all... / be entrusted with Striker?

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_006.en:
Yes.
Give him long-range work and he
probably won't learn the skills for it.
Still, if he wants to try,
I won't stop him.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah. / Even if I entrusted him with long-range attack, he probably / couldn't learn the skills and such. / Well, if he wants to do it himself, / I won't stop him.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_007.en:
Oddeye, on the other hand, is good
at long range...
So we shouldn't expect much from
her melee skills.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Conversely, Oddeye is good at / long-range attack, so... / we can't expect much / in melee skills.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_008.en:
Seeing through a pilot's traits is
part of a captain's job, too.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Seeing through pilots' traits is also / the captain's job.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh, Captain.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ. / Strength training in a place like this?

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_012.en:
Habit from my fighting days.
If I'm not moving, I get antsy.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's a habit from my active days. / If I'm not moving my body, I can't settle down.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_013.en:
I suppose a Striker, whose reflexes
and fighting sense carry over into
the wanzer, could use strength
training at that.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Indeed, for Strikers, whose reflexes and fighting sense / are reflected in WAP piloting, / strength training may also be necessary. /

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_014.en:
Huh, that so?
So my workouts ain't a waste!
Hey, while you're here, Captain,
why not do some sit-ups with me?
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh, is that how it is. / So my muscle training isn't a waste! / Ah, since we're at it, Captain, want to do / sit-ups together?

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_015.en:
No, I'll pass.
I train at my own pace,
when I need to.
Don't mind me. Carry on.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, I'll pass. / I train at my own pace / when necessary. / Don't mind me, keep going.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_016.en:
Right on!
Training at your own pace,
that's the key!
Figured I'd get chewed out for
doing sit-ups here.
But if the Captain says so,
sit-ups it is!
Alright! Hup! Hup!
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right, huh. / In training, your own pace is / what matters! / I thought I'd get scolded for doing sit-ups here. / If the Captain says so, / sit-ups without worrying! / Alriiight! Hmph! Hmph!

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_017.en:
Your own pace may be important...
but there's no need to brazenly
do sit-ups in a place like this...
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even if your own pace matters... / you don't have to brazenly do sit-ups / in a place like this...

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_018.en:
That's Champ's pace, I suppose.
Don't worry about it.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's probably Champ's pace. / No need to mind it.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_019.en:
...Sigh. If it's fine with you,
Captain, then I won't object...
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Hah. If the Captain is fine with it, / I don't mind...

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_020.en:
Training at your own pace,
that's the key!
Hup! Hup!
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: In training, your own pace is / what matters! / Hmph! Hmph!

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_021.en:
We moving out?
Alright, let's go wild!
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie. / Alright, I'm gonna run wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_022.en:
Oh, Captain!
Can I take a look at your
wanzer later?
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Captain. / Could you let me see / your WAP later?

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_023.en:
I don't mind.
You seem to like wanzers, Oddeye.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I don't mind. / Oddeye, you seem to like WAPs.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_024.en:
I love them!
A next-gen, multi-purpose weapon
for regional warfare!
That means they can do anything!
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I love them! / New-generation, local-warfare-ready multipurpose weapons, you know? / That means they can do anything, right?

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_025.en:
True.
Set up with the right intel and
experience for the terrain and the
operation, then used in real combat,
they can handle all kinds of missions.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Indeed. / It's a weapon that, by being set up with information and experience / for various terrains and operation content / and operated in real combat, / can be active in all kinds of missions.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_026.en:
Exactly!
And a wanzer merc's job is to rebuild
a robot with your favorite parts
and ride it around!
It's the best!
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / Plus WAP mercenary is the job of rebuilding robots / with your favorite parts and riding them around! / It's the best!

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Robots?

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_028.en:
A robot?
I'd call a wanzer gear that
augments infantry, if anything.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Robots? / If anything, a WAP is an / enhancement gear for infantry.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_029.en:
Infantry augmentation gear?
Oh, so it's like a mascot suit?
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Infantry enhancement gear? / Ah, then is it something like a mascot costume?

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mascot costume?

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_031.en:
Yeah!
Like the heroes and monsters
in theme park shows.
Oh, so that makes you and me
the people inside the suits!
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / Like the heroes and monsters / that appear at attractions and stuff. / Ah, then that makes me and the Captain the people inside.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The people inside?

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, you're troubling the Captain...

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_034.en:
Oh no, did I confuse you, Captain?
I'm sorry...
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, did I trouble you, Captain? / I'm sorry...

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_035.en:
No, I'm sorry.
Don't worry about it, Oddeye.
I'm just short on intel.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, I'm sorry. / Oddeye, you needn't worry. / I'm just ignorant of information.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_036.en:
"Intel"...?
It's not the kind of intel that's
any use on a battlefield...
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, "information"... / It's not information that's / useful on the battlefield...

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: True, it might not be useful...

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_038.en:
Oddeye, come look at my wanzer
later. As much as you like.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, later look at my WAP / as much as you like.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wah, thank you very much!

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I don't think so.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_040.en:
I don't think so.
Wanzers have only recently been
used as weapons.
Whether they're the best isn't
for me to judge.
History will decide that.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I don't think so. / Using WAPs as weapons is a recent thing. / Whether it's the best or not, I / can't judge. / Later history will judge it.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_041.en:
No, no, that's not it!
I'm not talking about weapons.
I mean wanzers are just the best!
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's not iiit. / Not talking about weapons, I mean WAPs / are the best.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_042.en:
Isn't that talking about
weapons, though?
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Isn't that, in other words, talking about weapons?

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_043.en:
Um, well, okay, wanzers are weapons,
but, how do I put it...
Walking weapons have a romance that
older weapons don't, don't you think?
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Umm, WAPs certainly are weapons, but / how do I put it... / Bipedal walking weapons have a romance / that old-generation weapons don't, right?

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_044.en:
Oh dear.
You two aren't quite on the
same page, are you?
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh my, / seems the conversation isn't meshing.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_045.en:
Sorry.
A lot of what Oddeye says
is hard for me to follow.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry. / Much of what Oddeye says seems hard for me to understand.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_046.en:
No, I'm the one who's sorry...
I'll work hard on finding things
to talk about that you'll get...
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm the one who's sorry... / I'll work hard and think up / talk that gets through to the Captain...

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_047.en:
Please show me your wanzer later,
Captain!
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Show me your WAP later, Captain!

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_048.en:
Oh, a sortie?
I'll get ready!
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, a sortie, right. / I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_049.en:
(Doesn't seem to be anyone shy
in this squad.
...In my experience, there's usually
at least one oddball.)
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (It seems there's nobody shy around strangers / in this squad. / ...In my experience, there's usually one / difficult character.)

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_050.en:
(Now that I'm in charge, I should
get on better terms with them...)
(...Wait. That makes it sound
like I'm the shy one...)
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (If I've been entrusted with the squad, I have to / get closer to the members...) / (...This way it's as if I'm the one / who's shy around strangers...)

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Alright. Sortie.)

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_052.en:
Hello, Rain.
It's been a while.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hello, Rain. / Long time no see.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_053.en:
Oh, Ellen! It's been ages.
Captain, this is Ellen Tyler.
She's a mercenary, like us.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Miss Ellen. Long time no see. / Captain, this is Ellen Tyler, / a mercenary like us.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_054.en:
I'm «E801:00».
Pleased to meet you.
About that name, though...
Isn't it a codename?
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm «E801:00». / Pleased to work with you. / By the way, that name... / isn't it a codename?

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_055.en:
Pleased to meet you, «E801:00».
My base has different rules.
Codenames are for operations
only, you know.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Nice to meet you, «E801:00». / At my base the rules are different. / We only use codenames / during operations.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_056.en:
Ellen is usually at another base,
mostly on joint operations
with the regular army.
We're both mercs, but she's
far more senior than I am.
When I first came to Huffman,
she took good care of me...
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Miss Ellen is normally at a different base, / and is someone who mainly does joint operations / with the regular army. / Even though we're both mercenaries, / she's far more senior than us. / When I came to Huffman Island, / she took good care of me...

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_057.en:
Took care of you? I just happened
to be your instructor.
You were so good I wanted you in
my squad, but Lancer snapped you up
before I had the chance.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even if I took care of you, / I just happened to be the instructor. / Rain was excellent, so when I thought / I'd bring her into my squad, Lancer / took her off easily.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_058.en:
Me, good? Not at all...
What brings you to our base today?
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Excellent, no, that's... / Why are you at this base today?

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_059.en:
A recon mission near the border...
or so it sounds on paper. Really,
I'm inspecting the bases that
guard the border, like yours.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A reconnaissance mission near the border... / That sounds nice when I say it, but in reality, / it's an on-site inspection of bases on / border guard duty like yours.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_060.en:
Checking that we're holding
the border properly, then.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So it's confirming whether we're properly maintaining the border.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_061.en:
Honestly, it's a job I'd rather
not do. But our report decides
this base's... I mean,
Commander Falcon's evaluation.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Honestly, it's a mission I don't want to do, but / based on our inspection, this base's... / in other words Commander Falcon's results / get graded.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_062.en:
Then we'd better do well,
for the Commander's sake.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If we don't work hard, it'll be bad for the Commander.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_063.en:
We just carry out the missions
we're given.
That will show in his record.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We just carry out the missions given to us. / That will probably lead to the Commander's results.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_064.en:
Exactly.
Rain.
Don't do it for the Commander.
Focus on getting the mission done.
Push too hard and it'll get you killed.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Exactly. / Rain. / Don't think "for the Commander," / concentrate on making missions succeed. / If you overdo it, it'll cost you your life.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_065.en:
Understood.
I still have a lot to learn
from you, Ellen.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood. / I still have a lot to learn / from you, Miss Ellen.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_066.en:
Hehe.
I'll be on border duty for a while,
so I'll drop by now and then.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hehehe. / I have missions near the border for the time being, / so I'll drop by every now and then.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_067.en:
I'll be on border duty for a while,
so I'll drop by now and then.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_067.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I have missions near the border for the time being, / so I'll drop by every now and then.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_068.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
Tuned the actuators like you asked.
Hopefully that takes some strain
off the joints.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_068.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yo, «E801:00». / I adjusted the actuators / as instructed. / Hope this reduces the strain on the joints.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_069.en:
First fight as captain was a
cakewalk, huh? Anyway...
That guy doing sit-ups over there,
his huffing is driving me nuts.
Can you do something about him?
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_069.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Looks like your first battle as captain was easy. / By the way... / The snorting of the guy doing sit-ups over there / is so noisy I can't stand it. / Can't you do something about it?

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_070.en:
...Oddeye and I... we just...
don't click...
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_070.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...With Oddeye... I can't talk well... / we don't mesh...

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_071.en:
Word just came in: an enemy supply
unit is on the move near Grayrock.
Going by its size, it's hauling
a lot of materiel.
Hit it in the mountains.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_071.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Word came in that an enemy supply unit / is moving around Grayrock. / Judging from its size it seems to be transporting / quite a lot of materiel. / Raid it in the mountain region.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_072.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is the enemy only a vehicle unit?

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_073.en:
At that size, better assume it has
wanzers along for the ride.
But hit them before they're unloaded
from the transports, and they're
no threat.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_073.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Judging from the size, you'd better assume / it's accompanied by WAPs. / However, if you hit them before they're unloaded / from the transport vehicles, they won't be a threat.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_074.en: A race against the clock, then.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_074.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A race against time.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_075.en:
Smash this unit and we may finally
break the stalemate on the front.
Take out as many as you can.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_075.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If we hit this unit, a breakthrough / of the stalemate on the front line comes into view. / Destroy as many enemies as possible.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_076.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / «E801:00» Squad, sortieing.

MsgLabels_station_07_msg_077.en:
Smash this unit and we may finally
break the stalemate on the front.
Take out as many as you can.
MsgLabels_station_07_msg_077.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If we hit this unit, a breakthrough / of the stalemate on the front line comes into view. / Destroy as many enemies as possible.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_001.en:
By the book: command vehicle first.
Then we hit the transports.
MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As per theory, we prioritize destroying / the command vehicle. / Next we hit the transport vehicles.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_003.en:
Three wanzer signatures!
But they're packed too close together
to tell apart.
Which transport's container are the
wanzers in...?
MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 3 WAP signatures! / But the range is too narrow to identify them / individually. / In which transport vehicle's container / are the WAPs stored...

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_004.en:
Screw it!
Then we just smash 'em all!
MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What a pain! / At this point, we'll just smash them all!

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Exactly. / Commencing the operation.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_007.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_009.en:
We're under attack!
Protect the transports!
Wanzer team, prep for launch! Move it!
MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy attack! / Don't let them get the transport vehicles! / WAP squad, hurry sortie preparations!

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_010.en: Wanzer team here. Ready to launch.
MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is the WAP squad, sortie preparations complete.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_011.en:
Wanzer team, go!
Buy time till the transports are clear!
MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: WAP squad sortie! / Buy time until the transport vehicles get away!

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger, sortieing.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy WAPs have activated.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_014.en:
So we missed a container.
All units, wipe out the enemy wanzers.
MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So a container was left. / All units, annihilate the enemy WAPs.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_016.en:
Wanzer signatures gone!
All transports carrying wanzers
confirmed destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The WAP signatures are gone! / Confirmed destruction of all transport vehicles / that held WAPs.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_017.en: Moving on to mop up the rest.
MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Next we move to sweeping up the remaining units.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy unit completely silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_019.en:
Lucky their wanzers were still boxed up.
But those vehicles moved pretty
damn well.
MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It was good that the enemy WAPs / stayed in the containers, but / that vehicle unit just now moved well.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The enemy is improving their skill too.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_021.en:
Vehicles or not, never drop your guard.
But knock out the command, and most
units turn into a rabble.
MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It means even vehicle units mustn't be underestimated. / But most units, once you / hit the chain of command, turn into a disorderly mob.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_022.en:
I see.
Combat's kind of like a puzzle, huh?
MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / Combat is like a puzzle.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_023.en:
Maybe so.
Mission complete.
Returning to base.
MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Maybe so. / Mission complete. / Returning to base now.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_024.en:
Captain, multiple contacts on radar.
Enemy reinforcements approaching.
MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, many unit signatures on radar. / Enemy reinforcement unit is approaching.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_025.en:
That's a big force...
No way we take that on alone...
MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Pretty large scale... / It's impossible with just us...

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It can't be helped, all units withdraw.

MsgLabels_tactics_07_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / Roger...

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_001.en:
Captain, I'd like to introduce two
squad candidates.
Codename: Buggy.
He was a squadmate in my old unit.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, let me introduce 2 member candidates. / Codename: Buggy. / He's a comrade from the previous squad.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_002.en:
Captain «E801:00». Rain's told me
all about what you've been up to.
Buggy. I fly launcher.
Good to meet ya!
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00», I've heard about your exploits / from Rain. / I'm Buggy, Launcher. / Nice to meet ya!

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_003.en:
Likewise.
Are you back in shape?
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Nice to meet you. / Is your body in good condition?

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_004.en:
I'm itching to cut loose in a wanzer.
Rain, that headache of yours
all cleared up?
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm about ready to run wild in a WAP. / Rain, are those headaches okay now?

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_005.en:
Yes, I haven't had one since.
And the other one:
codename Alchemist.
He took the top score in the mock
battle the other day.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, there haven't been any since then. / And one more, / codename: Alchemist. / Top score in the mock battle the other day.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Alchemist. / Volunteering for Assault.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Top score, huh. / Reassuring.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_008.en:
Oh, not at all. I merely happened
to match your own score, Captain.
I look forward to working with you.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No no, I just happened to get the same score / as the Captain. / I look forward to working with you.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Pleased to work with you both. /

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_010.en:
They're only candidates for now, but
I think they'll be front-liners soon.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The two are still candidates, but it seems they'll / soon become main forces.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_011.en:
They're only candidates for now, but
I think they'll be front-liners soon.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The two are still candidates, but it seems they'll / soon become main forces.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Uuu... Captain...
