MsgLabels_station_08_msg_014.en:
What's wrong, Champ?
You look pale.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What's wrong, Champ. / You look pale.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, it's nothing...

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_016.en:
Oh, Champ.
Is your stomach better?
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh my, Champ. / Is your stomachache better?

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Stomachache?

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_018.en:
Apparently he drank some milk that
had been left out of the fridge
and made himself sick.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Apparently, he drank milk that had been / left out of the refrigerator / and upset his stomach.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_019.en:
It wasn't milk!
It was my special protein shake!
Wait... ugh, no good...
Champ is tapping out!!
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It wasn't milk or anything! / It's my special protein. / And... u, no good... / Champ withdrawing!!

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh my...

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_021.en:
...I'd like them to keep an eye
on their health, too.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I'd like him to be careful / about health management too.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Right...

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Uuu, no good...

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie. / ...U, u, before that...!!

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_025.en:
Oh, Captain.
It's getting kind of lively around
here, isn't it?
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Captain. / It's gotten kind of lively here too.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_027.en:
Speaking of lively...
Captain, have you ever been to
Akiba, in Japan?
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Speaking of lively. / Captain, have you ever been to / Akiba in Japan?

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_028.en:
The 'Electronical Town'?
I've been sightseeing there twice.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Electronical Town, right? / I've been sightseeing there about twice before.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_029.en:
Electronical...?
Oh, you mean Electric Town!
These days Akiba's the holy land of
videos, toys, all kinds of fun stuff.
But there are also junk shops
selling army surplus.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Electro... / Ah, you mean Electric Town. / Akiba lately is a holy land of entertainment products / like videos and toys, / and on the other hand, there are junk shops / for army surplus goods and such.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_030.en:
Sounds like you could get anything
there.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems you could get anything if you go there.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_031.en:
Not really!
I went right before I came to this
island, but people come from all over
the world hunting the same stuff,
so a lot of the time you go home
empty-handed.
Honestly, you've got better odds at
niche shops out in the sticks.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Not really. / I went right before coming to this island, but / people searching for the same products gather / from all over the world, so in the end you often / can't get them. / Thinking about it that way, going to provincial / maniac shops makes it easier to get them.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_032.en:
I see.
Everyone thinks alike,
so it pays to do the unexpected.
Same as the battlefield.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / Everyone thinks the same thing. / So it's better to always outwit them. / Same as the battlefield.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_033.en:
Right?
Oh, Captain, we finally agree on
something!
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Right. / Ah, Captain. We finally agreed on something.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So it seems.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_035.en:
It's getting kind of lively around
here, isn't it?
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's gotten kind of lively here too.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_036.en:
Oh, a sortie?
I'll get ready!
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, a sortie, right. / I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00», huh.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_038.en: You're a launcher, aren't you, Buggy?
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Buggy, you were a Launcher, right.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_039.en: Yep. Leave the long-range stuff to me.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah, leave long-range attacks to me.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_040.en: Will you be joining us in a wanzer?
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Will you join the fight in a WAP?

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_041.en:
Nah. Docs say I need a bit more rehab
before I'm fit to ride a wanzer.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, they say I need a while more of / rehab to ride a WAP.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_042.en:
True. Motor problems and fractures
will affect how you handle a wanzer.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Indeed, injuries like motor impairment and fractures / affect WAP operation.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_043.en:
Get in a wanzer now and I'd just be
dead weight.
I'll earn my keep in a vehicle
for a while.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If I rode a WAP now, I'd just / become dead weight. / For a while I'll earn with vehicles.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_044.en: Leave the long-range stuff to me.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Leave long-range attacks to me. /

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_045.en: Leave the long-range stuff to me.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Leave long-range attacks to me. /

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00». / Is something the matter?

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No. / It's nothing much.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That bothers me.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_049.en:
You have the air of the military
about you... some special unit,
in fact.
I don't mean to pry.
It just caught my attention.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: From you, I sense the air of the army... and particular / to some kind of special unit at that. / No, I don't intend to pry, / it just bothered me.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_050.en:
...You're imagining things, Captain.
Though I'm flattered to be taken for
special forces elite.
An 'air', you say? I can't think
what that would be.
I've had no particular training.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...You're overthinking it, Captain. / But I'm honored to be mistaken for / an elite like special forces. / Even if you say "air," what would it be? / I haven't received any particular training.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_051.en:
Your bearing, I suppose.
The way you carry yourself.
No, I'm sorry.
Forget it.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Let's see, your bearing, or / the way you carry yourself. / No, sorry. / Forget it.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00». / Is something the matter?

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00». / Is something the matter?

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (It's gotten quite lively here.)

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (It's gotten quite lively here.)

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Alright. Sortie.)

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_057.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
So Buggy's back, huh?
And new parts came into the hangar,
so... guess I'll give the wanzers
a once-over.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yo, «E801:00». / So Buggy came back. / New parts have come into the hangar too, / so / maybe I'll do some WAP maintenance.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_058.en:
Alchemist's exercise score was the
same as yours.
This base sure pulls in some hotshot
mercs.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Alchemist's exercise results / were the same as yours. / Skilled mercenaries sure gather / at this base.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Another...... rival... increased......

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_060.en:
This time it's factory defense.
I've laid on missile carriers as
reinforcements.
Work with them, and it shouldn't be
too tough a job.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This time it's a factory facility defense mission. / I've prepared missile armored vehicles as reinforcements. / If you handle it together with the reinforcements, / it shouldn't be that hard a mission.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_061.en:
However many we are, we can't
protect the entire factory.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No matter how many there are, defending / the whole factory is impossible.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_062.en:
I know.
The enemy's most likely after the
containers inside the factory.
A raid with fast attack choppers
would be the textbook play.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I know. / The hostile force's goal is probably / the containers in the factory. / A raid with highly mobile combat helicopters / is the standard move.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_063.en:
Attack choppers... an anti-air fight.
And at night, recon...
recon choppers will show up too.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Combat helicopters... anti-air battle, huh. / At night, recon... / reconnaissance helicopters appear too.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_064.en:
Right.
Also, enemy ground units have been
sighted, though they haven't made
a move yet.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm. / Also, though it seems they haven't / shown movement so far, / enemy ground unit signatures have been confirmed too.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_065.en:
I see.
Leave a recon chopper flying and
things get ugly.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / Leaving recon helicopters behind will cause trouble.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_066.en:
There are about 20 containers at
the factory right now.
If you do come under attack,
I'd like losses held to
around 10.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Currently, the factory has about 20 / containers. / Even if attacked, / I'd like you to keep the damage / to about 10.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_067.en:
If we can't protect the target,
it's no defense mission.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_067.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If we can't protect the objective, / it's not a defense mission.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_068.en:
Fair enough.
The missile carriers have our next
batch of replacement mercs aboard.
Link up with them, then begin
the mission.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_068.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm. / The next replacement mercenaries are riding / in the reinforcement missile armored vehicles. / Start the mission after joining up.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_069.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood. Sortieing at once.

MsgLabels_station_08_msg_070.en:
The missile carriers have our next
batch of replacement mercs aboard.
Link up with them, then begin
the mission.
MsgLabels_station_08_msg_070.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The next replacement mercenaries are riding / in the reinforcement missile armored vehicles. / Start the mission after joining up.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_001.en:
Factory defense, huh?
Feels like I'm a security guard.
MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Factory defense, huh. / Feels like I've become a security guard.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_002.en:
All units, among the choppers,
take down the recon birds first.
MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units, with helicopters prioritize shooting down the recon ones.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_003.en:
We'll cover you from the missile
carriers.
MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We'll support with the missile armored vehicles.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Buggy, are your wounds okay?

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_005.en:
Hey, Rain.
Still sore all over.
I'll cover you from a vehicle.
Call it rehab.
«E801:00» Squad, you guard
the containers.
MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain, huh. / It still hurts here and there. / As part of rehab I'll support you with a vehicle. / «E801:00» Squad, protect the containers.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_006.en:
Roger.
We'll defend the containers with
the anti-air vehicles.
MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Together with the surface-to-air vehicle unit, / we'll defend the containers.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / I'll shoot them down!

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Operation start.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_009.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_011.en:
Assault unit hit!
Heavy damage... ground-attack power
down.
We're short on firepower.
Requesting reinforcements.
MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Assault hit! / Confirmed heavily damaged... ground-attack strength reduced. / Insufficient firepower. / Requesting reinforcements.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_012.en:
Roger.
ETA a few minutes.
Hold on somehow.
MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Arriving in a few minutes. / Hold out somehow.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_013.en:
Appreciated.
We'll be spraying every round we've
got till you get here!
MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thanks. / We'll scatter every last bit of ammo / and wait for you!

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed enemy reinforcement unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This time it's a ground battle.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_016.en:
Keep defending the target and
intercept the reinforcements.
MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We continue defending the objective while / intercepting the enemy reinforcements.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy unit completely silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_018.en:
Easy money, for once.
I could go for a toast back at base.
MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We made money surprisingly easily. / I'd like to go back and have a toast.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_019.en:
Drinks?
If we're going out, let's make it
dinner!
MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Drinking? / If we're going anyway, let's make it a meal.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_020.en:
If there's drinking, count me in.
You're coming too, right, Rain?
You drank the whole old squad under
the table, after all.
MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If it's drinking, I'm going too, ya know? / Rain's going too, right? / After all, she was the heaviest drinker in the old squad.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_021.en:
Ooh.
Then I'd love to see how Rain
holds her liquor!
MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ooh. / Then I'd like to see how Miss Rain / drinks too.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_022.en:
Buggy, honestly...
You didn't need to share that...
MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hey, Buggy... geez, / don't say unnecessary things...

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission complete. / Returning to base now.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_024.en:
Their reinforcements came at a
nasty time.
MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Reinforcements came at a bad timing.

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_025.en:
The containers...
All that brand-new stuff, scrapped...
MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The containers... / The brand-new goods turned to scrap...

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_026.en:
Tch. Defense missions just ain't
my style...
MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Kh, defense missions don't suit my nature...

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_027.en:
Guess a vehicle just doesn't have
the firepower...
Maybe I'll take a wanzer next time...
MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As expected, vehicles lack firepower... / Maybe I'll go in a WAP next mission...

MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_028.en:
The mission's complete.
Returning to base.
MsgLabels_tactics_08_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The mission is complete. / Returning to base.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain. / Good morning.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good morning, Rain.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_003.en:
Hm?
Captain, are those dark circles
under your eyes?
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh? / Captain, don't you have dark circles under your eyes?

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_004.en:
Yes. A bad headache hit me last night.
I didn't get much sleep.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah, last night I was struck by a severe headache, / and it seems I'm short on sleep.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_005.en:
A headache?
Is it a chronic condition?
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A headache? / Could it be a chronic condition?

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_006.en:
...Yes. For about two years now, I've
had sudden attacks of bad headaches.
The painkillers from the infirmary
keep them under control for now.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Yeah, since about 2 years ago I sometimes get / sudden severe headaches. / Thanks to the painkillers I got at the infirmary, / it's calmed down now.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_007.en:
It might be stress.
Please don't push yourself.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It might be stress. / Please don't overdo it.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_008.en:
Captain.
Please don't push yourself too hard.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain. / Please don't overdo it too much.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh, Captain. / Morning!

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_011.en:
Morning, Champ.
...That's quite a feast for breakfast.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Morning, Champ. / ...Quite a lavish meal from the morning.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_012.en:
Steak here's great, y'know?
Wanna eat some meat with me, Captain?
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The steak here is tasty, ya know? / Captain, won't you eat meat with me?

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_013.en:
I hear meat at breakfast is good for
the digestion, but...
I can't face it this early.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Indeed, they say meat dishes at breakfast are / good for digestion, but... / I really can't eat that from the morning.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_014.en:
Rare, dripping with juice like this!
Passing it up's a crime!
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This rare, practically dripping blood. / It's a waste not to eat it!

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_015.en:
Supplements and rations are enough
for me.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Supplements and rations are enough for me.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_016.en:
Rations for breakfast...?
How can you eat that crap...?
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rations from the morning...? / How can you eat such awful stuff...

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_017.en:
I try not to care about taste.
You can't choose your meals on the
battlefield.
I ate them in the mornings to get
used to it, and it became a habit.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I try not to be particular about taste. / On the battlefield you can't choose your meals. / I ate them in the mornings to get used to it, / and it seems it naturally became a habit.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I can't copy that...

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_019.en:
Nor me. Meat in the morning is
beyond me.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Me neither. I can't copy meat from the morning.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Meat's tasty!

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_021.en:
We moving out?
Alright, let's go wild!
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie. / Alright, I'm gonna run wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Fuwaa... / Good morniiing, Captain...

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_023.en:
Morning, Oddeye.
You still look sleepy.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good morning, Oddeye. / You still look sleepy.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_024.en:
Yes...
I'm not a morning person...
Oh, you've got dark circles too,
Captain.
I was up fighting online till dawn
myself...
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes... / I'm weak in the mornings... / Ah, Captain, you've got dark circles under your eyes too. / I was fighting online until morning too...

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Fighting online?

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_026.en:
Yes...
My clan had an event.
The team we faced in the final was
really strong...
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes... / There was an event / in the clan I belong to. / The opponent in the finals was pretty strong...

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_027.en: Sounds like some kind of contest.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems you were having some kind of match.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_028.en:
Yep.
We won the whole thing, though, so
I'm going to lay off logging in
for a while.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / Thanks to that I won, so for a while / I'm thinking of holding off on logging in.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_029.en:
I see.
Don't overdo it.
It'll affect your work.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / Don't overdo it. / It'll affect your work.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Okaaay. / I'll be careful.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Fuwaa...

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_032.en:
Oh, a sortie?
I'll get ready!
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, a sortie, right. / I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Morning, Captain!

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Buggy, huh. / You're lively from the morning.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_035.en:
Wanted to do some wanzer rehab, but
unless you get in first thing, you
can't get near the training rigs.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I thought I'd do WAP rehab, but / unless it's in the morning, I can't use / the training facility.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_036.en:
I see.
Come to think of it, I haven't seen
Alchemist around.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / Come to think of it, I don't see / Alchemist?

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_037.en:
Still asleep, I bet.
Guy's too serious or something.
Not much for hanging out.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Maybe he's still sleeping. / Maybe he's too serious, / he's bad at socializing.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_039.en: Well, back in a wanzer at last.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Now then, a WAP for the first time in a while.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_040.en: Well, back in a wanzer at last.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Now then, a WAP for the first time in a while.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_041.en:
(No sign of Alchemist...
For some reason, he reminds me of
my old unit...)
(Even now, thinking back to that
brings on the headaches...)
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Alchemist doesn't seem to be here... / For some reason he reminds me of the unit I used to be in...) / (Even now, when I remember that, / a headache starts...)

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_042.en:
(That was a bad one. First in
a while...)
(I'd better get extra medicine from
the infirmary.)
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (I had a severe headache for the first time in a while...) / (The medicine at the infirmary. I'll get extra.)

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Alright. Sortie.)

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_044.en:
......Um, Ellen.
I'm sorry if this touches on anything
classified, but...
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ......Um, Miss Ellen, / if this touches on classified matters / I'm sorry, but...

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_045.en: What is it? Why so formal?
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What is it, so formal?

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_046.en:
Has the regular army heard about
the mercenaries who went missing?
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The mercenary disappearance incidents, / are they being conveyed to the regular army?

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_047.en:
Ah, that...
I even know you were one of the
victims.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, that matter... / I even know / that you're a victim too.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is the regular army / doing an investigation or anything?

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_049.en:
...They're not.
And they have no intention of doing so.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...They're not doing it, / and not even trying to.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh?

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_051.en:
When the border inspection orders
came down, we were told to stay as
far away from that matter as we
possibly could.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: When the order for the border inspection came out, / I was told. / To avoid contact with that matter / as much as possible.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_052.en:
But...
They hire mercenaries to defend the
border, then don't even investigate
when they disappear?
Isn't that a contradiction!?
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's... / They hire mercenaries to protect the border, / yet don't investigate even when they go missing, / isn't that a contradiction!?

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_053.en:
It is.
But Rain, I'm just a merc too.
I can ask questions about missions
I'm given. I can't carry out missions
nobody gave me.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's true. / But Rain, I'm just a mercenary too. / I can ask questions about missions / handed down, but carrying out missions / not issued is impossible.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_054.en:
I'm sorry.
I got carried away...
Oh, Captain! How long have you
been there?
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm sorry. / I got carried away... / Ah, Captain, since when were you there?

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_055.en:
Sorry.
I didn't mean to overhear...
Rain, this isn't like you.
You know the mercenary rules.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry. / I didn't intend to listen, but... / Rain, that's unlike you. / I think you understand the rules of mercenaries.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_056.en:
It's all right, «E801:00».
Rain was one of the victims.
I understand why she's angry.
...If I get the chance,
I'll ask about it,
but don't expect much.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's fine, «E801:00». / Rain is a victim, so / I understand her feeling of indignation. / ...If I get a chance next time, / I'll ask about this matter, but / don't expect too much.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thank you very much.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_058.en:
About the missing mercs...
I'll ask if I get the chance,
but don't expect much.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The matter of mercenaries going missing... / If I get a chance next time, I'll ask, but / don't expect too much.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_059.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
Word is another merc's gone and
deserted.
Maybe it ain't desertion at all, though.
Could be another one of those
disappearances.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yo, «E801:00». / There's a rumor another mercenary / deserter came up. / Maybe it's actually not desertion / but a disappearance incident.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_060.en:
So Alchemist isn't in your squad,
huh?
Falcon planning to form another unit?
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Seems Alchemist isn't assigned / to your unit. / Is Falcon planning to make another squad?

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_061.en:
...Oddeye... strong...
...couldn't lay a finger on her...
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Oddeye... is strong... / ...I can't hold a candle to her at all...

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_062.en:
Regrettably, three men have deserted
from a nearby mercenary unit.
They're fleeing through the forests
of the Wayne Mountains.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Regrettably, 3 deserters came out / from a nearby mercenary unit. / They're fleeing through the forest region of the Wayne Mountains.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_063.en:
Mercenary Contract, Article 58:
acting outside your mission voids the
contract, counts as desertion, and
may carry a bounty.
...Our mission is to arrest them?
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mercenary Contract Article 58: actions outside of duties / are regarded as breach of contract, treated as desertion, / and in some cases a bounty is imposed. / ...Is the mission their arrest?

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_064.en:
You can urge them to surrender,
of course. But if they resist, you're
cleared to destroy them, wanzers and all.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Of course you may urge them to surrender, but / if they resist, it's fine to destroy them / WAP and all.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_065.en: To keep the units in line...
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: To correct the unit's discipline...

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_066.en:
Yes. Merc rules.
They've got no proper gear.
You'll catch up quickly enough, but
they're likely in hiding.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm, it's the rule of mercenaries. / They don't have proper equipment. / You should catch up quickly, but / there's a high possibility they're hiding.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_067.en:
So: find them as early as possible,
neutralize them, and bring them back?
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_067.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So I should find them as early as possible, neutralize them, / and bring them back?

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_068.en:
If possible.
The call on the ground is yours.
But... the wanzers they ran off in are
valuable assets too.
Word from above is, bring back the
parts at least.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_068.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If possible. / I leave the judgment on site to you. / However... the WAPs they're using / for their escape are also valuable forces. / The word is to bring back / at least the parts.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_070.en:
Buggy will join you as backup again.
Link up on site, then begin the
mission.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_070.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This time too, Buggy will join as reinforcement. / Start the mission after joining up on site.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_071.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. Sortieing at once.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_072.en:
Buggy will join you as backup again.
Link up on site, then begin the
mission.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_072.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This time too, Buggy will join as reinforcement. / Start the mission after joining up on site.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_073.en:
Two survivors from that unit
confirmed.
Continuing surveillance.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_073.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed 2 survivors of that unit. / Continuing surveillance.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_074.en:
Surveillance, sure.
Can't you lure one of 'em out already?
The client's riding my back.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_074.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Surveillance is fine. / Can't you lure one of them out soon? / The client's being noisy.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_075.en:
Not possible.
Their captain has sharp instincts.
Any more and he'll sense something.
Besides... No. It's nothing.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_075.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Impossible. / A guy with sharp intuition is serving as captain. / Any further action seems likely to be sensed. / Besides... no, nothing.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_076.en:
Sharp instincts? Who're we talking
about? If something's bugging you,
report it properly.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_076.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What's with this guy with sharp intuition? / If there's something bothering you, report it properly.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_077.en:
...Their captain has a tattoo shaped
like bat wings.
I've never seen that unit insignia
before.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_077.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...A man with a tattoo modeled on / bat wings is serving as captain, but / I've never seen this unit insignia.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_078.en:
What!?
Bat wings... What's his name?
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_078.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What!? / Bat wings... that man's name?

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_079.en:
He goes by «E801:00».
A merc codename, of course.
Real name unknown.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_079.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: He goes by «E801:00». / Of course, it's a mercenary codename. / Real name unknown.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_080.en:
«E801:00»...
No way... That's impossible.
...X-26, keep an eye on him too.
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_080.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: «E801:00»... / Nonsense... that can't be. / ...X-26, keep watch on that man too.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_081.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Ending report.

MsgLabels_station_09_msg_082.en:
(Bat wings... «E801:00»...
Barrett «E801:00»...)
(But there's no way he'd ever come
back to the battlefield...)
MsgLabels_station_09_msg_082.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Bat wings... «E801:00»... / Barrett «E801:00»...) / (But there's no way he would come back / to the battlefield...)

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_001.en:
This stray-hunting business is one
lousy mission...
MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This stray-hunting is / a nasty mission...

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_002.en:
Well, it's rough work.
I get wanting to run, sorta...
MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well, it's tough work, / so I understand wanting to run...

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_003.en:
It's like mercs eating their own,
isn't it?
And it feels like we're being tested
too. I don't like it.
MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's like mercenaries cannibalizing each other, right? / It feels like we're being tested too, / it's an unpleasant feeling.

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_004.en:
I understand, but anyone who doesn't
want to take part should head back
to base now.
MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I understand the feeling, but those who don't want to take part / had better return to base as is.

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_005.en:
Nah, I'm in.
If some other bunch goes,
it'll just be a slaughter.
MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, I'm in. / If other guys went, / it'd just become killing each other.

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_006.en:
Of course I'm going too.
Our squad might get through this
without anyone getting hurt.
MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Of course I'm going too. / With our squad, we might get it done / without casualties.

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood. / Captain, let's go.

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good, all units begin search operations.

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_009.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Deserter found.

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_012.en:
Men on the run are desperate.
All units, stay sharp.
MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The one trying to flee is desperate too. / All units, stay fully on guard.

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Found the 2nd unit!

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_015.en:
One left.
Don't force a one-on-one.
Work with your wingmen.
MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There's 1 unit left. / Don't force a one-on-one, / deal with it in coordination with your wingmates.

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Leave it to me.

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Found the last 1 unit!

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_018.en: All units, stay sharp till it's over.
MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units, don't let your guard down until the end.

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah, of course!

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_020.en:
All fleeing wanzers neutralized.
Receiving a surrender signal.
MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All fleeing WAPs neutralized. / Surrender signal received.

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_021.en:
Mission complete.
Contact the transport chopper on
standby.
MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission complete. / Contact the transport helicopter on standby.

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_023.en:
Once they're back, they get shipped
home, huh...
MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: When they get back, forced repatriation to the home country, huh...

MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_024.en:
Coming back alive beats the
alternative, I guess...
MsgLabels_tactics_09_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Maybe just getting back alive is better...

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, is something the matter?

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_002.en:
Rain, about that stray hunt.
Does that happen a lot around here?
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain, about the stray-hunting missions, / are they common here?

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_003.en:
Not often at this base.
At other bases, I hear mercs often
slip away around their second week.
These days people sign up as
mercenaries far too lightly...
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There weren't many at this base. / At other bases, mercenaries about 2 weeks into enlistment / often slip away, apparently. / Lately there are people who casually volunteer / to be mercenaries...

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_004.en:
That's what happens when people
unfit for war call themselves mercs.
Come to think of it, where's Buggy?
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is probably what happens when people unsuited to battlefields / call themselves mercenaries. / Come to think of it, I don't see Buggy?

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_005.en:
He went out last night on a fairly
easy solo mission. Partly as wanzer
rehab, I think.
But he's late.
He should be back by now...
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Last night, partly as WAP rehab, / he apparently went out on a relatively easy / single mission. / But he's late. / It wouldn't be strange if he'd already returned...

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_006.en: Knowing him, he'll be back soon.
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's him, he'll be back soon.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_007.en:
I suppose so.
He was so eager to get back out
there, I'm worried he'll do
something reckless.
He keeps everyone's spirits up and
gets along with anyone. That's a rare
thing on a battlefield.
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / He wanted to return to the battlefield quickly, so / I'm worried he's being reckless. / He's a mood maker, personable, / a valuable type on the battlefield.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_009.en:
Buggy hasn't even made his scheduled
check-in. That's not like him...
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Buggy, it's strange there's / not even a scheduled report...

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_010.en:
A mission?
...Buggy...
Understood. Preparing to sortie
at once.
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission? / ...Buggy... / Understood, I'll prepare to sortie at once.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gugooh...

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_012.en:
Asleep here again...
Maybe something's wrong with his
quarters...
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: He's sleeping here again... / Maybe there's some problem with his own room...

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gugooh...

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_014.en:
Buggy...?
Dammit, that woke me right up.
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Buggy...? / Geez, that blew my sleepiness away.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Captain...

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You don't look happy, Oddeye.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_017.en:
That stray hunt...
It left a bad taste, didn't it?
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Stray-hunting... was unpleasant.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_018.en:
It seems to be common in merc units
these days.
Mercs or not, we handle military
secrets.
I suppose it can't be helped.
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems to be a common thing in mercenary units lately. / Even mercenaries handle secrets / relating to the army. / It can't be helped, I suppose.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_019.en:
I know it was in the contract when I
signed up...
But getting shot by your own side,
before you even fall on a mission...
If I have to go, I'd rather go down
fighting...
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Indeed, when I volunteered as a mercenary / it was written in the contract documents, but... / To be shot by allies / before dying in action on a mission... / If anything, I'd rather die fighting...

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_020.en:
Oddeye, a mercenary doesn't get to
choose how they die.
Anyone who worries about how they'll
die won't last on the battlefield.
Better to think of it that way.
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, mercenary isn't a profession where you can / choose how you die. / You'd better assume that those who care how they die / can't survive on the battlefield.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_021.en:
You're right...
Oh, and besides, I can't die yet...
The movies I want to see haven't
even come out!
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right... / Ah, besides, I can't die yet... / The movie I want to see hasn't even started yet!

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_022.en:
That kind of motivation to live
might be what keeps you alive.
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That kind of motivation to live / might just be the power to survive.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_023.en:
Motivation to live...
Yeah, yeah, that's it!
Talking it out really cleared my
head. Thank you!
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Motivation to live... / Mm-hm, that's right! / Somehow talking cleared my head. / Thank you very much!

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_024.en:
There's that one to see...
and that one I still haven't
bought...
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I want to see that too, / and I haven't bought that yet...

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_025.en:
Huh? Buggy...?
I'll get ready right away.
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? Mr. Buggy...? / I'll get ready at once.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Alchemist isn't here again...)

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Is it already this time.)

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (...I'd like to believe in my comrade.)

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_029.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
Huh?«g:24»
Buggy's not back yet?
He said it was a quick one, and to
fit him with the rifle that came in
today once he got back.
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yo, «E801:00». / Huh? / Buggy's not back yet? / He told me since it's a mission that'll end quickly, / when he's back, to equip / the rifle that came in today.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_030.en:
Buggy sortied and hasn't made his
scheduled check-in.
You don't think he...
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There's no scheduled report from Buggy, who sortied. / That guy, maybe...

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I owe Buggy...... a debt...

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_032.en:
One of our wanzers has failed to
return.
So far there's no sign it was shot
down. If we can't find out where he
went, he'll officially be suspected
of desertion and espionage.
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A WAP unit from this base has failed / to return. / Since there's no sign of it having been shot down / so far, if we can't grasp his whereabouts / any further, he'll officially fall under / suspicion of desertion and spying.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_033.en:
One unit.
Do we know where contact was lost?
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 1 unit, huh. / Is the place where contact was lost known?

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_034.en:
We've pinpointed it.
I want him brought back before this
goes public...
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The location has been pinpointed. / I want you to bring him back before it goes public...

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_035.en:
The way you say that...
The target's someone we know?
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The way you say that, is the target an acquaintance?

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's Buggy.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_037.en:
...Didn't he go out on a simple solo
mission, as wanzer rehab?
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Didn't he go on a simple single-unit mission / for WAP rehab?

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_038.en:
It was a simple solo mission, yes.
But since he completed it, there's
been no contact at all.
And since then, what look like enemy
units have been sighted nearby.
If he's working with the enemy,
we may have to shoot him down.
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It certainly was a simple single mission. / But after mission completion, there's been no contact at all. / Furthermore, after that, signatures that seem to be enemies / have been confirmed in the vicinity. / If he's in league with the enemy, / shooting him down is unavoidable.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_039.en:
He never showed any sign of that.
...Mission understood.
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There wasn't any sign of that at all, though. / ...Mission understood.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_040.en:
Watch out for chance run-ins with
the enemy. We know enemy forces will
reach that area in 7 turns.
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Watch out for accidental combat with the enemy. / We know the enemy will arrive in that area / in 7 turns.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_041.en:
So if we take too long, enemy
reinforcements show up.
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So if we take too much time, / enemy reinforcements come.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_042.en:
They'll probably send a chopper unit
ahead as a vanguard.
If so, shoot down the recon chopper
and you'll buy yourselves some time.
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: They'll probably dispatch a helicopter unit / as the vanguard. / In that case, shooting down the recon helicopters / should buy time.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_043.en:
Understood.
A search will take manpower...
I'd like Alchemist's help as well.
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / When it comes to searching for a person, we need manpower... / I'd like to ask Alchemist to cooperate too.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_044.en:
Unfortunately he's already out on
another solo mission.
Not the sociable type, it seems.
He's asked to be given solo missions
whenever possible.
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Unfortunately he has already sortied / on another single mission. / It seems he's not very good / at socializing. / He'd like as many single missions / as possible sent his way.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_045.en:
Mercs don't get paid to socialize.
That's just the kind of man he is.
We'll move out, then.
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mercenaries don't get paid for socializing, / after all. / He must be that kind of person. / Then we'll sortie.

MsgLabels_station_10_msg_046.en:
Shoot down the recon chopper out in
front, and you'll buy some time.
MsgLabels_station_10_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If you shoot down the vanguard recon helicopters, / you should be able to buy time.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_002.en:
Damn you, Buggy...
You could've at least called in...
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That Buggy... / At least send word...

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_003.en:
Maybe his wanzer broke down and he's
stuck out there?
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is it a unit malfunction / and he can't move?

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If so, that'd still be better.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_005.en:
Either way, it's on us to find him
and bring him back.
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Either way, we have no choice but to find him ourselves / and bring him back.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Of course.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_007.en:
Hang in there, buddy.
We're coming to get you!
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wait for us. / We're coming to get you now!

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_008.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_010.en:
Friendly wanzer... Buggy's unit
located.
The pilot is... not inside.
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Allied WAP... Buggy's unit found. / The pilot is... not here.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There are bloodstains on the seat...

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Buggy's footprints are... these?

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_013.en:
That's them.
Huh? Captain...
There are wanzer tracks here I've never
seen before!
Looks like they're following Buggy.
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There are. / Huh? Captain... / There are also footprints of a WAP I've never seen! / It seems to be chasing Mr. Buggy.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_014.en:
...Looks like Buggy ditched his wanzer
and ran.
Captain, let's go after him now!
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Buggy, / seems he abandoned the WAP and ran. / Captain, let's chase after him at once!

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_015.en:
Wait.
Rotor noise, closing in.
This aircraft...
The ID code doesn't match...
An unknown...
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wait. / I detected approaching rotor noise. / This unit... / The identification code doesn't match... / An unknown, huh...

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_016.en:
Captain Gryphon,
target unit located.
Four wanzer signatures confirmed.
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain Griffon, / we've found the target's unit. / Confirmed 4 WAP signatures.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_017.en:
Gryphon Eye,
watch out for the target's wanzers.
This time we take him unharmed.
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Griffon Eye, / be careful of the target's WAP. / This time we capture him unharmed.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_018.en:
Gryphon Eye, roger.
Relaying to deployed units now.
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is Griffon Eye, roger. / Contacting the deployed units at once.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_019.en:
All units, anti-air intercept
formation.
Once we have a lead on Buggy,
we pull out.
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units take anti-air interception stance. / Once we get a lead on Buggy, we escape.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_021.en:
Mayday, mayday!
This is Gryphon Eye.
Took a direct hit.
N-no good, I'm going dow--
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mayday mayday! / This is Griffon Eye. / Took a direct hit. / N-no good, going down...

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_022.en:
That should hold off their
reinforcements for a while.
All units, take out what's left.
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Reinforcements won't come for a while now. / All units, hit the remaining forces.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_023.en:
Captain!
It's Buggy!
I've found him. He's badly hurt.
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain! / It's Buggy! / Found him, he's badly hurt.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ugh...

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_025.en:
We can't pull out of here carrying
wounded.
We clear out the remaining enemy.
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's impossible to withdraw from the battle line / carrying a wounded man. / We'll drive out the remaining enemies.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain... it's Buggy. / ...He's not breathing.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_028.en:
The enemy recon chopper got away.
Watch for reinforcements.
Resuscitation waits until after the
fight...
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Did we let the enemy recon helicopter escape. / Watch for reinforcements. / Resuscitation comes after the battle...

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Buggy, hang in there!

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_030.en:
R-Rain, is that you...
Captain «E801:00» too...
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: R-Rain, huh... / Captain «E801:00» too...

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_031.en:
Champ, you've got a first aid kit?
Patch him up.
Buggy, keep it simple.
Can you tell us what happened?
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ, / you have a first aid kit, right? / First aid. / Buggy, it's fine if it's simple, / can you tell us what happened?

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_032.en:
Sensors went haywire...
Wandered into this... forest...
A pitch-black... wanzer...
Ngh... ghhh...
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The sensors went haywire... / I wandered into this forest... and... / A pitch-black... WAP... / U... gugu...

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood, you're alright now.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_034.en:
The bleeding won't stop...
Dammit!
His pulse keeps getting weaker...
Dammit all!
Not enough morphine either!
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The bleeding won't stop... / Damn! / His pulse is getting weaker and weaker... / Damn it! / Not enough morphine either!

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_035.en:
I called for a medevac chopper ages
ago...
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I requested the rescue helicopter long ago...

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_036.en:
This is enemy territory.
They can't get in that easily...
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is enemy territory. / They probably can't approach easily...

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...M... Mom, I'm sorry...

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_038.en:
Buggy, don't talk.
Just breathe easy.
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Buggy, don't talk anymore. / Breathe easy.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_039.en:
Rain...
S-send my money... to my mom...
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain... / S-send my money... to my mom...

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood... I promise.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Th-thank...

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_042.en:
Open your eyes!
Don't you go to sleep!!
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Open your eyes! / Don't sleep!!

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Buggy!!

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_044.en:
...Recover Buggy and his unit.
We're heading back.
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...We'll recover Buggy and his unit and return to base.

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger...

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_046.en:
Looks like they beat him bad.
His face is... you can't even tell
it's him...
And a gunshot wound to the head,
point-blank...
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Looks like he was beaten badly. / His face is like a different person's... / And on top of that, a gunshot wound to the head from point-blank range...

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Buggy... / He was tortured...

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's too cruel...

MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_049.en:
...Recover Buggy and his unit.
We're heading back.
Rain, arrange for his belongings to
be sent to his family.
MsgLabels_tactics_10_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...We'll recover Buggy and his unit and return to base. / Rain, arrange to send his belongings / to his bereaved family.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh. Captain.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_002.en: I don't see Rain or Oddeye.
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems Rain and Oddeye aren't here.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_003.en: Those two? They went to the bar.
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Those two went to the bar.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The bar. / Understood.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_005.en: Those two? They went to the bar.
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Those two went to the bar.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_006.en:
Moving out?
Alright, let's go wild today too!
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie. / Alright, I'm gonna run wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_008.en:
Rain, Oddeye.
So this is where you were.
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain, Oddeye, / so you were here.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_009.en:
Yesh...
Cap'n, you wanna drink shomething?
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yesh... / Cap'n, will you drink shomething too?

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_010.en:
All right.
I'll have what she's having.
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Let's see. / Then I'll have the same thing.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_011.en:
Ehhh...
You really shouldn't, y'know?
I tried to keep up with Rain an'...
now everything'sh shpinning!
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ehh... / You really better not, ya know? / Even I, when I kept pace with Miss Rain... / am all wobbly-wobbly!

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Liquor is nothing much. / Gulp...

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_013.en:
Hngh!! ...Khaff!...
What is this?
Is this a drink?
Isn't this some kind of
disinfectant?
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hauh! ...Gahah!... / What is this? / Is this liquor? / Isn't it some kind of disinfectant?

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_014.en:
Ahaha, Rain'sh drinksh, no way!
Nobody can keep up with that!
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ahaha, Miss Rain's liquor, impossible! / No matter what, I can't keep up!

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_015.en:
It's Spirytus... a vodka.
It's a little on the strong side,
Captain, so please don't push
yourself.
I just felt like getting drunk,
for once...
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Spiritus... it's vodka. / It's a slightly strong liquor, so / Captain, please don't push yourself. / I was in the mood to really get drunk...

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_016.en:
"A little" strong...
But Rain, you seem exactly the same
as always...
Whereas Oddeye, on the other hand...
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I think it's too strong... / But Rain, / you seem no different than usual... / In contrast, Oddeye is...

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_017.en:
Wha'? Ish it a party?
Cap'n, let'sh go do KARAOKE!
Oh, but I'm shleepy.
Gonna... nap now...
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Whazzat? / A fes'ival? / Cap'n, let's go to KARAOKEee! / Ah, but I'm shleepy. / I'm gonna shleep...

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_018.en:
Oh dear, Oddeye...
Let's get you back to your room, hm?
Ah, she's fallen asleep...
I'm sorry, Captain...
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh my, Oddeye... / Shall we go back to your room? / Ah, seems she fell asleep... / I'm sorry, Captain...

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_019.en:
Don't worry about it.
Let her sleep.
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Don't worry about it. / Let her sleep.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_020.en:
In her own way, she was trying to
cheer me up.
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems she was trying, in her own way, / to cheer me up.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_021.en:
Sounds like a good comrade.
...I'm sorry about Buggy.
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Isn't she a good comrade. / ...It was a shame about Buggy.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_022.en:
Now I'm the only survivor left from
my old squad.
...I knew it might come to this when
I became a merc, but...
it's lonely, isn't it?
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: With this, I've become the only survivor / of the previous unit. / ...I'd been prepared for it since becoming a mercenary, / but it's lonely.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_023.en:
It is...
For the fallen, all we can do is
remember them.
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right... / All we can do for the war dead / is mourn them.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_024.en:
You've been through this too,
haven't you, Captain...
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Surely you've experienced it too, Captain...

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_025.en:
...Comrades dying.
It's burned into my memory.
But we can't grieve forever.
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...The death of comrades-in-arms. / It's vividly burned into my memory. / But we can't keep grieving forever.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_026.en:
Huh?
Cap'n and Rain?
Why're you talkin' in my room?
...Huh? This isn't my room.
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Huh? / Cap'n and Miss Rain? / Why are you talking in my room? / ...Huh? Seems it's not my room.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_027.en:
Oh, you're awake.
I'm sorry, Captain.
I'll take Oddeye back to her room.
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh, you're awake. / Captain, I'm sorry. / I'll take Oddeye to her room.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / That's best.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_029.en:
Thanks to you, I feel a little
calmer now. Thank you.
Please join me again some time.
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thanks to you, my feelings have calmed down a bit. / Thank you very much. / Please join me again.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_030.en:
I don't mind drinking, but
spare me the Spirytus...
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I don't mind drinking, but / spare me the Spiritus...

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / Roger.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_032.en: Let's have a drink together again.
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Please drink with me again.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm all floppy-wobbly.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_035.en:
A shortie...?
I'll do my besht!

Ow, ow...
But first I'm gonna go get some
hangover meds from the infirmary...
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A shortie...? / I'll do my besht! /  / Ah, ow ow... / Before that I'll get / alcohol-breakdown medicine at the infirmary...

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_036.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
I heard about Buggy.
It's a damn shame, but...
maybe it'll give us a lead on the
disappearances.
By the way, some new parts came in.
Gear up and pay 'em back for Buggy,
ya hear?
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yo, «E801:00». / I heard about Buggy. / It's a shame about him, but... / maybe it'll be a lead in the disappearance incidents. / Come to think of it, new parts have come in. / Strengthen your equipment and avenge Buggy / for him.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_037.en:
Back when I was a rookie, I used to
wonder why a base needs a bar...
But out here, sometimes you just
wanna drown it all in a drink.
Oh, there's a bar in New Millgan
called "Jiira" that's been open
since the first settlers.
Great atmosphere. Check it out if
you ever get the chance.
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: When I was a new recruit, / I wondered why there was a bar / on the base... / When you're on the battlefield, there are times / you want to escape into liquor. / Come to think of it, in New Milgan / there's a bar called "Jiira" that's been running / since the time of settlement. / It's a shop with a good atmosphere, so / if you have the chance, try going.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_038.en:
...The money I owe Buggy...
...should I give it... to Rain...
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...The money I borrowed from Buggy... / Should I hand it... to Rain...

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_039.en:
This mission is a joint operation
with the regulars.
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This mission is a joint operation with the regular army.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's rare. / The operation content?

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_041.en:
A special forces team will seize a
VIP hiding out in the Pacific
Huffman Hotel in Freedom City.
Your job is to secure the area and
clear away anything in their path,
so they don't get taken out.
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A special forces unit will secure a VIP / hiding in the Pacific Huffman Hotel / in Freedom City. / So they don't get destroyed, / handle surveillance of the surroundings and sweeping of obstacles.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_042.en:
Isn't that area supposed to be a
demilitarized zone?
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That area should be a demilitarized zone?

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_043.en:
On paper, yes.
And taking advantage of that, armed
guerrillas have made it their den.
Needless to say, attacking civilians
is strictly forbidden.
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Officially, it is. / But taking advantage of that, it has become a den / of armed guerrillas. / I think you understand, but attacks on civilians / are strictly forbidden.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_044.en:
How do we tell guerrillas from
civilians?
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: How to distinguish armed guerrillas from civilians?

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_045.en:
Anyone who attacks you is a hostile
target. Engage on that basis.
The call on the ground is yours.
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Fight treating those who attack you / as hostile targets. / I leave the judgment on site to you.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_046.en:
We can't attack until we're shot at.
And if we kill a civilian by
mistake, the regulars aren't
responsible.
Truly a job made for mercs.
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We can't attack until we're shot. / Yet if we kill civilians by mistake, / it won't be the regular army's responsibility. / Truly a mission for mercenaries.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_047.en:
Don't be like that.
Starting with this op, replacement
merc Gray is assigned to
«E801:00» Squad.
He's ex-special forces.
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Don't say that. / From this time, replacement mercenary Gray / is assigned to «E801:00» Squad. / A mercenary from special forces.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Special forces... huh.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_049.en:
His file says he has combat
experience as a special forces
sniper.
