No word on his wanzer skills, but he
should have plenty of aptitude.
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: According to the documents he has real combat experience / as a special forces sniper. / His WAP piloting skill is unknown, but / he should have plenty of talent.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_050.en:
Roger. Sounds like he can shoot.
...And if enemy reinforcements show?
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger, it seems his skill can be counted on. / ...Countermeasure for enemy reinforcements?

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_051.en:
If they're too much to handle, head
for POINT B.
An evac chopper will be waiting.
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If destroying them is difficult, head to Point B. / A pickup helicopter is waiting.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / «E801:00» Squad, sortieing.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_053.en:
If they're too much to handle, head
for POINT B.
An evac chopper will be waiting.
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If destroying them is difficult, head to Point B. / A pickup helicopter is waiting.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_054.en:
My apologies...
The target got away from us.
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm terribly sorry... / We let the target get away.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_055.en:
Hell, what are you even doing...
Now there's only one survivor left
from that unit.
Whatever.
Dead's dead. Can't be helped.
Gryphon, come on back.
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Geez, what are you doing... / The survivors of that unit / are down to the last 1. / Well, fine. / What's dead can't be helped. / Griffon, return.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. Returning now.

MsgLabels_station_11_msg_057.en:
Barrett «E801:00»...
Looks like it's really him.
Well, well. This is gonna get
interesting.
MsgLabels_station_11_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Barrett «E801:00»... / Seems he's the real thing. / Well, this looks like it's going to get interesting.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_001.en:
This is Delta.
In position.
We'll hit the target when your
diversion kicks off.
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is Delta. / In position. / Timed to the diversion, / we'll storm the target.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_002.en:
«E801:00» Squad, roger.
Beginning sweep around the target
facility now.
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: «E801:00» Squad, roger. / Beginning sweep around the target facility at once.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_003.en:
If we're the diversion, let's make
it loud!
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If it's a diversion, let's go flashy!

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Special forces...

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_005.en:
We draw the enemy out before they
can organize.
But nobody fires first.
Not until we know whether they're
civilians or guerrillas.
Oddeye, are you listening?
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We'll smoke out the enemy before the hostile forces get organized. / However, don't lay a hand first. / Not until we can confirm whether they're / civilians or armed guerrillas. / Oddeye, are you listening?

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_006.en:
Oh, yes, sorry...
Um, so we can't tell who the enemy
is until they shoot at us?
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, yes, sorry... / Um, we don't know who the enemy is / until we get shot at?

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_007.en:
Whoever takes hostile action is an
armed guerrilla. That's the rule.
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It means whoever takes hostile action / is an armed guerrilla.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So that's it. / Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_009.en:
So we make ourselves the targets...
The regular army would never run an
op like this...
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Becoming a target ourselves... / An operation unthinkable in the regular army...

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_010.en:
No need to worry.
Guerrillas around here don't get
much chance to train.
You can think of it as warning shots,
mostly.
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There's no need to worry. / The guerrillas around here aren't in an environment / where they can build much training, / so you can consider it mostly warning shots.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_011.en:
Even so, warning shots are still
live rounds flying around.
If your luck's bad, that's it.
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But even if they're warning shots, / it doesn't change that live bullets are flying. / If your luck's bad, that's it.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_012.en:
Yep.
Gray, was it?
Don't go eating some lucky shot in
your first bout and dropping dead
on us, got it?
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Right. / Gray, was it. / Don't go taking a lousy bullet in your first appearance / and dying right away, ya hear?

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Roger, I'll be careful.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_014.en:
Still... Delta 1's voice...
Is it just a coincidence...?
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even so, Delta 1's voice... / I wonder if it's a coincidence...

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_015.en:
Oddeye?
You're drifting out of formation.
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye? / The formation is in disorder, you know?

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, sorry...

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_017.en:
All units look ready.
This is the merc unit.
Beginning the operation.
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units, it seems you're ready? / This is the mercenary unit, beginning the operation.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / We wish you luck.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_019.en:
Victory: Delta completes its op.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed
or Delta wiped out.
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: Delta's operation ends. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down, or / Delta annihilated.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_021.en: The guerrillas have taken the bait.
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The enemy armed guerrillas / took the bait nicely.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_022.en:
So it seems.
All units, keep drawing them in.
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So it seems. / All units, keep drawing in the enemy unit like this.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_023.en:
This is Delta 1.
Looks like you've lured them out
nicely. Thanks for the diversion.
Main team is commencing the op.
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is Delta 1. / Seems you lured the enemy nicely. / Thanks for the diversion. / The main force will now begin the operation.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_024.en:
I didn't think being bait would be
this much work...
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I didn't know playing decoy was this hard...

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_025.en:
Captain, if this drags on it'll get
dangerous!
New contacts are starting to show
up on radar!
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, it's dangerous if this drags on too long! / New signatures are also starting / to show up on radar!

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_026.en:
This is Delta 1.
Target secured.
Heading for extraction POINT A.
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is Delta 1. / Succeeded in securing the target. / Heading to escape Point A now.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_027.en:
Roger.
Enemy reinforcements are closing in.
Hurry.
We'll keep covering Delta's
withdrawal.
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Reinforcements seem to be closing in. / Hurry. / Main force continues supporting Delta's escape.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / We'll do our best.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_029.en:
This is Delta 1.
Arrived at extraction POINT A.
«E801:00» Squad, we're picking up
the enemy reinforcements too.
It's a big force.
Do you need support?
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is Delta 1. / Arrived at escape Point A. / «E801:00» Squad, we've also picked up / the enemy reinforcements here. / Quite a number. / Do you need support?

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_030.en:
Delta 1, don't worry about us.
Get out of there.
We're heading for our own
extraction point.
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Delta 1, don't worry about us. / Hurry your withdrawal. / We'll also rush to the escape point.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_031.en:
Sorry. We'll take you up on that.
You dogs of war know your business.
Smooth work.
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry, we'll take you up on that. / But as expected of war-dealers. / You're efficient.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_032.en:
Delta's not bad either.
You'd earn more as mercs.
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Delta's skilled too. / If you became mercenaries you'd earn more than now.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_033.en:
Not a bad offer.
I hope we get a unit like yours
covering us on the next op, too.
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Quite a good proposal. / In the next mission too, I hope to be supported / by a unit like yours.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_034.en:
Until the next battlefield.
All units, head for POINT B.
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: On some battlefield again. / All units, rush to Point B.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_036.en:
We're under attack!
Dammit, where's «E801:00» Squad!?
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy attack! / Bad, isn't «E801:00» Squad here yet!?

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_037.en:
Captain, enemies near POINT B.
We won't make it in time from here!
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, enemies near Point B. / From here we won't make it!

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_038.en:
I'm hit!
No good, I can't take off...
Aaaagh!!
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm hit! / No good, can't take off... / Uwaaah!!

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_039.en:
The evac chopper's gone silent...
Pilot status unknown.
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The escape helicopter has gone silent... / The pilot's status is unknown.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_040.en:
And pursuers are closing in!
Captain, what do we do!?
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Pursuers are closing in too! / Captain, what do we do!?

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_041.en:
I'm afraid the pilot's beyond help.
...Change of plan.
The north point, where their cordon
is thinnest, is now POINT C.
We break out from there.
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Unfortunately, the pilot can't be saved. / ...Change of plan. / The point to the north where the enemy encirclement / is thinnest will be C. / We'll escape from there.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_042.en:
Roger. Looks like there's no other
way out...
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger, it seems there's no other way...

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_043.en:
So the finish line's got a few more
guys in the way. Big deal.
We've come this far. Same as always:
we go home alive!
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The goal just got a few more enemies around it. / We've earned this far, like always, / we're going home alive!

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_044.en:
When we get back, it's a welcome
party for the new guy!
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: When we get back, it's the newcomer welcome party!

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? / Newcomer means me!?

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_046.en:
Yeah, you.
If we get back alive, we go big!
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah, that's right. / If we make it back alive, a flashy one!

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_047.en:
Oddeye, what about your hangover?
...Honestly, all of you, at a time
like this...
Captain, say something!
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, what about your hangover? / Geez, everyone, at a time like this... / Captain, please say something!

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_048.en:
Picturing the trip home in a spot
like this isn't a bad thing.
All units, hurry to POINT C.
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Having an image of after the return / in this situation isn't bad. / All units, hurry to Point C.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed all squad units are safe.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Phew, what a relief.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Haa haa, we somehow made it...

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_053.en:
It should be safe from here.
The mission's complete.
Returning to base.
MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: From here on it should be safe. / The mission is complete. / Returning to base now.

MsgLabels_tactics_11_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Machine gun faction

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Shotgun faction

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Nothing in particular

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain. / Is something the matter?

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_005.en:
Rain, what do you make of our
squad's wanzer lineup?
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain, / what do you think of our squad's WAP composition?

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_006.en:
Two Assaults, yours and mine.
One Striker, Champ's.
One Launcher, Oddeye's.
And with Gray joining as a Sniper,
the squad has no blind spots now.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Two Assaults, yours and mine, Captain, / one Striker, Champ's, / one Launcher, Oddeye's. / Plus with Gray the Sniper joining, / the unit has no blind spots anymore.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_007.en:
Hold on a sec!
Add more Strikers!
No way one of me is enough!
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wait a sec! / Add more Strikers too! / However you think about it, me alone isn't enough!

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_008.en:
I'll grant you Strikers hit hard.
But I think the current lineup is
the best one.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I acknowledge the Striker's fighting power. / But I think the current composition is the best.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_009.en:
Get a whole pile of Strikers and
pound 'em as a gang! Nothing'd be
stronger than that!
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If we gather lots of Strikers / and beat 'em up as a group, that's the strongest!

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Is Champ's brain muscle too...?

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_011.en:
...A lineup that lopsided, a pack
of Strikers, can't adapt when the
situation changes.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...A group of Strikers, / such a lopsided composition can't respond / flexibly to circumstances.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_012.en:
Rain, if you go head-to-head with a
muscle-head, you'll just wear
yourself out, you know?
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Miss Rain, if you clash head-on with a muscle-brain man / too much, you'll get tired, ya know?

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Muscle-brain man...!

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_014.en:
Rain's right. One Striker is plenty.
What I'm counting on more is Gray's
long-range fire.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As Rain says, / one Striker is enough. / Rather than that, I'd like to put my hopes / in Gray's long-range attacks.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wha! Even the Captain!!

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'd like to put my hopes in Gray.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_018.en:
Oh, Captain.
Some new wanzer parts came in, did you
know?
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Captain. / New WAP parts came in stock, ya know?

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_019.en:
I see.
I'll check the hangar later.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / I'll check the hangar later.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_020.en:
Oh, by the way, Captain,
are you a shotgun person?
Or a machine gun person?
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Speaking of which, Captain, / are you the shotgun faction? / Or the machine gun faction?

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_021.en:
Weapons have factions now...
Well, if I had to pick...
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There are factions among weapons... / Let's see, if anything...

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_022.en:
Ooh, I knew it, machine guns!
I love machine guns too.
The way the shell casings fly out in
rhythm... so cool!
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ooh, as expected, it's machine guns, right! / I like machine guns too. / The way the shell casings fly rhythmically and stuff / is cool!

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_023.en:
Cool or not, in real combat they're
reliable.
Once you're used to them, you can
even snipe with short bursts.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Coolness aside, / in real combat they're reliable after all. / Once you're used to it, sniping with short trigger bursts is possible.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_024.en:
Machine guns are the best, aren't
they?
Even if your aim's bad, spray enough
and you'll hit something!
Oh, a new machine gun came in too.
I'm gonna buy one!
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: They're great, aren't they, machine guns. / Even if you're bad at shooting, if you fire away like crazy / you can hit! / Ah, come to think of it, new machine guns / came in too, I'll buy one too!

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_025.en:
Machine guns are the best, aren't
they?
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: They're great, aren't they, machine guns.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_026.en:
Ooh, shotguns...
Old school. Classy.
Hmm.
They're really satisfying, though.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Heh, shotguns... / How seasoned of you. / Hmm. / They sure are exhilarating.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_027.en:
Buckshot cuts down your aiming time
when you run into an enemy head-on.
And up close, stopping power matters
more than anything.
It's ideal for shredding wanzer parts.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Scattered shot, when you run into an enemy head-on, / can shorten sighting time, / and at close range, stopping power / is considered more important. / It's particularly ideal for shaving down WAP parts.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_028.en:
Ooh, so that's how you use them.
Oh, a shotgun came in, too.
I'll try buying one!
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Heh, so you use them like that. / Ah, come to think of it, shotguns / came in too. / I'll try buying one too!

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_029.en:
Shotguns, huh.
I'll try buying one!
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Shotguns, huh. / I'll try buying one too!

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Nothing in particular, really.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ehh... you don't have one?

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_032.en:
Rather, I try to be able to handle
whatever tool I'm given, in any
situation.
It's best to train until you're
used to every kind of firearm.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rather, I keep in mind / to adapt to whatever tool I use / in any situation. / It'd be better to train / to get used to handling all firearms.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Tool! / You call weapons tools!?

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah. / They're tools.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_035.en:
Tools, huh...
Haven't messed with any of mine
lately...
Oh, right, my PC's been acting up.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Tools, huh. / ...Haven't touched any lately. / Ah, my PC was acting up.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What are you talking about...?

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_037.en:
Oh, no.
Nothing.
Oh, more importantly! A "flame...
thrower"? A flamethrower?
Something pretty scary came in.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, no. / It's nothing. / Ah, more than that, flaymm-throwerr? / Flamethrower? / Some dangerous-sounding weapon came in stock.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_038.en:
A flamethrower, huh.
Maybe I'll buy one...
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Flamethrower, huh. / Maybe I'll try buying one...

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_039.en:
Oh, Captain.
Did you buy any of the
new wanzer parts?
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Captain. / Did you buy the new WAP parts?

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_040.en:
Oh, a sortie!
I'll get ready!
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, a sortie, right. / I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_041.en:
You oughta do some strength training
once in a while too, Captain.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Once in a while you'd better do / strength training too, Captain.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_042.en: True, I haven't trained much lately.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Indeed, I haven't trained lately.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_043.en:
Perfect timing, then.
Why not join me for once?
Let your body go soft and nothing
good comes of it.
Even retired, if I skip a workout,
I'm sluggish all the next morning.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's perfect. / How about together once in a while? / When your body gets dull, nothing good comes of it. / Even me, though I retired from active play, / if I skip training / I'm sluggish, sluggish the next morning.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_044.en:
Champ, I hear you did some kind of
martial art.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ, / I heard you did some martial art.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_045.en:
Huh? C-Captain...
You seriously don't know who I am...
Not even what my codename "Champ"
means?
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? C-Captain... / You seriously don't know me... / Not even the meaning of my / codename, Champ?

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_046.en:
I had a vague idea you were a
champion of something.
Sorry. I'm not up on worldly
matters...
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I vaguely thought you were probably / some kind of champion. / Sorry, I'm ignorant of worldly things...

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_047.en:
Oh, nah, don't worry about it!
Hahaha!
A merc's past doesn't matter anyway!
...Welp, I'm goin' for a run!!
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, no, don't worry about it! / Hahaha! / A mercenary's past doesn't matter! / ...Well then, I'm off to do roadwork!!

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_048.en:
Captain. Did you say something to
Champ? He looked kinda gloomy.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, did you say something to Champ? / He seemed kind of gloomy.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_049.en:
No, nothing in particular...
Oddeye, do you know what Champ was a
champion of?
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, not really... / Oddeye, do you know / what Champ is the champion of?

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_050.en:
Oh, that.
I didn't know either, but I looked
him up online, and it seems he was
famous in pro wrestling or
something?
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, that story. / I didn't know either, but / when I looked it up online, seems he was / a celebrity in pro wrestling or something?

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_051.en:
Oh, are we talking about Champ?
Oddeye... that's not pro wrestling.
Champ won the stand-up MMA title
three years running. He was a very
popular fighter.
Even I knew who he was.
When the base saw his profile,
everyone went wild.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh my, talking about Champ? / Oddeye... / That's not pro wrestling... / Champ was a 3-years-running champion of / stand-up mixed martial arts, a fighter who was / quite popular. / Even I knew him. / On the base everyone was making a fuss / when they saw his profile.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_052.en:
I see...
For the past few years, I haven't
been in the habit of watching TV,
reading magazines, or going online.
If he's that famous, I may have hurt
his pride.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see... / For the past few years I haven't been in the habit / of watching TV or magazines, let alone the net. / If he's such a famous person, / I may have wounded his pride.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_053.en:
Don't worry about it.
He'll forget all about it in three
days anyway.
Oh, and guess what? I'm a champ too!
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You don't need to worry about it, / he'll forget after 3 days anyway. / Ah, speaking of which, I'm a champ too, ya know?

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh? / That's news to me.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_055.en:
I may not look it, but I'm a
world-ranked player in a super
famous FPS!
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Despite how I look, / I'm a world ranker in a super-famous FPS!

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_056.en:
Seems this squad has a lot of
celebrities.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Seems to be a unit with many celebrities.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_057.en:
...No, Captain.
I'd never heard of this one.
I expect it's about an online game.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...No, Captain. / I didn't know either. / That's probably about an online game.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_058.en:
Whaaat? I'm at the TOP out of
three million players...?
You don't know!?
In the gaming world, three million
people know who I am!
Oh... so this is it...
Maybe I get how Champ feels now...
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ehh? I'm TOP among 3 million people, ya know...? / You don't know! / In the gaming world 3 million people / know me, ya know? / Ah, so this is it... / Maybe I understand how Champ feels a little...

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_059.en:
...In short, every field has its own
idea of what matters.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...In short, / values vary by field... is that it.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_060.en: That seems to be the gist of it.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems that's what it is.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Well then, / I'm off to do roadwork!!

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_062.en:
You oughta do some strength training
once in a while too, Captain.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Once in a while you'd better do / strength training too, Captain.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_063.en:
Moving out?
Alright, today we go all out wild!
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie. / Alright, today I'm going all-out wild!

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_064.en:
So this is the merc barracks.
This is where everyone's been.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The mercenaries' guardroom. / So everyone was here.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_065.en:
Yes.
Between missions, everyone comes here
to unwind.
Feel free to use it too, Gray.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah. / Between missions, everyone / takes a breather here. / You should use it too, Gray.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_066.en:
I will, thanks.
By the way, Champ... he's that
fighting legend, right?
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll do that. / Come to think of it, Champ is... / that martial arts hero, right?

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_067.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gray, you know Champ.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_068.en:
Of course.
Wow, meeting him in a place like
this...
There sure are all kinds of mercs,
huh.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_068.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Of course. / Amazing, to meet him in a place like this... / Even so, there sure are all kinds of mercenaries.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_069.en:
It may be a military facility, but
most of them have no military
training.
They're allowed a freedom you'd never
see in the regular army, but they've
survived real combat. They're good.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_069.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even though it's a military facility, / almost all of them haven't received military training. / They're allowed freedom of speech and conduct / unthinkable for military personnel, but / the skill of those who survive real combat is solid.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_070.en:
That's what's amazing about mercs.
They calmly pull off missions the
army can't... That's not ordinary.
I'd better fit in soon, too.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_070.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's what's amazing about mercenaries. / The ability to calmly carry out missions the army can't... / it's not ordinary. / I need to fit in quickly too.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_071.en:
You're one of them now, Gray.
Better get used to the atmosphere
quickly.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_071.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You're one of them too, Gray. / You'd better get used to this atmosphere quickly.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_072.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Right. / Roger.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_073.en: I'd better fit in soon, too.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_073.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I need to fit in quickly too.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_074.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_075.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
You guys really went to town on that
last mission.
Well, however much you wreck, the
whole crew'll fix it up, so relax.
Oh, and a new rifle came in.
Buy it and I'll fit it for ya.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_075.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yo, «E801:00». / You really went wild / last mission. / Well, no matter how much you break, the whole maintenance team / will fix it, so rest easy. / Also, a new rifle has come in. / If you buy it, I'll equip it for you.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_076.en:
I hear you did a mission with Delta?
Most mercs never even get to work
with the regulars, and you go and
team up with special forces...
You guys are something else.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_076.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I heard you did a mission / jointly with Delta? / Even operations with the regular army / are hard for ordinary mercenaries to get, / but special forces... you guys are amazing.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_077.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Yesterday too... to Oddeye's clan... / ...I lost...

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_078.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Bridge defense

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_079.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Elimination of tank unit

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_080.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Accept

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_081.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hear about another operation

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_082.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Accept

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_083.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hear about another operation

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_084.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Bridge defense

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_085.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Elimination of tank unit

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_086.en:
Two ops on offer.
Requests from HQ.
Defend a bridge under repair, or
eliminate a tank unit.
Decide which one you'll take.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_086.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Two operations proposed. / Requests from headquarters. / Defense of a bridge's repair work, / and elimination of a tank unit. / Decide which operation to take part in.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_087.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Let me hear the details.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_088.en:
Hm.
The bridge defense, then.
Repairs on the Riversgate Bridge,
down on the lower Mail River, are
way behind schedule.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_088.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hm. / Bridge defense. / The repair work on the Gate Bridge / downstream on the Mehr River / is greatly delayed.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_089.en:
The bridge that keeps getting hit by
enemy raids.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_089.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The bridge that has been raided by the enemy countless times.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_090.en:
That's the one. You'd be defending
it.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_090.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's a defense mission for that bridge.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_091.en:
Structurally, that bridge is
vulnerable to attack from the river.
We'd also need to watch the skies.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_091.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That bridge is structurally weak to attacks from the river. / Vigilance against attacks from the sky is also needed.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_092.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Exactly.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_093.en:
Mobility will be key, including on
the water.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_093.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mobility, including over water, will be emphasized.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_094.en:
A friendly transport unit carrying
repair materials is already on its
way there.
I want you to escort it.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_094.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: An allied transport unit loaded with repair materials / is already advancing to the site. / I want you to escort that transport unit.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_095.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I've grasped the operation content.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_096.en:
We'll take the bridge defense.
I'll get ready to sortie at once.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_096.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll accept the bridge defense mission. / I'll prepare to sortie right away.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_097.en:
Hm.
The tank unit, then.
An enemy tank unit is massing north
of Menasa.
I want you to hit it on the plains
outside town before it's in place.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_097.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hm. / Elimination of the tank unit. / An enemy tank unit is gathering / in northern Menasa. / I want you to hit it on the plains outside the city / before its deployment is in order.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_098.en:
I see. Good ground to make full use
of wanzer mobility.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_098.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see, a place where WAP mobility / can be put to full use.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_099.en:
It's an old-fashioned unit, mostly
armored vehicles.
But several tanks with anti-wanzer guns
have been spotted.
Don't get careless.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_099.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The enemy is an old-fashioned unit centered on / armored vehicles. / However, several tanks equipped with anti-WAP guns / have been confirmed. / Don't let your guard down.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_100.en: The mission is to wipe them out?
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_100.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is the mission a sweep of the enemy?

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_101.en:
That's right.
I'm sure you'll be fine, but if any
of them get away, they say your pay
gets docked.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_101.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / I think you'll be fine, but / should you let even one enemy escape, / the reward will be reduced, apparently.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_102.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sweep of all enemies... / I've grasped the operation content.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_103.en:
We'll take the tank unit.
I'll get ready to sortie at once.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_103.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll accept the tank unit elimination. / I'll prepare to sortie right away.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_104.en:
Can't decide?
Defend a bridge under repair, or
eliminate a tank unit.
Decide which one you'll take.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_104.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Can't decide? / Defense of the bridge repair work, / and elimination of a tank unit. / Decide which operation to take part in.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_105.en:
We'll take the bridge defense.
I'll get ready to sortie at once.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_105.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll accept the bridge defense mission. / I'll prepare to sortie right away.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_106.en:
We'll take the tank unit.
I'll get ready to sortie at once.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_106.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll accept the tank unit elimination. / I'll prepare to sortie right away.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_107.en:
A friendly transport unit carrying
repair materials is already on its
way there.
I want you to escort it.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_107.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: An allied transport unit loaded with repair materials / is already advancing to the site. / I want you to escort that transport unit.

MsgLabels_station_12_msg_108.en:
I'm sure you'll be fine, but if any
of them get away, they say your pay
gets docked.
Good luck.
MsgLabels_station_12_msg_108.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I think you'll be fine, but / should you let even one enemy escape, / the reward will be reduced, apparently. / I wish you luck.

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's awfully quiet.

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_002.en: The calm before the storm, huh.
MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The calm before the storm, as they say.

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_003.en:
Do we still get paid if no enemies
show up?
MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Do we still get the prize money even if the enemy doesn't come?

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_004.en:
I'm afraid you needn't worry about
that. Multiple rotors, dead ahead!
MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Unfortunately, it seems that worry is unnecessary. / Ahead, many rotor sounds!

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_005.en:
Stealth models...?
I could barely pick them up.
MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Stealth specs, huh... / I couldn't pick up a reaction easily.

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_006.en:
Contacts confirmed.
All units, prepare for combat.
MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Signatures confirmed. / All units, prepare for combat.

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_008.en:
I doubt it's just attack choppers.
There'll be wanzers hiding out there
too. All units, stay alert.
MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's hard to believe it's just a combat helicopter unit. / A WAP unit should be lurking too. / All units, stay fully on guard.

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_009.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, enemy reinforcements!

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: From where?

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_013.en:
The river!
At this speed... they've got hover
gear!
MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The river. / This movement speed... they're hover-equipped!

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...So the helicopter unit was a decoy.

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_015.en:
They're after the transports.
All units, don't let them get a
single one.
MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The enemy's aim is the transport unit. / All units, don't let them get even one.

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy unit completely silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That unit just now had good coordination.

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_018.en:
Probably a veteran merc outfit
themselves.
MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: They're probably a veteran / mercenary unit too.

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_019.en:
Looks like that's all they've got.
Our mission is complete.
Returning to base.
MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems that's the extent of the enemy forces. / Our mission is complete. / Returning to base.

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy unit completely silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah... the transport vehicles...

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We got hit by the enemy's surprise attack.

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_024.en: HQ is ordering us to return.
MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A return order came in from headquarters.

MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_025.en:
Still, that seems to be all they
had. Mission over. Returning to base.
MsgLabels_tactics_12_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But it seems that's the extent of the enemy forces too. / Mission over. Returning to base.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_001.en:
Captain.
May I ask you something about
choosing missions?
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain. / May I ask you / about mission selection?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_003.en:
The mission we choose goes ahead as
planned, but what happens to the
ones we don't pick?
My old squad never had a choice...
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The mission we select / proceeds as an operation, but / what happens to the missions / we didn't choose at that time? / It's something that didn't happen in the previous squad...

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_004.en:
Anything urgent should get picked up
by merc units from other bases.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: For operations that are urgent, / mercenary units from other bases should take on the mission.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_005.en:
I see.
I thought a merc unit just followed
orders, but sometimes we get to
choose our ops.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / I thought mercenary units / just follow orders, but / sometimes we can choose the operation.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_006.en:
We're paid to put our lives on the
line.
Nobody wants an op that throws their
life away for nothing.
But if we pull off hard missions and
the squad's rating goes up, we'll get
tougher, better-paying ops.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We're getting paid by staking our lives, after all. / Nobody would want to take part in operations / that throw away lives for nothing. / However, if we make difficult missions succeed / and the unit's rating goes up, more advanced / operations with higher pay will come our way.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_007.en: Then it's time to work hard.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's time to work hard.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_008.en:
But unlike the regulars, we get no
benefits and no issued weapons.
If mercs don't invest in their own
gear, the mission itself is at risk.
Another thing unique to mercs.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But unlike the regular army, / there's no insurance or supply of weapons. / If mercenaries don't invest in equipment themselves, / even carrying out missions is in danger. / This too is unique to mercenaries.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_009.en:
An investment in our freedom, then.
Speaking of freedom, our squad
members are certainly free-spirited...
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: An investment to protect freedom. / Even so, our squad members / sure are free...

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_010.en:
They're skilled, but they've had no
proper military training.
Forcing them into military discipline
and keeping them on edge would only
hurt the mission. That's my view.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: They're skilled, but they haven't received / proper military training. / I think forcing tension on them / with military restraints would have / a bad effect on carrying out missions.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_011.en:
If that's how you want it, Captain,
I'll go along with it.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If you're fine with that, Captain, I'll follow too.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_012.en:
Still, aren't they a little too
free-spirited...?
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But aren't they a bit too free...

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh, the Captain's here too!

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_015.en:
Video footage.
What is this, a concert of some kind?
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Video data. / Is this a concert or something?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_016.en:
A concert...?
No, no, no...
This is the fight where I took the
triple crown, back in my prime.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A concert...? / No no... / This is the match from my active days / when I took the triple crown.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ at this time was amazing.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_018.en:
Oho.
You know this fight, Gray?
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ho ho. / Gray, you know this match too?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_019.en:
When I'd just joined the army, I went
to the Arena to watch a few times.
His opponent was... Iron Arm Ox!
He was really popular too.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: When I'd just joined the army, I went to the arena / to watch a few times. / The opponent was, I think, Iron-Arm Ox! / He was popular too.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_020.en:
Yeah, me and him go way back.
My biggest rival.
Man, Ox's knee-and-elbow combo hurt
like hell every single time...
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah, me and that guy had a bond we couldn't shake. / He was my number one rival. / But Ox's knee and elbow / combination, whenever I took it, / was intense...

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_021.en:
Two summers ago.
The special waterfront arena back
home, wasn't it?
Champ was a true hero that night.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Summer 2 years ago. / The match held at the bayside / special arena in the home country. / Champ at this time was truly a hero.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_022.en:
Right, Rain?
Why, thank you.
It's fans like you that make the
Champ. Hahaha!
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Right? Rain. / Hey. / It's because of fans like you / that there's a Champ. / Hahaha!

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_023.en:
Ah, he's down!
Go! Hit him with an STF!
Aww, come on, attack him while he's
down! Now climb the turnbuckle and
do a moonsault press!!
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, he went down. / Go! STF there! / Ahh geez, it's a down attack! / In this opening, climb the post / and Moonsault Press!!

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_024.en:
Oddeye...
I keep telling you, it's not pro
wrestling...
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye... / I told you it's not pro wrestling...

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_025.en:
And what the hell's a moonsault!?
That's all illegal!
Huh?«g:24» Oddeye, you into pro
wrestling or something...?
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I mean, what the heck is a moonsault! / All of that is a foul! / Huh? Oddeye, / you liked pro wrestling...?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_026.en:
Nope?
I just picked it up from fighting
games.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No? / I just learned it from fighting games.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_027.en:
F-fighting games...!?
Don't lump my fights in with some
video game...
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: F-fighting games...!? / Don't lump my matches together with games...

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Cross armbar.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_030.en:
...Captain.
Are you getting a little fired up?
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Captain. / Could it be you're a little fired up?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_031.en:
No, I'm calm.
Watching sports is nice once in a
while.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, I'm calm. / Watching sports is nice once in a while.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_032.en:
Oh? Um, yes...
That's a side of you I didn't expect,
Captain.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? Yes... / I saw an unexpected side of the Captain.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Right...

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_034.en:
Watching that brought back my
glory days.
Alright, training, training!
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Watching the video made me remember / my active days. / Alright, training, training!

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_035.en:
Moving out?
Alright, let's go wild today too!
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie. / Alright, I'm gonna run wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_036.en:
Oh, Captain!
Can I take a look at the PC in your
room later?
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Captain! / Can I look at the PC / in your room later?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_037.en:
I don't mind, but where's this
coming from?
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I don't mind, but what's this all of a sudden?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_038.en:
Um, Rain's PC broke, apparently, and
it's the same model as yours, so I'm
investigating the cause.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Umm, Miss Rain's PC / apparently broke, and it seems to have the same specs / as your PC, Captain, so it's to investigate the cause.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_039.en:
Hm.
Wouldn't you normally call in a
professional for that?
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hm. / Don't you arrange a specialist contractor for that kind of thing?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_040.en:
That company's no good!
When they come out for maintenance,
they just follow the manual.
And their parts quotes are vague,
too.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That company is no good! / Even when they come for maintenance, they only do / by-the-manual work. / Their parts estimates are vague too.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_041.en:
Is that so.
You know your stuff, Oddeye.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is that so. / You know a lot, Oddeye.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_042.en:
Oh, but the wanzer hangar staff here are
great. They keep everything in shape,
right down to the newest parts.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, but the WAP hangar staff here / are excellent. / Their care extends even to the latest parts.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_043.en:
Everything's going digital.
But automate all you like, in the end
it comes down to the experience of
the person at the controls.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Digitization is advancing everywhere. / Even if you automate, where it ends up is / the experience of the humans controlling it.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_044.en:
Exactly.
I don't think going fully unmanned
could ever work.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Right. / I think complete unmanning and such is impossible.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_045.en:
I'll stop by your room later,
Captain!
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, I'll drop by your room later.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_046.en:
Oh, a sortie!
I'll get ready!
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, a sortie, right. / I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_047.en: Captain, have you got a minute?
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, do you have a moment?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I don't mind.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_049.en:
Captain, you're ex-special forces,
aren't you?
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, you're from special forces, right?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Why?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_051.en:
You've still got a unit insignia on
your right arm.
A dagger and bat wings. That's a
typical special forces design.
I'm ex-special forces too, but I've
never seen that emblem before...
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There's a unit insignia remaining / on your right arm, Captain. / A sword and ornamentation. This is a design / unique to special forces. / I'm from special forces too, but / I've never seen that emblem, so...

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...A past that won't disappear.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_053.en:
It must have been a highly classified
unit.
So classified that even special
forces people like us never heard of
it... Oh, I'm sorry.
I won't pry any further.
That'd be against the rules.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It must have been a unit with / very high secrecy. / So much that we special forces members couldn't recognize it... / Ah, sorry. / I won't pry any further. / It's against the rules, after all.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_054.en:
No, it's fine.
If you've been in special forces, you
can tell from a person's air, and
there's a certain kinship.
No wonder you don't know the insignia.
The unit wasn't active long, and it
no longer exists.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, I don't mind. / If you have special forces experience, you can tell / from a person's air, and a sense of fellowship / is born. / It's no wonder you don't know this insignia. / Its activity was relatively short, / and it's a unit that's already gone.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_055.en:
No longer exists?
...But with skills like yours,
Captain, why a merc unit?
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gone? / ...But with skill at your level, Captain, / why a mercenary unit?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_056.en:
I didn't want to go back to the army.
But I realized the only skill I had
was surviving on a battlefield.
So... to live, I stay next to death.
Why did you join a merc unit, Gray?
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I didn't want to go back to the army, but / I realized I had only acquired the skills / to live on the battlefield. / So... / to live, I sit next to death. / Gray, why did you join a mercenary unit?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_057.en: ...I have my reasons. I need money.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...For certain reasons, I need money.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_058.en:
I see. Same special forces
background, different reasons for
signing up.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. Even among those who came up from special forces, / motives for volunteering vary.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_059.en:
...I guess so.
Still, merc missions are a lot rougher
than the regulars'.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Right. / But mercenary missions are / harsh compared to the regular army.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_060.en:
Still, merc missions are a lot rougher
than the regulars'.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But mercenary missions are / harsh compared to the regular army.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_062.en:
(Freedom, and responsibility for
yourself.
Every merc has his own story...)
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Freedom and self-responsibility. / Mercenaries' various circumstances...)

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_063.en:
(Freedom, and responsibility for
yourself.
Every merc has his own story...)
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Freedom and self-responsibility. / Mercenaries' various circumstances...)

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Alright. Sortie.)

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_065.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
Heard this from Shresh on the crew.
Rumor is there's some wanzer nobody's
ever seen prowling around near the
border.
If you spot it, snap me a photo, ya?
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yo, «E801:00». / I heard from Thresh / on the maintenance team, / there's a rumor a wanzer nobody's seen / is wandering around near the border. / If you see it, take a picture for me.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_066.en:
Did Pete tell you about that wanzer?
People online are saying maybe some
manufacturer's running secret field
tests.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Did you hear from Peter / about the wanzer? / It's even written on the net that maybe / some manufacturer is doing / top-secret operation tests.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_067.en:
We've had a request for support from
friendly forces on the front line, in
the western canyons of the Parunta
Desert.
A good chance to have them owe us
one.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_067.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A support request arrived from allies in / the Parunta Desert West Valley area, the front line. / It's a good chance to make them owe us.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_068.en:
The western canyons of the Parunta
Desert. Better known as the
"Valley of Scrap Iron."
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_068.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The Parunta Desert West Valley area, / commonly called the "Valley of Scrap Iron."

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_069.en:
You know your stuff.
The Valley of Scrap Iron has been in
a stalemate for weeks now.
It's a buffer zone between the two
sides, so the fighting never stops.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_069.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You know it well. / In that Valley of Scrap Iron, several weeks / have passed since it fell into a stalemate. / Because it's a buffer zone between both camps, / it's a region where fighting never ends.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_070.en:
...I'd hoped never to go near the
place.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_070.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...If possible I'd rather not / have gone near it.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_071.en:
After our last op, the enemy seems
to be short on supplies.
Now's the chance to hit them, is the
idea.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_071.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems that due to the earlier operation the enemy is / hard-pressed for supply materiel. / If we're going to hit them, now is the chance, I suppose.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_072.en:
But a squad our size won't be much of
a reinforcement, I'd think.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_072.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But at the scale of our unit, / I don't think we'd be much of a reinforcement?

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_073.en:
No. With «E801:00» Squad's record,
an op in the Valley of Scrap Iron
should be easy enough.
And we're ready to send a supply
vehicle along for support.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_073.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, with «E801:00» Squad's record, / carrying out an operation in the Valley of Scrap Iron / should be easy. / Also, we're prepared to send / supply vehicles for support along with you.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_074.en:
A supply vehicle...
In the Valley of Scrap Iron, attrition
is the biggest enemy.
Good planning.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_074.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Supply vehicle support, huh... / In the Valley of Scrap Iron, attrition is / the greatest enemy. / Good arrangements.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_075.en:
I'm counting on you.
Now, the details.
Take out the enemy vehicle unit as
fast as you can.
Dawdle and their reinforcements
show up. Attrition is what'll kill
you out there.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_075.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I have expectations of you. / I'm counting on you. / Let me explain the details. / Destroy the enemy vehicle unit as quickly as possible. / If you dawdle, a reinforcement unit will appear. / Truly, attrition is what will be fatal.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_076.en:
Roger.
We'll get ready to sortie.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_076.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Let's prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_13_msg_077.en:
Take out the enemy vehicle unit as
fast as you can.
Dawdle and their reinforcements
show up. Attrition is what'll kill
you out there.
MsgLabels_station_13_msg_077.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Destroy the enemy vehicle unit as quickly as possible. / If you dawdle, a reinforcement unit will appear. / Truly, attrition is what will be fatal.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_001.en:
Arrived in the western canyons of the
Parunta Desert.
MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We've arrived at the Parunta Desert / West Valley area.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_002.en:
I'd heard about it, but there really
are mountains of wrecked weapons.
Looks like there'd be loads of
usable parts, but...
MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'd heard about it, but / there are mountains of weapon wreckage. / It seems there'd be lots / of usable parts...

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_003.en:
That's why they call it the Valley
of Scrap Iron.
Stand still and you might catch a
stray round.
All units, commence the op at once.
MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is why it's called the Valley of Scrap Iron. / If you stand still, you might / take a stray bullet. / All units, promptly begin the operation.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_005.en:
Captain!
Rotor noise detected.
Attack choppers.
MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain! / Rotor sound detected. / Combat helicopters.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_006.en:
They reacted fast.
What's the call, Captain?
MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The enemy's quick to react. / Captain, what do we do?

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_007.en:
Choppers first.
All units, don't forget to work
together.
MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Shoot down the helicopters first. / All units, don't forget to coordinate.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger, I'll watch the formation.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_009.en:
If you're running low, pull up next
to the supply vehicle.
We'll resupply ammo and do repairs.
MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: When you're worn down, come next to the supply vehicle. / We'll resupply ammo and do repairs.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger, I'm counting on you!

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Combat begins.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_012.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy WAPs confirmed.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Here they come.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There are a lot of enemies.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_017.en:
All units, protect the supply
vehicle. If we lose our supplies,
we'll end up scrap iron too.
MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units, protect the supply vehicles. / If our supply is cut off, we'll become scrap iron too.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_018.en:
More enemy wanzer signatures...
Four of them.
MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: More enemy WAP signatures... / 4 units.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Geez, one after another...

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_020.en:
So this is the Valley of Scrap
Iron...
MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So this is the Valley of Scrap Iron...

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy unit completely silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_022.en:
Doesn't look like any more of 'em
are coming.
MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As expected, there don't seem to be any more enemy reinforcements.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_023.en: We managed to clear them out.
MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We somehow cleaned it up.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_024.en:
Gray, guess that special forces
thing ain't just for show.
MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gray, seems special forces / isn't just for show.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_025.en: This much I can handle... barely.
MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: At this level, somehow...

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_026.en:
Captain.
HQ is ordering us to return.
MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain. / A return order came in from headquarters.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good, mission complete.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_028.en: No enemy signatures in the area.
MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No enemy signatures in the vicinity.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_029.en:
Haven't seen a fight like that in a
while. All units, report status.
MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's been a while since a battle this big. / All units, any problems?

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_030.en:
My armor's full of holes, but I'm
okay.
MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The armor is full of holes, but I'm okay.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Somehow alive.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_032.en:
Gray, guess that special forces
thing ain't just for show.
MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gray, seems special forces / isn't just for show.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_033.en:
Good work, everyone.
HQ just sent the order to return.
MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good work, everyone. / Just now a return order came in from headquarters.

MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_034.en:
Looks like luck hasn't abandoned us
yet. Good. Mission complete.
MsgLabels_tactics_13_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems luck hasn't abandoned us yet. / Good, mission complete.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Machine gun faction

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Shotgun faction

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Nothing in particular

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain. / Is something the matter?

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_005.en:
Rain, what do you make of our
squad's wanzer lineup?
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain, / what do you think of our squad's WAP composition?

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_006.en:
Two Assaults, yours and mine.
One Striker, Champ's.
One Launcher, Oddeye's.
And with Gray joining as our gunner,
the squad has no blind spots now.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Two Assaults, yours and mine, Captain, / one Striker, Champ's, / one Launcher, Oddeye's. / Plus with Gray the Gunner joining, / the unit has no blind spots anymore.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_007.en:
Hold on a sec!
Add more Strikers!
No way one of me is enough!
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wait a sec! / Add more Strikers too! / However you think about it, me alone isn't enough!

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_008.en:
I'll grant you Strikers hit hard.
But I think the current lineup is
the best one.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I acknowledge the Striker's fighting power. / But I think the current composition is the best.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_009.en:
Get a whole pile of Strikers and
pound 'em as a gang! Nothing'd be
stronger than that!
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If we gather lots of Strikers / and beat 'em up as a group, that's the strongest!

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Is Champ's brain muscle too...?

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_011.en:
...A lineup that lopsided, a pack
of Strikers, can't adapt when the
situation changes.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...A group of Strikers, / such a lopsided composition can't respond / flexibly to circumstances.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_012.en:
Rain, if you go head-to-head with a
muscle-head, you'll just wear
yourself out, you know?
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Miss Rain, if you clash head-on with a muscle-brain man / too much, you'll get tired, ya know?

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Muscle-brain man...!

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_014.en:
Rain's right. One Striker is plenty.
What I'm counting on more is Gray's
long-range fire.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As Rain says, / one Striker is enough. / Rather than that, I'd like to put my hopes / in Gray's long-range attacks.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wha! Even the Captain!!

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'd like to put my hopes in Gray.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_018.en:
Oh, Captain.
Some new wanzer parts came in, did you
know?
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Captain. / New WAP parts came in stock, ya know?

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_019.en:
I see.
I'll check the hangar later.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / I'll check the hangar later.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_020.en:
Oh, by the way, Captain,
are you a shotgun person?
