Or a machine gun person?
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Speaking of which, Captain, / are you the shotgun faction? / Or the machine gun faction?

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_021.en:
Weapons have factions now...
Well, if I had to pick...
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There are factions among weapons... / Let's see, if anything...

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_022.en:
Ooh, I knew it, machine guns!
I love machine guns too.
The way the shell casings fly out in
rhythm... so cool!
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ooh, as expected, it's machine guns, right! / I like machine guns too. / The way the shell casings fly rhythmically and stuff / is cool!

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_023.en:
Cool or not, in real combat they're
reliable.
Once you're used to them, you can
even snipe with short bursts.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Coolness aside, / in real combat they're reliable after all. / Once you're used to it, sniping with short trigger bursts is possible.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_024.en:
Machine guns are the best, aren't
they?
Even if your aim's bad, spray enough
and you'll hit something!
Oh, a new machine gun came in too.
I'm gonna buy one!
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: They're great, aren't they, machine guns. / Even if you're bad at shooting, if you fire away like crazy / you can hit! / Ah, come to think of it, new machine guns / came in too, I'll buy one too!

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_025.en:
Machine guns are the best, aren't
they?
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: They're great, aren't they, machine guns.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_026.en:
Ooh, shotguns...
Old school. Classy.
Hmm.
They're really satisfying, though.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Heh, shotguns... / How seasoned of you. / Hmm. / They sure are exhilarating.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_027.en:
Buckshot cuts down your aiming time
when you run into an enemy head-on.
And up close, stopping power matters
more than anything.
It's ideal for shredding wanzer parts.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Scattered shot, when you run into an enemy head-on, / can shorten sighting time, / and at close range, stopping power / is considered more important. / It's particularly ideal for shaving down WAP parts.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_028.en:
Ooh, so that's how you use them.
Oh, a shotgun came in, too.
I'll try buying one!
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Heh, so you use them like that. / Ah, come to think of it, shotguns / came in too. / I'll try buying one too!

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_029.en:
Shotguns, huh.
I'll try buying one!
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Shotguns, huh. / I'll try buying one too!

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Nothing in particular, really.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ehh... you don't have one?

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_032.en:
Rather, I try to be able to handle
whatever tool I'm given, in any
situation.
It's best to train until you're
used to every kind of firearm.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rather, I keep in mind / to adapt to whatever tool I use / in any situation. / It'd be better to train / to get used to handling all firearms.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Tool! / You call weapons tools!?

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah. / They're tools.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_035.en:
Tools, huh...
Haven't messed with any of mine
lately...
Oh, right, my PC's been acting up.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Tools, huh. / ...Haven't touched any lately. / Ah, my PC was acting up.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What are you talking about...?

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_037.en:
Oh, no.
Nothing.
Oh, more importantly! A "flame...
thrower"? A flamethrower?
Something pretty scary came in.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, no. / It's nothing. / Ah, more than that, flaymm-throwerr? / Flamethrower? / Some dangerous-sounding weapon came in stock.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_038.en:
A flamethrower, huh.
Maybe I'll buy one...
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Flamethrower, huh. / Maybe I'll try buying one...

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_039.en:
Oh, Captain.
Did you buy any of the
new wanzer parts?
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Captain. / Did you buy the new WAP parts?

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_040.en:
Oh, a sortie?
I'll get ready!
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, a sortie, right. / I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_041.en:
You oughta do some strength training
once in a while too, Captain.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Once in a while you'd better do / strength training too, Captain.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_042.en: True, I haven't trained much lately.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Indeed, I haven't trained lately.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_043.en:
Perfect timing, then.
Why not join me for once?
Let your body go soft and nothing
good comes of it.
Even retired, if I skip a workout,
I'm sluggish all the next morning.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's perfect. / How about together once in a while? / When your body gets dull, nothing good comes of it. / Even me, though I retired from active play, / if I skip training / I'm sluggish, sluggish the next morning.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_044.en:
Champ, looks like you used to
play some kind of sport.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ, / it seems you did some sport.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_045.en:
Huh? C-Captain...
You seriously don't know who I am...
Not even what my codename "Champ"
means?
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? C-Captain... / You seriously don't know me... / Not even the meaning of my / codename, Champ?

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_046.en:
I had a vague idea you were a
champion of something.
Sorry. I'm not up on worldly
matters...
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I vaguely thought you were probably / some kind of champion. / Sorry, I'm ignorant of worldly things...

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_047.en:
Oh, nah, don't worry about it!
Hahaha!
A merc's past doesn't matter anyway!
...Welp, I'm goin' for a run!!
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, no, don't worry about it! / Hahaha! / A mercenary's past doesn't matter! / ...Well then, I'm off to do roadwork!!

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_048.en:
Captain. Did you say something to
Champ? He looked kinda gloomy.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, did you say something to Champ? / He seemed kind of gloomy.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_049.en:
No, nothing in particular...
Oddeye, do you know what Champ was a
champion of?
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, not really... / Oddeye, do you know / what Champ is the champion of?

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_050.en:
Oh, that.
I didn't know either, but I looked
him up online, and it seems he was
famous in pro wrestling or
something?
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, that story. / I didn't know either, but / when I looked it up online, seems he was / a celebrity in pro wrestling or something?

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_051.en:
Oh, are we talking about Champ?
Oddeye... that's not pro wrestling.
Champ won the stand-up MMA title
three years running. He was a very
popular fighter.
Even I knew who he was.
When the base saw his profile,
everyone went wild.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh my, talking about Champ? / Oddeye... / That's not pro wrestling... / Champ was a 3-years-running champion of / stand-up mixed martial arts, a fighter who was / quite popular. / Even I knew him. / On the base everyone was making a fuss / when they saw his profile.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_052.en:
I see...
For the past few years, I haven't
been in the habit of watching TV,
reading magazines, or going online.
If he's that famous, I may have hurt
his pride.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see... / For the past few years I haven't been in the habit / of watching TV or magazines, let alone the net. / If he's such a famous person, / I may have wounded his pride.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_053.en:
Don't worry about it.
He'll forget all about it in three
days anyway.
Oh, and guess what? I'm a champ too!
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You don't need to worry about it, / he'll forget after 3 days anyway. / Ah, speaking of which, I'm a champ too, ya know?

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh? / That's news to me.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_055.en:
I may not look it, but I'm a
world-ranked player in a super
famous FPS!
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Despite how I look, / I'm a world ranker in a super-famous FPS!

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_056.en:
Seems this squad has a lot of
celebrities.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Seems to be a unit with many celebrities.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_057.en:
...No, Captain.
I'd never heard of this one.
I expect it's about an online game.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...No, Captain. / I didn't know either. / That's probably about an online game.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_058.en:
Whaaat? I'm at the TOP out of
three million players...?
You don't know!?
In the gaming world, three million
people know who I am!
Oh... so this is it...
Maybe I get how Champ feels now...
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ehh? I'm TOP among 3 million people, ya know...? / You don't know! / In the gaming world 3 million people / know me, ya know? / Ah, so this is it... / Maybe I understand how Champ feels a little...

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_059.en:
...In short, every field has its own
idea of what matters.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...In short, / values vary by field... is that it.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_060.en: That seems to be the gist of it.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems that's what it is.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Well then, / I'm off to do roadwork!!

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_062.en:
You oughta do some strength training
once in a while too, Captain.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Once in a while you'd better do / strength training too, Captain.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_063.en:
Moving out?
Alright, today we go all out wild!
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie. / Alright, today I'm going all-out wild!

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_064.en:
So this is the merc barracks.
This is where everyone's been.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The mercenaries' guardroom. / So everyone was here.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_065.en:
Yes.
Between missions, everyone comes here
to unwind.
Feel free to use it too, Gray.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah. / Between missions, everyone / takes a breather here. / You should use it too, Gray.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_066.en:
I will, thanks.
By the way, Champ... he's that
fighting legend, right?
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll do that. / Come to think of it, Champ is... / that martial arts hero, right?

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_067.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gray, you know Champ.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_068.en:
Of course.
Wow, meeting him in a place like
this...
There sure are all kinds of mercs,
huh.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_068.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Of course. / Amazing, to meet him in a place like this... / Even so, there sure are all kinds of mercenaries.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_069.en:
It may be a military facility, but
most of them have no military
training.
They're allowed a freedom you'd never
see in the regular army, but they've
survived real combat. They're good.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_069.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even though it's a military facility, / almost all of them haven't received military training. / They're allowed freedom of speech and conduct / unthinkable for military personnel, but / the skill of those who survive real combat is solid.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_070.en:
That's what's amazing about mercs.
They calmly pull off missions the
army can't... That's not ordinary.
I'd better fit in soon, too.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_070.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's what's amazing about mercenaries. / The ability to calmly carry out missions the army can't... / it's not ordinary. / I need to fit in quickly too.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_071.en:
You're one of them now, Gray.
Better get used to the atmosphere
quickly.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_071.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You're one of them too, Gray. / You'd better get used to this atmosphere quickly.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_072.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Right. / Roger.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_073.en: I'd better fit in soon, too.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_073.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I need to fit in quickly too.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_074.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_075.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
You guys really went to town on that
last mission.
Well, however much you wreck, the
whole crew'll fix it up, so relax.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_075.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yo, «E801:00». / You really went wild / last mission. / Well, no matter how much you break, the whole maintenance team / will fix it, so rest easy.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_076.en:
I hear you did a mission with Delta?
Most mercs never even get to work
with the regulars, and you go and
team up with special forces...
You guys are something else.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_076.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I heard you did a mission / jointly with Delta? / Even operations with the regular army / are hard for ordinary mercenaries to get, / but special forces... you guys are amazing.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_077.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Yesterday too... to Oddeye's clan... / ...I lost...

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_078.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Bridge defense

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_079.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Elimination of tank unit

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_080.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Accept bridge defense

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_081.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hear about another operation

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_082.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Accept elimination of tank unit

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_083.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hear about another operation

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_084.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Bridge defense

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_085.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Elimination of tank unit

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_086.en:
Two ops on offer.
Requests from HQ.
Defend a bridge under repair, or
eliminate a tank unit.
Decide which one you'll take.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_086.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Two operations proposed. / Requests from headquarters. / Defense of a bridge's repair work, / and elimination of a tank unit. / Decide which operation to take part in.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_087.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Let me hear the details.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_088.en:
Hm.
The bridge defense, then.
Repairs on the Riversgate Bridge are
way behind schedule. It's a key
strategic link between New Millgan
Port and friendly territory.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_088.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hm. / Bridge defense. / The repair work on the Rivers Gate Bridge, / an important strategic point linking New Milgan Port / and the allied area, / is greatly delayed.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_089.en:
The bridge that keeps getting hit by
enemy raids.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_089.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The bridge that has been raided by the enemy countless times.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_090.en:
That's the one. You'd be defending
it.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_090.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's a defense mission for that bridge.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_091.en:
Structurally, that bridge is
vulnerable to attack from the river.
We'd also need to watch the skies.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_091.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That bridge is structurally weak to attacks from the river. / Vigilance against attacks from the sky is also needed.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_092.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Exactly.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_093.en:
Mobility will be key, including on
the water.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_093.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mobility, including over water, will be emphasized.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_094.en:
A friendly transport unit carrying
repair materials is already on its
way there.
I want you to escort it.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_094.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: An allied transport unit loaded with repair materials / is already advancing to the site. / I want you to escort that transport unit.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_095.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I've grasped the operation content.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_096.en:
We'll take the bridge defense.
I'll get ready to sortie at once.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_096.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll accept the end(bridge) defense mission. / I'll prepare to sortie right away.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_097.en:
Hm.
The tank unit, then.
Enemy tanks are massing in the
East Peseta area.
I want you to hit them on the plains
outside town before they're in place.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_097.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hm. / Elimination of the tank unit. / An enemy tank unit is gathering / in the East Peseta area. / I want you to hit it on the plains outside the city / before its deployment is in order.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_098.en:
I see. Good ground to make full use
of wanzer mobility.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_098.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see, a place where WAP mobility / can be put to full use.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_099.en:
It's an old-fashioned unit, mostly
armored vehicles.
But several tanks with anti-wanzer guns
have been spotted.
Don't get careless.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_099.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The enemy is an old-fashioned unit centered on / armored vehicles. / However, several tanks equipped with anti-WAP guns / have been confirmed. / Don't let your guard down.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_100.en: The mission is to wipe them out?
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_100.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is the mission a sweep of the enemy?

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_101.en:
That's right.
But they've got reserves waiting
behind the target. If you want to get
out clean, you'll need to finish
the job in about 12 turns.
At the very least, take out the
command vehicle and those nasty tanks.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_101.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / However, behind the target / reserve forces are waiting. If we also consider our withdrawal, / we'll have to finish the job in about / 12 turns. / At least, I want you to destroy the command vehicle / and the troublesome tanks.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_102.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I've grasped the operation content.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_103.en:
We'll take the tank unit.
I'll get ready to sortie at once.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_103.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll accept the tank unit elimination. / I'll prepare to sortie right away.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_104.en:
Can't decide?
Defend a bridge under repair, or
eliminate a tank unit.
Decide which one you'll take.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_104.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Can't decide? / Defense of the bridge repair work, / and elimination of a tank unit. / Decide which operation to take part in.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_105.en:
We'll take the bridge defense.
I'll get ready to sortie at once.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_105.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll accept the end(bridge) defense mission. / I'll prepare to sortie right away.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_106.en:
We'll take the tank unit.
I'll get ready to sortie at once.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_106.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll accept the tank unit elimination. / I'll prepare to sortie right away.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_107.en:
A friendly transport unit carrying
repair materials is already on its
way there.
I want you to escort it.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_107.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: An allied transport unit loaded with repair materials / is already advancing to the site. / I want you to escort that transport unit.

MsgLabels_station_14_msg_108.en:
They've got reserves waiting behind
the target. If you want to get out
clean, you'll need to finish the job
in about 12 turns.
At the very least, take out the
command vehicle and those nasty tanks.
MsgLabels_station_14_msg_108.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Behind the target reserve forces are waiting. / If we also consider our withdrawal, / we'll have to finish the job in about / 12 turns. / At least, I want you to destroy the command vehicle / and the troublesome tanks.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_001.en:
A tank fight, huh?
Easy money.
MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A tank battle. / I'll earn easily.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_002.en:
Just watch out for the anti-wanzer
guns, and they're sitting ducks.
MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As long as we watch out for the anti-WAP guns, / they're easy prey.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_003.en:
Yeah, wanzers have the edge on a job
like this.
MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Certainly an advantageous mission for WAPs.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Everyone, don't let your guard down.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_005.en:
Never let your guard down, even
against an easy enemy.
There should be a command vehicle.
Find it and hit it first.
MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even against easy enemies, you don't relax. / There should be a command vehicle. / Find it and attack it with priority.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units, operation start.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_008.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_010.en:
The command vehicle's down!
Dammit!
Which way do we run!?
MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The command vehicle's been taken out! / Damn! / Which way should we run!?

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_011.en:
They lost their command vehicle,
and now their chain of command's
a mess.
Captain, so that's what you meant!
MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Having lost the command vehicle, / their chain of command is in confusion. / Captain, so this is what you meant!

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_012.en:
Right.
We hit them while they're confused.
MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / We hit them in this opening.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy unit completely silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_015.en:
Well, decent haul.
Gray, let's head back and have
ourselves a toast!
MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well, we earned a fair amount. / Gray, let's go back and have a toast!

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_016.en:
Drinking again...
Yeah, yeah, I'll keep you company...
MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Drinking again... / Yes, yes, I'll keep you company...

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_017.en:
Oh, Rain, I'll come by your room
when we get back.
MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, when we get back I'll go / to Miss Rain's room.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_018.en:
Oh, right, to fix my PC.
Thanks, Oddeye.
MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, the PC repair. / I'm counting on you, Oddeye.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_019.en:
Oh, the PC they issued me's been
acting up too.
Could you take a look later?
MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, the PC issued to me / was acting up too, / could I ask you later?

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_020.en:
Gray?
Hey, what about our drink?
Fine, tonight we drink in Rain's
room!
MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gray? / You, what about drinking? / Then today we'll drink in Rain's room!

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Don't come.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_022.en:
Mission complete.
Stay alert. Returning to base.
MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission complete. / Returning to base while staying alert to the surroundings.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_023.en:
That took longer than it
should've...
MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That took quite some trouble...

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_024.en:
Makeshift or not, you can't take
those anti-wanzer guns lightly.
MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even if they're makeshift, / anti-WAP guns can't be underestimated.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_025.en: I'm almost out of ammo, too.
MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Our ammo is nearly out too.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_026.en:
Those vehicles performed better
than we expected.
MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems the vehicles' performance / was higher than expected.

MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_027.en:
Don't judge an enemy by its looks.
All units, check your damage.
Mission complete.
Returning to base.
MsgLabels_tactics_14_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It means you mustn't judge the enemy / by appearance. / All units check damage status. / Mission complete. / Returning to base now.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_001.en:
Captain.
May I ask you something about
choosing missions?
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain. / May I ask you / about mission selection?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_003.en:
The mission we choose goes ahead as
planned, but what happens to the
ones we don't pick?
My old squad never had a choice...
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The mission we select / proceeds as an operation, but / what happens to the missions / we didn't choose at that time? / It's something that didn't happen in the previous squad...

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_004.en:
Anything urgent should get picked up
by merc units from other bases.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: For operations that are urgent, / mercenary units from other bases should take on the mission.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_005.en:
I see.
I thought a merc unit just followed
orders, but sometimes we get to
choose our ops.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / I thought mercenary units / just follow orders, but / sometimes we can choose the operation.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_006.en:
We're paid to put our lives on the
line.
Nobody wants an op that throws their
life away for nothing.
But if we pull off hard missions and
the squad's rating goes up, we'll get
tougher, better-paying ops.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We're getting paid by staking our lives, after all. / Nobody would want to take part in operations / that throw away lives for nothing. / However, if we make difficult missions succeed / and the unit's rating goes up, more advanced / operations with higher pay will come our way. /

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_007.en: Then it's time to work hard.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's time to work hard.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_008.en:
But unlike the regulars, we get no
benefits and no issued weapons.
If mercs don't invest in their own
gear, the mission itself is at risk.
Another thing unique to mercs.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But unlike the regular army, / there's no insurance or supply of weapons. / If mercenaries don't invest in equipment themselves, / even carrying out missions is in danger. / This too is unique to mercenaries.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_009.en:
An investment in our freedom, then.
Speaking of freedom, our squad
members are certainly free-spirited...
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: An investment to protect freedom. / Even so, our squad members / sure are free...

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_010.en:
They're skilled, but they've had no
proper military training.
Forcing them into military discipline
and keeping them on edge would only
hurt the mission. That's my view.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: They're skilled, but they haven't received / proper military training. / I think forcing tension on them / with military restraints would have / a bad effect on carrying out missions.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_011.en:
If that's how you want it, Captain,
I'll go along with it.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If you're fine with that, Captain, I'll follow too.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_012.en:
Still, aren't they a little too
free-spirited...?
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But aren't they a bit too free...

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh, the Captain's here too!

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_015.en:
Video footage.
What is this, a concert of some kind?
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Video data. / Is this a concert or something?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_016.en:
A concert...?
No, no, no...
This is the fight where I took the
triple crown, back in my prime.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A concert...? / No no... / This is the match from my active days / when I took the triple crown.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ at this time was amazing.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_018.en:
Oho.
You know this fight, Gray?
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ho ho. / Gray, you know this match too?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_019.en:
When I'd just joined the army, I went
to the Arena to watch a few times.
His opponent was... Iron Arm Ox!
He was really popular too.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: When I'd just joined the army, I went to the arena / to watch a few times. / The opponent was, I think, Iron-Arm Ox! / He was popular too.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_020.en:
Yeah, me and him go way back.
My biggest rival.
Man, Ox's knee-and-elbow combo hurt
like hell every single time...
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah, me and that guy had a bond we couldn't shake. / He was my number one rival. / But Ox's knee and elbow / combination, whenever I took it, / was intense...

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_021.en:
Two summers ago.
The special waterfront arena back
home, wasn't it?
Champ was a true hero that night.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Summer 2 years ago. / The match held at the bayside / special arena in the home country. / Champ at this time was truly a hero.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_022.en:
Right, Rain?
Why, thank you.
It's fans like you that make the
Champ. Hahaha!
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Right? Rain. / Hey. / It's because of fans like you / that there's a Champ. / Hahaha!

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_023.en:
Ah, he's down!
Go! Hit him with an STF!
Aww, come on, attack him while he's
down! Now climb the turnbuckle and
do a moonsault press!!
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, he went down. / Go! STF there! / Ahh geez, it's a down attack! / In this opening, climb the post / and Moonsault Press!!

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_024.en:
Oddeye...
I keep telling you, it's not pro
wrestling...
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye... / I told you it's not pro wrestling...

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_025.en:
And what the hell's a moonsault!?
That's all illegal!
Huh?«g:24» Oddeye, you into pro
wrestling or something...?
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I mean, what the heck is a moonsault! / All of that is a foul! / Huh? Oddeye, / you liked pro wrestling...?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_026.en:
Nope?
I just picked it up from fighting
games.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No? / I just learned it from fighting games.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_027.en:
F-fighting games...!?
Don't lump my fights in with some
video game...
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: F-fighting games...!? / Don't lump my matches together with games...

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Cross armbar.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_030.en:
...Captain.
Are you getting a little fired up?
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Captain. / Could it be you're a little fired up?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_031.en:
No, I'm calm.
Watching sports is nice once in a
while.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, I'm calm. / Watching sports is nice once in a while.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_032.en:
Oh? Um, yes...
That's a side of you I didn't expect,
Captain.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? Yes... / I saw an unexpected side of the Captain.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Right...

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_034.en:
Watching that brought back my
glory days.
Alright, training, training!
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Watching the video made me remember my active days. / Alright, training, training!

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_035.en:
We moving out?
Alright, let's go wild!
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie. / Alright, I'm gonna run wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_036.en:
Oh, Captain!
Can I take a look at the PC in your
room later?
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Captain! / Can I look at the PC in your room later?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_037.en:
I don't mind, but where's this
coming from?
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I don't mind, but what's this all of a sudden?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_038.en:
Um, Rain's PC broke, apparently, and
it's the same model as yours, so I'm
investigating the cause.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Umm, Miss Rain's PC / apparently broke, and it seems to have the same specs / as your PC, Captain, so it's to investigate the cause.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_039.en:
Hm.
Wouldn't you normally call in a
professional for that?
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hm. / Don't you arrange a specialist contractor for that kind of thing?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_040.en:
That company's no good!
When they come out for maintenance,
they just follow the manual.
And their parts quotes are vague,
too.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That company is no good! / Even when they come for maintenance, they only do / by-the-manual work. / Their parts estimates are vague too.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_041.en:
Is that so.
You know your stuff, Oddeye.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is that so. / You know a lot, Oddeye.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_042.en:
Oh, but the wanzer hangar staff here are
great. They keep everything in shape,
right down to the newest parts.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, but the WAP hangar staff here / are excellent. / Their care extends even to the latest parts.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_043.en:
Everything's going digital.
But automate all you like, in the end
it comes down to the experience of
the person at the controls.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Digitization is advancing everywhere. / Even if you automate, where it ends up is / the experience of the humans controlling it.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_044.en:
Exactly.
I don't think going fully unmanned
could ever work.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Right. / I think complete unmanning and such is impossible.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_045.en:
I'll stop by your room later,
Captain!
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, I'll drop by your room later.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_046.en:
Oh, a sortie?
I'll get ready!
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, a sortie, right. / I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_047.en: Captain, have you got a minute?
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, do you have a moment?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I don't mind.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_049.en:
Captain, you're ex-special forces,
aren't you?
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, you're from special forces, right?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Why?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_051.en:
You've still got a unit insignia on
your right arm.
A blade and ornamentation. That's a
typical special forces design.
I'm ex-special forces too, but I've
never seen that emblem before...
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There's a unit insignia remaining / on your right arm, Captain. / A sword and ornamentation. This is a design / unique to special forces. / I'm from special forces too, but / I've never seen that emblem, so...

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...A past that won't disappear.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_053.en:
It must have been a highly classified
unit.
So classified that even special
forces people like us never heard of
it... Oh, I'm sorry.
I won't pry any further.
That'd be against the rules.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It must have been a unit with / very high secrecy. / So much that we special forces members couldn't recognize it... / Ah, sorry. / I won't pry any further. / It's against the rules, after all.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_054.en:
No, it's fine.
If you've been in special forces, you
can tell from a person's air, and
there's a certain kinship.
No wonder you don't know the insignia.
The unit wasn't active long, and it
no longer exists.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, I don't mind. / If you have special forces experience, you can tell / from a person's air, and a sense of fellowship / is born. / It's no wonder you don't know this insignia. / Its activity was relatively short, / and it's a unit that's already gone.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_055.en:
No longer exists?
...But with skills like yours,
Captain, why a merc unit?
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gone? / ...But with skill at your level, Captain, / why a mercenary unit?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_056.en:
I didn't want to go back to the army.
But I realized the only skill I had
was surviving on a battlefield.
So... to live, I stay next to death.
Why did you join a merc unit, Gray?
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I didn't want to go back to the army, but / I realized I had only acquired the skills / to live on the battlefield. / So... / to live, I sit next to death. / Gray, why did you join a mercenary unit?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_057.en: ...I have my reasons. I need money.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...For certain reasons, I need money.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_058.en:
I see. Same special forces
background, different reasons for
signing up.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. Even among those who came up from special forces, / motives for volunteering vary.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_059.en:
...I guess so.
Still, merc missions are a lot rougher
than the regulars'.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Right. / But mercenary missions are harsh compared to the regular army.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_060.en:
Still, merc missions are a lot rougher
than the regulars'.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But mercenary missions are harsh compared to the regular army.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_062.en:
(Freedom, and responsibility for
yourself.
Every merc has his own story...)
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Freedom and self-responsibility. / Mercenaries' various circumstances...)

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_063.en:
(Freedom, and responsibility for
yourself.
Every merc has his own story...)
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Freedom and self-responsibility. / Mercenaries' various circumstances...)

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Alright. Sortie.)

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_065.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
Heard this from Shresh on the crew.
Rumor is there's some wanzer nobody's
ever seen prowling around near the
border.
If you spot it, snap me a photo, ya?
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yo, «E801:00». / I heard from Thresh / on the maintenance team, / there's a rumor a wanzer nobody's seen / is wandering around near the border. / If you see it, take a picture for me.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_066.en:
Did Pete tell you about that wanzer?
People online are saying maybe some
manufacturer's running secret field
tests.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Did you hear from Peter / about the wanzer? / It's even written on the net that maybe / some manufacturer is doing / top-secret operation tests.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_067.en:
We've got intel that enemy supplies
are being stored at a corporate
factory, disguised as something else.
Quite a lot of them, by the sound of
it. Go in quiet and destroy them.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_067.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We've obtained information that enemy supply materiel / is being stored disguised / at a corporation's factory. / It seems to be quite a quantity. / Destroy it while acting covertly.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_068.en:
A covert op.
Do we need to refit and pass as
unmarked machines?
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_068.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A covert operation. / Do we need a disguise refit as unknown-affiliation units?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_069.en:
Normally, yes.
But there's no need to get fancy on
this one. Speed's what they want.
The north side looks fairly lightly
defended.
Go in from there.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_069.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Normally, yes. / But in this operation there's no need / to make it elaborate. / Rather, swiftness of response is demanded. / The north side seems to have relatively thin defenses. / Infiltrate from there.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_070.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The guard forces?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_071.en:
On paper it's a civilian factory.
Armored vehicles at most, I'd say.
That said, it's safe to assume
enemy reinforcements will show up.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_071.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ostensibly it's a civilian factory. / Probably armored vehicles at most. / That said, it's reasonable to assume / there will be enemy reinforcements.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_072.en:
I see.
Is there a time limit?
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_072.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / Is there a time limit?

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_073.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: About 5 turns at most.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_074.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We should emphasize movement.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_075.en:
Your call.
In 5 turns, I want as many of those
containers destroyed as you can.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_075.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll leave the judgment to you. / I want you to destroy as many containers / as possible within 5 turns.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_076.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Starting operation preparations at once.

MsgLabels_station_15_msg_077.en:
Your call.
In 5 turns, I want as many of those
containers destroyed as you can.
MsgLabels_station_15_msg_077.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll leave the judgment to you. / I want you to destroy as many containers / as possible within 5 turns.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_001.en:
Sneaking around in the dead of
night...
Not exactly a classy op...
MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sneaking in a raid in the middle of the night. / Not a smart operation...

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_002.en: That's what covert ops are like.
MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Covert operations are like this.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_003.en:
I just wanna go in head-on and
smash 'em good...
MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I wanna attack head-on, with a bang...

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, another muscle-brain remark.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_005.en:
Champ?
This is a covert op.
Don't do anything flashy and drag
the squad down.
MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ? / This is a covert operation. / Don't do anything flashy and / drag the unit down.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_006.en:
I'm just kidding!
I've done plenty of ops as a merc by
now, y'know!
MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Just a light joke! / Even I've taken part in quite a few operations / as a mercenary by now!

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_007.en:
The scary part is it doesn't
sound like a joke, coming from
Champ...
Let's finish the job fast and get
back to base.
MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The way it doesn't sound like a joke / is so like Champ... / We'd better finish the mission quickly / and return to base.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_008.en:
Besides, if we take too long,
enemy reinforcements might arrive.
MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Besides, if we take time, / a reinforcement unit might arrive.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_009.en:
And the muscle-head might start
running wild.
MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The muscle-brain man looks about to run wild too.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wha! / Muscle-brain man!?

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's almost time.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_012.en:
All units, the containers take
priority over the guards.
Commencing mission.
MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units, prioritize destroying the containers / over destroying the guard unit. / Then the mission begins.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_014.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_016.en:
Unmarked machines breaking in!?
Call for backup!
Whose corporate lapdogs are these...
Now of all times...
MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Unknown-affiliation units infiltrating!? / Call reinforcements! / Which corporation's dogs are they... / At this important time...

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_017.en:
Backup's going to take a while to
get here, sir.
MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It will take time / until the reinforcement unit arrives.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_018.en:
No choice, then. Throw everything
the facility has at them and buy
us time!
MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No choice, buy time / with all the facility's forces!

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy reinforcement unit has appeared.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_020.en: Then we drop 'em all at once!
MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We'll just shoot them all down together!

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_021.en:
All units, watch your ammo.
Engage at will.
MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units, while watching remaining ammo, / intercept at will.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed all enemy units silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: They were kind of fragile.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_024.en:
It's a civilian factory. Guards
with little combat experience, and
that equipment...
MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's a civilian factory, and with guards with little / combat experience and that equipment...

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_025.en:
Mission complete.
Returning to base before their
reinforcements arrive.
MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission complete. / Returning to base before enemy reinforcements come.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_026.en:
All enemy units in the area are
silent.
MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All enemy units in the area silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_027.en:
Those guards put up more of a
fight than I figured.
MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Pretty tough for guards.

MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_028.en:
Mission complete.
It's dangerous to stay any longer.
Returning to base.
MsgLabels_tactics_15_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission complete. / Staying any longer is dangerous. / Returning to base.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_001.en:
Captain.
There you are.
Alchemist was looking for you.
Did he find you?
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain. / So you were here. / Alchemist was looking for you, Captain, / did you meet him?

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_002.en:
No.
I haven't seen him in a while.
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No? / I haven't seen him for a while.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_003.en:
He asked me about my old squad
just now.
That's not like him...
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Earlier, Alchemist asked me about / the previous squad. / That's unusual...

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_004.en:
I wonder what Alchemist wanted to
talk to you about...
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What did Alchemist want to talk to the Captain about...

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_005.en:
A mission?
I'll let Oddeye know.
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. / I'll tell Oddeye too.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_006.en:
Oh, Captain.
About Alchemist...
Do you think he's ex-special forces,
too? It's his air, or... I don't
know how to put it...
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Captain. / About Alchemist... / Do you think he came up from special forces too? / The air about him, or whatever...

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_007.en:
I sensed the same.
But I don't plan to pry.
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I felt so too, but / I don't intend to particularly pry.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_008.en:
Still, he seems to go out of his way
to avoid the other mercs.
And he's not exactly friendly...
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even so, he seems to be / avoiding other mercenaries. / And he's unfriendly...

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_009.en:
That's just who he is.
He gets his missions done.
No need to worry about it.
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I suppose that's his individuality. / He seems to be carrying out his missions. / There's no need to worry.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_010.en:
Still, Alchemist sure is a cold
fish...
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even so, Alchemist / sure is unfriendly...

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_011.en:
Mission understood.
I'll go get Champ.
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / I'll go call Champ.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_012.en:
Captain «E801:00».
I've been looking for you.
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00». / I was looking for you.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / What's your business?

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_014.en:
You brought up special forces once.
The truth is, I was special forces
myself. With the merc rules, I wasn't
sure how to answer, so I dodged it
rather clumsily.
My apologies.
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Before, you brought up special forces. / Actually, I was also a former special forces member. / Because of the mercenary rules, I didn't know how / to answer, and I evaded it awkwardly. / I apologize.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_015.en:
Rules are rules.
I didn't take it personally.
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's the rules. / I don't mind.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_016.en:
Since I'm already bending the rules,
may I ask... that insignia of yours,
Captain. What unit was it?
...Someone I knew may have served
in it, you see.
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: While I'm breaking the rules anyway, may I ask: / that unit insignia, Captain, which unit / did you belong to? / ...An acquaintance of mine might have / been in that unit.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_017.en:
Making conversation all of a sudden.
That's unusual.
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Communication all of a sudden, that's unusual.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_018.en:
...My personality tends to leave me
rather isolated.
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Because of this personality, / I somehow end up isolated.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_019.en:
That's just who you are.
Give it time and you'll fit in.
The unit I was in was...
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's individuality too. / Given time, you'll fit in soon enough. / The unit I was in was...,

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_020.en:
Captain, the Commander wants to
see you.
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, the Commander is calling for you.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry, Alchemist. / We'll talk later.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry, Alchemist.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_024.en:
Not at all.
It's quite all right.
I have another solo mission to
prepare for myself.
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No. / I don't mind. / I'm going to prepare for another / single mission too.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (That's unusual...)

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_026.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
Alchemist just asked me something
weird out of nowhere.
Wanted to know if I knew what unit
you used to be in.
I don't, so that's what I told him.
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yo, «E801:00». / Just now Alchemist / suddenly asked me something weird. / "Do you know the unit «E801:00» / used to belong to?" / I really don't know, so I said so.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_027.en:
That Alchemist guy saw the new parts
come in today and asked how often
new stuff gets shipped to the merc
base. Like, why would you even
want to know that?
And he's been asking around about
you a lot...
Something happen between you two?
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That Alchemist, / today he saw the new parts that came in / and asked how often new products / come to mercenary bases. / Like, what would you do knowing that. / Also, he's been asking around / about you an awful lot... / Did something happen with him?

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_028.en:
New wanzer parts for our side are
being unloaded at Dock 16, in our
territory.
But we've had word armed guerrillas
are after them.
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: At Dock 16 under our control, / allied new-model WAP parts are / being unloaded. / However, information came in that armed guerrillas / are targeting them.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_029.en:
So our job is guarding the
unloading?
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is our mission guarding the unloading work?

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_030.en:
That's right.
Escort the transports carrying the
parts until they're out of the area.
Losing all of them isn't an option.
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / Escort the transport vehicles loaded with the parts / until they escape outside the area. / Their annihilation is not permitted.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_031.en:
How big a guerrilla force are we
expecting?
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The expected scale of the armed guerrillas?

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_032.en:
Most likely built around wanzers with
long-range weapons.
Watch their range.
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Probably WAPs equipped with long-range weapons / are the core of the unit. / Watch out for the enemy's range.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_033.en:
We should also be ready for a
diversion.
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The possibility of a diversion can also be assumed.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_034.en:
Mm.
...And there've been sightings of
an unidentified large wanzer.
The intel's shaky, but I'd keep an
eye out.
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm. / ...Also, an unidentified large WAP / has been observed. / It's not accurate information, but it seems better / to stay alert.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_035.en:
Sounds like we'll need to be ready
for anything.
Understood.
Preparing to sortie.
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems we'll need to respond / to every situation. / I've grasped the operation content. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_16_msg_036.en:
Escort the transports until they're
out of the area.
Losing all of them isn't an option.
MsgLabels_station_16_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Escort the transport vehicles until they escape / outside the area. / Their annihilation is not permitted.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Cargo loading finished!

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_002.en:
Roger.
Get moving at once.
We'll keep escorting you.
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Start moving promptly. / We'll continue escorting.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Now we're safe...

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_004.en:
I'm afraid not.
Wanzers, likely the armed guerrillas,
confirmed. Coming from the west.
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Unfortunately it won't go that way. / Confirmed a WAP unit thought to be armed guerrillas, / from the west.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So they came after all.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_006.en:
More contacts closing in.
4... 5... 6... That's a lot of them.
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There are more signatures approaching. / 4... 5... 6... quite a number.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_007.en:
All units, prepare for combat.
Keep them away from the transports.
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units, prepare for combat. / Don't let enemy units near the transport unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_008.en:
I'll protect that cargo no matter
what!
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll protect the cargo no matter what!

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_009.en:
Transport unit.
We'll draw the enemy off.
Move out when you see an opening.
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Transport unit. / We'll draw the enemy in. / Seize an opening and set off.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_010.en:
Roger...
Still a long way to the extraction
point.
We're counting on you!
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger... / It looks like it'll take a while still to the escape point. / We're counting on you!

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_011.en:
Victory: Transports leave the area.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed or
all transports destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: transport vehicles escape the area. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down, or / transport vehicles annihilated.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy reinforcements confirmed!

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_014.en:
We'll never make the extraction
point like this!
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: At this rate we can't reach the escape point!

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_015.en:
Understood.
All units, take out the
reinforcements.
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / All units, eliminate the reinforcement unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_017.en:
Training target... armed guerrillas
confirmed.
...This wanzer unit appears to be
engaged with that merc squad.
Nevertheless... proceeding to gather
combat data as planned.
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Training target... / armed guerrillas confirmed. / ...This WAP unit seems to be engaged with / that mercenary unit. / However... as planned, / collecting real-combat data.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_018.en:
More reinforcements.
...Huh? I don't recognize that
silhouette.
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: More reinforcements. / ...Huh? Signatures I've never seen.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_019.en:
A large wanzer!?
Even an outfit like this has one?
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A large WAP!? / You're saying even a unit like this has them deployed?

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_020.en:
Large unit, ID code doesn't match.
...A different faction?
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The large unit's identification code doesn't match. / ...A different force?

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_021.en:
Don't worry about it, Rain.
Anything that acts hostile gets
taken out.
Our mission is to protect the
transports at all costs.
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Don't worry about it, Rain. / Anything taking hostile action / we eliminate. / The mission is to defend the transport unit to the death.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_023.en:
...Pulling back for now.
...Against that squad, this machine
alone isn't enough, it seems.
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Pulling back for now. / ...As expected, with that unit as the opponent, / this machine alone seems impossible.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Transport unit intact! / Operation successful.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_025.en:
Looks like we got ourselves a
top-notch escort.
Thanks for the cover.
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Seems we were escorted by an excellent unit. / Thanks for the escort.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_026.en:
Haha.
Nice day for a drive.
Just get that cargo home in one
piece.
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Haha. / Today's perfect weather for a drive. / The rest is to carry the cargo safely.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_027.en:
...Still, I wonder what that large
machine was.
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Even so, what was / that large unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_028.en:
Even the regulars only have a
handful of those...
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That machine, even in the regular army / only a few are deployed...

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_029.en:
If we're going to be up against
things like that, we'll need to
beef up too.
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If we're going to face things like that, / we need to strengthen / our forces too.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Did you record the combat log just now?

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Of course I recorded it!

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_032.en:
Give me the footage later.
I'll report it to the Commander.
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Give me the video data later. / I'll report to the Commander.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_033.en:
Roger!
I'll edit it so it's nice and easy
to watch!
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / I'll edit it properly / so it's easy to watch!

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed remaining transport unit has gotten away.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_035.en:
We barely made it out!
Escort, get out of there too!
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We somehow succeeded in getting away! / Escort unit, get away quickly too!

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_037.en:
...Sufficient combat data acquired.
Withdrawing from the area.
...That merc squad is good, though.
Next time, I take the target.
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...The real-combat data is sufficient. / Withdrawing from this area. / ...But that mercenary unit is good. / Next time, let's take the target.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_038.en:
Enemy remnants are withdrawing.
...Looks like they've given up.
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Remaining enemy units beginning withdrawal. / ...It seems they gave up.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_039.en:
Phew...
If we're going to fight things like
that, we really need stronger wanzers.
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Phew... / If we're going to face enemies like that, / we have to strengthen our WAPs more.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_040.en:
...Large machines are a real
problem, I'll give you that.
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Indeed large units are troublesome.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_041.en:
That firepower...
I wouldn't want to take it on
alone.
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That firepower... / I wouldn't want to face it alone.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_042.en:
Escort mission complete.
Returning to base.
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Escort mission complete. / Returning to base.

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_043.en:
Transports wiped out!
The mission's failed...
MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Transport unit annihilated! / Operation failed...

MsgLabels_tactics_16_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Kh! / We couldn't protect them...

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (It's unusual that no one's here.)

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Hm? Is that Alchemist.)

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (...Are the members in the hangar?)

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (...Are the members in the hangar?)

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...That is all. / Cutting communications.

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A transmission.

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: !! / «E801:00»... Captain...

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_008.en:
You never show any emotion, and
now you're rattled.
...Who were you talking to?
MsgLabels_station_17_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You, who don't show emotion, / are awfully flustered. / ...Where were you contacting?

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_009.en:
No, it's nothing.
...
...You see right through me, don't
you. Looks like the bad acting
ends here.
MsgLabels_station_17_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, it's nothing. / ... / ...As expected, you see through it. / Seems my clumsy act ends here.

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_010.en:
Naturally I have an idea.
USN?
What could anyone gain by spying on
a merc base like this?
MsgLabels_station_17_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Naturally I can guess. / Are you with the U.S.N.? / Is there some merit in spying / on a mercenary base like this?

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_011.en:
That's about as far as your guesses
can take you, I imagine.
Heh.
I don't have to answer that.
But now that you know...!
MsgLabels_station_17_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As expected, the range you can guess / ends there. / Heh. / No need to answer. / But since you know...!

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Useless.

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_013.en:
Ghh...
A fast draw!?
You're no ordinary wanzer pilot...
MsgLabels_station_17_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Guhah... / A fast draw!! / You're not just a WAP pilot...

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_014.en:
I don't have to answer that...
but I've picked up most of what it
takes to survive on a battlefield.
I'm taking you to HQ.
Don't resist.
MsgLabels_station_17_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There's no need to answer, but... / the skills to live on the battlefield, / I've acquired the full set. / I'm taking you to headquarters. / Don't resist.

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_015.en:
Taking me in, with no restraints?
Don't make me laugh...
MsgLabels_station_17_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Taking me in without even restraints? / Don't make me laugh...

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_016.en:
So he had a bomb planted.
Looks like he got away...
I missed his vitals on purpose, but
he can't get far like that...
Still, it looks like the hangar was
hit... Is HQ all right?
MsgLabels_station_17_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So a bomb had been planted. / It seems I let him escape... / Even though I missed his vitals, / he can't escape that far... / But it seems the hangar was hit... / Is headquarters safe?

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_017.en:
Captain «E801:00».
Sorry, but I need you out there in
a wanzer, now.
MsgLabels_station_17_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00». / Sorry, but please sortie in a WAP in a hurry.

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_018.en:
Sounds like there was an explosion
near the hangar.
MsgLabels_station_17_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems an explosion happened near the hangar.
