MsgLabels_station_17_msg_019.en:
Looks like sabotage by a spy who'd
been hiding among us.
The spy stole a wanzer from «E801:00»
Squad and is loose on the base.
I want him caught, whatever it
takes.
MsgLabels_station_17_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's presumed to be sabotage by / a spy who was lurking. / The spy stole a WAP of «E801:00» Squad / and is fleeing within the base. / I want him apprehended no matter what.

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...It's Alchemist.

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_021.en:
What?
What the hell is he after...?
MsgLabels_station_17_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What? / For what purpose...

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_022.en:
No idea.
Is the base sealed off?
MsgLabels_station_17_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That I don't know. / The base lockdown status?

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_023.en:
Part of the east gate's already
been blown.
If he gets outside, we'll have a hard
time tracking him.
Deal with him on base if you can.
MsgLabels_station_17_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Part of the East Gate seems to have / already been destroyed. / If he gets outside, pursuit will be difficult. / Deal with it within the grounds as much as possible.

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_024.en:
Roger.
Doesn't sound good.
And if we can't take him alive?
MsgLabels_station_17_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / The situation doesn't seem good. / If we can't arrest him?

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_025.en:
Worst case, it can't be helped if he
dies.
If the spy's Alchemist, he's very
good.
Don't let your guard down.
MsgLabels_station_17_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: At worst, death is unavoidable. / If the spy is Alchemist, / he's quite skilled. / Don't neglect your guard.

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_026.en:
I won't.
Heading to the hangar now.
MsgLabels_station_17_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Of course. / Heading to the hangar at once.

MsgLabels_station_17_msg_027.en:
Worst case, it can't be helped if he
dies.
If the spy's Alchemist, he's very
good.
Don't let your guard down.
MsgLabels_station_17_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: At worst, death is unavoidable. / If the spy is Alchemist, / he's quite skilled. / Don't neglect your guard.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_001.en:
Captain...!
Almost none of the squad's wanzers
can move...
MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain...! / Almost all of the unit's WAPs / can't be moved...

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_002.en:
That bastard tried to grab Rain...
...Dammit, my machine's controls are
wrecked.
MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That bastard was trying to grab / Rain... / ...Damn, my unit's control system / is destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_003.en:
Champ, guess punching him was the
right call.
I bet he meant to take Rain hostage.
Damn, mine too...
It won't even start like this.
MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ, seems punching him was the right call. / He was probably trying to take Miss Rain / hostage. / Tch, mine too... / This way it can't be started up.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_004.en:
Mine's no good either... it's a mess.
But the Captain's machine looks OK!
MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mine's no good either... terrible condition. / But the Captain's unit seems to be intact!

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_005.en:
Only this one, then...
But with the hangar door crushed,
it'll take time to get out.
MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Only this unit... / But with the hangar door crushed, / it'll take time to get outside.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_006.en:
Captain, give us 5 turns, that's all.
...We'll bust it open.
MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, 5 turns is fine, give us time. / ...We'll break it down.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_007.en:
We don't have that kind of time,
not like this...
Let's get it done in 3 turns.
MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: In this situation there isn't / that much time... / Let's manage it in 3 turns.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_008.en:
Roger.
We'll give it a shot.
MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / I'll try.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_009.en:
The vehicle units outside are
engaging him.
Captain, please command them from
your cockpit.
MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Outside, the vehicle units are returning fire. / Captain, please command the units outside / from the cockpit.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Let's believe in everyone.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_011.en:
Victory: Destroy Alchemist's unit.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed or
Alchemist escaped.
MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down Alchemist's unit. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down, or / Alchemist escapes.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_013.en:
Gryphon Eye... Do you read?
This is Alchemist. Target capture
failed.
MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Griffon Eye... can you hear me? / This is Alchemist. Capture of the target / failed.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is... Griffon Eye...

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_015.en:
We have a problem...
Heading to the rendezvous point.
MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Trouble occurred... / Heading to the rendezvous point.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / ...Hurrying there.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Take this! Take this! / ...Alright!

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_018.en:
Finally broke, damn thing...
Way tougher than it needed to be...
MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It finally broke... / Uselessly sturdy...

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_019.en:
A wanzer should fit through this hole!
Captain, go!
MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A WAP should be able to get through this hole! / Captain, please go!

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_020.en:
The enemy's still on base grounds.
Be careful!
MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The enemy is still within the grounds. / Please be careful!

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_021.en:
Good work, all of you.
«E801:00», launching.
MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good work, everyone. / «E801:00»'s unit sortieing.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Tch... / «E801:00»'s unit...

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Alchemist. / I won't let you escape anymore.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_024.en:
Almost there now.
I thought this would take a lot
more work!
MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Coming this far, just a little more. / I thought it'd take more trouble!

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_025.en:
Enemy machine has reached the gate.
At this rate he'll get away!
MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The enemy unit has reached the gate. / At this rate he'll get away!

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger...

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Further resistance is useless. / Surrender.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Kh, this unit is done for...

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm taking you in.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_030.en:
Gryphon Eye, I can't surrender and
be made to talk.
...Ready an anti-fortress missile.
Target my machine.
MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Griffon Eye, I can't afford to surrender / and be made to confess. / ...Prepare an anti-fortress missile. / Target my unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_031.en:
...Locked on.
Alchemist, are you sure about this?
MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Locked. / Alchemist, are you really sure?

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_032.en:
I'm sure. Fire.
...If it comes to this, I'm taking
him with me.
MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It doesn't matter. Fire. / ...If it's come to this, I'll take him down with me.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_034.en:
«E801:00»!«g:24» I surrender!
The cockpit hatch won't open.
Pry it open from outside with your
wanzer.
MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: «E801:00»! I surrender! / The cockpit hatch won't open. / Open it from outside with your WAP.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems he gave up resisting.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_036.en:
Captain, heat source incoming!
A high-yield missile!
Take evasive action!
MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, heat source approaching! / A high-output missile! / Please evade!

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_037.en:
Tch, Rain again...
In my way to the very end...
MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Tch, Rain again... / Will she be an obstacle to the end...

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_039.en:
Rain, thanks. You saved me.
After a blast like that, there'll be
nothing left of him...
Mission complete...
MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain, you saved me. / With this explosion, unfortunately no trace will remain... / The mission is complete...

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_040.en:
Gryphon Eye.
This is Alchemist.
Reached the extraction point.
Gryphon Eye, launch a ground-attack
missile. Target «E801:00»'s machine.
Destroy the whole base.
MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Griffon Eye. / This is Alchemist. / Reached the escape point. / Griffon Eye, fire the surface missile. / Target is «E801:00»'s unit. / Destroy it along with the base.

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_041.en:
To let him slip right through our
fingers...
MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: To let him escape right under my nose...

MsgLabels_tactics_17_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Farewell, «E801:00».

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even so, that Alchemist... /

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_002.en:
If Champ hadn't stepped in,
I might have ended up a hostage.
But I wonder how much information
he managed to send out...
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If Champ hadn't saved me, / I might have become a hostage. / But how much information / got through, I wonder...

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_003.en:
Hmm, why sneak into a merc base,
of all places?
I can't think of anything strategic
worth stealing here.
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm, why was he infiltrating / a mercenary base of all places? / I don't think there's any strategic / information here.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_004.en:
True...
Then again, passing yourself off as
a merc is probably pretty easy.
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Indeed... / But disguising oneself as a mercenary / might be easy.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Captain...

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: About Alchemist.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_007.en:
I barely knew him, but even so...
I have mixed feelings about it.
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even though I didn't interact with him much, / I have complicated feelings.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_008.en:
Same here.
I wish I'd caught on a little sooner.
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / I wish I had noticed a little sooner too, / but...

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_009.en:
Captain, why do you think Alchemist
infiltrated this base?
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, why was Alchemist infiltrating / this base?

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_010.en:
...Unknown.
But he was very good.
We may be up against whatever unit
a man like that belongs to.
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Unknown. / But his skill was considerable. / Perhaps our opponent is a unit / such a man belongs to.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_011.en:
A spy in a merc base...
Could it have something to do with
the mercs who've been disappearing...?
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A spy at a mercenary base... / Could it have something to do with the incidents / of mercenaries disappearing...

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_012.en:
...Now that I think of it, in the
hangar, Alchemist said my old
captain... is alive.
...That threw me, and he almost
got hold of me.
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Come to think of it, in the hangar / Alchemist said / the former captain is alive... / ...I was startled by those words / and almost got caught.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_013.en:
He knew about your old captain...?
That's suspicious...
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: He knew about the former captain... / Suspicious...

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_014.en:
Anyway, Champ, how did you know
Alchemist was a spy?
You decked him the second you
ran into him...
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even so, Champ, / how did you know / Alchemist was a spy? / You punched him down suddenly / the moment you met...

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_015.en:
The bastard was trying to grab Rain.
I saw that and swung on reflex,
that's all...
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That bastard was trying to forcibly grab / Rain. / I just punched him reflexively when I saw it...

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_016.en:
Not exactly thought through, but it
worked out, so...
Hm...?
If he brought up your old captain,
maybe this spy was digging into
something about your old squad?«g:24»
...Rain, when you made it back from
your old squad, what happened?
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's short-sighted, but it worked out all right... / Hm...? / If he was talking about the former captain, / could the spy this time have been investigating / something about the previous squad? / ...When Miss Rain returned alive from the previous squad, / what was the situation?

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_017.en:
It was... an ordinary mission,
as jobs go.
But when we got near the objective,
Buggy and I were both hit by
splitting headaches at the same
time. It was strange...
Lancer, our captain then, ordered
us to pull out, and we got off the
battlefield, but they never came back...
No mission report since. Nobody
knows what became of them.
Buggy was hit on the way out and
badly wounded.
Lancer and the others just weren't
the kind to desert...
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That was... a normal mission / as work. / But when we arrived near the destination, / strangely, Buggy and I were simultaneously / struck by severe headaches... / Lancer, who was captain at the time, told us / to withdraw, and we escaped the battlefield, but / they didn't come back... / After that, no mission report, whereabouts unknown. / When withdrawing, Buggy was hit and / seriously wounded. / Lancer and the others shouldn't be people / who'd desert, though...

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_018.en:
A spy at a merc base, mercs who
never came back, an unidentified
large machine...
If it's all connected, what on
earth is happening on Huffman?
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A spy at the mercenary base, mercenaries who didn't return, / large units of unknown affiliation... / If everything is connected, / what is happening on this Huffman?

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_019.en:
...Whatever it is, for now we go
back to merc work.
This isn't being officially treated
as an incident.
Let's get our machines repaired
and be ready for the next job.
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Whatever it is, for now we just / return to mercenary work. / This matter isn't officially / being treated as an incident. / Let's hurry the repair of our units / in preparation for missions.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_020.en:
You're right...
Everyone, let's put Alchemist
behind us.
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's true... / Everyone, let's forget / about Alchemist.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_021.en:
Still, what Alchemist said...
I can't stop thinking about it.
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even so, Alchemist's words / bother me...

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_022.en:
A mission?
If we've been issued wanzers,
we're fine.
I'll get ready right away.
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission? / If WAPs have been issued, / we're fine. / I'll prepare at once.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I don't think about complicated stuff!

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_024.en:
Whoa!
My wanzer's fixed already!
I'm ready to roll anytime!
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Whoa, fast! / My WAP's already fixed! / I can go anytime!

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_025.en:
Rain...
First she loses her old squad, and
now someone comes after her too...
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Miss Rain... / On top of her previous squad disappearing, / even she herself was attacked...

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_026.en:
The staff rebuilt our wanzers for us!
The parts are all brand new.
Ready to sortie anytime!
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The staff restored the WAPs / for us. / The parts are new. / We can sortie anytime!

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_027.en:
With this much pointing to foul play,
they still won't treat it officially...
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even with this much of an incident about it, / to not handle it officially...

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_028.en:
The wrecked wanzers have been fully
restored.
Mission acknowledged.
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The destroyed WAPs have been / completely restored. / Mission understood.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Headaches... huh.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_030.en:
Come to think of it, Captain, you
mentioned headaches too.
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Come to think of it, the Captain talked about headaches too.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_031.en:
Mine come on in sudden attacks...
Most likely an aftereffect of
old combat.
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: These headaches happen in fits, but... / they're probably an aftereffect from an old battle.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_032.en:
An aftereffect of combat...
It must have been one brutal fight...
What happened?
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: An aftereffect of battle... / It must have been a really fierce battle... / What on earth happened?

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_033.en:
A bad call on my part got my unit
wiped out.
When I try to remember that time,
the headaches can hit hard.
Anyway, it has nothing to do with
Rain's case.
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Through my misjudgment, I wiped out my unit. / When I try to remember that time, / I'm sometimes struck by a severe headache. / Well, it's a story unrelated to Rain's matter.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (No headache today, it seems...)

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_035.en:
(My machine seems untouched...
Time to get ready to sortie.)
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (My unit seems to be as it was... / Shall I prepare to sortie.)

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_036.en:
I heard a spy got onto the base.
I've been asked to come and hear
what happened from you.
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I hear a spy infiltrated the base. / I was told to come / ask you about the circumstances.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Circumstances or whatever...

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_038.en:
His paperwork was complete and all
in the proper format,
and with skills on a par with the
Captain's, I don't think there was
any reason for a merc outfit to
turn him down...
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: His paperwork was all in order / in the official formats, / and with skill on par with the Captain, I don't think / there was any reason to turn him down as a mercenary...

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wasn't he doing anything suspicious?

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_040.en:
Right before he was exposed,
he'd been going around asking
everyone about my past.
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Right before he was exposed as a spy, / he seems to have been asking everyone / about my past.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_041.en:
Oh, that's right!
He asked me too!
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, that's right. / He asked me too!

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's... / «E801:00», do you have any idea?

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_043.en:
He may have been digging into the
special forces unit I used to
belong to.
It shouldn't be public knowledge,
even inside the army.
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Maybe he was probing / about the special forces unit / I used to belong to. / It shouldn't have been made public even in the army.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_044.en:
I see...
I'll put that in my report.
If special forces intel is involved,
I expect Army Special Intelligence
will get involved.
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see... / I'll report that. / If it's special forces information, / I think the Army Special Intelligence Department will move.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_045.en:
Um, Ellen...
If you could, about the missing
mercs as well...
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Um, Miss Ellen... / if possible, the disappearance matter too...

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_046.en:
About that... I did ask already,
but they still wouldn't tell me
anything.
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: About that... I already asked, but / as expected they wouldn't tell me anything.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see... / Thank you very much.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Don't be discouraged, Rain.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_049.en:
There may be spies in other merc
bases too.
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There's a possibility spies have infiltrated / other mercenary bases too.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_050.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
We patched up the wrecked wanzers
and swapped in new parts, so
they're ready to sortie.
Meant pulling an all-nighter, ya
know... *yaaawn*
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yo, «E801:00». / The wanzers that got broken, I repaired them / and fitted new parts, / so they can sortie. / Thanks to that I pulled an all-nighter... / Fuaah.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_051.en:
Alchemist, a spy... who'd have
thought?
What was he even after?«g:24»
...Maybe there was a reason he kept
asking about you, «E801:00».
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That Alchemist, to think he was a spy... / What on earth was his goal? / ...Asking about «E801:00» too, / maybe he had some aim.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_052.en:
Emergency mission.
A transport chopper belonging to a
company rumored to be backing the
enemy has gone down in the
Wayne Mountains.
Get out there now and recover the
cargo.
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: An urgent mission. / A transport helicopter of a corporation / rumored to be backing the enemy side / crashed in the / Wayne mountain region. / Head to the site immediately and / recover the cargo.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_053.en:
Roger.
How long since the crash?
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / How much time has passed / since the crash?

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_054.en:
From the look of it, about three
hours already.
The enemy's probably sent its own
recovery team by now.
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: From the situation, it's believed 3 hours have / already passed. / The enemy has probably also dispatched / a recovery unit.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_055.en:
So it's a race against them.
But the squad's wanzers took serious
damage in the last incident.
Getting ready to sortie will take
time.
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It'll be a race against the enemy unit. / But in the earlier incident our squad's WAPs / took serious damage. / Sortie preparations will take time.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_056.en:
That's not a problem.
The trouble happened on this base.
I've told the hangar crew to put
together new wanzers for you.
If they grab any containers,
take them back by force.
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's no problem. / It's trouble that occurred on base. / I've instructed the hangar staff / to assemble new WAPs. / If containers are taken, / respond with force.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_057.en:
Roger.
Heading to the site now.
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Heading to the site at once.

MsgLabels_station_18_msg_058.en:
Expect to run into their recovery
team.
If they grab any containers,
take them back by force.
MsgLabels_station_18_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Engagement with the enemy recovery unit is expected. / If containers are taken, / respond with force.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_001.en:
Approaching the transport
chopper's crash site.
MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We're nearly at the transport helicopter's crash site.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's awfully quiet.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain, enemy signatures?

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No signatures so far.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_005.en:
Looks like we got here first.
Alright, let's grab the loot!
MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Seems our squad got here first. / Now, let's recover the treasure!

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_006.en: Let's scoop it all up while we can!
MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Let's recover all of it while we can!

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_007.en:
Right. We move before their
recovery team arrives.
MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good, before the enemy recovery unit arrives, / we begin action.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_009.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units
and recover all containers.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies and / recover all containers. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rotor sound... enemy units approaching!

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: They seem to be stealth specs.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So they came after all.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_014.en:
All units, prepare to intercept,
and speed up the recovery.
MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units, while taking interception stance, / hurry the recovery work.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All containers recovered.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission complete. / Returning to base.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_018.en:
Huh? ...This cargo...
I'm sure I've seen this emblem...?
MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Huh? ...This cargo, / this emblem is surely...?

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_019.en:
That's some medical company's
emblem... I've seen it around.
Doesn't exactly scream treasure.
MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's the emblem of a medical manufacturer / I've seen... / Doesn't feel much like treasure.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_020.en:
This cargo...
Is this... an animal's spinal cord?
What is it for?
It doesn't look like a weapon.
MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This cargo... / This is... an animal's spinal cord? / What could it be? / It doesn't seem to be a weapon.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_021.en:
And here I thought it'd be some
new weapon...
This is kind of gross...
MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I thought it'd be a new weapon... / This is kinda gross...

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_022.en:
Sakata... products...
It's classified.
You'd better not look any closer.
All of you, forget what you saw.
MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sakata... products, huh... / It's classified. / You'd better not look any further. / Everyone, forget what you saw.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes... / Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_024.en:
All containers recovered,
including the ones the enemy took.
MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Recovered all containers, / including those the enemy took.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_025.en:
Though we did blow a few of 'em
sky-high along with the enemy...
MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: In the end, some containers / got blown away along with the enemy, though...

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_026.en:
Some of that couldn't be helped.
Better than letting the enemy
have them.
MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: To some extent it can't be helped. / It's better than having them seized by the enemy.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_027.en:
This cargo...
Is this... an animal's spinal cord?
What is it for?
It doesn't look like a weapon.
MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This cargo... / This is... an animal's spinal cord? / What could it be? / It doesn't seem to be a weapon.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_028.en:
And here I thought it'd be some
new weapon...
This is kind of gross.
MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I thought it'd be a new weapon... / This is kinda gross.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_029.en:
Sakata... products...
It's classified.
You'd better not look any closer.
All of you, forget what you saw.
MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sakata... products, huh... / It's classified. / You'd better not look any further. / Everyone, forget what you saw.

MsgLabels_tactics_18_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes... / Roger.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_001.en:
Medical companies do work with the
military on technology, but still...
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Certainly medical manufacturers cooperate / with military technology too, but...

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_002.en:
That was the Sakata Industries
emblem, wasn't it.
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It was the emblem of / Sakata Industries.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_003.en:
Either way, that stuff was shady
as hell...
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even so, it was a fishy thing...

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_004.en:
Maybe they're building androids...
Hmmm...
Or maybe it's alien technology!?
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Are they making artificial humans or something... / Hmmm, / maybe it's alien technology!?

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_005.en:
Things like that don't happen in
real life...
Oh, Captain. Good work today.
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There's no way that exists in reality... / Ah, Captain, good work.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_006.en:
Sounds like you're talking about
what we saw on the last mission.
That job came in as an emergency.
It must have been highly classified.
The sooner you forget it, the better.
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Seems you're talking about the thing you saw / in the mission the other day. / It was a mission that came urgently. / It must have been something highly classified. / Better to forget what you saw quickly.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Right. / Let's forget it.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_008.en:
I hear it's not just mercs. Even
special forces operators have been
made to disappear for touching
military secrets.
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Not just mercenaries, even special forces members, / it seems sometimes they touch military secrets / and get erased.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_009.en:
So even idle curiosity can get you
killed.
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It means even light curiosity could / cost you your life.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_010.en:
Even special forces...
Then, now that we know, are we
going to disappear too?
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even special forces members... / Then, will we who found out / get erased too?

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_011.en:
We don't even know what it was,
so I doubt it'll come to that...
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We don't know what that was, / so probably not, that sort of thing...

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_012.en:
Awww, if it's going there anyway,
I want a mysterious plot twist...
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ehhh, if anything I'd like to expect / a mysterious development...

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_013.en:
No. The fact is, we can't rule it
out either.
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, it's also a fact that we can't say for sure there won't be.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's...

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_015.en:
C-Captain...
Don't scare me like that...
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: C-Captain... / don't scare us...

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_016.en:
Better to assume that's the kind
of work we do.
Call it a matter of mindset.
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You'd better think of yourselves as doing / that kind of work. / Well, it's a matter of mindset.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_017.en:
Right.
We just stick to the mission.
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Right. / We just devote ourselves to the mission.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_018.en:
Huh! So then there really IS alien
technology!?
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh! Then there is / alien technology!?

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_019.en:
That ain't what we're talkin'
about...
Oddeye, you weren't listening to
the Captain at all...
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's not what we're talking about... / Oddeye, you weren't listening to the Captain...

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_020.en:
Her train of thought jumps the
tracks sometimes, this one...
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sometimes the topic drifts, / with this girl...

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_021.en:
Ah, Rain just said something mean
about me...
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Miss Rain just said / something mean...

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_022.en:
We may run into classified material
again.
I'll be careful from now on.
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There's a possibility we'll touch secrets / from now on too. / I'll be careful going forward.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_023.en:
A mission, then.
I'll prepare to sortie.
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_024.en:
Well, can't unsee what we saw.
Alright, I'll work out till I
forget it...
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But what we saw can't be helped. / Alright, I'll do some training and forget...

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_025.en:
Sortie time?
Alright, let's go wild!
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie. / Alright, I'm gonna run wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_026.en: We just stick to the mission.
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We just devote ourselves to the mission.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_028.en:
Hmm, but a little mystery now and
then is nice, isn't it?
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm, but once in a while something mystery-like / is nice too, right?

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_029.en:
Oh, a sortie!
I'll get ready!
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, a sortie, right. / I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_030.en:
(That cargo... Gray, Rain and I are
one thing, but Oddeye and Champ
seeing it may have been a mistake.)
(They still think like civilians.
I'll have to drill confidentiality
into them.)
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (That materiel... leaving aside me, Gray, and Rain, / it might have been bad that Oddeye and Champ / saw it.) / (Their awareness isn't much different from civilians' yet. / I have to make them thoroughly observe confidentiality.)

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Alright. Sortie.)

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_032.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
Gabriel hasn't been coming by the
barracks lately.
He's a bit gloomy, but he's not a
bad guy, ya know?
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yo, «E801:00». / Lately Gabriel doesn't come to the guardroom. / He's a bit gloomy, but he's not / a bad guy, you know.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_033.en:
Word is Gabriel's been holed up in
his room whenever he's off shift.
Said something about his clan...
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That Gabriel, / apparently except when working he / shuts himself in his room. / He was saying something about a clan...

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_034.en:
We've had reports that enemy
remnants, routed by another merc
unit, are regrouping in the
Kydin Jungle.
«E801:00» Squad, go mop them up.
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There was a report that enemy remnant units that / fought another mercenary unit and were routed / are gathering in the Kadins jungle region. / «E801:00» Squad, go sweep them up.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_035.en:
Roger.
...Remnants.
They shouldn't be much of a threat,
but they could link up with a
relief force.
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / ...Remnant units. / I don't think they're a threat in terms of strength, but / they might join up with a relief unit.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_036.en:
Right. Five or six machines still
able to fight, at most.
Wipe them out before they link up
with any relief force.
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm. Units capable of combat / are at most 5 or 6. / They should be annihilated before joining up with the relief unit.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_037.en:
Roger.
But I've heard rumors that other
units have gone missing in that
area lately. Any intel?
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / However, I've heard rumors that lately other units / have gone missing in that area, / any information?

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_038.en:
Hm.
You keep your ear to the ground,
I'll give you that.
It's true reports of losses to a
third party in that sector have
gone up since the last recovery op.
Probably armed guerrillas stealing
weapons, but it could affect the
mission.
You'd do well to be very careful
out there.
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hm. / It seems you're diligent in gathering information. / Indeed, reports of damage by a third force / in this direction have increased since / the earlier recovery operation. / There are probably armed guerrillas / capturing weapons or such, but it could / affect the mission. / You might do well to / pay the utmost attention.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_039.en:
Roger.
We'll need repair gear.
Preparing to sortie.
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Repair equipment will be needed. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_19_msg_040.en:
Losses in that sector are up.
Probably armed guerrillas stealing
weapons.
You'd do well to be very careful
out there.
MsgLabels_station_19_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Damage in this direction has increased. / There are probably armed guerrillas / capturing weapons or such. / You might do well to / pay the utmost attention.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_001.en:
We've reached the area where the
enemy remnants are hiding.
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We've arrived at the area where the enemy / remnant units are hiding.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_002.en:
Lots of trees here.
Oh, is that them?
Enemy unit spotted ahead.
Doesn't look like a big force.
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Lots of trees. / Ah, is that it? / Enemy unit found ahead. / It doesn't seem large.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_003.en:
A platoon with some vehicles mixed
in. Should be an easy one.
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A platoon mixed with vehicles. / Well, an easy mission.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_004.en:
Yeah, but it's always the easy ones
where things go sideways.
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But it's precisely at times like this / that troublesome things happen.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ, aren't you unusually cautious?

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_006.en:
I heard there's bandits roaming
around here!
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Apparently mountain bandits and such / show up around here!

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_007.en:
Bandits...?
What are bandits going to do
against a wanzer?
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mountain bandits... / What are they going to do against WAPs?

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_008.en:
They're not bandits, but...
The rumors about losses to a third
party are true.
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: They're not mountain bandits, but... / the rumors of damage by a third force are certain.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_009.en:
Either way, we sweep the area fast.
All units, stay sharp.
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: In any case, we'll carry out the sweep operation promptly. / All units, don't let your guard down.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_011.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy unit silenced. Sweep complete.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Mission complete.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_015.en:
Gray, first round's the second we
get back.
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gray, when we get back, a drink right away.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_016.en:
And it's on you, of course, right,
Champ?
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wait, of course it's Champ's treat, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_017.en:
Huh? What's that!?
...Are those the bandits?
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? What's that! / ...Could that be the mountain bandits?

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_018.en:
There were still wanzers left?
All units, ammo holding out?
We hit what's left, right now.
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So there was still a WAP squad left. / All units, you have ammo left, right? / We'll hit the remaining forces as is.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_019.en:
Wait.
It's that large machine we fought
before... and two machines that
aren't in our data!
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Please wait. / The large unit we fought before and... / 2 units not in the data!

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_020.en:
His buddies, huh...
Tch. Gray, drinks'll have to wait!
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: His comrades, huh... / Tch, Gray, the treat's next time!

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_021.en:
Roger that, Champ...
But what unit are they from...?
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger, Champ... / But what unit on earth are they...

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_022.en:
These may be our "bandits."
They've already shown hostile
intent.
All units, stay alert and intercept
the unknowns.
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This might be the true identity of the mountain bandits. / They're already taking hostile action. / All units, while staying alert, / intercept the unknown units.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Bandit extermination, roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_024.en:
...Target confirmed.
...All units. They're in standard
wanzers, but their pilots are
high-level.
Don't hold back.
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Target confirmed. / ...All units, that unit / is riding ordinary WAPs, but / the pilots' level is high. / We can't hold back.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Interesting.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_026.en:
Good old Lich.
Lured them right out for us.
All units, watch the leader's
machine.
This doubles as a field test of our
units. Avoid wear where you can.
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As expected of Lich. / He lured them out nicely. / All units, watch the captain's unit. / This is also doubling as a test of the machines. / We avoid attrition as much as possible.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_028.en:
...So that's why Lich has his eye
on them.
We'll take the target another time.
Fall back.
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...So there's something to it, / as much as Lich is concerned about it. / We'll capture the target another time. / We withdraw here.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_029.en: I still have plenty left, you know?
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I can still keep going here?

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_030.en: This time, the data's all we need.
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This time it's fine as long as we get data.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No problem regarding data.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Returning.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This unit, output dropping.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_035.en:
...So that's why Lich has his eye
on them.
We'll take the target another time.
Fall back.
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...So there's something to it, / as much as Lich is concerned about it. / We'll capture the target another time. / We withdraw here.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I can still keep going?

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_037.en:
No problem.
I've got all the data I need.
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No problem. / We've gotten enough data here.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Returning.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_039.en:
...Output dropping.
This machine's still not worth
what they paid for it.«g:24»«g:24»
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Output dropping. / This machine still has a long way to go.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_040.en:
...So that's why Lich has his eye
on them.
We'll take the target another time.
Fall back.
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...So there's something to it, / as much as Lich is concerned about it. / We'll capture the target another time. / We withdraw here.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_041.en: I still have plenty left, you know?
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I can still keep going here?

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_042.en: This time, the data's all we need.
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This time it's fine as long as we get data.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The unknown units are retreating...

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_045.en:
Hey, hey, they can still move after
that? What are they, monsters...?
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hey hey, they can still move? / Are those guys monsters...

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Machines I'd never seen before...

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm shocked...

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_048.en:
No question, those pilots were all
veterans.
They were probably breaking in
those machines...
We're pretty worn down too.
All units, return to base.
Rain, I'll report this to the
Commander myself.
MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems the pilots are undoubtedly / all veterans. / They were probably doing familiarization / piloting of those machines... / We've been worn down considerably too. / All units, return to base. / Rain, I'll report this matter to the Commander myself.

MsgLabels_tactics_19_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Captain, good work!

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_002.en:
So this is where everyone is.
Oddeye, I came for the footage
from the other day.
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So everyone was here. / Oddeye, I came to get / the recorded video from the other day.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_003.en:
Oh, the one you're watching with
the Commander, right?
I edited it and everything!
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, you're watching it with the Commander, right? / I edited it properly.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see, that's a help.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_005.en:
Oh, Captain...
There's, um, a problem with the
footage...
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Captain... / But there's a problem with the video...

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is going too far...

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is Hollywood-class compositing...

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ehehe. / It's not that great~.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is this that video...?

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_010.en:
Captain...
It seems Oddeye took it upon
herself to add some... effects to
the combat footage...
I'm sorry. I'll get you the master
data later.
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain... / It seems Oddeye arbitrarily added staging / to the combat video... / I'm sorry, I'll hand you the master data / later.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_011.en:
A beam here...
A crash, then lightning effects...
She must have picked the camera
angles with the effects in mind.
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A beam here... / Crash and a lightning effect... / I can only think she decided even the camera / angles on the premise of adding effects.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_013.en:
Here an enemy machine gets
destroyed... and in the next cut...
oh, that's your machine, Captain...
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: An enemy unit is destroyed here... / In the next cut... ah, this is the Captain's unit...

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_014.en:
That's me?
...Missiles?
Hundreds of them...
I don't recall firing that many.
Then again, with that much missile
smoke, you'd never get a visual
lock on anything...
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is me? / ...Missiles? / And hundreds of them... / I have no memory of firing this many? / But with this much missile smoke / coming out, visual targeting / would become impossible...

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_015.en:
No.
Like I said, those are Oddeye's
effects...
You didn't fire that many, Captain...
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No. / Like I said, it's Oddeye's staging... / You didn't fire this many, Captain...

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_016.en:
And then, at the very end, the end
credits roll.
...Getting the timing right on that
was the hardest part.
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: And, finally, the end credits come up. / ...This timing was the hardest.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_017.en:
Oddeye, we can't use this as an
official record...
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, this can't be used / as recorded footage...

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_018.en:
Awww...
I pulled an all-nighter on this...
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ehhh... / I even pulled an all-nighter to make this...

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_019.en:
...That was quite good footage.
I'll take it.
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...It was a pretty good video. / I'll take it.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_020.en:
Huh? That's a bad idea...
I mean, it's well made, but...
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? That's bad... / The thing itself is good, though...

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_021.en:
If you hand him that, the
Commander will be furious...
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If you hand over something like this, / the Commander will scold you...

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_022.en:
No problem.
I'm sure he has plenty of time to
kill at HQ.
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No problem. / He must surely have too much free time / at headquarters too.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_023.en:
Then next time I'll try even
harder!
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Then next time I'll work / a little harder!

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_024.en: I see. I'll look forward to it.
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see, then I'll look forward to it.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_025.en:
But...
I'll give you the master as well,
just in case...
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But... / I'll give you the master too, just in case...

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_026.en:
I see.
I'll take that too.
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / I'll take that too.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_027.en:
We asked the wrong person...
But the Captain did seem pleased...
(Was that pleased...?)
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I asked the wrong person... / But the Captain seemed pleased... / (Was he pleased...?)

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_028.en:
A mission, then.
I'll prepare to sortie.
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_029.en:
I wanna get my fight footage
juiced up like that too...
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'd like her to process the footage / of my matches too...

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_030.en:
Sortie time?
Alright, let's go wild!
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie. / Alright, I'm gonna run wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_031.en: Next time I'll try even harder!
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Next time I'll work a little harder!

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_032.en:
Oh, a sortie!
I'll get ready!
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, a sortie, right. / I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_033.en:
Oddeye's really talented...
Why's she doing merc work, I
wonder...
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye has talent, huh... / Why is she doing something like mercenary work...

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_035.en:
(I need to get this footage to the
Commander.)
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (I need to give the video data to the Commander.)

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Alright. Sortie.)

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_037.en:
Hey, «E801:00».
Saw the combat footage.
Never seen a wanzer like that.
I joined the maintenance crew 'cause
I love wanzers, so when I see a new
model I get all fired up, ya know?
Friend or foe, doesn't matter.
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yo, «E801:00». / I saw the recorded footage. / Never seen a wanzer like that. / I joined the maintenance team because I love wanzers, / so when I see new machines, / regardless of enemy or ally, I get excited.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_038.en:
You guys sure keep running into
large machines...
It doesn't match the USN force
disposition we operators have, so
whose unit are they?
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You guys sure keep running into large units... / It also conflicts with the U.S.N. / force distribution we operators have grasped, / so what unit on earth / could it be?

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Oddeye's video... / ...I want to see it......

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The real-combat footage from the other day.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_041.en:
Appreciated.
I'll get it to the brass right away.
...Hm?
There seem to be two files here?
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That helps. / I'll hand it to the upper echelons right away. / ...Hm? / There seem to be 2 data files?

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_042.en:
Give the brass whichever one
they like.
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Give the upper echelons whichever you like.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_043.en:
Anyway, about your mission.
We've had word that the unidentified
unit «E801:00» Squad ran into is
resupplying in the Roxta Desert.
I want you to ambush them and get
us intel on the enemy.
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Anyway, about the mission. / Information came in that the unidentified unit «E801:00» Squad / encountered the other day is resupplying / in the Roxta desert region. / I want you to raid it and grasp intel on the enemy.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_044.en:
True, in those desert hills a
resupply would go unnoticed.
An unidentified unit of black
machines...
Where did this intel come from?
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Indeed, in the hills of that desert, / resupply work wouldn't stand out. / An unidentified unit composed of black machines... / Where's that information from?

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_045.en:
From the army's top brass.
Apparently they picked it up by
chance.
This may be our chance to find out
who they really are.
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's information from the army's upper echelons. / Apparently they caught it by chance. / With this we might grasp their true identity.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_047.en:
Make sure they don't see the ambush
coming.
And remember, the mission is intel,
not wiping them out.
According to the brass, if you
silence their special mechanic-type
machine, they can't make repairs,
and you may even capture some.
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Take care that the raid isn't detected. / Also, the mission is intel gathering rather than / annihilating the enemy. / According to the information from the upper echelons, / if you silence the special machine of / mechanic type, the enemy can't repair, / and capture will probably also be possible.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_048.en:
Roger.
We'll plan on a short fight and
bring gear for concentrated
firepower.
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Premised on a short decisive battle, I'll prepare / equipment that can concentrate firepower.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_049.en:
Destroy their supply vehicles, and
the machines being resupplied won't
last in a drawn-out fight.
Good luck.
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If you destroy the enemy supply vehicles, / the machines being resupplied won't be able / to endure long combat. / I wish you luck.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Preparing to sortie at once.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_051.en:
Destroy their supply vehicles, and
the machines being resupplied won't
last in a drawn-out fight.
Good luck.
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If you destroy the enemy supply vehicles, the machines / being resupplied won't be able to endure long combat. / I wish you luck.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_052.en:
Sorry, Lich...
We failed to capture the target.
But we did get combat data on the
machines.
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry, Lich... / We failed to capture the target. / But we got real-combat data on the machines.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_053.en:
Another failure...
Not much of a show for the Numbers,
huh?
So, what now?
X-01, push any harder and they'll
catch on.
Not that I expect the regulars to
lift a finger.
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Failure after failure... / The Numbers are a disgrace, aren't they? / So, what'll you do? / X-01, any more and they'll catch on to us, you know? / Mind you, I don't think the regular army will move.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_054.en:
As soon as resupply and tuning are
done, I intend to hit their base.
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As soon as resupply and machine adjustment are done, / I intend to hit their base.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_055.en:
...Now that's a bold plan.
And you're sure you can grab the
target this time?
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...That's a bold operation. / So, are you confident / you can secure the target?

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Leave it to me.

MsgLabels_station_20_msg_057.en:
I'm counting on you.
Before the client runs out of
patience.
MsgLabels_station_20_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm counting on you. / Before the client runs out of patience.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_001.en:
Target area reached.
They don't seem to have noticed us.
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Reached the target area. / They don't seem to have noticed us.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_002.en: Looks like the intel was good.
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Seems the intel was accurate.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_003.en:
Alright, time to pay 'em back for
last time, with plenty of interest!
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Alright, I'll pay them back for last time / generously, with interest!

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_004.en:
Champ, resupplying or not, don't
underestimate that unit.
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ, no matter that the enemy is resupplying, / don't underestimate that unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Come to think of it... those guys were monsters...

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_006.en:
Their machines and their skills are
both top-tier...
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Both machines and skill are high level...

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_007.en:
If we start taking damage, we
prioritize the desert-colored
mechanic-type machine.
As long as it's around, the enemy
wanzers seem to slowly recover.
All units, don't overextend.
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If it looks like we'll take damage, / we'll prioritize attacking the desert-colored / mechanic-type machine. / As long as that machine is around, the enemy WAPs / seem to gradually recover. / All units, don't push yourselves.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_008.en:
Roger.
The point of this ambush is
gathering intel, right?
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / The purpose of this raid was intel gathering.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_009.en:
All units, weapon safeties off.
Combat ready.
Commence the ambush.
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units, release weapon safeties. / Take battle stations. / Begin the raid.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_011.en:
Victory: Destroy Wizard's unit.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down Wizard's unit. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_013.en:
It seems someone has caught wind
of us here.
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems there was a unit that / sensed this place.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Them again.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_015.en:
Quick on their feet, for mercs.
I suppose that's to be expected.
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Quick action for mercenaries. / I suppose I should say, as expected.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_016.en:
So that's the unit everyone's
talking about...
This might be fun, don't you think?
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So that's the rumored unit... / Looks like it'll be fun, doesn't it.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_017.en:
Even so, we're mid-resupply.
Chimera's machine is under
maintenance and can't even move.
Stay alert.
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That said, we're resupplying. / Especially Chimera's unit under maintenance can't even move. / Don't let your guard down.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_018.en:
...Roger.
I can still work as a gun turret.
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Roger. / It'll serve as a gun turret.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_019.en:
...50% damage taken.
I can't afford to lose this machine
here.
This unit is breaking off.
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Hit rate 50%, huh. / I can't lose the machine here. / This unit is withdrawing from combat.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_020.en:
Oh my... to think they'd push me
this far.
They're stronger than the data said.
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: For me to be beaten this much, / ...isn't that skill beyond the data.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_021.en:
...Machine damage at 50%.
This unit is falling back for now.
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Machine damage rate 50%. / This unit is temporarily retreating.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_022.en:
...Support unit destroyed. Cable
severed.
...Estimated combat time under
these conditions: less than three
minutes.
...This unit is falling back for now.
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Support unit wiped out. Cable severed. / ...In this situation the estimated combat time is less than 3 minutes. / ...This unit is temporarily retreating.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The large units are withdrawing.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_024.en:
Don't chase them too far.
Concentrate fire on the mechanic
type.
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Don't pursue too far. / Concentrate attacks on the mechanic type.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_026.en:
Machine damaged, output dropping.
I can't move.
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Machine damaged, output dropping. / Unable to act.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_027.en:
Wizard, I can see black smoke.
Eject.
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wizard, I can see black smoke coming out. / Escape.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_028.en:
No good.
I've tried several times. The
ejection system won't activate.
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No good. / I tried several times but the ejection device won't activate.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_029.en:
Wait, Wizard.
Let me help you.
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wait, Wizard, I'll lend a hand.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_030.en:
Don't, Golem...
Wizard, base has ordered us to
withdraw.
We're pulling out...
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Stop, Golem... / Wizard, a withdrawal order came from the base. / We are withdrawing...

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_031.en:
No need to worry about me.
I'm simply going on ahead.
We made a fine team.
See you around.
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No need to worry. / It's only that I go first. / It was quite a good team. / See you.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...No. / ...See you, Wizard.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...All units withdraw.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_034.en:
Mechanic type destroyed.
The rest appear to have withdrawn.
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mechanic type heavily damaged. / The rest seem to have withdrawn.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_035.en:
Roger.
All units, gather what intel you can
on the enemy unit.
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / All units, gather intel on the enemy unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_036.en:
After an explosion like that,
there's no way we can recover the
mechanic-type machine...
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As expected, with this explosion, / recovering the mechanic-type machine / is impossible...

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_037.en:
And we flattened the vehicles
pretty good too...
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: And we crushed the vehicles flashily too...

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_038.en:
Come on, no grumbling. Start
searching.
MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Come on, stop grumbling and search.

MsgLabels_tactics_20_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger...

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_001.en: Captain, do you have a moment?
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, do you have a moment?

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_003.en:
