I've heard you're quite a shot,
Captain.
After nearly being taken hostage
the other day, I'd like to train a
little more for self-defense.
If you don't mind, would you give
me some pointers?
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I heard your shooting skill, Captain, / is quite something. / There was also the recent incident where I almost became a hostage, / so I thought I'd like to train a bit more / for self-defense. / If it's alright, could you give me a lecture?

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_004.en:
I see. Then shall we head to the
shooting range now?
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see, then shall we go to the / shooting range now?

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: By all means, please.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_006.en: This is my first time in here...
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is my first time coming in here...

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_007.en:
Rain.
Did you bring your own gun?
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain. / Did you bring your own gun?

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / This one.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_009.en:
7mm.
22 plus one in the chamber.
It's a little heavy, which keeps
the recoil down.
The type they issue to regular
army officers.
If it's loaded, go ahead and fire.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 7mm, huh. / 22+1 rounds. / The weight is a bit heavy, which makes the recoil light. / It's the type issued to / regular army officers. / If it's loaded, try shooting right away.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger...

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_011.en: Rain, which is your dominant eye?
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain, which is your dominant eye?

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: My right eye.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_013.en:
...Your form's off.
Let me help.
Don't close your right eye, it's
your dominant one.
Keep both eyes open and focus on
the target through the sights.
Keep your weight on both feet.
Don't lock your elbows.
Relax.
If you're too tense, you won't hit
the target either.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Your form is no good. / Let me help. / Don't close your dominant right eye. / Open both eyes and concentrate on the target / through the sights. / Better to put your weight on both feet. / Don't fully extend your elbows. / Don't tense up. / Even if you put in too much strength, you won't / hit the target.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: L-like this...?

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_015.en:
Good. That form's not bad.
Try pulling the trigger.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good, that form isn't bad. / Try pulling the trigger.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. Firing...

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_017.en:
The trigger has some slack.
Learn where the slack ends and take
it up in advance. Then steady your
breathing and pull in one go.
Otherwise you'll jerk the trigger,
and you won't hit anything.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The trigger has some amount of slack. / Learn the slack, squeeze the trigger up to there / in advance, and finally / steady your breathing and pull in one go. / Otherwise you'll jerk it, / and won't hit the target.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's difficult...

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_019.en:
Shooting takes technique and
practice.
It's supposed to be hard.
Practice until you can do the whole
sequence in under three seconds.
Once it's in your body, it'll help
with wanzer gunnery too.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Handgun shooting requires technique and training. / You can assume it's natural for it to be difficult. / Practice finishing that series of actions / within 3 seconds. / If you get your body used to this, / it's effective in WAP shooting too.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_020.en:
Thank you for all the advice.
I've been told for a while to put
in more time on the range, and now
I finally feel like doing it.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thank you very much for all the advice. / I've been told for a while to do more / shooting training, but I finally / feel motivated.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_021.en: Thank you for all the advice.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thank you very much for all the advice.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_022.en:
A direct attack on the base?
Preparing to sortie.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A direct attack on the base? / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_023.en:
Captain.
Looks like everybody went to the
shooting range.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain. / Seems everyone went / to the shooting range.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ, you're not going?

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_025.en:
Guns just ain't my thing...
I'd rather trust my own fists.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Guns just aren't my thing... / I want to believe in my own fists.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_026.en:
Hm.
You're a skilled fighter, Champ.
You may end up trading blows on the
battlefield, but hand-to-hand eats
up stamina.
If you can, it's better to carry a
weapon for self-defense.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hm. / Champ, you were skilled in hand-to-hand combat. / On the battlefield, situations of trading blows can be expected, but / hand-to-hand combat drains stamina. / If possible, you'd better carry / a self-defense weapon.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_027.en:
I get the logic, but...
In the end, what I trust most is
my own fists.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I understand the logic, but... / after all, what I can trust most / is my own fists.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_028.en:
Getting into close quarters isn't
easy, though.
Well, fine.
Confidence and pride like that
are admirable.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's hard to bring it into close-quarters fighting, though. / Well, fine. / That much confidence and pride / is admirable.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_029.en:
Heh, thanks.
You oughta train up in some martial
arts too, Captain.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Heh heh, thanks. / Captain, you'd better train martial arts / and such too.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_030.en:
True, I haven't done much practical
training lately.
Spar with me sometime.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Indeed, lately I haven't done / practical training. / Spar with me sometime.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_031.en:
Happy to.
I'll take you on anytime!
But Captain, you might get hurt,
you know?
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gladly. / I'll take you on anytime! / But Captain, you might get hurt, ya know?

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_032.en:
Don't worry.
I'll go easy on you.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's fine. / I'll go easy.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_033.en:
Huh?«g:24»
I'M the one gettin' beat...?
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? / I'm the one who gets beaten...

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_034.en:
In the end, what I trust most is
my own fists.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: After all, what I can trust most / is my own fists.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_035.en:
Who the hell's dumb enough to hit
our base... I'll knock 'em flat!
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Attacking the base, who the heck is it... / I'll turn the tables on them!

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Captain!

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, shooting training. / You're enthusiastic.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_038.en:
I come and shoot to blow off steam
sometimes.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I shoot sometimes to relieve stress.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_039.en:
Hm... a .45?
Oddeye, let me see your gun.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh, ...a .45 caliber. / Oddeye, show me the gun.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_040.en:
Sure.
What do you think? It's vintage,
but it's really easy to handle.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sure. / How is it? It's a vintage piece, but / this one's easy to handle.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_041.en:
Vintage...
Based on a Colt M1911A1.
It's been tuned to a frightening
degree.
One of the most reliable guns there
is, even today. Nothing else is
built quite like it.
Its design is the basis of modern
handguns, too.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Vintage... / It's based on the Colt M1911A1. / It's been tuned frighteningly. / It's one of the highly reliable guns that are still viable today. Its high degree of perfection is one of a kind. / Its concept is also the foundation of modern guns.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_042.en:
Ehehe.
That's what I love about it.
But I could only find replicas of
the hammer and magazine catch...
I've looked all over, but the
originals are so hard to find.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ehehe. / That's what's good about it. / But there are only copies of / the hammer and magazine catch... / I searched quite a bit, but / I just can't find them.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_043.en:
With this gun, there's no need to
stick to period parts.
There are plenty of good custom
parts out there.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: With this gun, there's no need / to insist on parts from that era. / There must be any number / of good-quality custom parts.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_044.en:
But that's the part I want to get
right...
Anyway, you really know your stuff,
Captain.
Oh, can I see your gun too?
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But that's where I want to be particular... / Even so, you know a lot, Captain. / Ah, may I see your gun too, / Captain?

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah, here.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_046.en:
Huh? A revolver?
And what even is this...?
I can't tell what it's based on...
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Huh? A revolver? / And what is this...? / I can't tell what the original model is...

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_047.en:
The frame's a one-off from a custom
gunsmith that supplies special
forces.
Chambered in .357 Magnum, built for
fast-draw shooting.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The frame is a one-off from a custom gun maker / for special forces. / It's chambered for .357 Magnum rounds, / a spec emphasizing the fast-draw style.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_048.en:
W-wow...
But don't people always say
revolvers aren't good for combat?
Low capacity, you can't carry much
ammo, and they're a pain to
maintain.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A-amazing... / But I often hear revolvers aren't suited / to real combat, you know? / Both the loaded capacity and carried ammo are small, / and maintenance is a pain too.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_049.en:
Depends on the use.
Once you have the technique, it's
more reliable than an issued
automatic.
Ideally you'd carry issue, so the
unit can share ammo, but I can't
trust a gun I'm not sold on.
I'm trusting it with my life.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It depends on the purpose. / Once you've acquired the technique, it's more reliable / than an issued automatic. / Ideally, issued weapons are better since ammo can be / shared within the unit, but unless it's something / I'm satisfied with, I can't trust it. / I'm entrusting my life to it, after all.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_050.en:
I see! So you're a stickler too,
Captain!
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see, so you're the particular type too, Captain!

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_051.en:
It's not that it's the best.
I've just never found anything
else I trust.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's not that this is the best, / it's just that I've never come across / anything else I can trust.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_052.en:
I love my .45, but now I want a
revolver too!
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I like .45 caliber too, but I'm starting / to want a revolver!

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_053.en:
Oddeye, I hope you find a gun
that suits you.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, I hope you come across / a gun that suits you.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_054.en:
Maybe I'll just give this one to
Gray...
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Maybe I'll just give this gun to Gray or something...

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_055.en:
The enemy's here?
I'll get ready right away!
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The enemy came? / I'll get ready at once!

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, good work.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Pretty good skill, isn't it.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_058.en:
Nah, I've gotten rusty lately.
And handguns aren't really my
thing.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, I've gotten rusty lately, as you'd expect. / Besides, I'm bad with handguns.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_059.en: Use whatever gun you handle best.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You should use a gun that's easy for you to handle.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_060.en:
Give me a rifle and I'm fine, but
I can't exactly bring one along in
a wanzer...
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: With rifles I'm confident, but / I can't exactly load one / on a WAP...

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sniper rifle?

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_062.en:
Yes.
In special forces I was on a
sniper team.
But then I was moved to a wanzer unit,
and I haven't touched one since.
It's been over a year now.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / In special forces I was on the sniper team. / But since I was transferred to a WAP unit, / I haven't handled one at all since then. / It's been over a year now.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_063.en:
I see.
If you can handle a rifle, your
basics are fine.
Why not carry something like a .45
for self-defense?
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / Being able to handle a rifle / means your basics seem fine. / How about carrying something like a .45 caliber for self-defense?

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_064.en:
A .45's the best bet, huh?
Come to think of it, Oddeye's
gun... now that was a nice gun...
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So a .45 caliber is the best after all. / Speaking of which, Oddeye's gun... / that was a good gun...

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Try negotiating with Oddeye.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_066.en:
N-no way...
A vintage piece like that...
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I-impossible... / A vintage piece like that...

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_067.en:
Oddeye's gun... that was a nice
gun...
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_067.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye's gun was a good gun...

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_068.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_069.en:
(I should get some range time in
myself later.)
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_069.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Maybe I'll do some shooting training later too.)

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_070.en:
(I should get some range time in
myself later.)
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_070.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Maybe I'll do some shooting training later too.)

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_072.en:
I've sent the intel from the ambush
up to the brass.
But so far, all we know is that
they're neither OCU nor USN...
In other words, not military.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_072.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The enemy intel collected in the earlier raid operation / has been sent to the upper echelons. / However, what's known at present / is just that they're neither O.C.U. nor U.S.N.... / in other words, not military.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_073.en:
That much firepower, and no known
affiliation...
If they're private soldiers, then
judging by their gear, there's a
serious organization behind them.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_073.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Unidentified with that kind of strength... / If they're a private army, judging from the equipment, / there seems to be quite an organization behind them.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_074.en:
It may have something to do with
the mercs going missing all over
Huffman Island.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_074.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It may have some connection / with the mercenary disappearance incidents all over Huffman Island.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_075.en:
Alchemist may be connected to that
unit, too.
But why infiltrate this base...?
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_075.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Alchemist could also be considered / connected to that unit. / But why was he infiltrating / this base...

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_076.en:
We're looking into it.
Trouble is, we've got nothing to go
on...
If they want something from this
base, I wouldn't rule out them
coming after it again.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_076.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This matter is under investigation. / After all, there's practically no information... / If they have some goal at this base, / the possibility of being targeted in the future / doesn't seem to be zero.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_077.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...This explosion and vibration... missiles?

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_078.en:
A direct attack on the base!?
What the hell is surveillance
doing!?
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_078.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A direct attack on the base!? / What's happening with surveillance!?

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_079.en:
...If they're following standard
doctrine for taking a facility, an
assault force of mobile weapons
will follow the bombardment.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_079.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...If it follows the theory of facility assault, / after the bombardment, a raid unit / of mobile weapons will come.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_080.en:
...Hmph.
Looks like you're right.
The sensors we have left just
picked up heat sources closing in.
Can't be friendlies, not now.
Get out there and intercept them.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_080.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Hmm. / It seems you're right. / The remaining sensors caught / approaching heat sources. / In this situation I can't think they're allies. / Hurry and intercept them.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_081.en:
Do you know the hangar damage and
the garrison's status?
We can't intercept anything if our
wanzers have already been destroyed.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_081.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Do you know the damage to the hangars and the garrison's situation? / Even if we want to intercept, our WAPs might / already be destroyed.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_082.en:
Air and ground defences are almost
all gone... Hm?
Oh, your squad's wanzer hangar looks
intact.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_082.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Anti-air and anti-ground facilities nearly all wiped out... hm? / Oh, it seems your WAP hangar is safe.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_083.en:
Only our hangar is intact?
(They're up to something... But
there's no time to figure it out.)
Roger. Moving to intercept.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_083.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Only our WAP hangar is safe? / (There's some aim here... but / I don't have the leeway to probe that now.) / Roger. Intercepting at once.

MsgLabels_station_21_msg_084.en:
...Your wanzer hangar looks intact.
Get out there and intercept them.
MsgLabels_station_21_msg_084.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...It seems your WAP hangar is safe. / Hurry and intercept them.

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Any problems with the wanzers?

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We're fine!

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No problem here either.

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_004.en:
All that shelling, and only this
spot's untouched. That's creepy.
MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: With that much bombardment, it's creepy / that only here is unscathed.

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_005.en:
If anything, it looks like they
missed it on purpose.
MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rather, it also looks like they / deliberately missed their aim.

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's probably so.

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Which means...

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_008.en:
It's a declaration of war on this
squad. No doubt about it.
Probably that unit again.
All units, prepare to intercept.
MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There's no mistaking it as a declaration of war / against our squad. / Probably that unit. / All units, take interception stance.

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_009.en:
So it's that unit...
Our parts have been upgraded too.
They're not getting away this time!
MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The enemy is that unit... / Our parts have been strengthened too. / This time we won't let them escape!

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_010.en:
They even knew where our squad's
hangar was...
MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: To think they even knew the location / of our squad's hangar...

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_011.en: Looks like a lot of intel leaked...
MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Seems a lot of information leaked...

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Tch, Alchemist... / that bastard...

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_013.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_015.en:
Shelled everything but the Block B
hangar.
As calculated, only that unit can
move.
MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Bombarded everything except the Block B hangar. / As calculated, only that unit can move.

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_016.en:
Their intel was accurate.
Oh dear... we've lost a fine member
of the Numbers.
MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Accurate information. / Honestly... we lost an excellent member of the Numbers.

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Alchemist, huh...

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_018.en:
And Wizard...
I won't forgive that unit.
MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: And Wizard too... / I won't forgive that unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_019.en:
This isn't a revenge match.
Don't let your emotions carry you
away, Golem.
MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This isn't a battle of revenge. / Don't get swept away by emotion, okay? / Golem.

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_020.en:
I know.
Raid the enemy base and lure the merc
unit out.
Capturing the target comes first.
Then erase all the evidence.
It's a hard job, isn't it...
MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I know. / Raid the enemy base, lure out the mercenary unit. / Then prioritize capturing the target. / After that, erase the evidence. / Quite a tough job...

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_021.en:
Even so, we can't afford any more
failures.
MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But no further blunders will be permitted.

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_022.en:
...I know.
My body needs the money.
I can't have the contract torn
up...
MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I know. / My body needs funds. / It'd be a problem if the contract were canceled...

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_023.en:
Me too. When this job's done, I'm
going to visit my little brother
in Europe.
I've already bought him presents,
so I mustn't fail.
MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Me too, when this mission is over, / I plan to go see my little brother in Europe. / I already bought souvenirs, so I can't fail.

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_024.en:
Now, let's get to work.
X-01 Berserker.
Engaging...!
MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Now, let's get to work. / X-01 Berserker. / Here I come...!

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_025.en:
Contacts confirmed.
All units, weapon safeties off.
We hold the base at all costs.
MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Signatures confirmed. / All units, release weapon safeties. / We defend the base to the death.

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_027.en:
Defeat...
So I'm the one going down...
MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Defeat... / So I fall...

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_028.en:
It's no use...
I can't move anymore.
MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No good... / Can't move anymore.

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_029.en:
...Output dropping... Power unit
melting.
...Artificial skin 80% burned away.
MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Output dropping... power unit melting. / ...Artificial skin 80% burned away.

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...The mercenary unit. / ...Their ability is Numbers level.

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_031.en:
...It pains me to say it, but maybe
even higher.
MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...It's frustrating, but maybe above it.

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...No regrets.

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 3 units heavily damaged... / Shockwave incoming!

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Mission complete.

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's finally over...

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I don't think so, though.

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_037.en:
Going out of their way to come
after us like that...
And those machines nobody's ever
seen... Who do they belong to?«g:24»
MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: To go out of their way to target and attack us... / And those machines I've never seen... / Where on earth are they from?

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_038.en:
Maybe, without realizing it, we've
wandered somewhere mercs should
never set foot...
That's how it feels.
MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Without knowing it, as mercenaries, we may have / stepped into a place / we must not enter... / I have that feeling.

MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_039.en:
At the very least, we've been
dragged into something. That much
is certain...
MsgLabels_tactics_21_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: At the very least, there's no doubt we've been / dragged into something...

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_001.en:
Here, Gray, your end.
Got it?
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Here, Gray, that side. / Got it?

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_002.en:
Okay, Champ.
Whoa, wait, too high.
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Okay, Champ. / Ah, wait, you're lifting it too high.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_003.en:
Sorry.
Put too much into it.
But hey, wouldn't it be faster to
clear all this bomb damage with a
wanzer?
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry. / Put in too much strength. / But hey, cleaning up the remains of this / bombing, wouldn't it be faster / to do with wanzers?

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_004.en:
With a wanzer, you'd wreck the
things we can still use, wouldn't
you?
Oh, sorry, Captain, could you help
me carry that desk next?
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: With wanzers, we'd break even / the usable stuff, right? / Ah, Captain, sorry, next please carry that desk / with me.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood. / So, where should I carry it?

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_006.en:
Outside for now.
Apparently they've already hired
contractors to rebuild the
building itself.
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Outside for now. / The building itself, it seems they've already asked / contractors to renovate it.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_007.en:
This air conditioner's dead too.
It was an ancient model anyway...
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This air conditioner's no good either. / The model is old to begin with...

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_008.en:
It was an old building to begin
with.
I wish they'd just put up a new one
while they're at it...
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It was originally an old building, after all. / If they're at it, I wonder if they'd build a new one...

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That'd be nice. / Please ask the Commander!

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_010.en:
Rather than a fancier building,
it'd be more realistic to ask for
wanzer upgrade parts first.
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rather than making the building luxurious, / it'd be more realistic to first request / WAP enhancement parts.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_011.en:
True.
If that mystery wanzer comes back
even stronger, our current gear
won't stand a chance...
If there is a next time, that is.
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Indeed. / If that mysterious wanzer gets / even stronger and attacks, with our current equipment / we won't stand a chance... / If there's a next time, that is.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_012.en:
Oh, I think I'd rather have the wanzer
parts too!
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, maybe WAP parts would be better for me!

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_013.en:
C'mon, even our bunks got hit, ya
know?
Forget wanzers...
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Look, even our beds / have taken damage, ya know? / This is no time for WAPs...

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_014.en:
Ehh?
I'll just sleep in my wanzer, so I'm
fine.
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ehhh. / I'll sleep in my WAP, so I'm fine, ya know?

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_015.en:
What about showers?
And we won't get a decent meal for
a while either, ya know?
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What about showers? / For a while we won't even be able to eat decent meals, ya know?

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_016.en:
There are rations, and I'll use the
showers at the beach, so I'm fine.
And if I go in my wanzer, that's two
birds with one stone!
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There are rations, and for showers I'll borrow / one at the beach, so I'm fine. / Plus if I go in my WAP it's killing two birds with one stone!

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_017.en:
With war liable to break out any
day now, would any beach huts even
be open...?
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: When war could break out anytime like this, / the beach houses wouldn't be open...?

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_018.en:
Oh, right...
But the plumbing should still be
there, so I'm sure it'll work!
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, I see... / But the water facilities should still be there, so / surely they can be used!

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_019.en:
You'd just help yourself?«g:24»
That's a whole other moral issue...
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You're going to use them without permission? / That's a matter of morals in its own way...

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_020.en:
That too, but more to the point,
you need the Commander's permission
to take a wanzer off base.
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There's that problem too, but in the first place, / if you take a wanzer out of the base you need / the Commander's permission.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_021.en:
Hmm.
You think he won't give it?
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm. / Would he not give permission?

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, what do you think?

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_023.en:
Well.
I'll try asking him myself, but
don't get your hopes up.
Why not each put in a request?
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Let's see. / I'll try negotiating too, but / you'd better not expect much. / Rather, how about each of you applying?

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_024.en:
A request, hm...
Maybe ordering wanzer parts should
come first after all.
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Applying, huh... / Indeed, ordering WAP parts / might come first.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_025.en:
Another attack!?
Understood, I'll prepare to sortie.
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Another raid!? / Understood, I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_026.en: Wish they'd give us mercs a raise...
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I wish they'd raise mercenary pay...

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_027.en:
Enemy mercs cashing in on our bad
luck, huh...
Alright, gearing up!
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: An enemy army mercenary unit piggybacking, huh... / Alright, getting ready!

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_028.en:
Permission to take a wanzer, or new
parts... Can't I ask for both?
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Permission to use wanzers, or new parts... / I wonder if I can't ask for both.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_029.en:
Huh? A different unit this time?
Our base sure has made a lot of
enemies...
I'll get ready right away!
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? A different unit this time? / Our base sure is resented... / I'll get ready at once!

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_030.en:
If we all ask together, maybe
they'll approve something...
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If we all ask together, I wonder if / they'd permit something...

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_031.en:
When it rains, it pours...
Preparing to sortie.
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's what you call adding insult to injury... / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_032.en:
My, they really did a number on
this place...
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well, this sure got hit flashily...

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Miss Ellen...

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_034.en:
I heard the base was attacked, so
I came to see. It's terrible.
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I heard the base was raided, / so I came to see, but this is terrible.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_035.en:
I've already reported what we know
about the enemy to the Commander.
They clearly came after this base,
so we should suspect a link to
Alchemist.
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Information on the enemy and such / has already been reported to the Commander. / Seeing how they clearly targeted / this base, we should suspect / a connection with Alchemist.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_036.en:
Yes, I reported that too.
But our border inspection mission
has been wound up.
So I came by to say goodbye to
Commander Falcon.
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, I reported it. / But our border inspection mission has ended. / So I dropped by to greet Commander Falcon.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_037.en:
What? Why?
Even a Border Guard merc base has
been attacked...
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh, why? / Even the border guard's mercenary base / is being attacked...

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_038.en:
They said it's the regular army's
job from here on...
But... going by how things have
gone so far, I wouldn't expect
much.
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I was told from here on it's / the regular army's job... / But... from how things have been, maybe it's better / not to expect too much.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_039.en:
Something about this feels really
off.
I think I'm starting to hate the
military.
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Something about this feels nasty. / I think I'm going to start hating the army.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_040.en:
Anyone in a department that handles
secrets ends up like that.
I wouldn't let it get to you.
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If you're in a department dealing with secrets, / everyone becomes like that. / I think it's better not to mind it too much.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_041.en:
Gray's right, Rain.
Don't let it get to you.
We'll meet again.
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's as Gray says, Rain. / Don't mind it too much. / Let's meet again.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_042.en:
Oh, yes.
I'm fine.
Thank you.
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, yes. / I'm alright. / Thank you very much.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_043.en:
You heard about Peter?
When the missiles came down, he
just happened to be checking the
radar...
A direct hit, they say.
Nothing left of him... Dammit!
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Did you hear about Peter? / When the missiles came down, he happened / to be inspecting the radar... / Apparently it was a direct hit. / I heard not even a body was left... damn it!

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_044.en:
...Yuji... has gone on leave...
The maintenance crew... new gear
arrived at a time like this...
they're swamped...
No wonder... they're grumbling...
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Yuji... went on vacation... / The maintenance team... new products arrived at a time like this, / and they're in a frantic rush... / Of course... complaints come out...

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_045.en:
The base is currently repairing the
facilities destroyed in the recent
battle and redeploying personnel
and equipment.
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Currently, our base is proceeding with repairs of / facilities destroyed in the battle the other day, and / redeployment of personnel and equipment.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_046.en:
With pilots and mechanics roped in
to help.
You can hear the staff grumbling
from here.
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's work that even dragged out pilots and / maintenance soldiers. / So much that you can hear the staff grumbling.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_047.en:
With all that going on, we still
put your wanzers first in line for
maintenance. I'd like a little
gratitude for that.
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: In such busy times, I'd like you to be grateful / that your WAPs were given priority / in maintenance.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_048.en: I assume you had your reasons.
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There must be a reason for it.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_049.en:
Well, naturally.
We've had word that an enemy unit,
small but real, is deploying near
this base.
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well, naturally. / Information has come in that, though small-scale, / an enemy unit is currently deploying near this base.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_050.en:
Making a move now...
Is it that unit?
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Making a move at this timing... / that unit?

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_051.en:
Apparently not.
It's an enemy merc unit looking to
hit us while we're rebuilding.
The base's weapons and facilities
are down for repairs.
Your squad is pretty much our only
fighting force.
So I want you to guard the base
while repairs are under way.
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems not. / It's an enemy army mercenary unit attacking / in the opening while the base is being repaired. / The base's armaments and facilities are under repair, / so they're unusable. / You could say your unit / is the only fighting force. / So, I want you to guard / the base under repair.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_052.en: So what are we likely facing?
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So, the conceivable enemy strength?

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_053.en:
Attacking in this situation, at
this timing... most likely a force
built around the large wanzers for
taking strongpoints that are being
sent to the front.
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Attacking in this situation, at this timing, / it's thought to be a unit centered on large WAPs / for base suppression that are being deployed / to the front line.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Troublesome.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_055.en:
This time I'll be directing the op
as well.
Large wanzers haven't been in service
long.
Estimating their operating time
from your combat data, the large
wanzers should break off and withdraw
at around 10 turns.
Hold until then, whatever it takes.
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This time I'll also take part in commanding the operation. / The large WAPs have only been in / actual deployment a short time. / Estimating operational time from your / real-combat data, the large WAPs will likely / break off the attack and move to withdrawal / at around 10 turns. / Defend until then no matter what.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_056.en:
So we build the large wanzers running
out of stamina into the plan.
Roger.
Starting sortie prep.
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So we build the large WAPs running out of stamina / into the strategy. / Roger. / I'll start sortie preparations.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_057.en:
This time I'll be directing the op
as well.
Large wanzers haven't been in service
long.
Estimating their operating time
from your combat data, the large
wanzers should break off and withdraw
at around 10 turns.
Hold until then, whatever it takes.
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This time I'll also take part in commanding the operation. / The large WAPs have only been in / actual deployment a short time. / Estimating operational time from your / real-combat data, the large WAPs will likely / break off the attack and move to withdrawal / at around 10 turns. / Defend until then no matter what.

MsgLabels_station_22_msg_058.en:
...So Berserker's team failed too.
They were supposed to be the best
the Numbers had...
Can't be helped.
Best to keep clear of that squad
for a while.
Tch. Barrett «E801:00»...
Still getting in my way, huh...
MsgLabels_station_22_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Berserker's squad failed too. / It should have been the unit at / the top of the Numbers... / It can't be helped. / Not getting involved with that squad for a while is the right answer. / Tch, that Barrett «E801:00»... / Still getting in my way...

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_001.en:
Enemy mobile force approaching.
Right now, this base is as good as
naked.
If they get inside, we're done for.
«E801:00» Squad, I'm counting on you.
MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy mobile unit approaching. / Right now this base is practically naked. / If they get in, we won't stand a chance. / «E801:00» Squad, I'm counting on you.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_002.en:
Roger.
As planned, we hold for 10 turns.
MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / As planned, we defend aiming for 10 turns.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_003.en:
Hey, Commander, Gray says if we hold
the line, you'd better make the
bonus a fat one!
MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hey Commander, Gray was saying / if we hold out, you'd better / be generous with the bonus, ya know?

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_004.en:
You're the one who said you wanted
better food in the barracks, Champ!
MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ, weren't you the one saying / to make the guardroom menu / tastier!

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_005.en: Oh, I'd like some time off~
MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, I want a vacation~.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_006.en:
And please put in the order for new
parts while you're at it.
MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Along with that, please order new parts.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_007.en:
...Understood.
I'll give it... positive
consideration, as far as possible...
MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Understood. / As far as possible, I'll consider it positively...

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good. / Beginning the defense mission.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_009.en:
Victory: Defend the base for
10 turns.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: defend the base for 10 turns. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_011.en:
Enemy unit silenced.
No remaining enemy signatures.
MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy unit silenced. / No signatures of remaining enemy forces.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission complete.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_013.en:
Alright!
Good grub, here we come!
Gray, start thinking how you'll
spend that bonus!
MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Alright! / Tasty grub is ours! / Gray, think about how to use the bonus!

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_014.en: My first time off in ages~
MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A vacation after so long~.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_015.en:
Falcon.
The rest is up to you.
MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Falcon. / I leave the rest to you.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_016.en:
Y-yes, well...
I suppose there's no way around it.
I'll put in requests with each
department...
MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Y-yes... / It can't be helped. / I'll try applying to each department...

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Remaining enemy forces withdrawing.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_018.en:
Mission complete.
Falcon.
I'll be expecting good news about
the success bonus.
MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission complete. / Falcon. / As for the success reward, I expect a good answer.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_019.en:
Y-yes, well...
I'll do my best...
MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Y-yes... / I'll do my best...

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 1 turn left until base defense is complete.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 2 turns left until base defense is complete.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 3 turns left until base defense is complete.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 4 turns left until base defense is complete.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 5 turns left until base defense is complete.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 6 turns left until base defense is complete.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 7 turns left until base defense is complete.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 8 turns left until base defense is complete.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 9 turns left until base defense is complete.

MsgLabels_tactics_22_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 10 turns left until base defense is complete.

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_001.en: Captain, do you have any leave plans?
MsgLabels_station_23_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, do you have vacation plans?

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_002.en:
Nowhere to go, nowhere to go back to.
I'll stand by at the base.
MsgLabels_station_23_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I have nowhere in particular to go or return to. / I'll stand by at the base.

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_003.en:
Oh, I see...
The other three seem to have left
Huffman already.
I can't decide whether to go home
myself... Shall I stay, if you need me?
MsgLabels_station_23_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh, is that so... / It seems the three of them left Huffman. / I'm torn about whether / to go back home... / If needed, shall I stay?

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_004.en:
The base is half shut down for repairs.
We have no work, and if the enemy
does attack, some other unit will
have to deal with them.
Go home, Rain. Get some rest.
MsgLabels_station_23_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: With repair work underway, the base is half closed. / We have no work now, and even if the enemy / attacks, some other unit will / probably deal with them. / Rain, you'd better go home and refresh / too.

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_005.en:
I see...
Going home is such a bother, though...
Everyone asking what I plan to do
with my future, and so on...
MsgLabels_station_23_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see... / Even if I go home, it's a lot of hassle... / They say all sorts of things, like what will I do about the future...

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Those around you must be worried.

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_007.en:
I know that, but...
Mine's a military family, and they
don't approve of me being a merc.
Sigh...
And now they've even started
talking about arranged marriages...
MsgLabels_station_23_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I understand that too, but... / My family is originally a military lineage, and they're / negative about me doing mercenary work. / Haah... / On top of it all, they even brought up a marriage-meeting proposal...

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_008.en:
Some people live only for
their parents' sake.
Others follow the path they
believe in.
Which one is up to you, Rain.
MsgLabels_station_23_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There's a life lived thinking only of one's parents. / And there's a life advancing on the path you believe in. / Which to choose is for you to decide, Rain.

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...That's right. / I'll think about it.

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_010.en: Well then, I'll be off home.
MsgLabels_station_23_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well then, I'll go home.

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_011.en:
(I must have got used to the noise.
The quiet feels wrong.)
(Before I came here, it was
the other way around...)
MsgLabels_station_23_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Maybe because I got used to a lively environment, / the quiet situation feels odd.) / (Until I came here, / it was the complete opposite...)

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_012.en:
(Leave, huh.
Not that I have any plans...)
MsgLabels_station_23_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (A vacation, huh. / I have no particular plans...)

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_013.en:
(A new weapons test.
Should help pass the time.)
MsgLabels_station_23_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (A test of a new weapon. / Seems it'll pass the time.)

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_014.en:
You «E801:00»?
Shresh, maintenance crew.
I'm takin' over your machine today.
Heard you're rough on 'em, but
I'll keep it runnin' as sweet as
Peter did. Don't you worry.
MsgLabels_station_23_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Are you «E801:00»? / I'm Thresh from the maintenance team. / From today I'm in charge. / I hear your unit gets damaged an awful lot, but / I'll maintain it as well as Peter, / so rest easy.

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_015.en:
Huh? Shresh reminds you of Peter?
Well, same crew, same overalls,
I guess.
MsgLabels_station_23_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh, Thresh and Peter look alike? / Well, they're on the same maintenance team, and / they wear the same thing.

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_016.en:
...Going on leave... with Matt...
for a while...
See you...
MsgLabels_station_23_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...For a while... vacation with Matt... / See ya...

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_017.en:
A company that backs our merc corps
wants to borrow a pilot to trial
some prototype parts.
Sorry to cut into your leave, but
you're the man for the job.
MsgLabels_station_23_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A corporation that backs our / mercenary unit has requested that / we lend a pilot for a trial of / prototype parts. / Sorry to do this while you're on vacation, but you're the right person.

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_018.en:
I was running out of ways to kill
time anyway.
So, what's the new weapon?
MsgLabels_station_23_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I was just bored with nothing to do. / So, this new weapon is?

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_019.en:
Melee gear, I'm told.
Get the details on site.
Their technician, Lycov, is waiting
at the weapons-test Killhouse.
MsgLabels_station_23_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's said to be melee equipment. / Ask for details on site. / Dispatched technician / Lycov is waiting at the killhouse for weapon testing.

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Which means live-ammo training.

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_021.en:
That's right.
And all the cover's been cleared out.
Go knock that technician's socks off.
MsgLabels_station_23_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Exactly. / Also, the cover has been removed. / Try to astound the technician.

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Let's prepare.

MsgLabels_station_23_msg_023.en:
All the cover's been cleared out.
Go knock that technician's socks off.
MsgLabels_station_23_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The cover has been removed. / Try to astound the technician.

MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_001.en:
Thank you so much for taking part.
Today we'll be testing a new weapon.
MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thank you for participating. / This time it will be a test of a new weapon.

MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_002.en:
Understood.
I was told I can use live ammo?
MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / I've heard we may use live ammo?

MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_003.en:
Yes, by all means.
And the targets carrying the new
weapon are unmanned.
Our staff will fly them by radio,
so please don't hold back.
MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, that's fine. / Also, the targets equipped with the new weapon / are unmanned units. / Our staff will pilot them by radio here, so / no need to hold back.

MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood.

MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_005.en:
Well then, I look forward to some
lovely data.
MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well then, I hope we can get / good data.

MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Beginning the test.

MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_007.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_009.en:
Data recording nominal.
No problems at all.
(Though this pilot's reactions are
almost too good...)
I'll send out the next target.
Is that all right?
MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Data recording good. / No problems. / (Or rather, this pilot's reactions / seem too good...) / I'll put out the next target. / Is that alright?

MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Continue.

MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_011.en:
All targets cleared!
...M-marvellous...
Um... that's a remarkable score.
So, er, what did you think?
How does the new weapon feel?
MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Target all clear! / ...M-marvelous... / Um... an amazing result. / Umm, how is it, how does the new weapon / seem?

MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_012.en:
The recoil into the arm looks heavy.
Joint damage will probably build up
fast.
MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The recoil on the arm seems strong. / Damage to the joints will probably / accumulate easily.

MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_013.en:
(This is no ordinary pilot...)
Ah -- I see, very helpful.
I'll have it adjusted by next time.
That concludes the test menu.
Thank you for your hard work.
MsgLabels_tactics_23_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (This person isn't an ordinary / pilot...) / Ah... I see, that's helpful. / I'll adjust it by next time. / The test menu is finished. / Good work.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Captain.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_004.en: Oddeye. What happened to your leave?
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, what about your vacation?

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_005.en:
Mmm~.
Well... there weren't any events on
in Tokyo this time of year, so
I came straight back.
Oh, Captain, here's a souvenir!
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm. / Well... even going to Tokyo this season, / there weren't any particular events, / so I came back. / Ah, Captain, this is a souvenir.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Thank you. / ...What on earth is this?

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_007.en:
Canned oden!
I've got canned ramen too, if you'd
rather have that?
I bought them for myself, but you
can pick whichever you like.
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's canned oden. / There's also canned ramen and such, / would you prefer this one? / I bought them for myself, but / I'll give you whichever you like.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see, then...

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oden

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll take the oden.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_010.en:
You know your classics, Captain!
If you say Akiba, you say
canned oden.
I just knew you'd love it!
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As expected of the Captain, you know the classic! / When it comes to Akiba, after all, / it's canned oden. / I thought you'd be pleased too, Captain!

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_011.en:
Is that so.
...I'll share it with the Commander
later.
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is that so. / ...I'll have it with the Commander later.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ramen

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm curious about the ramen.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_013.en:
Go ahead, go ahead! I've ordered
a whole box for myself, so it's fine.
That one's a sample, though.
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Go ahead, go ahead, I've ordered a box / for myself, so it's fine. / That one's a sample, though.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_014.en:
It's close to its use-by date.
I'll share it with the Commander
later.
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The expiration date is close. / I'll have it with the Commander later.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_015.en:
By the way, Captain, were you at
the base this whole time?
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: By the way, Captain, were you at the base / the whole time?

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_016.en:
I was.
I helped out with a new weapons test.
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / I was helping test a new weapon.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_017.en:
!!
You got a juicy job like that!?
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: !! / You were doing something that juicy!

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_018.en:
Juicy...?
Well, the pay was decent enough.
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Juicy...? / Well, it made for a decent income.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_019.en:
No fair~.
I want to test new weapons too!
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Lucky. / I want to try testing / a new weapon too~.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_020.en:
The technician should still be here.
They may call on us again.
If they do, I'll put your name
forward.
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: In that case the dispatched technician should still be here. / They might call on us again. / When that happens, I'll try recommending you, Oddeye.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_021.en:
Wow, thank you!
I'm so glad I came back early!
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wah, thank you very much! / I'm glad I came back early!

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_022.en: I'm so glad I came back early!
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm glad I came back early!

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_023.en: Is it time for the weapons test yet~?
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Isn't the new weapon test yet~?

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_024.en:
Captain «E801:00», isn't it?
Thank you so much for the other day.
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00», right. / Thank you for the other day.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_025.en: It helped me pass the time, too.
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It was a good way to pass the time for me too.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_026.en:
My, but you're skilled, Captain
«E801:00».
I'd always thought Captain Sarna of
Chariot Squad was the very best,
but you seem to be a cut above.
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But, Captain «E801:00», you're skilled. / Until now I thought Captain Sarna of the Chariot Squad / was number one, but / you seem to be above that.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_027.en:
Chariot Squad.
I hear they're a very capable unit.
I've met their captain a few times.
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The Chariot Squad. / I hear it's quite an excellent unit. / I've met their captain a few times.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_028.en:
Oho, you're acquainted?
Captain Sarna is strong, beautiful...
an altogether marvellous person.
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ho ho, you're acquainted. / Captain Sarna is strong and beautiful, / a wonderful person.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_029.en:
Though I sense she's hiding
something.
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Something hidden about her somehow bothers me, though.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_030.en:
Ah, but that air of mystery is
marvellous too.
...Wait, don't tell me, Captain
«E801:00» -- is that your type?
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That hidden air is wonderful too. / ...Wait, don't tell me, Captain «E801:00», / you like that type of woman?

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_031.en:
No. That's not what I meant.
Comrades on the same battlefield
are neither men nor women.
On the front line, you can't afford
feelings like that.
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, I don't mean it that way. / Among comrades on the same battlefield, / there's no opposite sex or same sex. / Especially if you stand on the front line, / there's no room to harbor special feelings.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_032.en:
Well, well. What admirable
egalitarianism, I suppose...
Oh, that reminds me. I've just put
a request in with HQ: I'd love you
to join another test.
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well well, what wonderful egalitarianism, / one might say... / Come to think of it, I applied to headquarters / just now, so by all means please participate / in the test once more.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_033.en:
Roger.
I'll go and talk to the Commander.
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / I'll ask the Commander about it right away.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_034.en: I'd love you to join another test.
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: By all means please participate in the test once more.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_035.en:
Peter and me... we were best mates...
The old so-and-so was upgradin'
a weapon for you.
Take it. Think of it as somethin'
to remember him by.
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Peter and I... were best friends... / Peter was / upgrading weapons for you. / Think of it as his keepsake, / and take this.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_036.en:
Captain «E801:00», sorry to interrupt
your leave, but I've got work for you.
Hm? What's this?
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00», sorry to bother you on vacation, but / it's about work. / Hm? What's this?

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_037.en:
A souvenir from Oddeye, apparently.
Want to try some?
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Seems it's a souvenir from Oddeye. / How about a bite?

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_038.en:
Hmm.
...Not bad at all.
Cute design on the can, too.
...Might be better heated up, though.
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hm. / ...Quite a flavor. / The can's design is cute too, isn't it. / ...But it might taste better warmed.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...That's right. / Let me hear about work.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_040.en:
Right.
Another request to test new parts.
They asked for you by name, no less.
Quite the popular fella, aren't you?
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm. / This time too it's a request to test new-model parts. / The other party directly / requested you by name. / You're quite popular, aren't you.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_041.en:
I ran into Lycov in the barracks,
but didn't ask for details.
What's it this time?
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I met Lycov at the guardroom, but / I didn't hear the details. / What's the content this time?

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_042.en:
All I've been told is it's a backpack
test under combat conditions.
They want two pilots: you and
a Launcher.
For this weapon, Oddeye's the
obvious pick.
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I've only heard it's a test of a backpack / in real-combat format. / Also, they'd like you and a Launcher, 2 people total, / to participate. / For the new weapon, Oddeye / would be the right person.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_043.en:
Good. I was going to recommend her.
Can we make a request of our own?
I'd like them to leave the cover in.
Otherwise it'll be over too fast.
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Perfect. / I was thinking of recommending her. / Will requests from our side go through? / I'd like the cover left in place. / Otherwise it'll be over right away.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_044.en:
They've already taken that into
account, I'm told.
They'll probably change the targets,
too.
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems the other side is also taking that into account. / They'll probably change the targets too.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Heading to the killhouse.

MsgLabels_station_24_msg_046.en:
It's a backpack test under combat
conditions.
Take Oddeye along with you.
MsgLabels_station_24_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's a test of a backpack in real-combat format. / Also, you and Oddeye, 2 people, / should go take part.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_001.en:
Thank you so much for joining us
again.
MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thank you for continuing / to participate in the test.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_002.en: I heard this was a backpack test?
MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I heard it's a backpack test?

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_003.en:
You'll be fighting an improved model
with a tuned engine.
Please go all out, just like last time.
MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll have you fight against an improved type / with a tuned engine. / Please fight with full strength like last time.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_004.en:
Roger.
Oddeye, you heard him.
Treat it as real combat.
MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Oddeye, as you heard. / Think of it as real combat.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_005.en:
Roger!
But are you sure?
We might break it, you know?
MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / But is it okay? / I'll break it, ya know?

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_006.en:
No need to hold back.
Collecting data is the whole point.
MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No need to hold back. / The purpose is data collection.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_007.en:
I see~.
Seems kind of a waste, though.
Oh! If we get a good score, could
I have some spare parts to play with?
MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I seee~. / But it's kind of a waste. / Ah, if I get a good result, could I have / spare parts used for the experiment?

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_008.en:
Certainly.
Given a good enough score, they're
yours.
MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I don't mind. / Depending on the result, I'll give you some.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_009.en:
Yay!
Then I'm not holding back!
MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yay! / Then I'm going in without holding back!

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good, commencing attack.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_011.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Now, next?

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_014.en:
Target Alpha, all units inactive.
Activating Target Beta.
MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Target Alpha, all units ceased activity. / Next, activating Target Beta.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_016.en:
All targets cleared.
Data collection nominal.
MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Target all clear. / No problems with data collection.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Over already?

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_018.en:
Outstanding.
This much combat data is an enormous
help!
MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As expected. / If we can collect this much combat data, / it's a big help!

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_019.en:
Looks like heat dissipation is a bit
better than the old type.
MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
