Literal: The heat dissipation efficiency seems slightly better / than the previous type.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_020.en:
Oh? You noticed?
That's exactly what we improved!
That concludes the trial.
As promised, I'll add some parts to
your reward.
MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh? You noticed? / That's the point of the improvement! / With this the trial is over. / As promised, I'll add parts / to the reward.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So this is the end.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_022.en:
Yes.
It took a little while, didn't it?
But thanks to you, we got our data.
Thank you for your hard work.
MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, / it took a little time. / But thanks to you, the data / was collected. / Good work.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ummm... / What about the parts...?

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_024.en:
...Ah, I'm terribly sorry.
The spare parts appear to be
broken...
MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Ah, sorry. / The spare parts seem to be broken...

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_025.en:
Aww...
Oh, I don't mind junk parts!
MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ehhh... / Ah, junk parts are fine too, ya know?

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_026.en:
No, we'll be using these to make
improvements...
I'll bring you working ones next time.
MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, we'll improve based on these, so... / I'll bring fully working ones again.

MsgLabels_tactics_24_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's too bad...

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_001.en:
Captain, was there any trouble
while I was on leave?
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, did any trouble / occur during the vacation?

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No particular problems.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_003.en:
I see.
Oh, here's a souvenir from home.
It's tea. I'll brew some later.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / Ah, this is a souvenir from my country. / It's black tea, so I'll brew some later.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / Thank you.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_005.en:
Come to think of it, I wonder if the
teapot I ordered has arrived...
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Come to think of it, I wonder if the teapot I ordered / has arrived...?

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_006.en:
A mission, then.
Preparing to sortie.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_007.en:
So the base got a makeover.
More like they put it back the way
it was than built anything new, huh.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: They renovated the base, huh. / Rather than new, it's more like / restored.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_008.en:
It's a stopgap, but it looks almost
back to normal.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's emergency measures, but it seems almost back to how it was.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_009.en:
I got three lazy days on a beach in
Malaysia.
Now I'm so sunburnt it hurts all
over...
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I got to laze around on a beach in Malaysia / for 3 days. / Thanks to that, my whole body hurts from sunburn...

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Your appearance doesn't seem to have changed much, though.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_011.en:
Look, Captain, see?
It's peelin' a little, right here...
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: See, Captain, can you see? / The skin's peeling slightly...

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...It's subtle.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_013.en:
Well, I'm in top condition all year,
so it don't show much.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well, I train every day, after all.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is that how it works.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Owah... / It hurts when I sit...

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_016.en:
We're movin' out?
All right -- let's go wild!
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie. / Alright, I'm gonna run wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_017.en:
Captain, I've been wondering for
a while... what's that tattoo on your
arm? A dagger motif seems kind of
special forces-y.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, I've been curious for a while, / what's that tattoo on your arm? / With a dagger as the motif, / it feels kind of special-forces-ish.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's the insignia of my previous unit.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_019.en:
Ooh.
It looks like a bat! It's cute!
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Heh. / It's like a bat, it's cute.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_020.en:
BATS...
I've never heard of that unit, though.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: BATS... / A unit I've never heard of, though.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_021.en:
Even you've never heard of it, Gray?
And you were special forces!
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gray, even though you were from special forces too, / it's a unit you don't know?

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_022.en:
It was special forces, of a sort, but
"special experimental agency" is
closer to the truth.
We had almost no contact with other
special forces or regular troops.
It's been disbanded, and the records
are surely classified.
Best not to spread this around.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's a kind of special forces, but it's more correct to call it / a special-duty experimental agency. / At the time there was no particular contact with / special forces members or ordinary soldiers. / It's been abolished now, and the records / are probably treated as top secret. / Better not to talk about this to others much.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_024.en:
A special experimental agency...
That sounds so cool...
And you hardly ever talk, Captain,
so it's even more mysterious!
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Special-duty experimental agency... / Quite an exciting ring to it... / The Captain says so little that his existence / is even more mysterious!

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_025.en:
Hey, hey, Oddeye...
Let's leave it there.
You're putting the Captain on the spot.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hey hey, Oddeye... / Let's leave it at that. / You're troubling the Captain.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_026.en:
Oh, sorry...
Whenever I hear "special forces",
I just get so curious...
Oh, um... While we're at it, shall
I tell you about my background too!?
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, sorry... / Whenever I hear special forces, / I just get curious... / Ah, um... while we're at it, shall I talk / about my background too!

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Uh, "while we're at it"...

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_028.en: Rain's not here, so now's our chance.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Miss Rain isn't here, so now's the time.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_029.en:
Why Rain?«g:24»
Oh, the rule about past jobs.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Why Miss Rain? / Ah, the rules issue.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_030.en:
...The truth is, I used to be an
operator in the Japan Defense Force!
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Actually, I / was an operator in the Japan Defense Force!

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_031.en:
Oh?
No wonder your battlefield
observation is so accurate.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh. / No wonder your battlefield observation is precise.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_032.en:
Yes, I did radar watch on a certain
island.
I actually joined the Japanese
police first, but...
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, on a certain island / I was doing radar observation. / I joined the Japanese police once, but...

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_033.en:
Huh.
The police, huh.
That seems a long way from wanzers.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Heh. / The police, huh. / Seems unrelated to wanzers.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_034.en:
As a detective I'd get to fire a gun,
and nab the bad guy, and shout
"Suspect secured!"...
But they posted me to the traffic
division instead of criminal
investigations.
I wanted to work closer to mechs and
weapons anyway, so I switched to
the JDF.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If I became a detective I could shoot a handgun, and I wanted / to catch criminals and say "Secured!"... / But my posting wasn't the detective division, / it was the traffic division. / So, since a workplace close to mecha and weapons / was better after all, I switched jobs to the Japan Defense Force.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_035.en:
...That's watching too many cop
shows, or impure motives, or...
But neither of those is exactly easy
to get into, is it?
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Watched too many dramas, or rather, the motive / is impure, or... / But neither of those is something you can / get into that easily, right?

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_036.en:
No.
I've heard JDF operator standards are
stricter than other countries'.
At least eight languages for
communication... or so I heard...
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / I heard Japan Defense Force operators especially have stricter / standards than other countries. / I've heard the languages needed for communication / are 8 or more...

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_037.en:
Oh, the exam was like that, but on
the job it's mostly English. If you
can use some Korean, Russian, French
and Spanish now and then, you're fine.
I understand around sixteen
languages, so they found me handy!
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, the exam was like that, but the work / is mainly English, and if you can sometimes use Korean, Russian, / French, and Spanish, / there's no problem. / Incidentally, I can understand about 16 languages, / so I was treasured.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_038.en:
(...Is she actually some kind of
genius...?)
I see.
And then you went merc to get even
closer to mechs and weapons...
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (...Isn't she an amazing person? / This person...) / I see. / So then you chose mercenary work, even closer / to mecha and weapons...

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_039.en:
Mm-hm.
That's about the size of it.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm. / Well, that's about it.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_040.en:
Since we're sharing, I'll tell you
what I can...
I think I've mentioned it before:
back then, I got my unit wiped out.
But whenever I try to remember that
time, I get a splitting headache...
In that unit, I was mostly a wanzer
test pilot.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Since we're at it, I'd like to answer too / as far as I can... / I think I told you before, but at that time / I wiped out a unit. / But when I try to remember that time, / I'm struck by severe headaches... / In that unit I was mainly / a WAP test pilot.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_041.en:
...What is it with those headaches,
I wonder.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...What could those headaches be.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_042.en:
A test pilot...
That's why you're so good at piloting
wanzers...
I'm sorry, Captain. I hope the
aftereffects clear up soon...
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A test pilot, huh. / That's why you're so good / at piloting WAPs... / Captain, I'm sorry, I hope the aftereffects / heal soon...

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_043.en:
No.
Don't worry about it.
If anything, I'm sorry I had nothing
more interesting to tell.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No. / There's nothing to worry about. / Rather, sorry I can't tell an interesting story.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_044.en:
The Captain's headaches... It must be
some really awful trauma...
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The Captain's headaches, / it must surely be a huge trauma...

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_045.en:
Oh, we're sortieing?
I'll get ready!
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, a sortie, right. / I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_046.en:
Everyone's got a history,
I guess.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Everyone has a history. / Huh.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_048.en:
(When I'm alone, I remember that unit.)
(It gives me headaches, yet I had its
insignia inked on my shoulder so I'd
never forget. My head and my body
can't agree.)
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (When I'm alone, I remember that unit.) / (Even though it gives me headaches, I carved the unit insignia / on my shoulder so as not to forget. / My head and body contradict each other.)

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_049.en:
(Thinking about the past again...)
(But with everyone around, it's
easier to put out of mind.)
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (I ended up remembering that past again...) / (But thanks to everyone being here, it distracts me.)

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_051.en:
Hey, pops. Whaddaya think you're
doin'?
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hey, old man, what are you doing?

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_052.en:
Hm?«g:24»
Oh, you one of the mercs from this
base? As you can see, I'm helping
myself to some food.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hm? / Oh, a mercenary of this base? / As you can see, I thought I'd get some food.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_053.en:
Huhh? Pops, I ain't never seen your
mug around here. Who the hell are you?
What're you doin' raidin' the food
stores? And what's with that star?
You even brought a basket...
And how'd you unlock this place!?
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Huh? Old man, / that's a face I don't see at this base, who are you? / Why are you rummaging through the food storage on your own? / And what's with that amount? / Even brought a basket... / I mean, how did you open the lock here!?

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_054.en:
Now, now, settle down.
I'm Thomas Norland, Lieutenant,
1st Army.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, well, calm down. / I'm Thomas Noland, / a first lieutenant of the 1st Army.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_055.en:
......
......
L-Lieutenant!?
S-s-s-sorry, sir!
Um, may I ask why the Lieutenant,
sir, requires the food, sir, if I may,
sir?
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...... / ...... / F-first lieutenant!? / P-p-p-pardon me! / Um, sir, why does the first lieutenant / require food, if I may be so, sir?

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_056.en:
Ga-ha-ha!
Don't be so stiff.
Lieutenant or not, I'm not the boss
of you mercs.
Right now my unit's tracking a USN
recon unit that slipped into
OCU territory.
They're holed up near this base and
my boys are keeping watch, but
we've run out of food.
Yours was the nearest base, so we're
stocking up here.
Your commander unlocked it for me.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gahaha! / Don't be so stiff. / A first lieutenant isn't you mercenaries' superior. / Right now, our unit is tracking a U.S.N. / reconnaissance unit that slipped / into O.C.U. territory. / They're hiding near this base, / and my comrades are keeping watch, but we've / run out of food. / So we're procuring it at this base, / the nearest one. / I had the Commander open the lock.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_057.en:
I see, sir...
Uh, should I get everyone to help
carry it, then?
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is that so... / Ah, then, shall I call everyone / and help carry it?

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_058.en:
Good attitude, but no need.
A basket of rations like this'll
do us fine.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh, good attitude, but no need. / About this basket's worth of rations is enough.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_059.en:
Oh, right, sir...
Uh, I was on my way to the john, so...
I'll be goin' now...
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, is that so... / Ah, I'm on my way to the toilet, / so, I'll be going...

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_060.en:
Ga-ha-ha!
Holding it in's bad for your health,
merc.
If we get the chance, we'll meet again.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gahaha! / Holding it in is bad for your body, mercenary. / If there's a chance, let's meet again.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_061.en:
You know about the anti-air units
that've been knocking down friendly
supply transports lately?
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Do you know that lately surface-to-air units / targeting the materiel of allied transport planes / have been showing up?

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_062.en:
Yes.
Not a day of my leave went by
without it on the news.
They're making quite a show of it.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah. / During vacation, there wasn't a day I didn't hear / that news. / They seem to be doing it quite flashily.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_063.en:
The brass have located their main
force.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The upper echelons have grasped the main force's position.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_064.en:
Losing all that cargo has HQ
desperate, then.
Where are they?
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Their cargo stolen, headquarters is desperate, I suppose. / Is the place known?

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_065.en:
The site of an abandoned mining plant
in the Parunta Desert.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's the site of an already abandoned / mining plant in the Parunta Desert.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_066.en:
An anti-air unit.
Mostly anti-aircraft weapons, then.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The enemy is a surface-to-air unit. / Centered on anti-air forces.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_067.en:
Right.
Hit them by surprise under cover of
a sandstorm, and they're not much
of a threat.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_067.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / If you raid them taking advantage of a sandstorm, / they're not that scary an opponent.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_068.en:
And if we find stolen cargo or
containers?
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_068.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If there's stolen cargo / or containers?

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_069.en:
The mission is to wipe out the enemy,
but if you can manage it, recover
the stolen cargo.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_069.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The mission is annihilating the enemy, but if you have leeway, / I want you to recover the stolen cargo.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_070.en:
If it pays.
Roger.
We'll sortie once we're equipped.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_070.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If it leads to a reward. / Roger. / Sortieing as soon as equipment is ready.

MsgLabels_station_25_msg_071.en:
The mission is to wipe out the enemy,
but if you can manage it, recover
the stolen cargo.
MsgLabels_station_25_msg_071.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The mission is annihilating the enemy, but if you have leeway, / I want you to recover the stolen cargo.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_001.en: That looks like the old plant.
MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That seems to be the plant site.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The enemy unit's deployment?

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_003.en:
As expected, the unit is built around
surface-to-air weapons.
MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As expected, it seems to be a unit / centered on surface-to-air weapons.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_004.en: Not many of them, for a main force.
MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Small in number for a main force.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_005.en:
Probably got chewed up in their last
fight.
Either way, this one's a cakewalk.
MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: They must have been worn down a lot in the previous battle. / Anyway, isn't it an easy mission.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_006.en:
Anti-air gear won't do much against
wanzers.
MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Surface-to-air equipment has no effect / against WAPs.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units, beginning the mission.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_009.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Unidentified unit approaching! / ...That machine is...

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_012.en:
A black wanzer?
...Identifying...
No doubt about it.
It's the same type as the unit that
attacked our base!
Huh?
That machine's carrying a katana!!
MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A black WAP? / ...Identifying... / There seems to be no mistake. / It's the same type as the machines / of the unit that attacked the base! / Eh? / That machine is holding a katana!!

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_013.en: It seems to be operating alone.
MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems to be acting alone.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What do we do, Captain?

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_015.en:
Two enemies at once is trouble.
Avoid engaging that machine as far
as possible.
Focus on the mission.
MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Dealing with two enemies is troublesome. / Better to avoid engaging that machine / as much as possible. / We focus on the mission.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_017.en:
...I see. An obedient unit.
Let us see what you are capable of.
MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I see, an obedient unit. / Let me see your skill.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_018.en:
That machine...
It seems to be after the same
targets we are.
MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That machine... / It seems to be aiming at the same target / as us.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_019.en:
Huh. Then maybe we'll save some
ammo.
MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Heh, then maybe it's good since we save ammo.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_020.en:
No.
It won't hurt the operation, but
it'll cut into our pay.
MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No. / In the end it won't hinder the operation, but / our reward will be cut.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_022.en: That bastard... He's poachin' our kills!
MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That bastard... stealing our prey!

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Then it's a contest!

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You bet!

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Shall I leave it about here.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The black WAP is withdrawing.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_027.en: So he ducked out of a real slugfest...
MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It avoided a serious head-to-head fight...

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We continue to focus on the mission.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy surface-to-air unit silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Shall I leave it about here.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_031.en: The black wanzer is withdrawing too.
MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The black WAP is withdrawing too.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_032.en:
Still, that firepower...
And a katana... What a machine.
MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But that guy's firepower... / And a katana... unbelievable machine.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_033.en:
It's tuned differently from the ones
that attacked the base...
And that katana...
Or is it more of a sword...?
So cool...
MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems to have tuning different / from the type that attacked / the base... / Even so, that katana... / no, maybe a sword... / It's cool...

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_034.en:
It was after the same targets as us.
What's going on...?
Mission complete.
Returning to base.
MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It was aiming at the same target as us. / What does that mean... / Mission complete. / Returning to base now.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy surface-to-air unit silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_036.en:
Roger.
Any sign of the black wanzer?
MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Signatures of the black WAP?

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No signatures in the vicinity.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_038.en:
Still, that firepower...
And a katana...
What a machine.
MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But that guy's firepower... / And a katana... / unbelievable machine.

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_039.en:
It's tuned differently from the ones
that attacked the base...
And that katana...
Or is it more of a sword...?
So cool...
MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems to have tuning different / from the type that attacked / the base... / Even so, that katana... / no, maybe a sword... / It's cool...

MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_040.en:
It was after the same targets as us.
What's going on...?
Mission complete. Returning to base.
MsgLabels_tactics_25_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It was aiming at the same target as us. / What does that mean... / Mission complete. Returning to base now.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_001.en:
Captain, would you like to have lunch
together?
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, how about lunch together?

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_002.en: Sorry. I already had a ration.
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry, I already made do with rations.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_003.en:
Rations again...
By the way, what came of that enemy
from the last mission?
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rations again... / Come to think of it, what became of the enemy / from the previous mission?

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_004.en:
The Commander reported it up to the
brass.
I hear the regular army's
investigations department is on it.
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I had the Commander report that matter / to the upper echelons. / It seems the regular army's investigation department is moving on it.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_005.en:
So it didn't end with the unit that
attacked the base after all...
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As expected, it didn't end with / the unit that attacked the base...

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's how it is.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_007.en:
Then please join me for a meal
another time.
I could cook, if you like.
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Please join me for a meal next time. / If you like, I'll cook.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_008.en:
A mission, then.
Preparing to sortie.
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_009.en:
Hey, Captain, wanna eat some meat
with me?
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh, Captain, won't you eat meat with me?

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry, I've already eaten.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_011.en:
Aw, too bad.
Got some prime cuts sent from home
yesterday. I'm havin' the kitchen
grill 'em up right now.
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's a shame. / Top-grade meat came from home yesterday, / so I'm about to have them grill it in the kitchen.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_012.en:
Sounds good.
Let me join you tomorrow, then.
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That sounds tasty. / Let me join you tomorrow or so.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_013.en:
Thing is, I'm treatin' the hangar
guys who hauled the meat in, too.
If there's any left by tomorrow...
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The thing is, I'm treating the hangar staff / who carried the meat too. / If there's any left until tomorrow...

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_014.en:
I see.
Don't worry about it.
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / Don't worry about it.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Man, sorry, Captain.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Now, how should I grill it...

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_017.en:
We're movin' out?
All right -- let's go wild!
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie. / Alright, I'm gonna run wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, did you eat lunch?

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 10 minutes ago.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What did you eat?

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: MRE ration Type D.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_022.en:
Oh, that one!
The cocoa's secretly really good,
isn't it!
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, that type! / The cocoa is surprisingly tasty, right!

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_024.en:
I like the Type A beans and the
Type E noodles!
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I like Type A's beans / and Type E's noodles!

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_025.en:
The noodles aren't bad, I'll admit.
Oddeye, don't you eat regular meals?
Nobody here makes you live on
issue rations.
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Indeed, the noodles aren't bad. / Oddeye, don't you eat regular meals? / Here there's no need to force yourself / to eat the issued food.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_026.en:
I do eat them.
But there aren't many dishes I like
on this base's menu...
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I do eat them. / But this base's menu has / few dishes I like...

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_027.en:
Hm.
A ration habit isn't a bad thing for
a mercenary.
You have a lot of interests, it seems.
Rations included?
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hm. / Making rations a habit is / not bad for a mercenary. / Oddeye, you seem to have many hobbies, / and you seem to be particular about issued food too?

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_028.en:
Hehe.
You got me!
The Type E noodles especially taste
just like the ramen I had in Tokyo.
I could eat those every day.
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ehehe. / Actually, I am! / Especially the taste of Type E's noodles, / it's just like the ramen I ate / in Tokyo. / I could eat that every day.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_029.en:
I see.
Even I'd struggle with the same
ration every day.
You must really like them.
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / Even for me, the same ration every day / would be tough. / You must really like it.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_030.en:
I had ramen every single day on
my leave, too!
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even during the last vacation, / I ate it every day!

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_031.en:
Sigh.
I want to go back and eat more...
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Haah. / I want to go eat it again...

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_032.en:
Oh, we're sortieing?
I'll get ready!
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, a sortie, right. / I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_033.en:
Captain, if you haven't eaten yet,
want to join me?
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, if you haven't eaten yet, how about together?

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry, I've already eaten.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_035.en:
Oh, I see.
That was quick.
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, is that so. / That's early.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_036.en: Why not ask Rain or Champ?
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: How about inviting / Rain or Champ?

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_037.en:
...Eh, Rain's scary, and Champ keeps
nagging me to eat meat...
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Well, Miss Rain is scary, / and Champ is noisy about eating meat...

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Who's scary, you say?

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gray! Eat meat, meat!

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Uh-oh! It just slipped out...

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_041.en:
I will not be called scary!
If everyone just did their cleaning
and tidying properly, I wouldn't have
to say a word...
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Being feared is unexpected! / If everyone would properly do / the cleaning and tidying up, / I wouldn't say anything...

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_042.en:
Gray.
People are difficult, aren't they.
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gray. / Dealing with people is hard too.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_043.en: I didn't think they'd hear me...
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I didn't think those two would hear.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_045.en:
(That wanzer last time was after the
same targets, yet it never really
fought us.
What was it actually after...?
And the brass say they'll look into it,
but they still won't treat it as
a case...)
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (That wanzer last time, / though our goal was the same, it didn't / properly fight. / What was its real aim...? / And the upper echelons say they'll investigate, but / as expected they won't treat it as an incident...)

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_046.en:
(Everyone relaxes more than
necessary at mealtimes.)
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Everyone relaxes more than necessary / at mealtime.)

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_048.en:
Heard the OCU Navy's got a big
exercise comin' up.
...You don't suppose they're startin'
another war on this island, do ya?
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Seems there's a large-scale exercise / in the O.C.U. Navy. / ...Maybe war's going to start / again on this island.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_049.en:
Shresh has been brooding a lot since
Peter died.
Maybe it finally hit him that even
the maintenance crew's on a
battlefield.
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Since Peter died, Thresh seems / to be thinking about a lot of things. / Even though he's maintenance, / maybe he realized he's on a battlefield.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_050.en:
...Eating this much......
making a big fuss...
I'm going to shit fury.....
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL). Since edited by a person.
Literal: ...Eating meat... / making a big fuss... is this the time for that, for about an hour...

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_051.en:
The Arena...
Put simply, it's wanzer battles you
bet on...
We've had a request from its
organizing committee.
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The Arena... / Simply put, it's betting battles / with wanzers, but... / a request came in from its executive committee.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_052.en:
That thing the whole island's been
talking about?
We take jobs from people like that?
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That thing that's been the talk of the island lately. / You take requests from places like that too?

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_053.en:
Hm.
Wanzer parts makers, army scouts and
Huffman's local government all have
a stake in the Arena business.
On paper it's a committee request,
but really it's the same as an army
order.
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hm. / In the Arena business, WAP parts manufacturers, / army scouts, Huffman's local governments, / all their intentions are concentrated. / It's nominally a request from the committee, but / in reality it's the same as an order from the army.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_055.en:
Lately someone's been attacking
wanzers entered in the Arena.
They want you lot to track down
these thugs and take them out.
Witnesses say the culprits are a wanzer
team of four or five machines.
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Lately Arena-entry WAPs are apparently / being attacked by someone. / So they want you to find the lawless rascals / and eliminate them. / Also, according to eyewitness testimony, the culprits are / a WAP squad of 4 to 5 units.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_056.en:
Hm.
If they're going after Arena wanzers,
they must be very good, or very
heavily armed... I'd guess.
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hm. / Targeting Arena WAPs means they're / either extremely skilled, or fortified with powerful equipment... / one can surmise.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_057.en:
Right. Going by the scraps of intel,
there's a good chance it's the same
lot that attacked the base.
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. Judging from fragments of information, / there's a high possibility they're the same as / the unit that attacked the base before.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_058.en:
Roger.
We'll sortie once we're equipped.
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Sortieing as soon as equipment is ready.

MsgLabels_station_26_msg_059.en:
Someone's attacking Arena-entered
wanzers.
I want you to track down these thugs
and take them out.
MsgLabels_station_26_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Arena-entry WAPs are being attacked / by someone. / So I want you to find the lawless rascals / and eliminate them.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_001.en:
This is the materials yard for the
arena under construction.
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is the materials yard / of the Arena under construction.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_002.en:
Hm?
Are those Arena wanzers?
There are a few of them.
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hm? / Are those Arena WAPs, there are a few.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_003.en:
Ooh!
Now those are Arena wanzers.
So flashy!
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ooh. / As expected of WAPs entering the Arena. / So flashy!

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_004.en:
Heh, they look like fighters before
a bout.
Maybe I'll enter myself sometime.
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ho, just like martial artists / before a match. / Maybe I'll enter next time too.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_005.en:
They've even got corporate emblems
painted on.
Like race cars with legs.
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: They have corporate emblems written / on the machines too. / WAPs like racing machines.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy signatures?

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_007.en:
Hmm~.
Nothing just now... wait, huh?
I've got a signal!
It's a black wanzer!
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm. / What was that just now... wait, huh? / There's a signature! / It's a black WAP's signature!

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_008.en:
What?...
The Arena wanzers are under attack!
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh?... / The Arena WAPs are being attacked!

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_009.en:
That's two down.
Huh?
They've still got guard wanzers?
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 2 units shot down. / Hm? / There are still guard WAPs...

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Fast...

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_011.en:
Arena wanzers are supposed to be tuned
up...
And they took them down that easily...
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Arena WAPs are supposed to be / tuned... / To destroy them that easily...

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_012.en:
Damn.
Five of 'em, huh...
Now I'm gettin' pissed off!
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Damn. / 5 enemy units... / I'm getting kind of pissed off!

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_013.en:
All right. We take them down before
any more Arena wanzers get hurt.
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good, we shoot them down before any more damage / comes to the Arena WAPs.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Of course, roger! / Here I go!

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_015.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_017.en:
Tch, these moves ain't no security
guards!
It's a merc unit... Merc-hunting
ain't even my job, dammit!
Ogre team here...
Requesting Numbers backup...
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Tch, these movements aren't some / guard WAPs! / It's a mercenary unit... geez, hunting mercenaries / isn't even my job! / This is Ogre Squad... / requesting Numbers reinforcements...

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_018.en:
Ogre, what is the matter?
My machine appears to be the closest
to your position.
I am on my way.
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ogre, what's the matter? / My machine seems to be the closest / to your position. / Heading there at once.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Dark Knight, huh... / S-sorry...

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_020.en:
Enemy reinforcements confirmed.
Another black wanzer.
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy reinforcement confirmed. / Likewise a black WAP.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_021.en:
That katana...
I've seen that machine before.
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That katana... / A machine we've seen once.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_022.en:
(...So this time it is chance.)
Ogre. What have you been doing?
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (...Is it a coincidence this time.) / Ogre, what were you doing.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_023.en:
Hey...
Nobody said nothin' about mercs
guardin' 'em!
My team can't take any more of this!!
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No... / I didn't hear that a mercenary unit / would be guarding! / Our squad can't do any more!!

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enough. / You fall back.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_025.en:
...B-but we ain't bagged an Arena
pilot yet today!
You handle the mercs, Dark Knight!
My team'll grab the Arena machines!
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...B-but, we haven't captured / an Arena pilot yet today! / Dark Knight's unit, take care of the mercenary unit! / Our squad will capture the Arena units!

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm telling you to fall back.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Kh. / I can't go back empty-handed!

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_028.en:
(Ogre, you fool...
You do not intend to return.
...Very well.
As a wanzer pilot, I shall test my own
skill as well.)
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (That Ogre... / does he not intend to return. / ...Well, fine. / As a WAP rider myself, / let me test my skill.)

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wh-what?

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_030.en:
Are they... fighting each other,
or something...?
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Infighting? / Or something...?

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_031.en:
Either way, we've still got one more
tough enemy on our hands.
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Whatever it is, it doesn't change that / the number of strong enemies has increased.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_032.en:
Hold him off while we hit the unit
that attacked the Arena.
All units, don't let them escape.
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: While engaging that guy, we hit the unit / that attacked the Arena. / All units, don't let the enemy escape.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's ridiculous...!

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_035.en:
Ogre...
So this is what comes of ignoring
the order to return...
Though going back empty-handed would
have ended the same.
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ogre... / So this is the result of ignoring the return order... / But it would have been the same if you'd returned empty-handed.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Dark Knight... help me! / Guwaaaaah!!

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_037.en:
(...A worthy opponent.
It seems I have been granted a fine
battle.)
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (...The response was plenty. / It seems I was given a good battle to experience.)

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_038.en:
Ah, the katana guy's pulling out,
you know?
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, that katana user is withdrawing, ya know?

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What was that about...

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_040.en: That machine fights like a samurai...
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A machine like a warrior...

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_041.en:
Hmph.
Anytime you want a rematch, pal!
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmph. / I'll take you on anytime!

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The ringleader's WAP silenced. / No reinforcements either.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_043.en:
Roger.
The culprits have been eliminated.
Looks like the mission's complete.
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Succeeded in eliminating the culprits. / It seems the mission is complete.

MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_044.en:
(He slipped past my attacks and
wiped out Ogre's team...
Such power... Heh heh heh.)
MsgLabels_tactics_26_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Slipping through my attacks, / they annihilated the Ogre Squad... / This power... heh heh heh.)

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_001.en: Captain, do you use the base ARENA?
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, do you use the base's arena?

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_002.en:
Now and then.
It's good training, and a change
of pace.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Once in a while. / It serves as training and a change of pace too.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_003.en:
That's true.
We saw one on our last mission:
the major cities on Huffman are
all building big Arena stadiums.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's true. / We also went in the last mission, but / in Huffman's major cities, / large-scale fighting arenas, Arenas, / are being built.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_004.en:
Apparently the rules are almost the
same as the base ARENA.
Still, an entertainment venue built
around wanzers...
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The rules seem to be almost the same as the base arena. / But an entertainment facility using WAPs...

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_005.en:
If private companies run places like
the Arena, it might shake off the
wanzer's image as a weapon of war.
That could be a happier fate for
them, don't you think?
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If private companies run facilities like / the Arena, the image of weapons for war / will be wiped away, and for WAPs / that might be happiness.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_006.en:
I see.
That's one way to look at it.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / You can look at it that way too.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_007.en:
If private companies run places like
the Arena, it might shake off the
wanzer's image as a weapon of war.
That could be a happier fate for
them, don't you think?
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If private companies run facilities like / the Arena, the image of weapons for war / will be wiped away, and for WAPs / that might be happiness.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_008.en:
A mission, then.
Preparing to sortie.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_009.en:
Captain, I'm headin' over to the
ARENA for a bit.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, I'm going to the arena / for a bit now.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You're enthusiastic.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_011.en:
Trainin' for the civilian Arena.
The fight money's pretty sweet.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's training to participate in / a private Arena. / You can earn quite a fight purse.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh, sounds quite interesting.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_013.en:
Word is a lot of the entry wanzers
have real good pilots.
Why don't you sign up too, Captain?
For me, it's the crowd, the buzz in
there... nothin' else like it.
Aight, I'm off!
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Among the entry WAPs, there are apparently / lots of skilled guys. / Captain, how about you participate too? / In my case, the atmosphere of the venue, / that exhilaration is indescribable. / Well then, I'm off!

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_014.en:
Don't let it get in the way of
your duties.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Make sure it doesn't hinder missions.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_015.en: Aight, I'm off to the base ARENA!
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well then, I'm off to the base arena!

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_016.en:
What, we're movin' out?
Fine -- I'll go wild out there instead!
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What, a sortie. / Alright, I'll run wild there!

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_017.en:
Oh, Captain, I've got a question about
wanzer one-on-ones...
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Captain, there's something I want to ask / about WAP 1-on-1...

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 1-on-1... the arena?

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_019.en:
Yes, exactly.
My machine is set up mainly for
long range, but I can't decide!
Should I keep a sharp, pure
long-range build, or cover my blind
spots up close and go all-rounder?
I've been agonizing over it...
Which do you think is better?
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. Exactly. / My unit's settings are / long-range focused, but / I'm totally torn about whether it's better / to keep a lopsided long-range spec setting, / or to eliminate blind spots at close range / and make it all-round... / Captain, which do you think is better?

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_020.en:
...In real combat, you work with
the rest of us.
A bit of specialization pays off there.
But fighting alone may be a different
story.
If you can use your skills reliably,
though, you can expect a one-sided
fight.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...In real combat, coordination with us is a given. / Being a little lopsided is probably effective. / But in solo combat, / it might be a different story. / If you can use your skills reliably, / you can expect a one-sided battle.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_021.en:
I see~.
It really is deep!
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I seee~. / It's deep after all!

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_022.en:
Should I keep a sharp, pure
long-range build, or cover my blind
spots up close and go all-rounder?
I've been agonizing over it...
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm totally torn about whether a lopsided long-range spec / setting is better, or eliminating blind spots / at close range and making it all-round / is better...

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_023.en:
Oh, we're sortieing?
I'll get ready!
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, a sortie, right. / I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_024.en: Captain, do you use the ARENA?
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, do you use the arena?

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_025.en:
Now and then.
It's good training, and a change
of pace.
It seems to be catching on in
our squad.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Once in a while. / It serves as training and a change of pace too. / It seems to be popular in our squad.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_026.en:
It's a pretty good system, the ARENA.
Maybe it's from seeing that flashy
civilian Arena the other day, but
everyone's really fired up.
If that catches on, it could change
the whole wanzer industry.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The arena is quite a good system. / Maybe because we saw the private, showy / Arena the other day, everyone / is motivated. / If that catches on, the WAP industry / might change.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_027.en:
True.
With private companies behind it,
wanzer parts technology and piloting
skills should both improve.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / Through the power of private companies, WAP parts / technology development and WAP piloting skills / will probably improve.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_028.en:
The Arena's entry pilots, the really
good ones anyway, might get scouted
by the army.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Arena entry pilots, / especially high-level ones, / might get scouted by the army.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_029.en:
It's possible.
Even a merc who runs out of work on
the battlefield might keep fed by
entering the Arena.
Looked at that way, it works in our
favor too.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That could happen. / Even if mercenaries run out of work on the battlefield, / if they enter the Arena / they might not struggle to eat. / Depending on how you look at it, it's / convenient for us too.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_030.en:
It's nothing like real combat, but
it's the same wanzers at heart.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's completely different from real combat, but / fundamentally it's the same WAP.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_031.en:
It's a pretty good system, the ARENA.
With these flashy civilian Arenas,
the wanzer industry's bound to change.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The arena is quite a good system. / Thanks to the private, showy Arena, / the WAP industry will change from now on.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_033.en:
Think about it.
Why're they shippin' mountains of
weapons and food here from home?
This base could never eat all that.
And the weapons... there's enough to
wipe out a USN base or two on this
island, every last man.
I'm tellin' ya, somethin's up.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Think about it. / For what reason are mountains / of weapons and food sent from the home country? / This base could never eat all the food. / And the weapons... there's enough to / wipe out one or two of this island's U.S.N. / bases. / It's definitely sketchy.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_034.en:
The Arena's great, isn't it?
The sound of machine slamming into
machine... can't get enough of it.
By the way, I hear the prize money
for the base ARENA comes from the
Arena committee.
Rumor is, they want us to train on
that system and then enter the Arena.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The Arena's great. / The sound of machines clashing with machines / is irresistible. / Come to think of it, the base arena's prize money / apparently comes from the Arena committee. / Rumor has it they're scheming / for people to practice with that system / and enter the Arena.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_035.en:
...Come to think of it...
I never got... a souvenir from
Oddeye...
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Come to think of it... / I didn't get... Oddeye's souvenir...

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Prevent Arena bombing

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rescue journalist

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Accept

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hear about another operation

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rescue journalist

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Accept

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hear about another operation

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Prevent Arena bombing

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Prevent Arena bombing

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rescue journalist

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_046.en:
Two urgent missions just came in.
One: stop a bombing at the Arena.
Two: rescue a team of journalists.
Whichever you pass on goes to
another unit.
So pick whichever you like, no need
to worry about the other.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Two urgent missions came in. / One is preventing the Arena bombing. / The other is rescuing a journalist. / The mission that's left over is arranged / to go to a separate unit. / You can choose a mission / without worrying.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_047.en:
Stopping the Arena bombing, then.
You know Arena construction is wrapping
up all over the island?
The anti-Arena groups aren't taking it
quietly.
Things were always tense, but now
they've finally turned to force.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Preventing the Arena bombing... it is. / You know Arena construction work / is finishing in various places? / It seems the anti-Arena forces / won't stay silent about it. / Their relationship was originally uneasy, but they've finally / resorted to force.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_048.en:
Anti-Arena groups turning to force...
Those groups opposing the damage the
stadiums do to the environment?
I thought they were a peaceful lot.
What are they threatening to do?
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Use of force by the anti-Arena forces... / The group opposed to environmental destruction / from stadium construction. / I thought it was a clean group, / what are they saying they'll do?

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_049.en:
Mm.
The Arena organizing committee just
received a bomb threat.
Get to the site fast and stop it from
going off.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm. / A bombing notice came to the Arena executive committee / just now. / I want you to rush to the site and prevent the bombing.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...A "clean group," what a joke.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_051.en:
Their gear's outdated, but the
anti-Arena groups have wanzers too,
apparently.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems the anti-Arena forces have WAPs deployed too, / though their equipment is old-fashioned.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_052.en: Not much of a fighting force, then.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Their strength isn't that much... huh.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_053.en:
Seems not.
A bomb disposal team is going with
you. Disarm the planted bombs with
their disposal vehicle while you
wipe out the enemy wanzers.
But they're desperate. Enemy
reinforcements are possible.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So it seems. / This time a bomb disposal team will accompany you. / Neutralize the planted bombs with the / explosive disposal vehicles while driving out the enemy WAPs. / But they're desperate too. Depending on the situation, / enemy reinforcements are also conceivable.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_054.en:
A bomb threat means we don't have
much time.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A bombing notice means there isn't much time / left.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_055.en:
Going by the deadline they gave, if
you head out now you'll have about
15 turns to work with.
Will you take this mission?
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Considering the time in the notice, if you head to the site / now, the time allowed for the work / will be about 15 turns. / Will you accept this mission?

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_056.en:
We'll take it.
There's no time before it goes off.
This one's urgent.
We sortie at once.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll accept. / There's no time until the bombing. / It seems urgent. / Sortieing at once.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What's the other mission?

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_058.en:
Rescuing the journalists, then.
Three days ago, a team of journalists
went silent in territory we control.
But this morning we picked up a
distress signal from their vehicle.
I want you to bring them out.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rescuing a journalist... it is. / 3 days ago, in our army's governed district, / a journalist team / lost contact. / But this morning we caught a distress signal / from their vehicle. / I want you to carry out the rescue / of that journalist team.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_059.en:
This needs wanzers?
Sending a vehicle or a chopper to
pick them up seems smarter.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is it a mission that needs WAPs? / Sending a vehicle or helicopter to pick them up / seems smarter.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_060.en:
It's our territory, but there are
reports of armed guerrillas sighted
in the area the signal's coming from.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even if it's the governed district, in the area / where the distress signal is being transmitted, / reports have come in that armed guerrillas / have been sighted.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_061.en: That sort are still roaming around?
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Are such types still showing up.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_062.en:
It never hurts to have journalists
and the press on our side.
Get out there and help them, fast.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Journalists and the media, / there's no loss in having them on our side. / I want you to head out to the rescue immediately.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_063.en:
Say we secure the journalists. Do they
have a way out?
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Assuming we secure the journalist team, / is there a means of transport?

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_064.en:
Their vehicle seems to be drivable.
The signal's on the move.
Just get that vehicle to the extraction
point.
Will you take this mission?
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The journalist team's vehicle / seems able to move. / Apparently there's movement in the signal. / Just deliver that vehicle / to the escape point. / Will you accept this mission?

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_065.en:
We'll take it.
The press may well be the greatest
weapon of all...
This one's urgent. We sortie at once.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll accept. / Indeed the media / could be called the greatest weapon... / It seems urgent. Sortieing at once.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What's the other mission?

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_067.en:
Both are urgent, but whichever you
pass on goes to another unit.
One: stop a bombing at the Arena.
Two: rescue a team of journalists.
Pick whichever you like, no need to
worry about the other.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_067.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Both are urgent missions, but / the mission that's left over is arranged / to go to a separate unit. / One is preventing the Arena bombing. / The other is rescuing a journalist. / Choose a mission without worrying.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_068.en:
We'll take it.
There's no time before it goes off.
This one's urgent.
We sortie at once.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_068.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll accept. / There's no time until the bombing. / It seems urgent. / Sortieing at once.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_069.en:
I see.
The press may well be the greatest
weapon of all...
This one's urgent. We sortie at once.
MsgLabels_station_27_msg_069.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / Indeed the media / could be called the greatest weapon... / It seems urgent. Sortieing at once.

MsgLabels_station_27_msg_070.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hurry. / I wish you luck.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_001.en:
Anti-Arena forces sighted.
Five wanzers, old models.
MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Found the anti forces. / 5 WAPs, old models.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_002.en:
Where's the bomb?
Can we even search for it from a
wanzer...? Wait, don't tell me that
container's...?
MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Where are the planted bombs? / Can we even search for them / while riding WAPs... wait, / don't tell me those containers?

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_003.en:
Yes.
That container is most likely the
time bomb.
MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm. / Those containers are probably time bombs.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_004.en:
Oh, you're right.
I'm picking up a timer signal.
MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, it's true. / There was a timer device signature.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Then that makes it quick.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_006.en:
To the bomb disposal team.
The container is a time bomb.
Request you disarm it.
MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: To the explosive disposal team. / The containers are time bombs. / Please dispose of them.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_007.en:
Roger.
We'll close on the container and take
out the timer.
Cover us.
MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / We'll approach the containers and destroy / the timer devices. / Requesting cover.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_008.en:
Roger.
We'll escort the bomb disposal team
and wipe out the enemy machines.
MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / While escorting the explosive disposal team, / we'll annihilate the enemy units.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_010.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units
or disarm all the bombs.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies or / dispose of all bombs. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, enemy reinforcements.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Reinforcements confirmed.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_014.en: Old junk, but a whole lotta it.
MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Old models, but quite a number.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Disposal vehicle hit.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_016.en:
Damn. Without the disposal vehicle,
we can't disarm the time bombs...
MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Tch, if the disposal vehicles are gone, / we can't defuse the time bombs...

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_017.en:
Worst case, we smash the container
with a wanzer?
MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Worst case, destroy the containers with WAPs?

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_018.en:
That's enough explosive to level a
building, you know?
Do that and every last one of us gets
blown to pieces.
MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: These are explosives on a scale that destroys buildings, ya know? / If you do that, everyone without exception gets blown up.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_019.en:
Rain, can you get another disposal
vehicle sent?
MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain, can you arrange disposal vehicles?

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_020.en:
They say they can send one.
But losing a vehicle apparently means
a penalty on our expenses...
MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems arranging vehicles is possible. / But apparently losing vehicles incurs / a penalty to expenses...

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_021.en:
Ugh.
I ain't workin' at a loss...
MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Kh. / No deficits for me...

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_022.en:
If you want to get paid, protect
the disposal vehicle.
MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It means if you want the reward, escort / the disposal vehicles.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All timer devices destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_024.en:
Remaining enemy forces are disarming.
Looks like they're surrendering.
MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Remaining enemy forces disarming; they seem to be surrendering.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission complete. / Returning to base now.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
