Literal: Enemy anti forces silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_027.en:
Roger.
The rest is up to the disposal team.
MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / We have no choice but to leave the rest to the disposal team.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain... / The timer devices are activating!

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Uh-oh...

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_030.en:
We took too long.
All units, withdraw from the area now.
Don't get caught in the blast.
MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Did we take too much time. / All units, withdraw from this area immediately. / Don't get caught in the explosion.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 1 turn left until the facility explodes.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 2 turns left until the facility explodes.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 3 turns left until the facility explodes.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 4 turns left until the facility explodes.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 5 turns left until the facility explodes.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 6 turns left until the facility explodes.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 7 turns left until the facility explodes.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 8 turns left until the facility explodes.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 9 turns left until the facility explodes.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 10 turns left until the facility explodes.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 11 turns left until the facility explodes.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 12 turns left until the facility explodes.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 13 turns left until the facility explodes.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 14 turns left until the facility explodes.

MsgLabels_tactics_27_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 15 turns left until the facility explodes.

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_001.en:
Oh?
So Champ got into the Arena.
MsgLabels_station_28_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Heh. / Champ was able to enter the Arena.

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_002.en:
Champ's used to big fights.
He might go further than anyone
expects, don't you think?
MsgLabels_station_28_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ is probably used to big matches, / so maybe he'll go surprisingly / far?

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_003.en:
It was the Striker division,
wasn't it? So he got leave!
MsgLabels_station_28_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Was it the Striker division? / He was able to get vacation.

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_004.en:
With that match schedule he needed
a decent block of time, so he put in
for leave with the Captain and the
Commander. Figured it was a long shot.
...Oh, Captain.
MsgLabels_station_28_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Judging from the match schedule, he needs / a good block of time, so he applied for vacation / to the Captain and Commander, expecting nothing. / Oh, Captain...

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: About Champ?

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_006.en:
Yes! It'd be so great if one of our
own became a champion!
MsgLabels_station_28_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, I'd be happy if a champion / came from among our comrades!

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_007.en:
Uh, Oddeye...
Champ already IS a champ.
Of fighting.
MsgLabels_station_28_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hey hey, Oddeye, / Champ is already / a champ of martial arts...

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_008.en:
But that's at human level, right?
A wanzer champion is way cooler.
MsgLabels_station_28_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's human level, right? / A wanzer champion is way cooler / after all.

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_009.en:
"Human level"...
What about all of Champ's hard work
and glory...?
MsgLabels_station_28_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Human level... / What on earth are Champ's efforts and glory...

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_010.en:
If fighting in the Arena sharpens
his wanzer combat skills, the squad
benefits too. I gave Champ the OK.
MsgLabels_station_28_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If entering the Arena leads to improving / WAP combat technique, it's a merit for the squad too. / I've given Champ permission.

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_011.en:
Go, Champ!
Win it all and become the one true
Champ!
MsgLabels_station_28_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Go Champ! / Win and become the true Champ!

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ, do your best.

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_013.en:
What? Champ...?
Understood.
I'll prepare to sortie...
MsgLabels_station_28_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? Champ is...? / Understood. / I'll prepare to sortie...

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_014.en:
Go, Champ!
Win it all and become the one true
Champ!
MsgLabels_station_28_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Go Champ! / Win and become the true Champ!

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_015.en:
What!? Champ is...!?
I'll get ready right away!
MsgLabels_station_28_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eeh! Champ is...!? / I'll get ready at once!

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_016.en:
Knowing Champ, he could go pretty
far.
MsgLabels_station_28_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ seems like he could go / surprisingly far.

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_017.en:
What could've happened to Champ...
Preparing to sortie.
MsgLabels_station_28_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What happened to Champ... / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_018.en:
Captain, hear me out.
This OCU Navy exercise is a cover.
They're usin' it to ship even more
supplies onto the island.
A buddy of mine in Barinden says
the port's in an uproar, so there's
no doubt about it.
I'm tellin' ya, a war's coming.
MsgLabels_station_28_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, listen for a sec. / The upcoming O.C.U. Navy exercise / is camouflage. / Taking advantage of the exercise, they intend to carry / even more materiel to this island. / An acquaintance in Ballinden / said the port is in an uproar, / so there's no mistake. / This, for sure, war is going to start.

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_019.en:
Shresh, calm down...
And quit spraying spit everywhere.
Oh, no Champ today?
Huh?
He's fighting in the Arena?
I had no idea.
Man, I'd have loved to see that.
MsgLabels_station_28_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thresh, calm down... / Don't spray spit like that. / Oh, Champ's not here today. / Eh? / He's competing in the Arena? / I didn't know. / I wanted to see that match.

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_020.en:
......Even I can't... keep up with
...Shresh......
...Maybe I'll go look at...
the Keen Saber... in the hangar...
MsgLabels_station_28_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ......As expected, even I... can't keep up / with Thresh...... / ...Maybe I'll go look at... the Keen Saber / that came into the hangar...

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00»...

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You look glum, did something happen?

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_023.en:
You've heard Champ entered the
Arena while on leave?
MsgLabels_station_28_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Have you heard that Champ took part / in the Arena during his vacation?

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Did Champ get into some trouble?

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_025.en:
After his Arena bout, he went
missing, wanzer and all.
He's a fine merc these days...
I want to know if he got caught up
in these missing-machine cases, or
if he deserted.
MsgLabels_station_28_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: After fighting in the Arena, / he went missing, WAP and all. / He's an excellent mercenary now... / I want to make clear whether he got caught up in / that non-returning unit incident, / or whether it's desertion.

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_026.en:
Champ...
Do we have any leads?
MsgLabels_station_28_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ... / But are there any leads?

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_027.en:
We do.
Because of the missing machines,
I've had every wanzer in this unit
fitted with a transmitter that gives
off a special ID signal. You knew that.
Go to the area where we last picked
up his signal.
There may be some clue there.
MsgLabels_station_28_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm. / Because of the non-returning unit incidents, / you know I've had transmitters emitting a special / identification signal fitted / to our squad's wanzers? / Go to this area where we / last received the signal. / There might be some lead.

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_028.en:
Hm?
The speed of this signal...
No sign of panic.
If anything, it's moving in step
with something...
Right. Either way, we'll check that
area.
MsgLabels_station_28_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hm? / This signal's movement speed... / there's no sign of panic. / Rather, it seems to be moving / in step with something... / Good, anyway, let's go to that area.

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm counting on you.

MsgLabels_station_28_msg_030.en:
Go to the area where we last picked
up his signal.
There may be some clue there.
MsgLabels_station_28_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Go to the area where we last received / the signal. / There might be some lead.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...What's wrong, Monk? / Trouble?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_002.en:
Nothin'.
You stay on standby.
Cuttin' the line.
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's nothing. / You continue standing by. / Cutting communications.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_004.en:
Now then... Hey, you! That wanzer!
You were in a match at the Arena
just now, weren't ya?
That's His Highness the Champion
in there, ain't it?
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Now then... hey, you there, wanzer! / You were in a match at the Arena earlier, right. / Riding it is the Mr. Champion, isn't it?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_005.en:
Figured you'd made me...
Thought I saw you at the Arena...
And you're in a black machine,
of all things!
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So you noticed me after all... / Thought I saw you at the Arena... / and of all things, the black unit!

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_006.en:
Some champion up and retired on his
own, see... then the shows went
downhill and I got the axe.
And right when I was about to beat
you and pack the house!
Ain't that right, Stan!?
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Over here, because some Mr. Champion / retired on his own... the shows ended up / going downhill and I got restructured. / Just when I was gonna beat you / and liven things up! / Right, Stan!!

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_007.en:
Hmph. A guy like you never stood a
chance against me in the ring!
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmph, someone like you could never / beat me in a match!

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_008.en:
That's ancient history!
Now we meet again, as enemies.
Let's settle this in our wanzers!
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's all old history! / Now we've met again here as enemies. / I'll settle it with WAPs!

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_009.en:
...You can't beat me there either.
I'll wrap this fight up quick, then
you're answering some questions!
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...That's impossible for you too. / I'll finish this fight quickly / and make you tell me all sorts of things!

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_010.en:
Still runnin' your mouth like it's
mic time, huh!
That joke won't get any laughs.
And get this: this prototype knuckle,
the Destroyer, ain't no ordinary
piece of kit!«g:24»
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Your mic performance / is the same as ever! / But that won't get any laughs. / And another thing, this prototype knuckle, / the Destroyer, isn't ordinary!

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_011.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_013.en:
Champ's wanzer located.
...It appears to be engaging a black
machine.
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ's unit found. / ...It seems to be engaged with a black machine.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_014.en: Hey, Champ, what are you doing!?
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hey, Champ, what are you doing!

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_015.en:
Tch, company...
(Hm? Looks like the squad that's got
the higher-ups all worked up...
So Stan's one of theirs...)
Hey, Stan. Don't let 'em spoil our
one-on-one, got it?
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Kh, there's interference... / (Hm? Seems to be the unit / making a stir among the higher-ups... / So Stan's one of them too...) / Hey Stan, don't go throwing cold water / on a single battle, okay?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_016.en:
So the whole squad was out lookin'
for me...
Well, yeah, 'course you were...
Sorry, Captain!
I ran into somebody I know...
And he was ridin' a black machine.
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Everyone in the squad was looking for me... / Well, of course they were... / Captain, sorry! / I ran into an acquaintance... / and that guy was riding / a black machine.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_017.en:
Roger.
You can explain later.
Do you need help?
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / I'll hear the details later. / So, do you need help?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_018.en:
Nah, I got this.
This guy needs a lesson, and it's
gotta come from my own fists!
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, I'm fine. / I have to make this guy understand / with my fists directly!

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_019.en:
Hmph, gonna give me a show, huh?
Then in return, I'll set your pals
up with the Arena wanzers I hired.«g:24»
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmph, you're gonna give me a show? / Then, as a substitute, / I'll assign the Arena WAPs I hired / to your comrades.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_020.en:
I see.
I understand the situation.
The rest of us will clear out
anything that resists.
Champ, focus on your fight.
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / I've grasped the situation. / The main force will exterminate resisting units. / Champ, concentrate on the fight to your heart's content.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh... yes.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_022.en:
That's the Captain... I owe ya.
Champ, goin' in!
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As expected of the Captain... I owe you. / Champ's unit, here I go!

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_023.en:
Can't beat you even in a wanzer...
I...
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I can't beat you even with WAPs... / me...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_024.en:
...I kept off your cockpit.
You can move, right, Ox?
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I missed the cockpit for you. / You can move, right? Ox.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_025.en:
Yeah, I'm alright.
But now they know who I am.
If I go back to the organization,
I'm a dead man...
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah, I'm fine. / But my identity got exposed. / This way even if I go back to the organization, I'm a dead man...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_026.en:
Hmph.
Don't worry. We'll do right by you.
Come with us.
You're a merc too, ain't ya?
I'll introduce you to a new boss.
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmph. / Don't worry. With us, we won't treat you badly. / Come with us. / You're a mercenary too, right? / I'll introduce you to a new boss.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_027.en:
Now that's nice to hear.
But my contract fee ain't cheap,
ya know?
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You're saying things that make me happy. / But my contract fee is expensive, ya know?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_028.en:
Hey, Ox, don't push your luck!
Jeez... same as ever.
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hey, Ox, / don't get carried away! / Geez... same as ever.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_029.en:
...Well, since it's you, Champ,
I'll give 'em the bargain rate.
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Well, this time, out of respect for Champ, / it's a bargain price.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_030.en:
Ox...!?
The Ox Warrior...?
Now that's one heck of a matchup.
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ox...!? / That Ox Warrior... / Isn't that an amazing matchup.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_031.en:
Oh, is he the one from Champ's fight
footage before?
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, the person who was in Champ's match / video before?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So it seems.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_033.en:
Alright, Ox.
Back to base, and we drink. Yeah?
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Alright, Ox. / Let's go back to base and drink, okay?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_034.en: Jeez, still a booze hound, huh...
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Geez, still loving booze as always...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_035.en:
Hah... hah...
I finally beat you...
But this machine's had it too...
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Haa, haa. / I finally beat you... / But my machine's at its limit too...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_036.en:
...Not bad at all.
Guess this side always suited
you better.
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Isn't that good skill. / So you were better suited to this.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_037.en:
Hey, Stan?
You can bail out, right?
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hey, Stan? / You can escape, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_038.en:
Yeah, no problem.
Got my squad here, too.
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah, no problem. / I have comrades too.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_039.en:
But now they know who I am.
If I go back to the organization,
I'm a dead man...
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But my identity got exposed. / This way even if I go back to the organization, I'm a dead man...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_040.en:
We'll do right by you.
Come with us.
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We won't treat you badly. / Come with us.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_041.en:
I'm fond of breathin' too.
I'll do like you say.
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I value my life too. / I'll do as you say.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_043.en:
But now they know who I am.
If I go back to the organization,
I'm a dead man...
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But my identity got exposed. / This way even if I go back to the organization, I'm a dead man...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_044.en:
Hmph. Don't worry.
We'll do right by you.
Come with us.
You're a merc too, ain't ya?
I'll introduce you to a new boss.
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmph. Don't worry. / With us, we won't treat you badly. / Come with us. / You're a mercenary too, right? / I'll introduce you to a new boss.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_045.en:
Now that's nice to hear.
But my contract fee ain't cheap,
ya know?
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You're saying things that make me happy. / But my contract fee is expensive, ya know?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_046.en:
Hey, Ox, don't push your luck!
Jeez... same as ever.
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hey, Ox, / don't get carried away! / Geez... same as ever.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_047.en:
...Well, since it's you, Champ,
I'll give 'em the bargain rate.
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Well, this time, out of respect for Champ, / it's a bargain price.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_048.en:
Ox...!?
The Ox Warrior...?
Now that's one heck of a matchup.
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ox...!? / That Ox Warrior... / Isn't that an amazing matchup.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_049.en:
Oh, is he the one from Champ's fight
footage before?
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, the person who was in Champ's match / video before?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So it seems.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_051.en:
Alright, Ox.
Back to base, and we drink. Yeah?
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Alright, Ox. / Let's go back to base and drink, okay?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_052.en: Jeez, still a booze hound, huh...
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Geez, still loving booze as always...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Betrayal after all... / Disposing of him.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Guwaaaah!

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hey! What the!? / ...Ox!!

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_056.en:
Captain!
Champ's opponent was attacked by
his own side...
A direct hit on the cockpit!
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain! / Champ's opponent / was attacked by his comrade... / Direct hit to the cockpit!

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ox...!? / N-no way...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_058.en:
This is X-17 Manticore.
X-12 displayed suspicious behavior.
Judged as betrayal. Eliminated.
Recovering X-12's wreckage and
returning to base.
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is X-17 Manticore. / X-12 showed suspicious movements. / Judged it as an act of betrayal and eliminated it. / Recovering X-12's wreckage and returning.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_059.en:
...Wh-what the...
...I've fought all kinds of guys...
but you bastards...
you'd shoot your own!?
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Th-this... / ...I've fought all kinds of guys, but... / you bastards... you even shoot your own comrades!!

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_060.en:
...So this is the unit in question?
It can't even control its emotions.
...Hardly the material it was made
out to be.
Material of this grade is not needed.
You will be erased.
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Is this that unit? / Can't even control emotions. / ...It seems not the material it was said to be. / If it's material of this level, it's not needed. / I'll have you disappear.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_061.en:
Captain, this large machine looks
like the same type we fought before.
Watch out for its firepower!
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, this large unit seems to be the same type / as the machine we fought before. / Watch out for its firepower!

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_062.en:
Roger.
All units, switch targets to the
large machine.
Champ, don't do anything rash.
We'll regroup and engage.
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / All units, change target to the large unit. / Champ, don't be rash. / Join up and return fire.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_064.en:
Output falling...
This unit is withdrawing from
the front...
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Output dropping... / This unit is leaving the battle line...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy large WAP beginning withdrawal.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_067.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ's unit, can you move?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_068.en:
Yeah, I can manage.
But Captain...
Before we go back, can I pick up his
machine?
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_068.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Seems I can move somehow. / But Captain... / Before we go back, can I pick up his machine?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_069.en:
Life signs in the wreckage!
The pilot is still alive!
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_069.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There are life signs in the wreckage! / The pilot is still alive!

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_070.en:
Rescue the survivor and recover the
wreck. Quickly.
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_070.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hurry the rescue of the survivor and the recovery work.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_071.en: Champ, I'll give you a hand.
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_071.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ, I'll lend a hand.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_072.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thanks, Gray. / That's a help.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_073.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Uuh...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_074.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ox...!?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_075.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Y...o... Stan.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_076.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You... that body...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_077.en:
What's with... that face... like
you're about to cry...
Sure is... cold today...
...Huh?
...Have you seen... my lower half?
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_077.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What's with that... about-to-cry face... / It's... awfully cold today... / ...Huh? / ...Do you know... where everything below my... stomach went?

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_078.en:
Hang on.
I'll find it.
Don't try to talk.
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_078.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wait. / I'll look for it. / Don't talk.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_079.en:
Heh heh heh... *cough*
For you...
instead of... a title belt...
this machine's... Destroy...er...
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_079.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Heh heh heh... cough. / To you... / instead of a champion belt... / this machine's Destroy...er...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_080.en:
...Yeah. I'll take it, and thanks.
...You're one tough son of a gun.
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_080.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Yeah, I'll gratefully take it. / ...Really, what a tough bastard.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_081.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I... to you...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_082.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hey, Ox...!!

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_083.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Ox Warrior. / Something like this...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_084.en:
A guy I know turns up an enemy...
and the enemy's a merc too...
This merc job's a rough one...
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_084.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: An acquaintance was the enemy... / The enemy was a mercenary too... / Mercenary is a painful job...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_085.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_087.en:
...People you know... they just die,
like it's nothing...
Buggy, too...
So this is what a battlefield is...
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_087.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...People you know die so easily... / Buggy too... / So this is the battlefield...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_088.en:
...Even so, we chose this road.
On Huffman, all we can do is
survive.
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_088.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Even so, we chose this path. / There's no way but to survive here on Huffman.

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_089.en: Recovered the parts and the body...
MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_089.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Recovery of parts wreckage and remains complete...

MsgLabels_tactics_28_msg_090.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission complete... / Returning to base now.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_001.en:
Captain...
Champ was drinking alone at the bar.
I didn't know what to say to him...
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain... / Champ was drinking alone at the bar. / I don't know how to talk to him...

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_002.en:
A mission.
I'll prepare to sortie.
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_003.en:
Champ...
Do you think he's okay?
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ... / Will he be alright?

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_004.en:
Oh, we're heading out?
I'll get ready!
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, a sortie, right. / I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_005.en:
Without the usual loudmouth around,
it's pretty quiet here...
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Without the usual cheerful guy, / it's quiet here...

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: He was a good warrior.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_009.en:
Yeah. Though his personality was
rotten right to the end.
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah, but he had a terrible personality / to the very end.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_010.en:
All we can do for the fallen is
remember them.
Nothing's more pitiful than being
forgotten.
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All we can do for the war dead / is remember them. / There's nothing more pitiful than / not even being remembered.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_011.en:
That guy...
We trained at the same dojo, ever
since I was a nobody.
Even after we went pro, we fought
each other more times than I can
count.
By then we knew each other's every
move.
Honestly... he was the last guy I
ever wanted to fight.
That footage I showed you here was a
fight with him.
Man, that crowd went nuts...
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: He... / we trained together at the dojo / since I was a beginner. / Even after I became a pro fighter, / I fought him many times. / By then, we each knew / the other's moves inside out. / Man, / honestly he was the guy I least wanted to fight. / The video we watched here before was a match with him too. / That match was really heated...

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_012.en: A friend and a rival, then.
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So he was a friend and a rival.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_013.en:
That's what we were.
...But I threw away the glory, threw
away my friends, and picked this
road...
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That was the relationship with him. / ...But I threw away the glory of martial arts, / threw away my comrades, and chose this path...

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_014.en: You had your reasons, didn't you?
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There were circumstances, right?

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_015.en:
...Yeah.
Fighting just got less popular as
time went on.
We still had plenty of die-hard fans,
but as a business it was one flop
after another.
I didn't want the flame to go out.
Fighting was the road we believed in.
...To keep the shows afloat, I
borrowed big from the underworld.
And when it's the reigning champ
asking, hell, they'll lend you as
much as you want...
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Yeah. / With the times, martial arts' popularity slumped too. / There were still lots of devoted fans, but / as an entertainment business it was / failure after failure. / I didn't want to let the path we believed in, / the fire of martial arts, go out. / ...To get through the financial troubles, I / borrowed a huge sum from the underworld. / With the reigning champion as the borrower, / well, they'd lend any amount...

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Did he know about that?

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_017.en:
Nah. I couldn't tell anybody...
It wasn't anyone's fault fighting
went out of style.
The longer we kept the shows going,
the deeper the debt got...
In the end I had no way to pay, and
the deal I'd made with the underworld
had me fixing fights...
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, I couldn't tell anyone... / The slump in popularity wasn't anyone's fault. / In the end, the more we kept running the shows, the more / the debt piled up... / Eventually there was no prospect of repaying it, / and through a contract with the underworld I / got into fixed matches...

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_018.en:
Fixed fights.
But with your personality, I can't
see you taking a dive.
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Fixed matches. / But with Champ's personality, / you shouldn't be able to deliberately lose a match.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_019.en:
Ha ha ha! That's the Captain.
You see right through me...
You got it.
I couldn't throw the fight. Ended up
sending the other guy to the hospital.
And that guy? Turns out he was the
idiot son of an underworld boss...
After that, I had those goons on my
tail every single day.
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hahaha, as expected of the Captain, / you see through everything... / Exactly. / In the end I couldn't throw the match, / and sent my opponent to the hospital. / And on top of that, that fighter was / the underworld boss's idiot son... / After that it was every day being chased / by the underworld guys.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_020.en: And then you came to Huffman.
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: And after that you came to Huffman.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_021.en:
That's about it.
If I'd stuck around the fighting
world, I'd have dragged everybody
around me into it...
And there's a guy who took on my
debt for me.
I'm paying him back with my merc
money. Bit by bit, but still.
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's how it is. / If I'd stayed in the martial arts world, / it would've caused trouble for the people around me... / Also, there was a benefactor / who took over my debt. / I'm putting the money I earn as a mercenary / toward repaying that person, little by little.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_022.en:
Underneath it all, you've had it
hard.
Still, you should report all this to
the base.
Though vanishing without a word and
keeping the truth hidden... they may
not let that slide.
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Your true nature seems to be someone who's had a hard life. / But you'd better report that matter / to the base beforehand. / Champ who hid the facts and vanished without a word, / this matter might not / be forgiven.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_023.en:
Heh heh, that's the plan.
But now, for his sake and for the
guy who bailed me out, I can't go
dyin' easy...
Captain, thanks for hearin' me out.
That took a load off.
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Heh heh, that's my intention. / But with this, for his sake, / and my benefactor's sake, I can't / die easily anymore... / Captain, thanks for listening. / I feel better.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_024.en: Glad to have you with us.
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm counting on you from here on too.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_025.en:
But now, for his sake and for the
guy who bailed me out, I can't go
dyin' easy.
Captain, thanks for hearin' me out.
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But with this, for his sake, / and my benefactor's sake, I can't / die easily anymore. / Captain, thanks for listening.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_026.en:
We're movin' out?
Alright, let's go wild!
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie. / Alright, I'll run wild!

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_027.en:
The war's comin', I tell ya.
And then I'll be gone without a
trace, just like Peter.
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: War is going to start. / Then I'll be like Peter, / and vanish without a trace.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_028.en:
Shresh...
Don't get so worked up.
You don't want to jinx it, right?
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thresh... / don't brood like that. / It'd be a problem if it came true, right?

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Lately... Oddeye... / doesn't come online much......

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_030.en:
Word from the brass.
We've located the large machine that
showed up during the Champ incident.
I want it shot down.
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Information from the upper echelons. / We've grasped the position of the large unit / that appeared during Champ's incident the other day. / I want you to shoot it down.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Tell me the details.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_032.en: It's lying low in the desert.
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's currently hiding in the desert region.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_033.en:
The desert...
That's their usual pattern.
Is it trying to link up with its main
force?
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The desert region... / That's their common behavior pattern. / Is the goal to rejoin the main force?

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_034.en:
Yes.
That read looks right.
We're picking up a large number of
big machines in the area nearby.
Unidentified as well.
You'd better stay sharp.
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm. / That reading seems correct. / In the nearby area there are also many / large unit signatures. / Likewise of unknown affiliation. / You'd better be fully on guard.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_035.en:
A large number of big machines...
The squad's at the limit of their
endurance, but...
Looks like there's no time for rest.
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Many large units... / The members' fatigue is at its limit too, but... / there seems to be no leeway for rest.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_036.en:
Of all the nearby bases, yours is
the only squad to fight the black
unit and bring everyone home alive.
They want that runaway destroyed
before it reaches its main force,
whatever it takes.
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Among nearby bases, the only squad that fought the black unit / and had all its members come back alive / is yours. / They want you to destroy the fleeing unit / before it rejoins the main force, no matter what.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_037.en:
That's the plan.
We'll sortie as soon as we're ready.
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's my intention. / Sortieing as soon as preparations are done.

MsgLabels_station_29_msg_038.en:
Even the brass admits nobody at the
nearby bases can stand up to the
black unit but you.
Take out that runaway before it
reaches its main force, whatever it
takes.
MsgLabels_station_29_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The upper echelons also acknowledged that among nearby bases, / you're the only ones who can stand up / to the black unit. / I want you to destroy the fleeing unit / before it rejoins the main force, no matter what.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Large unit found!

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_002.en:
The one who shot Ox...
Guess this makes it a grudge match...
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The guy who shot Ox... / Avenging him, huh...

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ, stay calm.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_004.en:
Don't worry.
I'm a merc too.
I'll do the job right!
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Don't worry. / I'm a mercenary too. / I'll do my job properly!

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Everyone, no recklessness.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Of course!

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_007.en:
Let's wrap this up fast. How about
we all hit the beach for once?
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: How about we finish the mission quickly / and for once go to the beach / all together?

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That would be nice too.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_009.en:
Agreed.
We're on a tropical island, after all.
I'll put in for squad leave later.
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / We're on a southern island, after all. / I'll apply for squad leave later.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_010.en:
Ooh, maybe I'll go buy a new
swimsuit.
Rain, come shopping with me!
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, maybe I'll go buy / a new swimsuit. / Miss Rain, let's go shopping / together too!

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hehe, I'll think about it.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_012.en:
The two of 'em in swimsuits...
Whoa, whoa. Now I REALLY can't die.
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The two of them in swimsuits... / Hey hey, I can't die easily now.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good, target acquired. / Mission start.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_015.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What... / Unit inoperable...

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_018.en: Go apologize to Ox on the other side.
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Go apologize to Ox over there.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_019.en:
To soldiers this green...
Does this mean I misjudged superior
material...?
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: By such fellows, immature as soldiers... / Does this mean I misjudged / excellent material...

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_020.en:
Large machine silenced.
More enemy reinforcements...
Six large machines.
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Large unit silenced. / More enemy reinforcements... / 6 large units.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_021.en:
Large reinforcements confirmed.
We'll intercept the remaining enemy
reinforcements.
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed large unit reinforcements. / Now intercepting the remaining enemy reinforcement units.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_023.en:
Good... I held out.
Large mobile unit, shoot them down.
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good... I somehow held out. / Large mobile unit, shoot them down.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy reinforcements... / 6 large units.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_025.en:
Large reinforcements confirmed.
We'll pursue the special machine and
intercept the reinforcements.
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed large unit reinforcements. / Now pursuing the special unit and / intercepting the enemy reinforcement units.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy unit completely silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_028.en:
That was a hard fight.
Good work, everyone.
Mission complete.
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That was a fierce battle. / Good work, everyone. / With this the mission is complete.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_029.en:
Captain, about that leave...
It's still on, right?
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, about the vacation... / it's alright, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_030.en:
We've been fighting day after day.
The Commander can hardly say no.
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's been battle after battle. / The Commander can't say no.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_031.en:
So, Champ, how about a drink at the
beach?
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Then Champ, shall we have a drink on the beach?

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_032.en:
Gray, YOU invitin' ME?
That's a first.
You're buyin', right?
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gray, inviting me yourself / is unusual, isn't it? / Of course it's your treat, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So that's how it goes...

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_034.en:
Rain, about the swimsuits... we're
going, right?
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Miss Rain, the swimsuit thing from earlier, / it's okay, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_035.en:
Yes, yes. I'll get ready once we're
back...
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, yes, I'll get ready once we're back...

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_036.en:
Then, Captain, you come shopping
with us too.
Just this once is okay, right?
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Then, Captain, please come along / on our shopping too. / It's fine once in a while, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_037.en:
Sure, I don't mind...
I didn't see that coming, though...
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah, I don't mind, but... / I didn't expect it to come to that...

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_038.en:
Hmm~
Sexy or cute...
Which do you prefer, Captain?
Oh, I bet the sexy look would suit
Rain!
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm. / Sexy type, cute type... / Captain, which do you prefer? / Ah, the sexy type would suit / Miss Rain!

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_039.en:
R-Rain, lookin' sexy...!!
C-C-Captain... I'm comin' too!
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: R-Rain in the sexy type...!! / C-c-c-Captain... I'll come along too!

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_040.en:
Nope, no Champs allowed.
You go have a nice drink with Gray.
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ's not allowed. / Please have a nice drink with Gray.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_041.en:
Hold on, Oddeye...
Hear me out!
Gray, forget what I said before!
Got it?
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wait, Oddeye... / Listen to me! / Gray, what we talked about earlier is off! / Got it?

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_042.en:
I don't mind, but I don't think
they're letting you in anyway.
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I don't mind, but I think Champ won't / be let in with them anyway?

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You understand well.

MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_044.en:
N-no way...
Gray... That's it, we're drinkin'
till we drop!
MsgLabels_tactics_29_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: N-no way... / Gray... if it's come to this, we're drinking all-out!

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_001.en: Captain, do you use the base ARENA?
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, do you use the base's arena?

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_002.en:
Now and then.
It's good training, and a change
of pace.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Once in a while. / It serves as training and a change of pace too.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_003.en:
That's true.
We saw one on our last mission:
the major cities on Huffman are
all building big Arena stadiums.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's true. / We also went in the last mission, but / in Huffman's major cities, / large-scale fighting arenas, Arenas, / are being built.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_004.en:
Apparently the rules are almost the
same as the base ARENA.
Still, an entertainment venue built
around wanzers...
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The rules seem to be almost the same as the base arena. / But an entertainment facility using WAPs...

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_005.en:
If private companies run places like
the Arena, it might shake off the
wanzer's image as a weapon of war.
That could be a happier fate for
them, don't you think?
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If private companies run facilities like / the Arena, the image of weapons for war / will be wiped away, and for WAPs / that might be happiness.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_006.en:
I see.
That's one way to look at it.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / You can look at it that way too.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_007.en:
If private companies run places like
the Arena, it might shake off the
wanzer's image as a weapon of war.
That could be a happier fate for
them, don't you think?
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If private companies run facilities like / the Arena, the image of weapons for war / will be wiped away, and for WAPs / that might be happiness.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_008.en:
A mission, then.
Preparing to sortie.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_009.en:
Captain, I'm headin' over to the
ARENA for a bit.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, I'm going to the arena / for a bit now.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You're enthusiastic.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_011.en:
Trainin' for the civilian Arena.
The fight money's pretty sweet.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's training to participate in / a private Arena. / You can earn quite a fight purse.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh, sounds quite interesting.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_013.en:
Word is a lot of the entry wanzers
have real good pilots.
Why don't you sign up too, Captain?
For me, it's the crowd, the buzz in
there... nothin' else like it.
Aight, I'm off!
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Among the entry WAPs, there are apparently / lots of skilled guys. / Captain, how about you participate too? / In my case, the atmosphere of the venue, / that exhilaration is indescribable. / Well then, I'm off!

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_014.en:
Don't let it get in the way of
your duties.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Make sure it doesn't hinder missions.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_015.en: Aight, I'm off to the base ARENA!
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well then, I'm off to the base arena!

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_016.en:
What, we're movin' out?
Fine -- I'll go wild out there instead!
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What, a sortie. / Alright, I'll run wild there!

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_017.en:
Oh, Captain, I've got a question about
wanzer one-on-ones...
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Captain, there's something I want to ask / about WAP 1-on-1...

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 1-on-1... the arena?

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_019.en:
Yes, exactly.
My machine is set up mainly for
long range, but I can't decide!
Should I keep a sharp, pure
long-range build, or cover my blind
spots up close and go all-rounder?
I've been agonizing over it...
Which do you think is better?
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. Exactly. / My unit's settings are / long-range focused, but / I'm totally torn about whether it's better / to keep a lopsided long-range spec setting, / or to eliminate blind spots at close range / and make it all-round... / Captain, which do you think is better?

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_020.en:
...In real combat, you work with
the rest of us.
A bit of specialization pays off there.
But fighting alone may be a different
story.
If you can use your skills reliably,
though, you can expect a one-sided
fight.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...In real combat, coordination with us is a given. / Being a little lopsided is probably effective. But in solo combat, / it might be a different story. / If you can use your skills reliably, / you could probably expect a one-sided battle.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_021.en:
I see~.
It really is deep!
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I seee~. / It's deep after all!

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_022.en:
Should I keep a sharp, pure
long-range build, or cover my blind
spots up close and go all-rounder?
I've been agonizing over it...
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm totally torn about whether a lopsided long-range spec / setting is better, or eliminating blind spots / at close range and making it all-round / is better...

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_023.en:
Oh, we're sortieing?
I'll get ready!
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, a sortie, right. / I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_024.en: Captain, do you use the ARENA?
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, do you use the arena?

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_025.en:
Now and then.
It's good training, and a change
of pace.
But it seems to be catching on in
our squad.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Once in a while. / It serves as training and a change of pace too. / But it seems to be popular in our squad.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_026.en:
It's a pretty good system, the ARENA.
Maybe it's from seeing that flashy
civilian Arena the other day, but
everyone's really fired up.
If that catches on, it could change
the whole wanzer industry.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The arena is quite a good system. / Maybe because we saw the private, showy / Arena the other day, everyone / is motivated. / If that catches on, the WAP industry / might change.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_027.en:
True.
With private companies behind it,
wanzer parts technology and piloting
skills should both improve.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / Through the power of private companies, WAP parts / technology development and WAP piloting skills / will probably improve.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_028.en:
The Arena's entry pilots, the really
good ones anyway, might get scouted
by the army.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Arena entry pilots, / especially high-level ones, / might get scouted by the army.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_029.en:
It's possible.
Even a merc who runs out of work on
the battlefield might keep fed by
entering the Arena.
Looked at that way, it works in our
favor too.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That could happen. / Even if mercenaries run out of work on the battlefield, / if they enter the Arena / they might not struggle to eat. / Depending on how you look at it, it's / convenient for us too.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_030.en:
It's nothing like real combat, but
it's the same wanzers at heart.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's completely different from real combat, but / fundamentally it's the same WAP.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_031.en:
It's a pretty good system, the ARENA.
With these flashy civilian Arenas,
the wanzer industry's bound to change.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The arena is quite a good system. / Thanks to the private, showy Arena, / the WAP industry will change from now on.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_033.en:
Think about it.
Why're they shippin' mountains of
weapons and food here from home?
«g:24»This base could never eat all that.
And the weapons... there's enough to
wipe out a USN base or two on this
island, every last man.
I'm tellin' ya, somethin's up.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Think about it. / For what reason are mountains / of weapons and food sent from the home country? / This base could never eat all the food. / And the weapons... there's enough to / wipe out one or two of this island's U.S.N. / bases. / It's definitely sketchy.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_034.en:
The Arena's great, isn't it?
The sound of machine slamming into
machine... can't get enough of it.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The Arena's great. / The sound of machines clashing with machines / is irresistible.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_035.en:
...Come to think of it...
I never got... a souvenir from
Oddeye...
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Come to think of it... / I didn't get... Oddeye's souvenir...

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Prevent Arena bombing

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rescue journalist

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll accept

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What's the other mission?

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rescue journalist

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll accept

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What's the other mission?

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Prevent Arena bombing

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Prevent Arena bombing

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rescue journalist

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_046.en:
Two urgent missions just came in.
One: stop a bombing at the Arena.
Two: rescue a team of journalists.
Whichever you pass on goes to
another unit.
So pick whichever you like, no need
to worry about the other.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Two urgent missions came in. / One is preventing the Arena bombing. / The other is rescuing a journalist. / The mission that's left over is arranged / to go to a separate unit. / You can choose a mission / without worrying.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_047.en:
Stopping the Arena bombing, then.
You know Arena construction is wrapping
up all over the island?
The anti-Arena groups aren't taking it
quietly.
Things were always tense, but now
they've finally turned to force.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Preventing the Arena bombing... it is. / You know Arena construction work / is finishing in various places? / It seems the anti-Arena forces won't stay silent about it. / Their relationship was originally uneasy, but they've finally / resorted to force.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_048.en:
Anti-Arena groups turning to force...
Those groups opposing the damage the
stadiums do to the environment?
I thought they were a peaceful lot.
What are they threatening to do?
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Use of force by the anti-Arena forces... / The group opposed to environmental destruction / from stadium construction. / I thought it was a clean group, / what are they saying they'll do?

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_049.en:
Mm.
The Arena organizing committee just
received a bomb threat.
Get to the site fast and stop it from
going off.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm. / A bombing notice came to the Arena executive committee / just now. / I want you to rush to the site and prevent the bombing.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...A "clean group," what a joke.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_051.en:
Their gear's outdated, but the
anti-Arena groups have wanzers too,
apparently.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems the anti-Arena forces have WAPs deployed too, / though their equipment is old-fashioned.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_052.en: Not much of a fighting force, then.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Their strength isn't that much... huh.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_053.en:
Seems not.
A bomb disposal team is going with
you. Disarm the planted bombs with
their disposal vehicle while you
wipe out the enemy wanzers.
But they're desperate. Enemy
reinforcements are possible.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So it seems. / This time a bomb disposal team will accompany you. / Neutralize the planted bombs with the / explosive disposal vehicles while driving out the enemy WAPs. / But they're desperate too. Depending on the situation, / enemy reinforcements are also conceivable.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_054.en:
A bomb threat means we don't have
much time.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A bombing notice means there isn't much time / left.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_055.en:
Going by the deadline they gave, if
you head out now you'll have about
15 turns to work with.
Will you take this mission?
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Considering the time in the notice, if you head to the site / now, the time allowed for the work / will be about 15 turns. / Will you accept this mission?

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_056.en:
We'll take it.
There's no time before it goes off.
This one's urgent.
We sortie at once.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll accept. / There's no time until the bombing. / It seems urgent. / Sortieing at once.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What's the other mission?

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_058.en:
Rescuing the journalists, then.
Three days ago, a team of journalists
went silent in territory we control.
But this morning we picked up a
distress signal from their vehicle.
I want you to bring them out.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rescuing a journalist... it is. / 3 days ago, in our army's governed district, / a journalist team / lost contact. / But this morning we caught a distress signal / from their vehicle. / I want you to carry out the rescue / of that journalist team.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_059.en:
This needs wanzers?
Sending a vehicle or a chopper to
pick them up seems smarter.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is it a mission that needs WAPs? / Sending a vehicle or helicopter to pick them up / seems smarter.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_060.en:
It's our territory, but there are
reports of armed guerrillas sighted
in the area the signal's coming from.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even if it's the governed district, in the area / where the distress signal is being transmitted, / reports have come in that armed guerrillas / have been sighted.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_061.en: That sort are still roaming around?
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Are such types still showing up.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_062.en:
It never hurts to have journalists
and the press on our side.
Get out there and help them, fast.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Journalists and the media, / there's no loss in having them on our side. / I want you to head out to the rescue immediately.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_063.en:
Say we secure the journalists. Do they
have a way out?
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Assuming we secure the journalist team, / is there a means of transport?

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_064.en:
Their vehicle seems to be drivable.
The signal's on the move.
Just get that vehicle to the extraction
point.
Will you take this mission?
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The journalist team's vehicle / seems able to move. / Apparently there's movement in the signal. / Just deliver that vehicle / to the escape point. / Will you accept this mission?

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_065.en:
We'll take it.
Information may well be the greatest
weapon of all...
This one's urgent. We sortie at once.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll accept. / Information could be called the greatest weapon... / It seems urgent. / Sortieing at once.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What's the other mission?

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_067.en:
Both are urgent, but whichever you
pass on goes to another unit.
One: stop a bombing at the Arena.
Two: rescue a team of journalists.
Pick whichever you like, no need to
worry about the other.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_067.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Both are urgent missions, but / the mission that's left over is arranged / to go to a separate unit. / One is preventing the Arena bombing. / The other is rescuing a journalist. / Choose a mission without worrying.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_068.en:
We'll take it.
There's no time before it goes off.
This one's urgent.
We sortie at once.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_068.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll accept. There's no time until the bombing. / It seems urgent. Sortieing at once.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_069.en:
I see.
Information may well be the greatest
weapon of all...
This one's urgent. We sortie at once.
MsgLabels_station_30_msg_069.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / Information could be called the greatest weapon... / It seems urgent. / Sortieing at once.

MsgLabels_station_30_msg_070.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hurry. / I wish you luck.

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Pursuers?

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_002.en:
Those armored cars from before,
right behind us!
Three of 'em!
MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The armored vehicles from before are behind us! / 3 of them!

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_003.en:
They don't give up, do they...
Whose soldiers ARE they...?«g:24»
Can't they see the PRESS markings on
the car?
MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: They're persistent... / What soldiers are they...? / Can't they see the press mark on the vehicle?

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_004.en:
What!?
Now there's a wanzer up ahead...!?
Dammit, we're boxed in!
MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What! / Now a wanzer ahead...!? / Bad, we'll be sandwiched!

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_005.en:
Civilian vehicle, do you read me?
At the army's request, we're here
to protect you.
MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Civilian vehicle there, can you hear me? / At the army's request, we will protect you.

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_006.en:
...Friendlies?
Understood. We'll follow your lead.
Looks like we made it after all...
MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Allies? / Understood, we'll follow your instructions. / Seems we're somehow saved...

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Huh...?

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hm? / What's wrong?

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_009.en:
...Oh, no, it's nothing.
That girl... she looks like someone
I know.
MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Ah, no, it's nothing. / That girl... resembled someone I know.

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_010.en:
Rachel Perkins...
She's a well-known journalist.
Maybe you've seen her on TV?
MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rachel Perkins... / a famous journalist. / Didn't you see her on TV?

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_011.en:
We'll cover you.
Get out when you see an opening.
MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We'll cover you now. / Seize an opening and escape.

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood, we'll try.

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units, operation start.

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_014.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, enemy reinforcements.

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_017.en:
All units, keep eyes on that
vehicle.
MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units, don't take your eyes off the vehicle.

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_018.en: One direct hit and they're finished...
MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If it takes even a direct hit, it won't stand a chance...

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_019.en:
What? A direct hit!?«g:24»
Oddeye, any life signs?
MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? A direct hit!? / Oddeye, life signs?

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_020.en:
There's no tracker on the civilian
vehicle!
Status unknown!
Resistant armor, anti-wanzer guns...
Are these really guerrillas?
MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The civilian vehicle doesn't have / a trace machine! / Status unknown! / Attribute-resistant armor, anti-WAP guns... / Are these really guerrillas?

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_021.en:
They only look the part.
That teamwork...
That's no civilian outfit.
MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems they're just pretending. / That teamwork... / it can't be civilian level.

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I couldn't protect them again...

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_023.en:
Nothing we can do.
We'll search the wrecked vehicle and
bring back any evidence...
The fight's over.
MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It can't be helped. / We'll investigate the destroyed vehicle / and bring back evidence... / The battle is over.

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_024.en:
Those bastards...
I won't forgive them!
MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Those bastards... / Unforgivable!

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hey, Gray, what's wrong?

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_026.en:
What? Gray, what's wrong?
The fight's over.
Captain, Gray's wanzer is heading for
the enemy vehicles!
MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What? What's wrong, Gray? / The battle is over. / Captain, Gray's unit is heading / toward the enemy vehicles!

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_027.en:
...We'll stay on and take out the
armed vehicles.
Don't worry about the rest.
MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...We'll intercept the armed vehicles as is. / Don't worry about what comes after.

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_028.en:
Roger!
Hey, hold up, Gray! What're you so
mad about!?
We're comin' too. Don't do anything
stupid!
MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger! / Hey, wait, Gray, why are you snapping! / We're going too, don't be rash!

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_029.en:
Enemy vehicles silenced.
No reinforcements.
...Captain, there are survivors in
the wreck!
MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy vehicles silenced. / No reinforcements. / ...Captain, there are survivors in the vehicle wreckage!

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah!?
