MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Cough, cough... / Seems we're still alive...

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gahah... / Ra...chel... / Are you alright...

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_033.en:
Johnston?
Hey, are you okay?
You're bleeding...
MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: John? / Hey, are you okay? / The blood...

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_034.en:
Took one in the lung...
I'm fine... I've got a spare...
MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: My lung got hit... / It's fine... I have another one...

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed wounded... / Any other survivors!?

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_036.en:
Two wounded, one unconscious and in
critical condition.
They got our driver...
MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 2 wounded, 1 unconscious and in critical condition. / The driver got hit...

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_037.en:
Still, a direct hit from an anti-wanzer
gun, and you're okay?
I was sure you were done for...
MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even so, the anti-WAP gun hit directly, / and you were alright. / We assumed it was hopeless...

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This vehicle had anti-penetration treatment...

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see, you're cautious.

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_040.en:
Well, we were told it was a combat
zone.
MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We'd heard it was a combat zone, just in case.

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_041.en:
Medical team's sling chopper
arriving in 5 minutes.
MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The rescue team's sling helicopter / arrives in 5 minutes.

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_042.en:
Roger.
We'll keep escorting until the
chopper arrives.
MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / We'll continue escorting until the helicopter arrives.

MsgLabels_tactics_30_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thank you. / With this, we're saved.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh, Miss Rachel.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_002.en:
I heard everyone was in here.
Um, it's Rain, isn't it?
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I heard everyone was here. / Umm, you were Miss Rain, right.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_003.en:
That's right.
This is where the base unwinds.
Everyone's taking it easy right now.
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / This is the base's place to unwind. / Everyone's relaxing right now too.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_004.en:
Huh? Rachel... ma'am?
What brings you here?
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Huh? Rachel... Miss, / what brings you to a place like this?

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_005.en:
Just Rachel is fine.
I wanted to thank you all for the
other day.
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Just Rachel is fine. / I wanted to thank everyone for the other day.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_006.en: Don't see many civilians in here.
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's rare for a civilian to come here.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_007.en: Now that you mention it, true.
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Come to think of it, that's true.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? Champ... / that Stan!?

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_009.en:
Ha ha ha!
That's what they used to call me,
back in the day.
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hahaha, / I used to be known by that name.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Surprised? / It's really him.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_011.en:
Wow...
Meeting a legendary fighter in a
place like this...
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Amazing... / To meet a legendary fighter / in a place like this...

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_012.en:
Huh.
So Champ really IS famous.
I thought he was just some weird,
drunk muscle-head.
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Heh. / Champ really is a celebrity. / I thought he was just a weird drunk / muscle-brain man.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Weird... muscle-brain man...

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_014.en:
I'm sorry, Rachel.
Please don't mind anything she says...
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry, Rachel, / please don't mind / her comments...

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Miss Rain, saying something mean again...

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_016.en:
Pretty sure you're the mean one
here...
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I think you're the meaner one...

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_017.en:
You must be the Captain.
Thank you for the other day.
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You're the Captain, right. Thank you / for the other day.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_018.en:
I was just carrying out the mission.
Save your thanks for the Commander.
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I merely carried out the mission. / Say your thanks to the Commander.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_020.en:
I'm sorry, Rachel.
Please don't mind anything the
Captain says either...
He can be curt, but he doesn't mean
anything by it...
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry, Rachel, / please don't mind the Captain's comments / either... / He can be curt, but he doesn't / mean any harm...

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I understand...

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_022.en:
By the way, is the rest of your
crew alright?
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: By the way, are the other staff safe?

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_023.en:
The ones with minor injuries left
Huffman a little while ago.
Johnston got the worst of it; he's
in intensive care at the hospital.
He should fly home tomorrow or so.
(Hm? The design on the Captain's
tattoo... I've seen it somewhere...)
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The lightly injured staff left / Huffman a little while ago. / Johnston, the most badly hurt, is getting / intensive care at the medical facility. / He'll probably go home tomorrow. / (Huh? The Captain's tattoo design... / I've seen it somewhere...)

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_024.en:
I see.
That's good to hear.
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / That's the best news.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_025.en:
Will you be staying here a while,
Rachel?
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rachel, will you be here for a while?

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_026.en:
Oh, yes.
I can't go home until the job's
done.
Even if I have to do it alone.
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, right. / I can't go home / until I finish the job. / Even if it's just me, I have to do it.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hoh, how dedicated to work.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_028.en:
Well, I chose this line of work,
so there's no helping it.
Anyway, the mercs here are all such
nice people.
Maybe I'll ask the Commander about
doing some one-on-one interviews.
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I chose that path, / so it can't be helped. / Even so, the mercenaries here / are all good people. / Maybe later I'll apply to the Commander / for individual interviews or something.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_029.en:
I'm free right now, if you want.
How about over a drink?
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: For me, even right now is fine, you know? / How about over a drink, even?

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_030.en:
Ooh, that's Champ for you.
I bet you're used to interviews.
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wow, as expected of Champ. / You must be used to / interviews.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_031.en:
...It's best not to write stories
about individual mercs.
I doubt the Commander would approve
it anyway.
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...It's better not to write articles about individual mercenaries. / I doubt it would pass even if you applied to the Commander.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh... / Why is that...

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_033.en:
...Because, like yours, it's that
kind of job, I guess.
Some of us have pasts we'd rather
not have dug up, and some people
would be in trouble if it got out
they were here.
Ah, sorry if that came off rude.
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...That's because, just like you, / it's that kind of job, I guess. / There are pasts we'd rather not have touched, / and there are people who'd be in trouble / if it got known they were here. / Ah, I apologize if that offended you.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_034.en:
I see.
No, I'm the one who should apologize.
Occupational hazard, I guess...
My curiosity runs off ahead of me...
(Hey, Rain?)
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So that's it. / I'm the one who should apologize. / Maybe this is an occupational disease too... / I just rush ahead out of curiosity... / (Hey, Miss Rain?)

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_036.en:
(Covering for your cool Captain
must be hard work, huh?)
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Covering for that cool Captain / must be hard, huh)

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_037.en:
(Oh, no... He doesn't look it, but
he's a kind man.)
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Ah, no... / Despite how he looks, he's a kind person)

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_038.en:
(Really? He doesn't seem it...
I guess love really is blind?)
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Hmm, he doesn't look it, though... / Is this that "love is blind" thing?)

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_039.en:
(Wh-what are you talking about!?
I-i-it's nothing like that!!)
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Wh-what are you saying! / I-i-it's nothing like that!!)

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_040.en:
(Hee hee, your face is all red.)
Well then, I'll head back to my
quarters. Good night!
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Hehehe, your face is red, you know?) / Well then, I'll head back to my lodgings. / Good night!

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Phew, honestly...

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain, is something wrong?

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_043.en:
N-no, n-nothing at all.
Excuse me.
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: N-no, i-it's nothing. / Excuse me.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_044.en:
Looks like Rachel said something
to you.
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Looks like Rachel / said something to her.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_045.en:
N-no, n-nothing at all.
Excuse me.
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: N-no, i-it's nothing. / Excuse me.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_046.en:
A mission.
I'll prepare to sortie.
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_047.en:
Captain, an interview's no big deal,
is it?
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, I think an interview or so / would be fine?

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_048.en:
We're movin' out?
Alright, let's go wild today too!
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie. / Alright, I'm gonna run wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_049.en: I wonder what Rachel said to Rain?
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What do you think Rachel / said to Miss Rain?

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_050.en:
Oh, a sortie?
I'll get ready!
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, a sortie, right. / I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_051.en:
There's always a wall between
civilians and mercs.
Nothing to be done about it, but...
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As expected, there's a wall between civilians and mercenaries. / It can't be helped, though...

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_053.en:
Captain «E801:00», I'm sorry about
earlier.
I thought I'd done my homework on
mercs, but seeing the legendary
Champ, I guess I got carried away...
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00», sorry about earlier. / I thought I'd studied up on mercenaries / quite a bit, but seeing the legendary Champ / I guess I got carried away...

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_054.en:
Please take care of that request
for me.
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Please take care of what I requested.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_055.en:
Word is the USN's beefing up its
forces on this island.
That's a sure sign a war's coming.
You guys better juice up your wanzers
with the new stuff in the hangar!
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This time, the U.S.N. army on this island / is apparently being reinforced. / This is definitely a sign that war is about to start. / You guys should strengthen your WAPs / with the new products in the hangar!

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_056.en:
Shresh, don't buy into that kinda
flimsy info.
Huh?«g:24» There's a face I don't know.
Maybe I'll say hi.
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thresh, don't believe such / unreliable information. / Huh? «g:24»There's a face I don't know. / Maybe I'll say hello.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Huh?... that person... I've seen her before...

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_058.en:
This time your mission is to help a
journalist with her reporting.
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This time the mission is to assist / a journalist's reporting.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_059.en:
Help with reporting?
So mercs are tour guides now?
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Assist reporting? / Are you saying mercenaries have become / tour conductors?

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_060.en:
Don't be like that.
The request came through the brass.
The client is Rachel Perkins, the
woman we rescued the other day.
She's asked for a guide through the
territory we control.
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Don't say that. / It's a request through the army's upper echelons. / The client is Rachel Perkins, / whom we saved the other day. / At her wish, she'd like us to guide her / around our army's governed zone.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_061.en:
...A guide.
But it's a job for mercs.
I take it this isn't a sightseeing
trip?
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...A guide, huh. / But it's a request to mercenaries. / It's not a place you can go in a sightseeing mood, right?

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_062.en:
Sharp as ever.
Our territory or not, the area she
wants to cover never sees an end to
armed guerrilla activity.
Stay alert at all times and keep her
safe.
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You're perceptive. / The reporting area, even though it's a governed zone, / is a region where armed guerrilla activity never ceases. / Escort her without / ever letting your guard down.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_063.en:
Roger.
We'll head out as soon as her crew
is ready.
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / We'll depart as soon as the staff are ready.

MsgLabels_station_31_msg_064.en:
Our territory or not, the area she
wants to cover never sees an end to
armed guerrilla activity.
Stay alert at all times and keep her
safe.
MsgLabels_station_31_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The reporting area, even though it's a governed zone, / is a region where armed guerrilla activity never ceases. / Escort her without / ever letting your guard down.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_001.en:
So this is the place...
(...These ruins match the files
exactly.)
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So this is the destination... / (...These ruins, just as in the documents.)

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_002.en:
The remains of a facility from the
first days of settling Huffman...
What's there to report on in a place
like this?
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The remains of a facility built / back when Huffman was being settled, huh... / Was there anything here / worth reporting on?

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_003.en: Somethin' to gawk at, I guess.
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's probably a curiosity.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_004.en:
Hee hee.
It is rather unusual, isn't it.
(There it is. I knew it was here.)
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hehehe. / It certainly is rare. / (There it is, it really was here.)

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_005.en:
(Of all places, she comes here...)
This is no ordinary story, is it.
I won't pry, but be quick about it.
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (To come to this place...) / This doesn't seem like just reporting. / I won't pry, but do it quickly.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_006.en:
...Oh my, the Captain's onto me.
Don't worry, it shouldn't take ten
minutes.
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Oh, seems the Captain's seen through me. / It's fine, I think it won't take 10 minutes.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_007.en:
Huh? It's not for a story?
If you're looking for something, I
can help!
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? It's not reporting? / If you're looking for something, I'll help, you know?

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_008.en:
It's fine, I found it!
(Now the truth can come out...)
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's fine, I found it! / (With this I can make the truth public...)

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_009.en:
If you're done here, we're heading
back.
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If the purpose is done, we'll return to base.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_010.en:
Yes, all done.
Let's go back.
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, that's fine. / Let's go back.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, enemies. / We're completely surrounded.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_012.en:
It's that unit again...
That black machine...
It's got a backpack I've never seen
before!
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's that unit again... / That black unit... / it has a backpack I've never seen!

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_013.en:
Them again...
I'm in the car.
We can go any time.
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Them again... / I'm in the vehicle. / I can go anytime.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_014.en:
Target acquired...
The mercenary unit in question
appears to be escorting.
Eliminating the target takes
priority.
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Target acquired... / That mercenary unit appears to be escorting. / However, eliminating the target takes priority.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_015.en:
Looks like Rachel's got some kind
of story...
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rachel seems to have some reason...

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_016.en:
All units, combat stance.
Protect Rachel's vehicle.
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units, take battle stance / and protect Rachel's vehicle.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_018.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit or
Gray unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down or / Gray's unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_020.en:
To think I would use this on a
mission like this...
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: To use this in a mission like this...

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The black unit is...

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What!? / It vanished?

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_023.en:
N-no way...
You mean they made one big enough
for a wanzer!?
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: N-no way... / Are you saying they developed / one of WAP size!?

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, what do you mean?

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_025.en:
I think it's a kind of optical
camouflage, developed for urban
sniping under the army's 2nd Round
Warrior program.
I never thought it could be fitted to
a wanzer...
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I think it's a kind of optical camouflage / developed for urban sniping / from the army's 2nd Round Warrior concept. / To be able to apply that to a WAP...

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_026.en:
I see. So he's still out there.
All units, stay alert.
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see, so he's still here. / All units, stay alert.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah!!

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_029.en:
Target vehicle destroyed.
Death not yet confirmed.
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Target vehicle destroyed. / But death not yet confirmed.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rachel!

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Calm down, Gray!

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_032.en:
Gray, clearing the enemy comes first.
Stay in your wanzer.
You'll get taken out too.
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gray, sweeping the enemy comes first. / Don't get out of your WAP. / You'll be shot down too.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Kuh... / Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...The «E801:00» squad, huh.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_035.en:
To think I would use this on a
mission like this...
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: To use this in a mission like this...

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The black unit is...

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What!? / It vanished?

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_038.en:
N-no way...
You mean they made one big enough
for a wanzer!?
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: N-no way... / Are you saying they developed / one of WAP size!?

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, what do you mean?

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_040.en:
I think it's a kind of optical
camouflage, developed for urban
sniping under the army's 2nd Round
Warrior program.
I never thought it could be fitted to
a wanzer...
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I think it's a kind of optical camouflage / developed for urban sniping / from the army's 2nd Round Warrior concept. / To be able to apply that to a WAP...

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_041.en:
I see. So he's still out there.
All units, stay alert.
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see, so he's still here. / All units, stay alert.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_043.en:
Enemy forces silenced.
The machine that vanished...
is still unaccounted for.
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed enemy unit silenced. / The vanished unit... / remains unconfirmed.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Where's that unit!?

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Looks like the battle is over...

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_046.en:
No, Rachel, stay down!
Keep hidden!!
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, Rachel, don't show your face! / Stay hidden!!

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_047.en:
So you survived after all.
...This mission will be completed.
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So she was alive after all. / ...I will accomplish the mission.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_048.en:
The enemy's showing itself!
It's aiming at Rachel!
No, it's in firing position!!
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The enemy showed itself! / It's aiming at Rachel! / No, it's in firing stance!!

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I won't let you!!

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Kyaa!!

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_051.en:
...Target confirmed alive.
Mission failed.
Death unit, backpack malfunction...
Withdrawing for now.
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Target survival confirmed. / Mission failed. / Death unit, BP malfunction occurred... / Returning temporarily.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The special unit... retreated.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_053.en:
Hey, Gray! You alive in there!?
Hang on!
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hey, Gray! Are you alive!? / Hang in there!

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_055.en:
Gray, if you're conscious, get out
of that machine.
...All units, we're getting Gray out.
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gray, if you're conscious, / get out of the unit. / ...All units, rescue Gray.

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_056.en:
Hang on, Gray!
I'll pry it open from out here...
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wait, Gray! / I'll open it from outside...

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_057.en:
I'm sorry...
This is all my fault...
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm sorry... / Because of me...

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I'm... alive?

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gray! / Are you okay?

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Somehow...

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_061.en:
Gray...
I'm so sorry...
I got in the way of the fight...
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gray... / I'm really sorry... / It seems I got in the way in the battle...

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_062.en:
Don't worry about it...
Protecting you is our job...
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Don't worry... / Protecting you is our job...

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_063.en:
But... to put your life on the line
like that...
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But... to the point of risking your life...

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_064.en:
Besides... you remind me of someone...
Your voice, the way you move...
How you get so set on one thing you
can't see anything else...
...Ugh...
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Besides... you resemble her... / Your voice, your gestures... / The way you can't see what's around you / when you're focused on one thing... / ...Ugh...

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gray...!!

MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_066.en:
He's alright.
Gray's just passed out.
Rain, have the base medical staff
stand by.
Mission complete.
Returning to base.
MsgLabels_tactics_31_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's alright. / Gray seems to have just lost consciousness. / Rain, have the base medical staff / stand by. / Mission complete. / Returning to base.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_001.en:
Captain, thanks to Gray blocking the
attack, Rachel came out of it almost
unhurt.
Though she's still in the hospital.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, thanks to Gray blocking the attack, / Rachel was almost / unhurt, it seems. / Though she's apparently still hospitalized.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: And Gray's condition?

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_003.en:
Gray came to last night and is
resting.
They say he could be discharged in
two or three days at the earliest.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gray regained consciousness last night / and seems to be resting. / They say he can be discharged in 2 or 3 days at the earliest.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_004.en:
I see.
That's good.
I'll go see him later.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / That's good. / I'll try visiting him later.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_005.en:
Still, that guy sure went nuts out
there.
He's usually so cool-headed.
Wonder what got into him.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Still, he did something reckless. / He's normally a calm guy; I wonder if something happened.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_006.en:
He said Rachel reminded him of
someone, didn't he?
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: He said Rachel resembled / someone.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A lover back home or something?

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_008.en:
A sweetheart, huh...
I'm kind of jealous.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A lover, huh... / Somehow I'm jealous.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_009.en:
For all we know, he just used the
chaos to make a move on Rachel.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Maybe he just confessed to Rachel / in all that confusion.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: He's not you, Champ...

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_011.en:
Hey, what's that supposed to mean?
I'd never pull that.
Back home I get mobbed by girls
who're fans of mine anyway!
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What, I wouldn't do that kind of thing, you know? / When I go home, I get surrounded / by fan girls!

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_012.en:
Yes, yes. Heroes are just different,
aren't they.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, yes, the hero is different, isn't he.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What kind of treatment is that...

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_014.en:
Gray came to last night and is
resting.
They say he could be discharged in
two or three days at the earliest.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gray regained consciousness last night / and seems to be resting. / They say he can be discharged in 2 or 3 days at the earliest.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_016.en:
Still, that guy sure went nuts out
there.
He's usually so cool-headed.
Wonder what got into him.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Still, he did something reckless. / He's normally a calm guy; I wonder if something happened.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_017.en:
We moving out?
Alright, let's go wild!
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie. / Alright, I'm gonna run wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_018.en:
A sweetheart, huh...
I'm kind of jealous.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A lover, huh... / Somehow I'm jealous.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_019.en:
Oh, a sortie?
I'll get ready!
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, a sortie, right. / I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Captain. / Sorry for everything.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_021.en:
Gray, stay as you are. At ease.
I just came to see how you're doing.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gray, stay as you are and relax. / I just came to see your face.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_022.en:
Sorry.
I can move now, so if there's a
mission, just say the word.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry. / I can move now, so if there's a mission, / tell me.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_023.en:
I was told you should rest a little
longer, though.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But I heard it'd be better to rest / a little longer.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_024.en:
This wound's nothing serious.
The shrapnel's been cleanly removed,
the bleeding's under control, and
there's no infection.
I was lucky I was in a wanzer cockpit.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This wound is nothing much. / The fragments in my body were cleanly removed, / the hemostasis went well, / and there's no infection. / It was lucky I was in a WAP cockpit.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_025.en:
Hm.
Spoken like an ex-special forces man.
You probably know more than the
doctors here.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm. / As expected of an ex-special forces member. / Don't you know more than the doctors here?

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_026.en:
Ha ha, they drilled a lot into us.
I can tell just by looking at the
wound.
By the way, do you know how Rachel's
doing?
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Haha, they drilled all sorts into me. / I can tell by looking at the wound. / By the way, do you know / what happened to Rachel?

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_027.en:
She's still in the hospital, but
thanks to you her injuries were
minor.
I'll let you know when I hear more.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: She seems to still be hospitalized, but / thanks to you, her injuries were light. / I'll let you know when I learn details.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_028.en:
No, that's enough for me.
But letting a civilian get hurt...
I've still got a lot to learn.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, that's enough. / But letting a civilian / get hurt... / I'm still immature.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_029.en:
But you saved her life.
That's enough for now.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But you protected her life. / For now that's enough.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_030.en:
Hearing that from you helps,
Captain.
Thanks for coming to see me.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hearing that from the Captain saves me. / Thank you for visiting.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_031.en:
Hearing that from you helps,
Captain.
Thanks for coming to see me.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hearing that from the Captain saves me. / Thank you for visiting.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_032.en:
Mission acknowledged.
I'm fine now.
Preparing to sortie right away.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / I'm fine now. / I'll prepare to sortie at once.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_033.en:
The war's comin', I tell ya.
And then I'll be gone without a
trace, just like Peter.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: War is going to start. / Then I'll be like Peter, / and vanish without a trace.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_034.en:
Shresh...
Don't get so worked up.
You don't want to jinx it, right?
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thresh... / don't brood like that. / It'd be a problem if it came true, right?

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Lately... Oddeye... / ...doesn't come online much......

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_036.en:
Rachel's already been discharged.
Nothing serious, apparently.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rachel was discharged right away; / it apparently didn't become serious.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_037.en:
That's good.
I'll let Gray know too, since he's
still laid up.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's good. / Let's tell Gray in the hospital too.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_038.en:
However, she's been ordered home.
The brass wants us to escort her to
the airport before the day's out.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: However, she's received a return order / from her home country. / The upper echelons request that you escort her / to the airport today.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's sudden.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_040.en:
We've kept anything about her as
quiet as we can, but we can't rule
out an attempt on her.
You'd best stay sharp at the airport.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Information about her is being kept secret as much as possible, / but the possibility she's targeted can't be denied. / You'd better stay fully on guard at the airport.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_041.en:
Agreed...
We know who we're up against.
The sniper may show up again.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: True... / It's them we're dealing with. / The one who sniped may appear again.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_042.en:
Get Rachel's armored car to the
extraction point in one piece, and
airport security can take it from
there.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If you get the armored vehicle carrying Rachel / safely to the escape point, / the airport security can take over from there.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_043.en:
Roger.
We'll sortie as soon as we're ready.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Sortieing as soon as ready.

MsgLabels_station_32_msg_044.en:
No enemy forces confirmed so far.
Get Rachel's armored car to the
extraction point in one piece, and
airport security can take it from
there.
MsgLabels_station_32_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Currently no enemy forces have been confirmed. / If you get the armored vehicle carrying Rachel / safely to the escape point, / the airport security can take over from there.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_001.en:
We've reached the airport.
No enemy attacks so far.
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We've arrived at the airport. / No enemy attacks / so far.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_002.en:
If they show, it'll most likely be
here. The airport has clear lines of
fire.
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If they appear, it's highly likely / at the airport with its good visibility.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_003.en:
True, that machine was set up for
sniping.
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: True, that unit was sniper spec.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_004.en:
Gray, you sure you're okay?
You ain't even been discharged yet,
have ya?
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gray, is your body okay? / You haven't been discharged yet, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_005.en:
Nah, I'm fine now.
I've got the doctor's okay, too.
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Nah, I'm fine now. / I got the doctor's permission too.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_006.en:
Enemy signatures...
There's so many aircraft and service
vehicles, it's hard to pick anything
out...
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy signatures... / with so many aircraft and maintenance vehicles / searching is hard...

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_007.en:
Now that we're here, I think I'll be
fine.
Thank you, everyone.
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Having come this far, it looks like I'll be fine. / Thank you, everyone.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_008.en:
Save the goodbyes for later.
You'd better get going.
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Save the goodbyes for later, / you'd better hurry.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_009.en:
Okay...
I'm going.
Thank you too, Gray.
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Okay... / I'm going. / Thank you too, Gray.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Heat source at 3 o'clock!

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_011.en:
It's a wanzer!«g:24»
Launcher type confirmed!
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's a vanzer!«g:24» / Launcher type confirmed!

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_012.en:
Thought so.
All units, defend Rachel's vehicle
at all costs.
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As expected. / All units, defend Rachel's vehicle to the death.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_013.en:
Rachel, head for the point!
Hurry!
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rachel, head for the point! / Hurry!

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Okay...!

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_015.en:
If that thing targets the car from
range, it won't stand a chance.
Take down the Launcher types first.
All units, commence operation.
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If the vehicle is targeted from enemy range, / it won't stand a chance. / Shoot down launcher types first. / All units, operation start.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_016.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit or
Rachel's vehicle destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down or / Rachel's vehicle shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_018.en:
Target confirmed.
Commencing mission.
The backpack is unusable, but that
is no problem...
I will simply bring down that
vehicle.
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Target confirmed. / Starting mission. / The backpack is unusable, but / no problem... / I'll just bring down that vehicle.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Him, huh...

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_020.en:
Gray, let's pay him back for last
time, yeah?
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gray, let's pay back what we owe from last time?

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_021.en:
You bet.
This time I'll protect her, no matter
what!
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Of course. / This time I'll protect her to the end!

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_022.en:
The machine that governs death...
is falling...?
Mission... failed...
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The one who governs death... / this unit is falling... / Mission... failed...

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed special unit silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_024.en:
Not yet.
We mop up the remaining forces.
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Not yet. / Sweep the remaining forces.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_026.en: If I can just get there...
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If I can make it this far...

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Phew... / We made it.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_028.en:
Rachel, get inside the facility.
We'll stay and mop up the rest.
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rachel, take shelter in the facility as is. / We'll stay and sweep the remaining forces.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Okay...!

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_030.en: Now we can fight all we want.
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So now we can fight to our heart's content.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_031.en:
Target cannot be acquired...
It appears to have left the combat
area.
The mission has failed, but the
mercenary unit must be given death...
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Target cannot be acquired... / It seems to have left the battle line. / The mission failed, but the mercenary unit / must be given death...

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_032.en:
Target destruction confirmed.
Mission accomplished.
Now all is buried in darkness.
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Target destruction confirmed. / Mission accomplished. / With this, everything is in darkness.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rachel!!

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_034.en:
Escort target destroyed...
The mission's failed...
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Escort target shot down, confirmed... / Mission failed...

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed all enemies silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Phew... / We somehow cleaned it up.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_037.en:
Mission complete.
All units, you're cleared to see
Rachel off.
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission complete. / All units have permission to see Rachel off.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? Yes!

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_039.en:
To the airport, then.
Let's go!
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The airport, right. / Let's go.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 1 hour later...

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_041.en:
I hate to say goodbye, but...
it's almost time.
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm sad to part, but / it's about time.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_042.en:
Yeah. Thank you all, really.
I don't know what to say...
It may be your job, but you saved
my life.
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah, everyone, thank you so much. / I don't know what to say... / Even if it's your job, you saved my life.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_043.en: Ha ha, you're making too much of it.
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Haha, that's an exaggeration.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_044.en:
Gray sure put his body on the line
more than usual this time!
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gray especially put his body on the line / more than his usual job!

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_045.en:
Hey, hey, that makes it sound like
I never do anything!
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hey hey, that makes it sound like I / don't do anything usually!

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_046.en:
Hee hee.
I'll have to work hard too!
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hehehe. / I have to do my best too!

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_047.en:
Oh, Rachel!
When I go home on leave, show me
some of the trendy places to eat!
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Rachel. / When I go home on leave, please / introduce me to trendy tasty places!

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_048.en:
Hee hee, I'd love to.
What do you like, Oddeye?
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hehe, gladly. / Oddeye, what do you like?

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm... tonkotsu ramen?

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_050.en:
Oh, that's all the rage right now.
I know a place that's sooo good,
I'll take you there.
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh, that's trendy now. / I know a super tasty place, / so I'll introduce you.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ooh, I'm looking forward to it!

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_052.en:
Oh, Gray, about that person who
looks like me... a girlfriend?
Or maybe a wife back home?
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Gray, / come to think of it, the person who resembles me, is it your girlfriend? / Maybe you have a wife back home?

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_053.en:
Oh, that...
It's my sister.
She was in an accident, and she
still hasn't woken up.
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, that topic... / My sister. / She's still unconscious after an accident.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_054.en:
Oh, the poor thing...
Isn't there something I can do...?
I could recommend a good hospital,
too. Don't hesitate to ask.
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh, how sad... / Isn't there something I could help with... / I can introduce good hospitals too, / so don't hesitate to say.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_055.en:
Huh, that's kind of you.
I might take you up on that.
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Huh, that's appreciated. / I might consult you sometime.

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_056.en:
Well then, goodbye.
Don't do anything reckless, all of
you.
Captain «E801:00», thank you so much!
Thanks to you, I've got loads of
scoops on top of what I came for.
And Rain, I'm rooting for you!
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well then, goodbye. / Everyone, don't be reckless. / Captain «E801:00», / thank you very much! / Thanks to you, besides my original goal, / I've got lots of scoops. / Miss Rain, I'm praying it goes well for you too!

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_057.en:
Honestly...
I told you it's not like that!
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Honestly... / I keep telling you it's not like that!

MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_058.en:
I don't know what brought you here.
But you're the only reporter who's
covered what's happening on Huffman.
...Take care of yourself.
MsgLabels_tactics_32_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I don't know what purpose you came here for. / But you're the only reporter who's covered / the incidents happening on Huffman now. / ...Take care of your life.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_001.en:
The army's been a lot more active
lately, hasn't it?
Huge shipments of supplies are
coming in from the mainland, too.
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The army's movements have gotten more active lately. / Large amounts of supplies are being sent from the home country.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_002.en:
Nothing unusual for Huffman.
As mercs, it's no concern of ours.
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's not unusual on Huffman. / We mercenaries probably don't need to worry.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_003.en:
Still, with that many supplies they
could keep thousands, tens of
thousands of troops going.
You could almost call it preparing
for war.
If it comes to war, I'd think it'll
affect us mercs too.
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But with that quantity of supplies, they could sustain / thousands, tens of thousands of soldiers. / It could even be seen as preparation for war. / If it becomes war, I think it'll affect / us mercenaries too.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_004.en:
Mercs on Huffman help hold the
border.
But we're not given the strength to
break it.
We're just a shield while that
strength is built up.
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mercenaries on Huffman contribute to maintaining / the territorial borders. / But they aren't given the power / to break that. / We're nothing more than a shield while that power is prepared.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_005.en:
So is the army trying to tip the
balance...?
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I wonder if the army is trying / to break that balance...

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_006.en:
I don't know their real intent, but
anyone can guess.
If there's no place left for us, we
leave Huffman. Simple as that.
There's no shortage of trouble spots.
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I don't know the true intent, but it's within / the range anyone can guess. / If there's no place left for us, we just / leave Huffman. / There are any number of fishy places.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_007.en:
Leave Huffman...
But before that... our missing
comrades, the black unit working in
the shadows... Don't mercs even have
the right to know the truth...?
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Leave Huffman... / But before that, the comrades who went missing, / the black unit operating in the shadows... don't mercenaries / have the right to know the truth...

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_008.en:
Normally it wouldn't be strange for
special forces to be looking into
that.
But if nothing's reached us, when
we've fought them several times...
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Normally it wouldn't be strange for special forces / to be moving to investigate that. / But the fact that the truth isn't reaching us, / who've fought them several times...

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_009.en:
After all those casualties...
Does that make mercs just pawns to be
thrown away?
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even though there were so many victims... / Does it mean mercenaries are disposable pawns?

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_010.en:
That's what the contract fee is for.
It was in the papers you signed when
you volunteered.
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's what the contract money is for. / It should have been written in the documents / when you volunteered as a mercenary.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_011.en:
Paid to be the army's shield, huh...
I guess that IS the contract...
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Get paid and be the army's shield... huh. / That certainly is the contract...

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_012.en:
Official military paperwork is always
written to be convoluted and
roundabout.
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The army's official documents are written in / complicated, roundabout wording.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_013.en:
Our missing comrades, the black unit
working in the shadows... Don't mercs
even have the right to know the
truth...?
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The comrades who went missing, the black unit / operating in the shadows... don't mercenaries / have the right to know the truth...

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_015.en:
Paid to be the army's shield, huh...
I guess that IS the contract...
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Get paid and be the army's shield... huh. / That certainly is the contract...

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_017.en:
Those two over there are talking
with really serious faces.
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Those two over there are talking / with complicated faces.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_018.en:
About merc contracts, right?
The army pays you fight money, you
fight. That's all there is to it.
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's about mercenary contracts, right? / Get fight money from the army and fight. / That's all it is, isn't it.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Simple.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_020.en:
It is simple.
You either sign the contract or you
don't. And the ones who signed are
here. That's all there is to it.
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It certainly is simple. / Whether you sign the contract documents. / And those who signed are here. / That's all there is to it.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Signing's my specialty.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_022.en:
Champ thought the contract was an
autograph board and signed it, right?
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ signed the contract documents / mistaking them for an autograph board, right?

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_023.en:
Ha ha ha!
Even a muscle-head doesn't go around
that brainless, y'know?
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hahaha! / Even a muscle-brain man / doesn't act without thinking that much, you know?

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_024.en:
Huh? But Rain said so!
She said, "Champ was probably drunk
and signed the contract thinking it
was for a fan, right?"
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh, but Miss Rain said so, you know? / That Champ was probably drunk and / mistook them for a fan's and / signed the contract documents, right?

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_025.en:
Oddeye doesn't know me, fine...
But Rain!?
Seriously, who do you people think
I am!?
I'll have you know!
I'm the first champion to take the
mixed martial arts triple crown and
unify the belts!
The great one with a record twelve
title defences!
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye doesn't know me, fine... / But Rain! / I mean, who does everyone / think I am? / I, the great me! / The first champion to conquer the mixed martial arts / triple crown and unify the belts! / And the great holder of a 12-defense record!

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A drunk, a show-off, a weird muscle-brain man?

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_027.en:
That's too long!
And why's it get longer every time!?
Please, just stop at muscle-head...
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's too long! / And why does it keep growing every time! / Please, let me off with just muscle-brain man...

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It certainly is long.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_029.en:
My glory...
What was it all for...
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: My glory... / what was it all for...

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_030.en:
We moving out?
Alright, let's go wild!
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie. / Alright, I'm gonna run wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_031.en:
The Captain says it's too long, so
I'll think up something shorter.
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The Captain shot it down, so / I'll think of a slightly shorter name.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_032.en:
Oh, a sortie?
I'll get ready!
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, a sortie, right. / I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_033.en:
The supplies are in.
Now all it takes is a spark, I tell
ya.
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The supplies arrived. / Now all it needs is a trigger.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_034.en:
Hmm, things really are turning out
like Shresh said...
The hangar's getting new gear
shipped in again, too...
Now even I'm getting nervous.
Hm? That's rare, Gabriel.
Are you laughing?
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm, somehow it's turning out / just like Thresh said... / Actually, new products are being / supplied to the hangar again... / Even I'm getting anxious. / Hm, that's rare, Gabriel, / are you laughing?

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_035.en:
...Heh heh heh... weird...
...drunk... show-off...
...muscle-head... heh heh heh...
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...heh heh heh... a drunk... a show-off / ...weird... muscle-brain... heh heh heh...

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_036.en:
You know the mainland's been sending
huge amounts of supplies to this
island ahead of a large-scale
regular army operation?
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You know that, ahead of a large-scale regular army operation, / large amounts of supplies from the home country / are arriving on this island?

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_037.en:
I hear they're shipping in enough to
start a war.
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I hear they're bringing in enough supplies / to start a war.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_038.en:
Right.
Yesterday a transport unit reported
losses on the route they're using.
They were shot down before they even
spotted the enemy.
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm. / Actually, yesterday the transport unit / reported that on the route currently used for transport, / they were shot down before / they could confirm any enemy.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is the enemy a ground unit?

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_040.en:
Most likely.
...Normally we'd change the route,
but there are so many supplies that
we have no choice but to use this
highway.
So I want «E801:00» Squad to escort
the transport unit.
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Probably. / ...Normally we should change the route, / but there are so many supplies / that we have no choice but to use / this highway for transport. / So I want the «E801:00» squad to / escort the transport unit.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_041.en:
I see.
Did the wreckage of the downed units
leave any trace of the enemy?
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / Were any traces of the enemy unit / left in the wreckage of the downed unit?

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_042.en:
There were no heavy burn marks, so
it doesn't look like missiles.
Most likely long-range sniping by
wanzers, but the enemy force hasn't
been confirmed.
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Since no conspicuous burn marks / were found, / it doesn't seem to be missiles or the like. / It's thought to be sniping by WAPs / from enemy range, but the enemy forces / haven't been precisely confirmed.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_043.en:
Roger.
Sounds like anti-piercing armor's a
must. We'll sortie when we're ready.
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Anti-penetration armor seems essential. / Sortieing as soon as ready.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_044.en:
There were no heavy burn marks, so
it doesn't look like missiles.
Most likely long-range sniping by
wanzers, but the enemy force hasn't
been confirmed.
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Since no conspicuous burn marks / were found, / it doesn't seem to be missiles or the like. / It's thought to be sniping by WAPs / from enemy range, but the enemy forces / haven't been precisely confirmed.

MsgLabels_station_33_msg_045.en:
The information we put our lives on
the line to protect went home with
Rachel.

What was happening on Huffman Island.
The black unit working in the
shadows.
The organization half-glimpsed
behind it.
And, as the Captain had said, what
Rachel had really been looking for.
If all this had been made public, the
affair might have been stopped before
it grew any bigger.

But Rachel never broke the story...
MsgLabels_station_33_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The information we protected with our bodies / was sent to the home country with Rachel. /  / The incidents now happening on Huffman Island. / The black unit operating in the shadows. / The organization glimpsed behind it. / And the thing the Captain said Rachel / was really looking for. / If these were made public, perhaps / the swelling of the incidents / could have been prevented beforehand. /  / But Rachel never / published the news...

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_001.en:
This is the area where the transport
unit was attacked.
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This vicinity is where the transport unit / was attacked.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_002.en:
Roger.
All units, keep watch around you.
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / All units, don't neglect watching the surroundings.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_003.en:
Sure is a whole lotta nothing out
here...
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Still, there's nothing here...

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_004.en:
Yeah. Terrain-wise, it's a perfect
sniping spot.
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Terrain-wise it certainly is a perfect / sniping point.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_005.en:
That's a lot of transports.
Can we protect them all...?
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There are lots of transport units. / Can we protect them all...

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_006.en:
That's the mission.
If we stand still, we're good
targets. Get the transports moving.
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's the mission. / Standing still, we'll make good targets. / Move the transport unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Heat source at point 0808.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sniper unit after all...

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_009.en:
Enemy confirmed.
We will now escort the transport
unit.
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy units confirmed. / Now escorting the transport unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_010.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit or
Oddeye unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down or / Oddeye's unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_012.en:
Bingo!
Good old Lich.
Spot-on intel.
So this is the merc unit everyone's
talkin' about.
Then I'm gonna hunt 'em down and
enjoy every second!!
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Bingo! / As expected of Lich. / Accurate info. / So this is the rumored mercenary unit. / Then I'll hunt you without holding back!!

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_013.en:
Captain, more enemies...
It's a black wanzer.
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, more enemies... / black WAPs.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...He's a sniper type too.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Tch, at a time like this...

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_016.en:
Things just got worse, but we hold
the transports no matter what.
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The situation has worsened, but no matter what / we defend the transport unit to the death.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_017.en:
...This is special forces Delta.
«E801:00» Squad, do you read?
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...This is special forces Delta. / «E801:00» squad, do you read?

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_018.en:
Captain, a transmission from the
army's special forces.
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, a transmission from the army's special forces.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_019.en:
This is «E801:00» Squad.
Delta 1, it's been a while.
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is the «E801:00» squad. / Delta 1, it's been a while.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Ah, that person...)

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_021.en:
Our mission is to escort the
transport unit and support «E801:00»
Squad.
Commencing operation.
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Our mission is to escort the transport unit and / support the «E801:00» squad. / Starting mission now.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_022.en:
Nobody told me, but if it's Delta 1,
I can trust you.
Glad to have you.
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I hadn't heard about this, but Delta 1 / I can trust. / Counting on you.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_023.en:
Huh?
Special forces are joining in?
Well, that just means more targets!
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Huh? / Special forces have joined in? / Still, it's just more targets!

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_024.en:
«E801:00» Squad, that machine...
What exactly are you fighting...?
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: «E801:00» squad, that unit... / What exactly are you fighting...?

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Umm... / It's a mysterious organization.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_026.en:
(...That voice, that way of
talking... It can't be.)
A mysterious organization...
I'll hear about it later.
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (...That voice, that way of talking... no way.) / A mysterious organization... I'll hear about it later.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_028.en:
Dammit...
Stupid special forces...
The hunt's off for now.
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Damn... / Freaking special forces... / The hunt is postponed.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sniper retreating.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_030.en:
Continue mopping up the remaining
forces.
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Continue sweeping the remaining forces.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is Delta 1, roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed all enemies silenced. / No reinforcements either.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_033.en:
From here the transport unit should
be able to get clear.
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Having come this far, the transport unit / should be able to get away.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_034.en:
«E801:00» Squad, good work on the
escort.
You're free to return to base.
Delta will handle the cleanup.
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: «E801:00» squad, good work on the escort mission. / You may return to base as is. / Delta will handle the aftermath.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_035.en:
Roger. Mission complete.
Thanks for the support. It helped.
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. Mission complete. / The support helped. Thank you.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_036.en:
You seem to have gotten even
stronger since last time.
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Still, you seem to have gotten / even stronger.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_037.en:
Oh, well, it's been one hard time
after another...
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well, it's been one hardship after another...

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_038.en:
Oddeye, honestly...
Making small talk with special
forces...
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hey, Oddeye... / Small talk with special forces...

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye... a code name, huh.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_040.en:
Yes! My eyes are odd eyes, one blue
and one silver.
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, my eyes are odd-eyed, / blue and silver.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_041.en:
I knew it...
That's what you always used to say to
people you'd just met...
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As I thought... / You've always said that / to people you've just met...

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_042.en:
...It really is you, David.
I sort of thought so from your voice.
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...So it is David. / From your voice I kind of / thought so.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_043.en:
I'm sorry, Kate...
Delta's still on a mission.
There's no time right now.
I'll stop by your base to resupply
later.
MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry, Kate... / Delta is still on a mission. / There's no time now. / We'll stop at your base later to resupply.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / We'll return first.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_046.en:
Oddeye...
So you knew the special forces
captain.
