MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye... / seems she knew the special forces captain.

MsgLabels_tactics_33_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah, I'm surprised...

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What is this awkward atmosphere...

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: She's different from usual...

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_003.en:
Looks like something happened
between them in the past...
MsgLabels_station_34_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Seems something happened in the past...

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_004.en:
Oh? So Delta's here.
I should say hello.
MsgLabels_station_34_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hoh, Delta is here? / I'll say hello.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_005.en:
Ah, Captain...
It might be best not to talk to
those two right now...
MsgLabels_station_34_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Captain... / It'd be better not to talk to those two right now...

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_006.en:
Just a hello.
Shouldn't be a problem.
MsgLabels_station_34_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Just a greeting. / Should be no problem.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_007.en:
Ah, Captain...
It might be best not to talk to
those two right now...
MsgLabels_station_34_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Captain... / It'd be better not to talk to those two right now...

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: She's different from usual...

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_010.en:
We moving out?
Alright, let's go wild!
MsgLabels_station_34_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie. / Alright, I'm gonna run wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What is this awkward atmosphere...

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_014.en: ...Two and a half years, isn't it.
MsgLabels_station_34_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Two and a half years, huh.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_015.en:
...Three years and two months.
Every database record I could access
said killed in action.
And most of your service records had
been erased.
MsgLabels_station_34_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Three years and two months. / In the accessible database records, / all killed in action. / And almost all activity records / had vanished.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_016.en:
I was in the army that whole time.
I'm sorry, but I can't tell you any
more than that...
MsgLabels_station_34_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I was in the army that whole time. / Sorry, but I can't say more than that...

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_017.en:
...Special forces rules, I suppose?
The records were wiped too neatly,
so I figured it out...
...Do you think that's cool, or
something?
...You're going to vanish again
without a word, aren't you?
...Did you forget your promise to me!?
MsgLabels_station_34_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...That's a special forces rule too, right? / The records had been unnaturally erased, / so I could tell... / ...You think that sort of thing is cool? / ...You'll just disappear again / without saying anything, right? / ...Did you forget your promise to me!?

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_018.en:
Kate... I'm sorry.
It's almost time for the mission.
If you still feel the way you did
back then...
...Hm.
Captain «E801:00», I presume?
MsgLabels_station_34_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Kate... I'm sorry. / It's almost time for the mission. / If your feelings are still as they were then... / ...Hm. / Captain «E801:00», right?

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_019.en: Sorry. I just wanted to say hello.
MsgLabels_station_34_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry, but just let me say hello.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_020.en:
Your squad is a good team.
I should have come to greet you
myself, but I spent the time
greeting an old acquaintance.
MsgLabels_station_34_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This squad is a good team. / Normally I should be the one greeting you, / but I spent the time greeting an old acquaintance.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: An old acquaintance...

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_022.en:
No need to worry about it.
Isn't it time for your mission?
See you on the battlefield.
MsgLabels_station_34_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No need to worry. / Isn't it time for your mission? / Until the battlefield again.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_023.en:
Captain «E801:00», I apologize.
It seems I shouldn't have come here.
MsgLabels_station_34_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00», I'm sorry. / It seems I shouldn't have come here.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_025.en:
Kate, when this mission is over, I
mean to keep my promise this time.
...It's time. I'm heading straight
out.
MsgLabels_station_34_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Kate, when this mission is over, / this time I mean to keep the promise. / ...It's time, I'm sortieing straight from here.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_027.en:
Huh? A mission, right?
Of course I'm going.
MsgLabels_station_34_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh, it's a mission, right. / Of course I'm going.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_028.en:
Maybe that black wanzer unit's gonna
be the spark...
MsgLabels_station_34_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I wonder if that black vanzer unit / will create the trigger...

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_029.en:
Word is Shresh's been reading nothing
but conspiracy books lately.
Hope it doesn't get in the way of
his work...
MsgLabels_station_34_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Lately Thresh has apparently been reading / nothing but conspiracy theory books and such. / Hope it doesn't affect his work...

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Oddeye / ...knew Delta, huh......

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_031.en:
At the brass's request, this is a
joint op with special forces.
MsgLabels_station_34_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: At the request of the army's upper echelons, / a joint operation with special forces.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_032.en:
Delta, then.
So that's why they were resupplying
here.
MsgLabels_station_34_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Delta, huh. / So that's why they were resupplying at this base.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_033.en:
Right.
You've fought that black unit
several times now.
That experience got noticed, and the
army came to us directly.
MsgLabels_station_34_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm. / You've fought that black unit / several times. / That experience was valued, and the military / requested the operation directly.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_034.en:
So the army's finally getting off
its backside.
MsgLabels_station_34_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So the military finally got off its heavy behind.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_035.en:
Special forces posing as mercs have
already infiltrated the op area.
For whatever reason, the black unit
goes after skilled mercs.
MsgLabels_station_34_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The special forces, posing as mercenaries, have already / infiltrated the operation area ahead. / I don't know why, but the black unit / targets excellent mercenaries.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_036.en:
I see. If this op succeeds, we might
find a lead on the missing mercs too.
MsgLabels_station_34_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see, so if this operation succeeds, / we might get a lead on / the mercenaries who went missing.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_037.en:
But if word gets out that the
regulars are involved, at a time
like this, it could turn into an
international incident.
Hence the merc disguise.
And with special forces skills, the
people hungry for good pilots won't
be able to resist.
Get out there now and take your
orders from special forces.
MsgLabels_station_34_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: However, if it becomes widely known that the regular army / is intervening, in this tense period, / it could lead to international problems. / That's the reason for the mercenary disguise. / Moreover, with special forces skill, / those who want pilot ability / won't stay quiet. / Go to the site immediately and receive / operation instructions from the special forces.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood.

MsgLabels_station_34_msg_039.en:
Special forces posing as mercs have
already infiltrated the op area.
Get out there now and take your
orders from special forces.
MsgLabels_station_34_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The special forces, posing as mercenaries, have already / infiltrated the operation area ahead. / Go to the site immediately and receive / the special forces' operation instructions.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_001.en:
This is the op area.
Rain, anything from Delta?
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So this is the operation area. / Rain, any transmission from Delta?

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Not yet. / No contact.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_003.en:
Another joint op with Delta, huh.
Say what you want, we keep crossin'
paths.
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A joint operation with Delta again. / Say what you want, we've got some connection with them.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Fighting alongside them is reassuring.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, are you okay?

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? / Yes, I'm okay.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_008.en:
Oddeye, special forces throw away
their pasts, just like mercs.
That's what codenames are for.
Don't look back right now.
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, just like mercenaries, / special forces members have thrown away their pasts. / That's what code names are for. / Don't look back on the past now.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / I understand...

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_010.en:
Oddeye?
I understand that you're worried.
But we're up against the black unit.
Focus on the mission for now.
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye? / I understand that you're worried. / But the opponent is the black unit. / Focus on the operation now.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_011.en:
...Phew.
Roger!
I'm a professional merc too, you
know. I'm fine now!
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Phew. / Roger! / I'm a professional mercenary too. / I'm fine now!

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_012.en:
If you say so...
Captain!
Enemy signatures confirmed.
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If so, good... / Captain! / Enemy signatures confirmed.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_013.en: And still no word from Delta.
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: With still no contact from Delta?

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_014.en: Oddeye, can you use the sonar?
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, can you use the sonar?

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_015.en:
No good.
The noise is terrible...
I can't pick anything up.
Did something happen?
The battlefield's in total chaos...
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No good. / The noise is terrible... / I can't collect sound. / Did something happen? / The battlefield is awfully chaotic...

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_016.en:
It can't be helped.
We engage.
All units, intercept positions.
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It can't be helped. / We'll engage the enemy. / All units, take intercept stance.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_018.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit or
Oddeye unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down or / Oddeye's unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_020.en:
What's this?
Now it's that merc unit...
Hey, mercs, I know you can hear me!
Those special forces boys playin'
merc? Not much of a fight at all.
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What's this? / Now it's that mercenary unit... / Hey, mercenary unit, you can hear me, right!? / Those special forces guys pretending / to be mercenaries had no bite at all.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_021.en:
What!?
You mean Delta was wiped out before
we even got here...?
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What!? / You're saying Delta was wiped out / before we came...

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_022.en:
Huh?
Didn't you hear me?
Now you lot make my hunt fun, got
it!?
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Huh? / Didn't you hear? / You guys, make my hunt / fun for me!

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_024.en: Th-this guy's out of his damn mind...
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Th-this guy's crazy...

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...This is... Delta 1... / Faceless...

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_026.en:
David!?
Captain, a transmission from Delta 1.
The signal's weak.
I finally picked it up!
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: David!? / Captain, a transmission from Delta 1. / It's a faint signal. / I finally received it!

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_027.en:
Sorry... the op was blown and the
team's been wiped out...
Hard as it is to believe... military
secrets were leaked.
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry, the operation details leaked and / the team was annihilated... / Unbelievably... the army's secrets / seem to have leaked.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_028.en:
Roger.
That's enough.
Leave this to us and withdraw.
Regroup.
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Leave the rest. / Leave it to us and retreat. / Regroup.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_029.en:
I can't do that.
I'll complete the mission with this
machine.
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But I can't do that. / I'll fulfill the mission with this unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_030.en:
...
You... always like that...
Playing the hero with your
self-sacrifice...
Think about the people waiting for
you to come home!!
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ... / You're... always like that... / Playing hero with self-sacrifice... / Think about the people / waiting for you to come back!!

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye...

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_032.en:
Oddeye, stop.
He's special forces.
...A soldier whose pride is in
carrying out the mission.
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, stop. / He's special forces. / ...A soldier who stakes his pride / on carrying out the mission.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_033.en:
...Kate, I threw away my past when I
volunteered for special forces.
Like Captain «E801:00» says, I live
to carry out the mission...
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Kate, since I volunteered for special forces / I threw away my past. / As Captain «E801:00» says, I live / to carry out missions...

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_034.en:
...Then why did you disappear
without a word!?
...Is that all we were!?
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Why did you disappear / without a word!? / ...Was that all our relationship was!?

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_035.en:
...I'm sorry.
I didn't want to drag you into it.
This is Delta 1.
Continuing the mission!
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I'm sorry. / I didn't want to cause you trouble. / This is Delta 1. / Continuing the mission!

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Idiot. / I don't care anymore.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...All units, support Faceless's unit. / Got it?

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Mission... failed.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: N-no... / David!!

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_040.en:
Hah... hah... finally took him down,
but... dammit, my sight system's
busted...
Tch, guess I'll haul this tough guy
back with me...
Looks like he's still barely
breathin'!!
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Huff, huff... it finally sank, but... / Damn, the sight system's malfunctioning... / Tch, can't be helped, I'll take this tough guy / home with me... / Looks like he's still barely alive!!

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I won't let you!

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_042.en:
Hm? A woman?
Cute voice you got there.
But I'm outta here, see?
I'll play with you next time!
Ha ha ha ha!
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hm, a woman? / That's a cute voice. / But I'm running away, you know? / I'll play with you next time! / Hahahaha!

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_043.en:
...Mop up the remaining forces, then
we go after him.
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Sweep the remaining forces and pursue him.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed all enemies silenced...

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_045.en:
Sorry, but... we're spent.
Ain't got the gas left to chase him...
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sadly... we seem to be too worn out. / There's no stamina left to chase him...

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_046.en:
Besides, tracking him now would be
hard.
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: And chasing him from now would be difficult.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_047.en:
The wanzer Delta was flying belongs to
a merc unit.
So it should have a transmitter.
We'll go back and resupply. I'll ask
the Commander to be ready to search
right away.
And all of you, erase the comm logs
of Oddeye and Faceless's exchange.
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The WAP Delta was piloting / belongs to a mercenary unit. / Then it should be fitted with a transmitter. / We'll go back to resupply once, and I'll talk to / the Commander so we can search right away. / Also, everyone, erase the recording of / Oddeye's conversation with Faceless.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry, Captain...

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_049.en: Oddeye, I'm sure he'll be fine.
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, I'm sure he'll be fine.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_050.en:
Yeah.
Even among special forces, Delta's
in a class of its own.
As soldiers, they're on a whole other
level.
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah. / Even among special forces, Delta is in a class of its own. / Even as soldiers, they're on a / totally different level.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_051.en:
No way the leader of an outfit like
that goes down that easy.
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There's no way the captain of a unit like that / would go down easily.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_052.en:
That's right.
Faceless is no ordinary soldier.
Alright, we return to base at once
and prepare for round two.
MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / Faceless is no ordinary soldier. / Good, return to base quickly / and prepare for a rematch.

MsgLabels_tactics_34_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Everyone, thank you...

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_001.en:
Captain, it seems Oddeye has gone
out on recon by herself.
MsgLabels_station_35_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, it seems Oddeye has gone out / scouting alone.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What did you say?

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_003.en:
Sorry, Captain...
I tried to stop her, but...
MsgLabels_station_35_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry, Captain... / I tried to stop her too...

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Will that girl be alright...

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Delta 1. / Faceless, huh.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_006.en:
They looked close... like they might
have been lovers once.
MsgLabels_station_35_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: They looked like they'd been lovers in the past, / or that close a relationship.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_007.en: The captain of Delta, of all people...
MsgLabels_station_35_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The captain of Delta...

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_008.en:
This is bad. With military intel
leaking, going on recon alone...
MsgLabels_station_35_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is bad; scouting alone in this situation / where army info is leaking...

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_009.en: We should go after her right away.
MsgLabels_station_35_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We'd better go after her right away too.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_010.en:
Tch. We only just got back, so the
maintenance crew's probably off
duty...
Let's at least get our own gear
sorted.
MsgLabels_station_35_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Tch, at this hour, right after our return, / the maintenance crew is on break... / Let's at least get our own equipment ready.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_011.en:
Right. I'll go talk to the
Commander.
MsgLabels_station_35_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm, I'll go hear what the Commander says.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_012.en: We should go after her right away.
MsgLabels_station_35_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We'd better go after her right away too.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Let's hurry.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_014.en:
Tch. We only just got back, so the
maintenance crew's probably off
duty...
Let's at least get our own gear
sorted.
MsgLabels_station_35_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Tch, at this hour, right after our return, / the maintenance crew is on break... / Let's at least get our own equipment ready.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_015.en:
Oddeye, don't do anything stupid
till we get there...
MsgLabels_station_35_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, don't do anything reckless / until we get there...

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_016.en: I'll get ready to sortie too.
MsgLabels_station_35_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll get ready to sortie too.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We'd better hurry...

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_018.en:
Huh?
Oddeye sortied, so I figured you
were all going together.
Shresh and the maintenance crew
already went back to their quarters.
Guess I'll call it a night too...
MsgLabels_station_35_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Huh? / Since Oddeye sortied, / I assumed you were all together. / Thresh and the maintenance crew seem to have / already gone back to the barracks. / Maybe I'll head back soon too...

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_019.en:
...Oddeye... sortied alone...
...I told her... new weapons came
in... but she didn't even change
her gear...
MsgLabels_station_35_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Oddeye... sortied alone... / ...I told her... new weapons / ...came in, but... she didn't even change her equipment...

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_020.en:
The brass has issued a request to
rescue the Delta personnel.
Oddeye already knew about it, so I
gave her permission to scout ahead.
MsgLabels_station_35_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A request has come from the army's upper echelons / to rescue the Delta members. / I gave Oddeye, who already knew of this mission, / permission to scout.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_021.en:
So that's why she went...
Falcon, didn't you read my report?
Why did you let her go alone?
Unless we act on the assumption that
intel has leaked, going solo means
death.
MsgLabels_station_35_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So that's why she sortied... / Falcon, didn't you read the report? / Why did you permit a solo sortie? / Unless we act on the premise that information is leaking, / acting alone means death.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_022.en:
I've already forwarded the report to
the brass.
But the brass won't admit there's
been a leak...!
MsgLabels_station_35_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The report has already been forwarded to the upper echelons. / But those upper echelons / don't acknowledge the information leak...!

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_023.en:
On a normal mission, a unit of
Delta's caliber wouldn't make that
kind of mistake.
Odds are classified intel is
reaching the enemy.
MsgLabels_station_35_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: On a normal mission, a Delta-class / unit wouldn't make a mistake. / The possibility that classified information is reaching the enemy / is high.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_024.en:
Yes, you're quite right.
But they also told me to hurry the
rescue...
And she was so set on going, I gave
in and said yes...
I'm sorry.
MsgLabels_station_35_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, exactly as you say. / But I was also told to hurry the rescue... / And I lost to her forcefulness demanding to sortie, / and permitted it before I knew it... / I'm sorry.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_025.en:
Every second counts.
Get the maintenance crew out of bed.
...We sortie immediately.
MsgLabels_station_35_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Every moment counts. / Wake up the maintenance crew. / ...We sortie immediately.

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_026.en:
Is special forces intel really
leaking?
If so, this base's intel is at risk
too...
MsgLabels_station_35_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is special forces information really / leaking? / If so, this base's information is in danger too...

MsgLabels_station_35_msg_027.en:
Is special forces intel really
leaking?
If so, this base's intel is at risk
too...
MsgLabels_station_35_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is special forces information really / leaking? / If so, this base's information is in danger too...

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_001.en: You just don't quit, do ya...
MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You're persistent...

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_002.en:
...I finally found you!
Do you understand what you've done!?
MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I finally found you! / Do you understand / what you've done!

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_003.en:
Huh?
That's my job, ain't it?
Besides, you lot have been takin'
out my buddies on your missions too.
You do this work 'cause you like it,
right?
MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Huh? / That's my mission, so? / I mean, you guys have taken down / our comrades on missions too. / You do that kind of work because you like it, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_004.en:
I like machines, but I don't like
killing people!
What you did... is unforgivable!
MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I may like machines, but I don't / like killing people! / What you did... is unforgivable!

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_005.en:
Oh, here we go. Can't win the
argument, so now you're mad?
Funny thing to hear from somebody
who fights for a paycheck.
Whatever. You wanted to see your
boyfriend, right?
Too bad. In the shape he's in, he
ain't ever holdin' you again.
Hey, if you want, I could comfort
you instead, huh?
MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ahh, ahh, things get inconvenient so you snap back? / That doesn't sound like the line of someone / who's a mercenary to earn money. / Well, whatever, you wanted / to see your boyfriend, right? / Too bad, with that body he probably / can't hold you anymore. / Ah, if you like, I could / comfort you instead?

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_007.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit or
Oddeye unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down or / Oddeye's unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_009.en:
Oddeye's machine located.
Oddeye!«g:24» Are you alright!?
MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye's unit found. / Oddeye!«g:24» Are you okay!?

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_011.en:
Oddeye, don't act alone.
Trust your squad.
Regroup with us now, then we attack.
Understood?
MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, don't act alone. / Trust the squad. / We'll join up at once and attack the enemy. / Got it?

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Ah, Captain... / I'm sorry...

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_013.en:
Oddeye, did you find the Delta
personnel?
MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, have you found / the Delta members?

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I confirmed the members' deaths.

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_015.en:
So they were already killed in
action...
MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So they're already killed in action...

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_016.en:
Huh?«g:24» Killed in action?
Nah, not quite.
They kept fightin' back even in
restraints, so I tortured 'em, one
at a time.
MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Huh?«g:24» Killed in action? / That's wrong. / Those guys resisted even wearing / restraints, / so I tortured them one by one.

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What a guy...

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_018.en:
Ha ha ha!
Nice and careful, one toe at a time.
Did ya know if you crush a person
from the edges in, they start
lookin' like some other kind of
creature?
Most of 'em died partway through,
but the one who looked like the
leader? Tough son of a gun.
MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hahaha! / Carefully, one at a time, starting from the toes. / Did you know that people, when you crush them / starting from the edges, look like / some other creature? / Still, most of them / died partway through, but the one who seemed like the captain / was tenacious.

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That guy isn't sane.

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_020.en:
Oddeye, don't let him bait you.
All units, cover Oddeye.
MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, don't fall for his provocation. / All units, support Oddeye's unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes!

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_022.en:
Damn iiit!
I-I was wrong... I was wrong... help
me!!
The cockpit... it's... f-fire...!!
My hair, my hair's burning!
Aaagh...!!
MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Damn it! / I, I was wrong... help me!! / In the cockpit... eek, fire...!! / My hair, my hair is burning! / Agaah...!!

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Black unit shot down!

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed all enemies silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_025.en:
Roger.
Oddeye, do you know where the
personnel are?
MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Oddeye, do you know where / the members are?

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...This way.

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_027.en:
Oddeye, let's take our honored
comrades home...
All units, leave no trace of Delta.
We take everything back.
MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, we're bringing my precious comrades-in-arms / home... / All units, leave no trace of Delta. / We take everything back.

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_029.en:
Captain... I couldn't find Faceless's
body anywhere I looked.
Even though his things are here...
MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain... Faceless's body / couldn't be found no matter where I searched. / Even though his belongings are there...

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_030.en:
Oddeye, that's enough.
I'll search. Rest a while.
MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, that's enough. / I'll search. Rest a bit.

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_031.en:
We'll look too.
Gray, Champ, take the building to the
north, please.
MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We'll search too. / Gray and Champ, please take the north building.

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_032.en:
It's no use.
I've checked everywhere...
Captain, I found a message capsule in
his dog tag, addressed to me.
...May I keep it?
MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's useless. / I checked everything... / Captain, in his ID tag I found / a message capsule addressed to me. / ...May I have it?

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_033.en:
I didn't see any such thing.
Do as you like.
MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I didn't see any such thing. / Do as you like.

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Thank you.

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Recovery work complete.

MsgLabels_tactics_35_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission... complete.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_001.en:
Oddeye hasn't come by since we got
back.
That mission must have been hard on
her...
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: After returning, Oddeye hasn't come here. / It was a painful mission for her...

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...A mission, right. / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_003.en:
Oddeye...? Now that you mention it,
she headed for the hangar looking
lost in thought.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye... come to think of it, she seemed to go / to the hangar lost in thought.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...A sortie, huh.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_005.en:
Oddeye?
She was in the hangar working on her
wanzer just a minute ago.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye? / She was maintaining her WAP / in the hangar until a bit ago.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Mission understood.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_007.en:
You took quite a beating too,
huh...
Okay, that's the armor done.
Frame checks out too.
Oh, Captain.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You got pretty banged up too, huh... / Okay, the armor treatment's done, I think. / Frame no problem either. / Ah, Captain.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_008.en:
Working on your wanzer?
You're keen.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Maintaining your WAP. / You're diligent.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_009.en:
It takes my mind off things.
If I'm not doing something, I feel
like I'll just keep sinking.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's a change of pace. / If I'm not doing something, / I feel like I'll just keep sinking.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's about Faceless.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_011.en:
Yes.
We were together back when I was in
the JDF.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / We were dating back in my Japan Defense days.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So it seems.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_013.en:
A few days after David went missing,
I searched the military database.
Within days, a death record that
didn't add up was entered, and then
his personal data disappeared
altogether.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A few days after David went missing, / I looked into the army database. / Within days an unnatural death record was written, / and then the personal data itself / disappeared.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You looked at army data?

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_015.en:
Yes.
I worked in that kind of section, so
it was easy.
But I'd touched classified material,
so I got out before anyone found out
I'd looked.
After that I used all sorts of
contacts to dig into the most
secretive special forces units...
Security was too tight to get the
personnel files, but I found out a
lot of special forces had been sent
to Huffman Island recently.
So...
I thought maybe I'd find him, and
signed up as a merc.
I've always liked wanzers anyway.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / I was in that kind of section, / so it was easy. / But since I'd touched classified material, I left the service / before the access was discovered. / After that, through various connections, I investigated / special forces that seemed highly classified... / The security was tight so the members' data / was impossible, but I found out / that lots of special forces had recently / been dispatched to Huffman Island. / So... / thinking I might be able to meet him, I volunteered / as a mercenary. / I always liked WAPs anyway.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: And you actually met him.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_017.en:
Yes...
I found him.
I found him, and...
Why didn't he tell me even one
word...? I couldn't hold that
feeling back...
I might have hurt him.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes... / I met him. / Even though I met him... / Why didn't he say a single word... / I couldn't hold back that feeling... / Maybe I hurt him.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_018.en:
He's the captain of an elite unit,
even by special forces standards.
He'd have been ready to give up
everything to carry out his mission.
But he met you again on the
battlefield, and heard from you.
That alone would have made him happy,
as a man.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: He's the captain of an elite unit / even among special forces. / He must have been prepared to throw away everything / and carry out the mission. / But he met you again on the battlefield / and got to hear your words. / That alone must have made him happy as a person.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_019.en:
Special forces was his dream, too.
I used to cheer him on, back then...
But all I could say was that one
word...
And still...
Was he really happy...?
What I wanted to say was that I was
glad he was alive... "Welcome home"...
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Special forces was his goal / too. / Back then I cheered him on too... / But I could only say that one word... / And yet... / Was he happy... / I should have wanted to tell him / I'm glad you're alive, / and welcome home...

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_020.en:
Then tell him when you see him again.
He'll understand how you feel.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Say it when you meet again. / Your feelings should get through.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? / What do you mean?

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_022.en:
I can't say for sure, but he may
still be alive.
It's a guess, based on what the
enemy said in your combat log.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I can't be certain, but / he may be alive. / It's a guess from the conversation with the enemy / in Oddeye's combat record.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The conversation with the enemy...

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_024.en:
Too bad. In the shape he's in, he
ain't ever holdin' you again.
...Most of 'em died partway through,
but the one who looked like the
leader? Tough son of a gun.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Too bad, with that body he probably / can't hold you anymore. / ...Most of them died partway through, but / the one who seemed like the captain was tenacious.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_025.en:
That's right.
That pilot was a twisted piece of
work, but he never said Faceless was
dead.
And we never found a body there.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / That pilot had an abnormal / personality, but he didn't say / he died. / And in fact, we couldn't confirm / his body at that place.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_026.en:
You're right... the words I never
got to say.
If I get to see him again, I'll do
my best to tell him.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: True... the words I couldn't say. / If I can meet him next time, / I want to try hard to tell him.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_027.en:
Now, time to prepare for the next
mission.
I'm going to HQ.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Now, preparing for the next mission. / I'm going to headquarters.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_028.en:
Roger.
Oh, Captain, this is his letter.
It has enemy intel in it too, so I'll
leave it with you.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Ah, Captain, this is his letter. / It seems to have enemy info written in it too, / so I'll leave it with you.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_029.en:
...I've got the gist of it.
But Oddeye, this letter is addressed
to you.
You should hold on to it.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I've grasped the contents. / But Oddeye, this is a letter addressed to you. / You'd better keep it.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Thank you... Captain.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_031.en:
...The words I never got to say.
If I get to see him again, I'll do
my best to tell him.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...The words I couldn't say. / If I can meet him next time, / I want to try hard to tell him.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Sortie, roger.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_033.en:
Shresh still seems to have a lot on
his mind.
He hasn't been talking much.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thresh seems to still be thinking about / all sorts of things. / I haven't talked to him much.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_034.en:
...Oddeye... should I talk to her...
...or leave her be...
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Oddeye... should I talk to her... / or should I hold back...

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_035.en:
We've had word the armed guerrillas'
base is in the mountains southwest
of Peseta.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We've received information that the armed guerrillas' / headquarters is in the mountain region / southwest of Peseta.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_036.en: Straight for their base this time?
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Straight to their headquarters this time, huh.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_037.en:
Cut down the forces there, and the
rest are a rabble.
They won't be able to do anything of
note after that.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If we cut off the forces there, they'll be no better than a rabble. / Any noticeable activity will become impossible.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_038.en: Is this op tied to that unit too?
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is this also an operation concerning that unit?

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_039.en:
No. This time the aim is to sweep
the armed guerrillas from around
Grayrock before the big operation
ahead.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, this time the aim is to sweep / the armed guerrillas around Greylock / before the big operation to come.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_040.en:
I see.
What are the guerrillas fielding?
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / The armed guerrillas' unit composition?

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_041.en:
Nothing with standout performance,
probably.
But there's a lot of patched-together
machines.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There probably aren't any units of notable performance. / However, many patchwork units / have been confirmed.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Looks like a long battle.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_043.en:
Which is why, starting with this
mission, I'm attaching a dedicated
supply vehicle.
The driver's codename is Hepaist.
He's a bit of a character, but he's
an old friend of mine and a man you
can rely on.
Meet up with him in the field and
begin the mission.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Partly because of that, from this mission / we're adding a dedicated supply vehicle. / The driver's code name is Hepaist. / He's a bit quirky in personality, but / he's an old friend of mine and a reliable man. / Join up with him on site and start the mission.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_044.en:
Hepaist... the god of the forge.
As long as he does the job, his
character doesn't matter.
Roger.
We sortie at once.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hepaist... the god of smithing, huh. / As long as he does the job, personality quirks / don't matter. / Understood. / Sortieing immediately.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_045.en:
Starting with this mission, I'm
attaching a dedicated supply vehicle.
The driver's codename is Hepaist.
He's a bit of a character, but he's
an old friend of mine and a man you
can rely on.
Meet up with him in the field and
begin the mission.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: From this mission, we're adding a dedicated supply vehicle. / The driver's code name is Hepaist. / He's a bit quirky in personality, but he's / an old friend of mine and a reliable man. / Join up with him on site and start the mission.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_046.en:
Faceless's notes
To Oddeye, wanzer pilot, «E801:00» Squad,
OCU independent mercenary corps.
No... to my dear Kate S. Houjou.

For an internal army investigation,
I was recorded as dead and went into
hiding.
When the job was done, I meant to
tell you everything, but by then you
had left the service and vanished.
Your friend Hinata told me over and
over how heartbroken you were.

After that I joined Delta and buried
myself in work.
I thought of looking for you, but how
could I ever apologize...
While I was thinking it over, the
months and years slipped by.
I never imagined you'd be on Huffman,
working as a merc.
But I'm glad I got to see you again
before I die.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Faceless's memo / O.C.U. Independent Mercenary Unit, «E801:00» squad, / WAP pilot Oddeye. / No, to my dear Kate S. Houjou. /  / For an army internal affairs investigation mission, / I was recorded as dead and went into hiding. / When the mission was over, / I tried to tell you the circumstances, but this time / you had left the service and disappeared. / From your friend Hinata / I heard over and over that / "Kate was terribly heartbroken." /  / After that I joined Delta / and buried myself in work. / I thought about searching for you too, but / how could I apologize to you... / while I was thinking that, months / passed. / I never imagined you were working as / a mercenary on Huffman. / But I'm glad I could meet you again / before dying.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_047.en:
If you're reading this, I'm probably
no longer in this world.
Let me leave behind what I learned
on this operation.
Most of it came from my close friend
Roy.
If you ever meet him, tell him I
said thank you.
The black unit is the Vampires,
Sakata Industries' private
mercenary army.
Its purpose is to collect skilled
wanzer pilots.
Mostly, it captures wanzer mercs and
makes it look like they deserted.
Behind the unit, they're suspected of
performing some kind of biological
experiments on the captured mercs,
and using the results to develop
next-generation weapons.
The unit's own mercs don't seem to
have been told any more than that.

But if even our intel leaked, I think
someone high in the army is helping
them.
There's no proof, but this is a more
powerful organization than we
imagined.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If you ever see this memo, / I'll probably no longer be in this world. / I'll leave in writing the information I got in this operation. / Most of this information came from my / close friend Roy. / If you ever meet him, / please tell him I said thanks. / The black unit is Sakata Industry's / private mercenary unit, the Vampires. / The unit's purpose is to gather excellent / WAP pilots. / Mainly, they capture WAP mercenaries, making it look / like desertion in the face of the enemy. / Behind the unit, they're suspected of performing / some kind of biological experiments on captured mercenaries, / and developing next-generation weapons based on them. / Though the mercenaries themselves don't seem to have been / told anything more than that. /  / But the fact that even our information / leaked means, I think, / there's backing from the army's upper echelons. / There's no proof, but it can be called a more / powerful organization than we imagine.

MsgLabels_station_36_msg_048.en:
Kate, I don't want to lose you to
this madness.
I loved the look on your face when
you went shopping in Akiba.
This is my last selfish wish.
Quit being a merc, and go home.
I'm sorry I couldn't keep my promise.

I love you, Kate.
MsgLabels_station_36_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Kate, I don't want to lose you / in this insane affair. / I loved the expression you had / when you were shopping in Akiba. / This is my last selfish request. / Quit being a mercenary and go back home. / I'm sorry I couldn't keep my promise. /  / Kate, I love you.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_001.en:
We've linked up with the supply
vehicle.
MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Joined up with the supply vehicle.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_002.en:
Good. All units, prepare for combat.
We're flushing out the enemy.
MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good, all units, prepare for battle. / We'll smoke out the enemy forces.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_004.en:
Hmm.
So this is Falcon's hand-picked crack
team, eh?
Smooth work, I'll give ya that.
MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm. / As expected of Falcon's / hand-picked skilled team. / Truly efficient.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_005.en:
Hepaist, stay at the rear of the
squad.
We're counting on you for repairs and
resupply.
MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hepaist, position yourself at the squad's rear. / Repairs and supply are up to you.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_006.en:
Right, leave it to me.
As you can see, this old rig's got no
guns on her.
I'll be countin' on you for cover.
MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh, leave it to me. / As you can see, this vehicle has no weapons. / I'm counting on your support.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_007.en:
Roger.
Covering people is what I do.
MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / We're used to support.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_008.en: That's a really old vehicle, though.
MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Still, it's quite an old vehicle.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_009.en:
Ha ha ha!
A weapon's only as good as the one
usin' it.
It ain't about looks, little missy.
MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hahaha. / Weapons depend on the user. / It's not about looks, / little missy.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Little missy...

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_011.en: Ready to attack. We can go any time.
MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Attack preparations complete, ready anytime.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Operation start.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_013.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy reinforcements.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_016.en:
Reinforcements confirmed.
Looks like taking out the command
vehicle brings more.
We use that to wear them down.
MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Reinforcements confirmed. / It seems reinforcements come when the command vehicle is shot down. / We'll use that to wear down the enemy.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Further reinforcements confirmed.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_019.en:
But there are still forces left at
their base.
MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But there are still forces remaining at the base.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_020.en:
We wipe them all out.
All units, stay sharp.
MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sweep them all. / All units, don't let your guard down.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: More enemy reinforcements.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_022.en:
Looks like this is the last of them.
No more signatures at the base.
MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This seems to be the last. / No force signatures at the base.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_023.en:
Good. Let's finish this.
We wipe them out in one push.
MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good, time for the finishing touch. / Annihilate them in one go.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ho ho. / Good teamwork.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed all enemies silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission complete.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm. / Splendid.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_029.en:
You did good work too, Hepaist.
I look forward to working with you.
MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You did good work too, Hepaist. / Looking forward to working with you.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_030.en:
Will do, missy.
Pleased to meet you all.
MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger that. / Count on me, everyone.

MsgLabels_tactics_36_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh, we're relying on you.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_001.en:
I'm Rain. Good to have you,
Hepaist.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm Rain, nice to meet you, Hepaist.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_002.en:
Oho, so you're the vice-captain, Rain.
My, you're even prettier in person
than on the monitor.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hoh, the vice-captain, Miss Rain. / Seen in person, you're even more / of a beauty than through the monitor.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wh-what!?

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_004.en:
She looks all quiet, but she's
scary as hell.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: She looks gentle, but she's pretty scary.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm. That's fine too!

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ!

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: And I'm Champ.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_008.en:
The famous fighter, eh?
Used to watch ya on TV all the time.
So ya can drive a wanzer too?
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The hero, right. / I watched you on TV a lot. / You can pilot a WAP too?

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_009.en:
Yeah.
In a wanzer, I'm all hand-to-hand.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah. / Even in a WAP, it's all hand-to-hand.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_010.en:
I'm Gray.
Nice to meet you.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm Gray. / Nice to meet you.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_011.en:
Hmm.
You're the most forgettable fella
in this squad, aren't ya.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm. / You're the one with the least presence in this squad.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_012.en:
Hepaist, you're a mechanic,
right? Oh, I'm Oddeye.
Because my eyes are odd... huh?
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mr. Hepaist, / you're a mechanic, right? / Ah, I'm Oddeye. / My eyes are odd-eyed... huh?

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_013.en:
Let's have a look, now... Oho, I see!
And ain't you a cute one too,
little missy.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Let's see, hoh, I see! / Little missy is cute too.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...You're close.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_016.en:
Anything resembling sexual
harassment of female personnel
will be severely punished.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Anything resembling sexual harassment / toward female members / is severely punished.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Here it comes.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_018.en:
...My eyesight ain't what it was.
Sorry, sorry.
Mm-hmm, mm-hmm.
Charmin' even when you're angry.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...My eyes are bad, you see. / Sorry, sorry. / Hmm hmm. / Your angry face is charming too.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_019.en:
...That's it, I'm reporting this to
the Commander. Captain, please say
something to Hepaist.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Honestly, I'm reporting this to the Commander. / Ah, Captain, please say something / to Hepaist.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_020.en:
Rain, there's no need to report it.
Hepaist is apparently an old
friend of the Commander's. He must
already know how the man behaves.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain, there's no need to report. / Hepaist seems to be the Commander's old friend. / He should be aware of his behavior.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A friend... is he...

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well, something like that.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_023.en:
Hepaist, communication is fine,
but too much of it causes problems.
Keep it in moderation.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hepaist, communication too / becomes a problem when excessive. / In moderation.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_024.en:
Alright, alright.
All these pretty faces got an old
man carried away, that's all.
Hm?«g:24» That insignia...
Captain, you were with BATS!?
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Alright, alright. / Surrounded by beauties, I got carried away / at my age. / Hm?«g:24» That unit emblem... / Captain, you're connected with BATS!

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_025.en:
Yes, I was in it.
That's in the past.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, I belonged to it. / It's in the past.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_026.en:
Huh.
You know about BATS, Hepaist?
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Huh. / Hepaist, you know BATS?

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_027.en:
A few of my engineer pals got
posted there. Then somethin'
happened, and the whole outfit
was disbanded.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Several of my engineer colleagues / were assigned there, but due to a certain incident / the organization itself disbanded.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A certain incident?

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_029.en:
Only rumors, mind, but they say an
experiment went wrong and that's why
they shut it down. Never heard from
any of the folks there again.
...Mind you, this is the first time
I've met a survivor of BATS.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's only a rumor, but apparently an experiment failed / and it disbanded. / I lost contact with the people who were in the organization. / ...But this is the first time I've met / a survivor of BATS like this.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_030.en:
Disbanded?«g:24»
That rumor's wrong.
I was there when the unit was wiped
out. (...Ngh... A headache...?)
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Disbanded?«g:24» / That rumor is wrong. / I was at the scene where they were wiped out. / (...Ugh... a headache...)

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_031.en:
...Hmm. Ya talk like it happened to
somebody else.
Anyhow, pleased to be workin' with ya.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Hmm, you talk as if it happened to someone else. / Anyway, nice to meet you.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_032.en:
Rain, he said "all these pretty
faces." We got complimented, you
know? Feels kind of nice!
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Miss Rain, he said we're all beauties. / We got complimented, you know? / Somehow I'm happy♪

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_033.en:
Yes, yes.
We'll leave it at that, then...
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, yes, / let's just leave it at that...

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_034.en:
Another larger-than-life character
in the squad, I see...
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Another intense character added...

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_036.en:
That old geezer's the Commander's
buddy? Seriously...
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: An old man like this is the Commander's friend...

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_037.en:
We're up, huh?
Alright, let's go wild today too!
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie. / Alright, I'm gonna run wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All beauties~♪

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_039.en:
Oh, we're sortieing?
I'll get ready!
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, a sortie, right. / I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_040.en:
Huh.
You know about BATS, Hepaist?
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Huh. / Hepaist, you know BATS?

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_042.en:
First time I've met a survivor
of BATS.
Well, pleased to be workin' with ya.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's my first time meeting a survivor / of BATS. / Well, nice to meet you.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_043.en:
Right you are.
Leave the repairs and resupply to me.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger that. / Leave repairs and supply to me.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_044.en:
Ah, you there, merc, got a minute?
I'm Thomas Norland.
Lieutenant, 1st Army.
Pleased to meet you.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, mercenary there, got a moment? / I'm Thomas Noland. / First Army lieutenant. / Nice to meet you.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_045.en:
Oh, uh, sure...
Wait, Thomas Norland? The Thomas
who stopped the Huffman Crisis?
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh, yes... / Eh, Thomas Noland? / The Thomas who prevented / the Huffman Crisis?

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_046.en:
Ga-ha-ha!«g:24»
What's this, you know me?
Well, well.
I've racked up plenty more since then,
mind you, but that one's so famous
nobody's heard about the rest.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gahaha!«g:24» / What, you know me? / I see, I see. / Well, I've racked up achievements since then, / but that one is so famous / nothing else seems to get through.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_047.en:
Wow, this is an honor.
Um, could I shake your hand?
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wow, I'm thrilled. / Umm, could I shake your hand?

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_048.en:
Ah, sorry about this.
I'm afraid I'm in the middle of an
operation. I've come in a hurry to
borrow some weapons and ammo.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, sorry. / Apologies, but I'm in the middle of an operation. / I came in a hurry to get some / weapons and ammo shared.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_049.en:
Oh, I see.
Thanks for your hard work.
It's a regular army operation, so
we can hardly say no.
The Commander's approved it, right?
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, is that so. / Thanks for your hard work. / Since it's a regular army operation, we / can't say no. / The Commander's agreed, right?

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_050.en:
Of course he has.
Sorry to trouble you, then. I'll grab
what I need from the armoury.
Enough for one fight will do me fine.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah, of course. / Then sorry, but I'll take some / from the armory. / What, about one battle's worth is plenty.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_051.en: Oh, then should I give you a hand?
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, then should I help too?

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_052.en:
No, no, no need for that.
You lot have your own ops to run.
Don't mind me, go ahead and sortie.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, no, no need for that. / You have operations too, right? / Sortie without worrying about me.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_053.en:
Yes, sir, understood!
I'll be going, then.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, understood! / Well then.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_054.en:
Hm?«g:24»
Wasn't that Thomas?
Don't tell me the rascal's set his
sights on the merc base now...
Blast, I'd better tell the Captain...
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hm?«g:24» / Isn't that Thomas? / Could that guy now be targeting / a mercenary base... / This is bad, I'd better tell the Captain...

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_055.en:
I've been worryin' about a lot of
stuff lately, but war or no war,
I figure I'll just do what I can
right now.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Lately I was worrying about all sorts of things, but / whether war breaks out or not, / I think I'll just do / what I can do now.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_056.en:
Shresh talked with that old guy who
just showed up for a while, and all
of a sudden he's perked right up.
Maybe the old man's a good counselor.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thresh, after talking with the old man / who came recently for a while, suddenly / seems to have perked up. / That old man might be a good adviser.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_058.en:
We've picked up word of a factory
supplying weapons to enemy forces.
Apparently it mass-produces gear
developed back on the mainland.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We've caught wind of a factory / delivering weapons to enemy forces. / Apparently things developed in the home country / are mass-produced here.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So we just need to hit that factory.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_060.en:
Not the facility itself, this time.
The job is destroying the goods
before delivery. Targets are the
containers awaiting shipment and
the transports carrying them.
Once we hit them, the transports
will try to run. Stop them if you can.
Also, we've confirmed a number of
large defense wanzers at the factory.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This time the mission isn't attacking the facility, / but destroying the materiel before delivery. / The targets are the containers before shipment, and / the transport vehicles they're loaded on. / When we attack, the transport vehicles / should try to flee. / Prevent that as much as possible. / Also, many large WAPs for defense / have been confirmed at the factory.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A factory... / Sakata... Industry...

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_062.en:
That's right, a Sakata Industries
production plant. More of a
subcontractor's site, by the look
of it. Captain «E801:00», what's
wrong? You don't look too good.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm, a Sakata Industry / production factory. / Though it seems to be more of a subcontractor facility. / Captain «E801:00», what's wrong? / You look pale.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_063.en:
It's nothing...
Mission acknowledged.
Priority targets: the containers
awaiting shipment and the transports.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No problem... / Mission understood. / We'll prioritize destroying the containers / before shipment and the transport vehicles.

MsgLabels_station_37_msg_064.en:
The job is destroying the goods
before delivery. Targets are the
containers awaiting shipment and
the transports carrying them.
Once we hit them, the transports
will try to run. Stop them if you can.
Also, we've confirmed a number of
large defense wanzers at the factory.
MsgLabels_station_37_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The mission is destroying the materiel before delivery. / The targets are the containers before shipment, and / the transport vehicles they're loaded on. / When we attack, the transport vehicles / should try to flee. / Prevent that as much as possible. / Also, many large WAPs for defense / have been confirmed at the factory.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_001.en:
That's the target arms factory.
Looks like they're loading for
shipment, just as the intel said.
MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The target weapons factory. / As the info said, they seem to be doing shipping work.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger... / Ugh... / Ah, ah...

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain? / Is something wrong?

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: S-sorry... / A headache...

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_005.en:
Not one of those headaches?
Are you alright?
MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Not that headache? / Are you okay?

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_006.en:
We've had one battle after another.
Maybe it's fatigue.
MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's been battle after battle, maybe / it's fatigue.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm fine... / Uuugh...

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_008.en:
Captain!
You're in no shape for an op...
MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain! / This is no time for an operation...

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_009.en:
Captain, fall back to the rear.
Leave this to us.
MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, go to the rear; / leave this to us.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_010.en:
Aye.
I'll put in a word with the
Commander too. Best not push it,
sonny. Pull out for now.
MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm. / I'll tell the Commander too. / Better not to push it and withdraw.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_011.en:
S-sorry...
Withdrawing from the line for now.
MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: S-sorry... / Temporarily leaving the battle line.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_012.en:
I'll take command in the Captain's
place. Oddeye, handle recon, please.
All units, destroy the transports
and the containers awaiting shipment.
Begin the attack.
MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
