Literal: I'll take command in the Captain's place. / Oddeye, enemy search please. / All units, destroy the transport vehicles and / the containers before shipment. / Begin the attack.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_014.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit or
Rain unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down or / Rain's unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_016.en:
That transport's trying to make
a run for it.
MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That transport vehicle is trying to escape.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Before it gets away...!

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed large units for factory defense.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_019.en:
Hmm.
But it looks like the transports
come first.
MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm. / But the transport vehicles seem to come first.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Continue pursuing the transport vehicles.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Tch, it got away.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It can't be helped...

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's too bad.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed all transport vehicles shot down!

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good, the transport vehicles are destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_026.en:
Right, any machine that needs
repairs or resupply, pull up next
to my truck. I'll send ya back out
in tip-top condition.
MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good, units needing repair or supply, / come close to my vehicle. / I'll restore you to / top condition.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger, Grandpa!

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Grandpa...

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_029.en:
Oh...
I'm sorry, it just slipped out...
MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah... / Sorry, it slipped out...

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_030.en:
Ha ha ha!
Grandpa suits me fine.
Beats bein' called a dirty old man!
MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hahaha. / Grandpa is fine. / It's better than being called a sexual-harassment geezer!

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ahaha.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All enemy forces silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, not yet. / Something's coming!

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Another large one...

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_035.en:
This is bad. I didn't think they
had a machine like that left.
MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's bad; to think a unit like this / was still left.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger... large unit confirmed.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? / Captain, are you alright?

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_038.en:
Sorry about that.
The headache's easing off.
Looks like that one's the last.
MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry about that. / The headache has eased. / He seems to be the last.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_039.en:
Looks that way.
Captain, you good to go?
MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Seems so. / Captain, can you do it?

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_040.en:
Yes. We take it down.
Badly damaged machines, move to the
rear and give cover.
MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, we'll shoot him down. / Badly worn units, go to the rear guard / and support.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger! / Returning command to Captain «E801:00».

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_043.en:
Large enemy machine fully silenced.
Oh, Rain, I'm sorry...
Handing recon back to you.
MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy large unit completely silenced. / Ah, Miss Rain, sorry... / Returning enemy search to you, Miss Rain.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_044.en:
Heh.
Thank you, Oddeye.
Good work.
MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hehe. / Thank you, Oddeye. / Good work.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Mission complete.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_046.en:
Okay, Captain!
Straight home and into bed with you!
MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Now, Captain! / Hurry back and sleep, okay!

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_047.en:
Aye.
You've got fatigue piled up too,
Captain. Get yourself a good rest
back at base.
MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm. / The Captain's fatigue has probably built up too. / Rest well at the base.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_048.en: The Captain's always wound so tight.
MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The Captain's always so tense.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_049.en: Leave things to us once in a while.
MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Leave it to us once in a while.

MsgLabels_tactics_37_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry, everyone. / Thank you.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, how is your headache?

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_002.en:
Sorry for the trouble.
I'm fine now.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I caused trouble. / I'm fine now.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_003.en:
That's the first time a headache's
hit you during a mission.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's the first time the headache came on during a mission.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_004.en:
Yes.
Normally I keep the symptoms away
by focusing on the mission...
A captain like that is no captain.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / Usually I focus my mind on the mission / so the symptoms don't appear... / At this rate I'm unfit to be captain.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_005.en:
These things happen sometimes.
Don't worry about it.
We'll cover for you.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That sort of thing happens sometimes. / Please don't worry. / We'll back you up.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / But...

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Leave it to me.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Leave it to me.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_010.en:
These things happen sometimes.
Don't worry about it.
We'll cover for you.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That sort of thing happens sometimes. / Please don't worry. / We'll back you up.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_012.en: Captain, shouldn't you be in bed?
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, shouldn't you be sleeping?

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_013.en:
Sorry for the trouble.
I'm fine now.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I caused trouble. / I'm fine now.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_014.en:
Captain, I reckon you overthink stuff.
Loosen up a little, like me, and
just fight however your body moves.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I think the Captain overthinks. / Like me, just be a bit more relaxed / and fight however your body moves.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_015.en: So you fight on reflex, Champ.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ, you fight by reflex?

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_016.en:
Yep.
"Enemy! Punch it!" That's the basics.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah. / "Enemy! Punch!" That's the basics.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_017.en:
...That's the level of a true master.
I haven't reached it yet.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...That's practically the realm of a master. / I haven't reached that realm yet.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_018.en:
Captain, you really shouldn't take
anything the muscle-head says
seriously, okay?
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, you'd better not take / a muscle-brain man's lines seriously, okay?

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_019.en:
Right.
It ain't like I'm sayin' anything
complicated, Captain.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / I'm not saying anything / difficult, Captain?

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_020.en:
Exactly. Anything the muscle-head
can do, I can do too.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right, if it's what the muscle-brain man says, / even I can do it.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy, punch!

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy, punch!

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, think even less.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy-punch!

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Pretty good

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: And allies?

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Allies, punch... don't? / Huh?

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_028.en:
That right there is what makes you
a muscle-head.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's what's called muscle-brained.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_029.en:
C'mon, when the adrenaline's
pumpin', don't you ever lose track?
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Nah, when the adrenaline's pumping, / don't you sometimes lose track?

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No. / Not that.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_031.en:
...It may be what the sword masters
of ancient Japan called mushin:
the state of selflessness.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...That may be what's called the state of no-self, / said to have been mastered by sword masters / in ancient Japan.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh, what...? / The state of mu-ga?

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_033.en:
Muscle-head behavior...? Really?
He just isn't thinking, that's all.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Muscle-brain behavior... is? / He's just not thinking about anything, you know?

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_034.en:
Clear away stray thoughts, focus on
a single point, and act on reflex
before thought. ...Few can do it.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Clearing away idle thoughts, focusing on one point, / acting by reflex before thinking. / ...It's not something easily done.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_035.en:
I'm really that amazing...?
Guess that's the great Champ for ya...
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So I'm that amazing... / It means I'm the great me as expected...

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_036.en:
So I'm a "great Champ" too?
I kind of don't like that...
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Am I a "great me" too? / I somehow don't like it...

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_037.en:
I'm really that amazing...?
Guess that's the great Champ for ya...
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So I'm that amazing... / It means I'm the great me as expected...

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_038.en:
We're up, huh?
Alright, let's go wild today too!
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie. / Alright, I'm gonna run wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_039.en:
Captain... I can't tell if you
meant that or were just
buttering him up.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain... I can't tell if you're serious / or flattering him.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_040.en:
Oh, we're sortieing?
I'll get ready!
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, a sortie, right. / I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_041.en:
(These headaches... On the
battlefield, they could make me
a liability...)
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (This headache... on the battlefield, as I thought, / it could make me a burden...)

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_043.en:
Looks like you're back on your
feet, Captain.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, looks like you're fine now.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_044.en:
Sorry about that, Hepaist.
If those symptoms keep showing up,
I'm not fit to be captain.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry about that, Hepaist. / If those symptoms appear, / I'm unfit to be captain.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_045.en:
You've got a record that outweighs
it, Captain. And your squad's strong.
Trust 'em, and take a breather
now and then.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The Captain has achievements that outweigh that. / Besides, the squad is strong too. Trust the squad, / and rest once in a while.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_046.en: But if I lean on them too much...
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But relying on them completely...

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_047.en:
Don't fret over it.
Havin' a weak spot just means
you're human too, Captain.
Strong as you are, without one
you'd be nothin' but a combat machine.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No need to worry. / Having a weakness just means / the Captain is human too. / If you had that strength and no weakness, / you'd just be a combat machine.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_048.en:
A combat machine...
That's what I've always wanted to be.
It's the ideal form of a soldier.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A combat machine, huh... / I always wish I were like that. / It's the ideal form of a soldier.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_049.en:
Well, maybe so.
But ya should enjoy life more.
Like me!
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well, I suppose. / But enjoy life more. / Like me!

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_050.en:
I see. The secret of a
battle-hardened veteran.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see, so that's the secret / of a veteran warrior.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_051.en:
Aye.
The secret to a long life.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm. / It's the secret to a long life.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_052.en:
Right, think I'll go practice the
secret to a long life again today.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Alright, shall I practice the secret / of long life today too.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_053.en:
Right you are.
Leave the repairs and resupply to me.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger that. / Leave repairs and supply to me.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_054.en:
Heard «E801:00» gets headaches.
Want me to share some of my
herbal medicine?
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I hear «E801:00» gets headaches. / If you like, shall I share my herbal medicine?

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_055.en:
Gabriel... He only meant to cheer
Oddeye up, and he ended up
confessing to her...
Talk about the worst timing ever......
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gabriel... / he meant only to comfort Oddeye, / but ended up confessing... / Talk about bad timing...

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I got... dumped... by Oddeye... / I wonder why...

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_057.en:
I heard about it. Looks like your
headache got in the way of a
mission.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'd heard, but it seems your headache / interfered with the mission.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_058.en:
I apologize.
If it happens again, I intend
to step down from the squad.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm sorry. / If it recurs any more, / I intend to leave the squad.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_059.en:
No. You and your squad have
achieved more than enough to make
up for it. Forget the headache.
Now, the brass has sent a special
request for «E801:00» Squad.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, you and your squad have left achievements / beyond that. / Don't worry about the headache. / Now, a special request has come / from the upper echelons for the «E801:00» squad.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A special request?

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_061.en:
Between your many reports and what
happened to Delta, the brass has
finally got off its backside.
The army has officially recognized
the "Vampires" and declared them
hostile. They mean to look into how
the Vampires tie in with the missing
mercs, and deal with it.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: With your many reports and Delta's losses, / the upper echelons finally seem to have gotten off their heavy behinds. / The army has officially recognized the existence of the "Vampires" / and judged them an enemy. / They'll investigate the relationship between these Vampires / and the mercenary disappearances, and take countermeasures.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_062.en:
About time...
Is the army moving in directly?
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Finally... / Will the army move directly?

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_063.en:
No. With the ceasefire agreement,
regular army involvement is tricky.
So they want «E801:00» Squad to join
the "Anti-Vampire Operation."
From now on your main job will be
taking out the Vampires' elite,
the "Numbers."
Naturally, the pay's generous.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, there's a ceasefire agreement, so regular army intervention / is difficult. / So the request is for the «E801:00» squad / to join the "anti-Vampires operation." / From now on, the «E801:00» squad's main mission / will be defeating the Vampires' elite group, / the "Numbers." / Of course, the contract money will be generous.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_064.en:
Sounds like a large-scale sweep.
So those special machines are
called the Numbers.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Seems to be a large-scale sweep operation. / So those special unit guys / are called the Numbers.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_065.en:
That's right.
And the people planning this op
aren't the army, they're a
government organization.
Naturally, it's highly classified.
Something seems to be going on
higher up... but that's all
they've told us.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / Also, the one planning this operation / isn't the army but a government organization. / Naturally it's highly classified. / Something seems to be happening / in the upper echelons, but... / what was told to us ends here.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_066.en:
A merc doesn't need to know more
than that. ...The Vampires seem to
be mercs too. If it's merc against
merc, it's no different from our
usual work. Alright, I'll take it.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mercenaries don't need operation details beyond that. / ...The Vampires seem to be mercenaries too, / and if it's "mercenary vs. mercenary," it's no different / from our usual missions. / Good, we'll take the offer.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_067.en:
I knew you'd say that.
First up, I want you to hit a
Vampire forward base.
Intel already puts the Numbers there.
There should be an informant near
the base. They'll make contact on
site, so get the details from them.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_067.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I thought you'd say that. / Right away, I want you to attack / the Vampires' forward base. / It's already known from intelligence / that the Numbers are there. / There should be an informant near the base. / They'll apparently contact you on site, / so ask that person for details.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_068.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Quite well arranged. / Roger.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_069.en:
An enemy forward base will be
well defended, mind.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_069.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Being the enemy's forward base, their forces / will probably be well stocked.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_070.en:
Still, no different from any other
mission. We sortie once we're ready.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_070.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But it's not particularly different from usual missions. / Sortieing once ready.

MsgLabels_station_38_msg_071.en:
First up, I want you to hit a
Vampire forward base.
Intel already puts the Numbers there.
There should be an informant near
the base. They'll make contact on
site, so get the details from them.
MsgLabels_station_38_msg_071.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Right away, I want you to attack / the Vampires' forward base. / It's already known from intelligence / that the Numbers are there. / There should be an informant near the base. / They'll apparently contact you on site, / so ask that person for details.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_001.en:
Multiple enemy contacts confirmed.
No sign of the Numbers yet.
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Many enemy units confirmed. / Presence of the Numbers unconfirmed.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There's nothing here for a base.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_003.en:
If the intel's right, there's likely
a facility hidden underground.
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If the info is accurate, the facility / is probably hidden underground.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Can't you confirm the informant?

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Cannot confirm.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_006.en: Captain, they're about to spot us.
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, the enemy's about to notice us.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_007.en:
Alright. We take down whatever comes
into view and wait for the informant.
All units, prepare for combat.
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good, we'll take down enemies in sight / while waiting for the informant. / All units, prepare for battle.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_009.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Whoa! Intruders? / Enemy attack!!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_012.en:
...How did they find this place?
No matter. Moths to the flame.
Ifrit Team, burn the intruders
to ash!
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...How did they find this place. / Well, fine. / Truly like the moth flying into the flame. / Ifrit squad, burn the intruders to ashes!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_013.en:
Intruders confirmed!
Lord Ifrit!
Someone's attacking the base!
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Intruders confirmed! / Lord Ifrit! / Someone is attacking the base!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_014.en:
...How did they find this place?
No matter. Moths to the flame.
Ifrit Team, burn the intruders
to ash!
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...How did they find this place. / Well, fine. / Truly like the moth flying into the flame. / Ifrit squad, burn the intruders to ashes!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_015.en:
Who the hell are you!? Whoa!?
Enemy attack!!
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You, who are you! Whoa!? / Enemy attack!!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_016.en:
...How did they find this place?
No matter. Moths to the flame.
Ifrit Team, burn the intruders
to ash!
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...How did they find this place. / Well, fine. / Truly like the moth flying into the flame. / Ifrit squad, burn the intruders to ashes!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_017.en:
Intruders confirmed.
They're inside the base perimeter!
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Intruders confirmed. / They're entering this base!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_018.en:
...How did they find this place?
No matter. Moths to the flame.
Ifrit Team, burn the intruders
to ash!
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...How did they find this place. / Well, fine. / Truly like the moth flying into the flame. / Ifrit squad, burn the intruders to ashes!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_019.en:
Special machine confirmed.
It's the Numbers!
It's packing fire weapons, same as
the defenders!
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Special unit confirmed. / It's the Numbers! / Like the defending units, it's / equipped with flame-type weapons!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_020.en:
Confirmed.
Rain, any word from the informant?
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed. / Rain, no informant yet?

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No signature.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_022.en: Maybe the enemy got to them...
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Maybe the enemy...

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_023.en:
Either way, now that the Numbers
are here, taking them out is the
priority. All units, stay sharp.
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But now that the Numbers have appeared, / exterminating him takes priority. / All units, don't be careless.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_025.en:
Captain!
Another Numbers machine!
It's the katana user we ran
into before!
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain! / Another Numbers! / Ah, it's the katana user we met before!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_026.en:
Him...
No choice. We split the squad
in two.
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Him, huh... / No choice, split the squad in two and deal with them.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_027.en:
«E801:00» Squad, do you read?
This is Dark Knight, your informant.
The black wanzer carrying a sword.
I am moving to support you.
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: «E801:00» squad, do you read? / I'm Dark Knight, the informant. / The black vanzer holding / a sword. / Moving to support action now.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...What does that mean?

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_029.en:
Dark Knight.
Good timing.
Cover me.
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Dark Knight, huh. / That's a help. / Support me.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_030.en:
Unfortunately for you, Ifrit,
I have long wanted to face you.
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Too bad. / Ifrit. / I always wanted to face you.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What did you say!?

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Heh, a duel, Ifrit!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You, No. 3, are saying you betrayed us...

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: From your side, I suppose that's how it is.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_035.en:
Tch, a spy...?
Then you're going down with me!
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Tch, a spy...? / I'm taking you down with me!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_036.en:
Dark Knight
«E801:00» Squad, explanations later.
First, we wipe out this unit.
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Dark Knight / «E801:00» squad, details later. / For now, let's annihilate the unit here.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_037.en:
I can't trust you just like that.
All units, if Dark Knight turns his
guns on us, treat it as hostile
and engage. Understood?
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I can't trust you right away. / All units, if Dark Knight's unit / points a gun at us, / consider it hostile action and attack. / Got it.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh, roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_039.en: That is as it should be.
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's fine.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Damn, that Dark Knight...

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_041.en:
To have held out this long alone...
Well fought, Ifrit.
Your skill was real.
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well done getting this far alone. / Ifrit. / Your skill was certain.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Numbers silenced!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_043.en:
Enemy unit silenced, Numbers
included. No hostile action
from Dark Knight.
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed enemy unit, including the Numbers, / silenced. / No hostile action from Dark Knight's unit either.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_044.en:
Downing the Numbers with such ease.
I expected no less of «E801:00» Squad.
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Taking down the Numbers so easily, / as expected of the «E801:00» squad.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_045.en:
You're one of the Numbers yourself,
but you talk like it's got nothing
to do with you.
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even though you're Numbers yourself, / you talk like it's someone else's business.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Dark Knight... what exactly are you?

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_047.en:
I still have work to do.
I will say only that I am not your
enemy, for now.
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I still have things to do. / For now I'll only say I'm not the enemy.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_048.en:
So you're spying on the
Vampires...?
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Does that mean you're spying / on the Vampires...?

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_049.en:
Think what you will.
Let me give you one warning.
There should be a survivor of a
former squad in «E801:00» Squad.
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll leave that to your imagination. / Let me give you one warning. / There should be a survivor of the previous squad / in the «E801:00» squad.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh, me?

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_051.en:
Your squad's former captain is
operating as one of the Numbers.
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Your squad's former captain is operating / as one of the Numbers.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_052.en:
What...!?
Captain Lancer is one of the
Numbers...
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What did you say...!? / Captain Lancer is one of the Numbers...

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_053.en:
X-24. He calls himself Dragoon.
Whether the organization behind him
is using him or he was lured by the
money, even I cannot say. But the
Vampires are mercenaries all the
same. He follows orders and carries
out inhumane operations. That much
is certain.
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: X-24. He calls himself Dragoon. / Whether he's being used by the organization behind it, / or was lured by the contract money, even I don't know. / But the Vampires are mercenaries too. / It's certain that he follows orders and carries out / inhumane operations.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: N-no way...

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_055.en:
Dark Knight...
Can't you prove you're on our side?
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Dark Knight... / can't you prove somehow that you're an ally?

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_056.en:
Rotor noise confirmed. Captain,
aircraft approaching!
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rotor sound confirmed. Captain, / unit approaching!

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_057.en:
My apologies. It seems there is no
time here. The next operation is a
simultaneous attack on two sites.
Dragoon will likely appear.
I will continue preparing for it.
Once ready, I will contact you
through your superiors.
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry, it seems I can't / take the time here. / The next operation plans a simultaneous attack / on 2 bases. / Dragoon will probably come out too. / I'll continue preparing the operation. / As soon as preparations are complete, I'll / contact you through the upper echelons.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_058.en:
If the orders come from HQ,
we'll follow them.
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If orders come from headquarters, / I'll follow them.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_059.en:
Good.
That you do not trust me easily
is also to my liking.
Staying longer is dangerous.
Withdraw.
MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm. / I like that you don't trust me easily / too. / Staying long is getting dangerous. / Withdraw.

MsgLabels_tactics_38_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ... / Mission complete. / Returning to base.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain Lancer...

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thinking about something?

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_003.en:
Can someone who was a comrade not
long ago really become an enemy?
And someone who was a captain here
at that...
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Can someone who was a comrade until a while ago / become an enemy? / And the person who was the former captain here...

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_004.en:
...It's possible, for someone who
sees merc work as strictly business.
For professional mercs, friend and
foe can switch with every battlefield.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...For a person who treats mercenary work / purely as business, it's possible. / For professional mercenaries, enemy and ally / may switch with each battlefield.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_005.en:
But...
My old captain cared about his
comrades more than anyone.
I can only think something happened
to him.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But... / the former captain was the one with / the strongest consideration for comrades. / I can only think something happened.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_006.en:
......
It's one of the most common kinds
of trouble between mercs.
That's why communication between
mercs is kept to a minimum.
Nobody pries into anyone's past or
reasons for signing up. It's an
unspoken rule.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ... / It's one of the troubles that easily happen / between mercenaries. / That's why communication between mercenaries / is kept to a minimum. / Not prying into each other's pasts or reasons for volunteering / is an unspoken understanding.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_007.en:
I... understand that in my head...
But I feel horribly betrayed.
If I meet him on the battlefield,
I'll ask him myself.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's... / I understand it in my head, but... / I feel terribly betrayed. / If I meet him on the battlefield, I'll / confirm it with him myself.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_008.en: Keep a cool head when you do.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: When that happens, stay calm.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / I'll be careful.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_010.en:
Captain Lancer...
Was it all just business to you,
I wonder...
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain Lancer... / was he doing mercenary work / business-like...?

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_012.en:
I dunno about that Dark Knight guy.
I don't trust him.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Somehow that Dark Knight guy / I can't trust.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_013.en:
He did say he wasn't our enemy.
I wonder who he really is.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: He said he's "not our enemy," / though. / I wonder who he is.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_014.en: His hair was really long, wasn't it?
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: His hair was really long.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_015.en:
THAT'S what you noticed!?
Normal people would be thinkin'
more like, "Is he shady?"...
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's what bugs you!? / Normally there'd be more like, something suspicious...

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_016.en: Well, honestly, I noticed it too.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Nah, honestly it bugged me too.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_017.en:
Shady stuff...
Hmmm.
Captain, did anything catch your eye?
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Suspicious things... / Hmmm. / Captain, did anything bother you?

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Dark Knight, huh... / He wore glasses.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_019.en:
Yes, yes!
Glasses and long black hair!
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Right, right. / Glasses and long black hair!

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_020.en:
Hold on a sec...
We ain't talkin' about lookin' shady!
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hold on a sec... / I'm not talking about looking suspicious!

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_021.en:
True. When it comes to looking
shady, the muscle-head's got him
beat anyway.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / If it's suspicious looks, the muscle-brain man / doesn't lose either.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What! / What about me is suspicious?

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_023.en:
You've totally got a villain face,
and way too many muscles.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: However you look at it, you have a villain's face, and too many muscles.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_024.en:
A villain face with muscles...
Shut up!
This is just my face, and I work
out, okay!?
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Villain-faced muscles... / Shut up! / This is just my face, and I train!

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_025.en:
Hmmm.
For one of the Vampires, Dark Knight
was a real pretty-boy character.
Oh, that's why he's shady!
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmmm. / Mr. Dark Knight / was a handsome character / for a Vampire. / Ah, that's why he's suspicious!

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_026.en:
I don't think that has anything
to do with it.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I don't think that's related.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_027.en:
Either way, we know very little.
We've fought him several times.
Asking us to trust him out of
nowhere is too much.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Anyway, there's little information. / He's someone we've fought several times. / Telling us to trust him suddenly is impossible.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_028.en:
He might win us over and then shoot
us in the back. Okay, everybody,
don't stand in front of him.
And keep a target lock on him
at all times.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: He might get us to trust him and then / shoot us from behind. / Okay, everyone, don't stand in front of him. / And you'd better keep him / target-locked at all times.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_029.en:
Um, wouldn't that make it look like
we don't trust him...?
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Nah, then wouldn't it look like / we don't trust him...?

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_030.en: Tch, so what are we s'posed to do...
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Tch, what am I supposed to do...

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_031.en:
If he makes a suspicious move,
I'll shoot him. The rest of you
just act normal.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If he shows suspicious movement, I'll shoot. / Everyone just stay normal.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Normal, huh. / Sounds difficult...

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_034.en:
Act normal, huh.
Wait, my normal is... all fired up.
So that's okay?
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Normal, huh. / Huh? My normal is... / being hot-blooded, is that okay?

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_035.en:
We're up, huh?
Alright, let's go wild today too!
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie. / Alright, I'm gonna run wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_036.en:
Glasses and long black hair...
Oh, that's me.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Glasses and long black hair... / Ah, me too.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_037.en:
Oh, we're sortieing?
I'll get ready!
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, a sortie, right. / I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_038.en:
Surely he won't stab us in the
back right away.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I doubt he'd suddenly backstab us, / surely.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_040.en:
Captain, looks like we've got a
visiting technician.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, / it seems the dispatched engineer has come.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Raikov?

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_042.en:
That's the one.
Does he come round here often?
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / Does that man come here often?

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_043.en:
We've tested new parts for him
a few times.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: He's had us test new parts / several times.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_044.en:
Well now, that man's a genius.
There ain't an engineer alive who
doesn't know him. His tests were
famous for bein' tough to pass.
If he's in and out of here that
often, he must rate you lot highly.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hoh, that guy's a genius. / There's no engineer who doesn't know him. / His tests are famous for being / a high bar, but / seeing him come and go so often, / you lot seem to be highly valued.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_045.en:
So that's how it is.
I took him for an oddball.
I didn't know he was famous.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is that so. / I thought he was an oddball. / So he was a famous person.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_046.en: Well, maybe I'll go say hello later.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well, I'll go say hello later.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_047.en: Well, maybe I'll go say hello later.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well, I'll go say hello later.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm taking a break this time.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_049.en:
Lancer was with the black unit...?
He did a lot for me, too...
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: To think Lancer was in the black unit... / He took care of me in a lot of ways...

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_050.en:
Gabriel took getting turned down so
hard, he's decided to quit...
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gabriel seems to have been so shocked / at being dumped that he decided / to leave the service...

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_051.en:
...I'm... going home...
This job... isn't for me...
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I... decided to go back home... / this job... isn't for me...

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_052.en: I hear you met the informant.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I hear you met the informant.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_053.en:
I've fought that machine several
times. I can't fully trust him.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I've fought that unit / several times. / I can't fully trust him.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_054.en:
He's one of the Numbers.
I'd say if he weren't the kind of man
you'd suspect, the organization
would suspect him instead.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: He's one of the Numbers. / Conversely, if he weren't someone who'd make you suspicious, / the organization would suspect him.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_055.en:
Maybe so.
So, what are his instructions?
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Maybe so. / So, his instructions?

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_056.en:
He seems to be preparing the op.
Before that, we'd commissioned
special parts for fighting the
Vampires. I want you to test the
prototypes this time.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: He seems to be preparing the operation now. / Before that, for this operation, / we requested development of special parts / suited to fighting the Vampires. / This time I want you to test / those prototype parts.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_058.en:
The visiting technician's waiting
at the Killhouse. If the trial goes
without problems, you're free to
keep using the parts.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The dispatched engineer is waiting at the Kill House. / If there's no problem in this trial, / you're welcome to keep / using them as is.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Raikov, huh.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_060.en:
That's right.
Apparently the targets are wanzers he
tuned using data on the Numbers.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / The target is apparently a WAP / he tuned based on / the Numbers' data.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Quite an elaborate test.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_062.en:
He says the prototype weapons can
only run for a limited time.
He wants results fast.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: They say the prototype weapons' trial has / limited operating time. / He wants results in a short time.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Let's prepare.

MsgLabels_station_39_msg_064.en:
He says the prototype weapons can
only run for a limited time.
He wants results fast.
MsgLabels_station_39_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: They say the prototype weapons' trial has / limited operating time. / He wants results in a short time.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_001.en:
Is everyone ready?
The parts fitted to the mock enemy
machines have a time limit.
Do be careful.
MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is everyone ready? / The parts fitted to the hypothetical enemy units / have a time limit. / Please be careful.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_003.en:
Still...
Lycov, you really put together
a wanzer like that...?
MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Still... / Mr. Raikov, you sure built / a WAP like this...

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_004.en:
Yeah.
How do I put this...
MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah. / How to put it...

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_005.en:
If you've got firepower like that,
maybe send it our way instead...
MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If you had forces like that, / send them our way, or rather...

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_006.en:
Hmm.
I understand what you mean.
This is, ah, my personal property.
I built it as a hobby, you see...
MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm. / I understand what you want to say. / This is my private property, or rather, something I / built as a hobby...

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's way too maniacal.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: To be told that by you!

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_009.en:
I-I'm not...
I'm not into that kind of thing!
MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I-I don't... / have that kind of hobby!

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_010.en:
Heh heh heh.
This mock enemy is not just for
show! Brace yourselves!
MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hehehe. / This hypothetical enemy isn't / just about looks! / Brace yourselves!

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_011.en: What are you, the final boss...?
MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Are you the final boss...

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_012.en:
Ahem...
The mock battle will now begin.
MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ahem... / Then we'll start the mock battle.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / We'll annihilate the hypothetical enemy.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_014.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_016.en:
You really are strong.
Now, on to the main event!
MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You really are strong. / Then let's get to the main event!

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? / Even a large unit!

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Raikov's really into it...

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Really private property...?

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_020.en: Ignore it. We take it down.
MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Don't mind it, smash them.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hypothetical enemy signatures gone.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_022.en:
The mock battle seems to have gone
smoothly.
MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The mock battle seems to have gone smoothly.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mr. Raikoooov? / The mock battle's over, you knooow?

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...You're demons.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is something wrong?

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No... it's nothing...

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission over. / That's right?

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Y-yes, that's right... / Mission over.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We get to take the reward, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Please take it.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_031.en:
Aww, Lycov...
I kind of feel sorry for him.
MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aww, Mr. Raikov... / I feel a little sorry for him.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Time limit's almost up.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_033.en:
Phew. We played it too safe
after all.
MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Phew, we really were too cautious.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_034.en:
Well? What do you think of my
special machine's power!
MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: How's that? / The power of my special unit!

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_035.en: There was hesitation in my piloting.
MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There seemed to be hesitation in our piloting.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_036.en:
...Once we heard it was your
personal property, we held back.
MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Hearing it was private property, we held back.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_037.en:
Well, wouldn't happen in a real
fight, though.
MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well, in real combat this wouldn't happen.

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So, my special unit...

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_039.en:
Lycov...
You did get the mock battle data,
right?
MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mr. Raikov... / you got the mock battle data, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_040.en:
Ah, yes...
I got the data.
The test is over...
MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, yes... / I got the data. / The test is over...

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is something wrong?

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No... it's nothing...

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission over. / That's right?

MsgLabels_tactics_39_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Y-yes, that's right... / Mission over.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_001.en:
Mm, oho, I see...!
Now this... this is top quality!
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm, hoh, I see...! / This is... high quality!

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is reading your hobby?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_003.en:
Aye.
One of the joys of my life.
Here, Captain, care for a look?
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm. / One of my reasons for living. / Here, would the Captain like to read it too?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...It's like... a cow.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_005.en:
Exactly so.
"Oh my, Catherine's udderly
flustered!" as they say.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Indeed. / "Catherine, moo, I'm in trouble!" like that.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_006.en:
...You call it reading, but I'd say
this kind of book doesn't have
many words.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...You say reading, but I think books of this sort / have few words?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_007.en:
Never mind that.
Books like this, ya read with
your heart.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Don't worry about it. / Books of this sort are read with the heart.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Read with the heart... / Deep.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's deep.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_010.en:
Hey, Hepaist!
Don't bring books like that into
the barracks!
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hey, Hepaist! / Don't bring that kind of book into the station!

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oops, I've been found / by Miss Rain.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_012.en:
Rain, I don't think it's anything
to worry that much about.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain, I don't think you need / to worry that much.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_013.en:
Huh!? C-Captain...
Honestly, Hepaist, showing the
Captain a book like that...
Get rid of it, now!
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh!? C-Captain... / Honestly, Hepaist, / showing the Captain that kind of book... / Get rid of it right now!

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_014.en:
Alright, alright, I hear ya!
"Oh my, Rain's udderly flustered!"
as they say.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Alright, alright! / Rain, moo, I'm in trouble! like that.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_016.en:
C-C-Captain, what are you looking
at...? Don't compare me to a
gravure model!!
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: C-c-Captain, what are you looking at... / Don't compare me to the gravure model!!

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_017.en:
Captain «E801:00», that there's the
secret of a battle-hardened
veteran... Wait, Rain, hold it!
Not the fist! Not the fist!
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00», / that is the secret of a veteran warrior... / Miss Rain, wait! / Not with your fist, please stop punching with your fist!

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_018.en:
Hepaist throws me completely
off balance... Honestly...
And I am NOT a cow!
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hepaist throws me off... / Honestly... / Ah, I'm not a cow!

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_020.en:
So what's actually different about
bein' an anti-Vampire merc unit?
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Come to think of it, the anti-Vampires mercenary unit, / what's different from before?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_021.en:
The army's admitted the Vampires
exist, but officially stepping in
would be bad, so they're having
mercs carry out the operation.
That's my guess.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The army acknowledged the Vampires exist, / and as a countermeasure, official army intervention / is bad, so mercenaries carry out / that operation, I guess.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_022.en:
But all we gotta do is beat the
black unit, right?
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But all we do is beat / the black unit, right?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well, probably, but...

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Then it's no different from before.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It has changed, you know?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? How?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_027.en: We've got a cooler title now.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The way we're treated got cooler.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Just the treatment...

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_029.en:
But our squad's name is still
"«E801:00» Squad." While we're at
it, why not rebrand? Like the
Vampire Busters, or the Vampire
Hunters! Captain, got any good
name ideas?
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But the unit name, «E801:00» squad, / hasn't changed. / While we're at it, / how about an image change to / Vampires Busters, / or Vampire Hunters? / Captain, do you have a good name?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_030.en:
The squad's name?
Is there any point to rebranding?
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The squad's name? / Is there any point to an image change?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_031.en:
To celebrate becoming an
anti-Vampire merc unit! A fresh
start! That kind of thing.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: To commemorate becoming the anti-Vampires mercenary unit, / a fresh start in spirit! That's the idea.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_032.en:
Celebrate, fresh start...
We don't need any of that...
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Commemoration, a fresh start... / we don't need that...

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_033.en:
Hmmm. They're a vampire squad,
right? Oh, how about "Garlic and
the Silver Bullets"?
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm. They're a vampire unit, right? / Ah, how about Garlic and the Silver Bullets?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_034.en:
I kind of think the first ones
were better.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I feel like the earlier one / was better.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_035.en:
All of a sudden we sound like
a comedy act...
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It suddenly sounds like a comedy act...

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_036.en:
Champ's the garlic, and the Silver
Bullets are the rest of us.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The garlic is Champ, and the Silver Bullets / is the image of us.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That makes me sound like a side garnish!

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_038.en:
I know you love your food, Champ,
but garlic isn't quite meat...
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: "Niku" may be meat, but that "niku" is different...

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_039.en:
...Hmmm.
Thinking up names is hard work.
Let's just stick with
«E801:00» Squad after all.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Hmmm. / Thinking about it is hard, so / let's just go with «E801:00» squad as before.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_040.en:
Having my own codename as the
squad's name did bother me a
little, too. But I've gotten used
to it by now.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I was also a little bothered that my / code name was used as the unit name / as is, but I've gotten used to it.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? / Was... that so...?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, a little.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_043.en:
All we gotta do is beat the
Vampires. Same as always.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All we do is beat / the Vampires. / As usual.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_044.en:
We're up, huh?
Alright, let's go wild today too!
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie. / Alright, I'm gonna run wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_045.en:
Hmmm. Once you start thinking about
names, you can't stop, right?
Silver bullets, cross and stake,
holy water... Hmm... Nothing good
is coming to me...
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm. Once you start thinking about names, / you can't stop, right? / Silver bullets, cross and stake, holy water, / hmm... no good name comes to mind...

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_046.en:
Oh, we're sortieing?
I'll get ready!
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, a sortie, right. / I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_047.en:
Renaming aside, the Vampire Busters
or the Hunters does sound pretty
cool.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Renaming aside, / Vampire Busters and / Hunters are cool too.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_049.en:
Boo hoo... Farewell, my sweet
little Catherine...
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Boo hoo, Catherine-tan, / farewell...

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_050.en:
Little Catherine...
Oops, a mission, eh?
Comin' right away.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Catherine-tan... / Oops, a mission? / I'll go right away.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_051.en: Lieutenant Thomas Norland, I take it?
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You're Lieutenant Thomas Noland?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_052.en:
(Gulp.)
Oh, so you're Captain «E801:00».
Pleased to meet you.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Gulp) / Oh, you're Captain «E801:00». / Nice to meet you.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_053.en:
I heard from Hepaist.
He says you've been diverting
weapons and food somewhere.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I heard from Hepaist. / That you're diverting weapons and food / somewhere.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_054.en:
(Tch, so Hepaist is here.)
Ga-ha-ha!
No, no, that's ancient history.
I don't do that sort of thing now.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Tch, Hepaist was here?) / Gahaha! / No, no, that's an old story. / I don't do that now.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_055.en:
Is that so?
Then what about the supplies you
took from our base? The Commander
never approved that. I hear you
told Champ and Gray otherwise.
Is it even alright for me to report
that you're here right now?
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is that so? / Then what about how, in the past, taking things / from our base didn't have / the Commander's approval? / I hear Champ and Gray were told / the Commander had approved. / And to begin with, is it okay to report / that you're here right now?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_056.en:
(No good. Can't fool this one.)
Ah... sorry.
I give up.
It's true, I took them without
permission. Please forgive me.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (This captain's no good. / Can't fool him.) / Ah, sorry. / I give up. / It's true I took them without permission. / Please forgive me.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_057.en:
In Estonia and on Huffman Island,
you're a hero.
Why do this?
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: In Estonia and on Huffman Island, / you're one of the heroes. / Why do this?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_058.en:
Same reason I got that medal from
Estonia. War always leaves civilians
orphaned and wounded. And plenty of
them get no help from anyone.
I share food with folks like that,
and weapons to protect themselves.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Same as when I got a medal / from Estonia. / War always creates civilian orphans and wounded. / And there are many people who can't get / anyone's help. / I'm sharing food and weapons to protect themselves / with those people.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_059.en:
Hepaist told me about the medal.
And about what you're probably
doing now.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I heard about the medal from Hepaist. / And about what you're probably doing.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_060.en:
Then that saves time.
Won't you let this one slide?
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Then this is quick. / Won't you overlook it?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_061.en:
......I did think our food ration
was generous. You can take about a
third of the food store.
No more weapons or ammunition.
We'll need them from here on.
And you'd better not come back to
this base. Any more and it's likely
to be traced back to you.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ......I did think the food rations / were plentiful. / About a third of the food storehouse / you may take. / Weapons and ammo, no more. / We'll need them from now. / Also, you'd better not / come to this base anymore. / Any more and there's a high chance you'll be traced.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_062.en:
Ga-ha-ha!
Glad you're a man who understands!
I'll do as you say.
Thanks, I mean it.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gahaha! / Glad you're someone who understands! / I'll do as you say. / That helps.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_063.en:
Don't mention it.
I'm the one wandering from
battlefield to battlefield. I share
the blame for what those battlefields
leave behind.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Don't mention it. / In the first place, I wander seeking battlefields. / For the situations those battlefields create, / I too bear responsibility.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_064.en:
......That's one way to live, in
this world. But don't think too hard
about it. All you can do is believe
you'll make up for it someday.
See you.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ......In this world there's that way of living too. / But you'd better not think too deeply. / All you can do is believe you can atone someday. / See ya.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_065.en:
So those black guys are called the
Vampires, huh... Kinda cool, for
the enemy...
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So those black guys are called / the Vampires... / Somehow, even though they're the enemy, it's a little / cool...

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_066.en:
With Gabriel gone, the operator
rotation's brutal. And there's no
way to get a replacement.
That guy, quitting just because
he got dumped...
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: With Gabriel gone, / the operator rotation / has gotten rough. / We can't even get staff replenishment. / That bastard, over just getting dumped...

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_067.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Commander, about Captain Lancer...

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_068.en: It seems he's joined the Numbers.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_068.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: He seems to have become one of the Numbers.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_069.en:
I can't believe it, but...
According to Dark Knight, he goes
by Dragoon.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_069.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's hard to believe, but... / according to Dark Knight, he calls himself / Dragoon.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_070.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's «E801:00». Coming in.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_071.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, I've been waiting.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_072.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain, so you were here.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_073.en:
Captain «E801:00», word just came
from the brass. With the Vampires
spreading their forces across
Huffman, we'll hit two fortified
strongholds at the same time.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_073.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00», a little while ago / word came from the upper echelons. / Now, while the Vampires have dispersed / their forces across Huffman, / we'll simultaneously attack 2 fortified / bases.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_074.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The operation Dark Knight spoke of.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_075.en:
Right.
Split «E801:00» Squad into two teams
and hit both sites at once.
Team A: Captain «E801:00», Oddeye.
Team B: Rain, Champ, Gray and
Hepaist.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_075.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / Split the «E801:00» squad into 2 teams / and attack the 2 bases simultaneously. / Team A is Captain «E801:00» and Oddeye. / Team B is Rain, Champ, Gray, / and Hepaist.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_076.en:
Roger.
I'll take command of Team B.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_076.note:
