Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / I'll take command of Team B.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_077.en:
Team B takes the airbase.
Its defences aren't to be taken
lightly, but seize the control tower.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_077.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Team B will suppress the airborne base. / The airport defense forces are not to be underestimated, but / take control of the control tower.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_078.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Commander, will Dragoon / come out...?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_079.en:
Likely.
Intel puts Dragoon at the airbase,
Team B's target.
...Rain, want to swap with
Captain «E801:00»?
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_079.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Probably. / We've received information that Dragoon is at / the airborne base, Team B's target. / ...Rain, do you want to switch with Captain «E801:00»?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_080.en:
No, I'm fine.
There's something I need to confirm
there in person.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_080.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, I'm fine. / There's something I want to confirm on site.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_081.en:
I see...
One more thing: so as not to damage
the facility, the airbase garrison
has no launchers. Expect mostly
machine guns. Go in with
anti-piercing armor.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_081.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see... / Also, the airborne base's garrison / has no launchers assigned for defense, / so as not to damage the facility. / Machine guns are thought to be the main armament. / Take on the operation with anti-penetration armor.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_082.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_083.en:
Captain «E801:00», Team A is to
destroy a fortified factory.
Dark Knight is undercover there.
He should have valuable intel, such
as the fortress's weak points.
Follow his lead on site.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_083.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00»'s Team A will / destroy the fortified factory. / Dark Knight is undercover there. / He should hold valuable information / such as the fortress's weak points. / Follow his instructions on site.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_084.en:
Then we start the mission once we
link up with Dark Knight.
Do we know the enemy's armament?
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_084.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Then after joining up with Dark Knight / we'll start the mission. / Do you know the enemy unit's armament?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_085.en:
Most likely no machine guns, so they
don't damage the factory.
Expect mainly fire weapons.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_085.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Probably so as not to damage the factory facilities, / they won't be equipped with machine guns. / Flame types are thought to be the main armament.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_086.en:
Roger. If the intel's good,
anti-heat armor will do the job.
We sortie once we're equipped.
Let's go, Rain.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_086.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. If the info is correct, / heat-resistant armor is effective. / Sortieing once equipped. / Let's go, Rain.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_087.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / I'll inform all units.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_088.en:
Split «E801:00» Squad into two teams
and hit both sites at once.
Team A: Captain «E801:00», Oddeye.
Team B: Rain, Champ, Gray and
Hepaist.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_088.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Split the «E801:00» squad into 2 teams / and attack the 2 bases simultaneously. / Team A is Captain «E801:00» and Oddeye. / Team B is Rain, Champ, Gray, / and Hepaist.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_089.en:
Hey, get the army to rein in
«E801:00» Squad already. They ain't
exactly my pals, but the Numbers
are down by half. It's gettin' in
the way of business.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_089.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hey, for crying out loud, tell the army / to make the «E801:00» squad behave. / We're not exactly... comrades, but / anyway the Numbers have been cut in half. / It's going to interfere with work.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_090.en:
I'm afraid that's impossible.
The army brass have begun to
question your work.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_090.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Unfortunately that's impossible. / The army's upper echelons have begun to / have doubts about your work.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_091.en:
Hm?
The army's backing out already?
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_091.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hm? / The army guys are pulling out already?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_092.en:
I didn't say that.
Your work is still needed, by our
company and by the army. But they
can no longer cover for you.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_092.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I didn't say that. / Your work is still necessary to our company / and to the army, but we / can no longer cover for you.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_093.en:
Can't cover for us...
We're doin' this for the army in
the end, and now that same army's
comin' after us?
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_093.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Can't cover for us... / Even though in the end we're doing it for the army, / we're being chased by that army?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_094.en:
The ceasefire keeps the regulars
out of it. Instead, «E801:00» Squad
has become a unit dedicated to you.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_094.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There's a ceasefire agreement, so the regular army won't move. / Instead, the «E801:00» squad became / a unit specializing in you.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_095.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What did you say!?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_096.en:
...Now I get it.
If we take out «E801:00» Squad and
the plan works, great. If they take
us out instead, the plan gets dropped
and everyone plays dumb. «E801:00»
wipes out the evidence, the Vampires,
for 'em.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_096.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I get it. / If we eliminate the «E801:00» squad / and the current plan succeeds, fine. / If the «E801:00» squad beats us, / they give up the plan and play dumb. / Because «E801:00» will erase the evidence / called the Vampires for them.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_097.en: Heh. So, what will you do, Lich?
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_097.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Heh, so what will you do, Lich?

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_098.en:
Me...? I fight.
I got paid plenty up front.
And I made Raven a promise.
Besides, A-- I mean, «E801:00»...
This time I'm gonna settle things
with him.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_098.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll... fight. / I got quite a lot paid in advance. / I have a promise with Raven too. / Besides, with A... no, / with «E801:00» I want to settle things / this time for sure.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_099.en:
Good.
Carry on with your mission.
And it seems the army has been
getting wind of your movements of
late. Be careful.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_099.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good. / Continue with your mission. / Also, lately there are signs that your movements / are known to the army. / Be careful.

MsgLabels_station_40_msg_100.en:
Huh...
I've got an idea about that
myself. Got it.
I'll be careful.
MsgLabels_station_40_msg_100.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm... / I have something in mind too. / Understood. / I'll be careful.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_001.en:
Team A... at the target.
Team B, status... report?
MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Team A... target reached. / Team B... how's it going?

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_002.en:
Team B here.
Arrived outside the airbase.
MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is Team B. / Arrived in front of the airborne base.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_003.en:
Simultaneous assault on both sites.
Time check, ready?
MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We'll do the simultaneous base attack. / Synchronize times, okay?

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 3, 2, 1... 3 minutes to operation start.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_005.en:
Captain, Dark... Knight still
hasn't arrived.
MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, Dark... Knight / hasn't arrived yet.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There seems to be... a time discrepancy.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_007.en:
With the enemy strength here,
Team B can go in first without
any trouble.
MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: With the enemy forces here, Team B / should have no problem attacking first.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_008.en:
Roger.
Team A will wait one minute, then
begin. Team B, start the operation
as planned.
MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Team A will wait 1 minute and then start the operation. / Team B, start the operation as planned.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_009.en:
Alright, Team B!
Let's get this party started!
MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Then, Team B! / Let's get it started!

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger, starting the operation.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good... luck.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_012.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: Rain unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: Rain's unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_014.en:
That giant assault lance...
It really is Captain Lancer...
Champ, Gray, Numbers confirmed.
MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That giant assault lance... / It really is Captain Lancer... / Champ, Gray, Numbers confirmed.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_016.en:
An attack, at this moment...
A merc unit...
Is that you, Rain...?
MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: An attack at this timing... / The mercenary unit... / Is that Rain...

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_017.en:
Hmm.
Just the one special machine.
Shouldn't be a problem.
MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm. / Just 1 special unit. / Should be no problem.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_018.en:
All units, that machine must be
Dragoon. He specializes in
hit-and-run charges with that
giant assault lance...
MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units, that unit seems to be Dragoon. / He should be good at hit-and-away tactics / with the giant assault lance...

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_019.en:
Hell of a weapon...
So closing in is dangerous, huh...
But Rain, we're clear to attack him,
right?
MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What a weapon... / So bringing it to close range is dangerous... / But Rain, it's okay to attack, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_020.en:
Go ahead.
Someone who went over to the
enemy...
MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's fine. / Someone who switched sides to the enemy...

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_021.en:
Rain.
You've grown strong...
If I am to be shot down, I would
have it be by you.
MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain. / You've gotten strong... / If I'm shot down by you, it's my heart's desire.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_022.en:
Dra...goon, don't be in such a...
hurry to die. Abandon that facility...
Pull out and link up with...
Demon.
MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Dra...goon, don't... rush to die. / Abandon that facility... withdraw / and join... up with Demon.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_023.en:
But Rain is...
A survivor of my squad is here.
MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But Rain is... / A survivor of my squad is here.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_024.en:
That adapter, huh.
But she's already...
Forget it.
More to the point, I can't afford to
burn through any more Numbers.
If you don't pull out...
You know what happens, right?
MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That compatible one, huh. / But someone like that... / already... / More importantly, I don't want to wear down / the Numbers any further. / If you don't withdraw... / You know what happens, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Kuh... / Roger. / Dragoon withdrawing.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wait! / Lancer!

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_027.en:
Don't, Rain.
It could be a trap!
MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Stop, Rain. / It may be a trap!

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_028.en:
Our job right now is taking the
control tower, not downing the
Numbers. Are you okay, Rain?
MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rather than shooting down the Numbers, / suppressing the control tower is the mission now. / Are you okay, Miss Rain?

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_029.en:
Roger...
Sorry, everyone.
Continuing the mission.
MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger... / Sorry, everyone. / Continuing the mission.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good, control tower suppressed!

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_031.en:
Team B here.
We've taken the airbase.
MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is Team B. / We've suppressed the airborne base.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Ro...ger... / ...Our operation... too...

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The radio conditions seem bad.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_034.en:
As planned, let's link up with
Team A.
MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As planned, let's join up with Team A.

MsgLabels_tactics_40_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_001.en:
Team A, at the target.
Team B, status report?
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Team A target reached. / Team B, how's it going?

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_002.en:
Team B... here.
Arrived outside... the airbase.
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is B... Team. / Arrived in front of the airborne... base.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_003.en:
Simultaneous assault on both sites.
Time check, ready?
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We'll do the simultaneous base attack. / Synchronize times, okay?

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 3, 2... 1... 3 minutes un...til operation start.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_005.en:
Captain, Dark Knight still
hasn't arrived.
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, Dark Knight / hasn't arrived yet.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There seems to be a time discrepancy.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_007.en:
With the enemy strength... here,
Team B can go... in first without
any trouble.
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: With the enemy forces here... / Team B... should have no problem / attacking first.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_008.en:
Roger.
Team A will wait one minute, then
begin. Team B, start the operation
as planned.
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Team A will wait 1 minute and then start the operation. / Team B, start the operation as planned.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_009.en:
Alright... Team B!
Let's get this... party started!
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Then... Team... B! / Let's get... it started!

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger, starting the oper...ation.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I wish you luck.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_012.en:
Still no Dark Knight...
It's almost been a minute.
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Dark Knight isn't here yet... / It's almost 1 minute.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_013.en:
Can't be helped.
Team A, begin the operation.
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It can't be helped. / Team A starts the operation too.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_015.en:
Victory: Destroy all containers.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: destroy all containers. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_017.en:
Numbers signal detected.
Oh! Captain, it's Dark Knight.
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Numbers signature. / Ah! Captain, it's Dark Knight.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_018.en:
Forgive me.
I am late for our appointment.
I see Team A is Captain «E801:00»
and Oddeye.
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry. / I'm late for the promised time. / Hoh, Team A seems to be Captain «E801:00» / and Oddeye.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_019.en:
Team B is already carrying out
its operation.
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Team B is already carrying out the operation.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_020.en:
Understood.
Then a brief rundown of the
fortress assault. Destroy every
container inside the facility.
One minute after the last container
is destroyed, the bombs I planted
underground will go off -- loudly.
Once the containers are down,
withdraw quickly so you are not
caught in the blast.
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Then I'll briefly explain how to take the fortress. / Destroy all the containers / in the facility. / When all containers are destroyed, 1 minute later / the bombs planted underground will / explode spectacularly. / After destroying the containers, withdraw / quickly so you aren't caught / in the blast.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Seems surprisingly simple.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_022.en: And if the Numbers show up?
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What if the Numbers appear?

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_023.en:
That will not be a concern.
The officer in charge of defending
this site is X-03 Dark Knight.
In other words, me.
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No need to worry about that. / The one in charge of guarding here is X-03 Dark Knight. / In other words, me.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_024.en:
So you mined the facility
you were assigned to guard...
Understood.
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So you planted bombs in the facility / you're in charge of... / Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_025.en: Let us be quick about it.
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Let's do it efficiently.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_026.en:
Whelps.
You dare make a fool of me.
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Greenhorn. / Making a fool of me.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_027.en:
Enemy reinforcements.
...Is that one of the Numbers too?
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy reinforcements. / ...Is that Numbers too?

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What! / X-19 Demon is here!?

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? What's wrong?

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_030.en:
This was not planned.
I was to defend this site alone.
And he is one of the strongest
among the Vampires. Alone, I would
never challenge him...
How did he find out...
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's unexpected. / I was supposed to guard here alone. / And he's a powerhouse even among the Vampires. / Alone I'd never challenge him, but... / how did he find out...

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_031.en:
Can we still put the containers
first?
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is it okay to prioritize destroying the containers?

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_032.en:
You can, but...
Fight Demon head-on and you will
not come away unscathed.
Captain «E801:00», it may be wiser
to fall back and face him when
your whole squad is together...
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's fine, but... / if you fight Demon head-on, / you won't come out unscathed. / Captain «E801:00», pull back once / and challenge him when / the squad members are all together...

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_033.en:
Whatever enemy shows up,
there will be damage.
But we've always put the mission
first. That's what a merc does.
Oddeye, we keep destroying
the containers.
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Whatever enemy comes, / it's never without damage. / But I've always prioritized carrying out the mission. / That's what a mercenary is. / Oddeye, continue destroying / the containers.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_034.en:
Roger.
Besides, that machine is the same
as the other Numbers we've fought.
No matter how much they tune it,
it doesn't look like anything that
special.
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Besides, that unit is the same as / the Numbers so far. / However much it's tuned up, / it doesn't seem to have that much performance.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_035.en:
I see. You are the squad that
has been taking down the Numbers...
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see, you're the unit that's / beaten the Numbers...

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_036.en:
Yep! We're kind of used to this
sort of fight by now.
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, we've gotten used to / this kind of battle.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Roger. / Let's prioritize destroying the containers...

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_038.en:
I've been hit? Me!?
Tch... No choice.
Lich, I'm abandoning the fortress.
Dark Knight is the spy after all.
Looks like he's thrown in with them.
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I've been hit!? / Tch... no choice, / Lich, I'm abandoning the fortress. / Dark Knight is the spy after all. / He seems to have joined up with them.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_039.en:
Ahh, figured as much.
That makes everything fit.
Can't be helped...
Link up with Dragoon and regroup.
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, so it was true. / That makes it all add up. / No choice... / Join up with Dragoon and regroup.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll do that.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_041.en: Um, that enemy just ran away...
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That enemy ran away, though...

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_042.en:
To come away from a fight with
Demon with so little damage...
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Against Demon, to get off with / this little damage.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_043.en:
If what you said is true, Dark
Knight, that wanzer might've had
some maintenance problems.
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If what Dark Knight says / is right, that vanzer / might be poorly maintained.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_044.en:
No...
I suspect he underestimated you...
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No... / he probably underestimated you...

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Continue destroying containers.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_047.en:
Understood.
Now I see why the Vampires keep
falling, one after another.
Fighting beside you made it clear.
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / I see, no wonder the Vampires are / getting beaten one after another. / Fighting together, I understand it well.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_048.en:
Good.
All containers destroyed.
Detonation is imminent.
Let us withdraw from the facility.
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good. / All containers destroyed. / It'll detonate shortly. / Let's withdraw from the facility.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_049.en: All units, withdraw at full speed.
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units, withdraw at full speed.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_050.en:
All units have reached the
withdrawal point.
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units have arrived at the withdrawal point.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Splendid.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Control tower... suppressed...

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Our operation is over too.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Gagah... beep...

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The radio waves are disturbed.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_056.en:
Looks like Team B took the
control tower.
Dark Knight, what's the next move?
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Team B seems to have suppressed the control tower. / Dark Knight, the next operation?

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_057.en:
It seems you now believe
I am on your side.
First, we resupply. Let us move
to our true forward base.
Commander Falcon should be
there as well.
MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems you've come to / believe I'm an ally. / For now, we'll resupply. / Let's move to our real forward base. / Commander Falcon should be coming there too.

MsgLabels_tactics_41_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Lead the way.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_001.en:
The enemy Dragoon really was
Captain Lancer, my old captain.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The enemy Dragoon was / indeed former Captain Lancer.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_002.en:
I see.
So, Rain. Can you shoot him?
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / So Rain, can you shoot him?

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_003.en:
He attacked us too.
There's no choice but to shoot.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: He attacked too. / There's nothing to do but shoot.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_004.en:
Understood.
But if it gets to be too much,
tell me. I'll shoot in your place.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood. / But if it becomes hard, tell me. / Then I'll shoot in your place.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_005.en:
Thank you for your concern.
But I'm a professional mercenary
too. I'll simply shoot anyone
who takes hostile action...
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thank you for your concern. / But I'm a professional mercenary too. / I'll just shoot those who take hostile action...

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood. / I'll trust you.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_007.en:
I'm a professional mercenary too.
I'll simply shoot anyone who takes
hostile action...
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm a professional mercenary too. / I'll just shoot those who take hostile action...

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_009.en:
Captain, this temporary forward
base is really well equipped.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, this temporary forward base / is really well equipped.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_011.en:
Check it out! There's a hot spring
right next to the showers!
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Amazing, there was a hot spring / beside the shower room!

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_012.en:
Huh? A hot spring!!
I wanna try it!
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? A hot spring!! / I want to try it!

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_013.en:
If I remember right, this area was
volcanically active back in the
early settlement days.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If I recall, this area was a place of active / volcanic activity early on.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_014.en:
Bit dusty outside, but there's
a lake too. How come nobody
turned this place into a resort?
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's a little dusty outside, but / there was a lake too. / Why didn't it become a resort area?

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_015.en:
This land got dragged into border
disputes early on. No company
would run a resort somewhere
that dangerous.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's land that got caught up in border disputes early on. / There probably aren't any companies that would do / resort business in such a dangerous place.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hot spring, hot spring~♪

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, you like hot springs?

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_018.en:
I love them!
I wonder what the water's good for?
Maybe it's like the hot springs
in Hawaii. I'm going right now!
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I love them! / I wonder what the spring's benefits are? / Might be close to Hawaii's hot springs. / I'll go try it right away!

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_019.en:
Hold it, Oddeye.
This is a temporary army base,
y'know? The fence is flimsy, and
it's mixed bathing!
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, wait. / This is an army temporary base, you know? / The fence is flimsy and it's mixed bathing, you know?

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_020.en:
It's fine!
I'll wear the swimsuit I bought
with Rain the other day!
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's fine. / I'll bring the swimsuit I bought / with Miss Rain the other day!

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_021.en:
Sounds like fun.
Oddeye...
Captain, you got a swimsuit...
Nah, course you don't...
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: She looks happy. / Oddeye... / Captain, do you have a swimsuit... / no way, huh...

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I don't happen to have one with me.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_023.en:
Tch...
I was gonna borrow one...
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Tch... / and I was going to borrow it...

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_024.en:
Then a real man goes in buck naked!
...Nah, Rain might shoot me...
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If it comes to this, a man goes stark naked! / Nah, Rain might shoot me...

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_025.en:
We're up, huh?
Alright, let's go wild today too!
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie. / Alright, I'm gonna run wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_026.en:
Hmm hmm hmmm~
Phew. The water in these showers
feels different from the old base.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm hmm hmm~♪ / Phew, the shower here seems to have different / water composition from the previous base.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_027.en:
Intruder acquired...
Target confirmed...
Codename: Oddeye.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Intruder acquired... / Target confirmed... / Code name: Oddeye.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_028.en:
Hm? Hepaist, what are
you mumbling about?
...Wait... are you a spy!?
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hm? Hepaist, / what are you muttering about? / ...Don't tell me... a spy!?

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_029.en:
Shh! Gray, is it?
Ya'll tip off the little missy...
C'mere.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Shh, Gray, is it. / Little missy will notice us... / Come over here.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_030.en:
Huh? There's a bath outside?
Hey, wait, that's Oddeye in there!
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? There's a bath outside? / Wait, Oddeye's in it, isn't she.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_031.en:
Hmph, a swimsuit, little missy?
That's cheatin'...
Now, this here's a hot spring.
Loaded with B vitamins.
Good for sunburn and such.
In other words, good for the skin.
The lady soldiers'll be tickled.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm, that little missy, / a swimsuit, how heretical... / This is a hot spring. It contains lots of / vitamin B components. / It's effective for sunburn and such too. / In short, it has a skin-beautifying effect. / That must be a delight for female members.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_032.en:
Hepaist, this looks exactly
like we're peeping.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hepaist, this looks just like / we're peeping.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_033.en:
Nope, absolutely not.
This is a mission simulation.
How to gather intel without the
enemy spottin' ya.
Hm, looks like the Captain's
comin'... Gray, she's all yours!
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, absolutely not. / This is a mission simulation. / Of how well one can gather information / without being found by the enemy. / Hm, the Captain seems to be coming... / Gray, I leave the rest to you!

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_034.en:
A simulation...
You're the supply guy, aren't you?
And what do you mean, all mine...
Now it looks like I'm the only
one peeping...
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Simulation... / Hepaist, you're in charge of supply, right? / Wait, "leave it to you"... / This makes it look like / only I am peeping...

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_035.en: Gray, what are you doing there?
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gray, what are you doing there?

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_036.en:
Captain...
See, Hepaist was here and...
No, that just sounds like an excuse...
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain... / Actually, Hepaist here... / Wait, this sounds like I'm making excuses...

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_037.en:
Hm? So this is the hot spring.
Looks like Oddeye's in.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hm? So this is the hot spring. / Oddeye seems to be in it.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_038.en:
Captain, she'll notice us.
N-not that I'm peeping, but...
what is this feeling? It's almost
like guilt...
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, Oddeye will notice us. / Nah, it's not like we're peeping, but / what is this, this feeling like / guilt...

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_039.en:
Oh?
Captain? Gray?
What are you doing over there?
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh? / The Captain and Gray? / What are you doing there?

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_040.en:
Nothing. Gray was here,
so we were talking.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, Gray was here, / so we were talking.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_041.en:
Captain, that sounds like an
excuse too...
Dammit, Hepaist...
You've landed us in a real mess...
Sorry for dragging you into this,
Captain...
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, that also sounds / like an excuse... / Damn it, that Hepaist... / he made it quite a complicated / situation... / Even dragging the Captain in, / I'm sorry...

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_042.en:
Gray, why are you flustered?
This spring is mixed bathing.
I don't see any problem with
looking in from outside.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gray, why are you flustered? / This hot spring is mixed bathing. / I don't think there's a problem / with looking from outside?

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_043.en:
Huh... So we're not peeping
on the women's bath, then...
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh, then it's not like we're peeping / at the women's bath...

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_044.en:
Quit mumbling, you two,
and come on in!
It feels great!
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Instead of both muttering, / why don't you come in together? / It feels nice, you know?

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_045.en:
Ah, Oddeye, I don't have a
swimsuit either. I'll go in later.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Oddeye, / I don't have a swimsuit, so I'll go in later.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_046.en:
Okay!
But the water's a little hot
for me. I'm getting out now~
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / But the water temperature is a bit high / for me. / I'll get out now~.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_047.en:
Heard there was mixed bathin',
so here I am!
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I heard it was mixed bathing and came.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hepaist, Oddeye already got out.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_049.en:
What!?
...Well, that's no fun at all.
And now two fellas are peepin'
at me... What's an old man to do?
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What! / ...How boring. / And on top of that, being peeped at by two men... / What am I supposed to do?

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_050.en:
Hm, looks like some other soldiers
are coming in. Hepaist, don't
bother the other soldiers.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hm, other soldiers seem to be coming in. / Hepaist, don't bother the other soldiers.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_051.en:
Gwah!
A whole pack of brawny soldiers!!
I'm gettin' out.
Hey! Outta the way, you lot!
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Whoa! / A group of burly soldiers!! / I'm getting out. / Hey! You lot, move it!

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_052.en:
Hepaist, the water seems hot.
Don't overdo it.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hepaist, the water seems hot. / In moderation.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_053.en:
The water's on the hot side,
but that was a lovely soak.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The temperature is on the high side, but / it was a nice bath.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_054.en:
Oh, we're sortieing?
I'll get ready!
Oh, I'd better get changed!
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, a sortie. / I'll get ready! / Ah, I'll go change!

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_055.en:
Hepaist got me good...
I'll watch out from now on.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hepaist got me good... / I'll be careful from now on.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_057.en:
Gwah!
I said outta the way, you lot!
I'm cookin', I'm cookin'...!!
Heeelp meeee!
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Whoa! / I told you lot to move! / I'm getting dizzy, dizzy...!! / Help meee!

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_058.en:
All those brawny soldiers...
Oops, mission time, eh...
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Burly soldiers... / Oops, a mission...

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_059.en:
So you're the Anti-Vampire unit.
Pleased to meet you.
I'm Sam, operator.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So you're the anti-Vampires unit, / nice to meet you. / I'm Sam, the operator.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_060.en:
Dean, maintenance crew.
Glad to have you.
Oh, Mr. Kinoshita came to this base
along with your commander.
And I'd bet good money we've got
parts your base didn't stock.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm Dean from the maintenance crew. / Nice to meet you. / Come to think of it, along with your commander, / Mister Kinoshita has come to this base too. / Also, there should be parts here / that your base didn't have.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_061.en:
Good work on the last operation.
Let me introduce Investigator Roy
of CISU. He's at the center of
this operation.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good work on the last operation. / Let me introduce you: C.I.S.U.'s Investigator Roy. / The central figure in this operation.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_062.en:
Perhaps "Dark Knight" would mean
more to you.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It might be clearer if I said / I called myself Dark Knight.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_063.en:
I'm «E801:00».
CISU...
So you were OCU Central
Intelligence.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's «E801:00». / C.I.S.U.... / So you were the Coalition Central Intelligence Agency.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_064.en:
That is right.
Commander Falcon, please brief him.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's how it is. / Commander Falcon, please explain the operation to him.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_065.en:
Yes, sir.
Thanks to the simultaneous assault,
we've cut the enemy forces off
from each other completely.
The investigator's intel says
there's a bridge north of here
leading to their stronghold.
Head there at once and take it.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / Thanks to the success of the simultaneous base attack, / we were able to completely divide the enemy forces. / According to the Investigator's information, going / north from here, / there's a bridge leading to the base. / Head for this bridge immediately / and suppress it.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_066.en:
So we're finally going after
their main camp.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So at last we're striking their main camp.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_067.en:
Yes.
Taking the bridge is the first step.
I will accompany you on this
operation, but in combat I will
place myself under Captain
«E801:00»'s command.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_067.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm. / Suppressing the bridge is the preparation for that, you could say. / I'll accompany this operation too, but / for combat command I'll put myself / under Captain «E801:00»'s command.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_068.en:
An investigator under a merc's
command?
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_068.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The Investigator under a mercenary's command?

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_069.en:
Naturally.
He is the more capable of us.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_069.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Of course. / His ability is higher.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_070.en:
...I see... If that's what you
want, Investigator...
«E801:00» Squad, take the bridge
and push straight on through.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_070.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Is that so... if the Investigator is fine with it... / «E801:00» squad, suppress the bridge / and advance in one go from there.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_071.en:
Take this bridge, and the Vampires
are completely cut off, while our
own resupply gets easier.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_071.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So if we suppress this bridge, the Vampires / will be completely isolated, and conversely our resupply / can be done easily.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_072.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Exactly.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_073.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Information on the Numbers?

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_074.en:
The two Numbers routed in the last
op may be lying low there.
Stay sharp.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_074.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There's a possibility that the 2 Numbers / who fled in the last operation are lurking. / Be on guard.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_075.en:
Dragoon, once captain of Rain's
old squad, and the veteran merc
Demon. Even for you, the two of
them together are a danger
beyond measure... You will need
the utmost care.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_075.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The previous squad's captain, Dragoon, and / the veteran mercenary Demon. / Even for you, the coordination of those 2 units / is immeasurable... / The utmost care is needed.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_076.en:
Mission understood.
Investigator Roy, one question?
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_076.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / Investigator Roy, may I ask one thing?

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_077.en:
Roy will do.
What is it?
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_077.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Just Roy is fine. / What is it?

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_078.en:
How long were you running with
the Vampires? Couldn't you have
stopped what they were doing?
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_078.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Since when have you been acting together / with the Vampires? / Their actions... / couldn't you have stopped them?

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_079.en:
Captain «E801:00», that's not
information a merc needs to know.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_079.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00», that's information / mercenaries don't need to know.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_080.en:
No, Falcon, it is fine.
He is already deeply involved
in this affair.

...The truth is, soldiers and mercs
began disappearing near the border
about two years ago. Abduction by
the enemy was suspected, yet the
army never properly investigated.
So we at CISU began looking into it.

I sold my services to the group
abducting those soldiers and
succeeded in infiltrating it.
For a year after that, I lived
as one of the Vampires.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_080.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, Falcon, it's fine. / He's already someone deeply / involved in this affair. /  / ...Actually, from about 2 years ago, disappearances of / soldiers and mercenaries had begun near the border. / Even though they were suspected of being abducted by the enemy nation, / the army didn't investigate properly. / So we at C.I.S.U. began investigating. /  / I pitched myself to the organization / attacking those soldiers, and succeeded / in infiltrating. / After that, for 1 year, I lived / as a Vampire.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_081.en:
So you took part in kidnapping
mercs, too.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_081.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You took part in abducting mercenaries too.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_082.en:
To earn the enemy's trust.
It weighed on me, but there was
no alternative.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_082.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: To gain the enemy's trust. / It was painful, but it couldn't be helped.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_083.en:
It was the mission.
I won't blame you for that.
But would you say a few words
to Oddeye?
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_083.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Because it's a mission. / I don't intend to blame you for it. / But would you speak / to Oddeye?

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_084.en:
...About Faceless.
There is something I wish to
tell her as well.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_084.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...About Faceless. / I have something to tell her too.

MsgLabels_station_42_msg_085.en:
There's a bridge north of here
leading to their stronghold.
Head there at once and take it.
MsgLabels_station_42_msg_085.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Going north from here / there's a bridge leading to the base. / Head for this bridge immediately / and suppress it.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_001.en: It seems all units have arrived.
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems all units have arrived.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This bridge, huh.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_003.en:
Yes.
The Vampires have already scattered
across Huffman. The aim of this
operation is to take the bridge
so they cannot return to their
stronghold.
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / The Vampires have already scattered / across Huffman. / This operation's goal is to suppress the bridge / so they can't return to the base.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_004.en:
I hear anti-Vampire units are being
formed outside the main force, too.
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Apparently besides the main force, anti-Vampires units / have been organized too.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_005.en:
Well, "formed" is generous.
They are closer to volunteers...
Emotional types chasing the
Vampires on their own.
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, they're organized, but / it's closer to volunteers... / Emotional people independently / chasing the Vampires.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Emotional...

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_007.en:
Our squad's pretty emotional too,
right?
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Our squad is pretty emotional too, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ is, sure?

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_009.en:
What?
It ain't just me, is it?
Well, the Captain's always cool
as ice, I guess...
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What? / It's not just me, right? / Well, the Captain is always calm...

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_010.en:
Either way, I'd love to meet them
sometime. The Emotional Brigade.
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Either way, I'd like to meet them once. / That emotion army.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Emotion army...

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Investigator... / please don't mind it.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_013.en:
Well, if this operation succeeds,
perhaps you will meet them.
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well, if this operation succeeds, / you might get to meet them.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ooh, I'm looking forward to it!

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_015.en:
Enemy machines confirmed.
All units, eliminate the hostiles
around the bridge.
Watch out for the Numbers.
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy units confirmed. / All units, eliminate the enemy forces around the bridge. / Watch out for the Numbers.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Let's go!

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_017.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_019.en:
Dark Knight, as I thought...
All units, Dark Knight's machine
is hostile. Don't be fooled by
its friendly signal. Wipe it out
along with the mercs.
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Dark Knight after all... / All units, Dark Knight's unit is the enemy. / Don't be fooled by the friendly signal. / Annihilate it together with the mercenary unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_020.en:
The traitor...
And Rain...
Then I will settle this with
my own hands.
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Traitor... / And Rain... / Then... I'll settle it with my own hands.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_021.en:
Dragoon, wait.
Don't be so eager to die.
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Dragoon, wait. / Don't rush off to die on your own.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_022.en:
Leave me be, Demon.
I want to settle things with my
own sense of justice.
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Demon, leave me be. / I want to settle things for my sense of justice.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_023.en:
I've no time to indulge your
self-satisfaction. Right now we
can't afford to waste one machine,
not even yours. Coordinate with me.
First find out whether this is an
enemy you can beat alone.
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I have no room to humor your self-satisfaction. / Right now I can't waste even you, a single unit. / Coordinate with me. / Determine whether they're an opponent / you can beat alone.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_024.en:
Dragoon, you're under Demon's
command now. You know your men's
lives are mine to do with as I
please, right? No dying on your
own. Got it?
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Dragoon, put yourself under Demon's command. / You know your subordinates' lives can go / any way I decide, right? / Don't die on your own. / You understand, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_025.en:
(Even if I am defeated... the
result would be the same...
Damn you, Lich...)
...Roger.
I will not waste myself.
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Even if I'm defeated... the result is the same... / that Lich...) / ...Roger. / I won't waste myself.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_026.en:
We throw every unit on this bridge
at them, and once they're worn
down, we strike all at once.
Understood, Dragoon?
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We'll throw all the bridge's forces at them, / and strike in one go once they're worn down. / Got it, Dragoon?

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger...

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_028.en:
So that unit's strength is
the real thing...
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As I thought, that unit's power is genuine...

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_029.en: Is retreat all that is left...?
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is there nothing to do but retreat...

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_030.en:
Lich...
It's bad.
At this rate, the bridge will fall.
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Lich... / The situation is bad. / At this rate the bridge will fall.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_031.en:
Well, that's not good...
Fine. I'll have the tech team
start up that thing.
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is bad... / No choice, I'll have the tech team / activate that.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You say it can already move...?

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_033.en:
It'll move, alright.
The material was a top-notch
soldier, after all.
You two Numbers, fall back
to POINT G.
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It'll move. / It was an excellent soldier to begin with. / The 2 Numbers, fall back / to point G.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_034.en:
...Roger.
Then we abandon the bridge and
fall back. Sorry, defense team.
Buy us some time.
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Roger. / Then we'll abandon the bridge and fall back. / Sorry, defense squad. / Buy us time.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The Numbers are withdrawing!

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_036.en:
Retreating again...
Lancer...
Can't you even fight me properly
anymore...?
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Retreating again... / Lancer... / have you become unable to even fight properly...

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_037.en:
Don't dwell on it, Rain.
We're finishing off the bridge.
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain, don't mind it. / We'll finish suppressing the bridge.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed all enemies silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_039.en:
Two special machines got away,
but we'll pursue them right away.
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We let 2 special units get away, but / we'll pursue at once.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Retreat here...? / A trap?

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What's wrong, Roy?

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_042.en:
Their withdrawal bothers me.
It is as if they are leading
us on...
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The way they pulled back bothers me. / It seems like they're luring us...

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_043.en:
Leading us...?
Do they have some kind of powerful
weapon or something?
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Luring... us? / Do they have some powerful weapon or something?

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_044.en:
I have something in mind.
It was called the B2 prototype...
If it is operational, it will be
a serious threat. But I heard that,
unlike a wanzer, only a few pilots
could operate it.
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I have something in mind. / It was called the B2 prototype... / if it's usable, it'll be a considerable threat. / But I'd heard that unlike vanzers, the pilots / who can operate it are limited.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_045.en:
I've heard of that weapon.
Bein' built for some bigwig or
other, so they said. A whole
different concept from your
regular wanzer...
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I've heard of that weapon. / Under development for some bigwig or other. / The concept itself is different / from conventional vanzers...

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You're well informed, Hepaist.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_047.en:
Be a merc long enough and ya
get to know a lot of folks.
But I also heard a fair few
engineers died in the tests,
or whatever they were doin'
with that machine...
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: When you've been a mercenary for a long time, / at least your circle of acquaintances gets wide. / But I also heard that in experiments or whatnot with that unit, / many engineers were / sacrificed...

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_048.en:
I see. Engineers among the
victims as well...
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see, so engineers were victims too...

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_049.en:
You're saying that prototype may
be waiting where we're headed.
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You're saying that prototype may be / deployed where we're advancing.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_050.en:
Rather than pressing on like this,
we would do better to return to
the forward base and resupply.
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rather than advancing as is, / it seems better to return to the forward base for now / and resupply.

MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_051.en:
Roger.
Bridge secured.
All units, resupply before we
advance.
MsgLabels_tactics_42_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Suppression operation complete. / All units, resupply before advancing.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Dragoon's unit retreated again.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_002.en:
As Roy said, it's probably a plan
aimed at us. Still, those two
Numbers are very battle-seasoned.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As Roy said, / it's probably an operation against us. / But those 2 Numbers / are quite used to fighting.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_003.en:
Captain Lancer understood wanzers
better than anyone in the squad.
I heard he was a merc on other
battlefields before he came to
Huffman.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Former Captain Lancer understood WAPs / best of anyone in the squad. / Apparently before coming to Huffman he was / a mercenary on another battlefield too.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_005.en: Next time, I intend to settle this.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Next time, I want to settle things.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / Don't push yourself.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_007.en: Next time, I intend to settle this.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Next time, I want to settle things.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, right. / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_009.en:
The other outfit, huh.
Wonder what they're like?
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A separate unit, huh. / I wonder what kind of guys they are?

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_010.en:
Apparently they're not even proper
mercs. They've got sponsors,
though.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: They're apparently not official mercenaries either. / Though they seem to have a sponsor.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_011.en:
Either way, we've made it this far
partly thanks to their work.
If I get the chance, I'd like to
talk with them.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Anyway, it's partly thanks to the separate unit's work / that we got this far. / If we get a chance to meet, I'd like to talk with them.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_012.en: They must be a really good unit.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: They must be an excellent unit.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_013.en:
Bet they're about as tough as us,
or close to it.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: They probably have skill on par / with us, or close to it.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_014.en:
Wonder if they've got any cute
girls in that unit, eh?
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I wonder if that unit has cute girls too.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_015.en:
Your skirt-chasing's got no limits,
old man...
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The old man's love of women has no limit...

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_016.en:
And thanks to that, I got put
through the wringer last time.
Don't drag us into it again.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thanks to that, the other day we went through / a terrible ordeal. / Don't drag us in too.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_017.en:
The secret to a long life,
I suppose. Still, best avoid
anything that invites
misunderstanding.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The secret of long life, huh. / But you'd better refrain from things / that invite misunderstanding.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_018.en:
I know, I know.
The Captain's the only one
who understands me, eh.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I know. / As expected, the Captain is the only one / who understands me.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_019.en:
Somehow I don't think that's what
he meant... Eh, whatever.
Guess I'll get ready for the next
fight.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Something seems off about that... / Well, whatever. / Now, shall I prepare for the next battle.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_020.en:
Guess I'll get ready for the next
fight.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Now, shall I prepare for the next battle.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_021.en:
We're up, huh?
Alright, let's go wild today too!
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie. / Alright, I'm gonna run wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll finish resupplying too.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_024.en:
Oh, Captain.
That's Dark Knight, isn't it?
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Captain. / That person is Dark Knight, right?

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Everyone, are sortie preparations going smoothly?

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_027.en: Unusual to see you down here.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's rare for you to appear in a place like this.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You're Oddeye.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, that's right.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I must apologize to you.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes? What's the matter?

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm sorry about Faceless.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh!?

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_034.en:
He was my friend.
And Delta was working with us.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: He was my friend. / And Delta was cooperating with us.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So that's how it was.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_036.en:
"My close friend Roy"...
So that was you...
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: His close friend Roy... So it was you...

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_037.en:
I wish I could have helped you
sooner... But I was investigating
the Vampires from the inside and
could not move freely. That is why,
from time to time, I passed you
information through the army.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If only I could have cooperated with you / a little sooner... / I was doing internal investigation / of the Vampires, / so I couldn't move. / That's why occasionally, through the army, / I provided you with information.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_038.en:
I was also the one who gave Delta
its orders.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It was also I who gave Delta the operation orders.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see......

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_040.en:
He told me about you often.
Whenever you came up, he looked
so very happy.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I often heard about you from him. / Whenever the talk turned to you, / he looked very happy.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_041.en:
David...
Roy, do you think David's
still alive?
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: David... / Mr. Roy, / is David alive?

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_042.en:
There was no body at the scene.
Which means he may already have
been sent to the facility.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There was no body at the scene. / That being so, there's a possibility he's / already been sent to the facility.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The facility?

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_044.en:
Some kind of experiments are being
conducted there. Mercs captured by
the Vampires are taken away by its
people. Only a few are allowed
inside; I could not learn what goes
on there. If he is at the facility,
David may still be alive.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems some kind of experiment is done there. / The mercenaries the Vampires capture / are taken by the facility's people. / The people who can enter the facility are limited, / and I couldn't learn what goes on inside. / If he's at the facility, there's a possibility / David is alive.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_045.en:
...If there's a chance, then
that's good.
Well, I'll go get ready for battle
in the hangar!
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...If there's a possibility, I'm glad. / Now, I'll go prepare for battle / in the hangar!

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_046.en:
All right. I'll be there shortly.
Roy, there's something I want to
pass on. It's from David...
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood. I'll come soon too. / Roy, there's information I want to tell you. / It's from David...

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Let me hear it.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_048.en:
The Vampires, Sakata Industries'
private mercenary army.
Its purpose is to collect skilled
wanzer pilots.
Mostly, it captures wanzer mercs and
makes it look like they deserted.
Behind the unit, they're suspected of
performing some kind of biological
experiments on the captured mercs,
and using the results to develop
next-generation weapons.
The unit's own mercs don't seem to
have been told any more than that.

But if even our intel leaked, I think
someone high in the army is helping
them.
There's no proof, but this is a more
powerful organization than we
imagined.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sakata Industry's private mercenary unit, / the Vampires. / The unit's purpose is to gather excellent WAP pilots. / Mainly, they capture WAP mercenaries, making it look / like desertion in the face of the enemy. / Behind the unit, they're suspected of performing / some kind of biological experiments on captured mercenaries, / and developing next-generation weapons based on them. / Though the mercenaries themselves don't seem to have been / told anything more than that. /  / But the fact that even our information leaked / means, I think, there's backing / from the army's upper echelons. / There's no proof, but it can be called a more / powerful organization than we imagine.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_049.en:
...I see, David.
So they have ties to the army's
top brass as well...
Our orders to Delta went through
the army. Their every move was
known... But if they knew about my
infiltration too... why did they
let me run free?
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I see, David. / So they were connected / to the army's upper echelons too... / The orders to Delta were given through the army. / All their movements were known... / But if my infiltration was known too... / why did they let me swim free?

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_050.en:
They seem to have something
in mind.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There seems to be some scheme.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_051.en:
So it seems.
Let us keep digging.
Now, Captain «E801:00», I will go
ahead to headquarters.
Later.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / Let's push the investigation forward. / Well then, Captain «E801:00», / I'll go to headquarters first. / Later.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_052.en:
All right.
I'll be right there.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood. / I'll come right away.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_053.en:
Well, I'll go get ready for battle
in the hangar!
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Now, I'll go prepare for battle / in the hangar!

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_054.en:
Oh, we're sortieing?
I'll get ready!
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, a sortie, right. / I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_055.en:
The Captain's the only one
who understands me, eh.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Only the Captain / understands me.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_056.en:
Right you are.
Leave the repairs and resupply to me.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger that. / Leave repairs and supply to me.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_057.en:
Now, Captain «E801:00», I will go
ahead to headquarters.
Later.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well then, Captain «E801:00», / I'll go to headquarters first. / Later.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_058.en:
As you know, CISU is the
intelligence agency under the
OCU Prime Minister's office.
We're its action unit, sent in
when it faces armed enemies.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As you know, C.I.S.U. / is the intelligence agency held by the O.C.U. Prime Minister's Office. / We're the "action unit" that deploys / when countering enemies with armed force.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_059.en:
CISU does a lot of internal probes
into ministries and the military,
so, honestly? We're not exactly
popular. Safe bet, that one.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: C.I.S.U. often does covert investigations / of ministries and the military, so honestly / it doesn't seem very liked.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_060.en:
Commander Falcon, we are in the
middle of the advance, but I am
changing the plan.
It seems they readied their trump
card sooner than I expected...
Please hurry the resupply.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
