Literal: Commander Falcon, we're in the middle of the advance operation, but / we're changing the plan. / They seem to have prepared their trump card / sooner than I thought... / Hurry the resupply work.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / I'll have them hurry the resupply.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_062.en:
Captain «E801:00», if this enemy
is what I expect, it is the
strongest and worst yet. Far beyond
any of the Numbers so far...
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00», / if this enemy is as expected, / it's the strongest and worst. / On a different order from the Numbers so far...

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems to be quite an opponent.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_064.en:
The two Numbers that retreated
will surely join it, too.
This time, focus above all on
driving the prototype off.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The 2 Numbers who withdrew are surely / going to join up too. / This time you'd better prioritize / driving off the prototype above all.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_065.en:
Drive it off?
Not shoot it down?
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Drive it off? / Not shoot it down?

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_066.en:
Investigator Roy...
What exactly are we about to
fight...?
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Investigator Roy... / what exactly are we about to fight...?

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_067.en:
That is no wanzer...
A devil born of human hands,
you might say... The B1 prototype
went out of control and reduced
its research facility to ash
in seconds. B2 is the improved
model. It will be stronger still.

I hear the prototype's operating
time is still short. Destroy it if
you can, but do not push it.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_067.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That is not a WAP... / A devil born of humans, you could say... / They say the B1 prototype went berserk and in seconds / turned the research facility to ash. / B2 is the improved model. / It's probably even more powerful. /  / I hear the prototype's operating time is still short. / If possible you may destroy it, but / don't push it. /

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_068.en:
Roger.
I'll drive it off, as requested.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_068.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / We'll drive it off as you expect.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_069.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Good luck.

MsgLabels_station_43_msg_070.en:
The op: drive off the prototype
while watching for the two Numbers.
Get that resupply done, fast.
MsgLabels_station_43_msg_070.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The operation is to drive off the prototype / while watching out for the 2 Numbers. / Hurry the resupply work.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_001.en:
Enemy machines acquired.
X-03's signal detected as well.
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy units acquired. / Also caught X-03's signature.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_002.en:
This thing will really move,
won't it?
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It really will move, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_003.en:
In theory...
But five turns is the limit.
Beyond that, it will go out of
control, just like the B1
prototype.
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Theoretically... / But 5 turns is the limit. / Beyond that, just like the B1 prototype, / it will become uncontrollable.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_004.en:
Still, that's enough to crush
a whole wanzer division...
Right, they're the target!
Wipe them out!
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But with that much, / it should pulverize about one WAP division... / Good, they're the target! / Annihilate them!

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_006.en: What's wrong? It's not starting up.
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What's wrong, it doesn't seem to be starting?

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_007.en:
W-wait!
I'm not the enemy!
It's that wanzer unit!
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: W-wait! / I'm not the enemy! / It's that WAP unit!

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Starting... operation...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_009.en:
Finally up and running...
But clearly not to be relied on...
Dragoon, looks like it's up to us
after all. We coordinate.
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Finally started, huh... / But it means we can't rely on it... / Dragoon, it seems we must handle this ourselves / after all. / We'll coordinate.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_011.en:
Enemy machines confirmed, lying in
ambush. Investigator, is that white
machine the target?
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy units confirmed, they're lying in wait. / Investigator, is that white unit the target?

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_012.en:
Yes...
But those awkward movements...
It seems it is still incomplete.
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right... / But those awkward movements... / it seems still incomplete.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_013.en: So we drive off that white machine.
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So we drive off that white unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_014.en:
That was the plan, but if the
prototype is incomplete, downing
the Numbers should come first.
I will hold the white machine.
«E801:00» Squad, bring down
the two Numbers.
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That was the intent, but if the prototype / is incomplete, it's better to prioritize / shooting down the Numbers. / I'll hold down the white unit. / «E801:00» squad, bring down / the 2 Numbers.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_015.en:
Roger.
Roy, don't be in a hurry to die.
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Roy, don't rush to die.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_016.en:
Do not worry.
I still have a great deal
left to do.
Moving in!
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm fine. / I still have lots of things / I must do. / Let's go!

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_017.en:
Victory: Destroy the Numbers.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit or
Rain unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down the Numbers. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down or / Rain's unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_019.en:
Rain... This is how it
should be...
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain, this is fine...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Dragoon's unit silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_021.en:
So this is the end...
«E801:00» Squad... such strength.
But...
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is this the end... / «E801:00» squad... what strength. / But...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Demon's unit... no way, a suicide attack?

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_023.en:
Damn, he's going for Rain.
Rain, get clear!
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Bad, the target is Rain's unit. / Rain, get away!

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_024.en:
I'll take as many of you
with me as I can...!!
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Take as many as I can down with me...!!

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_025.en: No! I can't make it in time!
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No good, we won't make it!

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Kyaaaaah! / ... / ...!?

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_027.en:
No way...
Dragoon's machine...
It's shielding Rain!
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No way... / Dragoon's unit is... / shielding Miss Rain!

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_028.en:
Damn you, Dragoon...
You would stand in my way...
So this is my end as well...
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Damn you, Dragoon... / You'd get in my way... / With this I too am...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_029.en:
Rain... It's been a while...
Ghk...
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain... it's been a while... / cough...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain Lancer... why...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_031.en:
My squadmates... were taken
hostage... Ghk... hhk...
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Comrades from the squad... were taken hostage... / cough, cough...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_032.en:
I see... Just the sort of thing
Lich would do. Dragoon, did you
truly think Lich would keep the
hostages alive?
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see... just the kind of thing Lich would do. / Dragoon, do you think Lich would keep / the hostages alive?

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_033.en:
Dark Knight, is it...
Earlier... the researchers told me
they had all been executed...
It's late to say it, but it seems
I was wrong...
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Dark Knight, huh... / Earlier... I heard from the researchers / that they were all executed... / It's too late now, but my actions / seem to have been wrong...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, you saved me.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_035.en:
...Rain... I'm leaving you
alone again...
No... you have comrades in your
squad now...
Take care... of your comrades...
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Rain... I'm leaving you alone. / No... you have your current squad comrades... / Take good care... of your comrades...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_036.en:
Captain Lancer, get out. We'll
get you treated right away...
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain Lancer, get out, and get treated right away...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_037.en:
No... the cockpit block is crushed.
I can't move.
The machine will cook off soon...
There's no getting out...
Move away from me.
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No... the cockpit block is crushed / and I can't move. / The unit will probably have an induced explosion soon... / Escape is impossible... get away.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_038.en:
Rain, get back.
Numbers machines carry a liquid
that explodes by chemical reaction,
so they leave no evidence behind...
I am afraid the reaction has
already begun...
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain, get away. / The Numbers' units carry a liquid that explodes / by chemical reaction to wipe them out / without leaving evidence... / Unfortunately, the reaction has already started...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_039.en:
...You hadn't changed after all.
I'm glad I could see that...
Goodbye... Lancer.
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...It seems you hadn't changed. / I was happy to confirm that... / Goodbye... Lancer.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_040.en:
Rain...
Both Numbers machines destroyed.
Only the white machine is left!
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Miss Rain... / Both Numbers are wrecked. / Only the white unit remains!

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_041.en:
I-I'm... sor...ry...
Can't I... save... them...?
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I-I'm... so...rry. / Can't I... save... them...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_042.en:
Not good, fragments of its
consciousness are surfacing...
At this rate it'll go berserk!
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Bad, fragments of consciousness are surfacing... / At this rate it will go berserk!

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Withdraw.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_044.en:
R-roger...
Withdrawing.
Cut the power!
Reinforce the neural link filters!
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: R-roger... / Withdrawing. / Cut the power! / Strengthen the neural connection filter!

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: White unit retreating...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_046.en:
We have done what we came for,
for now. We know where it is
retreating to. Captain «E801:00»,
let us resupply, regroup and
strike there. But those movements...
Who is it? Who is the victim...?
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: For now we accomplished our goal. / We know where it's retreating to. / Captain «E801:00», let's resupply once, / reorganize the squad, and attack there. / But those movements... who is it? / Who is the victim...?

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is bad! / Enemy reinforcements!

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_048.en:
Not good. We can't take
much more of this...
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is bad, any more and we can't possibly...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed 2 more reinforcements.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_050.en:
Tch...
We have taken heavy wear as well.
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Kuh... / We're badly worn down too.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Whaaat? / Isn't that Hepaist?

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yo, old man.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_054.en: Well, if it ain't you two!
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's you lot!

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_055.en:
Ahaha!
If it isn't Pervy Gramps!
Still kicking, I see!
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ahaha! / Sexual-harassment Grandpa, / you still look healthy.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: S-sexual-harassment Grandpa...!? / Do you know them?

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_057.en:
Know 'em? These two are
my disciples!
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Know them? These are / my disciples.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_058.en:
Disciples...
What kind of relationship is that...
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Disciples... what kind of relationship...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_059.en:
Disciples!? What are you on about?
We were the ones looking after
you, Gramps!
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Disciples!? What are you saying? / Weren't we the ones / looking after Grandpa?

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Old man, we'll lend a hand, okay?

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_061.en:
Whatever.
Leave the rest to us.
You old-timers are headed
somewhere, right?
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well, whatever. / Leave the rest to us. / You old folks are going somewhere, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_062.en:
Aye, everyone's outta ammo.
We were wantin' to head back
and resupply.
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, everyone's out of ammo, / and we wanted to go back to resupply.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_063.en:
Are you sure, Hepaist?
They appear to be attack
helicopters and old tanks...
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is this okay, Hepaist? / They seem to be an attack helicopter / and an old-model tank...

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_064.en:
Hmm...
Well, leave it to 'em.
Old means there's that much more
history behind it.
These two know how to fight with
that history.
You two, don't overdo it now.
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm... / Well, leave it to them. / Old models have that much more / history. / These two know how to fight / with that history. / You two, don't push yourselves.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_065.en:
We'll be fine!
Everyone else'll be here soon
anyway.
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We're fine! / In a little while everyone will come too.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_066.en:
Oh? I see. So you lot are...
Hm.
Give everyone my best.
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hoh, I see, so you lot are... / Hmm. / Give my regards to everyone.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_067.en:
Let's have a drink once things
settle down! Deal, old man?
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_067.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Once things calm down let's drink again! / Right! Old man.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_068.en:
I'll stay alive till then,
don't you worry.
Captain, ya can leave this to them.
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_068.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll stay alive until then. / Captain, you can leave it to them.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_069.en:
Roger.
We'll resupply, then go after
the prototype.
MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_069.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / We'll resupply once and pursue the prototype.

MsgLabels_tactics_43_msg_070.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_001.en: No, no, you've got it wrong!
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, that's wrong!

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_002.en:
What's all this commotion, in the
middle of an emergency?
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What's this commotion in an emergency?

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_003.en:
Captain, Hepaist did something
that borders on harassment...
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, Hepaist / did something like sexual harassment...

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_004.en:
The old man suddenly unhooked
Rain's wanzer harness from behind,
and he nearly touched my bottom...
He really is Pervy Gramps.
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Miss Rain suddenly had her WAP harness / unfastened from behind by Grandpa, / and he almost touched my butt... / He really is a sexual-harassment Grandpa.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is that so? / Hepaist.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_006.en:
No, you've both got it wrong!
The lock on Rain's harness was
bent, so I was just checkin' it.
See? A harness like that's
dangerous. Swap it for a new one,
quick as ya can.
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, it's a misunderstanding by the two of them! / Miss Rain's harness / had a warped locking mechanism, / and it bothered me so I just checked it. / See, a harness like that is dangerous. / Better replace it with a new one right away.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_007.en: And trying to touch my bottom?
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: And trying to touch my butt?

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_008.en:
That's a misunderstandin' too!!
Your holster's cowhide, little missy,
rare these days, eh? Don't look
after it and it'll go moldy and
rot in no time.
I was only tryin' to check on it!
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's a misunderstanding too!! / Little missy's holster is / a cowhide holster, rare these days, right? / If you don't care for it, it'll mold and / quickly rot. / I was trying to check that!

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_009.en:
Oh, I see...
Now that you mention it, I ran out
of maintenance oil.
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, I see... / Come to think of it, I'd run out of / maintenance oil.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_010.en:
See?
Even I wouldn't go harassin'
folks in an emergency like this!
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: See? / Even I wouldn't commit sexual harassment / in this emergency!

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems the problem is solved.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_012.en:
Right, I'll get rid of this
harness for ya.
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good, I'll dispose of / the harness.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_013.en:
Wait, why is Hepaist wearing
my harness?
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wait, why is Hepaist wearing / my harness?

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_014.en:
Well now, not bad at all.
Ya've got a fine figure, Rain.
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hoh, not bad. / Miss Rain has a nice body.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_015.en:
Hepaist...
It IS harassment!
Give that harness back this instant!
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hepaist... / it IS sexual harassment after all! / Give that harness back!

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_016.en:
So this is the secret of a seasoned
veteran... Not something just
anyone could imitate.
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So this is the secret of a veteran warrior... / It's not easily imitated.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_017.en:
What!?
Captain...
Please don't be impressed by that...
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh!? / Captain... / Please don't be impressed by that...

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_018.en:
It's right before the decisive
battle, and when I'm alone I end up
thinking about all sorts of things...
Oh! Was Hepaist being
considerate of that...!?
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even though it's before the decisive battle, / being alone I end up thinking about all sorts of things... / Ah, was Hepaist / being considerate of that...!?

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_019.en:
A sortie. I'll get ready right away.
Oh, and the harness is a new one...
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie, I'll get ready at once. / Ah, the harness is new...

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_020.en:
Do I have any maintenance oil
left...?
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I wonder if there's maintenance oil?

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_021.en:
Oh, we're sortieing?
I'll get ready!
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, a sortie, right. / I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Amazing, old man...

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_023.en:
We're up, huh?
Alright, let's go wild today too!
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie. / Alright, I'm gonna run wild today too!

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_024.en:
Hepaist...
The smith god of mythology.
An old soldier who takes that name
for his codename.
A force to be feared...
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hepaist... / the name of the smithing god in mythology. / An old soldier who uses that name as his code name. / Fearsome...

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_026.en:
(Hepaist, as ever...
Loosening up the squad before
the decisive battle, I suppose...)
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (As expected of Hepaist... / Loosening the members' tension / before the decisive battle, I suppose...)

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_027.en:
(Now, resupply should be done soon.
I'll head to headquarters to go
over the plan.)
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Now, resupply should be finishing soon. / I'll go to headquarters to confirm the operation.)

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good, sortie.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_029.en:
Ha ha ha!
A bit of liveliness like this
before the big fight does ya good!
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hahaha! / Before a decisive battle, it's better to have / this much liveliness!

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_030.en:
Right you are.
Leave the repairs and resupply to me.
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger that. / Leave repairs and supply to me.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_031.en:
That old guy Hepaist is supposed
to be a famous merc, but... we keep
getting complaints about him from
the women on base.
Could you do something about it?
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That old man Hepaist / is apparently a famous mercenary, but... / there are a ton of complaints from / women on the base. / Can't you do something?

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_032.en:
That old man does whatever he
likes... Wonder if I'd get away
with that much once I'm his age.
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That old man does whatever he pleases... / If I get old, would I get off / that lightly?

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_033.en:
Investigator, resupply will be
complete in 30 minutes.
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Investigator, resupply work will be complete / in 30 minutes.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_034.en:
Good work.
Captain «E801:00», let us go over
the operation one last time.
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good work. / Captain «E801:00», let's do the operation's final check.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_036.en:
Where the X-00B2 prototype fled...
It is most likely here.
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Where the X-00 B2 prototype fled to is... / probably here.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's like a fortress.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_038.en:
The Numbers assigned here was
X-07 Wizard. You have already
destroyed that machine.
It is now a castle without a lord.
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The Numbers in charge here was / X-07, Wizard's unit. / You've already destroyed that unit. / It's currently a castle with no master.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_039.en:
Are the fortress's defences just
gun turrets?
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is this fortress's defense system / just the gun turrets?

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_040.en:
Yes.
They should pose little threat.
As soon as resupply is finished,
we head for the fortress.
We must strike while the B2
prototype cannot operate.
Left alone, it will certainly
become a threat.
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / It shouldn't be much of a threat. / As soon as resupply is done, let's head / to the fortress at once. / We have no choice but to strike while the B2 prototype / can't conduct operations. / Left alone, it will definitely become a threat.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood.

MsgLabels_station_44_msg_042.en:
Investigator, resupply will be
complete in 20 minutes.
MsgLabels_station_44_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Investigator, resupply work will be complete / in 20 minutes.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_001.en: Is the sling chopper here yet?
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hasn't the sling helicopter arrived yet?

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 2 more minutes.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_003.en:
X-00 still has not regained
consciousness?
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hasn't X-00 regained / consciousness yet?

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_004.en:
Nope.
It got thrown into real combat out
of nowhere, after all. Honestly, if
Lich hadn't rushed it out, this
never would've happened.
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Nope. / It was sudden live combat, after all. / Honestly, if Lich hadn't rushed to deploy it, / this wouldn't have happened.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_005.en:
Stop grumbling.
The enemy is the unit that downed
Wizard and the other Numbers.
It was likely unavoidable.
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Don't grumble. / The enemy is the squad that shot down Wizard / and the other Numbers. / It was probably unavoidable.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_006.en:
So they have thrown all our plans
into disarray.
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So they threw all our plans off.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_007.en:
Word is that unit is connected to
X-00... to its donor body, as well.
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That squad is connected to X-00... / to this one's base body too, apparently.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy unit signatures. / Here they come!!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_009.en:
Mixed in with them... an X-series
signal.
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mixed among the units, there's / an X-series signature too.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Dark Knight... the traitor's unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_011.en:
So Dark Knight really did turn
on us, huh. I kinda liked him, too.
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Dark Knight, so you really / betrayed us. / I kind of liked you, too.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_012.en:
A pity, Witch.
But you may at least savor his
face twisted in agony at the end.
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Too bad, Witch. / But you'd do well to behold his / anguished face at the end.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roo-ger♪

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As the info said, there are gun turrets.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_015.en: Roy, aren't there a lot of turrets?
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roy, aren't there a lot of turrets?

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_016.en:
Strange.
I had no idea they had reinforced
it this much...
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Strange. / To think they'd reinforced it this much...

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 4 special units found!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_018.en:
They were called the Mage Corps...
Like Wizard, their machines repair
their own parts automatically.
A troublesome unit...
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: They were called the Mage squad... / Like Wizard, they have a function / where their parts self-repair. / A troublesome unit...

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The white one is there too.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's standing still.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_021.en:
All units, the Mage Corps use
sophisticated tactics.
Be careful.
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units, the Mage squad uses / advanced tactics. / Be careful.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_022.en:
Roger.
We pin down the Mage Corps and
put the white machine first.
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / While holding the Mage squad in check, / prioritize destroying the white unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_024.en:
Victory: Destroy the Mage Corps
or X-00.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit or
Rain unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down the Mage squad or / X-00. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down or / Rain's unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_026.en:
Sling chopper's arrived.
Two minutes exactly.
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sling helicopter arrived. / Exactly 2 minutes.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_027.en:
Good. Have it recover X-00
and withdraw at once.
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. Have it recover X-00 / and withdraw swiftly.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_028.en:
I won't let you mess with
the pickup!
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I won't let you interfere with the recovery!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_029.en:
Recovery complete.
Sending the sling chopper off.
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Recovery complete. / Withdrawing the sling helicopter.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Now then, all that's left is them♪

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_031.en: Wear them down as much as you can.
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wear them down as much as possible.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_033.en:
Captain, the sling chopper carrying
the prototype has withdrawn!
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, the sling helicopter carrying the prototype / withdrew!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_034.en:
Too late...
Roy, you're good at working alone,
aren't you?
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We didn't make it in time... / Roy, you were good at solo action, weren't you?

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: «E801:00», what do you intend to do?

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_036.en:
We'll hold off the Mage Corps.
Roy, go after the target.
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We'll hold down the Mage squad. / Roy, pursue the target.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_037.en:
But...
This formation of theirs... they
are certainly planning something.
I do not like it, but we should
withdraw for now.
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But... / this Mage squad formation... / they're definitely plotting something. / It's against my will, but we'd better withdraw for now.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_038.en:
Roy, please go.
If you don't hurry, it'll be too
late to undo, right?
We'll be fine.
We're used to this kind of thing.
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mr. Roy, please go. / If you don't hurry, it'll become / irreversible, right? / We'll be fine. / We're used to this kind of thing.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_039.en:
Roy, I'm counting on you to
track it down.
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roy, I'm counting on you for the pursuit.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger...

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ehh~, Dark Knight's running away?

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_042.en:
Tch.
A coward to the very last!
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Tch. / Cowardly to the end!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I'm counting on you for the rest.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Leave it to us.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's about time.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / Good timing♪

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units, activate!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh...?

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_049.en:
No way!!
This many were right under
our feet!?
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Seriously!! / There were this many under our feet!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We're surrounded...

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So this was the scheme.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_052.en:
Phew.
Remote-piloting all that
wears a guy out.
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Phew. / Remote control is tiring too.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_053.en:
Dark Knight got away, but this
unit should make a fine gift
to bring home.
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We let Dark Knight get away, but / it looks like we can bring this squad back as a souvenir.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_054.en:
Now then, mercenaries.
Would you kindly surrender?
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Now, gentlemen of the mercenary unit. / Shall we have you surrender.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We're completely surrounded. / Captain...

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But we can't surrender.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_057.en:
Right.
Let's give it everything we've got.
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / Let's do our best as far as we can.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_059.en:
Of course. I'm with you
all the way.
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Of course, I'll stick with you all the way.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Alright, I'll go wild!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_061.en:
Attention, all units.
Equip anti-jammer gear.
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Notice to all members. / Equip anti-jammer gear.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger, ready anytime.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ooh, scary scary.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Bio-jammer activate, maximum output!!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_065.en:
!!!
Sensor malfunction!!!
What... is this headache?
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: !!! / Sensor malfunction!!! / What? This headache?

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Nwaaaaaah!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_067.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Guh!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_068.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What's wrong, everyone?

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_069.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: C-Captain... / are you okay? / Uwah!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_070.en:
...Just a faint dizziness.
But this feeling...
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_070.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Just a faint dizziness. / But this feeling...

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_071.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain!!!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_072.en:
Abandon your machine and get out,
Sergeant!
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_072.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Abandon your unit and escape, Sergeant Major!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_073.en:
Captain, it's a trap!
Help me!!
Gwaaaah!!
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_073.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, it's a trap! / Please help me!! / Gwaaaah!!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_074.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Was it... my error in judgment...

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_075.en:
That's right.
You're too cold-blooded.
Pilots ain't machines, y'know.
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_075.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / You're too cold-hearted. / Pilots aren't machines.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_076.en:
Hoh, four machines...
And even the supply vehicle is
caught. A fine yield from this unit.
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_076.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hoh, 4 units... / even the supply vehicle got caught. / This unit has quite good results.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_077.en:
Huh?
There's a dud in the captain's
machine?
Guess we'll have to get rid of it,
like always.
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_077.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Huh? / The dud is the captain's unit? / Then we have to dispose of it as usual.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_078.en:
Wait, Witch! He should already
be under the spell as well!
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_078.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wait, Witch, he should already have / fallen under the technique!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_079.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: At this rate...

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_080.en:
Whoops.
Missed the cockpit.
Won't miss next time!
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_080.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oops. / Missed the cockpit. / I won't miss next time!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_081.en:
We take them prisoner.
Do not damage them!
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_081.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We're taking prisoners. / Don't damage them!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_082.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain...! / Please run...! / Kyaaaaaah!!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_083.en:
Rain!
...Am I going to repeat it
all over again...?
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_083.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain! / ...Am I going to repeat it again / ...I.

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_084.en:
Ugh, come on!
Quit getting in my way!
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_084.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ahh, geez! / Don't get in my way!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_085.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Witch! / That's enough!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_086.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aww. / I got scolded...

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_087.en:
Not good... Captain, take Rain and
pull out! Rain's machine took a
direct hit... Leave it like that and
it'll blow...! At least you two...
Gah!
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_087.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is bad, Captain... withdraw with Rain! / Rain's unit took a direct hit... / As is, the unit will explode...! / At least you two... / Guhah!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_088.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: B-but...

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_089.en:
No buts!
Captain!
Come rescue us later, like you
always do!
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_089.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Don't fuss! / Captain! / Come rescue us later like always!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_090.en:
Yeah, we believe in ya...
Nwaaaaargh!
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_090.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah, we believe in you... / Nwaaaaah!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_091.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Please go!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_092.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Now go!

MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_093.en:
...Rain, are you conscious?
We're going.
...I'll come back for them.
I swear it.
MsgLabels_tactics_44_msg_093.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Rain, are you conscious? / We're going. / ...I'll save them for sure.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_002.en:
She still hasn't regained consciousness...
There's no external injury, but her
brainwaves are showing abnormal
readings.
...Yes, a waveform much like yours.
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: She hasn't regained consciousness yet... / There's no external injury, but abnormal values / are appearing in her brain waves. / ...Yes, a waveform just like yours.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I see.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Doctor, a patient!

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_005.en:
Understood. I'll see to it right away!
Captain «E801:00», excuse me.
Please let her rest.
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood. I'll treat them right away! / Captain «E801:00», excuse me. / Please let her rest.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain!! / We're surrounded by the enemy!!

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That can't be.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_009.en:
Hicks, Logan, Sato -- all hit!
Dammit... What the hell is going on...!!
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hicks, Logan, Sato, hit! / Damn... what's going on...!!

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain Barrett «E801:00»! / Uwah!!!

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No... / This is a trap.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_012.en:
No? Sure it is.
This was your plan, wasn't it?
You're the one who drew the short straw.
Your time's over.
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's not wrong, is it? / This is the operation you thought up. / You drew the dud, didn't you? / Your era is over.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Captain... Captain «E801:00»?

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain! / Are you alright?

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain...? / You've regained consciousness.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_017.en:
Huh? Yes.
You were having a nightmare, Captain.
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? Yes. / Captain, you were having a nightmare.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_018.en:
Sorry.
I must have been dreaming...
Are you all right, Rain?
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry. / I seem to have been dreaming... / Are you alright, Rain?

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_019.en:
...I still have a bit of a headache.
You must have been exhausted too,
Captain.
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...The headache still lingers, but. / You were tired too, Captain.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_020.en:
Rain, I'm sorry.
The other four were captured...
Whether they're alive, I don't know.
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain, I'm sorry. / The 4 were captured... / Unfortunately, whether they're alive or dead is unknown.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_021.en:
I see...
Then we have to rescue...
Oh. Mercenary Contract, Article 32...
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see... / To rescue them... / Ah, mercenary contract Article 32...

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_022.en:
...If a mercenary is captured, the army
will not intervene in any way. Instead,
a bond is paid to the registered address.
...Article 58: acting outside your mission
voids the contract, counts as desertion,
and may carry a bounty.
Rain, we're in the middle of a major
operation, but I intend to break
my contract.
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...If a mercenary is captured, / the army will not intervene at all. / However, a guarantee payment will be paid / to the registered address. / ...Article 58: / actions outside missions are deemed breach of contract, / treated as desertion, and in some cases / a bounty is imposed. / Rain, we're in the middle of an important operation now, but / I intend to break the mercenary contract.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_023.en:
I'm coming too.
Even if they put a bounty on me...
as long as I'm with you, Captain...
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll go too. / Even if a bounty is put on me, / if it's with the Captain...

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_024.en:
...In your condition?
Concentrate on getting better.
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...With that body? / Concentrate on treatment.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But... / Capt-, ugh... my head...

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_026.en:
Stay in bed.
...I'm going to talk to the Commander.
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rest. / ...I'll go talk to the Commander.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...C-Captain...! / Please wait... / U-uuh...

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ugh... my head...

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Zzz, zzz...

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_030.en:
(Rain's headaches...
They might be the same as mine...
If so, I want her to rest
for now...)
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Rain's headache... / It might be the same as mine... / If so, for now I want / to let her rest...)

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain... I'm going.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_032.en:
Heard your squadmates got captured.«g:24»
You must be worried sick...
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Your comrades got caught by the enemy?«g:24» / You must be worried...

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_033.en:
So even your squad, unbeaten till now,
finally took a loss...
Wouldn't have bet on that one.
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even your squad, which was invincible until now, / finally got hit...

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Rain's condition?

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_035.en:
She's regained consciousness, thanks
to the base's quick response.
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thanks to the base's swift response, / she regained consciousness.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_036.en:
I see...
That's twice now, for Rain.
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see... / That's the 2nd time for Rain.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The 2nd time?

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_038.en:
Mm.
It's a dead ringer for the time her
old squad went missing...
Back then, too, the only two machines
that made it back were Buggy's and
Rain's, both damaged.
Same as now.
Maybe her old squad was hit by the
same enemy, with the same attack.
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm. / It closely resembles when the previous squad / went missing... / That time too, the ones who returned alive were the 2 units, / Buggy's, which was hit, and Rain's. / It's the same as then. / The previous squad may have received the same attack / from the same enemy.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_039.en:
My apologies.
It seems I made the wrong call during
the operation. The investigator warned
me how dangerous the enemy was,
and I still couldn't handle it.
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm sorry. / I seem to have misjudged during the operation. / The Investigator warned me of the enemy's danger, / but I couldn't deal with it.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_040.en:
And yet, in all that chaos, you still
managed to get Rain out.
Not like a merc of your caliber to
beat himself up over a mistake.
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But in that confusion, weren't you able / to rescue Rain? / It's unlike a mercenary of your caliber / to worry about a mistake.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_041.en:
Once before, my mistake got my
whole unit wiped out.
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Before too, I wiped out a squad / through my mistake.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_042.en: Hard to picture, looking at you now.
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I can't imagine it from how you are now.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_043.en:
Back then I trusted no one but myself.
I was like a machine.
That was the cause...
So in this squad, I decided to change
that: to trust others... no, my comrades,
and act on it.
And still I've driven a unit to ruin...
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: At the time, I was a machine-like being / that trusted no one but myself. / That was the cause... / To improve that, in this squad I decided to trust / others, no, comrades, and act. / But in the end I still drove the squad / to annihilation...

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_044.en:
So that's what's been off about the way
you deal with people.
Well? What about this squad?
Think you can trust them?
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So that's what the awkwardness / in your communication was. / How about it, the current squad? / Do you think you can trust your comrades?

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_046.en:
According to Investigator Roy, there
were no enemies left at the site where
your people were captured.
Looks like they were taken to a
detention camp northwest of there.
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: According to Investigator Roy's information, / there was no sign of the enemy / at the scene where your comrades were captured. / They were apparently escorted to a detention camp / northwest of the scene.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_047.en:
...! A detention camp...
So they're alive?
...Commander Falcon.
I'm sorry, with a major operation under
way, but I mean to break my contract
and act outside my mission.
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...! A detention camp... / So they're alive? / ...Commander Falcon. / I'm sorry, in the middle of an important operation, but / I intend to break the mercenary contract and act / outside of missions.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_048.en:
Hold on, Captain «E801:00».
I've got a mission for you.
The captured mercs... our comrades.
Champ, Oddeye, Gray and Hepaist.
I want the four of them rescued.
I'm asking you this as commander of
this base... no, as a friend.
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wait, Captain «E801:00». / It's a mission from me. / The captured mercenaries... our comrades, / Champ, Oddeye, Gray, / and Hepaist, I want you to rescue the 4. / This operation is a request as this base's commander, / no, as a friend.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Commander Falcon...

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_050.en:
Got a problem with me calling you
a friend?
...Sorry. Right now, this is about
all I can do.
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Are you displeased with me calling you a friend? / ...Sorry, / this is about all I can do now.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_051.en:
...No, it's more than enough.
But you're a soldier, Commander.
This won't come free for you...
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...No, that's enough. / But the Commander is a soldier. / It won't come without consequences...

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_052.en:
Don't worry about it.
All it means is filing a few reports.
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Don't worry. / What, I'll just submit report documents.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_053.en: How many boxes of paperwork is that?
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: How many cardboard boxes of documents?

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_054.en:
Ha ha ha!
That's a good one, Captain «E801:00».
Oh -- word from the investigator, just
in time.
...Hm.
...Says he'll join the rescue too.
Sounds like he's dug something up.
Best you sortie on the double.
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hahaha. / Captain «E801:00», you say funny things. / Oh, just now the Investigator's information came in. / ...Hmm / ...The Investigator will also join the rescue. / He seems to have gotten some information. / You'd better sortie in a hurry.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_056.en:
Ah, Captain «E801:00», nearly forgot.
The enemy took your comrades'
machines,
so the maintenance crew insisted on
building exact copies.
All they need now is their pilots.
...I'm counting on you.
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Captain «E801:00», I forgot to say, / for the captured comrades' units, / at the maintenance crew's wish, we prepared / exactly identical ones. / All that's left is to put the pilots in them. / ...I'm counting on you.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood. / Sortieing.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_058.en:
The investigator says he'll join the
rescue too. Sounds like he's dug
something up.
Best you sortie on the double.
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The Investigator will also join the rescue. / He seems to have gotten some information. / You'd better sortie in a hurry.

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain, hang in there. / Rain!!

MsgLabels_station_45_msg_061.en:
Rain...
This is «E801:00». Commander Falcon,
have the medical staff stand by.
Rain's machine took a direct hit...
MsgLabels_station_45_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain... / This is «E801:00»'s unit, Commander Falcon, / have the medical staff stand by. / Rain's unit took a direct hit...

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roy.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00», you were safe...

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_003.en:
Yeah.
Rain's recovering.
Any movement at the camp?
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / Rain is recuperating. / Any movement at the detention facility?

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_004.en:
Not yet.
According to the sentries, the transport
vehicle should be arriving soon.
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Not yet. / According to the sentries, the escort vehicle / will arrive soon.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_006.en:
Because your squad drew the Mage
Corps
away, I learned where X-00B2 is, and
what they are researching.
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thanks to you drawing off the Mage squad, / I learned X-00 B2's whereabouts and / their research.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I see.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_008.en:
You seem to blame yourself for your
squad's defeat. What hit you is called
a Bio-jammer. It affects brainwaves.
...Though they appear to use it
as a screening tool.
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You seem worried about the squad's annihilation. / The attack you received is called the bio-jammer, / and it affects brain waves. / ...They seem to use it / as a checker.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_009.en:
...Almost everyone complained of
headaches, but it had no effect on me.
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Most of my comrades complained of headaches, but / it didn't work on me.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_010.en:
Which means you are most likely
a non-adapter.
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: In other words, you were probably an incompatible.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What does that mean?

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_012.en:
Those the Bio-jammer affects are
adapters... the people they want.
In some individuals, the brainwaves
must contain something incompatible
with their system.
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Those affected by the bio-jammer / are compatibles... / the people they want. / Probably there are elements in individual brain waves / that don't fit their system.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_013.en:
So it didn't affect me because
I'm incompatible... is that it?
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So because I was incompatible, / it didn't affect me...

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_014.en:
And the facility ahead is where the
adapters are gathered, to become
bio-parts for next-generation weapons.
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: And at the facility ahead, compatibles are / gathered and apparently become biological parts / for next-generation weapons.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_015.en:
Bio-parts?
Why not call them pilots?
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Biological parts? / Why not call them pilots?

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_016.en:
Whether "pilot" is even the word...
They take pilots with fatal injuries
and subject them to a special form of
brainwashing that amplifies only their
bestial fighting instinct, physical
ability and reflexes.
When the pilot wakes, the personality
is gone, and it is thrown onto the
battlefield as a living weapon.
Physical pain is not actually part of
the process. It seems Nightmare simply
ran wild to satisfy his own tastes...
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Whether it's right to call them pilots... / Pilots who've suffered near-fatal wounds / are given special brainwashing, emphasizing only / beast-like fighting instinct, motor ability, and reflexes. / The pilot who wakes up / no longer has a personality, and is thrown / into battle as a biological weapon. / Originally, physical pain isn't necessary, but / Nightmare apparently went out of control / with his personal tastes...

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The Vampires haven't received / brainwashing?

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_018.en:
Brainwashing apparently makes them
harder to control.
The Vampires are nothing more than
a collection of veteran mercs.
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Brainwashing apparently makes them harder to control. / The Vampires are strictly / nothing more than a gathering of veteran mercenaries.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_020.en:
According to my findings, Rain's old
squad was also hit by a Bio-jammer.
Only the two judged to be adapters
were lucky enough to make it back.
The captain and the rest fought the
Vampires, and lost.
With his men held hostage, the captain
apparently signed a contract to
join the Vampires.
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: According to my investigation, Rain's previous squad also / was attacked by the bio-jammer. / And only the 2 judged to be compatibles / luckily returned alive. / The remaining captain and others fought the Vampires / and were defeated. / The captain, whose members were taken hostage, / seems to have made a contract / to become a Vampire.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_021.en:
And that was Dragoon.
Lancer...
...And the two survivors were Rain
and Buggy. So the Vampires kept
coming after them as adapters.
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's Dragoon. / Lancer. / ...The 2 who returned alive, in other words, / are Rain and Buggy. / So they kept being targeted by them / as compatibles.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_022.en:
Correct.
But since «E801:00» Squad was formed,
the Vampires have lost again and again.
Worn down by the fighting, they took
your squad out of their plans and
turned to Arena rankers and the like.
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / But after the «E801:00» squad formed, / the Vampires have suffered defeat after defeat. / The Vampires, worn down in battle, / dropped your squad from the plan / and reached out to Arena rankers / and such.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_023.en:
I see...
But now my people have been taken...
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see... / But now the members have been captured...

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_024.en:
They are excellent pilots.
Left alone, it is only a matter of
time before they are made into
bio-parts...
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The members are excellent pilots. / If left alone, it's probably / only a matter of time before the members / are made into biological parts...

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_025.en:
Does the army know about this
inhuman plan...?
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is the army aware of this / inhumane plan...?

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_026.en:
That is what I am chasing.
To obtain clear evidence against the
companies involved, and the military,
and to expose this affair completely.
That is my mission.
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's what I'm pursuing. / Grabbing clear evidence of the companies involved / and the military, / and investigating this affair thoroughly. / That's my mission.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The enemy is huge.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_028.en:
Yes.
Which is exactly why I will help you
rescue your people.
To expose the army's ties to the
Vampires, I need «E801:00» Squad.
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / That's exactly why I'll cooperate / in rescuing the members too. / To expose the relationship between the army and the Vampires, / the «E801:00» squad's strength is needed.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_029.en:
Understood.
I'm counting on you as well.
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / I ask for your cooperation too.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The vehicle seems to have come.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_031.en:
That is the target, no doubt.
Four wanzers as escort...
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No mistake, it's the target. / 4 WAPs as escort...

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No problem. / Beginning action.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll support.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_034.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units
except the vehicle.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed or
enemy vehicle escaped.
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies other than the vehicle. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down or / the enemy vehicle withdraws.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_036.en:
Damn... If I could just get outta
these restraints...
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Damn... if only these restraints came off...

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_037.en:
Hold on.
Maybe I can do something with
this safety pin...
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wait. / With this safety pin, somehow...

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_038.en:
That's gonna open it?
Hey, whoa, don't stab my wrist!
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Will that open it? / Ah, hey, don't stab my wrist!

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Damn, it doesn't seem to work after all.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_040.en:
We knocked out the guard in here,
and we STILL can't get out.
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The vehicle's guards went quiet, but / we still can't escape.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_041.en:
Yeah. That was something, Champ.
Honestly, how many guys have you put
in the hospital with just your feet?
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah. As expected, Champ. / Honestly, / how many did you send to the hospital with just kicks.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_042.en:
Nah, nah, my finisher's the fist,
y'know? Can't use it right now, though.
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, no, my special move is the fist, you know? / Though I can't use it now.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_043.en:
Tell me about it.
We have to do something about this...
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Exactly. / We have to do something about this situation...

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_044.en:
Oh?
Gray, look! It's the Captain and
the investigator!
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh? / Gray, look, it's the Captain and the Investigator.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Phew, now we're saved...

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_046.en:
Once that transport reaches that point,
we can no longer rescue them.
We must bring down the escorts without
damaging the vehicle...
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If the escort vehicle reaches that point, / we won't be able to rescue them. / We have to shoot down the escort units / without damaging the vehicle...

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Annihilating the escort units.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ, Gray!

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain!

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_050.en:
Sorry, we were right there and...
Oddeye and Hepaist were moved
somewhere else as soon as we got here.
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry, even though we were there... / Oddeye and Hepaist / were transferred right after / we arrived here.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_051.en:
Then they are not at the facility
ahead... I cannot tell where they
were taken. Go back to base for now
and prepare for combat.
I will infiltrate the research
facility and gather information.
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: In that case, it's not the facility ahead... / I can't pinpoint where the two were transferred. / You go back to base once / and prepare for battle. / I'll infiltrate the research facility and get information.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_052.en:
...Roger.
We're heading back.
Your wanzers are ready too.
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Roger. / Returning to base. / The two's WAPs are ready too.

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_054.en:
No... The transport
has broken through...
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Damn... the escort vehicle / got away...

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm sorry... / everyone...

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: N-no way, Captaaaaain!! / Heeeelp meeeee!!!

MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_057.en:
Champ, my ears...
But I guess this is the end...
Captain, the rest is up to you...
MsgLabels_tactics_45_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ, that hurts my ears... / But with this, it's over... / Captain, I leave the rest to you...

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_001.en:
We owe you our lives, Captain.
I don't know what to say.
MsgLabels_station_46_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thanks to the Captain we were saved. / I don't know what to say.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_002.en:
No, save your thanks for the Commander.
He went against regulations to send
me to rescue you all.
MsgLabels_station_46_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, I'd like you to thank the Commander. / He went against military regulations to send me / to rescue everyone.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The Commander did!?

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_004.en: I just hope nothing comes of it...
MsgLabels_station_46_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I hope nothing comes of it...

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_005.en:
Got it.
Gray, we'll thank him ourselves later.
MsgLabels_station_46_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Got it. / Gray, let's thank him later too.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_006.en:
Yeah.
...By the way, Captain, any word on
where Oddeye and Hepaist are?
MsgLabels_station_46_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Right. / ...By the way, Captain, after that, have you found / where Oddeye and Hepaist are?

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_007.en:
Not yet.
The investigator is out gathering
intel, but he hasn't checked in.
MsgLabels_station_46_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Not yet. / The Investigator is out gathering information, but / there's no contact.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_008.en:
The longer this takes, the worse...
We oughta get moving ourselves,
and quick.
MsgLabels_station_46_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If it takes time, it's bad... / It seems we'd better get moving / soon too.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_009.en:
...No, that'd be acting outside our
mission too.
MsgLabels_station_46_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...No, that would also become a mercenary's / action outside of missions.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_010.en:
Dammit...
And Rain's still out cold...
MsgLabels_station_46_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Damn... / Rain's still in a coma too...

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_011.en: Best to let her rest for now.
MsgLabels_station_46_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's better to let her rest now.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_012.en:
That headache back then...
Mine and Champ's cleared up right away.
MsgLabels_station_46_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That headache then... / Me and Champ got over it right away, though.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_013.en:
Come to think of it, Oddeye's and
Hepaist's headaches hung on longer.
MsgLabels_station_46_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Come to think of it, Oddeye's and Hepaist's / headaches seemed to drag on.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_014.en:
It seems this was the second time
Rain was hit by that attack.
MsgLabels_station_46_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems it was Rain's 2nd time / receiving that attack.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_015.en:
When her old squad got wiped out, huh...
A Bio-jammer...
What the hell are those guys researching?
