MsgLabels_station_46_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: When the previous squad was wiped out... / Bio-jammer... / What the hell are they researching.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_016.en:
I'm going to HQ.
There may be news soon.
MsgLabels_station_46_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll go to headquarters. / Information may come soon.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_017.en:
A Bio-jammer...
What the hell are those guys researching?
MsgLabels_station_46_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Bio-jammer... / What the hell are they researching.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_018.en: Alright, let's get over there, fast.
MsgLabels_station_46_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Alright, let's hurry to the site.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_019.en:
If this drags on, it's going to
get ugly...
MsgLabels_station_46_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If it takes time, things / will get bad...

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Let's hurry.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_021.en:
(She seems to be asleep.
I'll leave her be for now.)
MsgLabels_station_46_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (She seems to be sleeping. / I'll leave her be for now.)

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Zzz, zzz...

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Zzz, zzz...

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Where were the two taken...)

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sortie.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_026.en:
You actually brought your people back.
Honestly, everyone on base figured
it couldn't be done.
MsgLabels_station_46_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: To think you brought your comrades back. / Honestly, everyone on the base thought it was impossible.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_027.en:
I knew you'd pull it off!
I mean, if I'd lost that bet, I'd be
buying Sam dinner.
The guy eats like a horse. Close call.
MsgLabels_station_46_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I thought you'd succeed! / Or rather, if my prediction was wrong, / I'd have had to treat Sam to a meal. / He's a big eater, so that was a relief.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_028.en:
Yes, he's right here.
Roger. Putting you through.
Captain «E801:00», it's the investigator.
MsgLabels_station_46_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, he's here now. / Roger. Connecting. / Captain «E801:00», a call from the Investigator.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_029.en:
Captain «E801:00», I have found Oddeye
and Hepaist.
They are being moved to another
facility by way of the port.
You had best sortie at once.
MsgLabels_station_46_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00», I've learned where / Oddeye and Hepaist are. / They're apparently being transferred via the harbor / to another facility. / You'd better sortie in a hurry.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_030.en:
The port.
Roger.
We're on our way.
MsgLabels_station_46_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The harbor. / Roger. / We'll rush there.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_031.en:
Still, their organization is in chaos...
The information is all contradictory.
Something serious seems to have
happened. Captain «E801:00», the Mage
Corps is waiting at the port.
MsgLabels_station_46_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Still, the organization is in chaos... / The information is confused. / Something serious seems to have happened. / Captain «E801:00», the Mage squad is / waiting at the harbor.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A troublesome opponent.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_033.en:
I am heading there too.
We will meet on site...
MsgLabels_station_46_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm heading there too. / Let's meet on site...

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood.

MsgLabels_station_46_msg_035.en:
Once they're on a ship, we may not be
able to get them back...
Captain «E801:00», good luck.
MsgLabels_station_46_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If they're moved onto a ship, / there's a risk we can't save them... / Captain «E801:00», good luck.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Arrived at the target point.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's it... / It's those Mage squad guys!

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But where are the two...?

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_004.en:
So if we take these guys down, we
get 'em back...
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So if we bring them down, we can take them back...

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_005.en:
I doubt it'll be that simple.
...No sign of Roy's machine, either.
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I don't think it'll go that easily. / ...I can't confirm Roy's unit either.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Not yet.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...We'll launch an assault by ourselves.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Then let's go!

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_009.en: We owe these guys a payback.
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We owe those guys payback.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_010.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_012.en:
Huh?
What are THEY doing here?
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ehh? / Why did they come here?

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_013.en:
Damn...
They caught us completely off guard.
All units, buy as much time as you can.
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Damn... / We've been completely caught off guard. / All units, buy as much time as possible.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: X-15, roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: X-18, roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_016.en:
But it's okay if we just kill 'em,
right~!?
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But it's okay to take them down, right!?

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good, preparations complete. / ...Undead squad!!

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is this... a WAP...!?

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_019.en:
A new model...?
Dammit, there's a ton of 'em...
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A new model... / Damn, there are a lot of them...

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_020.en:
Tch...
The remote link...
Undead squad's not responding...!
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Tch... / The remote control is... / Undead squad uncontrollable...!

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_021.en:
...Still incomplete, then... But they
will buy us time.
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Incomplete after all... but / it'll buy time.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_022.en:
The neural link filter isn't working
either.
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The neural connection filter isn't working either.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_023.en:
What is this, factory rejects!?
Don't shoot at ME!
Ugh, these things are so annoying!
Necromancer, aren't you using the
jammer?
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What is this defective junk! / Don't attack me! / Hey, these things are annoying! / Necromancer, aren't you using the jammer?

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_024.en:
Not now.
It takes time to charge.
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Impossible right now. / Charging takes time.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_025.en:
What the hell!?
What's goin' on??
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What!? / What's going on??

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_026.en:
It looks like the new models have
a system fault.
While they're confused, we take out
the Mage Corps first.
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems that new model / has a system malfunction. / Use this opening to prioritize attacking the Mage squad.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_027.en:
...This is Roy...
...«E801:00» Squad, do you read?
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...This is Roy's unit... / ...«E801:00» squad, do you read?

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_028.en:
This is «E801:00».
Roy, why haven't you joined us?
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is «E801:00». / Roy, why aren't you joining up?

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_029.en:
...My apologies. Trouble has kept me
away. But listen well, «E801:00»...
The Vampires have effectively collapsed.
It seems the client has cut them loose.
The Mage Corps at the port most likely
means to load the prototype and run.
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Sorry, I can't join because of trouble. / But listen well, «E801:00»... / The Vampires have effectively collapsed. / The client seems to have cut them off. / The Mage squad at the harbor probably intends / to load the prototype / and flee.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_030.en: I don't see the two of them.
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I don't see the two.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_031.en:
...I have traced them.
...A medical facility near Grayrock.
Lich, the mastermind, is there too.
Can you turn back right away?
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I've traced the two's trail. / ...A medical facility on the outskirts of Greylock. / The mastermind Lich is there too. / Can you turn back right away?

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_032.en:
Unfortunately, the Mage Corps doesn't
look inclined to let us.
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Unfortunately, the Mage squad doesn't seem / to want to allow that.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_033.en:
Forgive me. With the organization
collapsing, the intel was garbled.
I intend to pin him down when I see
an opening, but whether I can wait
until you arrive...
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry, with the fallout of the organization's collapse, / the information seems to have been confused. / I intend to seize an opening and hold him down, but / whether I can wait until you come...

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_034.en:
Roger. We'll wipe out the Mage Corps
and head back.
Don't throw your life away.
Roy.
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger, we'll annihilate the Mage squad / and turn back. / Don't rush to die, / Roy.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_035.en:
If Lich activates X-00B2, I will move.
Oddeye and the others, at least, I will
save, no matter what...
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If Lich activates X-00 B2, / I'll move. / At least Oddeye and the other will be saved, for sure...

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_036.en:
Wait, Roy.
You should tread carefully.
...Lost contact?
All units, keep hitting the Mage Corps.
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wait, Roy. / You'd better act cautiously. / ...The transmission's cut off. / All units, continue annihilating the Mage squad.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Kuh, my unit!

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Bad, we're completely being pushed back.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_039.en:
...Can I not even... serve as
a shield...?
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Can't even... be a shield...

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Move! / Move, damn it!!

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...By just 3 units...

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_042.en:
...So this is the end of the Mage
Corps...
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...This Mage squad is annihilated...

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Mage squad... evacuation failed...

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_045.en: So they never even used that jammer.
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: In the end they didn't even use that jammer.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_046.en:
Being on the run, I guess they didn't
have anything prepared.
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Since they were fleeing, they seem / not to have prepared anything.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_047.en:
In a straight-up slugfest, even the
Mage Corps ain't so tough.
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: In a straight-up fight, the Mage squad / is just this much.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_048.en:
Captain, what now?
Do we turn back?
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, what do we do? / Turn back?

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_049.en:
Against the white machine and the
mastermind, we can't move carelessly.
We'll stop at base and wait for intel.
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: With the white one and the mastermind as opponents, / we can't move carelessly. / We'll stop at the base and wait for information.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_050.en:
Roger. But it doesn't look like we
have much time.
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger, but it doesn't seem we have time.

MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_051.en:
Right. If no intel comes, we head
for Grayrock regardless.
MsgLabels_tactics_46_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, if there's no information, / we'll just head to Greylock.

MsgLabels_station_47_msg_001.en:
Captain, I'm good to go.
Just say the word!
MsgLabels_station_47_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, I can go right away. / Call me anytime!

MsgLabels_station_47_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Alright, let's go!!

MsgLabels_station_47_msg_003.en:
Looks like Rain went on ahead.
We'd better hurry too.
MsgLabels_station_47_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Miss Rain seems to have gone out first. / Let's hurry too.

MsgLabels_station_47_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / Sortieing!

MsgLabels_station_47_msg_005.en:
(As soon as we've resupplied, we
have to move...)
MsgLabels_station_47_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (As soon as resupply is done, we must hurry...)

MsgLabels_station_47_msg_007.en:
Captain «E801:00», word just came in
from the investigator.
Oddeye and Hepaist are confirmed
alive at a medical facility near
Grayrock. Also confirmed there is the
Vampires' mastermind, a man who calls
himself Lich.
The investigator is lying low around
the facility, and seems to mean to
get them out when he sees an opening.
But against the mastermind, that's
far too dangerous...
MsgLabels_station_47_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00», just now, information / came in from the Investigator. / At a medical facility on the outskirts of Greylock, / the survival of the 2, Oddeye and Hepaist, / and the presence at that facility of the Vampires' mastermind, / a man calling himself Lich, have been confirmed. / The Investigator is currently lying low around the facility. / He seems to intend to seize an opening and take them back. / But with the mastermind as the opponent, it's too dangerous...

MsgLabels_station_47_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Let's sortie at once.

MsgLabels_station_47_msg_009.en:
...Since it couldn't wait, I sent
Rain on ahead.
MsgLabels_station_47_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Since the situation is urgent, / I sent Rain ahead.

MsgLabels_station_47_msg_010.en: I see. Is Rain all right now?
MsgLabels_station_47_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see, Rain is alright now?

MsgLabels_station_47_msg_011.en:
Mm.
The doctor signed off on it.
But... the intel says the Vampire
machine you drove off before was
spotted at the same building.
Safe to say it's one of their bases.
MsgLabels_station_47_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm. / She got the doctor's permission too. / However... the information says that in the same building / the Vampire unit we drove off before / has also been found. / There's no doubt it's / one of their bases.

MsgLabels_station_47_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Rushing there.

MsgLabels_station_47_msg_013.en:
Swing by the hangar.
The new weapons I put in for have
arrived.
...A commander's a sorry sort of
thing... This is all the help I can
give you.
MsgLabels_station_47_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Stop by the hangar. / The new weapons and such I requested / have arrived. / ...How useless a commander is... / This is all the help I can give.

MsgLabels_station_47_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00», hurry.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_001.en:
Looks like they're short-handed
right now.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems lightly guarded right now.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_002.en: I think we can get out!
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Looks like we can escape.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good, this vehicle runs.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_004.en:
Ah, Grandpa, wait!
With the stuff I scrounged earlier...
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Grandpa, wait, / with the materials I gathered earlier...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_005.en:
Oho, homemade explosives...
Clever little thing, aren't ya.
Little missy, it's a waste keepin' you
as a wanzer jockey.
Nimble hands, cute as a button...
how 'bout bein' my assistant?
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Uhoh, handmade explosives... / How dexterous. / Little missy, it's a waste to keep you / as a WAP rider. / You're good with your hands and cute, / won't you become my assistant?

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_006.en:
Ahaha, I'll pass!
Okay, we're good to go.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ahaha, I decline! / Okay, ready to go.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_007.en:
Oh?
My material, way out here?
You're supposed to stay put like
good little specimens.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh? / The materials are in a place like this. / You need to stay quiet, don't you?

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Bad, we've been found...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hey, Vampire.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_011.en: Pin them down. Don't kill them.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Restrain their movement without killing them.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_013.en:
And don't damage the brains, got it?
That's valuable material.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Don't damage the brains, okay? / They're precious materials.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_015.en:
(Damn...
I cannot wait for «E801:00» and
the others any longer.)
(Even if it costs me my life,
those two...)

Lich!!
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Damn... / I can't wait for «E801:00» and the others / any longer.) / (Even at the cost of my life, the two...) /  / Lich!!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_016.en:
Been a while, hasn't it?
Dark Knight.
Or should I say, Investigator Roy
of the OCU Central Intelligence
action unit.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Long time no see, isn't it? / Dark Knight. / No, Investigator Roy of the Coalition Central / Intelligence Agency's action unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So I was known after all.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_018.en:
Sure, and I played it right back
at you. Let you swim around free, and
got a whole lot of army intel out of it.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Though I used it against you. / By letting you swim free, I got / quite a lot of army information.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Tch...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_020.en:
Thanks to all your hard work,
Investigator, the Vampires are done.
The client pulled its protection,
and look at us now.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thanks to the Investigator's hard work, / the Vampires are finished. / We lost the client's protection too, / and look at us now.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Too bad.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_022.en:
Ah, but the client says it's shifting
to another project.
Me, I plan to sell myself to that
project, with the X-00 and that
material over there as a gift.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, but the client says they'll shift / to another project. / Well, I intend to sell myself to that project / with X-00 and the materials there / as souvenirs.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_023.en:
And this client of yours...
whose money is it?
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So, which rich person / is that client?

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_024.en:
Ah, I could tell ya, but first I want
some combat data.
How about it?
Why don't you fight an old comrade?
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, I could tell you, but / before that I want live combat data. / How about it? / Try fighting your war buddy?

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: War buddy...!? / No way...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_026.en:
Go, Faceless.
Take down the traitor.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Go, Faceless. / Strike down the traitor.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh!?

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Lich, you bastard!!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_029.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Ugh, escape is... / impossible...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_032.en:
Pathetic, man.
Your machine's smoking.
You know Numbers machines are rigged
with explosive liquid, right?
Anybody who won't make good material
is no loss dead.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Pathetic, hey. / Smoke's coming out of your unit. / You know the Numbers' units are rigged / with explosive liquid, right? / Those who won't become materials aren't worth / regretting even if they die.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Kuh...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_034.en:
Analog soldiers with nothing but
piloting skill -- nobody's gonna need
'em from here on out.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Analog soldiers with nothing but piloting skill / are unnecessary from here on.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You bastard...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_036.en:
Here's the client, as a parting gift
for the afterlife.
You've traced it as far as Sakata,
right? And you've heard about the army
brass? Thing is, brass goes all the
way up. Bet you didn't know it reaches
the very top.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As a souvenir for the underworld, I'll tell you / about the client. / You've grasped as far as Sakata, right? / And have you heard about the army's upper echelons? / But, among the upper ones, you don't know / it's the very top, do you?

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wh-what did you say!?

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_038.en:
And get this: it's not just
the OCU, either.
Both armies agree, they've got no use
for analog soldiers.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: And it's not / just the O.C.U., you see. / Both armies alike say they don't need / analog soldiers.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's... ridiculous...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_040.en:
Huh?
Smoke stopped, did it?
Well then, Faceless.
Finish him off.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Huh? / The smoke stopped. / Now, Faceless. / Finish him off.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_041.en:
...Heh.
This entire conversation has already
been transmitted to «E801:00».
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Heh. / This conversation / has already been transmitted to «E801:00».

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_042.en:
Sharp as ever, aren't ya.
Doesn't matter. Fire.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As shrewd as ever. / Doesn't matter, shoot.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_044.en: ...«E801:00», the rest is up to you!
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...«E801:00», I leave the rest to you!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: David, nooooo!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_046.en:
Blast!
...Little missy, get out of the truck!
...I'll draw his eye!
Run for it!!
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No good! / ...Little missy, get out of the vehicle! / ...I'll draw his attention! / Run!!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_047.en:
Eek! Grandpa, what are you--
Grandpa!?
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Kya, Grandpa, what are you... / Grandpa!?

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_048.en:
...She's packed with explosives, too!!
Oddeye, haven't had a squad this fun
in years!
Tell the Captain...!!!
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...It's fully loaded with explosives too!! / Oddeye, it was the most fun squad in a long time! / Tell the Captain...!!!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Why...!? / Noooooooo!!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_050.en:
Dammit... my material...
The old man?
Tch. Faceless, grab the girl.
What's wrong? Move!
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Damn... the material... / The old man? / Tch, Faceless, / capture the girl. / What's wrong? Move?

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_052.en:
My eyes are odd eyes, see.
Look...
...
You know, when I was little,
I got picked on a lot.
Because of my eyes, see?
I wasn't like everyone else...
So when I meet someone new,
I show them my eyes first...
And if we can be friends anyway,
I'll treasure them forever and ever.
I guess it just turned into a habit.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: My eyes are odd-eyed, you know. / See... / ... / You know, when I was little, / I was often bullied. / See, my eyes are odd-eyed, right? / Because I'm different from the people around me... / So to people I meet for the first time, / I show my eyes first... / And if we can become friends, / I'll treasure them forever and ever, I thought. / And then it seems it became a habit.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_053.en:
That's an order.
Grab the girl!
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's an order. / Capture the woman!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_055.en:
What?
You useless scrap heap... move!
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What? / This piece of junk... move!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_056.en:
Ah, you laughed again...
Is the way I talk... that funny?
Hmm, I wonder why.
...
When I was little, I always played
by myself. Watching anime, tinkering
with machines... Learning languages
from all over the world...
Oh, maybe that's how all my grammar
got mixed up?
David?
Geez, stop laughing so much!
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, you laughed again... / Is the way I talk... that funny? / Hmm, I wonder why. / ... / When I was little, I always played alone. / Watching anime, tinkering with machines... / Learning words from various countries... / Ah, maybe that's why the grammar / got all mixed up? / Daviiid? / Geez, please don't laugh that much!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Daviiiiid!!!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I refuse the order. / A, agaaaaaaaah!!!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_059.en:
Dammit!
His mind's snapped...
Fine.
I'll go myself...
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Damn! / His mind collapsed... / Can't be helped. / I'll go...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_060.en:
Grandpa...
Roy...
David...
What is this...
It isn't right...
Why does it have to be like this!?
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Grandpa... / Mr. Roy... / David... / What is... this... / It's wrong... / Why does it turn out like this!?

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye!!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_062.en:
Rain...
Everyone... they're all...
they're all dead!!
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Miss... Rain... / Somehow, everyone... / everyone died!!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_063.en:
Oddeye... I'm so sorry...
That must have been awful...
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye... I'm sorry... / It was hard, wasn't it...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_064.en:
Burning truck and the investigator's
machine confirmed...
The white machine's gone silent too.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed the burning vehicle and the Investigator's unit... / The white unit is silent too.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Damn, were we too late...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, are you safe...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_067.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Captaaain... / You're laaate...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_068.en:
I'm sorry, Oddeye...
I brought your wanzer.
Can you board?
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_068.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm sorry, Oddeye... / I brought your WAP. / Can you get in?

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_069.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: My... vanzer...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_070.en:
I heard your exchange with Roy.
We're going to crush them.
All units, move!!
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_070.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I heard the conversation with Roy. / We'll pulverize these guys. / All units, let's go!!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_071.en:
So «E801:00» showed up after all...
Hey, scrap heap, can you move?
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_071.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That «E801:00»... he came... / Hey, junk, can you move?

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_073.en:
Useless...
Bits of memory are surfacing...
What a miscalculation...
Never figured there'd be a woman
in the picture.
Hey!
Defense unit, scramble every machine.
Tech team, send out the test units too!
At this point, we throw everything
we've got at 'em!
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_073.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's hopeless... / Fragments of memory are surfacing... / What a miscalculation... / That a woman was involved. / Hey! / Defense squad, sortie all units. / Tech team, put out the test units too! / If it's come to this, we have no choice but to throw / every force we have at them!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_074.en:
Figures test units couldn't make
sense of a situation like this...
Well, looks like all that's left is
the scrap heap and me.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_074.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: After all, test units can't / understand this situation... / Well, all that's left seems to be the junk / and me.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_075.en: Lich. We've met before, haven't we?
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_075.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Lich, this isn't our first meeting, is it?

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_076.en:
Heh, so you noticed.
Captain Barrett «E801:00».
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_076.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Heh, you noticed. / Captain Barrett «E801:00».

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_077.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Barrett... «E801:00»...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_078.en:
Ah, still got those headaches?
Still dreaming about that lost battle?
Ha ha ha!
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_078.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, does the headache still continue? / Still dreaming of the lost battle? / Hahaha!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_079.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...You're... Greg.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_080.en:
Long time no see.
I brainwashed you good and thorough,
and it still wore off, huh.
After all the trouble I went to,
planting that defeat in you.
And then you go back to the
battlefield and make it all the way
here? Didn't see that coming...
...
Pretty artistic, wasn't it?
Those fake memories.
During the Bio-jammer prototype tests,
you blacked out.
...You were the strongest soldier we
had, and you were in my way.
So I brainwashed you while I was at it.
You oughta thank me.
That brainwashing's the reason
you're a non-adapter!
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_080.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Long time no see. / Even though I brainwashed you so thoroughly, / it came undone. / After I went to the trouble of planting / a sense of defeat in you. / And on top of returning to the battlefield, coming this far / is what you'd call unexpected... / ... / It was artistic, right? / The false memory. / During the bio-jammer prototype experiment, / you went unconscious. / ...You, the strongest soldier, / were in the way. / So I brainwashed you while I was at it. / Be grateful. / You being incompatible / is also because of that brainwashing!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_081.en:
You did this to me...
So BATS being wiped out was
a false memory...
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_081.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You're the one who did my... / So the annihilation of BATS was / a false memory...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_082.en:
Feel better now?
I'm the one who brought BATS down.
Remember all those nasty experiments
we ran? Internal Affairs wouldn't stop
sniffing around, the army couldn't
handle it anymore, so I sold the lot
to Sakata.
You fought it to the very end, though.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_082.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Feel refreshed? / I'm the one who crushed BATS. / See, we were doing all sorts of dangerous experiments, right? / The internal affairs guys were annoying, / the army couldn't handle it anymore, / so I sold it to Sakata. / Though you were against it to the end.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_083.en:
So that's... where the Vampires
came from...
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_083.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's... the origin of the Vampires...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_084.en:
The bats grew up into vampires.
Pretty stylish, huh?
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_084.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Grown from bats to vampires. / Pretty witty, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_085.en:
I won't say you're the root of all
of it. But... what you've done is
something my feelings can't accept...
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_085.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I won't say you're the root of all evil. / But... my emotions can't understand / your actions...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_086.en:
Huh, now there's a surprise.
You angry?
You, the one with no ups and downs,
who knew nothing about the world?
Just a combat machine!
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_086.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Huh, I'm surprised. / Are you angry? / You were just a combat machine with no ups and downs of emotion, / knowing nothing of the world!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_087.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll pulverize you.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_088.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll resist, though.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_089.en:
Captain!!
Explosives detected all around us...
They're on a timer!
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_089.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain!! / There are explosive signatures all around... / They're timed!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_090.en:
Tch, you noticed...
Can't leave any evidence behind.
This whole area's about to be blown
sky-high.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_090.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Tch, you noticed... / I can't leave evidence behind. / This whole area will be blown away, you know?

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_091.en:
I'll stay and finish this.
...All units, withdraw.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_091.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll stay and clean up. / ...All units withdraw.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_092.en:
No!
Captain, you're coming with us!!
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_092.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No! / Captain, come with us!!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_093.en:
...Rain, please. Let me settle this
with him.
He's my problem too!
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_093.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Rain, please, let me settle things / with this guy. / This guy is my problem too!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_094.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain... / Let's go.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_095.en:
...Captain «E801:00».
...Understood.
Champ, Gray, recover Roy's machine
and fall back!
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_095.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Captain «E801:00». / ...Understood. / Champ and Gray, recover Roy's unit / and evacuate!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_096.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_097.en:
Oddeye, give me a hand.
You and I will get Faceless's machine
out of here.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_097.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, lend me a hand. / You and I will evacuate / Faceless's unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_098.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? / Y-yes!!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_099.en:
I'm sorry.
Rain.
...I'll win. You have my word.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_099.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm sorry. / Rain. / ...I'll win for sure.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_100.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Yes. / Good fortune in battle!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_101.en:
Heh.
A one-on-one, is it?
Earnest to the bitter end!
That's exactly why you were in my way!
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_101.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Huh. / You desire one on one. / Serious to the very end! / That's why you were in the way!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_102.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Here I come!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_103.en:
...So this is where it ends...
...Barrett «E801:00»? What are you
doing!?
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_103.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Is it ending here... / ...Barrett «E801:00»? What are you doing!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_104.en:
I can't have the evidence go up
in the blast.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_104.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I can't let the evidence vanish / by being caught in the explosion.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_105.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...So... I can't beat you after all.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_106.en:
We'll be taking all of this evidence
home to the OCU.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_106.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We'll deliver this evidence, all of it, / to the home country.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_107.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...It's probably... impossible for you lot.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_108.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We won't know until we try.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_109.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...You'll be erased.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_110.en:
Then we'll fight back with
everything we've got.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_110.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We'll resist with everything we've got.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_111.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You lot... are strong.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_112.en:
You're the ones... who made us
this way.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_112.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The ones who made us that way... are you.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_113.en:
Through so much grief and anger...
I learned that feelings make people
strong. From fighting you.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_113.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I learned that much sadness and anger... emotion / makes people strong. / Through the battles with you.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_114.en:
...Ha ha ha ha!
I see...!
...So I went and toughened you up.
...I made the strongest soldier,
without even meaning to!
Ha ha ha!
Now that's a masterpiece!
I went and made that combat machine
Barrett even stronger!!
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_114.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Hahahaha! / I see...! / ...So I trained you instead. / ...You're saying I indirectly created / the strongest soldier! / Hahaha! / Isn't that a masterpiece! / So I went and strengthened Barrett, / who was a combat machine, even further!!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_115.en:
Looks like your machine's self-destruct
has stopped.
...Greg, why didn't you kill me?
If I was in your way, you could have
just got rid of me.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_115.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The unit's detonation seems to have stopped. / ...Greg, why didn't you kill me? / If I was in the way, you could have erased me, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_116.en:
You were an eyesore... but as a
soldier, you were my ideal... so...
...Now get clear. You'll be caught in
the blast!
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_116.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You were an eyesore... but as a soldier / you were my ideal... so... / ...Get away now. You'll be caught in the explosion!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_117.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What!?

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_118.en:
You're not my ideal anymore...
But I finally get it.
In the end, analog's stronger.
...Guess the next project's a bust too.
...You hear me, Raven?
I'm going on ahead...
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_118.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You're no longer my ideal... / But I finally understood. / That in the end, analog / is stronger. / ...At this rate, the next project will fail too. / ...Can you hear me, Raven. / I'm going on ahead...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_119.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All enemies... silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_120.en:
...Captain!
The investigator!!
Champ, the respirator and the
coagulant!
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_120.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Captain! / The Investigator!! / Champ, the respirator and hemostatic agent!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_121.en:
This?
It was in the transport...
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_121.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This? / It was in the transport vehicle, but...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_122.en:
Perfect!
...He's bleeding, but he'll be okay.
The investigator's just unconscious.
...That should hold him.
...
...And Faceless...
Dammit, these cables...
how is this thing wired...
...No good... I can't make heads
or tails of it.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_122.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Excellent! / ...He's bleeding, but it's okay, / the Investigator's just unconscious. / ...With this, somehow. / ... / ...And Faceless... / Damn, these cables... / what's going on... / ...No good... I can't make any sense of it.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_123.en:
...I've already called for a rescue
team.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_123.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I've already called the rescue team.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_124.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mr. Roy... David...

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_125.en:
Oddeye.
There must be something you wanted
to tell him.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_125.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye. / There were words you wanted to tell him.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_126.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Welcome home... / David.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_127.en:
No way... I've got a heartbeat!
David's alive too!!
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_127.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No way... heartbeat confirmed! / David's alive too!!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_129.en:
Looks like the rescue team is here.
We'll leave the rest to them.
Oddeye, stay with him.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_129.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The rescue team seems to have arrived. / Let's leave the rest to them. / Oddeye, go with him.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_131.en:
Anti-Vampire Operation, «E801:00»
Squad: mission complete...
Roy's and Faceless's machines
recovered. Returning to base!
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_131.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Anti-Vampires operation, «E801:00» squad, / operation complete... / Recovered Roy's unit and Faceless's unit. / Returning to base now!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_132.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Barrett «E801:00»!! / Let's go together!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_133.en:
...I'm sorry...
Looks like I couldn't keep my promise.
MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_133.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I'm sorry... / It seems I couldn't keep my promise.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_134.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captaaaaaain!!!

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_135.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 1 turn left until the facility explodes.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_136.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 2 turns left until the facility explodes.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_137.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 3 turns left until the facility explodes.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_138.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 4 turns left until the facility explodes.

MsgLabels_tactics_47_msg_139.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 5 turns left until the facility explodes.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_001.en:
This is a placeholder message
for the barracks.
MsgLabels_station_48_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is a placeholder message / for the mercenary station.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_002.en:
Don't make me say it again.
This is a placeholder message
for the barracks.
MsgLabels_station_48_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Don't make me say it over and over. / This is a placeholder message / for the mercenary station.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_003.en: So this is after visiting HQ...
MsgLabels_station_48_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: After going to headquarters...

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_004.en:
Captain «E801:00». I hear Lieutenant
Colonel Roy has regained consciousness.
MsgLabels_station_48_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain Storm. Lieutenant Colonel Roy has apparently regained consciousness.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_005.en:
I see.
...Any chance he'll return to duty?
MsgLabels_station_48_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. ...Prospects of returning to duty?

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_006.en:
Twelve fractures. Wounds that
took
dozens of stitches. Burns from the
explosive liquid over 30% of his body.
Even for a lieutenant colonel, it'll
be months before he's back in the
field...
MsgLabels_station_48_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 2 fractures. Wounds needing dozens of stitches. Burns from explosive liquid covering 30% of his body. Even a lieutenant colonel will take how many months to return to the field...

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_007.en:
...It's a miracle he survived.
...And David's condition?
MsgLabels_station_48_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...The lieutenant colonel's survival was a miracle. ...David's condition?

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_008.en:
...He's conscious, apparently.
But...
his mind has collapsed, and he's still
wandering lost in his memories.
MsgLabels_station_48_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...He's conscious, apparently. But... due to mental collapse, he keeps wandering inside his memories.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_009.en:
Just as he was back then... huh.
...I hear Oddeye is coming back.
MsgLabels_station_48_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Still as he was then... huh. ...I hear Oddeye is coming back.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_010.en:
He's hooked up to a special
life-support
system. Visits, nursing, everything's
been cut off. Even at his side, there
was nothing she could have done for him.
MsgLabels_station_48_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: He's connected to a special life-support device, with visits and nursing all cut off. Even by his side, she probably couldn't do anything for him.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: How unfortunate.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain Storm, there's a mission.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_013.en:
For a while, pass the routine jobs
to
the other squads.
MsgLabels_station_48_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: For a while, send general missions to other squads.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_014.en:
That's my intention. But this one's
from a regular customer, you know.
MsgLabels_station_48_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's my intention, but, it's a request from a regular customer, you know?

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...The lieutenant colonel?

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_016.en:
Right. It's a request from
Lieutenant
Colonel Roy's unit. The Anti-Vampire
Operation is over, but the Vampire
remnants are said to be stirring.
They want «E801:00» Squad to wipe out
the remnants and get to the truth of
the matter. Planning to turn this one
down too?
MsgLabels_station_48_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. A request from Lieutenant Colonel Roy's unit. The anti-Vampires operation is over. But its remnants are apparently showing disturbing movements. The request is for the Storm squad to eliminate the remnants and work to uncover the truth of the matter. Do you intend to cancel this too?

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_018.en:
As you know, the army's being
extremely
cautious about dealing with the
Vampires. In fact, it's no exaggeration
to say it doesn't want to move at all.
MsgLabels_station_48_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As you know, the army is extremely cautious in its actions regarding dealing with the Vampires. No, it's no exaggeration to say it doesn't want to move at all.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_019.en:
...If the intel that the top of the
army is behind it all is true, no
wonder.
MsgLabels_station_48_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...If the information that the army's top is the mastermind is correct, no wonder.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_020.en:
Mm. Except for the lieutenant
colonel's
unit. ...But if we wait for him to get
back in the field, a second and third
Vampires will have formed by then.
So the job's come down to «E801:00»
Squad, as mercs.
MsgLabels_station_48_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mm. Except for the lieutenant colonel's unit. ...But if we wait for the lieutenant colonel to return to the field, a second and third Vampires will be formed. So the job came around to the Storm squad, who are mercenaries.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_021.en:
Is the mission to take an enemy
base?
MsgLabels_station_48_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is the mission suppressing an enemy base?

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_022.en:
No, nothing that big. First, they
want
you to look into the Vampire remnants
that have turned into armed guerrillas
all over, and gather intel.
MsgLabels_station_48_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, nothing large-scale. First, investigate the Vampires' remnants in various places who've turned into armed guerrillas, and gather information.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_023.en:
Roger. We'll start preparing.
Send the terrain data for the
destination to our wanzers.
MsgLabels_station_48_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. Starting preparations. Transfer the destination's terrain information to the WAPs.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_024.en:
Will do. And, Captain «E801:00».
Oddeye is apparently already out there.
Pick her up, would you?
MsgLabels_station_48_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. Also, Captain Storm. Oddeye is apparently on site. Please pick her up.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...So that's it. Roger.

MsgLabels_station_48_msg_026.en:
First, they want you to look into
the
Vampire remnants that have turned into
armed guerrillas all over, and gather
intel. And, Captain «E801:00». Oddeye
is apparently already out there.
Pick her up, would you?
MsgLabels_station_48_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: First, investigate the Vampires' remnants in various places who've turned into armed guerrillas, and gather information. Also, Captain Storm. Oddeye is apparently on site. Please pick her up.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...That's a lot of luggage, Rain?

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_002.en:
...I was here over a year.
Things pile up, I suppose.
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I was here more than a year, / so personal belongings really pile up.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_003.en:
Place sure has gotten empty,
though...
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But this place has gotten really lonely...

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Huh? / That book is.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, it's Hepaist's gravure magazine...

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_006.en:
Exactly so.
"Oh my, Catherine's udderly
flustered!" as they say.
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Indeed. / "Catherine, moo, I'm in trouble!" like that.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_007.en:
Hepaist, honestly!
Don't bring that kind of book
into the barracks!
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hey, Hepaist! / Don't bring that kind of book into the station!

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oops, I've been found by Miss Rain.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_009.en:
...I just couldn't bring myself
to throw it out.
Oh, Captain.
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Somehow I can't throw it away. / Ah, Captain.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...It's become a keepsake of Hepaist.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_011.en:
Heard the old man didn't have
any family...
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I hear the old man didn't have any surviving family...

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_012.en:
Yeah.
Seems he was a merc his whole life.
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / It seems he stayed a mercenary his whole life.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_013.en:
...He always took everything in
stride, didn't he?
I bet that's how he drifted from
one battlefield to the next.
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...He was always so carefree. / He probably wandered through all sorts / of battlefields like that.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_014.en:
...When I was feeling down, he
cheered me up too. In his own way.
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...When I was down too, / Hepaist encouraged me in his own way.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Huh? / My cell phone...

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_016.en:
Hello?
Is that you, Rain?
...Huh? The signal's...
Hellooo?
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hello? / Is that Miss Rain? / ...Huh? The signal... / Hellooo?

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_017.en:
Oddeye?
I can hear you!
Are you alright?
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye? / I can hear you! / Are you well?

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_018.en:
Rain, can you... hear me?
I just... got to Huffman!
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Miss Rain, can you... hear me? / I just arrived... on Huffman!

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_019.en:
Wait, Oddeye, we're not
mercenaries anymore.
Even if you come here...
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hey, Oddeye, / we're not mercenaries anymore. / Even if you come here...

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_020.en:
...I can't... hear you very well?
...Ah!
A girl...
This is bad!
There's this girl!!
Shady people are... I'm going in!
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I can't hear... you well? / ...Ah! / A girl is... / This is bad! / Some girl is!! / with suspicious people... I'll help her!

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_021.en:
What? «g:24»Oddeye?
What's happening?
Oddeye, listen, even if you come...
...She hung up...
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh?«g:24» Oddeye? / What's wrong? / Hey, even if you come here. / ...It got cut off...

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye came back to Huffman?

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_023.en:
It seems so.
But something's happened...
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems so. / But something seems to have happened...

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_024.en:
Dammit, we finally take down
the Vampires, and...
They shut the merc base and kick
us out with it...
And now Commander Falcon's gone
too...
What the hell's going on...
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Damn, even though we finally beat / the Vampires... / The mercenary base abolished, and even we get dismissed... / Commander Falcon's gone too... / What the hell is going on...

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_025.en:
The Commander vanishing...
The merc base being dismantled...
Is this what Lich meant by
"getting erased"...?
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The Commander's mysterious disappearance... / The dismantling of the mercenary base... / I wonder if this is what Lich meant / by "you'll be erased"...

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_026.en:
I've started packing to go home,
but something about this doesn't
sit right.
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I tried preparing to go home, but / something doesn't sit right.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_027.en:
I hear Roy's at headquarters.
I'll go see if he knows anything.
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roy seems to be at headquarters. / I'll go ask if there's any information.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_028.en:
Understood.
I'll stay here a while longer,
until you get back.
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood. / I'll stay here a while longer until the Captain returns.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_029.en:
I'll stay here a while longer,
until you get back.
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Until the Captain returns, / I'll stay here a while longer.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_030.en:
Huh? A mission?
...An action unit... Understood.
I'm with you, Captain.
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? A mission? / ...The action unit... roger. / I'll accompany the Captain.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_031.en:
Dammit, we finally take down
the Vampires, and...
They shut the merc base and kick
us out with it...
And now Commander Falcon's gone
too...
What the hell's going on...
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Damn, even though we finally beat / the Vampires... / The mercenary base abolished, and even we get dismissed... / Commander Falcon's gone too... / What the hell is going on...

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_032.en:
Hey, now that's what I like to hear!
I'm with you, Captain!
Like that was ever a question!
Little Catherine, wish me luck!!
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hoh, isn't that a good deal! / I'll follow the Captain! / Of course! / Catherine-tan, I'm off!!

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_033.en:
The Commander vanishing...
The merc base being dismantled...
Is this what Lich meant by
"getting erased"...?
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The Commander's mysterious disappearance... / The dismantling of the mercenary base... / I wonder if this is what Lich meant / by "you'll be erased"...

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_034.en:
CISU's action unit...
Of course, that's a way in!
Nice one, Investigator.
I'll get ready right away.
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: C.I.S.U.'s action unit... / I see, there was that way! / The Investigator's good. / I'll get ready right away.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_035.en:
(Dismantling the merc corps...
So this is how the army does it...)
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (The mercenary unit dismantled... / So this is the army's way...)

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_036.en:
(I'll keep what I know about
Commander Falcon to myself
for now.)
(...The mission comes first.)
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (About Commander Falcon... / I'll keep it quiet for now.) / (...First, the mission.)

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_037.en:
I hear they fired you from the
merc corps?
You took down the Vampires.
If anything, the regulars ought
to be recruiting you.
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I hear you were dismissed from the mercenary corps? / You're the ones with the achievement of defeating / the Vampires, so they could even / promote you into the regular army.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_038.en:
You folks are the heroes of
Huffman Island.
Now if we could just find out who
was behind the Vampires...
Me, I've got money on the EC.
Why the EC?
They'd love to see the OCU and USN
fight and wipe each other out.
It's only lunch money, mind you.
Want in?
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You're the heroes of Huffman Island. / Now if only we knew the Vampires' mastermind. / By the way, I'm betting / on the E.C. guys. / Why the E.C.? / They surely think it'd be great if the O.C.U. and U.S.N. / fought and both were crushed. / Even though it's a bet, / it's just treating someone to lunch, / so would you like to join in too?

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_039.en:
The merc base dismantled out of
nowhere. Commander Falcon resigns.
And then vanishes...
The one mercy is that nothing has
happened to any of you yet.
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The sudden dismantling of the mercenary unit base, / Commander Falcon's resignation. / And his mysterious disappearance... / That nothing has happened to you yet / is the only saving grace.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_040.en:
Still no word on where Commander
Falcon is?
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Since then, haven't you been able to find / any trace of Commander Falcon?

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_041.en:
...His whereabouts remain unknown.
What's more, it seems he's been
struck from the army's rolls.
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...His whereabouts are still unknown. / Moreover, he seems to have been struck from the military register.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_042.en:
I can't see him leaving the
service on his own...
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I don't think he'd leave the service on his own...

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_043.en:
...I'm sorry.
This is my fault.
I never expected them to move this
fast, dismantling the merc corps
included.
The Commander may well have...
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I'm sorry. / It's my responsibility. / Including the dismantling of the mercenary unit, it was a miscalculation / that they'd take action this quickly. / Perhaps the Commander too...

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_044.en:
Whoever's pulling the army's
strings is erasing every unit
involved in that incident...
...But then, aren't you in danger
too, Investigator?
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The army's mastermind is trying to erase the units / involved in that affair... / ...But in that case, aren't you, Investigator, / in danger too?

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_045.en:
I act on government orders.
They likely cannot touch me
directly, so this is meant as
a message to me.
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I act on government orders. / They probably can't lay hands on me directly, / so this is likely a dig at me.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_046.en:
And getting rid of one merc base
is an easy enough warning shot...
Is that it?
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So in place of a warning, disposing of something / like a mercenary base is easy... / is that it.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_047.en:
...And your mercenary contracts
have been voided as well.
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...And your mercenary contracts were annulled as well.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_048.en:
...About that. Couldn't we sign on
as mercs at another base?
I don't want to be crushed just
because it suits whoever's
behind this.
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...About that, can't we be hired / as mercenaries at another base? / I don't want to be crushed / as the mastermind pleases.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_049.en:
...I was about to propose that
myself, but your right to work as
mercenaries has been revoked
entirely.
So I ask instead: would you work
for me, or rather, as a private
force of the Internal Affairs unit?
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I was going to propose that too, but / you've been stripped of mercenary rights themselves. / So, would you act as my, no, the internal / investigation unit's private soldiers?

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_050.en:
...If that's possible, I've got no
reason to refuse.
But is there still something going
on here on Huffman?
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...If that's possible, there's no reason to refuse. / But is there still something / happening on Huffman?

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_051.en:
Yes. There is a mountain of work.
Since the Anti-Vampire Op, the
organization's remnants have been
stirring.
I can no longer fight on the front
line, so I want «E801:00» Squad to
use those remnants as leads and
uncover the truth.
And of course I will pay as before.
No, better than mercenary rates.
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, there's a mountain of work. / After the anti-Vampires operation, / the organization's remnants seem to be showing / disturbing movements. / In place of me, who can no longer fight on the front line, / I want the «E801:00» squad to use the remnants as leads / and work on uncovering the truth. / Of course I'll prepare funds as before, no, / more than as mercenaries.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Please handle the transfer procedures.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_053.en:
...Thank you.
I will register you at once.
As you know, the army is being
extremely cautious about dealing
with the Vampires.
It would be no exaggeration to
say it does not want to act at all.
...But unless we find proof of who
stood behind the Vampires, a
second and a third Vampires will
surely be formed.
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Thank you. / I'll do the registration right away. / As you know, the army is extremely cautious / in its actions regarding dealing with the Vampires. / No, it's no exaggeration to say / it doesn't want to move at all. / ...But unless we grab evidence of / what was behind the Vampires, / a second and third Vampires / will be formed.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: For now, what should we do?

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_055.en:
First, investigate the Vampire
remnants that have turned into
armed guerrillas across the island,
and gather intelligence.
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: First, investigate the Vampires' remnants / in various places who've turned into armed guerrillas, / and gather information.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_056.en:
Roger.
We'll start getting ready.
Send the terrain data for the
site to our wanzers.
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Starting preparations. / Transfer the destination's terrain information / to the vanzers.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_057.en:
Understood.
One more thing, «E801:00».
Oddeye has returned to Huffman
Island.
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood. / Also, «E801:00». / Oddeye has come back to Huffman Island.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_058.en: Yeah. She called Rain just now.
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, she contacted Rain a bit ago.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...3 days ago, / David passed away.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I see.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_061.en:
After the incident, he was taken
to a medical facility under my
jurisdiction.
She asked to stay by his side,
and I allowed it, but...
He was on special life support.
Visits, nursing, all of it was
cut off.
She says she could do nothing for
him, even sitting right there...
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: After the incident, he was transported to a medical facility / under my jurisdiction. / She requested to stay by his side, / and I permitted it too, but... / he was connected to a special life-support device, / with visits and nursing all cut off. / Even by his side, she apparently couldn't do anything for him...

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: How unfortunate...

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_063.en:
She wishes to rejoin «E801:00»
Squad.
She has just arrived near the
target site.
Meet up with her there.
Also, a wanzer repair backpack has
been delivered to the hangar.
It won't replace Hepaist, but
it can stand in for his supply
truck.
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: She wishes to return / to the «E801:00» squad. / She's just arrived around the target site. / Join up with her on site. / Also, backpacks for WAP repair / have been delivered to the hangar. / They won't replace Hepaist, but / they'll replace the supply vehicle.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Of course we welcome her.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_065.en:
First, investigate the Vampire
remnants that have turned into
armed guerrillas across the island,
and gather intelligence.
Also, Oddeye has arrived near the
site. Meet up with her there.
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: First, investigate the Vampires' remnants / in various places who've turned into armed guerrillas, / and gather information. / Also, Oddeye has arrived near the site. / Join up with her on site.

MsgLabels_station_49_msg_066.en:
This incident, which had cost
so many precious lives, seemed
to have been resolved through the
mercenaries' efforts.
And yet...

...A few days after the battle
with Lich.
MsgLabels_station_49_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This affair, which produced many precious sacrifices, / seemed to have been solved by the mercenaries' work. / But... /  / ...A few days after the battle with Lich.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_001.en: Still no sign of remnant forces.
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As expected, no remnant units can be confirmed.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So it seems.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_003.en:
Huh?
That armored vehicle... looks like
someone's chasing it.
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Huh? / That armored vehicle seems to be being chased.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Infighting?

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, what do we do?

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_006.en:
Those are wanzers behind it.
Any wanzer out here that isn't army
is almost certainly a remnant.
We cover the armored vehicle.
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What's behind it is a WAP. / A WAP in this area other than the army's / is strongly suspected to be the remnants. / We'll support the armored vehicle ahead.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_007.en:
Heh. Sharp as ever, Captain.
Mission understood!
Covering the armored vehicle!
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hehe, Captain, your observation is as calm as ever. / Mission understood! / Supporting the armored vehicle!

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aisha, are you alright?

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_009.en:
Y-Yeah!
Oddeye, they're still on us!
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
