Literal: Y-yeah! / Oddeye, there are still pursuers!

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_010.en:
No problem, I'm used to this kind
of thing! Hold on tight!
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's fine, I'm used to this kind of thing! / Hold on tight!

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Uwah, my eyes... are spinning...

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_012.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit or
Oddeye unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down or / Oddeye's unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...At this rate.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Kuh, I hate persistent guys!

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...That vehicle looks to be in trouble.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_017.en:
I'll try guiding them on a direct
channel.
...Armored vehicle, we'll cover you.
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll try guiding it by direct call. / ...Armored vehicle there, we'll support you.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_018.en:
Ah, that voice!
Rain, is that you!?
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, that voice! / Is that Miss Rain!?

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye!?

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? Someone you know?

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_021.en:
Yep!
They're my precious teammates!
Now that everyone's here,
we're totally safe.
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah! / They're my precious comrades! / Everyone came, / so we're fine now.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_022.en:
Oddeye, explanations later.
Head for the escape point.
We'll intercept your pursuers.
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, I'll hear the circumstances later. / Aim for the escape point. / We'll intercept the pursuers.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wow, Captain! / Roger!!

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_024.en:
Oddeye's... awfully wound up...
Still, that's a relief.
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye... / is somehow really hyped... / But I'm relieved.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Same.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_026.en:
All units, don't let them lay
a finger on Oddeye's vehicle.
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units, don't let them lay a finger / on Oddeye's armored vehicle.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_027.en:
Goooal! Made it!
Captain, over to you!
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Goooal! / Captain, I'm counting on you!

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_028.en:
Roger.
All units, wipe out the hostile
wanzers.
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / All units, annihilate the hostile WAPs.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All enemy units silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye's armored vehicle is safe too.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_032.en:
Oddeye, thanks for coming back.
Welcome.
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, thank you for coming back. / Welcome.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_033.en:
Captain, why so formal?
Of course I came back!
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, why are you being so formal? / Of course I'd come back!

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, that girl is...?

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_035.en:
This is Aisha.
Some weirdos were about to grab
her on the edge of town, so I
rescued her!
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is Aisha. / By chance, at the edge of town, she was about to / be caught by weird people, / so I rescued her.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_036.en:
Yes. I was in real danger, and
Oddeye saved me.
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, I was in danger, / and Oddeye saved me.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_037.en:
That's Oddeye for you.
Probably felt like picking up
a stray cat...
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Knowing Oddeye, / it's like picking up a stray cat...

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's so like Oddeye.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_039.en:
That's how it started, but when
I heard her story, wow!
...Aisha was a researcher at
a Vampire research facility!
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: At first that's how it was, but / when I heard her story, I was shocked. / ...Aisha was working as a researcher / at the Vampires' research facility.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_040.en:
...I see. There's more to this.
...I'd like to hear the details.
Would you come by our base?
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I see, there seem to be circumstances. / ...I'd like to hear details; / would you stop by the base?

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, I don't mind.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_042.en:
Oddeye, you knew that and came
out this way...
Don't tell me the Investigator
gave you a secret assignment?
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, you knew that / and came around here... / Don't tell me, a special order from the Investigator?

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_043.en:
Huh? No way.
That's spy-movie stuff...
Rain, you watch too many movies!
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? No way. / Something like a spy movie... / Miss Rain, you watch too many movies!

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_044.en:
Ugh...
Hearing that from her, of all
people...
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ugh... / To be told that by this girl...

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_045.en:
So it really was pure
coincidence...
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Then it really was just a coincidence...

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_046.en:
Then we may have a source of
intel.
We'll head back and hear her out.
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: With this, there's now a chance / we can get information. / Let's return to base and hear the circumstances.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_047.en:
It's a messy place, but please
bear with it, okay?
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's a dirty place, but please bear with it.

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_048.en:
Yeah, it's fine.
I'm used to it!
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah, it's fine. / I'm used to it!

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Ahh!«g:24» Captain!!

MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_050.en:
I'm sorry...
I couldn't hold the line...
MsgLabels_tactics_49_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm sorry... / So I couldn't protect him...

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see... / So David...

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_002.en:
But I got to say a proper goodbye.
Thanks to all of you.
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But I was able to say goodbye properly. / Thanks to everyone.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye... you're strong.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_004.en:
No, I'm not.
...I cried a lot, all on my own.
But I made him a promise.
I don't want any more victims like
the ones in that incident...
That's what keeps me fighting now.
Oh, Captain!
Have you seen Aisha?
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No. / ...I cried a lot alone. / But I swore to him. / I don't want any more victims / like in that affair... / For now I can fight with that. / Ah, Captain! / Have you seen Aisha?

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_005.en:
No. I thought she'd be in the
barracks. Looks like she isn't.
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, I thought she was in the station. / She doesn't seem to have come.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_006.en:
Hmm...
Where'd she run off to?
I stayed up all night making the
white cat version, too...
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm~. / Where did she go? / Even though I stayed up all night making / the white cat version...

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The white cat version?

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_008.en:
Yes! Aisha really wanted this black
cat pendant, so I made a white cat
version, with her in mind!
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, Aisha saw this black cat pendant / and wanted one, so I tried making / a white cat version / inspired by Aisha!

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_009.en:
I've been wondering for a while...
You made that accessory yourself?
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'd wondered for a while, but / that accessory is homemade...

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_010.en:
It works as PC memory, it plays
music, it's packed with all kinds
of features!
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It can become PC memory, / play music too, / it has all sorts of functions in it!

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As expected, you're dexterous...

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_012.en:
Hehehe, and the white one, Shishi,
has a secret weapon built in!!
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hehehe, and on top of that, Shishi the white cat / has a secret weapon inside!!

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_013.en:
A secret weapon...
There's nothing you can't do,
is there, Oddeye?
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A secret weapon... / Anything goes with Oddeye.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_014.en:
Captain, if you find Aisha,
let me knooow!
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, if you find Aisha, / please let me knooow!

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood. / I'll let you know.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_016.en:
Maybe I should ask her to make me
something too...
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Maybe I'll have her make me something too...

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_017.en:
An escort mission for Aisha.
Understood.
We have a little time before we
leave, though...
I'll go make us some tea.
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The escort mission for Aisha. / Roger. / But there's a little time until departure... / Ah, I'll go make some tea.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_018.en:
Captain, if you find Aisha,
let me knooow!
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, if you find Aisha, / please let me knooow!

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_019.en: Ah, Aisha, you were at HQ!
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Aisha, you were at headquarters.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_020.en:
Yeah, Oddeye.
I heard you were looking for me?
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah, Oddeye. / I heard you were looking for me?

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Here, this!

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wow, a white cat.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_023.en:
This is Shishi.
I made it with you in mind, Aisha!
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's Shishi. / I made it inspired by Aisha!

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_024.en:
Shishi?
The black cat's cute, but this one's
cute too. Thanks, Oddeye!
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Shishi? / The black cat is cute too, but this one's cute too. / Oddeye, thank youuu.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_025.en:
I'm so glad you like it!
Oh, Captain, we've still got time,
right?
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm glad you like it~. / Ah, Captain, there's still time, right?

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_026.en:
Yeah.
Feel free to relax until then.
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / You may relax until it's time.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_027.en: Oh, I know! Aisha, let's go eat!
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh right, Aisha, let's eat something!

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_028.en:
Oh, come to think of it,
I'm starving...
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, come to think of it, I was hungry...

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_029.en:
Then it's a full-course ration
meal! Let's go, Aisha!
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Then it's a full course of rations! / Let's go, Aisha!

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_030.en:
Huh?
Oh, sorry, Captain.
I'll be off, then...
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? / Ah, sorry, Captain, / I'll be going...

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_031.en:
Yeah.
I'll call you when it's time.
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / I'll call when it's time.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_032.en:
Oddeye looks like she's bounced
back, but it must've hit her hard...
Well, if she's back on her feet,
this squad'll liven up again too.
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye looks like she's recovered, but / it must have been really hard... / Well, if Oddeye gets her energy back, / this squad's liveliness will come back too.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_033.en:
Got time before the mission...
Alright, think I'll hit the hot
springs.
Hey, Grayyy? «g:24»Hot springs, let's go!
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There's time before the mission. / ...Alright, maybe I'll go to the hot spring. / Heeey, Graaay?«g:24» We're going to the hot spriiing!

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_034.en:
Action unit or not, it's not that
different from before.
Still, where could Commander Falcon
have gone after leaving the army...
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even though we're an action unit, / it's not that different from before. / Still, I wonder where Commander Falcon / went after leaving the army...

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_035.en:
An escort mission. Understood.
There's still time, but I think
I'll get ready early.
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: An escort mission. / Roger. / There's still time, but / maybe I'll get ready first.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_036.en:
Hey, Grayyy?
Hot springs, let's go!
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Heeey, Graaay? / We're going to the hot spriiing!

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_037.en:
......
Hot springs again...
Whenever I go with Champ, he spends
the whole time showing off his
muscles...
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ... / The hot spring again... / When I go to the hot spring with Champ, / he shows off his muscles...

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_038.en:
Huh? «g:24»
You can't bring civilians onto
the base. Especially not kids...
Hey, Oddeye, are you listening?
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Huh?«g:24» / You can't let civilians into the base. / Especially kids... / hey, Oddeye, are you listening?

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_039.en:
By the way, Mr. Kinoshita's back.
Says he wants to help you folks
however he can.
You've got a fan there.
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Come to think of it, Mister Kinoshita / has come back. / He apparently wants to be even a little useful to you. / You're well liked.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_040.en:
Hey. I'm Jon.
CISU intelligence unit.
I gather intel on Huffman Island.
Huh? «g:24»The outfit?
I wear it on purpose.
Best way to blend in with the
locals is to dress like them.
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hi. I'm John. / I'm with C.I.S.U.'s intelligence unit. / I'm gathering information on Huffman Island. / Eh?«g:24» This outfit? / I'm wearing it on purpose. / To blend in with people on site, / dressing the same is best.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_041.en:
I see.
So her pursuers were a combat unit
from the organization's remnants.
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / The pursuers are the organization's remnant combat unit.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_042.en:
But that's the first time I'd ever
seen the organization's combat
units...
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But I'd never seen / the organization's combat unit before...

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_043.en:
Aisha, there you are.
Oddeye was looking for you.
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aisha, you were here. / Oddeye was looking for you.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, I'll go right away.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_045.en:
Forgive me, «E801:00».
I took her account first.
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry, «E801:00», / I was hearing her circumstances first.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_046.en:
Hard at work as always.
So, any progress?
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Diligent as ever. / So, any progress?

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_047.en:
Dr. Aisha.
She is Zaftran, and a prodigy in
neuroscience.
It seems the Vampires' research
body forced her to work on that
experimental unit.
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Doctor Aisha. / She's Zaftran, / a genius in neuroscience. / It seems she was forced to research / that experimental unit at the Vampires' research institution.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That thing of Faceless's...

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_049.en:
My work was mainly on the control
system.
After the accident when B1 was
installed, I was evacuated, so I
never saw the finished unit...
And after the organization was
broken up, most of the research
staff were moved somewhere...
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What I did was mainly research on / the control system. / After the accident following B1's implementation, I evacuated, / and I haven't seen the finished version... / Also, after the organization was dismantled, / many of the research staff / were transferred somewhere...

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You did well to escape.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_051.en:
...I saw an opening during the
transfer and ran.
But ever since they brought me to
Huffman, I'd been shut in a lab...
I had no idea where to run, and
they were after me in no time...
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...During the transfer, I saw an opening and ran. / But since being brought to Huffman, / I'd been shut up in the lab the whole time... / I had no idea where to run, / and pursuers came right away...

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_052.en:
Nowhere to go.
And that's when Oddeye saved you.
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There was no way to escape. / That's when Oddeye saved you.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_053.en:
Yes.
But it wasn't pure chance.
I spotted Oddeye and ran to her.
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / But it wasn't a complete coincidence; / I saw Oddeye / and ran up to her.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hm? / You knew Oddeye?

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_055.en:
Yes. Files with her photo had been
passed around... She was to be a
subject in the next experiment...
I was clutching at straws.
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, as a person to be used in the next experiment, / documents with photos had been circulated... / I was grasping at straws.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_056.en:
Forgive me, but let us leave that
for later.
I've spoken with headquarters, and
we have decided to take her into
protective custody.
Her parents are waiting for her
back home, it seems.
I want her delivered safely to the
airport.
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry, but let's have / that story later. / I spoke with headquarters, and we've decided / to take her into protective custody. / Apparently her parents are waiting back home. / I want you to deliver her safely to the airport.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_058.en:
May I go say goodbye to everyone,
then?
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Then may I go say goodbye to everyone?

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_059.en:
Permission granted.
You have three hours before
departure.
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Permitted. / There are 3 hours until departure.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_060.en:
Mission understood.
I'm used to escort work.
All of «E801:00» Squad will
see her off.
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / We're used to escorting. / The whole «E801:00» squad will see you off.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, thank you for everything.

MsgLabels_station_50_msg_062.en:
I've spoken with headquarters, and
we have decided to take her into
protective custody.
Her parents are waiting for her
back home, it seems.
I want her delivered safely to the
airport.
MsgLabels_station_50_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I spoke with headquarters, and / we've decided to take her into protective custody. / Apparently her parents are waiting back home. / I want you to deliver her safely to the airport.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Entering the airport area.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There seems to be no sign of hostile forces.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_003.en:
Guess we can't run into a fight
everywhere we go.
MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There's no way there'd be a battle / everywhere we go, surely.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_004.en:
You know, Aisha, you're pretty
amazing.
MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Still, Aisha is / amazing.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? What is?

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_006.en:
You're famous in neuroscience,
aren't you?
MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You're famous in neuroscience, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_007.en:
It's nothing special.
I think you, surviving out on the
battlefield, are far more amazing
than me.
MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's not really amazing. / I think you, surviving the battlefield, / are far more amazing than me.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_008.en:
Aisha Romaryoff.
Born 2071.
Held four doctorates by the age
of 14...
MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aisha Romariaf. / Born 2071. / By age 14 had already obtained 4 doctorates...

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_009.en:
Whaaat! 2071 means...
You're only two years older than me!?
That's kind of a shock...
MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh! 2071 means... / you're only 2 years different from me...! / Somehow it's a shock...

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Lots of surprises.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_011.en:
But I'm self-conscious about
looking so young for 18...
MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But for 18, I'm seen as childish-looking, / and it's a complex of mine...

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_012.en:
...To be honest, I thought you
were about 14.
MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...True, I thought you were about 14.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_013.en:
I get that a lot...
Even though I take calcium and
everything...
MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I get told that a lot... / Even though I take calcium and all sorts of things...

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_014.en:
What's wrong with that?
When you're cute, all is forgiven!
MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Isn't that fine? / If you're cute, anything is forgiven!

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ahaha.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Arrived at the target point.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_017.en:
Looks like we can see her off
without any trouble.
MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Looks like we can see her off without any problem.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_018.en:
Alert level yellow.
All units, you may see Aisha off.
MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Alert level to yellow. / All units have permission to see Aisha off.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_019.en:
Everyone,
thank you for everything.
Oddeye, I'll email you once I'm
settled. Oh, and the Shishi pendant,
I'll take good care of it!
MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Everyone. / Thank you for everything. / Oddeye, I'll email you once things settle down. / Ah, and also, Shishi's pendant, / I'll treasure it~.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Okaaay. / See yaaa!

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? A heat source!?

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hm, what are these unit signatures...!?

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There are combat helicopters too.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_024.en:
Aisha, get inside the airport
building, now.
MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aisha, hurry and take shelter in the airport facility.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes!

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_026.en:
Looks like her pursuers.
All units, wipe out the hostiles.
MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems to be the pursuers. / All units, exterminate the hostile forces.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_028.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit or
Aisha unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down or / Aisha's vehicle shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_030.en:
Target acquired.
Positive ID, confirmed.
Take her, armored vehicle and all.
MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Target acquired. / No mistake, confirmed. / Capture it, armored vehicle and all.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...For remnants. / They're well disciplined.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Geez, what unit are they from...?

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll protect her!

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed all hostile units silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_035.en:
Ah... Captain!
The comm line's gone dead...
Aisha, come in...!
Answer me!
MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah... Captain! / The comm line was cut... / Please respond, Aisha...! / Answer me!

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_036.en:
Aisha's armored vehicle is lost.
No visual.
No sign it was destroyed either...
MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Lost Aisha's armored vehicle. / Cannot confirm. / No trace of it being shot down either...

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Vanished? / What does that mean.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_038.en:
Ah, Captain, Shishi's...
The transmitter's moving.
At this speed... it's a chopper!
When did they grab her...?
MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Captain, Shishi's... / transmitter is moving. / This speed is... a helicopter! / When did she get / captured...

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Are we chasing it?

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_040.en:
It's no good...
Five seconds to the edge of
reception range.
...3...2...
Signal lost...
MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No good... / 5 seconds until the signal's reception distance limit. / ...3... 2 / Lost it... /

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_041.en:
No choice... We take the enemy
wreckage back and have the base
identify the unit and its aims.
It looks like those weren't
Vampire remnants...
MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It can't be helped... take the enemy wreckage back, / and have the base identify the unit / and figure out its goal. / It seems that enemy isn't / the Vampires' remnants...

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aisha... will she be okay...

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aisha...!!

MsgLabels_tactics_50_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Kuh! So we couldn't protect her...

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_001.en:
Still, failing an escort mission...
Every mission up to now went off
without a hitch...
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Still, to fail an escort / mission... / Every mission until now / went smoothly...

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_002.en:
They caught us completely off
guard while we were busy fighting.
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: In the battle with the hostile forces, / we were completely caught off guard.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_003.en:
I hope Aisha's okay...
Oh, Captain.
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Will Aisha be okay... / Ah, Captain.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_004.en:
Rain has a point.
But we took our eyes off the person
we were protecting. That's on us.
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What Rain says has a point. / But taking our eyes off the escort target / was our mistake.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_005.en:
The unexpected resistance tied us
up, too.
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There's also that we struggled / with unexpected resistance.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_006.en:
Getting cocky after we beat the
Vampires, huh...
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That conceit after / beating the Vampires, huh...

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_007.en:
Maybe...
We might've let our guard down.
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: True... / We might have been careless.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_008.en:
Still, Oddeye's secret weapon was
a stroke of luck.
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But Oddeye's secret weapon / was a blessing in disguise.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_009.en:
Shishi...
You see, Aisha said she didn't know
her way around Huffman, so besides
the memory, I built in a tracker in
case she got lost...
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Shishi... / That was, since Aisha said she didn't / know Huffman well, / besides the memory function, I put in / a transmitter for if she got lost...

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_010.en:
I see.
If it's meant for finding someone
lost, the signal can't be that
strong.
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / Since it's for getting lost, the signal strength / doesn't seem to be very high.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_011.en:
That's right.
Huffman's full of military sites,
so reception here is awful.
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / Huffman has a lot of military facilities, / so the radio conditions are bad.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_012.en:
True...
Phones from back home are
practically useless here...
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: True... / Phones made back home are also / mostly useless...

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_013.en:
I never thought it'd come in handy
so soon...
I should've shown her how to
use it...
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: To be useful this soon... / I should have properly explained / how to use it...

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_014.en:
They took Aisha alive, so they
must need her skills as a
researcher.
They won't kill her right away.
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Since they abducted Aisha without killing her, / they must need a researcher's abilities. / They probably won't take her life right away.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_015.en:
Oh, that's true!
If we can just get a lead,
we can get her back!
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, that's right. / If we can just get a lead, / we can rescue her!

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_016.en:
For now, all we can do is trace
their movements with the
Investigator's intel and use that
signal to find her.
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: First, with the Investigator's information, / it seems we have no choice but to trace her path, / and search using that signal as a lead.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_017.en:
Whose unit are we up against
this time, I wonder...
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I wonder what unit this enemy is...

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_018.en:
Sortie order understood.
I'll get ready at once.
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sortie, roger. / I'll get ready at once.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_019.en:
Next time we run into those guys,
I want my rematch...
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Next time I meet them, / I want to clear our name...

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Alright, I'll go wild!

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_021.en:
I never thought it'd come in handy
so soon...
I should've shown her how to
use it...
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: To be useful this soon... / I should have properly explained / how to use it...

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_022.en:
Aisha might be there!
I'll go get ready to sortie!
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aisha might be there! / I'll go prepare to sortie!

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_023.en:
That unit...
For Vampire remnants, they seem
far too well organized.
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That unit... / I feel it's too orderly / for the Vampires' remnants.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_024.en:
An intelligence building...
Sounds suspicious.
Understood. Preparing to sortie.
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The Intelligence Building... / Suspicious. / Roger, I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_025.en:
I heard the girl who was on base
the other day got kidnapped?
What would anyone want with a kid
who looks junior-high age?
Wait, she's actually 18? «g:24»
An authority on neuroscience? «g:24»
Seriously?
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I hear the girl who was at the base the other day / was kidnapped? / What do they intend, abducting a kid / about junior high age? / Eh, she's actually 18?«g:24» / An authority in neuroscience?«g:24» / Is that true?

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_026.en:
I heard just now, Mr. Kinoshita's
son ran away from home a long time
ago. No one knows where he is.
Rough, huh?
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I heard just now, / Mister Kinoshita's son / apparently ran away from home long ago and his whereabouts are unknown. / That's rough.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_027.en:
You folks are probably the
strongest mercs in the OCU army,
but there's a regular unit with a
standout record too.
Captain's name was Lloyd Clive,
if I remember right.
With the ceasefire in place, though,
I doubt they'll be deployed.
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The strongest mercenaries in the O.C.U. army now are / probably you, but even in the regular army / there's a unit with outstanding results. / I think the captain's name was / Lloyd Clive. / Of course with the ceasefire agreement, / I don't think they'll move.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_028.en:
Can the parts we brought back
identify the unit?
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: From the parts we brought back, / can the unit be identified?

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_029.en:
The recovered parts come from a
model in widespread use.
...Identifying the unit will
take time.
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The recovered parts are / from mass-produced, widespread units. / ...Identifying the unit will take time.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_030.en:
Even so, they're wanzers.
Not something you buy off the shelf.
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even so, they're vanzers. / They can't be bought easily.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_031.en:
In any case, it seems very likely
that Dr. Aisha has been taken by
the organization, like the other
researchers.
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As expected, the possibility is strong that Doctor Aisha, / like the other researchers, / was captured by the organization.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_032.en:
Right, she did say her colleagues
had been moved.
Any intel on that?
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: True, she herself said her fellow researchers / were transferred. / Any information about that?

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_033.en:
We have word that a number of
people in white coats have been
taken into an intelligence building
near Grayrock.
I cannot say for certain that it
is the organization, but...
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We've obtained information that many people / in white coats are being brought into / the Intelligence Building on the outskirts of Greylock. / It can't be determined for certain that it's the organization's movement...

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_034.en:
...That intel's all we've got.
...They're probably after the
research. If so, the researchers
should be alive.
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...For now we can only rely on that information. / ...The goal is probably the research. / ...If so, the researchers' lives are safe.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_035.en:
But left alone, there will surely
be more victims.
I want the researchers secured as
soon as possible.
Captain «E801:00», if the researchers
are on site, storm the building
and rescue them.
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But if left alone, the victims / will definitely increase. / I want to protect the researchers as soon as possible. / Captain «E801:00», if the researchers / seem to be on site, assault the building / and rescue them.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_036.en:
Roger.
Expect the same unit that hit us
at the airport.
We'll prepare to sortie at once.
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / The enemy unit can be assumed to be the same / one that attacked the airport. / Preparing to sortie at once.

MsgLabels_station_51_msg_037.en:
The researchers may be held in an
intelligence building near
Grayrock.
MsgLabels_station_51_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The researchers may be confined in / the Intelligence Building on the outskirts / of Greylock.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_001.en:
Could a plan for controlling the
adult brain be built into your
current research?
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Can't we introduce a plan to control adult brains / into the current research?

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_002.en:
Controlling the adult brain?
What do you mean?
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Control adult brains? / What do you mean?

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_003.en:
I'm asking if it's possible.
Can it be done?
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm asking about the possibility. / Can it be done?

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Theoretically it's possible. / But...

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_005.en:
Would it be more realistic with
her help, perhaps?
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: With her help, would it be more realistic?

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Doctor Aisha!

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_007.en:
No introductions needed, I see.
She was lead researcher on another
plan. It seems she succeeded in
controlling an adult brain there.
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems there's no need to introduce her. / She was the main researcher of a separate plan. / There, she apparently succeeded in / controlling an adult brain.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_008.en:
Control is possible.
But...
Under the other plan, the
experimental unit went berserk.
It was a disaster.
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Control is possible. / But... / In the separate plan, the experimental unit went berserk / and it became a disaster.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_009.en:
...You mean you actually got it
to run on its own!?
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...You're saying it actually moved on its own!

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_010.en:
...No.
That's something we must never do...
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...No. / As I thought, that must not be done...

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_011.en:
I understand your misgivings.
But it would advance medicine, too.
Won't you continue the plan with
this organization's vast funds?
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I understand your conflict. / But it also leads to medical progress. / With this organization's enormous funds, won't you / continue the plan?

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_012.en:
If the research aims to revive the
brain-dead, I'll take it on.
But...
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If it's research aimed at revival from brain death, / I'll accept. / But...

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_013.en:
Exactly. Weapons development is
not the main purpose of this
research. It is for humanity.
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right, this research's main purpose / isn't weapons development. / It's research for humanity.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_014.en:
Certainly, if Dr. Aisha's research
and mine could be reconciled...
We might see results quickly,
but...
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Certainly, if Doctor Aisha's research and / mine are well aligned... / it seems results could come in a short time, but...

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_015.en:
An excellent answer, Dr. Brown.
Then let us return you to the
facility. Dr. Aisha, you'll come
along as well.
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's a good answer, Doctor Brown. / Then please return to the facility. / I'd like Doctor Aisha to accompany us too.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Resisting would be useless too, I suppose.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_017.en:
You're very sensible, I see.
Right, escort the two of them.
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You seem quick to understand, as expected. / Good, take the two.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is it that building?

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_019.en:
Several guard wanzers confirmed.
Same models as the intel.
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Several security WAPs confirmed. / The units are as the information said.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_020.en:
Ah, I've got a ping from Shishi!
No doubt about it.
Aisha's in that building!
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, there's Shishi's signal! / No mistake. / Aisha is in that building!

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: An awfully solid formation...

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_022.en:
No ordinary outfit, that's
for sure.
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's certain they're no ordinary unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_023.en:
...Reviving the project, then?
Either way, this is beyond what
any one company could pull off.
All units, assume Vampire-class
strength and wipe them out.
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...The goal is reviving the project. / Anyway, it doesn't seem like something / a single company could do. / All units, assume the enemy has Vampires-class strength / and work on annihilating them.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_025.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_027.en:
Hostile force has appeared.
Engaging several of the garrison's
wanzers.
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Resisting forces appeared. / Engaging several garrison WAPs.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_028.en:
Understood.
I'll arrange reinforcements.
They'll be there in five minutes.
Hold until then.
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood. / I'll arrange a reinforcement unit. / It should arrive in 5 minutes. / Hold out until then.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_029.en:
Roger.
The garrison will hold at all costs
until reinforcements arrive.
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / The garrison will defend to the death until reinforcements arrive.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Many enemy reinforcements!

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_031.en:
Look at 'em all...
No way we're going straight in!
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What numbers... / A frontal assault is difficult!

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_032.en:
To hit us with a force this
large...
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: To throw such an organized force / at us...

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Remaining ammo below 30%.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Same here. / The ammo won't last.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_035.en:
Five minutes of operating time
left, max.
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Operation time available: 5 more minutes is the limit.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Damn...

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That WAP is...

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Someone you know?

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_039.en:
......
(Captain... Oddeye...
They all came for me...)
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ... / (Captain... Oddeye... / Everyone came...)

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_040.en:
Naturally, Dr. Aisha.
You already have fine test
material lined up, is that it?
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As expected of Doctor Aisha. / So you've already secured / good experimental material.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No! / Those people are...

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_042.en:
Well, no matter.
We'll leave this to the elite unit
and enjoy our flight.
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well, fine. / Let's leave this place to the elite unit / and enjoy the flight.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ... / (Ah, I see... / Thank you, Shishi.)

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_044.en:
We're leaving the combat zone.
Ground units, it's in your hands.
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We're leaving the battle line. / Ground unit, I leave the rest to you.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, Aisha is on / that helicopter!

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_047.en:
...But with this many enemies,
pursuit won't be easy.
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...But. / With this many enemies, pursuit is difficult.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_048.en:
Worst case, we rely on Oddeye's
tracker. Wipe out the hostiles,
fast.
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: At worst we'll rely on Oddeye's transmitter, but / hurry to annihilate the hostile forces.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger, I'll concentrate on the radar!

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed all enemies silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_051.en:
They just carried her off right
under our noses...
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: She got taken right in front of us...

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_052.en:
Huh?
I'm picking up the tracker's
signal from where the chopper
withdrew...
Captain!
Aisha must've noticed Shishi!
Looks like she boosted the
tracker's output!
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Huh? / I can catch the transmitter's signal from the direction / the helicopter seems to have withdrawn... / Captain! / Aisha seems to have noticed / Shishi! / She seems to have raised the transmitter's output.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_053.en:
Roger.
But that enemy force was more than
we bargained for, and we're badly
worn down.
We'll keep tracking the signal and
return to base to regroup.
MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / But unexpected enemy forces appeared, / and we're badly worn down too. / While picking up the transmitter's signal, / we'll return to base once and regroup.

MsgLabels_tactics_51_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_001.en:
Captain, we're ready to track
Aisha's transmitter.
Just say the word.
MsgLabels_station_52_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, we're ready to follow Aisha's / transmitter. / Call us anytime.

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sortie, roger!

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_003.en:
Those guys...
They're on a whole other scale.
Might even be bigger than the
Vampires...
MsgLabels_station_52_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Those guys... / are really big in scale. / Maybe even / bigger than the Vampires...

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_004.en:
Time to sortie?
I'm good to go!
MsgLabels_station_52_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie? / I'm ready!

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_005.en:
Oh, Captain, I boosted the
receiver's sensitivity.
That should widen the range a bit!
MsgLabels_station_52_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Captain, / I raised the receiver's sensitivity. / This expands the range a little!

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_006.en:
Oh, time to sortie?
Ready whenever you are!
MsgLabels_station_52_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, a sortie. / Ready anytime!

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_007.en:
Captain, that enemy...
That was regular-army scale,
wasn't it?
MsgLabels_station_52_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, that enemy... / is regular army scale, right?

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_008.en:
Both armies have put enough force
on Huffman to start a war at any
moment. It's not impossible.
MsgLabels_station_52_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: On Huffman, both armies have deployed forces / enough to start a conflict anytime. / It's not impossible.

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_009.en:
Machines with no unit insignia,
no faction markings...
I figured special forces of some
kind, but with that level of
training, I don't think so.
And those numbers...
MsgLabels_station_52_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Units with no unit emblem / and no faction marking... / I thought they were some kind of special forces, but / judging by that skill level, / I don't think so. / But those numbers...

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_010.en:
A unit issued new models and sent
straight into combat...
If not special forces, maybe the
Marines, or the navy.
Either way, it'll never be
officially announced.
MsgLabels_station_52_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A unit supplied with new models / and immediately put into real combat... / If they're not special forces, / they might be marines or navy. / Either way, it'll probably never / be officially announced.

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_011.en:
Discipline, drills, orders...
If it's a regular unit that's loyal
to the mission, in a way they could
be more trouble than mercs...
MsgLabels_station_52_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Discipline, training, orders... / If they're regular army faithful to their mission, / in a sense they might be more troublesome / than a mercenary unit...

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_012.en:
But whatever the enemy is, we only
have one job.
MsgLabels_station_52_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But whatever the enemy is, / there's only one thing we must do.

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_013.en:
Right. Follow Aisha's trail and
stop them rebuilding that
inhuman research program...
MsgLabels_station_52_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Right. Using Aisha as a lead, / we must stop the rebuilding / of that atrocious research institution...

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_014.en:
Discipline, drills, orders...
If it's a regular unit that's loyal
to the mission, in a way they could
be more trouble than mercs...
MsgLabels_station_52_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Discipline, training, orders... / If they're regular army faithful to their mission, / in a sense they might be more troublesome / than a mercenary unit...

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_016.en:
(The size of that force...
Just as I thought...)
MsgLabels_station_52_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (The scale of that enemy... as I thought...)

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Let's follow the transmitter at once.)

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_018.en:
New units keep turning up one
after another.
You don't think it's really the USN
attacking us in disguise, do you?
MsgLabels_station_52_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: New units keep appearing / one after another. / It's not actually that the U.S.N. army is / hiding its identity and attacking, / is it?

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_019.en:
Investigator Roy's itching to go
out with you folks, you know.
He volunteered for the action unit
because he wanted fieldwork.
The new stock in the hangar? He
ordered it...
I hear he does test firing in the
Killhouse now and then.
MsgLabels_station_52_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Investigator Roy actually really wants / to sortie with you. / He's someone who volunteered for the action unit / because he wanted to work in the field. / The new products that came into the hangar again / were ordered by the Investigator too, but... / apparently he sometimes does test shooting / in the Kill House.

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_020.en:
Captain «E801:00»...
Don't take this the wrong way, but
I've been looking into your squad
members' pasts.
Looked like the enemy might be
targeting them.
Keep this from the others, would ya?
MsgLabels_station_52_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00»... / sorry if this offends you, but / I'm investigating your squad members' pasts. / There were signs they were being targeted by the enemy. / Keep it secret from the other members, okay?

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_021.en:
Oddeye's transmitter appears to be
heading south from where they
got away.
Our search team is monitoring it.
«E801:00» Squad, track it and
secure Dr. Aisha.
MsgLabels_station_52_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye's transmitter appears to be heading south / from the withdrawal site. / The search team is currently continuing to monitor it. / «E801:00» squad, pursue it / and protect Doctor Aisha.

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_022.en:
Mission understood.
Anything new on the organization?
MsgLabels_station_52_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission understood. / Since then, any leads on the organization?

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_023.en:
This case is guarded more tightly
than I expected.
Other departments appear to be
blocking information on purpose.
MsgLabels_station_52_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This matter is more tightly guarded than I thought. / Other departments also seem to be deliberately / cutting off information.

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As usual, huh...

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_025.en:
Continue the tracking mission.
As you saw in the last battle,
the enemy strikes from nowhere.
Proceed with every caution.
MsgLabels_station_52_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Continue the pursuit mission. / As I think you learned in the last battle, / the enemy appears and disappears at will. / Please carry out the mission with full caution.

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_52_msg_027.en:
Oddeye's transmitter appears to be
heading south from where they
got away.
Our search team is monitoring it.
«E801:00» Squad, track it and
secure Dr. Aisha.
MsgLabels_station_52_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye's transmitter appears to be heading south / from the withdrawal site. / The search team is currently continuing to monitor it. / «E801:00» squad, pursue it / and protect Doctor Aisha.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_001.en:
Captain, Shishi's signal is gone...
Hmm, something's weird...
Maybe she boosted the output so
much the battery died...?
I'm sorry, Captain...
MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, Shishi's signal vanished... / Hmm, something's strange... / Did I raise the output too much and / the transmitter's charge run out...? / Captain, I'm sorry...

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_002.en:
Pin down where we last had the
signal.
MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Pinpoint the position of the last signal.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: X209«g:24» Y360. / 200 meters from here.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Quite close.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_005.en:
...Then we should be able to see it
from here.
MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Then it wouldn't be strange to see it visually.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_006.en:
All units, advance to the last
signal coordinates, combat-ready.
MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units, move to the transmitter's final signal coordinates / in battle readiness.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_008.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_010.en:
These are the last signal
coordinates...
MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: These are the final signal coordinates...

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units, check the surroundings.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No hostile signatures.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_013.en:
No sign of a chopper, no vehicle
tracks either.
MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No helicopter silhouettes or vehicle tracks / either.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The transmitter was... a decoy.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Since when, I wonder...

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed many hostile WAPs.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_017.en:
...All units, weapon safeties off.
Combat stations.
MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...All units, release weapon safeties, / take battle readiness.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_019.en:
Already combat-ready, in this
situation?
All units, be advised.
This is no ordinary unit.
Treat them as superior and
eliminate them.
MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Already in battle readiness in this situation. / Notice to all units. / The enemy is no ordinary unit. / Recognize them as superior and eliminate them.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed all hostile units silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Back to square one...

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_022.en:
They must have planned for the
transmitter.
...That's the kind of unit they are.
MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: They probably anticipated the transmitter. / ...That's the kind of unit the enemy is.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...They seem to be a unit with very high skill.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_024.en:
Aisha's a researcher, so I know
they won't hurt her, but... I don't
know, it feels like she'll break if
someone doesn't protect her...
I'm worried.
MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aisha's a researcher, and even knowing / she's safe, how to say it, / it feels like if I don't protect her she'll break... / I'm worried.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_025.en:
Yeah.
She's the total opposite of you.
MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Right. / The exact opposite of Oddeye.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_026.en:
Whaaat!!
Is that the kind of character
I am!?
MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ehh!! / Is that the kind of character I am!

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_027.en:
Hey, hey, that's a compliment!
You've gotten real tough.
MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hey hey, I'm complimenting you, you know? / You've gotten really tough.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: True.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_029.en:
Well, I am a professional
mercenary, after all...
MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well, I'm a professional mercenary, after all...

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_030.en:
...As long as she's still on
Huffman, we can find her.
We head back and pick apart how
that decoy worked.
MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...As long as she stays on Huffman, / we can find her. / We'll return to base and work out the decoy process.

MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_031.en:
Oh, leave that kind of thing
to me!
MsgLabels_tactics_52_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, leave that kind of thing to me!

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, good morning.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_002.en: Rain, you look short on sleep.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain, you seem short on sleep.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_003.en:
Oh! Does it show?
...I was helping Oddeye, and before
I knew it, it was morning...
I think I dozed off partway through,
but Oddeye kept at it and finished
the analysis.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh! Does it show on my face? / ...I was helping Oddeye / and it became morning... / I seem to have fallen asleep partway, / but Oddeye apparently worked hard and analyzed it.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_004.en:
I see.
Good work.
Get some rest.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / Good work. / Rest a bit.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_005.en:
Thank you.
I'm all right, but since I have
the chance, I'll go grab a shower.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thank you. / I'm fine, but since I have the chance, / I'll go take a shower.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_006.en:
I've just never been the type
who can pull an all-nighter...
Well, I'm off to the shower.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm the type who / can't pull all-nighters... / Well then, I'll go take a shower.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_007.en:
An infiltration op?
Backup, understood.
I'll get ready right away.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: An infiltration operation? / Backup, roger. / I'll get ready right away.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_008.en:
Huh?
The Captain and I are doing
the infiltration?
What to wear, though...
We can't exactly go like this, can we?
What about you, Captain?
A suit?
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? / The Captain and I on an infiltration operation? / Clothing... / It'd be strange as we are, right? / What will you do, Captain? / A suit?

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_009.en:
I don't own anything like a suit...
Ordinary clothes that don't stand out
should do, I think.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I don't happen to have a suit or the like... / I think plain clothes that don't stand out are fine.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_010.en:
R-Right, of course...
Understood. I'll go change.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: R-right... / Roger, I'll go change right away.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Fwaah~... / Good morniiing...

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_012.en:
Oddeye, don't tell me you didn't
sleep at all?
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, don't tell me you didn't sleep?

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_013.en:
Hehehe.
It's for Aisha.
This is nothing!
Rain helped me out, too.
Thanks to her, we cracked it!
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hehehe. / It's for Aisha. / This much is nothing! / I had Miss Rain help too. / Thanks to that, I analyzed it!

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_014.en: An all-nighter for both of you, huh...
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Both pulled all-nighters, huh...

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_015.en:
The theory was simple.
Between the point where the signal
we were receiving started to fluctuate
and the point where the transmitter
went dead -- that's where it might
have been swapped.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The theory was simple. / From the point where the signal caught by the receiver changed, / to the point where the transmitter cut out. / There's a possibility it was swapped in between.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? / Why can you say that?

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_017.en:
That transmitter used a frequency
the military hardly ever uses.
But I think Aisha noticed, and changed
the output so it'd be easier
for us to pick up.
I never showed her how to use it,
but she must've figured it out
right away.
That's what I didn't count on...
No wonder the battery drained so fast.
No matter how much we boosted
the receiver, I figured it wouldn't
put much load on the transmitter,
so I ran a simulation from there.
And when I did that,
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That transmitter used a radio frequency / not often used by the military. / But I think Aisha noticed it / and changed the output so we / could pick it up easily. / I didn't teach her how to use it, but / she probably figured it out right away. / That was my miscalculation... / That's why the power drain was so heavy. / Even if I raised the receiver's output, / I thought it wouldn't burden the transmitter that much, / and simulated from there. / Then,

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_018.en:
Sorry, Oddeye.
I got no idea what you're sayin'.
None. Zero. Nada.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry, Oddeye. / I have no idea / what you're saying.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_019.en:
I get it!
In short, Aisha boosted the
transmitter's output to help us,
the enemy noticed, and they turned it
against us.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see! / Simply put, Aisha meant well and / raised the transmitter's output, the enemy noticed, / and used it against us.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_020.en:
That's almost certainly it.
Oh, Captain, here are
the simulation results.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's probably correct. / Ah, Captain, / these are the simulation results.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_021.en:
Impressive.
I'll take this to Roy right away.
Oddeye, get some rest.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As expected. / Let's take this to Roy right away. / Oddeye, rest a bit.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_022.en:
Okaaay.
Let me know when we're
sortieing~.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Okaaay. / Let me know when the sortie's decided~.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood. / I'm going to headquarters.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_024.en:
Oddeye and Aisha...
Are those two some kinda geniuses?
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye and Aisha... / Could those two be amazing people?

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_025.en:
You only just noticed...?
Though, come on, you're pretty
amazing yourself, Champ...
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You just noticed... / Wait, / Champ, you should be plenty amazing too...

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_026.en:
Nah, I dunno...
Feels like they're miles ahead of me.
Gonna go do some roadwork.
First time in a while...
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, somehow / I feel a huge distance, you know? / I'm going roadwork for the first time in a while...

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_027.en:
Sure.
I'm not coming along, though...
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah. / I won't join you, though...

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_028.en:
Don't sweat it.
I'll run by myself today...
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Don't mind. / Today I'll run alone...

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Why are you so down?

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_030.en: I'm off to do some roadwork!
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm going roadwork!

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_031.en:
Huh?
An infiltration op?
Tearin' it up behind enemy lines?
Sounds like fun!
...Wait, I'm on standby in the rear?
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Huh? / Infiltration operation? / Running wild in enemy territory? / Sounds fun! / Wait, I'm on standby in the rear...

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_032.en:
Coffee after an all-nighter
is the BEST...
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Coffee after an all-nighter is exceptional!

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_033.en:
Whoa!
The Captain and me? Then we need
disguises!
Hmm, what kind of costume would
work best...
What are you wearing, Captain?
I should probably match you,
right?
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ehh! / The Captain and me? Then, a disguise! / Hmm~, what costume would be good... / What outfit will you go in, Captain? / I should match the Captain too, / right?

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_034.en:
I hadn't given it much thought.
Ordinary clothes that don't stand out
should do, I think.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
