Literal: I hadn't particularly thought about it, but / I think plain clothes that don't stand out are fine.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_035.en:
Oh, right, of course.
I almost went full cosplay there...
I'll go change right away!
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, right. / I almost went cosplay... / I'll go change right away!

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_036.en:
An infiltration op?
Roger! Leave the backup to me!
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Infiltration operation? / Roger, leave the backup to me!

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_037.en: Champ, what are you sulking about?
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ, why are you so down?

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_038.en:
An infiltration op?
Understood.
Preparing to sortie.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: An infiltration operation? / Roger. / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_039.en:
(An enemy that swaps out
a transmitter, huh...)
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (An enemy that swaps transmitters...)

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_040.en:
(Ordinary clothes...
All I have are the ones I bought
when I went out with Rain
and Oddeye last time...)
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Plain clothes... / The only ones I have are what I bought when / the three of us, Rain, Oddeye and I, went the other day...)

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_041.en:
Supplies keep pouring into every
OCU base, one after another.
Between you and me, the USN side's
beefing up the same way.
Honestly, it's a powder keg.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Supplies are being sent steadily to / each O.C.U. base. / Between you and me, the U.S.N. side / is being reinforced the same way. / Really, it's a powder keg.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_042.en:
I know it's in poor taste, but
there's a pool going on whether you
get Aisha back.
Naturally, my money's on you
bringing her home.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I know it's inappropriate, but / a bet has started on whether you can rescue / Aisha. / Of course I'm betting on the rescue.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_043.en:
Captain «E801:00», I took the liberty
of digging up your records from
before BATS.
Found out you were in the orphanage
in Smolensk, but before and after
that, it's a total blank...
Ah, no, you don't have to answer
if you don't want to...
Then you came over to the OCU
and went straight into special
forces after the entrance exam...
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00», I searched for your records / from before BATS. / I learned you were at an orphanage in Smolensk, / but before and after that is completely unknown... / Ah, no, if you don't want to answer, that's fine... / And then you crossed to the O.C.U. and / joined special forces right after the enlistment exam...

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_046.en:
Oddeye analyzed how the decoy
switch was done.
This is the data, apparently.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye analyzed the decoy process. / This is apparently the data.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_047.en:
...I see.
So they may have been heading north.
One of my people reports that some
organization appears to be forcibly
gathering skilled medical staff
from the mainland to Huffman.
And it is happening in the area
directly north of the last site.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I see. / So there's a possibility it was heading north. / From my subordinates, I received information / that there's apparently an organization forcibly gathering / excellent medical staff from the home country / to Huffman. / That's in the area exactly north / of the previous site.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_048.en:
It's possible.
But if we're dealing with a medical,
non-combat organization, it'll be hard
for a merc outfit like us to make
contact.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's possible. / But if it's a non-combat medical organization / we're dealing with, it'll be difficult for us mercenaries / to make contact.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_049.en:
Accordingly, we forgo a wanzer
operation this time.
I want you to make contact with
the facility's staff and get
information.
An infiltration operation, in effect.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So this time we'll pass on a WAP operation. / I want you to contact the facility's staff and / get information. / An infiltration operation, so to speak.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_051.en:
On-site intel gathering will be you
and one other.
A female partner should draw less
suspicion.
Take either Oddeye or Rain and try
to approach the medical staff.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: For gathering information on site, the Captain and one more. / A female partner will probably / avoid suspicion. / Try contacting the medical staff with either / Oddeye or Rain.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: In that case...

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_053.en:
I see.
She is certainly suited to the task.
This is not a wanzer operation, but as
a precaution, it would be best to keep
the other three on standby in wanzers.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / She certainly is suited to the mission. / This time it's not a WAP operation, but / just in case it'd be better to have the 3 / stand by in WAPs.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_055.en:
This is not a wanzer operation, but as
a precaution, it would be best to keep
the other three on standby in wanzers.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This time it's not a WAP operation, but / just in case it'd be better to have the 3 / stand by in WAPs.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_056.en:
Oddeye analyzed how the decoy
switch was done.
This is the data, apparently.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye analyzed the decoy process. / This is apparently the data.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_057.en:
...I see.
So they may have been heading north.
One of my people reports that some
organization appears to be forcibly
gathering skilled medical staff
from the mainland to Huffman.
And it is happening in the area
directly north of the last site.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I see. / So there's a possibility it was heading north. / From my subordinates, I received information / that there's apparently an organization forcibly gathering / excellent medical staff from the home country / to Huffman. / That's in the area exactly north / of the previous site.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_058.en:
It's possible.
But if we're dealing with a medical,
non-combat organization, it'll be hard
for a merc outfit like us to make
contact.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's possible. / But if it's a non-combat medical organization / we're dealing with, it'll be difficult for us mercenaries / to make contact.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_059.en:
Accordingly, we forgo a wanzer
operation this time.
I want you to make contact with
the facility's staff and get
information.
An infiltration operation, in effect.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So this time we'll pass on a WAP operation. I want you to contact the facility's staff and / get information. / An infiltration operation, so to speak.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_061.en:
This is not a wanzer operation, but
as a precaution, keep Champ, Gray and
Oddeye on standby in their wanzers.
You and Rain will try to approach
the medical staff.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This time it's not a WAP operation, but / just in case, have the 3, Champ, Gray and Oddeye, / stand by in WAPs, and the 2, the Captain / and Rain, try contacting / the medical staff.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_062.en:
And if the enemy gets wind of us,
a fight may be unavoidable.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If the enemy notices us, / is fighting unavoidable?

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_063.en:
You should be quite capable in
combat on foot as well.
But if wanzers are involved, I would
like those three standing by.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You should be good at fighting people too. / But if the opponent is WAPs, / I want the 3 on standby.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Roger. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_53_msg_065.en:
This is not a wanzer operation, but as
a precaution, keep Champ, Gray and
Oddeye on standby in their wanzers.
You and Rain will try to approach
the facility's staff.
MsgLabels_station_53_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This time it's not a WAP operation, but / just in case, have the 3, Champ, Gray and Oddeye, / stand by in WAPs, and the 2, the Captain / and Rain, try contacting / the facility's staff.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_001.en: So that building is the facility.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is that building the facility?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_002.en: My first mission in plain clothes!
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission in plain clothes is a first!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_003.en:
Looking at you two like this,
neither of you seems like a merc.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Looking at you like this, neither of you seems like a mercenary.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_004.en:
Ah, so that's why it's the Captain
and Oddeye.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see, so that's why it's the Captain / and Oddeye.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hehehe!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_006.en:
Oh, honestly, Captain! You too, Oddeye!
Leave your holsters behind!
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, geez, Captain! Oddeye too! / Leave your holsters behind!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_007.en:
Hahaha. She's right, you'd be made
in a second if you were armed.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hahaha, true, / if you're armed you'll be found out.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Is a knife a problem?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_010.en:
Sneakin' into enemy turf bare-handed...
I wanna try that!
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Infiltrating enemy territory bare-handed... / I want to try it too!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ, your face is known, right!?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Kuuh, being famous is tough...

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_013.en:
I don't expect a fight, but just
in case, keep our wanzers ready
to start up at a moment's notice.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I don't think it'll come to a fight, but just in case, / prepare our WAPs so they can / start right away too.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger, leave it to me.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Captain, a figure.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good, starting the mission.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_017.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hellooo.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hm? Sightseeing?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Something like that.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Captain... more natural, natural!)

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_023.en:
(Easy for you to say...
This IS natural...)
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Even if you say that... this is natural...)

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_025.en:
This isn't really a place for
sightseeing, you know.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This isn't a place for sightseeing.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_026.en:
Is it a hospital or something?
It's such a nice, clean building.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is it a hospital or something? / It's quite a beautiful building.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_027.en:
Hospital, well...
More like a medical research facility.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A hospital, or rather... / it's a facility doing medical research.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh, I see~.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_029.en:
I'm not anyone suspicious, but there's
something I'd like to ask.
Have there been any disappearances
recently, or more people coming
and going than usual...
or anything?
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We're not suspicious people, but / there's something I want to ask. / Recently, have people gone missing, / or have more people been coming and going... / anything like that?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (C-Captain! You're awkward!)

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (...Don't mind it.)

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_032.en:
Hmm?
Haven't heard anything about anyone
going missing, but...
who are you two, anyway?
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm? / I haven't heard about anyone missing, but / who are you people?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Just passersby.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (...This is... bad...)

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_035.en:
Pretty suspicious.
Why don't you come inside with me
for a bit?
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Suspicious. / Shall I have you come inside for a bit?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_036.en:
Oh, ah, um!
He's not used to the language here!
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh, ah! / This person isn't used to the language.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Hmm. Really sightseeing?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (...Captain, what language can you speak?)

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_039.en:
(...Russian. Or languages from
around the Middle East.)
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (...Russian, or Middle Eastern languages.)

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: "...Russian, roger." / (in Russian)

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: "Hoh, quite good pronunciation." / (in Russian)

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: "Ooh! The Captain is amazing too!" / (in Russian)

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_043.en:
Huh? What language is that...?
Ah, so that's why he sounds so stiff.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Huh? What language is that... / I see, so that's why he's awkward.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_044.en:
Yes, that's right, that's it!
The thing is, we think a friend
of ours might be working here,
so we've been going around all kinds
of medical facilities looking.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, yes, that's right! / Actually, we think our friend might be / working at this facility, / so we're walking around searching various medical facilities.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_045.en: We haven't been able to reach them.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We can't get in touch.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_046.en:
Ah, in that case, maybe it's
B-Block, 10 km further on?
The cleaner was saying B-Block took
on a few dozen new staff lately.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, if that's it, / maybe it's Building B, 10 km ahead? / The cleaner said Building B recently / got dozens more staff.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_047.en:
...Three unidentified wanzers intruding.
...Guard A, report to your post.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...3 WAPs of unknown affiliation intruding. / ...Guard A to assigned position.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_048.en:
Enemies, out here?
You'd better come inside too, miss.
There might be shooting.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemies in a place like this? / You young ladies come inside too. / A battle may start.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_049.en:
That won't be necessary.
We'll be on our way.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No need. / We'll take our leave.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, really, it's dangerous.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_051.en:
Oh, we'll be fine, honest.
Bye-bye, Mr. Guard A~!
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, we're really fine. / See you again, Mr. Guard A~!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_052.en:
Hey, wait! Hello!?
...What's with those two?
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hey, heeey! / ...What's with them? / Those two.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain, Champ, Gray, situation?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_054.en:
Captain, this place is bad news.
They've got a crazy number
of sensors set up.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, this facility is dangerous. / An insane number of sensors / are installed.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry... / We were careless.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_056.en:
Roger.
We've got useful intel on our end.
Rejoining you now.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / We've also obtained useful information. / Joining up right away.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Number of enemies?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 8 security WAPs.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_060.en: All right. We fight our way out.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good, we'll withdraw while returning fire.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed all enemy units silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...As I thought, WAP missions / are easier.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_064.en:
Honestly, Captain, my heart nearly
jumped out of my mouth back there...
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Geez, thanks to the Captain, my heart / almost came out of my mouth...

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_065.en:
We could hear the audio over here,
too, you know...
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We were hearing the audio over here too...

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_066.en: Rain, you're laughing way too hard.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Miss Rain, you're laughing too much.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_067.en: And we got spotted on top of it!
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_067.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: And in the end we got found!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_068.en:
Well...
But if there's a next time, Captain,
you're minding the wanzers...
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_068.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But... / If there's a next time, the Captain stays / home in the WAP...

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_069.en:
Sorry... Please let me...
Mission complete.
Returning to base.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_069.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry... let me do that... / The mission is complete. / Returning to base.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_1_msg_070.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger...

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_001.en: So that building is the facility.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is that building the facility?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_002.en:
Captain, with that shirt, it looks more
natural with the top buttons undone.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, with those clothes, it's more natural / to leave the top buttons undone.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_003.en:
I see. It's easier on the neck,
too.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see, this way my neck certainly / isn't as tight.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_004.en:
Oh, honestly, Captain...
Please don't hide a holster or a knife
on you...
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, geez, Captain... / please don't carry hidden / holsters and knives...

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_005.en:
Hmm~.
Looking at you two like this,
you're just like newlyweds!
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm~. / Looking at you like this, you two look like newlyweds!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_006.en:
Now that you mention it, I guess
they could pass for that.
But something's a little stiff...
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Now that you mention it, they kind of look that way. / But there's something awkward, or...

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_007.en:
For a couple, they're actin' like
strangers.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: For a couple, / they're kind of distant.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_008.en:
It does look unnatural.
We need to stage it a bit more...
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It definitely is unnatural. / We need to stage it more...

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye, staging...

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_010.en:
Oh, try linking arms!
That'll look more natural!
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, try linking arms! / That's more natural!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_011.en:
W-Wait, there's no need
to go that far...
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hey, there's no need to go that far...

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_012.en:
Rain, this is an infiltration mission.
Failure is not an option!
Rain, please link arms
with the Captain!
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Miss Rain, this is an infiltration mission. / Failure is not allowed! / Miss Rain, try linking arms / with the Captain!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain, link arms with me.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh, ah, yes!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_015.en:
Mm-hm, very natural!
Nobody will suspect a thing now!
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, yes, natural! / That way I don't think you'll be suspected!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_016.en:
I don't expect a fight, but just
in case, keep our wanzers ready
to start up at a moment's notice.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I don't think it'll come to a fight, but just in case, / prepare our WAPs so they can / start right away too.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good, starting the mission.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Y-yes, roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_020.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_022.en: Guard A doesn't seem to be here.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Guard A doesn't seem to be here.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Y-yes... no figures confirmed.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_024.en:
Rain, can't you walk a little
more naturally?
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain, can't you walk a bit more naturally?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_025.en:
Oh, sorry.
Captain... you walk awfully fast.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, sorry. / Captain... you walk really fast.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_026.en:
...I see. You were having trouble
keeping up.
In enemy territory, I can't help it.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I see, it seems it was hard to walk. / When I think it's enemy territory, I can't help it.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_027.en:
It's all right.
I'll try to match your pace.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's fine. / I'll try matching your pace.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_028.en:
There's a guard post over there.
There may be something useful.
Let's slip inside.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There's a guard station there. / There may be some clue. / Let's infiltrate it.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_030.en:
...Nothing of note here.
Rain, anything on your side?
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...There doesn't seem to be anything in particular. / Rain, how about over there?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_031.en:
...A map of the facility, maybe?
...B-Block extension work?
What a big building...
And it's already finished.
Capt-- Mmph.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...A map of the facility? / ...Building B expansion construction? / Quite a big building... / The construction is already completed. / Capt... mmph.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Quiet... the guard seems to have come back.)

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Mm, mmm...)

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_034.en:
Seriously, who adds over thirty staff
all of a sudden?
Think about us poor saps on patrol.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Geez, don't suddenly add / more than 30 staff. / Think about the people doing patrols.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (More than 30 staff...?)

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_036.en:
...Three unidentified wanzers intruding.
...Guard A, report to your post.
...I repeat...
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...3 WAPs of unknown affiliation intruding. / ...Guard A to assigned position. / ...Repeat...

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_037.en:
Why would enemies come all the way
out here?
...Everybody's out to make trouble,
I swear.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Why would enemies come to a place like this? / ...Everyone's always causing a fuss, / honestly.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (...Mm, mmm.)

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_039.en:
...Sorry, Rain.
I covered your mouth on reflex.
Could you breathe?
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Sorry, Rain, / I covered your mouth by reflex. / Wasn't it hard to breathe?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_040.en:
Oh, no, I'm fine.
Just a little startled...
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, no, I'm fine. / I was a little surprised, but...

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_041.en:
Guard A seems to have gone off
somewhere.
...Rain?
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Guard A seems to have gone somewhere. / ...Rain?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_042.en:
...Huh? Yes.
Oh, were Champ and the others
spotted?
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Eh? Yes. / Ah, did Champ and the others / get found?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_043.en:
Looks that way.
Heading to the rendezvous point.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems so. / Heading to the rendezvous point.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ, Oddeye, Gray, / situation?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_045.en:
Captain, there are dozens of sensors
set up around this facility!
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, around this facility / dozens of sensors are installed!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_046.en:
Sorry, everybody.
I went and tripped one...
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry, everyone. / I carelessly got caught...

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_047.en:
Roger.
We've got useful intel on our end.
Rejoining you now.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / We've also obtained useful information. / Joining up right away.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Number of enemies?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Yes, 8 security WAPs.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_051.en: All right. We fight our way out.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good, we'll withdraw while returning fire.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Confirmed all enemy units silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_054.en:
...Being in a wanzer really does
feel more right.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...As I thought, being in a WAP / feels right.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_055.en:
Hm?
Rain, your face is red.
Got a fever or something?
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh? / Miss Rain, your face is red, / do you have a fever?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? That's not it...

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_057.en:
Oh my, Rain, are you catching a cold?
When we get back, you should drink
some warm eggnog and go to bed.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh, Miss Rain, a cold? / When we get back to base, you'd better drink / some milk egg-sake and sleep, you know?

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_058.en:
Ugh, what the heck kinda drink
is that...
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ugh, what kind of drink is that...

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_059.en:
Huh, you don't know it?
It works wonders on a cold.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh, you don't know? / It's a drink that works well for colds.

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Geez, I'm fine...

MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_061.en:
I see. Don't push yourself.
Mission complete.
Returning to base.
MsgLabels_tactics_53_2_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see, don't push yourself. / The mission is complete. / Returning to base.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_001.en:
I've reported the intel from the
infiltration mission to Investigator
Roy.
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I reported the information obtained in the infiltration mission / the other day to Investigator Roy.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good work.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_003.en:
My heart was pounding the whole
time back there...
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: My heart was really pounding then...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_004.en:
Sounds like Oddeye's quick thinking
kept them from getting suspicious...
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thanks to Oddeye's quick thinking, it seems we / avoided suspicion...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_005.en:
Sorry about that...
It seems I have no talent for acting...
If there's a next time, I'd like you
and Oddeye to handle it, Rain...
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry... / I don't seem to have any talent for acting... / If there's a next time, try carrying it out / with Rain and Oddeye...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_006.en:
Two ladies on their own? Sounds
risky. I'll throw on a disguise and
tag along.
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Two women alone would be uneasy. / I'll disguise myself or something and go.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_007.en:
Uh, Champ, even in disguise, your
build would give you away.
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Nah, Champ, even disguised I think your build / would make them suspicious.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_008.en:
True... You don't see many ordinary
people with that many muscles.
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right... there aren't many / ordinary people that muscular.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_009.en:
Dammit, guess I trained a little
too hard...
So Gray and Oddeye are the right
picks, then...
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Kuh, maybe I trained a bit too much... / Then Gray and Oddeye are suited, I guess...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_010.en:
But maybe it was exactly because it
was the Captain and Oddeye that they
got the intel.
I'm not sure I could've pulled it
off that well...
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But it may be precisely because it was the Captain and Oddeye / combo that they got the information. / Whether I could have made it / that successful...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_011.en:
I suppose that's one way of looking
at it...
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: True, there's that view too...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_012.en:
Hmm~, then, Captain, if there's a
next time, let's go together again!
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmm~, then Captain, / if there's a next time, let's go again!

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_013.en:
I-I see...
Then I'd better practice my acting...
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I-I see... / Then I must practice acting...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Practice acting...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The Captain practicing acting...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_016.en:
So Aisha's location has been
confirmed.
Understood. Preparing to sortie.
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aisha's location has been found. / Roger. I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_017.en:
Guess I trained a little too hard
for infiltration missions...
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: To take part in infiltration missions, / maybe I trained a bit too much...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_018.en:
Oh? Teaming up with that other
detachment from back then?
Wonder what they're like.
I'll get ready right away!
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hoh, together with that separate unit from before. / I wonder what kind of guys they are. / I'll get ready at once!

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_019.en:
Captain, if you're going to practice
acting, I'll help!
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, if you're practicing acting, / I'll help!

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_020.en:
You found out where Aisha is!
I'll get ready right away!
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You found where Aisha is! / I'll get ready right away!

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_021.en:
I'm not much of an actor myself,
honestly.
Captain, if there's a next time,
good luck...
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm not that good at acting / either. / Captain, if there's a next time, do your best...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_022.en:
Phew... A wanzer battle.
Understood.
This is a lot easier, isn't it?
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Phew... a WAP battle. / Roger. / This is easier, right?

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_023.en:
The other day, when I was coming
down with something, Oddeye made me
this thing called a milk egg toddy...
That stuff was dangerous...
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The other day when I was a bit under the weather, / Oddeye made me something called / milk egg-sake, but... / that was dangerous...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_024.en:
Go get Aisha back, okay?
I've got 2000 H$ riding on it.
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Do your best rescuing Aisha. / My 2000 H$ is riding on it.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_025.en:
I looked into everyone else's past,
too. Nothing in particular that would
make them targets...
But there are signs you were all
brought together on purpose.
You, Oddeye and Champ especially were
all headed for other merc bases, and
it got changed at the last minute.
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I investigated the pasts of members other than you too, but / there was no particular reason / for the enemy to target them... / However, there are traces that you were / deliberately gathered. / Especially you, Oddeye, and Champ: / you were about to be sent to another mercenary base, / and it was changed just before.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_026.en:
I've reported the intel from the
infiltration mission to Investigator
Roy.
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I reported the information obtained in the infiltration mission / the other day to Investigator Roy.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_027.en:
Good work.
Are you feeling all right?
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good work. / Are you feeling alright?

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_028.en:
Oh, um, I'm fine.
I was just tense about a lot
of things back there...
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh, ah, I'm fine. / I was nervous about various things then...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_029.en:
The audio cut out on us. Did
something happen in the guard post?
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The audio didn't reach us, but / did something happen at the guard station?

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_030.en:
Yes.
Guard A came near while we were
searching, so we kept quiet.
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / While searching, Guard A approached, / and we both held our breath.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_031.en:
...Ah, yes.
If we'd been found then, who knows
what would have happened...
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Ah, yes. / If we'd been found then, / who knows what would have happened...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_032.en:
You were arm in arm like a real
couple, and then you went sneaking
around the guard post!
In that situation, you'd probably
have been safer just chatting
with Guard A.
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even though you linked arms and looked like a couple, / you snuck around investigating / in the guard station! / In that situation, if you'd just talked / to Guard A, it might have been safe, / you know.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah! / That may be true...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_034.en:
Well, with the Captain and Rain,
maybe that was bound to happen.
They'd both get so focused on the
mission, acting would go right out
the window...
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well, for the Captain and Miss Rain, / that may have been inevitable. / I think both would focus on the mission / and have no room for acting...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_035.en:
True. Putting on an act never even
occurred to me...
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: True, the option of putting on / an act didn't come to mind...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_036.en:
But it worked out great in the end,
right?
Next chance you get, maybe you two
should practice your acting.
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But in the end it was a big success, right? / Next chance, both Rain and the Captain / might do well to practice acting.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_037.en:
Acting practice... I love it!
Good luck, you two!
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Acting practice... sounds good! / Do your best, both of you!

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I-I see...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Practice acting...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_040.en:
Captain, shall we practice acting
sometime...?
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, shall we practice acting sometime...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_041.en:
So Aisha's location has been
confirmed.
Understood. Preparing to sortie.
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aisha's location has been found. / Roger. / I'll prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_042.en: I'm no good at acting either...
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm bad at acting too...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_043.en:
Oh? Teaming up with that other
detachment from back then?
Wonder what they're like.
I'll get ready right away!
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hoh, together with that separate unit from before. / I wonder what kind of guys they are. / I'll get ready at once!

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_044.en:
Captain, if you're going to practice
acting, I'll help!
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, if you're practicing acting, / I'll help!

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_045.en:
You found out where Aisha is!
I'll get ready right away!
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You found where Aisha is! / I'll get ready right away!

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_046.en:
I'm not much of an actor myself,
honestly.
Captain, if there's a next time,
good luck...
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm not that good at acting / either. / Captain, if there's a next time, do your best...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_047.en:
Phew... A wanzer battle.
Understood.
This is a lot easier, isn't it?
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Phew... a WAP battle. / Roger. / This is easier, right?

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_048.en:
The other day, when I was coming
down with something, Oddeye made me
this thing called a milk egg toddy...
That stuff was dangerous...
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The other day when I was a bit under the weather, / Oddeye made me something called / milk egg-sake, but... / that was dangerous...

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_049.en:
Go get Aisha back, okay?
This time a fancy hotel buffet's
on the line.
Huh?«g:24» Okay, okay.
If I win, I'll make sure to bring
some back for you guys.
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Do your best rescuing Aisha. / This time a luxury hotel buffet / is riding on it. / Eh?«g:24» Ah, got it. / If I win, I'll definitely / bring back your share.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_050.en:
I looked into everyone else's past,
too. Nothing in particular that would
make them targets...
But there are signs you were all
brought together on purpose.
You, Oddeye and Champ especially were
all headed for other merc bases, and
it got changed at the last minute.
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I investigated the pasts of members other than you too, but / there was no particular reason / for the enemy to target them... / However, there are traces that you were / deliberately gathered. / Especially you, Oddeye, and Champ: / you were about to be sent to another mercenary base, / and it was changed just before.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_051.en:
Thanks to you, we were able to
pinpoint Dr. Aisha's location.
I had my people confirm it just now.
There is no mistake.
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thanks to you, we were able to pinpoint / Doctor Aisha's location. / I had my subordinates confirm it a bit ago, / and it seems correct.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_052.en:
But a facility like that is bound
to have that unit stationed there,
too.
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But if it's that kind of facility, / we can assume that unit / is deployed there too.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_053.en:
Hostile forces have been confirmed
on the same scale as at Grayrock,
or larger.
As a countermeasure, I have placed
people I trust as much as you
in hiding nearby.
They will launch the assault; while
they do, «E801:00» Squad is to make
Dr. Aisha's safety the priority.
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hostile forces have been confirmed deployed / on the same scale as Greylock before, / or larger. / As a countermeasure, I've placed people / as trustworthy as you undercover. / I'll have them assault, and in that opening, / the «E801:00» squad should prioritize / protecting Doctor Aisha.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_054.en:
Understood.
I'd rather not shoot down the assault
team by mistake.
Give me the details.
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I've grasped the operation details. / I don't want to mistakenly shoot down the assault unit. / Tell me the details.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_055.en:
If I tell you it is the unit that
once took down a Vampire base, will
you trust their skills?
I'll have their IFF signals sent
to your wanzers.
There should be no friendly fire.
Get Dr. Aisha back, whatever
it takes.
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If I say it's the unit that took down / a Vampires base before, / will you trust their skill? / I'll have their unit identification signals transferred / to your WAPs. / There should be no friendly fire. / Retrieve Doctor Aisha / no matter what.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_056.en:
The unit that took down the base...
The other detachment from the
Anti-Vampire Operation.
...I see.
Preparing to sortie.
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The unit that took down a base... / the separate unit from the anti-Vampires operation. / ...I see. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_54_msg_057.en:
Hostile forces have been confirmed
on the same scale as at Grayrock,
or larger.
As a countermeasure, I have placed
people I trust as much as you
in hiding nearby.
They will launch the assault; while
they do, «E801:00» Squad is to make
Dr. Aisha's safety the priority.
MsgLabels_station_54_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hostile forces have been confirmed deployed / on the same scale as Greylock before, / or larger. / As a countermeasure, I've placed people / as trustworthy as you undercover. / I'll have them assault, and in that opening, / the «E801:00» squad should prioritize / protecting Doctor Aisha.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_001.en:
Captain, incoming transmission from
the assault team.
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, a transmission from the assault unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_002.en:
This is Chariot 1.
Captain «E801:00», it's been a while.
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is Chariot 1. / Captain «E801:00», long time no see.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Chariot 1. / We meet again. / Tornado.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Tornado-kun!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_005.en:
Good to see you're well, Oddeye.
I'm sorry, there's a lot to catch up
on, but let me brief you first.
We'll hit the facility's guard force
and draw out the main body.
«E801:00» Squad, prioritize securing
the target.
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Miss Oddeye, you look well too. / Sorry, there's a lot to catch up on, but / I'll explain the operation right away. / We'll assault the facility security unit / and lure out the main body. / «E801:00» squad, prioritize / securing the target.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_006.en:
Understood.
Chariot 1, the enemy unit is made up
of new models.
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Operation understood. / Chariot 1, / the enemy is a unit composed of new models.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_007.en:
Yes.
I've seen «E801:00» Squad's combat
data.
Their machines perform at Numbers
level, but their pilots seem
to be a step below.
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / I saw the «E801:00» squad's / combat data. / The enemy units' performance is Numbers class, but / the pilots' level seems / lower than that.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_008.en:
I see.
If you understand that, no problem.
«E801:00» Squad, ready.
We'll time our move to Chariot Squad.
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / If you understand that, no problem. / «E801:00» squad, ready. / We'll match our timing to the Chariot squad.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_009.en:
Roger. Starting the count.
...5, 4... 3, 2, 1...
Operation start.
Napalm, open fire!
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. Starting the count. / ...5, 4... 3, 2, 1... / Operation start. / Napalm, begin bombardment!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_010.en:
Victory: Rescue Aisha.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit or the wanzer
carrying Aisha destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: rescue Aisha. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down or / the WAP carrying Aisha shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_012.en:
B-Block defense unit here.
We're under attack by unidentified
hostiles!
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is Building B garrison. / We're under attack by / unidentified hostile forces!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_013.en:
Copy.
Diverting all facility defense forces.
Attention, Guard A.
Guide the researchers to the shelter.
I repeat...
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Diverting the forces of all facility defense units. / To Guard A. / Guide the researchers to the shelter. / Repeat...

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_014.en:
Transferred to B-Block, and right
away we get attacked...
Unbelievable...
Just my luck...
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Assigned to Building B and immediately an enemy attack... / Geez... / I'm so unlucky...

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_015.en:
All facility forces are out.
All Chariot units, intercept.
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All of the facility's forces have appeared. / All Chariot squad units, intercept.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_016.en:
Sure enough, there's a ton of 'em.
Tornado, need a hand?
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There really are a lot. / Tornado, need help?

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_017.en:
Champ?
We'll manage on our own.
How are things on your end?
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ, huh. / We'll manage on our own. / How's it going on your side?

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_018.en:
Still lookin'...
Sorry, gonna take a little longer.
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We're searching, but... / sorry, it looks like it'll take a bit longer.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_019.en:
Roger.
Chariot Squad, we buy them time.
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Chariot squad, we'll somehow buy time.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_020.en:
Attention, Guard A.
Guide the researchers to the shelter.
I repeat...
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: To Guard A. / Guide the researchers to the shelter. / Repeat...

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...What's happening?

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_022.en:
Looks like a hostile wanzer unit is
attacking this place.
I'll escort you, Doctor.
Honestly, trouble on my first day
after the transfer...
Ah, hey, Doctor!
Where are you going!?
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A hostile WAP unit seems to be / assaulting this place. / I'll escort you, Doctor. / Geez, an incident on the first day / I'm transferred here... / Ah, hey, Doctor! / Where are you going!?

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_023.en:
Wanzers...
Those silhouettes...
(Everyone... you came for me...)
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Vanzers... / Those silhouettes... / (Everyone came...)

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_024.en:
Doctor!
You can't go outside!
The shelter's this way!
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Doctor! / You can't go outside! / The shelter is this way!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_025.en:
My colleagues are still in
the facility.
I can't leave them behind.
I'll find them and evacuate together.
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: My colleagues are still in the facility. / I can't abandon them. / I'll join them and evacuate.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_026.en:
Huh?
The word I got was that you were
the only one left, Doctor.
Let's hurry to the shelter.
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? / The report said only you were left, Doctor. / Let's hurry to the shelter.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_027.en:
Did you confirm that yourself?
In all this chaos, can you say for
certain that information is correct?
Can you guarantee their lives?
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Did you confirm it? / In this chaotic situation, can you assert / that information is correct? / Can you guarantee human lives?

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_028.en:
Ah, well, orders are orders...
But if lives are at stake...
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, no, it's an order, so... / But, human lives...

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_029.en:
In your position, orders may be
absolute.
But not all information is
necessarily correct.
Sometimes, saving lives on your own
judgement on the ground is the
right thing to do.
...Give me five minutes.
I'll check the facility, and if there
are survivors, I'll lead them out.
Meanwhile, report the situation
to command.
If I don't come back, call for help.
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: In your position, orders may be / absolute. / But not all information / is correct. / Sometimes, by judgment on the spot, saving lives / is justice. / ...Give me 5 minutes. / I'll check the facility, and if there are survivors, / I'll guide them. / Meanwhile, report the situation to headquarters. / If I don't come back, / call for people.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_030.en:
Huh? Ah, yes ma'am!
...Ah, but it's dangerous on your own!
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? Ah, yes! / ...Ah, but alone is dangerous!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_031.en:
I'll be fine.
Bye-bye, Mr. Guard~.
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll be fine. / See you, Mr. Guard~.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_032.en:
Right, be careful!
Yeah, that's right.
The Doctor's got a point!
The guys upstairs never know what's
really going on down here anyway.
Wow, I feel like I just did
a good deed!
Now, time to report, report!
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, take care! / That's right. / Just as the Doctor says! / The people on top don't understand / the details on site anyway. / Wow, I feel like I did something good! / Now, report, report!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...A transmitter signal? / Captain! It's from Aisha!!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_034.en:
Roger.
Can you get a location?
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Do you know the position?

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_035.en:
Yes!
Sending the transmitter's position
to all wanzers.
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes! / Transferring the transmitter point / to each WAP.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_036.en:
Roger.
All units, head for that point.
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / All units, head to that point.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aisha! / Get in quickly!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Miss Rain, thank you!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, I've secured Aisha.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_040.en:
Roger.
Rain, head for the extraction point.
All units, cover Rain.
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Rain's unit, head to the escape point. / All units, support Rain's unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aisha! / Come on, get in!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ? / You saved me!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, I've secured Aisha!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_044.en:
Roger.
Champ, head for the extraction point.
All units, cover Champ.
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Champ's unit, head to the escape point. / All units, support Champ's unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aisha! Get in quickly!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye!! / Thank you! You saved me!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, I've secured Aisha!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_048.en:
Roger.
Oddeye, head for the extraction point.
All units, cover Oddeye.
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Oddeye's unit, head to the escape point. / All units, support Oddeye's unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aisha! / Get in quickly!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_050.en:
Gray, is that you?
Thank goodness!
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gray, right? / You saved me!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, I've secured Aisha.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_052.en:
Roger.
Gray, head for the extraction point.
All units, cover Gray.
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Gray's unit, head to the escape point. / All units, support Gray's unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aisha, over here.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00»! / Thank you!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_055.en:
Aisha secured.
Making for the extraction point now.
All units, cover me.
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I've secured Aisha. / Rushing to the escape point now. / All units, cover me.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As expected of the Captain! / Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_057.en:
«E801:00» Squad, as expected.
Chariot Squad, draw the enemy off.
Buy them time to get clear!
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As expected of the «E801:00» squad. / Chariot squad, draw the enemy units. / Buy time until they escape!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aisha's carrier unit escaped successfully!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_059.en:
Roger. Chariot Squad, thanks for
the assist.
All units, withdraw.
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger, Chariot squad, thanks for your cooperation. / All units withdraw.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_060.en:
Roger, withdrawing.
Captain «E801:00», I'll drop by
the base sometime.
We can talk then.
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger, withdrawing. / Captain «E801:00», I'll stop by / your base sometime. / We can talk then.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aisha, are you hurt?

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thanks to you, I'm fine.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_063.en:
Aisha, we'll keep you under
protection at the base for a while.
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aisha, we'll keep you in protective custody / at the base for a while.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_064.en: Yes. Thank you for having me.
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, I'm in your care.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A direct hit!? / Captain...!! / Kyaaaaah!!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_066.en:
Dammit...
Aisha... Rain...
I couldn't protect them...
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Damn... / Aisha... Rain... / I couldn't protect them...

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_067.en:
Tch, I let my guard down!?
But... at least Aisha...!!
Nwaaaargh!!
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_067.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Tch, we got careless!! / But... at least Aisha!! / Nwaaaah!!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_068.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Damn... / Aisha... Champ!!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_069.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah!? / Aisha, Captain...!!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_070.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Damn... / Aisha... Oddeye!!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_071.en:
Ngh, I'm hit...
Aisha, get out, hurry!!
Waaaaah!!
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_071.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Kuh, I'm hit... / Aisha, hurry and escape!! / Uwaaaah!!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_072.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Damn... / Aisha... Gray!!

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_073.en:
I'm hit...
Heavy damage.
Aisha, get out of here.
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_073.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hit... / Heavy damage. / Aisha, escape.

MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_074.en:
N-No... Captain!!
Aisha!!
This can't be...
Noooooo!!
MsgLabels_tactics_54_msg_074.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: N-no way... Captain!! / Aisha!! / That can't... / Noooooo!!

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's good that Aisha was safe.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_002.en:
Impressive that she got out of the
facility in that situation.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: She did well to get out of the facility / in that situation.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_003.en:
Will this set back Organization B's
research, do you think?
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Will this interfere with Organization B's / research too?

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_004.en:
Aisha is a key figure to
Organization B.
Until they find someone to replace
her, their research will stall.
I'd like to corner them while we can.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aisha is an important person to Organization B. / Until they find someone / to replace her, the research will probably stop. / I'd like to corner the enemy while we can.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_005.en:
Time to corner Organization B...
I wonder how much of a margin
we've bought...
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Time to corner Organization B... / How much leeway did we gain...

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_006.en:
Time to corner Organization B...
I wonder how much of a margin
we've bought...
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Time to corner Organization B... / How much leeway did we gain...

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_007.en:
Sounds like we've found a lead.
Understood.
I'll go prepare to sortie.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A lead seems to have been found. / Roger. / I'll go prepare to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_008.en:
Still, that friendly unit sure
was reliable.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Still, that friendly unit / was reliable.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_009.en:
Yeah, Chariot Squad, they said.
And Tornado.
That kid's toughened up a lot.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah, they said Chariot squad. / Tornado. / He's gotten a lot tougher too.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_010.en:
Sounds like you and Oddeye
knew him, Champ.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ and Oddeye seem to / have known him.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_011.en:
Yeah, we all signed on as mercs
at the same time, kinda.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well, we're mercenary classmates, so to speak.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_012.en:
Apparently they're the ones who took
down the Vampire base.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: They're apparently the ones who took down / a Vampires base.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_013.en:
I see.
So they were the other detachment.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / So the separate unit was them.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_014.en:
Chariot Squad is well known, even
among the regulars.
Their captain came to scout in
person, and that's when Tornado's
posting was decided.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The Chariot squad is a well-known unit / even among friendly forces. / Their captain came to inspect in person, and at that time / Tornado's assignment was decided.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_015.en:
Way things went, could've been me
that ended up in Chariot.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Depending on how things went, I might've been / assigned to Chariot.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_016.en:
No. Chariot was looking for an
Assault back then.
I believe you and Oddeye were already
out of the running.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, at that time Chariot / seemed to be looking for an assault type. / I think Champ and Oddeye had already / been dropped from selection.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_017.en:
I see.
Still, after fighting side by side,
I'd like to meet the rest of
Chariot Squad.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / But as comrades we fought alongside, / I'd like to meet Chariot's / other members too.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_018.en:
Yeah.
I'd love to knock back a drink
with those guys.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / I'd like to have a drink with them.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_019.en:
Chariot is apparently one of the
units under Roy now.
We'll get the chance sooner or later.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Chariot has apparently become one / of the units under Roy's jurisdiction. / There'll be a chance eventually.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_020.en:
Someday I wanna knock back a drink
with those guys.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Someday I'd like to have a drink with them.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_021.en: Let's go smash Organization B, too!
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Let's go crush Organization B too!

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_022.en:
I'd like to meet the rest of
Chariot Squad.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'd like to meet Chariot's / other members too.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_023.en:
We've finally got a lead.
I'll get ready to sortie right away.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We finally got a lead. / I'll prepare to sortie right away.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_024.en:
The investigator gave me permission
to come into the barracks.
Captain, thank you for rescuing me.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I got permission from the Investigator / to enter the station. / Captain, thank you for the rescue.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_025.en:
You did well to get out of
the facility.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You did well to get out of the facility.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_026.en:
It was thanks to all of you bringing
chaos to the facility.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It was thanks to everyone / who brought chaos to the facility.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_027.en:
Chaos...
I don't quite get it, but
I'm glad...
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Chaos... / I don't really get it, but / I'm glad...

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_028.en:
And thanks to little Shishi,
from Oddeye.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: And thanks to Shishi, / whom Oddeye gave me.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_029.en:
Oh, Aisha, you figured out the
transmitter! Nice going!
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, Aisha, / you figured out the transmitter well!

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_030.en:
I had time to tinker with it
while I was captive.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: When I was captured I had time, / so I tinkered with it in various ways.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_031.en: Ohh, so that's how it was!
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see, so that's how it was!

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_032.en:
But when I turned up the output,
they caught on...
They took the transmitter inside.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But when I made the output bigger, they found out... / and the transmitter inside was taken.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_033.en:
So I thought.
But it still gave us a lead
to find you.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As I thought. / But it became a clue to / pinpointing your location.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hehe. / I'm glad~.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_035.en:
I'll be imposing on you here for
a while.
I look forward to working with
you all.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll be imposing on you here for a while. / Everyone, please take care of me.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_036.en:
Yes. Until this is over, you're safer
here.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, until this is over, / it's safer to be here.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, yes, nice to have you!

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aisha, nice to have you!

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_039.en:
A mission? Roger!
Preparing to sortie!
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A mission, roger! / Preparing to sortie!

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_040.en:
I'll be imposing on you here for
a while.
I look forward to working with
you all.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll be imposing on you here for a while. / Everyone, please take care of me.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_041.en:
Understood.
I'll hold down the fort here.
Be careful out there, everyone!
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood. / I'll stay home here. / Everyone, be careful and take care!

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_042.en:
Oh, hey,
Aisha's back, isn't she?
Good for you guys.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, / Aisha's back, isn't she. / That's good.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_043.en:
Yes!
