Aisha's back!«g:24»
Gotta book that buffet right away!
And I'd better get some containers
ready for your share, too.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes! / Aisha came back!«g:24» / I have to reserve the buffet right away! / Also I have to prepare containers / for your share.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_044.en:
Why you were brought together...
Maybe it was to take down the
Vampires in the first place.
In other words, you may have been
assembled on purpose to erase
their evidence.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Why you were gathered... / Maybe it was to defeat the Vampires / in the first place. / In other words, you may have been / deliberately gathered / to erase their evidence.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_045.en:
Captain «E801:00».
Good work.
Thanks to you, Dr. Aisha is safe,
and we have an outline of the
research at that facility.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00». / Good work. / Thanks to you, Doctor Aisha is protected, / and the outline of the facility's research has come to light.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_046.en:
The op only succeeded because
Chariot Squad was there.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The operation's success was only possible / with the Chariot squad's cooperation.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_047.en:
Chariot Squad was originally led
by one of my direct subordinates.
But in the Anti-Vampire Operation
they lost their base and their
captain, so Tornado took over.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Originally the Chariot squad was / commanded by my direct subordinate. / But due to the losses in the earlier anti-Vampires / operation, they lost their base and captain, / and I had Tornado take over.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Tornado... / He's grown.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hoh, you knew him?

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_050.en:
We ran an exercise together once,
with Champ and Oddeye.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I once did exercises with him, / Champ and Oddeye.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_051.en:
I see.
So the merc base that scouted him
was the one you were at...
I had them tracking the Numbers
who escaped.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / So the mercenary base that scouted him / was the base you were at... / I had them tracking the whereabouts / of the Numbers who fled.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There were still Numbers left?

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_053.en:
Missing, to be precise.
But after their base fell, not one
piece of physical evidence remained.
If they are alive, they will without
doubt be more troublesome than
even Lich.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Precisely, they're missing. / But after the base collapsed, not one piece / of physical evidence remained. / If they're alive, there's no doubt / they're a more troublesome opponent / than that Lich.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_054.en:
More than Lich...
So that's why the investigation
on Huffman continues.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: More than Lich... / So that's why you're continuing / the investigation on Huffman.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_055.en:
Precisely.
Criticism of Internal Affairs has
been growing lately.
In place of me, I intend to have
Tornado's team serve as guards
on the mainland.
I want «E801:00» Squad to continue
the investigation on Huffman.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's how it is. / Since the other day, criticism of internal investigations / has intensified. / For Tornado and the others, I intend to dispatch guards / from the home country in my place. / I want the «E801:00» squad to continue / the investigation on Huffman.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Leave it to us.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_057.en:
According to what Chariot Squad
learned, the Vampires' research arm
was working on something called
the PS (Puppet Soldier) Plan.
Its aim, apparently, was "to
manipulate soldiers like puppets."

And the new organization that
abducted Aisha appears to be doing
new research based on the PS Plan.
For now, we've decided to call this
organization "Organization B."

The Organization B facility where
we recovered Aisha was a recent
addition. This time, I want you to
investigate their old medical
facility.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: From the information the Chariot squad obtained, / what the Vampires' research organization / was working on / was called the PS (Puppet Soldier) plan. / Its purpose was apparently / "manipulating soldiers like dolls." /  / And the new organization that kidnapped Aisha / seems to be doing new research / based on that PS plan. / For now we've decided to call / this organization "Organization B." /  / The Organization B facility where we rescued Aisha / the other day was recently expanded, / but this time I want you to investigate the old medical facility.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_058.en:
Would there be anything left at the
old medical facility?
Erasing evidence is their specialty.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is anything left at the old medical facility? / They should be good at erasing evidence.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_059.en:
True.
But as long as clues may remain,
we cannot afford not to look.
However, if the enemy appears, there
is no one but your unit who can
put up a real fight.
That is the long and short of it.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: True. / But as long as there's a possibility / a clue remains, we can't not investigate. / However, if the enemy appears, there's no one / other than your unit who can fight them properly. / That's how it is.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_060.en:
I see.
Understood.
We'll gear up and move out.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / Roger. / We'll get equipped and sortie.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm counting on you.

MsgLabels_station_55_msg_062.en:
I want you to investigate
Organization B's old medical
facility.
The enemy may appear.
Don't neglect your preparations.
MsgLabels_station_55_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I want you to investigate / Organization B's old medical facility. / The enemy may appear. / Don't neglect preparations.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_001.en:
Is this the old medical facility?
No Organization B forces detected
so far.
MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is this the old medical facility? / So far, no Organization B forces / can be detected.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_002.en:
Awful bare place.
...Hm? These scars...
Was there fightin' here too?
MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's awfully plain. / ...Hm? These scars... / Was there fighting here too?

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_003.en:
Those are some heavy battle scars.
...Still, a place like this...
Perfect for doing shady experiments
where no one can see.
MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Very intense battle scars. / ...Still, a place like this... / is ideal for secretly / doing dark experiments in the shadows.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_004.en:
Should we get out of the wanzers
and take a look?
MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Shall we get out of the WAPs and investigate?

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_005.en:
No, it's dangerous.
Stay in your machines.
All units, record footage.
Collect anything that could serve
as physical evidence.
MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, it's dangerous. / Stay aboard. / All units, record video. / If there's anything that could be physical evidence, / collect it.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_006.en:
Roger.
Let's head to that point; we should
be able to see inside from there.
MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Let's head to that point / where we can see inside the facility.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_007.en: All units, move to the point.
MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units, move to the point.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_008.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_010.en:
Nothin' suspicious here.
Looks like they already moved out.
MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Nothing suspicious in sight. / Looks like they've already finished moving out.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_011.en:
Still no enemy contacts.
Recording continues.
MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Still no enemy signatures. / Recording continues.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_012.en:
I don't know... it's just
a creepy place...
Glad we didn't get out of the wanzers.
MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But how to put it, / it's an unpleasant place... / Good thing we didn't get out of the WAPs.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_013.en:
Yeah?
Doesn't look dangerous to me.
Though somethin' ELSE might show up...
MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Really? / It doesn't look dangerous. / Well, something else might come out, though...

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_014.en:
Like zombies or ghosts?
Anyone with a sixth sense would
probably see them.
I don't think I want to watch
this footage later...
MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Zombies or ghosts? / People with a sixth sense might see them. / I don't feel like watching the recorded footage later...

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_015.en:
Sixth sense or not, I do feel
a chill somehow.
MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sixth sense aside, somehow / I feel a chill.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_016.en:
We're not even inside, but I can
almost smell it... a stench mixed
with disinfectant...
MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even though we didn't enter the facility, / it's like I can smell a foul odor / mixed with disinfectant...

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_017.en:
This building...
It's built more like a factory than
a medical facility.
All these little culture cases...
As if something was on display.
MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This building... / Its structure is closer to a factory than a medical facility. / These countless small culture cases... / It's built like something was on display.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_018.en:
Ah, this is... RDX!?
...Captain, it's a trap!
There are remote-detonated bombs
planted here!
MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, this is... RDX!? / ...Captain, it's a trap! / Remote-detonated bombs have been planted!

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_019.en:
If they're remote-detonated, the
enemy may be hiding nearby.
All units, combat ready.
Pull out of the facility.
MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Remote-detonated means / they may be lurking nearby. / All units, take battle readiness / and leave the facility.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_020.en:
Cleaners here.
...Five intruder wanzers still active.
MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is Cleaner. / ...5 intruder WAPs intact.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Erase them.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_022.en:
Roger.
Withdrawal team, once you take hits
as planned, head for the rendezvous
point.
Main body, focus on pinning them
down.
MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Withdrawal team, as arranged, when hit, / head to the rendezvous point. / The main body will concentrate on holding them back.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy units confirmed.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_024.en:
Doesn't look like many.
We'll intercept as we are.
MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The scale seems small. / We'll intercept as is.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger!

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_026.en:
Heading for the rendezvous point,
as planned.
MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As planned, rushing to the rendezvous point.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_027.en:
Cleaners here...
...The enemy is far stronger than
expected.
Main body wiped out...
The rest have been sent to the
rendezvous point as planned.
MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is Cleaner... / ...The enemy is a more powerful unit than imagined. / Main body annihilated... / The others, as planned, I had rush / to the rendezvous point.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...You know what comes next.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Of course... / Activating the detonator...

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's fine.

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_031.en:
Several units appear to have
withdrawn.
Is that... their leader's machine?
Huh...?
Captain, a heat source underground...
This is...
Just like that time...
It's the same trap as in the fight
with Lich!
MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Several units seem to have withdrawn. / Was that... the leader's unit? / Eh...? / Captain, heat sources underground... / This is... / The same as that time... / It's the same setup as during the Lich battle!

MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_032.en:
What kind of people are they...
All units, clear the area.
MsgLabels_tactics_55_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What kind of people are they... / All units, leave this area.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_001.en:
Captain. I've sent every unit's
footage to the investigator's
analysis team.
They should be in touch soon.
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain. I sent each unit's video data / to the Investigator's analysis team. / I think we'll hear back later.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good work.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_003.en:
Still, blowing up the whole
facility...
Reminds me of the fight with Lich...
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Still, self-destructing along with the whole facility. / It reminds me of the battle with Lich...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_004.en: Damn, those guys give me the creeps...
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Honestly, those guys are creepy...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_005.en:
Judging by their methods, the
remnants were set up to wipe out
anyone who came to investigate
the facility.
...I also want to know where the
units that fled have gone.
I'll ask the investigator if he
has any intel.
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Judging by the method, the remnant unit / seems to have been arranged to erase anyone / investigating the facility. / ...The whereabouts of the unit that fled bother me too. / I'll ask the Investigator if there's information.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_007.en:
Where could the units that fled
have gone...?
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Where did the unit that fled go...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Really creepy guys...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_010.en:
Roger that.
I'll get my wanzer ready!
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / I'll get the WAP ready!

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_011.en:
To think the Vampires' shadow
is still hanging over us...
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: To think the shadow of the Vampires / still remains...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Preparing for the sortie.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_013.en:
The place you all went last time
was the old research facility,
wasn't it?
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The place everyone went the other day / is the old research facility.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Were you there too, Aisha?

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_015.en:
No, I was usually at another
facility. I was called to the old
one only once, during the B1
activation test, to deal with a
control system problem.
But the test unit went berserk, so
I was evacuated to another facility
right away.
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, I was usually at a different facility. / I was called to the old facility just once, during B1's activation test, / to deal with control device trouble, / but the experimental unit / went berserk, so I immediately / evacuated to another facility.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_017.en:
No.
Vampire was the B2 test unit.
The B1 had its code changed...
I think they called it Ghost.
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No. / Vampire is the B2 experimental unit. / The B1 experimental unit had a code change, / and I think it was called Ghost.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_018.en:
...What was the control system
research you were doing, Aisha?
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...What was the control device research / you did, Aisha?

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_019.en:
Brief revival of brain-dead patients
through an external neural
connection.
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Research on short-term revival of brain-dead people / through external neural connection.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Reviving the brain-dead...?

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_021.en:
It's less a revival than calling
someone back from the brink for a
single moment.
The brainwave control is so strong
that it's a heavy burden on the
patient. So I believe a moment is
the limit.
In some countries it's against the
law, but I thought the testimony of
the dead could help solve all kinds
of cases, so I kept at it...
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's closer to calling them back for a moment / from the brink of life and death than revival. / It's powerful brain-wave control, / so the burden on the patient is great. / That's why I think a moment is the limit. / In some countries it violates the law, but / I thought dead people's testimony would help / solve all kinds of cases, / so I researched it...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_022.en:
Did you know your research was
being used to develop weapons?
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Did you know the research was being used / for weapons development?

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_023.en:
No. Of course, if I'd known, I'd
never have taken part...
No... I suppose I couldn't have
refused anyway...
...At first they told me it was for
medical purposes, and brought me
to this island.
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, of course if I'd known / I wouldn't have joined the research... / No, / I probably couldn't have refused anyway... / ...At first I was told it was for medical purposes / and was brought to this island.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_024.en:
But that prototype ran for a lot
longer than a moment...
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But that prototype's operation / wasn't just a moment...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_025.en:
Yes...
I never imagined they'd combine my
research and use it to move a wanzer...
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes... / To think they'd combine the research / and move a WAP...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_026.en:
Does the pilot have to be someone
brought back from brain death?
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Does that pilot have to be in a state / of having come back from brain death?

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_027.en:
Mm, it should be, yes.
If a healthy person is put under that
brainwave control... it causes
violent headaches like Captain
«E801:00»'s, memory loss, and in the
worst cases, a mental collapse.
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, it should. / If a normal person receives that brain-wave control, / ...like Captain «E801:00», it causes / severe headaches, memory disorders, and in bad cases / mental collapse.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_028.en:
I see...
Then I owe you a lot, Aisha.
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see... / So Aisha is my benefactor.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_029.en:
Huh?
Oddeye, what do you mean?
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? / Oddeye, what do you mean?

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_030.en:
X-00B2 Vampire was David...
He was someone very dear to me.
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: X-00 B2 Vampire was David... / My precious person.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_032.en:
It seems the Vampires had been
searching for pilots compatible
with that machine.
And when David was wounded fighting
them, they deliberately drove him
into brain death...
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The Vampires seem to have originally been looking for / a pilot compatible with that unit. / And it was their doing / that deliberately drove David, wounded in battle with them, / into brain death...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_033.en:
...When we rescued him from the
Vampires, David's mind had collapsed.
But in the end, he got his memories
back, and now he's resting
peacefully back home.
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...When we rescued him from the Vampires, / David had suffered mental collapse. / But in the end he properly regained his memories / and rested peacefully back home.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_034.en:
No...
That can't...
I'm so sorry, Oddeye.
Because of my research...
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's... / Something like that... / I'm sorry, Oddeye, / because of my research...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_035.en:
No, it's not your fault, Aisha.
By rights, once he was gone, I'd
never have heard another word from
him, or seen him ever again.
But I got to hear him say goodbye,
when he was supposed to be brain
dead!
Thank you. It's all thanks to you,
Aisha!
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, Aisha isn't to blame. / Otherwise, I'd never have heard / the words of that person who'd disappeared, and might never / have met him again in my life. / And I even got to hear words of farewell / from him, who should have been brain-dead! / Thank you, it's thanks to Aisha!

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_036.en:
...But...
If that machine had never existed...
if the project had never gone
ahead...
none of you would have been dragged
into this fight...
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...But... / If that unit hadn't existed, if the project / hadn't advanced... / everyone wouldn't have been dragged / into this kind of fighting...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_037.en:
Even after the Vampires collapsed,
Organization B rose in their place.
If it hadn't been you, someone else
would have done it.
You don't have to carry it alone.
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even when the Vampires collapsed, / Organization B rose up. / Even if not Aisha, someone else / would have done it. / There's no need to shoulder it alone.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_038.en:
That's right.
Don't let it get to you, Aisha.
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / Aisha, you mustn't worry about it.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_039.en:
I'm truly sorry...
......
...It started when I was little,
when my grandfather died.
He passed without leaving a word.
There was a fight over the will,
and the family fell apart.
...In time, the research succeeded.
But people can't become gods.
No... people mustn't become gods.
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm really sorry... / ... / ...When I was little, my grandfather's death / was the trigger. / Grandfather passed without being able to leave any words. / It developed into an inheritance dispute and the family fell apart. / ...Eventually the research succeeded. / But people can't become gods. / No, they mustn't become gods.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_040.en:
...I understand the regret.
But so it never happens again, we
do everything we can, right now,
with our own strength.
I think that's the responsibility
of those who know the truth.
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I understand the feeling of regret. / But so as not to repeat it, / do what you can now with all your strength. / I think that's the responsibility / of people who know the truth.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_041.en:
You're right...
My abilities...
I wonder if they could be of some
use...
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right... / My strength... / Isn't there some way I can be useful...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_042.en:
As long as you're here, Organization
B's research is stuck, right?
Then just being here is already a
huge help!
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Just by Aisha being here, / Organization B's research stops, right? / Then just being here, you're being / plenty useful!

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_043.en:
But... all of you are out there
risking your lives, and I'm the only
one who gets to stay home...
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But... everyone is fighting / risking their lives, / and I'm the only one staying home...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_044.en:
Well, we're mercenaries.
Fighting is what we can do right now.
Besides, when somebody's waiting to
say "welcome back," it makes you
swear you'll come home no matter
what!
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But we're mercenaries, you know. / Fighting is what we can do now. / Besides, when there's someone who'll say / "welcome home," / you feel like you'll definitely come back!

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oddeye...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_046.en:
Aisha, once Organization B is shut
down, you can go home.
You can think about the rest then.
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aisha, when Organization B's activities stop, / you can go home. / You can think about the rest then.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_048.en:
Aisha took it to heart, didn't
she...
Maybe I should've kept it to myself
after all...
But I wanted to thank her...
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aisha took it to heart, huh... / Maybe I should have kept it hidden after all... / But I wanted to thank her...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_049.en:
A sortie?
I'll go get ready!
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie? / I'll go prepare!

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_050.en: Something I can do to help...
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Something I can help with...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_051.en:
You're heading out, then.
Please be careful, everyone.
...I'll ask the investigator if I can
help analyze the footage.
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie. / Everyone, be careful. / ...I'll ask the Investigator and help / with the video analysis.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_052.en:
I was chatting with Aisha...
and when I brought up neuroscience,
she switched straight into lecture
mode...
Didn't let me go for about three
hours. Brutal.
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I talked with Aisha... / when I brought up neuroscience, / she suddenly switched to a lecture tone... / and then I wasn't released for about 3 hours. / It was rough.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_053.en:
Heard they decided to call the new
enemy "Organization B."
Pretty lazy, next to "the Vampires."
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I hear they decided to call this enemy / Organization B. / Compared to the Vampires, / it feels pretty half-hearted.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_054.en:
Unconfirmed info, but...
looks like some medical outfit just
crossed the border from OCU
territory into USN territory.
Proper embassy permits and all...
but at a time like this? Fishy...
Guess I'll pass it on to Roy.
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's unconfirmed information, but / there seems to be a medical institution that crossed the border / from O.C.U. territory to U.S.N. territory. / It apparently has proper embassy permission, / but... / it's suspicious at this time... / Maybe I'll tell Roy.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_055.en:
I am reviewing the footage from your
wanzers, but nothing that qualifies as
evidence was recorded.
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We're checking the recorded video shot by the WAPs, / but nothing that could be called evidence seems to have been captured.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_056.en:
Booby traps and an underground
detonation system.
Judging by their methods, the
Vampire remnants are the likely
culprits, but...
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Booby-trap bombs and an underground detonation device. / Judging by the method, the possibility that they're / Vampires remnants is high, but...

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_057.en:
...As expected, that alone is not
enough to trace who is behind them.
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...As I thought, that alone / makes it hard to dig into who's behind it.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_058.en:
Several enemy machines withdrew.
Any idea where they went?
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Several enemy units withdrew; / can you find where they withdrew to?

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_059.en:
There are reports of unidentified
machines gathering at ruins in the
desert.
However, any link to Organization B
is unconfirmed.
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There's information that units of unknown affiliation are / gathering at ruins in the desert region. / But the connection with Organization B is uncertain.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_060.en:
The desert...
Another thing they share with the
Vampires.
If need be, we'll investigate.
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The desert... / That's also something in common with the Vampires. / If necessary, we'll investigate.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_061.en:
...Indeed.
I am counting on you.
I will keep going through the
footage here.
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...That's right. / I'm counting on you. / I'll continue checking the video here.

MsgLabels_station_56_msg_062.en:
There are reports of unidentified
machines gathering at ruins in the
desert.
However, any link to Organization B
is unconfirmed.
MsgLabels_station_56_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There's information that units of unknown affiliation are / gathering at ruins in the desert region. / But the connection with Organization B is uncertain.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_001.en:
We've reached the point where the
unidentified machines were sighted.
MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Arrived at the point where units of unknown affiliation / were sighted.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Those ruins?

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_003.en:
Could it be their base...?
No, doesn't really look like one...
MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The possibility that it's their base... / No, it doesn't particularly look like it...

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_004.en:
Maybe some armed group was just
runnin' drills out here?
MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Maybe an armed group was / just doing exercises?

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_005.en:
A place like this means they've
got something planned.
All units, proceed with caution.
MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Precisely because it's a place like this, there must / be some scheme. / All units, act cautiously.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_006.en:
A trap...
Yeah, that does make more sense.
MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A trap... / Thinking that way certainly feels right.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sonar signature. / 12 WAP signatures.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_008.en:
All right. All units, intercept
positions.
We wait for them to make a move.
MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Good, all units, intercept stance. / We'll wait for the enemy's move.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_009.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_011.en:
Rain, check whether those are the
machines that fled.
MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain, confirm whether they're the fled units.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_012.en:
Roger.
Matching silhouettes...
Same model as the wanzers that fled
the old research facility, confirmed.
Other machines are mixed in.
MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Matching silhouettes... / Found units of the same type as the vanzers that fled / at the old research facility. / Other units are mixed in too.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_013.en:
The ones that fled, and others...
Oddeye, any explosives in the area?
MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The fled units and other units... / Oddeye, any explosive signatures around?

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_014.en:
No, I've been scanning since we got
here. Nothing.
MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, I've been scanning since we arrived here, / and there's no signature.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_015.en: So this is just where they ran to...
MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You're saying it's just where they fled to...

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_016.en:
Then we disable their forces and get
the information out of them.
MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Then we'll just neutralize their forces / and get information out of them.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_018.en:
What are these people...
So this is the strength of the unit
that beat the Numbers...
Dammit, this wrecks the whole plan.
Forget it. Send out the
strongpoint-assault machine!
MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What kind of people are they... / Is this the power of the unit / that beat the Numbers... / Damn, at this rate the arrangements will go wrong. / Never mind, put out the anti-base assault unit!

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_019.en:
Huh? What is that...
A large machine?
No, it's a wanzer!
Captain!
MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh? What's that... / A large unit? / No, it's a WAP! / Captain!

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_020.en:
I see. So there was an ambush after
all.
They meant to wear us down, then
finish us with a special large
machine.
All units, work together. Take it
down.
MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see, there was an ambush after all. / They seem to have arranged to suppress us with a special large unit / once we were worn down. / All units, coordinate and deal with it.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed special large unit silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_023.en:
Monsters...
...All remaining units, bring them
down, whatever it takes!
If it comes to that, take them
with you...
MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Monsters... / ...With the remaining forces, bring them down no matter what! / At worst, take them down with you...

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed all enemies silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_025.en:
Roger.
To any survivors:
Lay down your arms and surrender.
MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / To the survivors. / Disarm and surrender.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry, everyone... / ...Eraser activate...

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_027.en:
I repeat.
Lay down your arms and surrender.
Further fighting is pointless.
MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Repeat. / Disarm and surrender. / Further fighting is meaningless.

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_028.en:
Captain!
The enemy leader's machine... I'm
reading explosive liquid!
...It's going to self-destruct!!
MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain! / Enemy leader's unit... explosive liquid signature! / ...It's going to self-destruct!!

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_029.en:
Hell...
What do they think a life is
worth...
MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What the hell... / What do they think life is...

MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_030.en:
...So this is how they do things.
Withdraw.
All units, don't get caught in the
blast.
MsgLabels_tactics_56_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...So this is their way after all. / Withdraw. / All units, don't get caught in the explosion.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_001.en:
Still, those bastards...
What the hell do they think a human
life is?
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Still, those guys... / what do they think human life is.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_002.en:
Blowing themselves up to destroy
evidence, experimenting on people...
Are they mercenaries too, I wonder...
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Self-destructing to erase evidence, / and experiments using people... / Are those people mercenaries too...

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_003.en: That's way too extreme just for money.
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's too forceful to be just for money.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_004.en:
Remember what happened with Lancer.
They may be forcing people to sign
through blackmail.
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There's the matter of Lancer too. / They may be forcing contracts / through threats.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_005.en:
Or they're ruled by something even
more frightening...
The Vampires...
In that sense, they haven't
collapsed at all.
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Or there's control through / something even more frightening... / The Vampires... / In that sense, / they haven't collapsed yet.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_006.en:
So unless we track down the root
and get rid of it, this will just
keep happening.
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As expected, unless we track down the root / and eliminate it, / it will be repeated.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_007.en:
Damn...
This is driving me nuts...
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Honestly... / it's frustrating...

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_008.en:
...The enemy is bigger than we
imagined.
Solving what we can see, one thing
at a time, may look like the long way
round, but I think it's the shortest.
No rushing. All we can do is pull
off each mission, one by one.
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...The enemy is more enormous than imagined. / Solving the visible situations one by one / may look roundabout, but / I think it's the shortest route. / We can only stay calm and make missions / succeed one by one.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Yeah, roger.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_010.en:
Are we really getting any closer to
the truth, I wonder...
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Are we really getting closer / to the truth...

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_012.en:
One at a time, huh...
Hmm.
That's how I became Champ, too.
Back to basics, then!
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Surely, one at a time, huh... / Hmm. / That's how I became champ too. / I'll go with the feeling of returning to the basics!

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_013.en:
Roger that!
Let's nail that evidence, whatever
it takes!
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger! / Let's nail the evidence no matter what!

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_014.en:
Unless we track down the root and
get rid of it, this will just keep
happening.
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Unless we track down the root / and eliminate it, / it will be repeated.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_015.en:
Sortie, understood.
I'll get ready right away.
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sortie, roger. / I'll get ready right away.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_016.en:
Aisha's still shut away doing
analysis, same as ever.
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aisha is shut in with analysis work / as usual.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_017.en:
I see.
She'd rather do her own kind of work
than just sit around here.
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / Rather than just being here, she probably wants / to do work in her own way.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_018.en: I wish I could help her somehow...
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I wish I could help / with something too...

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_019.en:
She seems to get along especially
well with you, Oddeye.
I understand wanting to do something
for her as a friend, but you have
your job on the front line.
That should be enough.
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: She seems to get along especially well / with Oddeye. / I understand wanting to do something for her / as a friend, but Oddeye has work / on the front line. / That should be enough.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_020.en:
I guess...
Aisha and I are just on the same
wavelength, somehow.
She's the kind of friend I want to
treasure.
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right... / Aisha and I are somehow on the same wavelength. / She feels like a friend I want to treasure.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_021.en:
Then Aisha may be thinking the same
thing.
The more you worry about her, the
more she may end up worrying about
you.
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Then Aisha may be thinking / the same thing. / Conversely, the more considerate Oddeye is, / the more considerate she may be too.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_022.en:
Oh, I get it...
You're right.
I'll do my best on the front line!
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, I see... / That's right. / I'll do my best on the front line too!

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_023.en:
Aisha's working hard, so I'll do my
best on the front line too!
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aisha's doing her best too, / so I'll do my best on the front line!

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_024.en:
A sortie!
I'll go get ready right away!
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie! / I'll go get ready right away!

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_025.en:
I hear the enemy blows themselves up
when they're cornered?
I remember an old anime like that.
Maybe the enemy's after something
too?
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I hear when the enemy is cornered, / they self-destruct? / I remember watching an anime show like that long ago. / Is the enemy aiming for something too?

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_026.en:
Passed Aisha in the hallway the other
day. Hair a total mess, face all
pale.
She's cute normally, but seeing her
like that, she looked like a proper
scientist.
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: When I passed Aisha in the hallway the other day, / she had messy hair and a pale face. / She's usually cute, but seeing her like that / she looked like a researcher.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_027.en:
That intel from before? Bingo.
Looks like the enemy's run off into
USN territory.
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The info from before was a bingo after all. / The enemy has apparently fled into U.S.N. territory.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_028.en:
We have located a facility housing
Organization B's research division.
It is a medical facility in Larcus.
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A facility housing Organization B's research division / has been identified. / It's a medical facility in Larcus.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_029.en:
Larcus...
That's USN territory.
Enemy territory...
How did they move it all there?
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Larcus... / That's U.S.N. territory. / An enemy nation... / How did they transfer them?

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_030.en:
They simply crossed the border, it
seems. There were records.
Our agent on the ground reports the
facility is in operation.
...We have secured an infiltration
route from the coast.
I want you to go and investigate.
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: They seem to have crossed the border normally. / Records remained. / According to reports from a special correspondent, / the facility is apparently in operation. / ...We've secured an infiltration route from the coast. / Go investigate.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_031.en:
If we're found, there'll be hell
to pay.
That's a USN controlled zone.
It's not the same as slipping a
little over the border.
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If we're found, it won't end well. / That's a U.S.N. controlled zone. / It's different from slightly crossing the border.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_032.en:
There is no time to wait for the
embassy's permission.
All I can say is, don't get caught.
Also, a sizeable wanzer force appears
to be guarding the area.
Be careful.
New weapons and parts have just
been delivered to the hangar.
Upgrade as much as you can before
you go.
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There's no time to wait for embassy permission. / All I can say is don't get caught. / Also, a considerable number of vanzers seem / to be guarding the area. / Be careful. / New weapons and parts have just / been supplied to the hangar. / Strengthen yourselves as much as possible before going.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_033.en:
So it's a job only we can do...
Understood.
Looks like we have no choice.
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So it's impossible unless it's us... / Understood. / It seems we have no choice.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_034.en:
And...
I hate to raise this at a time
like this...
...
...
...
Commander Falcon's death has been
confirmed.
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Also... / this is a bad time, but... / ... / ... / ... / Commander Falcon's death / has been confirmed.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What did you say?

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_036.en:
Officially, it is being called
suicide by gunshot.
There were traces of drugs as well.
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Officially it's ruled a suicide by pistol. / There was apparently a drug reaction too.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_037.en:
...He wasn't the kind of man who'd
do that.
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...He's not a man who'd do that.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_038.en:
Of course not.
It looks like whoever is pulling the
strings is sending us a warning...
But...
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Of course. / It seems the mastermind is making / a warning against us... / But...

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_039.en:
But we can't let it break us...
We sortie at once.
...This could shake the squad before
a mission.
I'll keep Falcon's death to myself
until the mission is over.
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But we can't give in... / Preparing to sortie immediately. / ...It could shake the members before the sortie. / I'll keep Falcon's matter quiet until the mission ends.

MsgLabels_station_57_msg_040.en:
Unfortunately, we do not know the
details of their forces.
On the surface it is a working
medical facility, but if it is in
operation, we can safely assume a
considerable force is hidden there.
MsgLabels_station_57_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Unfortunately the details of their forces are unknown. / On the surface it's an active medical facility, but / if it's in operation, it's safe to assume / a considerable force / is lurking there.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_001.en:
Arrived at the Larcus plant zone.
That facility appears to be the
target.
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Arrived at the Larcus plant zone. / That facility seems to be / the target.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The scale is smaller than I thought.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_003.en:
We recon the facility while keeping
watch on the surroundings.
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We'll reconnoiter inside the facility while watching the surroundings.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_004.en:
Feels like another place that's
gonna smell of disinfectant.
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Somehow this place also seems like it'll / smell of disinfectant.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_005.en:
You really hate disinfectant that
much?
Are you a germ, Gray?
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Do you hate disinfectant that much? / Could it be Gray is a germ?

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_006.en:
So after muscle-head, now it's
germ...
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: After muscle-brain comes germ...

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_007.en:
That's mean, Oddeye...
That smell reminds you of hospitals,
right...?
I don't have many good memories of
those...
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's cruel, Oddeye... / That smell reminds you of hospitals, right...? / I don't have many good memories of them...

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_008.en:
I don't mind that smell so much,
myself...
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I don't dislike that smell / that much, though...

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_009.en:
Don't worry, Gray.
Not as long as you stay in your
wanzer.
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No need to worry, Gray. / As long as you don't get out of the vanzer.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_010.en:
Ha ha ha!
Muscle-head and germ-head, huh?
We gotta stick together, Gray!
Oh, look at that.
The garrison here?
It's a wanzer unit.
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hahaha! / Let's be friends as fellow germs, Gray? / Oh, look. / The garrison here? / A WAP unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_011.en:
They're deployed right out in the
open...
...Wait, that's the USN regular army!
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: They're deployed so openly. / ...Wait, it's the U.S.N. regular army!

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_012.en:
Would USN machines guard a place
that isn't even military?
Maybe it's camouflage.
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's not even a military facility; would U.S.N. / units be guarding it? / Maybe it's camouflage.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_013.en:
But if they're real...
Fighting the regular army would be
bad.
Captain, what do we do?
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But if they're real... / fighting the regular army is bad. / Captain, what do we do?

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_014.en:
We still need to investigate that
facility.
Rain, mark the recon points for
all units.
Keep contact with the garrison to a
minimum. Get the evidence and pull
out.
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: But that facility needs investigating. / Rain, display the reconnaissance points to all units. / Keep engagement with the garrison to a minimum, / obtain evidence and withdraw.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_016.en:
Victory: Investigate the enemy
facility.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit or
Oddeye unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: investigate the enemy facility. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down or / Oddeye's unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Intruders. / 5 WAPs! / Approaching Plant 4!

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_019.en:
Damn, who the hell are they...
All units, intercept!
Keep them away from the plant!
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Damn, what unit is it... / All units, take intercept stance! / Don't let them near the plant!

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, the garrison noticed us.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_021.en: Get to the recon point, fast.
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rush to the reconnaissance point.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Reached the point. / Starting to record.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / All units, support Rain's unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_024.en:
Noise on the image...
No good. I can't record.
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Noise in the image... / No good. Can't record.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_025.en:
A canceler, maybe...?
Rain, I'll break the protection
remotely from here.
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A canceller...? / Miss Rain, I'll remove the protection / remotely from here.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger, Oddeye. / Rain, go cover Oddeye.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger, I'm counting on you.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Reached the point. / Starting to record!

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / All units, support Champ's unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_030.en:
Noise on the image?
No good...
What a time to break down!
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Noise in the image? / No good... / Breaking down at a time like this!

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_031.en:
A canceler, maybe...?
Champ, let's switch.
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A canceller...? / Champ, let's switch with me.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger, Oddeye. / Champ, go cover Oddeye.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_033.en:
Roger.
This kinda thing's Oddeye's job...
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger, / I'll leave this kind of thing to Oddeye...

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Reached the point. / Starting to record.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / All units, support Oddeye's unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_036.en:
Noise on the image...?
A canceler?
Removing...
Whoa, what's this?
Layers and layers of protection...
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Noise in the image...? / A canceller? / Removing... / Whoa, what's this? / Multiple layers of protection...

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What's wrong, Oddeye?

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_038.en:
Captain, breaking the protection is
going to take a little while.
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, removing the protection / will take a little time.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_039.en:
Roger.
All units, protect Oddeye at all
costs.
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / All units, defend Oddeye's unit to the death.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Reached the point. / Starting to record.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / All units, support Gray's unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_042.en:
Noise on the image...?
Interference...
Oddeye, how do you break this kind
of protection?
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Noise in the image...? / Radio interference... / Oddeye, how do you remove / this type of protection?

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_043.en:
I'd have to take a look...
Gray, let's switch.
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I won't know unless I look... / Gray, let's switch with me.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger, Oddeye. / Gray, go cover Oddeye.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_045.en:
Roger.
It's up to you, Oddeye.
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Oddeye, I'm counting on you.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Reached the point. / Starting to record.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_047.en:
Roger.
All units, cover the Captain.
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / All units, supporting the Captain.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_048.en:
Noise on the image...
Looks like interference.
Oddeye, how do I break this kind of
protection?
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Noise in the image... / It seems to be radio interference. / Oddeye, tell me how to remove / this type of protection.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_049.en:
I'd have to take a look...
Captain, let's switch.
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I won't know unless I look... / Captain, let's switch with me.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger, Oddeye. / I'll go cover Oddeye.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_051.en:
...So much jammer noise...
Mmm, third layer removed... there.
Image clear...
...Huh? Glass cases?
Covering the whole wall...
What is this... What's going on!?
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...There's a lot of jammer noise... / Hmm, removing the 3rd layer... there. / Image clear... / ...Eh? Glass cases? / Covering a whole wall... / What is this... what does it mean!?

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_052.en:
What's up, Oddeye?
Get yourself a scoop?
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What's wrong, Oddeye? / Did you get a scoop?

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_053.en:
Wh-what IS this!!
Things that look like brains...
Lots of them, in glass cases...
It's horrible!!
...Sending the footage...
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh, what is this!! / Things like brains... / Lots of them in glass cases... / It's gross!! / ...Transferring the footage...

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh...!?

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_055.en:
Holy hell...
There's sick, and then there's
this...
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What the hell... / There are limits to bad taste...

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_056.en:
...We've kept the garrison busy long
enough.
Oddeye, that's enough.
Good work.
All units, head for the withdrawal
point.
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...We've dealt with the garrison enough. / Oddeye, that's enough. / Good work. / All units, head to the withdrawal point.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Y-yes...

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Commander, the intruders are withdrawing!

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_059.en: Did they see inside the plant?
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Did they see inside the plant?

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_060.en:
No, sir. We have jammers layered
all around it.
No ordinary technician could get
through them.
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, we've laid jammers / tightly all around. / I don't think an ordinary engineer could remove them.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_061.en:
Hmph.
Turned tail and ran, then.
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hmph. / They turned tail and ran.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Shall we pursue the intruders?

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_063.en:
No need.
The project director arrives in an
hour.
I don't want any trouble.
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No need. / The project chief arrives / in 1 hour. / I don't want to cause trouble.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_065.en:
Reached the withdrawal point.
No sign of pursuit.
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Reached the withdrawal point. / No signs of pursuit.

MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_066.en:
Roger.
Looks like they don't want to chase
us too far either.
Recon mission complete.
We'll leave the rest to Roy.
MsgLabels_tactics_57_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / The other side doesn't seem to want to pursue deeply either. / Reconnaissance mission complete. / Let's leave the rest to Roy and the others.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain... / Rachel is...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What about Rachel?

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_004.en:
RACHEL PERKINS: SUICIDE!?

A few weeks ago, young journalist
Rachel Perkins was arrested on
suspicion of drug possession just
after returning from a reporting
trip. She was released days later
for lack of evidence, but the
scandal is said to have distanced
her, a campaigner on anti-war and
healthcare issues, from the mass
media.
What drove her to take her own
life...
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rachel Perkins suicide!? /  / Several weeks ago, young famous journalist / Rachel Perkins, / immediately after returning from a reporting trip, / was arrested on suspicion of drug possession. / Days later she was released for insufficient evidence, / but she, who had been working on anti-war and medical issues, / is said to have drifted away from the mass media / with that commotion as the trigger. / The reason that drove her to suicide this time is...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_005.en:
Rachel? THAT Rachel?
The Rachel we know wouldn't touch
drugs...
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is Rachel, you know? / The Rachel we know / wouldn't do drugs...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Let alone suicide...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Are you saying another victim has been added...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Another? / ...Did something happen?

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_009.en:
I'm sorry. I was told before the
last mission, but I judged it would
affect the operation, so I held it
back until now...
...A few days ago, Falcon's body was
found.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry, I was informed before the last mission, / but judging it would interfere, / the report has come only now... / ...The other day, Falcon's body was found.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You're kidding...? / Why Falcon...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_012.en:
Like Rachel, he went missing for
several days, and they're calling it
suicide...
Apparently there were traces of drugs
in his body too.
...
...Rachel, Falcon... We know better
than anyone that neither of them
would ever do such a thing.
But the two of them had something
in common...
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Like Rachel, he went missing for several days / and is said to have committed suicide... / There was apparently a drug reaction in the body too. / ... / ...Both Rachel and Falcon, / we understand better than anyone that neither / is a person who'd do such a thing. / But the two have something in common...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_013.en:
In common...
Oh! You don't mean...
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Something in common... / Ah! No way...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_014.en:
They were both involved with the
Vampires...
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: They were involved in the Vampires affair...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_015.en:
Yes.
And their bodies were found close
to each other.
There's no doubt they were seized by
someone back home and murdered to
look like suicide.
Rachel got hold of information on
the Vampires back then.
Maybe even the story she originally
came for got in the way of whoever
is behind them.
And Falcon, if only indirectly, was
an ordinary officer helping the
Internal Affairs investigation.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / The places the two bodies were found are close too. / There's no doubt they were caught by someone back home / and murdered in a way disguised as suicide. / At that time Rachel obtained information / about the Vampires. / Maybe even her original reporting purpose / was a nuisance to the organization / behind it. / Falcon, though indirectly, / was an ordinary soldier who lent a hand to the internal investigation.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_016.en:
Is this what Lich meant by
"getting erased"...?
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is this also the "being erased" / that Lich talked about...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_017.en:
...Something this blatant... could it
be a warning to the investigator,
and to us?
If so...
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...From such an obvious method, / is it a warning to the Investigator and us? / If so...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_018.en:
This is how they work.
It can never be forgiven.
But as mercenaries, there's nothing
we can do to touch them...
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is their way. / It can never be forgiven. / But as long as we're mercenaries, / we can't lay a hand on them...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_019.en:
...Dammit. Mastermind or whatever
the hell they are, sneakin' around
in the shadows doin' their dirty
work...
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Damn, mastermind or whatever, I don't know, / doing dirty things sneaking in the shadows...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_020.en:
The Organization B case should be
wrapping up soon.
Maybe it's time we thought about
what we do next.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It looks like the Organization B matter will soon be settled. / We might do well to think / about our own futures.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Commander Falcon... / Rachel...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_022.en:
...Understood.
...For now, let's finish things with
Organization B.
Preparing to sortie!
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Roger. / ...For now let's settle things with Organization B. / Preparing to sortie!

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I have to tell everyone...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Did something happen?

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_025.en:
A few days ago, Falcon's body was
found.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The other day, Falcon's body was found.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You're kidding...? / Why Falcon...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_028.en:
Falcon left the army, went missing
for several days, and they're calling
it suicide...
Apparently there were traces of drugs
in his body.
...
Several staff from the merc base
have dropped out of sight as well...
...We know better than anyone that
none of them would do such a thing.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Falcon quit the army, / went missing for several days, / and is said to have committed suicide... / There was apparently a drug reaction in the body too. / ... / Others, several staff who were at the mercenary base / seem to have disappeared too... / ...We understand better than anyone that / they aren't people who'd do such a thing.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_029.en:
Even the merc base staff...
You don't mean...
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even the mercenary base staff... / No way...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_030.en:
Soldiers who knew about the
Vampires...
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The soldiers who knew about the Vampires affair...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_031.en:
Yes.
There's no doubt they were seized by
someone back home and murdered to
look like suicide.
Falcon, if only indirectly, was an
ordinary officer helping the Internal
Affairs investigation.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes. / There's no doubt they were caught by someone back home / and murdered in a way disguised as suicide. / Falcon, though indirectly, / was an ordinary soldier who lent a hand to the internal investigation.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_032.en:
Is this what Lich meant by
"getting erased"...?
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is this also the "being erased" / that Lich talked about...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_033.en:
...Something this blatant... could it
be a warning to the investigator,
and to us?
If so...
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...From such an obvious method, / is it a warning to the Investigator and us? / If so...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_034.en:
This is how they work.
It can never be forgiven.
But as mercenaries, there's nothing
we can do to touch them...
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is their way. / It can never be forgiven. / But as long as we're mercenaries, / we can't lay a hand on them...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_035.en:
...Dammit. Mastermind or whatever
the hell they are, sneakin' around
in the shadows doin' their dirty
work...
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Damn, mastermind or whatever, I don't know, / doing dirty things sneaking in the shadows...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_036.en:
The Organization B case should be
wrapping up soon.
Maybe it's time we thought about
what we do next.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It looks like the Organization B matter will soon be settled. / We might do well to think / about our own futures.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Commander Falcon...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_038.en:
...Understood.
...For now, let's finish things with
Organization B.
Preparing to sortie!
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Roger. / ...For now let's settle things with Organization B. / Preparing to sortie!

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_039.en:
"As mercenaries"...
Then what are we supposed to do...
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As long as we're mercenaries... / what on earth can we do...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_040.en:
So they've finally found Organization
B's development base.
I'll get ready to sortie at once.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Organization B's development base / has finally been found. / I'll prepare to sortie right away.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_041.en:
After Organization B's finished...
What can guys like us even do...
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: After Organization B is destroyed... / What we can do...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_042.en:
Thinkin' won't get us anywhere.
We just do what we can right now!
Alright, final round!
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
