Literal: Thinking about it won't get us anywhere. / We'll just do what we can now! / Alright, final round!

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What's wrong, Oddeye?

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_045.en:
It's Aisha.
Ever since we talked about David,
she's been brooding over it...
I've tried talking to her a few times,
but she's not her usual cheery self...
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's about Aisha. / Since I told her about David before, / she seems to be brooding... / I've talked to her several times since then, / but she doesn't have her usual energy...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_046.en:
...If she learned her research
hurt you and so many others, even
indirectly... knowing Aisha, she
must feel responsible.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...If she learned her own research, even indirectly, / made Oddeye and many people suffer, / knowing Aisha, she must / feel responsible.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_047.en:
But it's not like any of it is her
fault...
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even though Aisha isn't to blame...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_048.en:
Whatever the circumstances, Aisha
probably can't just file it away
and move on.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Whatever the circumstances, Aisha probably / can't understand it in a detached way.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_049.en:
That's just it...
Aisha's still a kid, and she's a
civilian...
I... don't know what to do...
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right... / Aisha is still a kid, / an ordinary person... / I... don't know what to do...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_050.en:
Maybe you should just treat her the
way you feel like, same as always.
...No, sorry.
...That's hardly advice.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Maybe you should treat her as usual, / the way you feel. / ...No, sorry. / ...This isn't really advice.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_051.en:
No, thank you!
I think that's good advice!
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, thank you. / I think it's good advice!

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_052.en:
Watching you all, I sometimes envy
you...
...When it comes to communication,
you're all far better at it than I am.
If anything, I'm the one being
taught.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Watching you, I sometimes feel envious... / ...At the art of communication, / you're several times better than me. / If anything, I'm the one being taught a lot by you.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_053.en:
Oh, come on...
When you listen to me, Captain, I get
these really honest, straight words
back. It always helps!
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's not... / When the Captain listens to me, / I get to hear, how to say it, pure words, / and it always helps me!

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_055.en:
It does!
We can leave the mind games to the
enemy.
That's what comrades are for, right?
Oh, I get it...
It's the same with Aisha, isn't it.
See, you were right after all,
Captain!
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It does! / Probing each other's intentions is enough with enemies. / That's what comrades are, right! / Ah, I see... / Aisha must be that way too. / As I thought, what the Captain says / is right!

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_056.en:
Hearing that helps me, too.
Communication...
Oddeye, let's talk again sometime.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: When you say that, it helps me too. / Communication... / Oddeye, talk with me about all sorts of things again sometime.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes! Of course!

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, thank you for the advice!

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_059.en:
A sortie!
Huh? Aisha's coming too...!?
Got it.
I'll protect Aisha.
Okay, let's go settle this!
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A sortie! / Eh? Aisha's going out too...!? / Understood. / I'll protect Aisha. / Now, let's go settle this!

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_060.en:
Long time no see, everyone.
You're not registered as mercs any
more, so you were hard to track down.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Everyone, long time no see. / Your mercenary registration was gone, / so it was hard finding you.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_061.en:
Ellen!
What brings you out here?
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Miss Ellen! / What are you doing in a place like this?

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_062.en:
Well, as it happens,
I've brought you something nice.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Well, actually, / I brought something good.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_063.en:
This is...
Where did you get it?
It looks like it's been modified.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This is... / Where did you get it? / It seems to be modified somehow.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_064.en:
It's a prototype from the 1st Army's
Tactical Research Institute.
I have a friend there who slipped it
into my supplies, said to use it if
I liked. But I thought it'd do more
good with you, since you're the ones
fighting right now.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's a prototype made by the First Army's tactical research lab. / I have an acquaintance there, / and they slipped it in with supplies / saying use it if you like, but / I thought it'd be better for you, fighting now, / to have it.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_065.en:
Th-thank you!
Hm?
Ellen, all that luggage...
Are you leaving the island?
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Th-thank you! / Huh? / Miss Ellen, that luggage... / could you be leaving the island?

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_066.en:
No, I've got some leave, so I'm just
going home to my family.
They live in a town on this island,
called Lark Valley.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, I got leave, / so I'm just going home to my family. / It's in a town on this island called Lark Valley.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_067.en:
I see.
I thought I might never see you
again.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_067.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / I thought I'd never see you again.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_068.en:
Ah, but... maybe I really will leave
the island.
...Probably... no.
This island is going to war again,
I'm sure of it.
The regulars have already started
preparing.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_068.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, but... maybe / I really will leave the island. / ...Probably... no, / this island will surely become a war zone again. / The regular army has already begun preparations.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_069.en:
No... A war...?
Is that true?
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_069.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's... war... / Is it true?

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_070.en:
...I'm going home to tell my parents
and friends to get off the island,
and soon.
If my parents ask me to come with
them... I may go too.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_070.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...The reason I'm going home is to tell my parents and friends / to leave the island quickly. / If my parents say let's go together... / I might go too.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_072.en:
I know you're helping CISU, but...
If you sense danger, get off the
island. Right away.
Understood?
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_072.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I know you're helping C.I.S.U., / but... / if you sense danger, flee / the island right away. / Okay?

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_073.en:
Yes...
Thank you for the warning.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_073.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes... / Thank you for the warning.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_074.en:
If you sense danger, get off the
island. Right away.
Understood?
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_074.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If you sense danger, flee / the island right away. / Okay?

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_075.en:
Is it true you went into USN
territory...?
Roy sure hands out some risky orders.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_075.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is it true you went to U.S.N. territory... / Roy sure gives dangerous orders.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_076.en:
The investigator told us to go over
your wanzers extra carefully this
time. You guys up against something
nasty?
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_076.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The Investigator told me to maintain / your vanzers more carefully than usual; / are you fighting / some dangerous enemy?

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_077.en:
...No way... If this intel's true...
This is bad. I gotta tell Roy, right
now...
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_077.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...No way... if this information is true... / This is bad, I have to tell Roy right away......

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_078.en:
Captain «E801:00».
We have finished analyzing the
intelligence you gathered.
Thanks to you, we finally know where
Organization B's weapons development
base is.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_078.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain «E801:00». / The analysis of the information you gathered is complete. / Thanks to it, we finally have a good idea of / Organization B's weapons development base.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_079.en:
I see.
Then let's finish the job.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_079.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / Then let's get to the finishing touch.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_080.en:
Excuse me for interrupting.
I've reviewed the footage «E801:00»
Squad brought back.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_080.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Excuse me during the operation. / I've checked the footage the «E801:00» squad / obtained.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_081.en: Dr. Aisha, please brief the Captain.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_081.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Doctor Aisha, explain to the Captain.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_082.en:
It looks as if the core system has
entered mass production...
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_082.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It seems the core system has entered / the mass-production stage...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_083.en:
Core system...?
What are they researching at that
facility?
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_083.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The core system...? / What research is being done at that facility?

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_084.en:
The objects in the footage are an
artificial brain and spinal cord
system.
The organization is experimenting
with running it as a core system:
in other words, a replacement for
the pilot.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_084.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The objects in the footage are artificial brain and spinal cord / systems. / The organization is doing experiments to operate them / as the core system, / that is, as a substitute for the pilot.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_085.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...So artificial pilots.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_086.en:
...They're bio-parts for next-
generation wanzers.
I was researching the control system,
so I had no way of knowing the
details...
But if those are being produced, then
there's no doubt a plan is under way
to fit them to the X-00 type that
was prototyped under the PS Plan.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_086.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...They're biological parts for next-generation WAPs. / We were researching the control system, / so I had no way of knowing the details, / but... / The fact that those are being produced means / there's no doubt a plan is in progress to repurpose them / for the X-00 type prototyped in the PS plan.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_087.en:
What?
There are more of those prototypes?
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_087.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What? / That prototype still remained...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_088.en:
So it seems...
Without Dr. Aisha's project team,
Organization B cannot develop the
X-00 on its own at present.
Most likely some remnants sold
themselves off along with the whole
PS Plan facility.
But time has passed since then.
We can safely assume it outperforms
the machine we fought.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_088.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So it seems... / At present, lacking Doctor Aisha's / project team, / Organization B can't develop X-00 / on its own. / There were probably remnants who sold themselves / along with the whole PS plan facility. / But time has passed since then. / There's no doubt its performance is higher / than the unit we fought.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_089.en:
An X-00 rev., then.
We can't let that machine go into
mass production...
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_089.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So it's an X-00 Kai. / We can't let that unit / be mass-produced...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_090.en:
Exactly.
We have to destroy every one of
them...
Captain «E801:00», please let me go
with «E801:00» Squad.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_090.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / We must destroy all of those units... / Captain «E801:00», please let me accompany / the «E801:00» squad too.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_091.en:
It's too dangerous.
We'll get the mission done on our own.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_091.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's dangerous. / We'll carry out the mission by ourselves.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_092.en:
...I know the danger.
But I don't believe that machine can
operate on its own.
It must have some weakness.
If I'm there, I may be able to guide
you...
Besides... I don't want my research
to hurt anyone else...
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_092.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I'm aware of the danger. / But I don't think that unit can / operate on its own. / There must be some kind of weakness. / If I go to the site, I may be able / to give instructions... / Besides... I don't want my research / to hurt anyone else...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_093.en:
So we protect Aisha while she
analyses its weaknesses...
I understand how you feel, but...
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_093.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So we escort Aisha / and have her analyze the weakness... / I understand how you feel, but...

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_094.en:
The X-00 rev.'s performance and
numbers are both unknown.
But if it has a weakness, we can
gain the upper hand.
...I ask this of you as well,
Captain «E801:00».
Follow her advice on site.
If this goes on, it will drag in not
only her but the families of every
researcher.
That is not what they did their
research for.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_094.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: X-00 Kai's performance and number of units are both unknown. / But if there's something that's a weakness, / we should be able to proceed advantageously. / ...I ask you too. / Captain «E801:00». / Follow her advice on site. / If this affair continues, not only her but / the families of all the researchers will be dragged in. / They didn't do research / for something like this.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_095.en:
A tragedy that swallows everyone...
Roger.
Aisha, get ready to board the large
mobile weapon.
Roy, I'm borrowing one veteran pilot.
We'll prepare to sortie.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_095.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A tragedy that drags in everyone... / Roger. / Aisha, prepare to board a large mobile weapon. / Roy, I'm borrowing a veteran pilot. / Preparing to sortie.

MsgLabels_station_58_msg_096.en:
The X-00 rev.'s performance and
numbers are both unknown.
But it may have a weakness.
Follow her advice on site.
MsgLabels_station_58_msg_096.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: X-00 Kai's performance and number of units are both unknown. / But there may be something that's a weakness. / Follow her advice on site.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_001.en:
No sign of the garrison.
...There. The experimental machine.
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No garrison in sight. / ...There it is, the experimental unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_002.en:
Contact confirmed.
Aisha, sending you the feed.
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Unit confirmed. / Aisha, transferring the footage.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_003.en:
I see it.
The type is... X-00...
The same type as the Vampire.
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I can see it. / The type is... X-00... / The same type as the Vampire unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Vampire...!!

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Those bastards.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Are they still going to add more victims...

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_007.en:
I count one by sight.
We hit it before the garrison shows.
Aisha, hold back in the rear.
Keep watching the monitors.
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Visually, there's 1 unit. / We'll launch a surprise attack before the garrison appears. / Aisha's unit stand by in the rear. / Continue monitor surveillance, please.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes!

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_009.en:
Aisha, if there's any footage you
want, just say so.
I'll do my best to get it!
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aisha, if there's footage you want, / tell me. / I'll do my best to shoot it!

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Counting on you, Oddeye!

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Starting the mission.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_012.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit or
Aisha unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down or / Aisha's vehicle shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_014.en:
A surprise attack!?
What is the defense unit doing!
Dammit, send out the experimental
machine!!
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A surprise attack!? / What is the defense unit doing! / Damn it, put out the experimental unit!!

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_015.en:
Hey, what are you saying...?
There's no guarantee it'll run
properly!
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hey, what are you saying...? / There's no guarantee of normal operation!

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_016.en:
Who cares? You wanted combat data,
didn't you?
Here's your chance.
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Doesn't matter, you wanted live combat data, right? / Isn't this a good opportunity.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_017.en: Don't blame me for what happens...
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I don't care what happens...

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Experimental unit activated!

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_019.en:
No control cables...
Are they saying it won't go
berserk...?
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Without even a control cable... / Are they saying it won't go berserk...?

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_020.en:
It moves completely differently from
the last one.
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Its movements are clearly different from the previous unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_021.en:
If anything, it's worse than a
normal wanzer.
All units, concentrate fire. Finish
it in one go.
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If anything it's below a normal WAP. / All units, concentrate firepower and annihilate it in one go.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_022.en:
Experimental machine silenced.
More enemy reinforcements.
It's the garrison.
Multiple contacts on radar.
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed experimental unit silenced. / Continuing enemy reinforcements. / It's the garrison. / Multiple units confirmed on radar.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_023.en:
That experimental machine was
awfully easy...
We'll sweep the second wave too.
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The experimental unit put up awfully little fight... / Continue sweeping the second wave as well.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_024.en:
That experimental machine wasn't
running properly, I think.
It doesn't seem to have had a core
installed.
The pilot was probably an ordinary
test pilot.
...Hm? Champ!
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The experimental unit earlier doesn't seem / to have been operating normally. / It doesn't seem to have the core installed either. / I think the pilot was / an ordinary test pilot. / ...Huh? Champ!

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hm, what's wrong?

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_026.en:
Can you zoom in on the footage from
fifteen seconds ago?
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The footage from 15 seconds ago, can you / show it zoomed in again?

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_027.en:
Fifteen seconds...
Hang on...
Around here?
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: 15 seconds... / Hang on... / Around here?

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_028.en: Nope, three seconds too far back.
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, 3 seconds too far back.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_029.en:
Too far back... Picky, aren't ya...
Around here?
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Too far back... that's subtle... / Around here?

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Yes, there. / That footage.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Is there something?

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_032.en:
Mm. Some of my assistants are in it.
Once the experiments are over, they
may be quietly disposed of too...
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yes, several of my assistants / are in it. / Once the experiment is over, they too / may be secretly eliminated...

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_033.en: Sounds like we oughta get 'em out.
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Seems we'd better rescue them.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Captain, is it possible?

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_035.en:
We won't know until we try...
But I promise we'll rescue and free
as many of the researchers as we can.
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We won't know until we try, but... / I promise to rescue and free the researchers / as far as possible.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thank you!

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_037.en:
...So this is the strength of the
merc unit that wiped out the
Vampires.
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...So this is the power of the mercenary unit / that destroyed the Vampires.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_038.en:
Wh-what!?
THESE are the ones...?
Forget the data, then...
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wh-what!? / These guys are... / This is way beyond data...

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So, what now? / Chief.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_040.en:
Then we throw in every experimental
machine we have...
Hurry up and install the cores!
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If it's come to this, deploy all experimental units... / Hurry the core installation work!

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_041.en:
Are you out of your mind...?
The core system isn't finished.
The moment it's installed, it'll go
berserk...!
Make do with the test pilots!
(My, they move well. With Dr. Brown
gone, the research here is finished
anyway.
Perhaps I'll slip away in all this
chaos too...)
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Are you sane...? / The core system is incomplete. / The moment it's installed it'll go berserk...! / Make do with test pilots! / (I see, good movements. Since Doctor Brown / ran away, the research here / is probably over. / Maybe I'll escape too in this confusion...)

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_042.en:
Wh-what, all the experimental
machines destroyed...?
I-I surrender!
We're abandoning the base!
Don't shoooot!!
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A-all experimental units destroyed... / I-I surrender! / We're abandoning this place! / Don't shoot!!

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_043.en:
What's going on...?
Someone who seems to be the enemy
commander says he's surrendering...
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What does this mean...? / Someone who seems to be the enemy commander / says he's surrendering...

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_044.en:
Oh dear. The enemy big shot's gone
all to pieces.
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aww, the enemy's important-looking person / is all confused.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_045.en:
...Looks like he won't be blowing
himself up this time.
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...They don't seem to be self-destructing this time.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gray, Champ, free the researchers.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger, securing a vehicle.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_048.en:
Rain, you're with me. We take the
surrendering enemy into custody.
If they make any suspicious moves,
you're cleared to fire.
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rain, secure the surrendering enemies with me. / If they show suspicious movement, / you're permitted to attack.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_049.en:
Roger.
Those surrendering, over here!
Drop your weapons and line up!
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Those surrendering, over here! / Disarm and line up!

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_050.en:
Aisha, check the facility with
Oddeye.
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Aisha, check the facility / with Oddeye.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_051.en:
Understood.
...Oh, good. Everyone looks all right.
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / ...Good, everyone looks well.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Y-you saved me...

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Huh, Doctor Gilmore?

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_054.en:
That voice... Dr. Aisha...
You're alive!
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That voice, Doctor Aisha... / You were alive!

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_055.en:
So you were at this facility.
Is Dr. Brown with you?
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So you were at this facility. / Is Doctor Brown with you too?

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_056.en: Dr. Brown ran off three days ago.
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Doctor Brown ran away / 3 days ago.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_057.en: Oh, I see... I hope he's safe...
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh really... I hope he's safe...

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_058.en:
I can't guarantee it's safe here yet.
Sorry, but could you continue this
back at base?
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We can't guarantee this place is safe yet. / Sorry, but could you continue / the talk at the base?

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_059.en:
Ah, my apologies.
Oh, and I'll be staying with an
acquaintance, if that's all right.
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ah, my apologies. / Also, I'll be staying at an acquaintance's house.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_060.en:
I see. If that suits you, we'll
release you here.
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see, if that's fine, I'll release you / right here.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_061.en:
That would be most helpful.
I'd hate to lose precious time to
a debriefing...
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That'd help. / I don't want to lose precious time / to questioning...

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_062.en:
You hear that, Champ?
That Larcus research facility we
scouted got destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Did you hear, Champ? / The Larcus research facility we went / to reconnoiter apparently got destroyed.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_063.en:
The announcement says the OCU
military did it.
Goin' by the timing, it wasn't us,
though...
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The announcement says it was / the O.C.U. army's doing. / Judging by the time, it doesn't seem / to be us, though...

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What's wrong? / Trouble?

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_065.en:
No, Captain. The researchers told us
to watch the TV...
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No, Captain, the researchers told us to watch TV...

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_066.en:
...I see.
That facility.
They've used their favourite trick,
destroying evidence, to manipulate
the news...
But whatever the truth, the
ceasefire treaty has been broken.
There's no doubt a war will start
over this.
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I see. / That facility. / It's probably information manipulation using / their specialty of crushing evidence... / But whatever the truth, the ceasefire treaty / has been broken. / There's no doubt war will start / with this as the trigger.

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_067.en:
All those weapons being shipped onto
the island...
Were they expecting this...?
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_067.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The large amounts of weapons brought onto the island... / were they anticipating this...

MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_068.en:
...This conflict may be following a
script.
Well, a major battle may be coming.
We'll head back and get the wanzers
serviced.
MsgLabels_tactics_58_msg_068.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...This conflict may have / a script. / Now, a big battle may happen. / We'll also return to base and maintain the WAPs.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This broadcast again...

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_002.en:
A medical facility blown up...
That kind of thing happens all the
time on this island, so why are they
zooming in on Larcus...?
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A medical facility bombing... / Even though incidents like this are common on this island, / why are they only spotlighting / Larcus...

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_003.en:
The same TV coverage, over and
over...
It feels deliberate.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The same TV broadcast for a while now... / I sense something deliberate.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_004.en:
It could be.
Someone may be using the mass media
to steer public opinion.
What happened to our report, I
wonder...
It should have reached the mainland
through the investigator.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's possible. / Someone may be using the mass media / to manipulate the public's / consciousness. / What happened to our report... / It should have gone to the home country / through the Investigator.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_005.en:
The footage we took inside the
facility hasn't been shown at all...
And calling it a military factory
instead of a research facility...
I think that's a kind of mind control,
too.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The footage of the facility's interior we shot / hasn't been reported... / That it's being reported not as a research facility / but as a military factory / is also a kind of mind control, I think.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_006.en:
Looks like both armies are making
official statements.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There seem to be official announcements from both armies.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_007.en:
This broadcast is being carried live
around the world.
We now bring you a statement from
Brigadier General Winger of the USN
army.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: This broadcast is being relayed simultaneously worldwide. / Now, please listen to the announcement / of U.S.N. Brigadier General Winger.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_008.en:
...The munitions factory in the USN's
Larcus district has been destroyed
by an attack from four OCU wanzers,
and sixty-two workers have lost
their precious lives.
...Here on Huffman Island, where
tensions have never eased, this
incident has trampled on the welfare
and happiness of humanity itself.
We regard it as a declaration of war
by the OCU military...
and we hereby renounce the ceasefire
treaty that has held for years.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...A munitions factory in the Larcus district / of U.S.N. territory was destroyed by an attack / of 4 vanzers belonging to the O.C.U., / and the precious lives of 62 workers were lost. / ...On this Huffman Island, where tension / never ceases even now, we determine this incident, / which trampled even the welfare and happiness / of us humans, to be the O.C.U. army's / declaration of war, / ...and the ceasefire treaty of several years, / we hereby annul.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The Second Huffman Conflict...

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_010.en:
...Furthermore, despite the ceasefire,
our bases on the island have already
suffered repeated attacks by OCU
mercenaries and insurgent forces,
costing the lives of many brave
officers and soldiers...
...In response, we have decided to
dispatch twenty thousand troops and
supplies from the homeland, and will
prepare to resist to the last.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Furthermore, despite the ceasefire treaty, / our army's local bases have already received / repeated attacks by O.C.U. mercenaries / and resistance forces, and in those battles / we lost the precious lives of many officers and soldiers... / ...In response, we have decided to dispatch / 20,000 soldiers and supplies from the home country, / and intend to prepare for all-out resistance.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_011.en:
What is he talking about...
They're already deployed...
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What is he saying... / The deployment is already in place, isn't it...

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_013.en:
Next, a statement from the OCU
military.
...
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Next, a statement from the O.C.U. army. / ...

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_014.en:
Captain, where are you going?
The OCU statement hasn't aired yet...
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, where are you going? / The O.C.U. side's announcement isn't over yet...

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_015.en:
...It's obviously going to be war.
No need to watch.
You should all think about getting
ready to leave the island.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...It's clear it'll be a conflict. / No need to watch. / Maybe everyone should get ready / to leave this island.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_016.en:
Ready...?
So we really are getting out of the
merc business?
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Get ready... / So mercenary work is finished after all?

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_017.en:
After this, mercs won't be needed
to hold the front line.
...Besides, we've already seen the
army's dark side.
Wherever they post us, we could be
disposed of.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: With this, there'll be no more work for mercenaries / maintaining the front line. / ...Besides, we've already touched / the army's dark side. / We could be disposed of wherever we're assigned.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Like Falcon...

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_019.en:
...But leaving the island is
dangerous, too.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...But leaving the island is dangerous too.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_020.en:
Exactly.
Not even intel sent through CISU sees
the light of day.
I'll go to headquarters and see if
there's a way out.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / Even information through C.I.S.U. / doesn't come out in public. / I'll go negotiate with headquarters to see if there's some way.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger...

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_022.en:
War...
I wonder if Father and my brother
will go to the front...
But me...
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: War... / Will Father and my brother, everyone, join the war... / But I...

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_023.en:
An operation to make an impression...
Understood.
I'll get ready to sortie at once.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: An operation to make an impression... / Roger. / I'll prepare to sortie right away.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_024.en:
Rear support, huh...
Not my style...
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Rear support... / doesn't suit me...

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_025.en:
Ho, an operation to make an
impression?
That's easy!
I'll put on a real show!
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hoh, an operation to make an impression. / That's easy! / I'll go all out!

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_026.en:
Captain, what do I do...?
I've got a mountain of stuff...
I should've rented a storage unit
back home...
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, what do I do... / I have mountains of personal stuff... / If I'd known, I would have rented / a storage unit back home...

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_027.en:
The last mission...?
Got it, I'll get ready!
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The last mission...? / Understood, I'll get ready!

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_028.en:
So if we stay mercs, we're just
dancing to someone else's tune.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even if we keep being mercenaries like this, / we're just being made to dance.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_029.en:
The last mission...
Roger.
Let's make an impression they won't
forget.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Last mission... / Roger. / Let's leave an impression with all we've got.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_030.en:
So it's finally war.
The parts of this island they call
paradise...
I never did get to see them.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's finally becoming war. / The part of this island called paradise... / In the end I never got to know it.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_031.en:
All right.
I'll help get everyone's things
packed.
...I'll be waiting for you all to
come back.
Good luck out there!
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood. / I'll help with everyone's packing. / ...I'll be waiting for everyone to come back. / Take care!

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_032.en:
So it's war after all...
Just my luck...
Now I can't go home even if I want to.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So the war's starting after all... / What bad luck... / Now I can't go home even if I want to.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_033.en:
Bingo!«g:24»
Knew there'd be a war!«g:24»
But even if I collect, will I ever
get a chance to spend it?«g:24»
Hadn't thought that far.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Bingo!«g:24» / I knew the war would definitely start!«g:24» / But even if I get the money, / will I have a chance to use it?«g:24» / I didn't think that far.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_034.en:
So the intel was right after all...
Lloyd Clive's unit... they got used,
plain and simple...
Hm?«g:24» Oh, Lloyd's that top regular
soldier I told you about before.
Looks like they made him the spark
that started the war.
I wonder what'll happen to his unit...
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So the information was right after all...... / Lloyd Clive's unit / got used as it suited them...... / Hm?«g:24» Ah, Lloyd is / the excellent regular army soldier I mentioned before. / He apparently got made into the trigger for the war. / I'm worried about how his unit will be treated...

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_035.en:
Thanks to the last operation,
Organization B has effectively been
dismantled.
In the end, USN engineers were
involved behind it, but sadly the
link to the OCU leadership that we
were chasing remains unknown.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thanks to the last operation, Organization B / was effectively dismantled. / In the end, U.S.N. engineers were involved / behind Organization B, but / unfortunately the connection to the O.C.U. upper echelons / we were pursuing remains unknown.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_036.en:
And at the same time, the Second
Huffman Conflict breaks out...
And the trigger, I hear, was the
bombing of that facility in Larcus
we scouted.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: And at the same time, / the outbreak of the Second Huffman Conflict... / And it was triggered by the Larcus district / we reconnoitered before... / the bombing of that facility.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_037.en:
I know what you are getting at,
Captain «E801:00».
Even if the conflict was staged, the
enemy is too vast. We have no
magic bullet against it.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I understand what you want to say, Captain «E801:00». / Even if it's an engineered conflict, the enemy / is too huge, and there's no silver bullet against it.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_038.en: So not even CISU can touch them.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: To think even C.I.S.U. can't lay a hand on it.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_039.en:
That stings.
From now on, holding the front line
is the regular army's job.
The mainland has ordered us home.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That hurts to hear. / From now on, maintaining the front line will be / the regular army's job. / An order came from the home country to come back.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_040.en:
The hunt for evidence on whoever's
behind the Vampires and Organization
B isn't over.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The search for evidence of the organization behind / the Vampires and Organization B isn't over.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_041.en:
...That organization's influence
appears to be behind the recall
order as well.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...The return order seems to have that organization's / power at work too.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_042.en:
...Then going home would be walking
right into our own executions.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Then it's like going / to get killed for nothing.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_043.en:
So far, no one in CISU has been
harmed.
In other words, if we pull out of
the island now, they will most likely
leave us alone.
But leaving Huffman also means our
contract with you will end...
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: So far, no one in C.I.S.U. / has been harmed. / In other words, if we pull out of this island here, / they probably won't do anything. / However, leaving Huffman / will also end my contract with you...

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_044.en:
I see...
Roy, I have a favor to ask.
Could CISU keep on even a few of my
squad?
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see... / Roy, I have a request. / Could C.I.S.U. continue to take on / even some members of our squad?

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_045.en:
...Captain «E801:00», are you serious?
You would lose your freedom as
mercenaries entirely.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Captain «E801:00», are you serious? / You'll completely lose your freedom / as mercenaries.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_046.en:
If we stay mercs, we'll never get a
shot at an enemy that big.
We'd just end up killed wherever
they post us.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even if we continue as mercenaries, it doesn't look like / we can fight the huge enemy. / We'd just end up killed where we're sent.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_047.en:
True.
Very well. If everyone agrees, I will
hire you all as my own action unit.
You will come with me to the
mainland.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / Good, if everyone is willing, / I'll hire all of you / as my direct action unit. / You'll go to the home country with me.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_048.en:
Thank you.
I'll ask each of them whether they
want to join.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Thank you. / I'll ask each member / whether they intend to join this unit.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_049.en:
Understood.
But first, I want you to carry out
one last mission as Huffman's
mercenaries.
Wipe out the USN Marines approaching
the front line: in other words,
this base.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Understood. / But as Huffman mercenaries, / I want you to carry out one last mission. / Sweep away the U.S.N. Marines approaching / the front line, in other words this base.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_050.en:
Units are reaching the front line
already?
But what's the point of fighting the
USN?
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There are already units reaching the front line? / But is there any point / in fighting the U.S.N.?

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_051.en:
The media.
Footage of us defeating USN soldiers
will be broadcast worldwide, over the
World Net and television.
It will mark you, back home, as the
unit that won the first battle.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The mass media. / The scenes of us defeating U.S.N. soldiers / will be broadcast to the whole world / via the World Net and television. / We'll make an impression on the home country / as the unit that won the first battle's honors.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_052.en:
I see.
You're as thorough as ever.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / Shrewd as ever.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_053.en:
I will file the paperwork with each
department, so that «E801:00» Squad
can leave Huffman as soon as it
returns.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll file procedures with each department. / So that the «E801:00» squad can leave Huffman / right after returning.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Preparing for the «E801:00» squad's last sortie.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_055.en:
I want you to carry out one last
mission as Huffman's mercenaries.
Wipe out the USN Marines approaching
this base.
This battle will make the world
remember us.
Hold nothing back.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As Huffman mercenaries, / I want you to carry out one last mission. / Sweep away the U.S.N. Marines / approaching this base. / It's a battle to impress us upon the world. / Go wild to your heart's content.

MsgLabels_station_59_msg_056.en:
The bombing of a research facility...
This would later be known as the
Larcus Incident.
MsgLabels_station_59_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The bombing of the research facility... / This is what would later be called the Larcus Incident.

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_001.en:
USN Marine wanzer unit confirmed.
At least eleven of them.
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed U.S.N. Marines WAP squad. / At least 11 in number.

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_002.en:
War, huh...
It doesn't feel real somehow.
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: War, huh... / It somehow doesn't feel real.

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_003.en:
Once you're in a wanzer, it's all the
same.
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Once you're in a WAP, it's the same thing.

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_004.en:
Well, our last mission.
Captain, we're supposed to make it
flashy, right?
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Now, the last mission. / Captain, we just need to go all out, right?

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_005.en:
That's right.
Make sure they remember we were here.
All units, commence attack.
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right. / Leave the impression / that we were here. / All units, begin the attack.

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_006.en:
Ha ha ha!
Now that's a mission I can get
behind!
Champ, goin' in!
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hahaha! / That's a good mission! / Champ's unit, here I go!

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_007.en:
Marines, huh.
Let's see how well they've trained.
Gray here. Sniping the center wanzer
to knock the wind out of them.
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Marines, huh. / Now, how much training have they done? / Gray's unit, snipe the center WAP / and nip them in the bud.

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_008.en:
All sensors in the green!
Target lock...
Oddeye here. Taking out the arms and
legs of the right-flank wanzers!
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All sensors' sensitivity good! / Target lock... / Oddeye's unit, destroying the right-flank WAP squad's / arms and legs!

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Captain, let's go too.

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_010.en:
Roger, Rain.
«E801:00» and Rain, moving in close.
We'll throw their ranks into chaos.
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_010.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger, Rain. / «E801:00»'s unit, Rain's unit, get into the enemy's bosom / and throw the enemy unit into disorder.

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_011.en:
Victory: Destroy all enemy units.
Defeat: «E801:00» unit destroyed.
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies. / Defeat condition: «E801:00»'s unit shot down.

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_013.en:
What the hell are these guys...
Charging in with just five machines!
...We're the Marines, dammit!
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What are these guys... / They're charging in with just 5 units! / ...We're Marines, you know!?

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_014.en:
They move nothing like any wanzer
we've seen...
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Their movements are too different from the WAPs so far...

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units, move as in the simulations!

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_016.en:
We ARE...
It's not working at all!
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We are... / It's not working at all!

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_017.en:
Wh-what...
Then what the hell are we supposed
to do!?
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Wh-what... / Then what are we supposed to do.

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I-it's impossible, something like this...

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_019.en:
More enemy contacts.
Quite a lot of them, but...
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: More enemy units appearing. / Quite a lot of them, but...

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Fragile... rookies?

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_021.en:
Could be.
Slow reactions... and above all, no
experience.
Come on, just run away already...
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Maybe so. / Their reactions are slow... and above all they lack experience. / Please, just run away already...

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_022.en:
All units, show them what real
combat is.
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All units, teach them / that this is real combat.

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger...

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_024.en:
Oh god...
So this is real combat...
This is the front line...
It's a nightmare...
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What the hell... / This is real combat... / This is the front line... / It's a nightmare...

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed U.S.N. Marines silenced. / Or they withdrew.

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_026.en:
...Missed the vitals on every one
of 'em.
Left 'em enough to make it home.
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...I avoided vital spots on every unit. / They've got enough function left to escape.

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Sorry, Captain, me too.

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_028.en:
Against rookies like that, I just
couldn't aim for the cockpit...
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Against rookies like those, / I can't hit / the cockpits...

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_029.en:
Same here.
I couldn't bring myself to do it...
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Me too. / I really felt reluctant...

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_030.en:
That's fine.
This mission was never about
slaughter.
Objective complete.
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's fine. / This mission's goal isn't slaughter. / The mission is complete.

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Now, what do we do from here.

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_032.en:
If we stay on Huffman, they'll
probably stick the mercs in rear
support.
I've seen it happen before.
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even if we stay on Huffman, mercenaries / will probably be assigned to rear support units. / I've seen that kind of thing before.

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I don't want that...

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_034.en:
Even if we keep on as mercs, we know
too much now.
Our own side might kill us.
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even if we continue as mercenaries, / we've learned too much. / We might be killed by our own side.

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_035.en:
There's no going back now...
But what do we do...?
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There's no turning back now... / But what should we do...

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_036.en:
This is where «E801:00» Squad's
mission ends.
Mercenaries can't get involved any
further.
So... I asked Roy, and got us jobs
at CISU.
I'll lose my freedom as a merc, but
I intend to go.
There's a place for each of you, but
the choice is yours.
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The «E801:00» squad's mission / ends with this. / Mercenaries can't intervene any further. / Now... I asked Roy and got / employment at C.I.S.U. / We'll lose our freedom as mercenaries, but / I intend to go. / There are seats for everyone too, but what you do is your choice.

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_037.en:
Wait, not as temps?
The actual CISU action unit?
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Eh, not temporary hire, / C.I.S.U.'s action unit?

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_038.en:
We know this much of the truth, and
still we can't make a move.
Anything we do would just get
smothered by something bigger.
But if I work with Roy, I thought,
maybe someday we'll drag the truth
into the light.
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Even knowing the truth this far, / we can't move. / We'd just end up erased / by a huge presence. / But I thought if I work with Roy, / someday there might be a day / we expose the truth.

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_039.en:
It's true, there's only so much we
can do as mercs.
With CISU, we might get to the truth
about Commander Falcon, and all the
other cases that got swept under
the rug...
Captain, take me with you.
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: True, as mercenaries / there are limits. / With C.I.S.U., we might be able to uncover the truth / about Commander Falcon and / other matters that were left vague... / Captain, take me with you too.

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_040.en:
Heh, Gray on his own'd be a little
lonely, right?
Guess I'll tag along too.
Eh, I've saved up plenty anyway.
The merc business is closin' up shop!
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hoh, just Gray would be uneasy, right? / I'll come along too, okay? / What, I've saved plenty of money, / I'm closing up the mercenary business!

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_041.en:
If that's the case, I want to come
too!
Back to being a civil servant!
You're coming too, right, Rain?
The whole «E801:00» Squad joins CISU!
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If that's how it is, I want to come / along too! / I'll go back to being a civil servant! / Miss Rain, you're going too, right? / The whole «E801:00» squad / joins C.I.S.U.!

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_042.en:
I... I'm not like my father and
brother.
I became a mercenary because I didn't
want to join any official
organization...
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I... am different from my father and brother. / I became a mercenary because I didn't want / to join a public organization...

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_043.en:
......
Rain, do you remember what I said
when I became captain...?
That with me as captain, the squad
would never hold together.
At CISU, unlike merc work, a lot of
missions will call for delicate
judgement.

Rain, I need you.
Come with me.
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...... / Rain, do you remember what I said / when I became captain...? / With me as captain, the squad won't hold together. / At C.I.S.U., unlike mercenaries, / there will probably be many missions / requiring delicate judgment. /  / Rain, I need you. / Come with me.

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_045.en: Whoa, that kinda made me jump...
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Ooh, that surprised me a little...

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_046.en:
Yeah...
Thought he was proposin' for a
second there...
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Yeah... / I thought it was a proposal...

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_047.en:
Ha ha. But honestly, without Rain,
this squad would fall apart...
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Haha, but without Miss Rain, our squad / really wouldn't hold together...

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_048.en:
Honestly...
So I'm just the squad's mom, huh...
Well... I suppose that's not so bad.
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Honestly... / In the end I'm the squad's mom... / Well, that's not so bad either...

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_049.en:
At CISU, we'll be getting close to
the heart of it.
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: At C.I.S.U., we'll be touching / the heart of things.

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's what I want!

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_051.en: You may die in your first battle.
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: We may be killed in the first battle.

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_052.en:
I made my peace with that the day
I became a merc!
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I made up my mind about that / when I became a mercenary!

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_053.en:
Through some scheme, one of our own
may become an enemy.
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Through a scheme, one of our comrades / may become an enemy.

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_054.en: I hate the thought... but I'm ready.
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'd hate it, but... I'm prepared.

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_055.en:
There's also a chance of
assassination from within.
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There's also the possibility of assassination from within.

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I've fully anticipated it!

MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_057.en:
...All right.
«E801:00» Squad, mercenary unit.
All missions complete.
Returning to base!
MsgLabels_tactics_59_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...Good. / Mercenary unit «E801:00» squad, / all missions cleared. / Returning to base now!

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_001.en:
...And three years went by.

The Second Huffman Conflict was
already over.
In that conflict, the PS Plan that
«E801:00» Squad had once witnessed
bore fruit as a weapon called B.D.,
and took many lives. But it, too,
became a system of the past.

2093.
«E801:00» and the others had left the
CISU action unit for Delta, the
long-suspended special forces of the
Ground Defense Force's 2nd Army
Mobile Division.
Now they were carrying out a new
mission...
MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: ...And 3 years passed. /  / The Second Huffman Conflict had already / ended. / In this conflict, the PS plan the «E801:00» squad / had witnessed in the past bore fruit as a weapon / called B.D., and took many lives, / but that too became / a system of the past. /  / 2093. / «E801:00» and the others / transferred from C.I.S.U.'s action unit / to the frozen / Ground Defense Force 2nd Army Mobile Division special forces, Delta, / and were carrying out new missions...

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_002.en:
Enemy machines confirmed.
Sending target coordinates to all
units.
Gray Squad, Champ Squad, deploy as
planned.
Don't be late, okay?
MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_002.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Enemy units confirmed. / Transferring target coordinates to all units. / Gray squad, Champ squad, deploy / as planned. / Don't be late.

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_003.en:
Heh, like MY squad's ever late.
Gray Squad, keep up with us, got it?
Champ Squad, goin' in!
MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_003.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Heh, there's no way our squad would be late, right? / Gray squad, match the timing, okay? / Champ squad, here we go!

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_004.en:
Oh, come on, Champ.
Who do you think cleared the road
for you...
Gray Squad, commencing sniping.
MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_004.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: What's that, Champ. / Who do you think made the path for you... / Gray squad, beginning sniping.

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_005.en:
Roger.
All squads ready.
Assault team, proceed to the point
as planned.
MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_005.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / All squads ready. / Assault unit, head to the point / as planned.

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_006.en:
Roger.
Assault team advancing.
Rain, Tornado, follow me.
MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_006.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Assault unit advancing. / Rain, Tornado, follow me.

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_007.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger.

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_008.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: All squads, begin assault.

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_009.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Victory condition: shoot down all enemies.

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_011.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Assault unit reached the point.

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_012.en:
Roger.
Well, well, here comes the boss.
Careful, everyone.
MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_012.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Now then, here comes the boss character. / All squads, be careful.

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_013.en: Huh. Rare kind of special machine.
MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_013.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hoh, a rare special unit.

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_014.en:
Five of the damn things...
What's the call, Major?
MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_014.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: There are 5 of them... / What do we do, Major?

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_015.en:
No problem.
We wipe them out.
MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_015.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: No problem. / Sweep them.

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_016.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Confirmed all enemy units silenced.

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_017.en:
(Hm? This cockpit looks like a
B.D. unit's...)
...Oddeye, contact headquarters.
MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_017.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: (Hm? This cockpit / resembles a B.D. unit's.) / ...Oddeye, contact headquarters.

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_018.en:
Roger.
Aisha, can you hear me?
MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_018.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Aisha, can you hear me?

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_019.en: Oh my, that was quick. Already done?
MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_019.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Oh, that was fast, it's already over?

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_020.en:
We are, but...
looks like the Major's found
something pretty incredible.
Sending you the data now.
MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_020.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: That's right, but... / the Major seems to have found / something outrageous. / I'm transferring the data now.

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_021.en:
Let's see, now...
Hm?
This... it can't be B.D.?
But it's slightly different from the
ones that were in circulation...
And research for anything but
medical use is supposed to be
banned...
This... could really be something.
Could you capture one so we can
examine it?
MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_021.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Umm, let's see... / Huh? / Could this be a B.D.? / But it's subtly different from the ones that circulated... / But research other than for medical purposes / should be prohibited... / This might... really be outrageous. / For now, can we capture it and investigate?

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_022.en:
Two or three cockpits, we can
probably manage.
MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_022.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: If it's 2 or 3 units' cockpits, / it looks manageable.

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_023.en: Maybe I went a little overboard...
MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_023.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Maybe I went a bit too far...

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_024.en:
Another incident report...
I've got a stack of 'em already.
MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_024.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Another written apology... / They're piling up.

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_025.en:
OK, Rain, over to you.
Aisha, did you get that?
MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_025.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: OK, then Miss Rain, please. / Aisha, did you hear?

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_026.en:
I heard.
This souvenir might even be worth a
medal.
But to think B.D. would be used in
war again...
MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_026.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'm listening. / This time's souvenir might be worth a medal. / But, B.D. being used / in war again...

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_027.en: Making sure it isn't is our job.
MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_027.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Not letting that happen is our job.

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_028.en:
Mission complete.
All squads, return to base.
MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_028.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Mission over. / All squads return to base.

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_029.en:
Roger.
Champ Squad headin' home.
Man, though... Ain't we ever gonna
get a real fight again, like back on
Huffman?
MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_029.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Roger. / Champ squad heading back. / Aww, but won't an enemy worth fighting / like back on Huffman ever show up.

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_030.en:
Gray Squad returning too.
Champ, if you say stuff like that...
MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_030.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Gray squad returning too. / Champ, if you say unnecessary things...

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_031.en:
Champ!
A world where we don't have to fight
at all is the best one, isn't it!
Honestly. When we get back, I'll have
the Major put you in a joint lock
again.
MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Champ! / A world where we don't need to fight / is best, isn't it! / Honestly, when we get back to base, I'll have to / have the Major put a joint lock on you again.

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_032.en:
Whoa, whoa, nobody gets out of the
Major's joint lock!
My bad, I take it back.
Peace is the best.
I'm sorryyy.
MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Whoa whoa, the Major's joint locks can never be escaped! / I was wrong, I apologize. / Peace is best. / I'm sorryyy.

MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_033.en:
Hee hee.
Good work, everyone.
Well then... looks like I'm pulling
an all-nighter...
MsgLabels_tactics_60_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Hehehe. / Everyone, good work. / Well then, tonight's an all-nighter...

MsgLabels_station_60_msg_001.en:
The fight by «E801:00» Squad and
CISU to uncover the truth bore fruit
at last. In 2094, the OCU and the
USN both admitted their involvement
in the Sakata Industries affair
during the Second Huffman Conflict.
With that, every conspiracy
surrounding the PS Plan, Organization
B, and in the end the weapon called
B.D., seemed to have been brought to
light.
But what shadow would the new B.D.
that Delta found cast over the
future...?
«E801:00» and the others had no way
of knowing yet.
MsgLabels_station_60_msg_001.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The «E801:00» squad and C.I.S.U.'s battle to uncover the truth bore fruit, and at last in 2094, both nations, the O.C.U. and U.S.N., admitted involvement in the Sakata Industry incident during the Second Huffman Conflict. With this, the conspiracy surrounding the PS plan, Organization B, and in turn the weapon called B.D., seemed to have been entirely uncovered. But what kind of shadow the new B.D. Delta found will cast on the future... «E801:00» and the others have no way of knowing yet.
