MsgLabels_common_msg_031.en:
You're the merc posted here today.
Ask me if anything's unclear.
MsgLabels_common_msg_031.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You're the mercenary assigned starting today. / If there's anything you don't understand, ask me.

MsgLabels_common_msg_032.en:
Oh, it's you.
Ask me if anything's unclear.
MsgLabels_common_msg_032.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's you. / If there's anything you don't understand, ask me.

MsgLabels_common_msg_033.en:
Oh, it's you.
A new system's been added.
Ask me if anything's unclear.
MsgLabels_common_msg_033.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: It's you. / A new system has been added. / If there's anything you don't understand, ask me.

MsgLabels_common_msg_034.en:
There are three main kinds of facility.
Which one do you want to hear about?
MsgLabels_common_msg_034.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Broadly, there are 3 kinds of facilities; / which do you want to know about?

MsgLabels_common_msg_035.en:
Combat's probably more your field...
but ask away. Call it a refresher.
MsgLabels_common_msg_035.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You seem better at battle than me, but... / ask questions as a review too.

MsgLabels_common_msg_036.en:
Alright.
More topics may be added as the
missions go on, so if anything's unclear
then, come and ask me.
MsgLabels_common_msg_036.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / Items may be added as missions progress, / so if there's something you don't understand then, / ask me.

MsgLabels_common_msg_037.en:
[HEADQUARTERS] is where you take on
missions.
In the [BARRACKS] you can talk with
the other mercs.
Some unusual folks turn up there, too.
Also, sometimes you can't get into
[HEADQUARTERS] till you've picked up
info at the other facilities.
Then you can't take a mission, so
make a habit of talking to people.
MsgLabels_common_msg_037.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: [Headquarters] is / the place to accept missions. / At the [Mercenary Station] / you can talk with mercenaries. / Sometimes unusual people seem to come by too. / Also, unless you get information at the facilities / you can enter at the time, there are times you / can't enter [Headquarters]. / If that happens you can't accept missions, / so it's good to listen to people often.

MsgLabels_common_msg_038.en:
In the [HANGAR] you can do your
wanzer [SETUP].
You can [EQUIP PARTS] you own,
of course, and you can also
[BUY AND EQUIP].
Parts you don't need any more can be
turned into cash with [SELL PARTS] or
[SELL UNEQUIPPED PARTS].
In other words, it's a shop as well.

You can also set your [ARMOR TYPE]
and repaint with [WANZER COLOR], all
free of charge.
MsgLabels_common_msg_038.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: In the [Hangar] / you can do the [Setup] / of your WAP (Wanzer). / Of course [Setup with Owned Items], / and you can also do / [Buy and Setup]. / Parts you no longer need / can be turned into funds with / [Sell Parts] or / [Sell Unequipped Parts]. / In other words, it doubles as a shop. /  / Also, for free you can do [Attribute Defense Selection], / and change your WAP's color with / [Unit Color Selection].

MsgLabels_common_msg_039.en:
Besides that, there's [EXIT BASE] to
sortie on the missions you take at HQ,
and [OPS RECORDS], where you can
save and load your data.
Mind you, you can't [EXIT BASE]
until you've taken a mission.

Oh, and there's the [ARENA], a
mock-combat system.
You can win wagers and earn EXP in
virtual battles.
Opponents are also built from your own
combat data, so you can even have a
rematch with a tough enemy.
MsgLabels_common_msg_039.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Otherwise, there's [Leave Base] to sortie / on missions accepted at headquarters, / and [Operation Record] where you can / save and load data. / Though you can't [Leave Base] / without accepting a mission. /  / Ah, also, there's a mock battle system / called the [Arena]. / In virtual battles you can earn bet money / and experience. / Opponents are also made from your / real combat data, so you can rematch / strong enemies too.

MsgLabels_common_msg_040.en:
How far a wanzer can move depends on
its [MOVE] value and the terrain cost.
So some leg parts suit some ground
better than others.

To attack, just put the cursor on the
enemy you want to hit with your
equipped weapon.
If distance, remaining ammo and so on
don't meet a weapon's conditions,
you can't use it.
It's no exaggeration to say attacking
and moving go hand in hand.

On top of that, you can counterattack
if the conditions are right.
It lets you take enemies down on the
counter, so it's a very useful tactic.
The same conditions apply to enemy
counterattacks.
When can you counter, and when will
you be countered?
Know that, and you're a real soldier.
MsgLabels_common_msg_040.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A WAP's movable range is determined by / its [move] value and / terrain cost. / Meaning different leg parts / suit different terrain. /  / To attack with an equipped weapon, / just put the cursor on / the enemy you want to attack. / If the conditions for the weapon you want to use aren't met, / due to enemy distance or remaining ammo etc., / it can't be used. / It's no exaggeration to say it's closely / related to movement. /  / Further, if conditions match, you can counterattack. / It's a way to defeat enemies with counters, / quite an effective tactic. / Counterattacks have the same conditions for enemies. / Under what conditions you can counter, / under what conditions you'll be countered. / If you understand this, they say you're / a full-fledged soldier.

MsgLabels_common_msg_041.en:
[ITEMS] are gone once you use them.
Consumables, in other words.
They're carried in your backpack, so
a backpack with more item slots lets
you take more consumables into
battle.

[REPAIR] restores a part's HP.
Think of it as medicine.
There's also [CHAFF], which lowers
the enemy's accuracy.
Try the rest out in real combat.
Each item comes in several grades,
and the pricier it is, the better.
MsgLabels_common_msg_041.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: [Items] disappear once used. / They're so-called consumables. / They can be loaded on backpacks, / so if you equip a backpack with a large / item capacity, you can take lots of consumables / to the battlefield. /  / [Repair] restores a part's HP. / It's like medicine. / There are also things like [Chaff] / that lower the enemy's hit performance. / Try the rest in real combat. / Items each have types, / and the more expensive, the bigger the effect.

MsgLabels_common_msg_042.en:
Alright.
More topics may be added as the
missions go on, so if anything's unclear
then, come and ask me.
MsgLabels_common_msg_042.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / Items may be added as missions progress, / so if there's something you don't understand then, / ask me.

MsgLabels_common_msg_043.en:
Changing your wanzer's armor type cuts
the damage you take from enemies.
[ANTI-PIERCING] works against
machine guns and the like,
[ANTI-IMPACT] against melee attacks,
shotguns and so on,
and [ANTI-HEAT] against flamethrowers,
missiles and so on.
Some attacks combine types, though,
so watch out.
MsgLabels_common_msg_043.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: By changing the unit's attribute, / you can reduce the damage / received from enemies. / [Anti-penetration attribute] is effective / against machine guns and such, / [anti-impact attribute] against melee attacks / and shotguns etc., / and [anti-heat attribute] / against flamethrowers and missiles etc. / Some attacks have compound attributes, / so be careful.

MsgLabels_common_msg_044.en:
You can repaint your wanzer in any
colors you like.
A loud color won't make you any
easier to hit, either.
Paint your wanzer however you please.
MsgLabels_common_msg_044.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You can change the unit color / to whatever you like. / Even if it's a conspicuous color, it doesn't / become easier to hit. / Set your WAP to whatever coloring you like.

MsgLabels_common_msg_045.en:
Alright.
More topics may be added as the
missions go on, so if anything's unclear
then, come and ask me.
MsgLabels_common_msg_045.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / Items may be added as missions progress, / so if there's something you don't understand then, / ask me.

MsgLabels_common_msg_046.en:
Alright.
More topics may be added as the
missions go on, so if anything's unclear
then, come and ask me.
MsgLabels_common_msg_046.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / Items may be added as missions progress, / so if there's something you don't understand then, / ask me.

MsgLabels_common_msg_047.en:
There are three main kinds of facility.
Which one do you want to hear about?
MsgLabels_common_msg_047.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Broadly, there are 3 kinds of facilities; / which do you want to know about?

MsgLabels_common_msg_048.en:
Combat's probably more your field...
but ask away. Call it a refresher.
MsgLabels_common_msg_048.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: You seem better at battle than me, but... / ask questions as a review too.

MsgLabels_common_msg_049.en:
A link attack is when two wanzers
attack one target at the same time.
Here's the basic flow.
MsgLabels_common_msg_049.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: A link attack is where 2 WAPs / launch a simultaneous attack / on 1 target. / I'll explain the general flow.

MsgLabels_common_msg_050.en: Say we have this wanzer, A...
MsgLabels_common_msg_050.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: For example, this WAP called A and...

MsgLabels_common_msg_051.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: this WAP called B...

MsgLabels_common_msg_052.en:
...and they want to link attack
this enemy unit.
MsgLabels_common_msg_052.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: when launching a link attack / on this enemy unit.

MsgLabels_common_msg_053.en:
First, a character who has learned
the link attack skill has to
trigger the link attack.
...Looks like A has
the skill.
MsgLabels_common_msg_053.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: First, a character who has learned / the link attack skill / needs to activate the link attack. / ...A seems to know / the skill.

MsgLabels_common_msg_054.en:
But there's no link attack in the
command menu.
Link attack only appears as a command
when the conditions are met.
MsgLabels_common_msg_054.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: However, link attack isn't / displayed in the commands. / Link attack appears in the commands / only when conditions are met.

MsgLabels_common_msg_055.en:
These are the conditions.
1: An enemy is in A's attack range.
2: An enemy is in B's attack range.
3: Neither A nor B has ended its turn.
4: The right weapon combination.
MsgLabels_common_msg_055.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The link attack conditions are as follows. / Condition 1: an enemy is within A's attack range. / Condition 2: the enemy is within B's attack range. / Condition 3: neither A nor B has ended its action. / Condition 4: the combination of weapons used.

MsgLabels_common_msg_056.en:
About condition 4:
two weapons of the same type
won't trigger a link attack.
For example, machine gun + machine gun
or missile + missile.
Choose your weapons carefully.
MsgLabels_common_msg_056.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As for condition 4, / weapons of the same type / won't activate a link attack. / For example, machine gun + machine gun, / missile + missile, those / combinations. / Choose weapons carefully.

MsgLabels_common_msg_057.en: Now an enemy is inside B's range.
MsgLabels_common_msg_057.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The enemy has entered B's attack range.

MsgLabels_common_msg_058.en:
Now link attack should be showing
in A's command menu.
MsgLabels_common_msg_058.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Now link attack should be displayed / in A's commands.

MsgLabels_common_msg_059.en:
Let's pick link attack.
Once you choose the command, you then
choose the enemy to attack.
MsgLabels_common_msg_059.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Let's try selecting link attack right away. / When you select the link attack command, / you next select the enemy to attack.

MsgLabels_common_msg_060.en:
For now, let's aim a link attack
at this enemy.
MsgLabels_common_msg_060.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: For now, let's aim a link attack / at this enemy.

MsgLabels_common_msg_061.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Next, choose A's attack weapon.

MsgLabels_common_msg_062.en:
Then pick B to join in
the link attack.
MsgLabels_common_msg_062.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Next, select B to join / the link attack.

MsgLabels_common_msg_063.en:
Finally, pick B's weapon.
...Right, the link attack is set.
MsgLabels_common_msg_063.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Finally, choose B's attack weapon. / ...Good, that completes the link attack.

MsgLabels_common_msg_064.en: The rest you'll learn in real combat.
MsgLabels_common_msg_064.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: The rest is to try it in real combat.

MsgLabels_common_msg_065.en:
Thought so.
You're a veteran merc, after all.
MsgLabels_common_msg_065.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see, of course. / As expected of a veteran mercenary.

MsgLabels_common_msg_066.en:
Alright.
More topics may be added as the
missions go on, so if anything's unclear
then, come and ask me.
MsgLabels_common_msg_066.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I see. / Items may be added as missions progress, / so if there's something you don't understand then, / ask me.

MsgLabels_common_msg_067.en:
When you enter the hangar, the menu
shows on the lower screen first.
[Wanzer Setup] lets you change a
wanzer's equipment and buy or sell
parts and items.
[Sell Unequipped Parts] sells parts
nobody on the team has equipped.
[Parts Collection] lets you browse
every part you've ever owned.
MsgLabels_common_msg_067.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: When you enter the hangar, first a menu / is displayed like on the lower screen. / In [Setup], / you can change WAP equipment, / and buy and sell parts and items. / [Sell Unequipped Parts] lets you sell / parts that no member / has equipped. / In [Parts Collection], / you can browse parts you've / obtained once.

MsgLabels_common_msg_068.en:
Let me walk you through
[Wanzer Setup].
First, choose the wanzer whose
equipment you want to change.
MsgLabels_common_msg_068.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: I'll specially explain the procedure / when you choose [Setup]. / First, select the vanzer / whose equipment you want to change.

MsgLabels_common_msg_069.en:
Next, choose the slot you want to
change. [Color] and [Armor Type] can
only be changed from this screen,
so keep that in mind.
MsgLabels_common_msg_069.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Next, select the part location you want to change. / Changing [Unit Color] and [Attribute Defense] / can only be selected from this screen, / so be careful.

MsgLabels_common_msg_070.en:
Choosing a slot puts you
in
[EQUIP PARTS] mode first.
To change equipment using what you
own, do it here.
MsgLabels_common_msg_070.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: When you select a location, / first it goes into / [Setup with Owned Items] mode. / If you change equipment with what you have, / it's possible in this mode.

MsgLabels_common_msg_071.en:
Next, how to set up while buying
parts.
Select the [Shop] panel, and...
MsgLabels_common_msg_071.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Next is how to set up / while buying parts. / Select the panel called [SHOP]...

MsgLabels_common_msg_072.en:
...you're in [BUY AND EQUIP] mode.
Parts you buy are equipped at once.
MsgLabels_common_msg_072.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: and it goes into [Buy and Setup] mode. / Bought parts are equipped right away.

MsgLabels_common_msg_073.en:
Select the [Sell Parts] panel on this
screen to sell parts
you own.
MsgLabels_common_msg_073.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: On this screen, if you select the panel / called [SELL], you can sell / parts you own.

MsgLabels_common_msg_074.en:
Unlike [Sell Unequipped Parts] in the
hangar menu, you can sell while
checking how the wanzer looks
with the part equipped.

Select the [Stock] panel to go back
to [EQUIP PARTS] mode.
MsgLabels_common_msg_074.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Unlike [Sell Unequipped Parts] / when entering the hangar, / you can sell while checking / how it looks equipped. /  / Select the [STOCK] panel / to return to [Setup with Owned Items] mode.

MsgLabels_common_msg_075.en:
Items work differently from other
parts, so pay attention.
After choosing the item slot, you
then choose where to put the item.
Once you've chosen the spot...
MsgLabels_common_msg_075.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Only equipping items is different from / other parts, so be careful. / For items, when you select the location, / you further select where to equip them. / When you decide where to equip...

MsgLabels_common_msg_076.en:
...the items you can equip appear,
so pick the one you want.
MsgLabels_common_msg_076.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: the items you can equip are displayed, / so select the item you want.

MsgLabels_common_msg_077.en:
It gets equipped, just as you see.
Also, for items only, a [Trade]
panel appears.
It lets you swap your equipped items
with another member's
equipped items.
Just follow the screen.
MsgLabels_common_msg_077.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: As shown on screen, it gets equipped. / Additionally, only for item equipping / a [TRADE] panel is displayed. / You can exchange your equipped items / with other members' / equipped items. / Follow the screen for the procedure.

MsgLabels_common_msg_078.en:
Here's a handy feature, too.
Tap the L/R icons on screen
or press L/R to switch
the slot you're setting up.
MsgLabels_common_msg_078.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Also, there are convenient functions, / so I'll explain. / Touch the L, R icons on screen / or use the L, R Buttons to change / the location being set up.

MsgLabels_common_msg_079.en:
Tap the X/Y icons on the lower screen
or press X/Y to switch
the wanzer you're setting up.
MsgLabels_common_msg_079.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Touch the X, Y icons on the lower screen / or use the X, Y Buttons to change / the vanzer being set up.

MsgLabels_common_msg_080.en:
Tap the [Sort] panel at top right
or press START to sort the
parts for the slot
you're equipping.
MsgLabels_common_msg_080.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Touch the [Sort] panel at the upper right / or press the START Button / to sort the parts / for the location you're currently choosing equipment for.

MsgLabels_common_msg_081.en:
To change the sort order, tap the
L/R icons on screen or press L/R
to sort by name, price
and so on.

That's the end of the tour.
It's simple once you've tried it,
but if you get stuck,
come and ask me again.
MsgLabels_common_msg_081.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: For the sort condition, / touch the L, R icons on screen, / or use the L, R Buttons to sort by name, / by price, etc. /  / That's the end of the explanation. / I think it's easy once you use it, / but if you get confused, / come ask me again.

Graphics_ending.en:
The fight by Delta and CISU to
uncover the truth bore fruit at last.
In 2094, the OCU and the USN both
admitted their involvement in the
Sakata Industries affair during
the Second Huffman Conflict.
Every conspiracy around the PS Plan,
Organization B and the weapon B.D.
seemed to have come to light.

But what shadow would the new B.D.
that Delta found cast on the future...?
None of them could know yet.
Graphics_ending.note:
Source: Claude's machine translation (MTL).
Literal: Delta and C.I.S.U.'s / battle to uncover the truth finally bore fruit, / and in 2094, both nations, the O.C.U. and U.S.N., / admitted involvement in / the Sakata Industry incident / during the Second Huffman Conflict. / With this, the conspiracy surrounding the PS plan, Organization B, and / the weapon called B.D. / seemed to have been entirely uncovered. /  / But what kind of shadow / the new B.D. Delta found / will cast on the future... / they have no way of knowing yet.
